chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Ikhono lokuzala ngohlobo "luyisici esiyisisekelo sazo zonke izinto eziphilayo. Ngohlobo"kusho ukuthi inzalo yento ephilayo ifana kakhulu nomzali wayo noma abazali bayo. Iimvubu zizala amathole emvubu, izihlahla zikaJoshua ziveza izithombo zemithi kaJoshua, kanti amaflamingo abekela amaqanda aqandusela amaphuphu e-flamingo. Ngohlobo kungasho okufanayo ncamashi. Izinto eziningi eziphilayo ezi-unicellular, njengemvubelo, kanye nezinto ezimbalwa ezi-multicellular, njengeziponji, zingakhiqiza ama-clone azo afanayo ngokwezakhi zofuzo ngokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Kodwa-ke, izinto eziningi ezi-single-cell kanye nezinto eziningi ezi-multicellular zizala njalo zisebenzisa indlela edinga abazali ababili. Ukuzala ngokocansi kwenzeka ngokukhiqizwa ngumzali ngamunye weseli le-haploid (eliqukethe ingxenye eyodwa yezinto ezidingekayo zezakhi zofuzo zenzalo) kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwala maseli amabili e-haploid ukwakha iseli elilodwa, eliyingqayizivele le-diploid elinesethi ephelele yolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo. Ezitshalweni nasezilwaneni eziningi, ngokusebenzisa imijikelezo eminingi yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-mitotic, leli seli le-diploid lizokhula libe yinto ephilayo endala. Amaseli e-haploid adingekayo ekuzaleni ngokocansi akhiqizwa uhlobo lokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli olubizwa ngokuthi i-meiosis. Ukuzala ngokocansi, ikakhulukazi i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa, kungenisa ukwehlukahlukana enzalweni. Ukuhlukahlukana kuyisici esibalulekile sempumelelo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo kohlobo. Iningi elikhulu lezinto eziphilayo ze-eukaryotic lisebenzisa uhlobo oluthile lwe-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa ukuze lizale.

 Akuwona wonke ama-eukaryotes azala ngokocansi azala kuphela ngokuzala ngokocansi. Isibonelo, uhlobo lwezintuthwane zase-Asia, i-Reticulitermes speratus, lungazala ngokocansi noma ngokungahambisani nocansi. Ekolonini elincane, umbhangqwana owodwa wezintuthwane—inkosi nendlovukazi—ukhiqiza inzalo eyisisebenzi ngokocansi ngokuhlangana kwamaseli e-haploid. Kodwa-ke, ngemva kweminyaka eminingana, njengoba indlovukazi iqala ukuguga, ikhiqiza inzalo ethile ngokungahambisani nocansi enkambisweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-parthenogenesis. Lezi nzalo, ezimiselwe ukuba yizindlovukazi ezintsha, azivundiswa yinkosi. Ziyizakhi zofuzo zendlovukazi. Bheka Umfanekiso 11.1
question1: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo zasendle sifunda ngohlobo lwexoxo olusengozini yokuqothulwa olunezakhi zofuzo ezincane kakhulu. Kungani ukwanda kokuzalana okuphumelelayo kungalindelwa ukuthi kuthuthukise ukusinda kwesikhathi eside kwabantu?
answer1: Ukuzala ngokocansi kwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo, kuthuthukisa ikhono labantu lokuzivumelanisa nezimo zemvelo ezishintshayo
distractor1a: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuveza inzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo zabazali bobabili
distractor1b: Ukuzala ngokocansi kususa izinguquko eziyingozi kuzo zonke izizukulwane
distractor1c: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuhlala kukhiqiza inzalo enama-chromosome amaningi kunabazali bayo
question2: Umtholampilo wokuzala uhlaziya ama-gametes abantu ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Lingakanani inani lama-chromosome elilindelekile kuseli elijwayelekile lesidoda somuntu?
question3: Abacwaningi baqhathanisa inzalo ekhiqizwa ngokuzala ngokocansi nenzalo ekhiqizwa ngokuzala okungenabo ubulili kuhlobo olufanayo. Yimuphi umphumela olindelekile?
answer3: Inzalo ekhiqizwe ngocansi ibonisa ukwehluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo kunenzalo ekhiqizwe ngaphandle kocansi
distractor3a: Inzalo ekhiqizwe ngaphandle kocansi ikhombisa ukwehluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo kunenzalo ekhiqizwe ngokocansi
distractor3b: Zombili lezi zindlela zihlala zikhiqiza inzalo efana ngokwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3c: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuhlala kukhiqiza ama-clone abazali bobabili
question4: Isazi sezitshalo sithola isitshalo esiqhakazayo esikhiqiza imbewu ngaphandle kokuvundisa. Yimuphi inqubo yokuzala ebonwayo?
answer4: I-Parthenogenesis
question5: Ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa komuntu, yisiphi isenzakalo esibuyisela inombolo ye-chromosome ye-diploid?
answer5: Ukuhlanganiswa kwama-gametes amabili e-haploid
question6: Isazi sezakhi zofuzo sichaza ukuthi i-meiosis inegalelo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo yize ingashintshi ngokuqondile ukulandelana kwe-DNA. Yisiphi isitatimende esisekela kangcono lesi simangalo?
answer6: I-Meiosis idala inhlanganisela entsha yama-allele akhona ngokusebenzisa ukuqoqwa okuzimele kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha
distractor6a: I-Meiosis idala izakhi zofuzo ezintsha kuzo zonke izizukulwane
distractor6b: I-Meiosis isusa unomphela ama-allele ayingozi kubantu
distractor6c: I-Meiosis iphinda kabili inani le-DNA kuyo yonke inzalo
question7: Ososayensi bafunda nge-termite Reticulitermes speratus. Izindlovukazi ezindala ngezinye izikhathi ziveza izindlovukazi ezintsha ngaphandle kokuvundisa. Yibuphi ubudlelwano obungaba khona phakathi kwezindlovukazi ezintsha nendlovukazi yokuqala?
answer7: Izindlovukazi ezintsha ziyizakhi zofuzo zendlovukazi yokuqala
distractor7a: Izindlovukazi ezintsha zizuza ingxenye ye-DNA yazo enkosini
distractor7b: Izindlovukazi ezintsha zifana ngokwezakhi zofuzo nenkosi
distractor7c: Izindlovukazi ezintsha ziqukethe ama-chromosome aphindwe kabili kunendlovukazi
question8: Inani lemvubelo lizala ngokuhluma kwe-mitotic ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle kodwa lishintshela ekuzaleni ngokocansi lapho izimo zemvelo ziba zicindezelayo. Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yalolu shintsho?
answer8: Ukuzala ngokocansi kwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo, kuthuthukisa amathuba okuba ezinye izingane zisinde ezimweni ezishintshayo
distractor8a: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuvumela amangqamuzana ukuba ahlukane ngokushesha kune-mitosis
distractor8b: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuqeda isidingo sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor8c: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke inzalo zifana ngokofuzo nomzali

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Ngocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Ngocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba sihlole umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis esahlukweni esedlule, sifunde ukuthi amangqamuzana ayahlukana ukuze akhule, athathe indawo yamanye amangqamuzana, futhi azale ngaphandle kocansi. Ngaphandle kokuguquka, noma izinguquko ku-DNA, amangqamuzana ayindodakazi akhiqizwa yi-mitosis athola isethi yemiyalelo yezakhi zofuzo efana neyeseli lomzali. Ngenxa yokuthi izinguquko ezakhiweni zofuzo ziqhuba ubunye kanye nokwehlukahluka kokuphila, izinto eziphilayo ezingenayo i-genetic variation azikwazi ukuguquka ngokukhetha kwemvelo. Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela ngoba izinto eziphilayo ziye zakha izindlela zokushintsha izinto zazo zezakhi zofuzo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ku-DNA, ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi se-meiosis, kanye ne-meiosis kulandelwa ukukhulelwa ezintweni eziphilayo ezizala ngokocansi.

 Ukuzala ngokocansi kudinga ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid (2n) zikhiqize amangqamuzana e-haploid (1n) nge-meiosis nokuthi lawa maseli e-haploid ahlangane ukuze akhe inzalo entsha, ye-diploid. Ukuhlangana kwala maseli amabili e-haploid, elilodwa elivela kumzali ngamunye, kuwukukhulelwa. Nakuba izinqubo ze-meiosis kanye ne-mitosis zifana, imikhiqizo yazo yokugcina ihlukile. Khumbula ukuthi i-DNA ye-eukaryotic iqukethwe kuma-chromosome, nokuthi ama-chromosome ayenzeka ngamabili afanayo (ama-homologues). Ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, umzali wesilisa unikela ilungu elilodwa lebhangqa ngalinye elifana nelakhe enzalweni, kanti umzali wesifazane unikela elinye. Ngaphandle kwama-chromosome ocansi, ama-chromosome afana nelakhe aqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezifanayo, kodwa lawa ma-gene angaba nokwehluka okuhlukile, okubizwa ngokuthi ama-allele. (Isibonelo, kungenzeka ukuthi uzuze i-allele yamehlo ansundu kubaba wakho kanye ne-allele yamehlo aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kumama wakho.) Njengase-mitosis, ama-chromosome afana nelakhe aphindaphindwa ngesikhathi se-S-stage (synthesis) ye-interphase. Kodwa-ke, ngokungafani ne-mitosis, lapho kukhona ukuhlukaniswa okukodwa kwe-nuclear, i-meiosis inezindilinga ezimbili eziphelele zokuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear—i-meiosis I kanye ne-meiosis II. Lokhu kuphumela kuma-nuclei amane kanye (ngokuvamile) namaseli endodakazi amane, ngalinye linengxenye yenani lama-chromosome njengeseli lomzali (1n). Ukuhlukaniswa kokuqala, i-meiosis I, kuhlukanisa ama-chromosome afana nelakhe, kanti ukuhlukaniswa kwesibili, i-meiosis II, kuhlukanisa ama-chromatids. (Khumbula: ngesikhathi se-meiosis, i-DNA iphindaphinda KANYE kodwa ihlukanise KABILI, kanti ku-mitosis, i-DNA iphindaphinda KANYE kodwa ihlukanise KANYE kuphela.).

 Nakuba i-mitosis ne-meiosis zifana ngezindlela eziningi, zinemiphumela ehlukene. Umehluko omkhulu usehlotsheni lweseli elikhiqizwayo: i-mitosis ikhiqiza amaseli afanayo, okuvumela ukukhula noma ukulungiswa kwezicubu; i-meiosis ikhiqiza amaseli okuzala, noma ama-gametes. Ama-gametes, avame ukubizwa ngokuthi amaseli ocansi, ahlangana namanye amaseli ocansi ukukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo ezintsha, ezihlukile.

 Ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka ngesikhathi se-meiosis I, lapho ama-chromosome afanayo ebhangqa futhi eshintshana ngezingxenye ze-chromatid ezingezona ezikadadewabo (i-crossover). Lapha ama-chromosome afanayo ahlukana abe ama-nuclei ahlukene, okubangela ukwehla kwe-ploidy.” Ngesikhathi se-meiosis II—efana kakhulu nokuhlukaniswa kwe-mitotic—ama-chromatids ayahlukana futhi ahlukanise abe amaseli amane ocansi e-haploid. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa ye-crossover, amaseli endodakazi aphumayo awaqukethe ama-genome afanayo. Njengase-mitosis, izici zangaphandle nezimpawu zangaphakathi zilawula umjikelezo weseli we-meiotic. Njengoba sizohlola kabanzi esahlukweni esilandelayo, amaphutha ku-meiosis angabangela ukuphazamiseka kwezakhi zofuzo, njenge-Down syndrome.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Okuzuzwayo Ulwazi luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.9 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha incazelo, esebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo noma izindaba, mayelana nendlela i-DNA kuma-chromosome edluliselwa ngayo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo nge-mitosis, noma i-meiosis elandelwa ukuchumisa.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izehlakalo namamodeli kuzo zonke izindawo kanye Izikali zesikhashana.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.10 Umfundi uyakwazi ukumela ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-meiosis kanye nokwanda kokwehlukahlukana kwezakhi zofuzo okudingekayo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:

 Ufunda ukuthi ukukhulelwa kuwukuhlangana kwamaseli amabili ocansi avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezimbili ngazinye. Uma lawa maseli amabili ngalinye liqukethe isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome, iseli elivundisiwe elivelayo liqukethe amasethi amabili ama-chromosome. Amaseli e-Haploid aqukethe isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome. Amaseli aqukethe amasethi amabili ama-chromosome abizwa ngokuthi i-diploid. Inani lamasethi ama-chromosome esitokisini libizwa ngokuthi izinga lalo le-ploidy. Uma umjikelezo wokuzala uzoqhubeka, iseli le-diploid kumele linciphise inani lamasethi alo ama-chromosome ngaphambi kokuba ukukhulelwa kuphinde kwenzeke. Ngaphandle kwalokho, inani lamasethi e-chromosome lizophindeka kabili, futhi liqhubeke liphindwe kabili kuzo zonke izizukulwane. Ngakho-ke, ngaphezu kokukhulelwa, ukuzala ngokocansi kuhlanganisa ukuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear okunciphisa inani lamasethi e-chromosome.

 Izilwane eziningi nezitshalo ziyi-diploid, equkethe amasethi amabili ama-chromosome. Emaseli omzimba womuntu, ngezinye izikhathi abizwa ngokuthi amaseli omzimba (wonke amaseli ento ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi ngaphandle kwamaseli okuzala), i-nucleus iqukethe amakhophi amabili e-chromosome ngayinye, abizwa ngokuthi ama-chromosome e-homologous. Ama-chromosome e-homologous angamabhangqa afanayo aqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezifanayo ezindaweni ezifanayo ngobude bawo. Izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid zithola ikhophi eyodwa ye-chromosome ngayinye e-homologous kumzali ngamunye; konke ndawonye, kubhekwa njengesethi ephelele yama-chromosome. Amaseli e-Haploid, aqukethe ikhophi eyodwa ye-chromosome ngayinye e-homologous, atholakala kuphela ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo zokuzala zento ephilayo, njengeziqanda nama-testes. Amaseli e-Haploid angaba ama-gametes noma ama-spores. Ama-gametes esilisa ayi-sperm kanti ama-gametes esifazane angamaqanda. Zonke izilwane nezitshalo eziningi zikhiqiza ama-gametes. Ama-spores angamaseli e-haploid angakhiqiza into ephilayo ye-haploid noma angahlangana nenye i-spores ukuze akhe iseli le-diploid. Ezinye izitshalo nazo zonke izikhunta zikhiqiza ama-spores.

 Njengoba usufundile, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear okwakha amaseli e-haploid—i-meiosis—kuhlobene kakhulu ne-mitosis. I-Mitosis yingxenye yomjikelezo wokuzala kweseli ophumela kuma-nuclei endodakazi afanayo nawofuzo afana ne-nucleus yomzali wokuqala. Ku-mitosis, bobabili ama-nuclei omzali nendodakazi basezingeni elifanayo le-ploidy—i-diploid yezitshalo nezilwane eziningi. I-Meiosis isebenzisa izindlela eziningi ezifanayo ne-mitosis. Kodwa-ke, i-nucleus yokuqala ihlala iyi-diploid kanti ama-nuclei aphumela ekupheleni kokuhlukaniswa kweseli le-meiotic angama-haploid. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu kuncipha kwenombolo ye-chromosome, i-meiosis iqukethe umjikelezo owodwa wokuphindaphindwa kwe-chromosome kanye nemijikelezo emibili yokuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear. Ngenxa yokuthi izehlakalo ezenzeka ngesikhathi ngasinye sesigaba sokuhlukaniswa zifana nezehlakalo ze-mitosis, amagama esigaba afanayo abelwe. Kodwa-ke, ngoba kunemijikelezo emibili yokuhlukaniswa, inqubo enkulu kanye nezigaba zibizwa nge-I” noma i-II.” Ngakho-ke, i-meiosis I iyindilinga yokuqala yokuhlukaniswa kwe-meiotic futhi iqukethe i-prophase I, i-prometaphase I, njalo njalo. I-Meiosis II, lapho kwenzeka khona indilinga yesibili yokuhlukaniswa kwe-meiotic, ihlanganisa i-prophase II, i-prometaphase II, njalo njalo.
question1: Umcwaningi uqhathanisa amangqamuzana esikhumba namaseli esidoda avela kumuntu ofanayo. Iyiphi inqubo ebangela ukukhiqiza amangqamuzana esidoda anesigamu senani lama-chromosome?
answer1: I-Meiosis
question2: Iseli lomuntu elinomzimba lidlula ku-meiosis. Mangaki amangqamuzana amantombazane akhiqizwayo, futhi iyini inombolo yawo ye-chromosome?
answer2: Amaseli amane e-haploid, ngalinye liqukethe ama-chromosome angu-23
distractor2a: Amaseli amabili e-diploid, ngalinye liqukethe ama-chromosome angu-46
distractor2b: Amaseli amane e-diploid, ngalinye liqukethe ama-chromosome angu-46
distractor2c: Amaseli amabili e-haploid, ngalinye liqukethe ama-chromosome angu-23
question3: Umfundi webhayoloji uthi i-meiosis kanye ne-mitosis zombili zikhiqiza amangqamuzana endodakazi afana ngofuzo. Yisiphi isitatimende esilungisa kangcono lo mbono ongalungile?
answer3: I-Meiosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana e-haploid ahlukile ngokofuzo ngoba ama-chromosome afanayo aphinde ahlanganiswe futhi ahlukaniswe ngokuzimela
distractor3a: I-Meiosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana e-diploid afanayo ngokofuzo
distractor3b: I-Mitosis ikhiqiza amaseli e-haploid ahlukile ngokofuzo
distractor3c: Kokubili i-meiosis ne-mitosis kukhiqiza amaseli endodakazi afanayo e-haploid
question4: Ngesikhathi sokuzala komuntu, yisiphi isenzakalo esibuyisela inombolo ye-chromosome ye-diploid ngemva kokuba i-meiosis ikhiqize ama-gametes e-haploid?
answer4: Ukuvundisa
question5: Isifo sofuzo sibangelwa iphutha ngesikhathi se-meiosis lapho ama-chromosome afanayo ehluleka khona ukuhlukana kahle. Leli phutha lithinta ngqo yiphi inqubo?
answer5: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome ngesikhathi se-meiosis
question6: Yisiphi isenzakalo esinomthelela ngqo ekushintsheni kwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi se-meiosis I?
answer6: Ukuwela phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona odade bama-chromosome ahambisanayo
distractor6b: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromatids angodadewabo ngesikhathi se-meiosis II
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle i-mitosis ne-meiosis?
answer7: I-Mitosis igcina inombolo yama-chromosome, kanti i-meiosis inciphisa inombolo yama-chromosome ngesigamu
distractor7a: Kokubili i-mitosis ne-meiosis kunciphisa inani lama-chromosome ngesigamu
distractor7b: I-Meiosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana endodakazi afanayo, kanti i-mitosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana ahlukene ngofuzo
distractor7c: I-Mitosis ihilela imijikelezo emibili yokuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear, kanti i-meiosis ihilela eyodwa
question8: Usosayensi ofunda ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo uthi i-meiosis ibalulekile ekukhetheni kwemvelo. Iyiphi incazelo esekela kangcono lesi sitatimende?
answer8: I-Meiosis ikhulisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwenzalo, okwenza kube nokuhlukahluka okusebenza kukho ukukhetha kwemvelo
distractor8a: I-Meiosis isusa zonke izinguquko eziyingozi kubantu
distractor8b: I-Meiosis iqinisekisa ukuthi yonke inzalo izuza inhlanganisela engcono kakhulu yama-allele
distractor8c: I-Meiosis ivimbela ukuguquka kwe-DNA ukuthi kwenzeke ngesikhathi sokuzala

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I
chapterContent:
I-Meiosis yandulelwa yi-interphase equkethe izigaba ze-G1, S, kanye ne-G2, ezicishe zifane nezigaba ezandulela i-mitosis. Isigaba se-G1, esibizwa nangokuthi isigaba sokuqala se-gap, yisigaba sokuqala se-interphase futhi sigxile ekukhuleni kwamaseli. Isigaba se-S yisigaba sesibili se-interphase, lapho i-DNA yama-chromosome iphindaphindwa khona. Ekugcineni, isigaba se-G2, esibizwa nangokuthi isigaba sesibili se-gap, yisigaba sesithathu nesokugcina se-interphase; kulesi sigaba, iseli lidlula emalungiselelweni okugcina e-meiosis.

 Ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA esigabeni se-S, i-chromosome ngayinye iyaphindaphindwa ukuze kukhiqizwe amakhophi amabili afanayo, abizwa ngokuthi ama-chromatids angodadewabo, abanjwe ndawonye ku-centromere ngamaprotheni e-cohesin. I-Cohesin ibamba ama-chromatids ndawonye kuze kube yi-anaphase II. Ama-centrosome, okuyizakhiwo ezihlela ama-microtubules e-meiotic spindle, nawo ayaphindaphindwa. Lokhu kulungiselela iseli ukungena kwi-prophase I, isigaba sokuqala se-meiotic
question1: Usosayensi uhlola amangqamuzana angena ku-meiosis I futhi uqaphela ukuthi i-chromosome ngayinye iqukethe ama-chromatid amabili afanayo. La ma-chromatid angodade akhiqizwa ngasiphi isigaba?
answer1: Isigaba S se-interphase
question2: Umcwaningi ususa amaprotheni e-cohesin ngokuhlola ngaphambi kokuba i-meiosis II iqale. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
distractor2a: Ama-chromosome ahambisanayo ayehluleka ukuhlangana ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor2c: Ukuwela ngeke kusakwenzeka ngesikhathi se-prophase I
question3: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ama-centrosome ukuthi angaphindaphindi ngesikhathi sokuhlangana kwesigaba ngaphambi kwe-meiosis. Yisiphi isakhiwo seseli esingase sihluleke ukwakheka kahle?
answer3: I-meiotic spindle
question4: Yisiphi isenzakalo esenzeka ngesikhathi sokuhlangana kwesigaba ngaphambi kwe-meiosis kodwa ASENZI ngesikhathi se-meiosis I uqobo?
answer4: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
question5: Umfundi uthi i-DNA iphindaphindwa ngaphambi kokubili i-meiosis I kanye ne-meiosis II. Yisiphi isitatimende esihlola kahle lesi simangalo?
answer5: I-DNA iphindaphindwa kanye kuphela, ngaphambi kwe-meiosis I, hhayi ngaphambi kwe-meiosis II
distractor5a: I-DNA iphindaphindwa ngaphambi kokuhlukaniswa kokubili kwe-meiotic
distractor5b: I-DNA iphindaphindwa kuphela ngaphambi kwe-meiosis II
question6: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima yamaprotheni e-cohesin ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer6: Babamba ama-chromatids angodade ndawonye kuze kube yilapho ehlukana ngesikhathi se-anaphase II
distractor6a: Zixhumanisa ama-chromosome afanayo kuze kube yi-anaphase I
distractor6c: Zikhuthaza ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Prophase I
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Prophase I
chapterContent:
Ekuqaleni kwe-prophase I, ngaphambi kokuba ama-chromosome abonakale ngokucacile nge-microscope, ama-chromosome afanayo anamathele eziqongweni zawo e-nuclear envelope ngamaprotheni. Njengoba i-nuclear envelope iqala ukuwohloka, amaprotheni ahlobene nama-chromosome afanayo asondeza lezi zibili eduze komunye nomunye. Khumbula ukuthi, ku-mitosis, ama-chromosome afanayo awahlangani ndawonye. Ku-mitosis, ama-chromosome afanayo alandelana kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni ukuze lapho ehlukana, iseli ngalinye lendodakazi lithola i-chromatid engudadewabo kuwo womabili amalungu e-homologous pair. I-synaptonemal complex, i-lattice yamaprotheni phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo, iqala ukwakheka ezindaweni ezithile bese isakazeka ukuze imboze ubude bonke bama-chromosome. Ukuhlanganiswa okuqinile kwama-chromosome afanayo kubizwa ngokuthi i-synapsis. Ku-synapsis, izakhi zofuzo kuma-chromatids ama-chromosome afanayo zihambisana kahle. I-synaptonemal complex isekela ukushintshaniswa kwezingxenye ze-chromosome phakathi kwama-chromatids angama-homologous angewona angodade, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi ukuwela. Ukuwela kungabonakala ngokubonakalayo ngemva kokushintshana njenge-chiasmata (isinye = i-chiasma) (Isithombe 11.2).

 Ezinhlotsheni ezifana nabantu, yize ama-chromosome obulili buka-X no-Y engekho afanayo (iningi lama-gene awo ayahluka), anesifunda esincane se-homology esivumela ama-chromosome ka-X no-Y ukuthi ahlangane ngesikhathi se-prophase I. I-synaptonemal complex engaphelele ikhula kuphela phakathi kwezifunda ze-homology.

 Ezitholakala ngezikhathi ezithile eduze kwe-synaptonemal complex kunezinhlangano ezinkulu zamaprotheni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-recombination nodules. Lezi zinhlangano ziphawula amaphuzu e-chiasmata yakamuva futhi ziqondisa inqubo yezinyathelo eziningi ze-crossover—noma i-genetic recombination—phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade. Eduze kwe-recombination nodule ku-chromatid ngayinye, i-DNA enezintambo ezimbili iyaqhekeka, iziphetho ezisikiwe ziyaguqulwa, futhi ukuxhumana okusha kwenziwa phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade. Njengoba i-prophase I iqhubeka, i-synaptonemal complex iqala ukuwohloka futhi ama-chromosome aqala ukuqina. Lapho i-synaptonemal complex isihambile, ama-chromosome afanayo ahlala enamathele komunye nomunye ku-centromere naku-chiasmata. I-chiasmata ihlala kuze kube yi-anaphase I. Inani le-chiasmata liyahlukahluka kuye ngohlobo kanye nobude be-chromosome. Kumelwe kube okungenani i-chiasma eyodwa nge-chromosome ngayinye ukuze kuhlukaniswe kahle ama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-meiosis I, kodwa kungaba khona okungafika ku-25. Ngemva kwe-crossover, i-synaptonemal complex iyaphuka futhi uxhumano lwe-cohesin phakathi kwama-pair afanayo nalo luyasuswa. Ekupheleni kwe-prophase I, ama-pair abanjwa ndawonye kuphela ku-chiasmata (Isithombe 11.3) futhi abizwa ngokuthi ama-tetrad ngoba ama-chromatids amane angodadewabo e-pair ngayinye yama-chromosome afanayo manje ayabonakala.

 Imicimbi ye-crossover ingumthombo wokuqala wokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-nuclei akhiqizwa yi-meiosis. Isenzakalo esisodwa sokuhlanganisa ama-chromatid angewona angodade afanayo siholela ekushintshisaneni kwe-DNA efanayo phakathi kwe-chromosome kamama ne-chromosome kababa. Manje, lapho leyo chromatid kadadewabo ithuthelwa esitokisini se-gamete izothwala i-DNA ethile evela kumzali oyedwa womuntu kanye ne-DNA ethile evela komunye umzali. I-chromatid kadadewabo ephinde ihlanganiswe inenhlanganisela yezakhi zofuzo zikamama nezobaba ezazingekho ngaphambi kokudlulela ...
question1: Yisiphi isenzakalo esiyingqayizivele se-prophase I se-meiosis esibangela ngokuyinhloko ukwanda kokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ukuwela phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona odade bama-chromosome ahambisanayo
question2: Umcwaningi ubona ama-chromosome afanayo ahlanganiswe ngokuqinile kulo lonke ubude bawo ngesikhathi se-meiosis. Kubizwa ngokuthini lokhu kubhangqa?
question3: Yisiphi isakhiwo samaprotheni esakha phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo futhi esiza ukuwela phakathi kwe-prophase I?
answer3: I-Synaptonemal complex
question4: Isazi sezakhi zofuzo sithola indawo ebonakalayo lapho kwenzeke khona ukuwela phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo. Sibizwa ngokuthini lesi sakhiwo esibonakalayo?
answer4: I-Chiasma
question5: Ukuwela kwenzeka phakathi kwaziphi i-chromatids?
answer5: Ama-chromatids angewona odade bama-chromosome afanayo
question6: Kungani ukuwela ngaphesheya kubhekwa njengomthombo obalulekile wokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Kwakha ama-chromosome aphinde ahlanganiswe aqukethe i-DNA kamama nekababa
question7: Ama-chromosome e-X kanye ne-Y omuntu ayakwazi ukuhlangana ngesikhathi se-prophase I ngoba:
answer7: Yabelana ngesifunda esincane esifana nesinye esivumela i-synapsis
question8: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ukwakheka kwe-synaptonemal complex ngesikhathi se-meiosis. Yimuphi inqubo engaphazamiseka kakhulu?
answer8: Ukuwela phakathi kwama-chromosomes afanayo
distractor8b: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromatids angodadewabo ngesikhathi se-meiosis II
question9: Amaqhubu okuhlanganisa atholakala ku-synaptonemal complex abalulekile ngoba:
answer9: Lungisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokumaka izindawo lapho kuwela khona
question10: Kungani kudingeka okungenani i-chiasma eyodwa kumbhangqwana ngamunye we-chromosome efanayo?
answer10: Kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuhlukaniswa okufanele kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
distractor10a: Iqala ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA ngaphambi kwe-meiosis II
distractor10b: Ivumela ama-chromatids angodade ukuthi ahlukane ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
distractor10c: Ivimbela ama-chromosome afanayo ukuthi angahlangani ngesikhathi sokuhlanganisana

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Prometaphase I
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Prometaphase I
chapterContent: Isenzakalo esibalulekile ku-prometaphase I ukunamatheliswa kwama-microtubules e-spindle fiber kumaprotheni e-kinetochore kuma-centromeres. Amaprotheni e-Kinetochore ayizinhlanganisela zama-protein amaningi ezibopha ama-centromeres e-chromosome kuma-microtubules e-mitotic spindle. Ama-Microtubules akhula kusuka kuma-centrosome abekwe ezigxotsheni eziphambene zeseli. Ama-microtubules aya maphakathi neseli futhi anamathele kwenye yama-chromosome amabili e-homologous ahlanganisiwe. Ama-microtubules anamathela kuma-chromosomes ngayinye ama-kinetochores. Ngelungu ngalinye le-homologous pair linamathele ezigxotsheni eziphambene zeseli, esigabeni esilandelayo, ama-microtubules angadonsa i-homologous pair ihlukane. I-spindle fiber enamathele kwi-kinetochore ibizwa ngokuthi i-kinetochore microtubule. Ekupheleni kwe-prometaphase I, i-tetrad ngayinye inamathele kuma-microtubules avela kuzo zombili izigxobo, kanye ne-chromosome eyodwa ehambelanayo ebheke igxobo ngalinye. Ama-chromosome e-homologous asabanjwe ndawonye ku-chiasmata. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-membrane yenuzi iphukile ngokuphelele
question1: Ngesikhathi se-prometaphase I, ama-microtubules e-spindle aqala ukunamathela kusiphi isakhiwo se-chromosome?
answer1: I-kinetochore
question2: Umcwaningi usebenzisa umuthi ovimbela amaprotheni e-kinetochore ekubopheni ama-microtubules e-spindle ngesikhathi se-meiosis I. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer2: Ama-chromosome ahambisanayo azohluleka ukuhlukana kahle ngesikhathi se-anaphase I
distractor2c: Ama-chromatids angodade azohlukana ngesikhathi se-prometaphase I
question3: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle ukuqondiswa kwe-chromosome ekupheleni kwe-prometaphase I?
answer3: I-chromosome ngayinye efana nayo inamathele kuma-spindle fibers avela ezigxotsheni eziphambene zeseli
distractor3a: I-chromatid ngayinye kadade inamathele ezigxotsheni eziphambene
distractor3b: I-chromosome ngayinye efana nayo inamathele esigxotsheni esifanayo se-spindle
question4: Yisiphi isakhiwo esiqhubeka nokubamba ama-chromosome afanayo ndawonye ngesikhathi se-prometaphase I ngemva kokuba i-synaptonemal complex isinyamalele?
answer4: I-Chiasmata
question5: I-fibre ye-spindle enamathiselwe kwi-kinetochore yama-chromosome ibizwa ngokuqondile ngokuthi:
answer5: I-Kinetochore microtubule
question6: Yimuphi umcimbi omkhulu osuqediwe ekupheleni kwe-prometaphase I?
answer6: Imvilophu yenuzi iphukile ngokuphelele
question7: Kungani ukunamathela kwama-chromosome afanayo ezigxotsheni eziphambene kubalulekile ngesikhathi se-prometaphase I?
answer7: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-chromosome afanayo angahlukaniswa ngokunembile ngesikhathi se-anaphase I
distractor7a: Ivumela ama-chromatids angodade ukuthi ahlukane ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
distractor7c: Kubangela ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA ngaphambi kwe-meiosis II

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Metaphase I
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Metaphase I
chapterContent:
Ngesikhathi se-metaphase I, ama-chromosome afanayo ahlelwe maphakathi neseli kanye nama-kinetochores abheke ezigxotsheni eziphambene. Ama-pair afanayo aziqondisa ngokungahleliwe e-equator. Isibonelo, uma amalungu amabili afanayo e-chromosome 1 ebhalwe u-a no-b, khona-ke ama-chromosome angalandelana u-a-b, noma u-b-a. Lokhu kubalulekile ekunqumeni izakhi zofuzo ezithwalwa yi-gamete, njengoba ngayinye izothola eyodwa kuphela kuma-chromosome amabili afanayo. Khumbula ukuthi ama-chromosome afanayo awafani. Aqukethe umehluko omncane olwazini lwawo lwezakhi zofuzo, okwenza i-gamete ngayinye ibe nokwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile.

 Lokhu kungahleliwe kuyisisekelo esingokwenyama sokudalwa kohlobo lwesibili lokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo enzalweni. Cabanga ukuthi ama-chromosome afanayo ezinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi aqale azuzwe njengeqoqo ezimbili ezihlukene, elilodwa elivela kumzali ngamunye. Usebenzisa abantu njengesibonelo, isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome angu-23 ikhona eqandeni elinikelwe ngumama. Ubaba unikeza elinye isethi lama-chromosome angu-23 esidodaneni esivundisa iqanda. Iseli ngalinye lenzalo enamangqamuzana amaningi linamakhophi amasethi amabili okuqala ama-chromosome afanayo. Ku-prophase I ye-meiosis, ama-chromosome afanayo akha ama-tetrad. Ku-metaphase I, la mabhangqa ahlangana endaweni ephakathi kwezinsika ezimbili zeseli ukuze akhe ipuleti le-metaphase. Ngenxa yokuthi kunethuba elilinganayo lokuthi i-microtubule fiber izohlangana ne-chromosome ezuzwe njengomama noma njengoyise, ukuhlelwa kwama-tetrad epuletini le-metaphase kuhleliwe. Noma iyiphi i-chromosome ezuzwe njengomama ingabhekana nanoma yiliphi ipuleti. Noma iyiphi i-chromosome ezuzwe njengoyise ingabhekana nanoma yiliphi ipuleti. Ukuqondiswa kwe-tetrad ngayinye kuzimele ekuqondisweni kwamanye ama-tetrad angu-22.

 Lesi senzakalo—ukuhlanganiswa okungahleliwe (noma okuzimele) kwama-chromosome afanayo epuletini le-metaphase—yindlela yesibili ethula ukuhlukahluka kuma-gametes noma ama-spores. Kuseli ngalinye elidlula i-meiosis, ukuhlelwa kwama-tetrad kuhlukile. Inani lokuhlukahluka lincike enanini lama-chromosome akha isethi. Kunezindlela ezimbili zokuqondiswa epuletini le-metaphase; Ngakho-ke inani elingenzeka lokuqondanisa lilingana no-2n, lapho u-n kuyinani lama-chromosome ngesethi ngayinye. Abantu banezibhangqa ze-chromosome ezingu-23, okuholela kuma-gametes angaphezu kwezigidi eziyisishiyagalombili (223) ahluke ngokwezakhi zofuzo. Leli nani alifaki ukuguquguquka okwadalwa ngaphambilini kuma-chromatids angodadewabo nge-crossover. Njengoba kunikezwe lezi zindlela ezimbili, akunakwenzeka ukuthi noma yimaphi amaseli amabili e-haploid avela ku-meiosis abe nokwakheka okufanayo kwezakhi zofuzo (Isithombe 11.4).

 Ukufingqa imiphumela yezakhi zofuzo ye-meiosis I, izakhi zofuzo zikamama nobaba zihlanganiswa kabusha yimicimbi ye-crossover eyenzeka phakathi kwebhangqa ngalinye elifana ngesikhathi se-prophase I. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqoqwa okungahleliwe kwama-tetrad epuletini le-metaphase kukhiqiza inhlanganisela eyingqayizivele yama-chromosome kamama nobaba azongena kuma-gametes.
question1: Yisiphi isenzakalo esenzeka ngesikhathi se-metaphase I esibangela umthombo wesibili omkhulu wokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo ku-meiosis?
answer1: Iqoqo elizimele lama-chromosome afanayo
question2: Umfundi uqaphela ukuthi i-chromosome eyodwa efana nayo ebhangqweni ibhekene nensika yesobunxele kuyilapho umlingani wayo ebhekene nensika yesokudla ngesikhathi se-metaphase I. Yini enquma lokhu kuqondiswa?
answer2: Ukuqondiswa kuhleliwe futhi akuxhomekile kwamanye ama-chromosome pair
distractor2a: Ama-chromosome kamama ahlala ebhekene nensika efanayo
distractor2b: Ama-chromosome kayise ahlala ebhekene nensika ephambene
question3: Iseli lomuntu lidlula ku-meiosis ngaphandle kokuwela ngaphesheya. Cishe zingaki izinhlobo ze-gametes ezihlukile zofuzo ezingase zikhiqizwe ngokuqoqwa okuzimele kuphela?
answer3: Ngaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-8
question4: Ukuhlukahluka okuzimele kwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi:
answer4: Ipheya ngalinye le-chromosome elihambisanayo livumelana ngokuzimela kuzo zonke ezinye izinhlangothi epuletini le-metaphase
distractor4a: Ama-chromatids angodade ahlukana ngokungahleliwe ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
distractor4b: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kwethula ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okungahleliwe
question5: Umeluleki wezakhi zofuzo uchaza ukuthi izingane zakubo zingazuza inhlanganisela ehlukene yama-chromosome kamama nobaba ngisho nangaphandle kokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo. Yisiphi isenzakalo esichaza lokhu kangcono?
answer5: Ukuqondiswa okungahleliwe kwama-chromosome pair angama-homologous ngesikhathi se-metaphase I
question6: Ku-metaphase I, ama-chromosome aqondana ngasiphi isakhiwo?
answer6: Ipuleti le-metaphase
question7: Kungani ama-gametes amabili akhiqizwa ngumuntu ofanayo engavamile ukufana ngokwezakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ukuwela kanye nokuqoqwa okuzimele kukhiqiza inhlanganisela ehlukene yama-allele ku-gamete ngayinye
distractor7a: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kukhiqiza ukulandelana kwe-DNA okuhlukile kuwo wonke ama-chromosome
distractor7b: I-gamete ngayinye ithola ama-chromosome kumzali oyedwa kuphela
distractor7c: Inombolo ye-chromosome ishintsha ngokungahleliwe ngesikhathi se-meiosis
question8: Umcwaningi uvimbela ama-chromosome afanayo ukuthi angavumelani ngokungahleliwe ngesikhathi se-metaphase I. Yimuphi umphumela okungenzeka kakhulu?
answer8: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwama-gametes kuzoncishiswa
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuhlukahluka okuzimele?
answer9: I-pair ngayinye ye-chromosome efanayo ihlukana ngokuzimela komunye nomunye ngesikhathi se-meiosis I.
distractor9a: Izakhi zofuzo eziku-chromosome efanayo zihlala zizuzwa ndawonye
distractor9b: Ama-chromatids angodade ahlukahluka ngokuzimela ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
distractor9c: Ama-chromosome aphindaphinda ngokuzimela ngesikhathi se-meiosis II
question10: Kubantu, ukubalwa okungu-223 kumele:
answer10: Inani lenhlanganisela yama-chromosome engenzeka ekhiqizwa yiqoqo elizimele lodwa
distractor10a: Inani lama-chromosomes kuseli le-diploid ngemuva kwe-meiosis
distractor10b: Inani lezehlakalo ze-crossover ezilindelwe ngesikhathi se-meiosis

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Anaphase I
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Anaphase I
chapterContent: Ku-anaphase I, ama-microtubules adonsa ama-chromosome axhunyiwe ahlukane. Ama-chromatids angodade ahlala eboshwe ngokuqinile ndawonye ku-centromere. Ama-chiasmata aphukile ku-anaphase I njengoba ama-microtubules anamathele kuma-kinetochores ahlanganisiwe edonsa ama-chromosome ahambisanayo ahlukane (Isithombe 11.5)
question1: Yini ehlukanisa i-meiosis ngesikhathi se-anaphase I?
answer1: Ama-chromosome afanayo
question2: Yisiphi isakhiwo esihlala sinjalo ngesikhathi se-anaphase I, esivimbela ama-chromatids angodade ukuthi ahlukane?
question3: Kwenzekani ku-chiasmata ngesikhathi se-anaphase I?
answer3: Ziyaphuka njengoba ama-chromosome afanayo ehlukaniswa
question4: Kungani ama-chromatids angodade ehlala ndawonye ngesikhathi se-anaphase I?
answer4: Amaprotheni e-cohesin ku-centromere ahlala engashintshi
question5: Umcwaningi ubona ama-chromosome ehamba eya ezingosini eziphambene kuyilapho i-chromosome ngayinye isakhiwa ama-chromatids amabili angodadewabo. Yisiphi isigaba se-meiotic esibhekwayo?
answer5: I-Anaphase I
question6: Yisiphi isenzakalo esibangela ngqo ama-chromosome afanayo ukuthi ahambe aye ezigxotsheni eziphambene ngesikhathi se-anaphase I?
answer6: Ukufinyezwa kwama-kinetochore microtubules anamathele kuma-chromosome afanayo
question7: I-anaphase I ihluke kanjani ku-anaphase ye-mitosis?
answer7: Ama-chromosome afanayo ahlukene ku-meiosis I, kanti ama-chromatids angodade ahlukene ku-mitosis
distractor7a: Ama-chromatid angodade ayahlukana ku-meiosis I kodwa ama-chromosome afanayo ayahlukana ku-mitosis
distractor7b: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi se-anaphase I
question8: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela i-chiasmata ukuthi iphuke ngesikhathi se-anaphase I. Yimuphi umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer8: Ama-chromosome afanayo angase ahluleke ukuhlukana kahle
question9: Iyini ukwakheka kwe-chromosome ku-pole ngayinye ngokushesha ngemva kokuba i-anaphase I isiqediwe?
answer9: I-chromosome eyodwa evela kumbhangqwana ngamunye ofana nawo, kanti i-chromosome ngayinye isakhiwa ama-chromatids amabili angodadewabo
distractor9a: I-chromatid eyodwa evela kubhangqa ngalinye elifana nelinye
distractor9c: Ama-chromatids amane angodade avela kubhangqa ngalinye elifana nelinye
question10: Iseli legciwane lomuntu liyabonwa ngesikhathi se-anaphase I. Mangaki ama-chromosome ahamba aye esigxotsheni ngasinye?
answer10: Ama-chromosome angu-23, ngalinye lisakhiwa ama-chromatids amabili angodadewabo
distractor10c: Ama-chromosome angu-46, ngalinye lakhiwe ama-chromatids amabili angodadewabo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Telophase I kanye ne-Cytokinesis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis I | I-Telophase I kanye ne-Cytokinesis
chapterContent:
Ku-telophase, ama-chromosome ahlukene afika ezigxotsheni eziphambene. Okusele kwezehlakalo ezijwayelekile ze-telophase kungenzeka noma kungenzeki, kuye ngohlobo. Kwezinye izinto eziphilayo, ama-chromosome ahlukanayo kanye nezimbobo zenuzi zakha azungeze ama-chromatids ku-telophase I. Kwezinye izinto eziphilayo, i-cytokinesis—ukuhlukaniswa ngokomzimba kwezingxenye ze-cytoplasmic zibe amaseli amabili endodakazi—kwenzeka ngaphandle kokuguqulwa kwe-nuclei. Cishe kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane kanye nesikhunta esithile, i-cytokinesis ihlukanisa okuqukethwe kweseli ngomsele oqhekekile (ukuncishiswa kwendandatho ye-actin okuholela ekuhlukanisweni kwe-cytoplasmic). Ezitshalweni, ipuleti leseli lakhiwa ngesikhathi i-cytokinesis yeseli yi-Golgi vesicles ehlangana epuletini le-metaphase. Leli puleti leseli ekugcineni lizoholela ekwakhekeni kwezindonga zeseli ezihlukanisa amaseli amabili endodakazi.

 Amaseli amabili e-haploid angumphumela wokugcina wokuhlukaniswa kokuqala kwe-meiotic. Amaseli angama-haploid ngoba ku-pole ngayinye, kukhona eyodwa kuphela kumbhangqwana ngamunye wama-chromosome afanayo. Ngakho-ke, kukhona isethi eyodwa egcwele yama-chromosome. Yingakho amaseli ebhekwa njenge-haploid—kunesethi eyodwa kuphela yama-chromosome, yize i-homolog ngayinye isakhiwa ama-chromatid amabili angodadewabo. Khumbula ukuthi ama-chromatid angodadewabo angama-replica nje e-chromosome eyodwa yama-homologous amabili (ngaphandle kwezinguquko ezenzeka ngesikhathi sokuwela). Ku-meiosis II, la ma-chromatid amabili angodadewabo azohlukana, adale amaseli amane endodakazi ye-haploid.
question1: Yisiphi isenzakalo esiyinhloko esenzeka ngesikhathi se-telophase I ye-meiosis?
answer1: Ama-chromosome afanayo afika ezigxotsheni eziphambene zeseli
question2: Yisiphi isenzakalo esingase senzeke ngesikhathi se-telophase I kwezinye izinhlobo kodwa hhayi kwezinye?
question3: Kuyini i-cytokinesis?
answer3: Ukuhlukaniswa ngokomzimba kwe-cytoplasm ibe amaseli endodakazi
question4: I-cytokinesis ivame ukwenzeka kanjani emangqamuzaneni ezilwane?
answer4: Umsele wokuqhekeka wakha njengendandatho ye-actin enciphayo
question5: I-cytokinesis yenzeka kanjani kumaseli ezitshalo?
answer5: Ama-vesicle e-Golgi ayahlangana epuletini le-metaphase ukuze akhe ipuleti leseli
distractor5c: I-plasma membrane igoba ngqo ngaphandle kwama-vesicles
question6: Kungani amaseli akhiqizwa ngemva kwe-meiosis engiyicabangele njenge-haploid?
answer6: Iseli ngalinye liqukethe i-chromosome eyodwa kuphela evela kubhangqa ngalinye elifana nelinye
distractor6a: Iseli ngalinye liqukethe i-chromatid eyodwa kuphela
question7: Nakuba amangqamuzana akhiqizwa ngemva kwe-meiosis I engama-haploid, kungani engakakulungeli ukusebenza njengama-gametes?
answer7: I-chromosome ngayinye isakhiwa ama-chromatids amabili angodadewabo
question8: Yisiphi isigaba se-meiotic esihlukanisa ama-chromatids angodadewabo?
answer8: I-Meiosis II
question9: Usosayensi uhlola iseli ngokushesha ngemva kwe-telophase I futhi uthola ama-chromosome angu-23, ngalinye lakhiwa ama-chromatids amabili angodadewabo. Kungenzeka ukuthi leli seli lavela kusiphi isidalwa?
answer9: Umuntu
question10: Uyini umphumela wokugcina we-meiosis I?
answer10: Amaseli amabili endodakazi e-haploid, ngalinye liqukethe ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe
distractor10a: Amaseli amane endodakazi e-haploid anama-chromatids angawodwa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis II | I-Prophase II, i-Prometaphase II, i-Metaphase II, i-Anaphase II, i-Telophase II kanye ne-Cytokinesis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis | I-Meiosis II | I-Prophase II, i-Prometaphase II, i-Metaphase II, i-Anaphase II, i-Telophase II kanye ne-Cytokinesis
chapterContent:
Kwezinye izinhlobo, amaseli angena esigabeni esifushane, noma i-interkinesis, ngaphambi kokungena ku-meiosis II. I-Interkinesis ayinaso isigaba se-S, ngakho-ke ama-chromosome awaphindaphindwa. Amaseli amabili akhiqizwa ku-meiosis I adlula ezenzakalweni ze-meiosis II ku-synchrony. Ngesikhathi se-meiosis II, ama-chromatids angodadewabo ngaphakathi kwamaseli amabili amantombazane ayahlukana, akha ama-gametes amane amasha e-haploid. Indlela esebenza ngayo i-meiosis II ifana ne-mitosis, ngaphandle kokuthi iseli ngalinye elihlukanisayo linesethi eyodwa kuphela yama-chromosome afanayo. Ngakho-ke, iseli ngalinye linesigamu senani lama-chromatids angodadewabo okufanele ahlukaniswe njengeseli le-diploid elidlula ku-mitosis.

 I-Prophase II
Uma ama-chromosome ehlukana ku-telophase I, ayahlangana futhi. Uma kwakheka ama-envelope enuzi, ayahlukana abe ama-vesicle. Ama-centrosome aphindaphindwa ngesikhathi se-interkinesis ayasuka komunye nomunye aye ezingosini eziphambene, futhi kwakheka ama-spindle amasha.

 I-Prometaphase II
Ama-envelope enuzi aphukile ngokuphelele, futhi i-spindle yakheke ngokuphelele. I-chromatid ngayinye engudade yakha i-kinetochore eyodwa enamathela kuma-microtubules avela ezingosini eziphambene.

 I-Metaphase II
Ama-chromatids angudade afinyeziwe futhi aqondaniswe kakhulu enkabazweni yeseli.

 I-Anaphase II
Ama-chromatids angudade adonswa yi-kinetochore microtubules bese ehambela ezingosini eziphambene. Ama-microtubules angewona ama-kinetochore andisa iseli.

 I-Telophase II ne-Cytokinesis
Ama-chromosome afika ezingosini eziphambene futhi aqala ukubola. Ama-envelope enuzi akheka azungeze ama-chromosome. I-Cytokinesis ihlukanisa amaseli amabili abe amaseli amane ahlukile e-haploid. Kuleli qophelo, ama-nuclei asanda kwakheka womabili angama-haploid. Amaseli akhiqizwayo ahlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa okungahleliwe kwama-homologs kababa nonina kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezingxenye zama-chromosomes kababa nonina (namaqoqo azo ezakhi zofuzo) okwenzeka ngesikhathi sokudlula. Yonke inqubo ye-meiosis ichazwe kuMfanekiso 11.6
