answer10: I-Metaphase II

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | Ukuqhathanisa I-Meiosis Ne-Mitosis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzalana Kocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | Ukuqhathanisa I-Meiosis Ne-Mitosis
chapterContent:
I-Mitosis kanye ne-meiosis zombili ziyizinhlobo zokuhlukaniswa kwe-nucleus kumaseli e-eukaryotic. Zifana ngandlela thile, kodwa futhi zibonisa umehluko ohlukile oholela emiphumeleni ehlukene kakhulu (Isithombe 11.7). I-Mitosis ukuhlukaniswa okukodwa kwe-nuclear okuholela kuma-nuclei amabili avame ukuhlukaniswa abe amaseli amabili amasha. Ama-nuclei avela ekuhlukanisweni kwe-mitotic afana ngokwezakhi zofuzo ne-nucleus yokuqala. Anenani elifanayo lamasethi ama-chromosome, isethi eyodwa esimweni samaseli e-haploid kanye namasethi amabili esimweni samaseli e-diploid. Ezitshalweni eziningi nakuzo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane, ngokuvamile amaseli e-diploid adlula ku-mitosis ukuze akhe amaseli amasha e-diploid. Ngokuphambene nalokho, i-meiosis yakhiwa ukuhlukaniswa okubili kwe-nuclear okuholela kuma-nuclei amane avame ukuhlukaniswa abe amaseli amane amasha. Ama-nuclei avela ku-meiosis awafani ngokwezakhi zofuzo futhi aqukethe isethi eyodwa ye-chromosome kuphela. Lena ingxenye yenani lamasethi e-chromosome kuseli lokuqala, okuyi-diploid.

 Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwe-mitosis ne-meiosis uvela ku-meiosis I, okuwukuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear okuhluke kakhulu kune-mitosis. Ku-meiosis I, ama-chromosome amabili afanayo ahlanganiswa, ahlanganiswa ndawonye ne-synaptonemal complex, athuthukise i-chiasmata futhi adlule phakathi kwama-chromatids angodadewabo, futhi alandelana eduze kwepuleti le-metaphase kuma-tetrad anemicu ye-kinetochore evela ezigxotsheni eziphambene ezinamathele ku-kinetochore ngayinye ye-homolog ku-tetrad. Zonke lezi zenzakalo zenzeka kuphela ku-meiosis I.

 Lapho i-chiasmata ixazululeka futhi i-tetrad ihlukana nama-homologs athuthela kwelinye ipholi noma kwenye, izinga le-ploidy—inani lamasethi ama-chromosome ku-nucleus ngayinye yesikhathi esizayo—lincishisiwe kusuka kokubili kuya kwelinye. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, i-meiosis I ibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa. Akukho ukuncishiswa okunjalo ezingeni le-ploidy ngesikhathi se-mitosis.

 I-Meiosis II ifana kakhulu nokuhlukaniswa kwe-mitotic. Kulesi simo, ama-chromosome aphindaphindiwe (isethi eyodwa kuphela yawo) ahambisana epuletini le-metaphase elinama-kinetochores ahlukene anamathele kuma-kinetochore fibers avela ezigxotsheni eziphambene. Ngesikhathi se-anaphase II, njengakwi-mitotic anaphase, ama-kinetochores ayahlukana kanti i-chromatid eyodwa engudadewabo—manje ebizwa ngokuthi i-chromosome—idonswa egxotsheni elilodwa kuyilapho enye i-chromatid engudadewabo idonswa egxotsheni elinye. Ukube bekungengenxa yokuthi bekukhona i-crossover, imikhiqizo emibili yesigaba ngasinye se-meiosis II ibizofana (njengakwi-mitosis). Esikhundleni salokho, ahlukile ngoba bekulokhu kukhona okungenani i-crossover eyodwa nge-chromosome ngayinye. I-Meiosis II ayiyona i-reduction division ngoba yize kunezikhophi ezimbalwa ze-genome kumaseli aphumayo, kusekhona isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome, njengoba kwakunjalo ekupheleni kwe-meiosis I.
question1: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle i-mitosis ne-meiosis?
answer1: I-Mitosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana amabili afanayo ngokwezakhi zofuzo, kanti i-meiosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana amane e-haploid ahlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor1a: I-Mitosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana amane e-haploid, kanti i-meiosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana amabili e-diploid.
distractor1b: Kokubili i-mitosis ne-meiosis kukhiqiza amaseli endodakazi afanayo ngofuzo
distractor1c: Kokubili i-mitosis ne-meiosis kunciphisa inani lama-chromosome ngesigamu
question2: Kungani i-meiosis I ibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa?
answer2: Ngoba ama-chromosome afanayo ayahlukana, okunciphisa inani lama-chromosome kusukela ku-diploid kuya ku-haploid
question3: Yisiphi isenzakalo esenzeka ngesikhathi se-meiosis I kuphela hhayi ngesikhathi se-mitosis?
answer3: I-synapsis kanye nokuwela phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo
question4: Iyini injongo eyinhloko ye-mitosis ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer4: Ukukhula, ukulungiswa kwezicubu, kanye nokufakwa esikhundleni kwamaseli
question5: Kungani imikhiqizo ye-meiosis II ingafani ngokwezakhi zofuzo, yize ama-chromatids angodade ehlukene njengase-mitosis?
answer5: Ngoba ukuwela kwenzeka ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor5b: Ngoba ama-chromosome afanayo ahlangana ngesikhathi se-meiosis II
distractor5c: Ngoba inombolo ye-chromosome iphindwe kabili ngesikhathi se-meiosis II
question6: Umfundi uhlola amaseli ahlukanisayo bese ebona ama-chromosome afanayo ahlanganiswe njenge-tetrad. Yimuphi inqubo eyenzekayo?
answer6: I-Meiosis I
question7: Iyiphi inqubo egcina inani lama-chromosome ohlobo kuzo zonke izizukulwane?
answer7: I-Meiosis ilandelwa ukukhulelwa
question8: Iseli lesikhumba liyahlukana ukuze lithathe indawo yezicubu ezonakele. Yimuphi inqubo obangela lokhu?
answer8: I-Mitosis
question9: Yisiphi isici esabelwana ngaso kokubili yi-mitosis kanye ne-meiosis II?
answer9: Ama-chromatids angodade ahlukana ngesikhathi se-anaphase
question10: Umcwaningi uqhathanisa ukuziphatha kwe-chromosome ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Yikuphi ukubonwa okubonisa i-meiosis kune-mitosis?
answer10: Ama-chromosome afanayo ayabhangqana, adlule, bese ehlukana ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kokuqala

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | Imfihlakalo Yokuvela Kwe-Meiosis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.1 Inqubo Ye-Meiosis | Imfihlakalo Yokuvela Kwe-Meiosis
chapterContent:
Ezinye izici zezinto eziphilayo zisakazeke kakhulu futhi ziyisisekelo kangangokuthi ngezinye izikhathi kunzima ukukhumbula ukuthi zavela njengezinye izici ezilula. I-Meiosis uchungechunge oluyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu lwezehlakalo zamaseli kangangokuthi izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziye zaba nenkinga yokucabanga nokuhlola ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi yavela kanjani. Nakuba i-meiosis ihlanganiswe ngokungenakuqhathaniswa nokuzala ngokocansi kanye nezinzuzo kanye nokungalungi kwayo, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa imibuzo yokuvela kwe-meiosis kanye nokuvela kocansi, ngoba i-meiosis yokuqala kungenzeka ukuthi yayinenzuzo ngezizathu ezahlukene kunamanje. Ukucabanga ngaphandle kwebhokisi nokucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo zokuqala ezivela ku-meiosis kungenzeka ukuthi zaziyini kuyindlela eyodwa yokuthola ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi yavela kanjani.

 I-Meiosis kanye ne-mitosis zabelana ngezinqubo zamaseli ezisobala futhi kunengqondo ukuthi i-meiosis yavela ku-mitosis. Ubunzima busekuhlukeni okucacile phakathi kwe-meiosis I kanye ne-mitosis. U-Adam Wilkins noRobin Holliday1 bafingqa izehlakalo ezihlukile okwakudingeka zenzeke ukuze kuvele i-meiosis kusuka ku-mitosis. Lezi zinyathelo ukuhlangana kwe-chromosome efanayo, ukushintshana kwe-crossover, ama-chromatids angodadewabo asele enamathele ngesikhathi se-anaphase, kanye nokucindezelwa kokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ku-interphase. Baphikisana ngokuthi isinyathelo sokuqala sinzima futhi sibaluleke kakhulu, nokuthi ukuqonda ukuthi savela kanjani kuzokwenza inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo icace. Basikisela ukuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo okungase kukhanyise ngokuvela kwe-synapsis.

 Kunezinye izindlela zokuqonda ukuvela kwe-meiosis okuqhubekayo. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-meiosis kuma-protist aneseli elilodwa. Ezinye zibonakala zilula noma zingezinhlobo zakudala ze-meiosis. Ukuqhathanisa ukuhlukaniswa kwe-meiosis kwama-protist ahlukene kungakhanyisa ukuvela kwe-meiosis. UMarilee Ramesh kanye nozakwabo2 baqhathanise izakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ku-meiosis kuma-protist ukuze baqonde ukuthi i-meiosis kungenzeka ukuthi yavela nini futhi kuphi. Nakuba ucwaningo lusaqhubeka, ucwaningo lwamuva nje nge-meiosis kuma-protist lusikisela ukuthi ezinye izici ze-meiosis kungenzeka ukuthi zavela kamuva kunezinye. Lolu hlobo lokuqhathanisa izakhi zofuzo lungasitshela ukuthi yiziphi izici ze-meiosis ezindala kakhulu nokuthi yiziphi izinqubo zamaseli okungenzeka ukuthi zibolekwe kuzo kumaseli angaphambilini.
question1: Iyini inkolelo-mbono ehamba phambili ngemvelaphi yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ye-meiosis?
answer1: I-Meiosis yavela ku-mitosis
question2: Ngokusho kukaWilkins noHolliday, yisiphi isinyathelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo esibhekwa njengesinzima kakhulu nesibaluleke kakhulu ekuziphendukeleni kwe-meiosis?
question3: Yisiphi isenzakalo esiyingqayizivele ku-meiosis I futhi esingatholakali ku-mitosis?
answer3: Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-chromosome efanayo kanye ne-synapsis
question4: Kungani ososayensi befunda nge-meiosis kuma-protist aneseli elilodwa?
answer4: Abanye abaphrotheyini banezinhlobo ezilula ze-meiosis ezingase zembule ukuthi i-meiosis yavela kanjani
distractor4c: AmaProtist yiwona kuphela ama-organic anamandla okwenza i-meiosis
question5: Yini engavezwa ukuqhathaniswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezihlobene ne-meiosis kuma-protists?
answer5: Yiziphi izingxenye ze-meiosis ezavela kuqala nokuthi zaqala kanjani
distractor5b: Indlela i-binary fission eyashintsha ngayo yaba umanyolo
question6: Kungani ososayensi behlukanisa phakathi kokuvela kwe-meiosis kanye nokuvela kokuzala ngokocansi?
answer6: Ngoba i-meiosis kungenzeka ukuthi ekuqaleni yavela ngezizathu ezihlukile kunezinzuzo zokuzala ngokocansi
distractor6a: Ngoba i-meiosis yenzeka kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezingezona ezesilisa
distractor6b: Ngoba ukuzala ngokocansi kwavela ngaphambi kwama-chromosome
question7: Yisiphi isenzakalo okwadingeka siguquke ukuze kuvunyelwe i-meiosis ukunciphisa inani lama-chromosome?
answer7: Ukuncishiswa kokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA phakathi kwe-meiosis I ne-meiosis II
distractor7a: Umjikelezo wesibili wokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ngaphambi kwe-meiosis II
distractor7c: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA okuqhubekayo kulo lonke i-meiosis
question8: Umcwaningi uthola i-protist eyenza ukuhlanganiswa kwama-chromosome kodwa ingakwazi ukuwela. Lokhu kungasikiselani kakhulu?
answer8: Ezinye izici ze-meiosis zavela ngaphambi kwezinye
distractor8a: Kudingeka ukuwela ngaphambi kokuba ukubhanqana kwama-chromosome kuguquke
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani i-meiosis ikhulisa ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer9: Ihlanganisa ukuwela kanye nokuhlanganiswa okuzimele kwama-chromosome afanayo
question10: Yisiphi isenzakalo esilandelayo esenzeka kokubili ku-mitosis kanye ne-meiosis I?
answer10: Ama-chromosome alandelana ku-metaphase plate
distractor10c: Ama-chromatids angodade ahlala enamathele ngesikhathi se-anaphase

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Cishe wonke ama-eukaryote azalwa kabusha ngokocansi. Ukwehluka okufakwa emangqamuzaneni okuzala (ama-gametes noma ama-spores) yi-meiosis kuzuzisa ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo. I-Meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa kuyashintshana njengoba izinto eziphilayo zidlula ezigabeni ze-haploid kanye ne-diploid zemijikelezo yazo yokuphila. Ezilwaneni eziningi, isigaba se-diploid siyabusa, kanti ku-fungus, isigaba se-haploid siyabusa. Ukuhlonza izigaba ze-haploid kanye ne-diploid ngaphakathi kwemijikelezo yokuphila yezinto eziphilayo ezahlukene kubalulekile ekuqondeni ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zizalana kanjani futhi ekunqumeni ukuthi i-mitosis kanye ne-meiosis zenzeka nini.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Zebhayoloji lwe-AP®. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.C
Ukucutshungulwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo akuphelele futhi kuwumthombo wokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.C.2 Izinhlelo zebhayoloji zinezinqubo eziningi ezandisa ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhuma imiqondo ezizindeni nakuzo zonke ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.27 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuqhathanisa nokuqhathanisa izinqubo lapho ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kukhiqizwa futhi kugcinwe khona ezintweni eziphilayo ezivela ezizindeni eziningi.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 3.7][APLO 3.9][APLO 3.24][APLO 3.28]

 Ukuzala ngokocansi kwakuyinto entsha yokuqala yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngemva kokuvela kwamaseli e-eukaryotic. Kubonakala sengathi iphumelele kakhulu ngoba ama-eukaryote amaningi ayakwazi ukuzala ngokocansi, futhi ezilwaneni eziningi, kuyindlela yodwa yokuzala. Noma kunjalo, ososayensi bayaqaphela ezinye izinkinga zangempela ekuzaleni ngokocansi. Ngaphandle, ukudala inzalo engama-clone ezakhi zofuzo zomzali kubonakala kuyindlela engcono. Uma into engumzali ihlala kahle endaweni yokuhlala, inzalo enezimfanelo ezifanayo ingaphumelela ngendlela efanayo. Kukhona futhi inzuzo esobala kwinto ephilayo engakhiqiza inzalo noma nini lapho izimo zivuma ngokuhluma okungenabo ubulili, ukuqhekeka, noma amaqanda angenabo ubulili. Lezi zindlela zokuzala azidingi enye into ephilayo yobulili obuhlukile. Ngempela, ezinye izinto eziphilayo eziphila impilo yodwa zigcine ikhono lokuzala ngaphandle kobulili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubantu abangenabo ubulili, wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukuzala. Emiphakathini yobulili, abesilisa abazikhiqizi inzalo ngokwabo, ngakho-ke ngokombono inani labantu abangenabo ubulili lingakhula ngokushesha okuphindwe kabili.

 Kodwa-ke, izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi ezincike kuphela ekuzaleni okungenabo ubulili azivamile kakhulu. Kungani ucansi (kanye ne-meiosis) kuvame kangaka? Lona omunye wemibuzo ebalulekile engaphendulwanga ku-biology futhi ube yinto egxilwe ocwaningweni oluningi oluqala engxenyeni yokugcina yekhulu lama-20. Kunezincazelo eziningana ezingaba khona, enye yazo ukuthi ukwehluka okudala ukuzala ngokocansi phakathi kwenzalo kubaluleke kakhulu ekusindeni nasekuzaleni kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, ngokwesilinganiso, inani elizala ngokocansi lizoshiya inzalo eningi kunenani elizala ngokungahambisani ngokocansi elifanayo. Umthombo okuwukuphela kokwehluka kwezinto eziphilayo ezingahambisani ngokocansi ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Lona umthombo wokugcina wokwehluka kwezinto eziphilayo zocansi, kodwa ngaphezu kwalokho, lezo zinguquko ezahlukene zihlala zishintshwa kusuka kwesinye isizukulwane kuya kwesinye lapho abazali abahlukene behlanganisa ama-genome abo ahlukile futhi izakhi zofuzo zixutshwa zibe yizinhlanganisela ezahlukene ngama-crossover ngesikhathi se-prophase I kanye nokuqoqwa okungahleliwe ku-metaphase I
question1: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yokuzala ngokocansi?
answer1: Kwandisa ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwenzalo
question2: Yimuphi umthombo okuwukuphela kwawo wokwehlukahluka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo ezintweni eziphilayo ezingahambisani nobulili?
question3: Yiziphi izinqubo ezimbili ze-meiotic ezidala ukwehluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo ezintweni eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi?
answer3: Ukuwela ngesikhathi se-prophase I kanye nokuhlanganiswa okuzimele ngesikhathi se-metaphase I
distractor3c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuqhekeka kwe-binary
question4: Kungani inani labantu abangebona abesilisa nabesifazane lingakhula ngokushesha ngokwemfundiso kunabantu abathandana nabobulili obufanayo?
answer4: Wonke umuntu angazala inzalo
distractor4a: Izinto eziphilayo ezingahambisani nobulili zikhiqiza amathole amakhulu
distractor4c: Izinto eziphilayo ezingahambisani nobulili zinama-chromosome amafushane
question5: Yisiphi isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila esivelele ezilwaneni eziningi?
answer5: I-Diploid
question6: Yisiphi isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila esivelele ezinkomeni eziningi?
answer6: I-Haploid
question7: Inqwaba yezimbali zasendle izala ngokocansi. Iyiphi inqubo enegalelo ngqo ekuzivumelaniseni nezimo ngokukhetha kwemvelo?
answer7: Ukukhiqizwa kwenzalo ehlukahlukene ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani ukuzala ngokocansi kuvame kangaka naphezu kobubi bako?
answer8: Ukwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuvamile kuthuthukisa ukusinda kwesikhathi eside kwabantu
distractor8a: Ukuzala ngokocansi kuvimbela ngokuphelele ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okuyingozi
distractor8b: Imiphakathi yocansi ihlala ikhula ngokushesha kunemiphakathi engathandi ucansi
distractor8c: Ukuzala ngokocansi kudinga amandla amancane kunokuzala okungenabo ubulili
question9: Inani lamagciwane lizala kuphela ngokuhlukana kwe-binary. Uma kuqhathaniswa nenani elizalanayo ngokocansi, yimuphi umkhawulo omkhulu?
answer9: Ithembela cishe ngokuphelele ekuguqukeni kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze idale ukuhlukahluka okusha kwezakhi zofuzo
question10: Izinhlobo ezimbili zohlobo olufanayo zihlala endaweni eshintsha ngokushesha. Olunye luzala ngokocansi kanti olunye aluzalani ngokocansi. Yiluphi uhlobo olunamathuba amaningi okusinda ezizukulwaneni eziningi, futhi ngani?
answer10: Inani labantu abazalana ngokocansi, ngoba ukwehlukahluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo kwandisa amathuba okuba abanye abantu babe nezici ezizuzisayo
distractor10a: Iqembu labantu abazala ngokungakhethi ubulili, ngoba bonke abantwana bafana nabazali abaphumelelayo
distractor10b: Zombili lezi zinhlobo zabantu zinamathuba afanayo okusinda ngoba amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo afanayo
distractor10c: Inani labantu abazalana ngaphandle kocansi, ngoba i-meiosis inciphisa ukuqina komzimba

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | I-Red Queen Hypothesis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | I-Red Queen Hypothesis
chapterContent:
Akuphikiswana ngokuthi ukuzala ngokocansi kunikeza izinzuzo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo ezintweni eziphilayo ezisebenzisa le ndlela ukukhiqiza inzalo. Kodwa kungani, ngisho naphezu kwezimo ezizinzile, ukuzala ngokocansi kuqhubeka lapho kunzima futhi kubiza kakhulu ezintweni eziphilayo ngazinye? Ukwehluka kuwumphumela wokuzala ngokocansi, kodwa kungani ukwehluka okuqhubekayo kudingeka? Faka i-hypothesis ye-Red Queen, eyahlongozwa okokuqala nguLeigh Van Valen ngo-1973.3 Lo mqondo waqanjwa ngokubhekisela emncintiswaneni wamaRed Queens encwadini kaLewis Carrolls, Through the Looking-Glass.

 Zonke izinhlobo ziyaguquka ngokubambisana nezinye izinto eziphilayo; isibonelo izilwane ezidla ezinye ziyaguquka kanye nezilwane ezizidlayo, kanti izilwane ezidla ezinye ziyaguquka kanye nabantu ezibaphethe. Inzuzo ngayinye encane etholakala ngokuhlukahluka okuhle inikeza uhlobo ithuba ngaphezu kwezimbangi eziseduze, izilwane ezidla ezinye, izilwane ezidla ezinye, noma ngisho nezilwane ezidla ezinye. Indlela kuphela ezovumela uhlobo oluguquka ndawonye ukuthi lugcine isabelo salo sezinsizakusebenza ukuthuthukisa njalo ukufaneleka kwalo. Njengoba uhlobo olulodwa luzuza inzuzo, lokhu kwandisa ingcindezi yokukhetha kwezinye izinhlobo; kumele futhi luthuthukise inzuzo noma luzonqotshwa. Akukho nhlobo eyodwa eqhubekela phambili kakhulu ngoba ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwenzalo yokuzala ngokocansi kunikeza zonke izinhlobo indlela yokuthuthuka ngokushesha. Izinhlobo ezingakwazi ukuqhubeka ziyanyamalala. Isisho seNdlovukazi Ebomvu sasithi, Kudingeka konke ukugijima ongakwenza ukuze uhlale endaweni efanayo.” Lena incazelo efanele yokuguquguquka ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezincintisanayo
question1: Uyini umqondo oyinhloko we-theory ye-Red Queen?
answer1: Izinhlobo kumele ziqhubeke zithuthuka ukuze zihambisane nezinye izinhlobo ezishintshayo
distractor1a: Izinhlobo ziyavela kuphela uma izimo zemvelo zishintsha kakhulu
distractor1b: Ukukhetha kwemvelo ekugcineni kuqeda isidingo sokwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor1c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela ezizingelweni, hhayi ezizingelweni
question2: Kungani i-hypothesis ibizwa ngokuthi i-Red Queen hypothesis?
answer2: Isekelwe emjahweni weRed Queens ku-Through the Looking-Glass, lapho kudingeka khona ukugijima njalo ukuze uhlale endaweni efanayo.
distractor2a: Ichaza ukuvela kwezinto eziphilayo ezinombala obomvu
distractor2c: Kubhekisela kuhlobo lokuqala olwathuthukisa ukuzala ngokocansi
question3: Ngokusho kombono we-Red Queen, kungani ukuzala ngokocansi kuqhubeka naphezu kwezindleko zako?
answer3: Ihlala ikhiqiza ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okusiza abantu ukuthi bazivumelanise nezimbangi eziguqukayo, izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane, kanye nezinambuzane.
distractor3b: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke inzalo izobe iphilile kakhulu kunabazali bayo
distractor3c: Ivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zizalane ngaphandle kwabalingani
question4: Yikuphi ukusebenzisana okubonisa kangcono ukuguquka kwemvelo?
answer4: Isilwane esizingelayo sithuthukisa amakhono okuzingela kuyilapho isisulu saso sithuthukisa ukuzivikela okungcono
distractor4a: Isitshalo sikhula sibe side ngenxa yokukhanya kwelanga okwandisiwe
distractor4c: Isidalwa esisodwa silungisa izicubu ezonakele nge-mitosis
question5: Ngokusho kombono we-Red Queen, kwenzekani uma uhlobo olulodwa oluncintisanayo luthuthukisa inzuzo?
answer5: Ingcindezi yokukhetha iyanda ezinhlotsheni ezincintisanayo ukuze zithuthuke futhi
question6: Kungani ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kubalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo?
answer6: Ihlinzeka ngezinto zokusetshenziswa zokukhetha kwemvelo ukuze kukhiqizwe izici ezizuzisayo
distractor6a: Kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi kungenzeki
question7: I-parasite ithuthukisa ukumelana nokuzivikela komzimba komnikazi wayo. Ngokusho kombono we-Red Queen, iyiphi impendulo engenzeka kakhulu yabantu abamukelayo ezizukulwaneni eziningi?
answer7: Abantu abanokuzivikela komzimba okuthuthukisiwe banamathuba amaningi okusinda nokuzala
distractor7a: Inani labantu abamukelayo liyayeka ukuguquka unomphela
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kahle isisho esidumile seRed Queens, Kudingeka wonke umzamo ongakwenza ukuze uhlale endaweni efanayo?
answer8: Izinhlobo kumele ziqhubeke zithuthuka ukuze zilondoloze impilo yazo ekushintshashintsheni kokuxhumana kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor8a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ekugcineni kufinyelela esiphethweni esihlala njalo
distractor8b: Izinhlobo zezilwane ezidla inyama kuphela ezidinga ukuthuthuka njalo
distractor8c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwenzeka kuphela lapho isimo sezulu sishintsha
question9: Inani labantu abazalana ngokocansi lisinda ekuqubukeni kwezifo ezintsha okuphindaphindiwe kangcono kunenani labantu abaseduze abangazalani ngokocansi. Yimuphi umqondo ochaza kangcono lokhu okuphawuliwe?
answer9: I-hypothesis ye-Red Queen
question10: I-Red Queen hypothesis ihlose ukuchaza ukuguquka kwezinhlobo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezincintisanayo. Uma siqhathanisa lezi zimo ezilandelayo, yikuphi okunikeza ukwesekwa okungcono kakhulu kwe-Red Queen hypothesis?
answer10: Izinhlobo zezinyoni ezizalana ngokungahambisani nobulili ziyafa ngemva kokuba izinambuzane zingene endaweni yazo
distractor10a: Isitshalo esizala ngokungahambisani nobulili sigcwala ngokushesha igquma elishiywe lingenalutho ngumlilo
distractor10b: Iqembu labantu abahlakazekile kakhulu be-grouse elinoboya liyanyamalala ngoba abantu banenkinga yokuthola abangane
distractor10c: Uhlobo lwe-gopher oluzala ngokocansi luyanyamalala ngemva kokwethulwa kwesilwane esisha esidla ezinye izilwane

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi
chapterContent: Ukuvundisa kanye ne-meiosis kuyashintshana emijikelezweni yokuphila ngokocansi. Okwenzekayo phakathi kwalezi zenzakalo ezimbili kuncike kulokho okuphilayo. Inqubo ye-meiosis yehlisa inani le-chromosome ngesigamu. Ukuvundisa, ukuhlangana kwama-gametes amabili e-haploid, kubuyisela isimo se-diploid. Kunezinhlobo ezintathu eziyinhloko zemijikelezo yokuphila ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi: i-diploid-dominant, lapho isigaba se-diploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi siyisigaba sokuphila esisobala kakhulu, njengasezilwaneni eziningi okuhlanganisa nabantu; i-haploid-dominant, lapho isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi siyisigaba sokuphila esisobala kakhulu, njengakuzo zonke izikhunta kanye nolwelwe oluthile; kanye nokushintshana kwezizukulwane, lapho izigaba ezimbili zibonakala khona ngamazinga ahlukene kuye ngeqembu, njengasezitshalweni kanye nolwelwe oluthile.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-meiosis ezintweni eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi?
answer1: Ukunciphisa inani lama-chromosome ngesigamu, kukhiqiza amaseli e-haploid
question2: Iyini indima yokukhulelwa emjikelezweni wokuphila kocansi?
answer2: Ibuyisela inombolo ye-chromosome ye-diploid ngokujoyina ama-gametes amabili e-haploid
question3: Yimuphi umjikelezo wokuphila owuphawu lwezilwane eziningi, kuhlanganise nabantu?
answer3: Umjikelezo wokuphila olawula i-diploid
question4: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezivame ukuba nomjikelezo wokuphila olawula i-haploid?
answer4: Isikhunta kanye nolwelwe oluthile
question5: Yini echaza ukushintshashintsha komjikelezo wokuphila kwezizukulwane?
answer5: Zombili izigaba ze-haploid ezinamaseli amaningi kanye nezigaba ze-diploid ezinamaseli amaningi zenzeka
distractor5a: Kuphela izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi ze-haploid ezikhona
distractor5b: Kuphela izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi e-diploid ezikhona
question6: Yiliphi iqembu lezinto eziphilayo elivame ukubonisa ukushintshana kwezizukulwane?
answer6: Izitshalo kanye nolwelwe oluthile
question7: Umfundi ubheka into ephilayo lapho isigaba samangqamuzana amaningi siyi-haploid kanti isigaba se-diploid kuphela yi-zygote. Yimuphi umjikelezo wokuphila okungenzeka ukuthi le nto ephilayo inayo?
answer7: Okubusa kakhulu i-Haploid
question8: Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid, yimaphi amaseli avame ukuba yi-haploid?
answer8: Ama-Gametes kuphela
question9: Kungani i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa kufanele kushintshane emijikelezweni yokuphila kocansi?
answer9: I-Meiosis inciphisa inani lama-chromosome ngesigamu, bese ukukhulelwa kuyalibuyisela.
distractor9a: Zombili lezi zinqubo ziphinda kabili inombolo ye-chromosome
distractor9b: Zombili lezi zinqubo zikhiqiza amaseli e-haploid
distractor9c: Zombili lezi zinqubo zikhiqiza inzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo
question10: Isazi sezitshalo sihlola i-fern ene-sporophyte ye-diploid enamangqamuzana amaningi kanye ne-gametophyte ye-haploid enamangqamuzana amaningi. Yimuphi umjikelezo wokuphila oboniswa yi-fern?
answer10: Ukushintshana kwezizukulwane

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi | Umjikelezo Wokuphila Olawula I-Diploid
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi | Umjikelezo Wokuphila Olawula I-Diploid
chapterContent: Cishe zonke izilwane zisebenzisa isu lomjikelezo wokuphila olawula i-diploid lapho amaseli e-haploid kuphela akhiqizwa yizinto eziphilayo kungama-gametes. Ekuqaleni kokukhula kwe-embryo, amaseli e-diploid akhethekile, abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-germ, akhiqizwa ngaphakathi kwama-gonads, njenge-testes nama-ovari. Amaseli e-germ ayakwazi ukwenza i-mitosis ukuze aqhubeke nomugqa weseli kanye ne-meiosis ukukhiqiza ama-gametes. Uma ama-gametes e-haploid esebunjiwe, alahlekelwa ikhono lokuhlukana futhi. Akukho sigaba sokuphila se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi. Ukukhulelwa kwenzeka ngokuhlanganiswa kwama-gametes amabili, ngokuvamile avela kubantu abahlukene, okubuyisela isimo se-diploid (Isithombe 11.8)
question1: Yimuphi umjikelezo wokuphila owuphawu cishe lwazo zonke izilwane, kuhlanganise nabantu?
answer1: Umjikelezo wokuphila olawula i-diploid
question2: Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid, yimaphi amaseli angama-haploid?
question3: Hlobo luni lwamaseli adala ama-gametes ezilwaneni?
answer3: Amaseli egciwane le-Diploid
question4: Atholakala kuphi amangqamuzana egciwane ezilwaneni?
answer4: Kuma-gonad, njenge-testes nama-ovari
question5: Amaseli egciwane akwazi kanjani ukugcina inani lawo kuyo yonke impilo yezinto eziphilayo?
answer5: Badlula ku-mitosis ukuze baqhubeke nomugqa weseli
question6: Iyiphi inqubo ekhiqiza ama-gametes e-haploid avela kumaseli e-germ e-diploid?
answer6: I-Meiosis
question7: Kwenzekani kuma-gametes ngemva kokuba enziwe?
answer7: Balahlekelwa ikhono lokuphinde bahlukane
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle isigaba se-haploid ezilwaneni?
answer8: Asikho isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi; ama-gametes kuphela angama-haploid.
distractor8c: Isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi siyashintshana nesigaba se-diploid
question9: Uyini umphumela wokukhulelwa emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid?
answer9: Ukuhlanganiswa kwama-gametes amabili e-haploid kubuyisela isimo se-diploid
distractor9a: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaseli amabili e-diploid kukhiqiza umbungu we-tetraploid
distractor9b: Ama-gamete amabili e-haploid akhiqiza amaseli amane e-haploid
distractor9c: Iseli le-diploid liyahlukana ukuze lakhe ama-gametes e-haploid
question10: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo sithola into ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi lapho umuntu omdala ene-diploid khona kanti i-meiosis ivele kuphela kuma-gonad ukuze ikhiqize isidoda namaqanda. Yimuphi umjikelezo wokuphila okungenzeka ukuthi le nto ephilayo iwubonisa?
answer10: Umjikelezo wokuphila olawula i-diploid

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi | Umjikelezo Wokuphila Olawula Ama-Haploid
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi | Umjikelezo Wokuphila Olawula Ama-Haploid
chapterContent: Iningi lama-fungus kanye ne-algae zisebenzisa uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho umzimba "wezinto eziphilayo - ingxenye ebalulekile yezemvelo yomjikelezo wokuphila - uyi-haploid. Amaseli e-haploid akha izicubu zesigaba samaseli amaningi abusayo akhiwa yi-mitosis. Ngesikhathi sokuzala ngokocansi, amaseli akhethekile e-haploid avela kubantu ababili, aqoke izinhlobo zokuhlangana (+) kanye (−), ahlangana ukuze akhe i-zygote ye-diploid. I-zygote ngokushesha idlula ku-meiosis ukuze yakhe amaseli amane e-haploid abizwa ngokuthi ama-spores. Nakuba i-haploid ifana nabazali,"lawa ma-spores aqukethe inhlanganisela entsha yezakhi zofuzo evela kubazali ababili. Ama-spores angahlala elele isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni, lapho izimo zivuma, ama-spores akha izakhiwo zama-haploid ezinamaseli amaningi ngemijikelezo eminingi ye-mitosis (Isithombe 11.9)
question1: Yiliphi iqembu lezinto eziphilayo elivame ukubonisa umjikelezo wokuphila olawulwa yi-haploid?
answer1: Iningi lesikhunta kanye nolwelwe oluningi
question2: Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-haploid, iyini i-ploidy yomzimba wamangqamuzana amaningi wezinto eziphilayo?
question3: Akhiqizwa kanjani amaseli esigaba se-haploid samaseli amaningi?
answer3: Nge-mitosis
question4: Yini eyakheka lapho izinhlobo zokuzalana (+) kanye (−) zihlangana ngesikhathi sokuzalana ngokocansi?
answer4: I-zygote ye-diploid
question5: Kwenzekani ngokushesha ngemva kokuba i-zygote ye-diploid yakheke emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-haploid?
answer5: Idlula ku-meiosis ukuze ikhiqize ama-haploid spores
distractor5a: Idlula ku-mitosis ukuze ikhiqize i-diploid endala
question6: Uyini umsebenzi wama-spores kuma-fungus kanye nolwelwe oluningi?
answer6: Zikhula zibe izinto eziphilayo ze-haploid ezinamaseli amaningi nge-mitosis
distractor6c: Baba ngabantu abadala abane-diploid ngaphandle kokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
question7: Kungani ama-spores akhiqizwa yi-meiosis ahlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo ezintweni eziphilayo ezingumzali?
answer7: Ziqukethe inhlanganisela entsha yezakhi zofuzo ezivela kubazali ababili
question8: Iyiphi inzuzo enikezwa yi-spores elele?
answer8: Zingasinda kuze kube yilapho izimo zemvelo zivuma
question9: Usosayensi uqaphela into ephilayo lapho isigaba se-diploid kuphela kuyi-zygote edlula ngokushesha ku-meiosis. Yimuphi umjikelezo wokuphila okungenzeka ukuthi le nto ephilayo inayo?
answer9: Umjikelezo wokuphila olawula ama-haploid
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 11.9. Hlola izinqubo eziboniswe kumdwebo. Uma kwenzeka ushintsho ngendlela yokuthi isikhunta singasakwazi ukukhiqiza uhlobo lokuzala olungenayo i-minus, ingabe sisazokwazi ukuzala?
answer10: Yebo, isikhunta sizokwazi ukuzala ngokwahlukana kwe-mitotic yama-spores
distractor10a: Cha, ngoba indlela yokuzala yobulili iyona kuphela indlela yokuzala ku-fungi
distractor10b: Cha, ngoba ukungabikho kwezinhlobo zokuzalanisa ezingaphansi kuzophazamisa imisebenzi yezinto eziphilayo ku-fungi
distractor10c: Yebo, isikhunta sizokwazi ukuzala ngaphandle kocansi ngesenzo sama-enzyme athile

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi | Ukushintshana Kwezizukulwane
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi | Imijikelezo Yokuphila Yezinto Ezizala Ngocansi | Ukushintshana Kwezizukulwane
chapterContent:
Uhlobo lwesithathu lomjikelezo wokuphila, olusetshenziswa ezinye izitshalo kanye nazo zonke izitshalo, luyinhlanganisela yezinto ezivelele kakhulu ze-haploid kanye ne-diploid. Izinhlobo ezinokushintshana kwezizukulwane zinezinhlobo eziningi ze-haploid kanye ne-diploid njengengxenye yomjikelezo wazo wokuphila. Izitshalo eziningi ze-haploid zibizwa ngokuthi ama-gametophyte, ngoba zikhiqiza ama-gametes avela kumaseli akhethekile. I-Meiosis ayihilelekile ngqo ekukhiqizweni kwama-gametes kulokhu, ngoba into ekhiqiza ama-gametes isivele iyi-haploid. Ukufakwa komanyolo phakathi kwama-gametes kwakha i-zygote ye-diploid. I-zygote izodlula ezigabeni eziningi ze-mitosis futhi iveze isitshalo se-diploid multicellular esibizwa ngokuthi i-sporophyte. Amaseli akhethekile e-sporophyte azodlula i-meiosis futhi akhiqize ama-spores e-haploid. Ama-spores azokhula abe ama-gametophyte kamuva (Isithombe 11.10).

 Nakuba zonke izitshalo zisebenzisa uhlobo oluthile lokushintshana kwezizukulwane, ubukhulu be-sporophyte kanye ne-gametophyte kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwazo buyahlukahluka kakhulu. Ezitshalweni ezifana ne-moss, i-gametophyte organism iyisitshalo esiphila ngokukhululeka, kanti i-sporophyte incike ngokomzimba ku-gametophyte. Kwezinye izitshalo, njenge-ferns, zombili izitshalo ze-gametophyte kanye ne-sporophyte ziphila ngokukhululeka; nokho, i-sporophyte inkulu kakhulu. Ezitshalweni zembewu, njengezihlahla ze-magnolia kanye ne-daisies, i-gametophyte yakhiwe ngamaseli ambalwa kuphela futhi, esimweni se-gametophyte yowesifazane, igcinwa ngokuphelele ngaphakathi kwe-sporophyte.

 Ukuzala ngokocansi kuthatha izinhlobo eziningi ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi. Kodwa-ke, ngesikhathi esithile kuhlobo ngalunye lomjikelezo wokuphila, i-meiosis ikhiqiza amaseli e-haploid azohlangana neseli le-haploid lesinye isidalwa. Izindlela zokushintshashintsha—i-crossover, ukuhlanganiswa okungahleliwe kwama-chromosome afanayo, kanye nokukhulelwa okungahleliwe—zikhona kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuzala ngokocansi. Iqiniso lokuthi cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi eMhlabeni zisebenzisa ukuzala ngokocansi kuwubufakazi obuqinile bezinzuzo zokukhiqiza inzalo enezinhlanganisela zezakhi zofuzo ezihlukile, yize kunezinye izinzuzo ezingaba khona.
question1: Yiliphi iqembu lezinto eziphilayo elibonisa ukushintshana kwezizukulwane emjikelezweni walo wokuphila?
answer1: Zonke izitshalo kanye nolwelwe oluthile
question2: Ekushintsheni kwezizukulwane, uyini umsebenzi we-gametophyte?
question3: Yini eyakhiwa ngokushesha ngemva kokukhulelwa ezitshalweni ngokushintshana kwezizukulwane?
answer3: I-zygote ye-diploid
question4: Ikhiqizwa kanjani i-sporophyte enamangqamuzana amaningi?
answer4: I-zygote ye-diploid idlula ezigabeni eziningi ze-mitosis
question5: Yimaphi amaseli e-sporophyte adlula ku-meiosis?
answer5: Amaseli e-diploid akhethekile akhiqiza ama-haploid spores
question6: Zikhula zibe yini izinhlamvu ze-haploid?
answer6: Ama-gametophyte amaningi
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle izitshalo ze-mosses nembewu?
answer7: Kuma-mosses i-gametophyte iyisigaba sokuphila ngokukhululeka esibusayo, kanti ezitshalweni zembewu i-sporophyte iyabusa kanti i-gametophyte incishisiwe kakhulu.
distractor7a: Zombili izitshalo ze-mosses kanye nembewu zine-gametophyte evelele
distractor7b: Zombili izitshalo ze-mosses kanye nembewu zine-sporophyte evelele ene-gametophyte enkulu ngokulinganayo
question8: Kuma-fern, yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono umjikelezo wokuphila?
answer8: Zombili i-gametophyte kanye ne-sporophyte ziphila ngokukhululeka, yize i-sporophyte inkulu kakhulu
distractor8b: I-sporophyte kuphela ephila ngokukhululeka ngoba i-gametophyte ayikho
question9: Iyiphi inqubo edala ngqo ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi sokushintshana kwezizukulwane?
answer9: Ukuwela, ukuhlanganiswa okuzimele ngesikhathi se-meiosis, kanye nokukhulelwa okungahleliwe
question10: Isazi sezitshalo sithola isitshalo lapho isizukulwane se-diploid sikhiqiza khona ama-spores nge-meiosis, kuyilapho isizukulwane se-haploid sikhiqiza ama-gametes nge-mitosis. Yiluphi uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila oluboniswa yilesi sitshalo?
answer10: Ukushintshana kwezizukulwane

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.3 Amagama Ayinhloko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.3 Amagama Ayinhloko
chapterContent:
ukushintshana kwezizukulwane
uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho izigaba ze-diploid neze-haploid zishintshana khona

 chiasmata
(esinye, i-chiasma) isakhiwo esakha amaphuzu okuwela ngemva kokushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo

 cohesin
amaprotheni akha inkimbinkimbi ehlanganisa ama-chromatids angodade ndawonye kuma-centromere awo kuze kube yi-anaphase II ye-meiosis

 crossover
ukushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade okuholela kuma-chromosome afaka izakhi zofuzo ezivela kubazali bobabili bezinto eziphilayo

 i-diploid-dominant
uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-diploid samaseli amaningi sivame khona
ukukhulelwa
ukuhlangana kwamaseli amabili e-haploid avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezimbili ngazinye

 gametophyte
isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila we-haploid enamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza ama-gametes

amangqamuzana egciwane
 umugqa weseli okhethekile okhiqiza ama-gametes, njengamaqanda noma isidoda

i-haploid-dominant
 uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-haploid enamangqamuzana amaningi sivame khona

i-interkinesis
 (futhi, i-interphase II) isikhathi esifushane sokuphumula phakathi kwe-meiosis I ne-meiosis II

umjikelezo wokuphila
 ukulandelana kwemicimbi ekuthuthukisweni kwendalo kanye nokukhiqizwa kwamangqamuzana akhiqiza inzalo

i-meiosis
 inqubo yokuhlukaniswa kwenyukliya eholela kumaseli amane e-haploid

i-meiosis I
 umjikelezo wokuqala wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic; okubizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa ngoba izinga le-ploidy lincishisiwe kusuka ku-diploid kuya ku-haploid

i-meiosis II
 umzuliswano wesibili wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic ngemuva kwe-meiosis I; ama-chromatid angodade ahlukaniswe ngama-chromosome ngamanye, futhi umphumela uba amaseli amane e-haploid ahlukile

ama-nodules okuhlanganisa kabusha
 izinhlangano zamaprotheni ezakhiwe ku-synaptonemal complex eziphawula amaphuzu emicimbi ye-crossover futhi ziqondise inqubo yezinyathelo eziningi zokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade

ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa
 ukuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear okukhiqiza i-nuclei yendodakazi ngayinye enamasethi e-chromosome amaningi ayingxenye eyodwa kwengxenye njenge-nucleus yomzali; i-meiosis I ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa

iseli le-somatic
 wonke amaseli ento ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi ngaphandle kwama-gametes noma amaseli okuzala

i-spore
 iseli le-haploid elingakhiqiza into ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi e-haploid noma elingahlangana nenye i-spore ukuze yakhe iseli le-diploid

i-sporophyte
 isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila we-diploid enamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza ama-haploid spores nge-meiosis

i-synapsis
 ukwakheka kobudlelwano obuseduze phakathi kwama-chromosome e-homologous ngesikhathi se-prophase I

i-synaptonemal complex
 i-protein lattice eyakha phakathi kwama-chromosome e-homologous ngesikhathi se-prophase I, esekela i-crossover

i-tetrad
 ama-chromosome amabili e-homologous aphindaphindiwe (ama-chromatids amane) ahlanganiswe ndawonye yi-chiasmata ngesikhathi se-prophase I
question1: Kuyini ukushintshana kwezizukulwane?
answer1: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho izigaba ze-diploid neze-haploid zishintshana khona
distractor1a: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-diploid samaseli amaningi sivame khona
distractor1b: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi sivame khona
distractor1c: Ukulandelana kwezenzakalo ekuthuthukisweni kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokukhiqizwa kwamaseli akhiqiza inzalo
question2: Ziyini i-chiasmata?
answer2: (isinye, i-chiasma) isakhiwo esakheka ezindaweni ezihambisanayo ngemva kokushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo
distractor2a: Izinhlangano zamaprotheni ezakhiwe ku-synaptonemal complex eziphawula amaphuzu emicimbi ye-crossover
distractor2b: Amaprotheni akha inhlanganisela ehlanganisa ama-chromatids angodade ndawonye kuma-centromere awo
distractor2c: I-lattice yeprotheni eyakha phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-prophase I
question3: Kuyini i-cohesin?
answer3: Amaprotheni akha inhlanganisela ehlanganisa ama-chromatids angodade ndawonye kuma-centromere awo kuze kube yi-anaphase II ye-meiosis
distractor3a: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaprotheni okuphawula izehlakalo ezihambisanayo futhi kuqondise ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor3b: I-lattice yeprotheni eyakha phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor3c: Izakhiwo ezakheka ezindaweni ezivundlile ngemva kokushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo
question4: Kuyini ukujikijela?
answer4: Ukushintshana kwezinto zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodadewabo okuholela kuma-chromosome afaka izakhi zofuzo ezivela kubazali bobabili bento ephilayo
distractor4a: Ukwakheka kobudlelwano obuseduze phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor4b: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaseli amabili e-haploid avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezimbili ngazinye
distractor4c: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromatids angodadewabo kuma-chromosome ngamanye ngesikhathi se-meiosis II
question5: Uyini umjikelezo wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid?
answer5: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-diploid samaseli amaningi sivame khona
distractor5a: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi sivame khona
distractor5b: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho izigaba ze-diploid neze-haploid zishintshana khona
distractor5c: Isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila esikhiqiza ama-gametes emvelweni we-haploid enamangqamuzana amaningi
question6: Kuyini ukukhulelwa?
answer6: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaseli amabili e-haploid avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezimbili ngazinye
distractor6a: Ukushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade
distractor6b: Ukwakheka kobudlelwano obuseduze phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo
distractor6c: Ukuhlukaniswa kwenyukliya okukhiqiza amaseli amane e-haploid
question7: Iyini i-gametophyte?
answer7: Isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila we-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza ama-gametes
distractor7a: Isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila we-diploid enamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza ama-haploid spores nge-meiosis
distractor7b: Umugqa weseli okhethekile okhiqiza ama-gametes, njengamaqanda noma isidoda
distractor7c: Iseli le-haploid elingakhiqiza i-haploid multicellular organism
question8: Ayini amaseli egciwane?
answer8: Umugqa weseli okhethekile okhiqiza ama-gametes, njengamaqanda noma isidoda
distractor8a: Wonke amangqamuzana ento ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi ngaphandle kwama-gametes noma amangqamuzana okuzala
distractor8b: Amangqamuzana e-haploid angakhiqiza i-haploid multicellular organism
distractor8c: Izigaba zomjikelezo wokuphila we-haploid ezinamaseli amaningi ezikhiqiza ama-gametes
question9: Uyini umjikelezo wokuphila olawulwa yi-haploid?
answer9: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi sivame khona
distractor9a: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho isigaba se-diploid samaseli amaningi sivame khona
distractor9b: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho izigaba ze-diploid neze-haploid zishintshana khona
distractor9c: Isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila lapho ama-spores e-haploid akhiqizwa khona yi-meiosis
question10: Kuyini i-interkinesis?
answer10: (futhi, i-interphase II) isikhathi esifushane sokuphumula phakathi kwe-meiosis I ne-meiosis II
distractor10a: Umjikelezo wokuqala wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic okunciphisa izinga le-ploidy
distractor10b: Umjikelezo wesibili wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic lapho ama-chromatids angodade ehlukana khona
distractor10c: Isikhathi lapho ama-chromosome afanayo ehlangana futhi edlula khona
question11: Uyini umjikelezo wokuphila?
answer11: Ukulandelana kwezenzakalo ekuthuthukisweni kwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokukhiqizwa kwamaseli akhiqiza inzalo
distractor11a: Uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila lapho izigaba ze-diploid neze-haploid zishintshana khona
distractor11b: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaseli amabili e-haploid avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezimbili ngazinye
distractor11c: Inqubo yokuhlukaniswa kwenyukliya eholela kumaseli amane e-haploid
question12: Kuyini i-meiosis?
answer12: Inqubo yokuhlukanisa i-nuclear eholela kumaseli amane e-haploid
distractor12a: Inqubo yokuhlukanisa i-nuclear ephumela kumaseli amabili e-diploid afanayo ngokofuzo
distractor12b: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaseli amabili e-haploid avela ezintweni eziphilayo ezimbili ngazinye
distractor12c: Ukushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade
question13: Kuyini i-meiosis I?
answer13: Umjikelezo wokuqala wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic; okubizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa ngoba izinga le-ploidy liyancipha kusukela ku-diploid kuya ku-haploid
distractor13a: Umjikelezo wesibili wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic lapho kuhlukaniswa khona ama-chromatids angodadewabo
distractor13b: Isikhathi esifushane sokuphumula phakathi kwemijikelezo emibili yokuhlukaniswa kwe-meiotic
distractor13c: Ukuhlukaniswa kwenyukliya okukhiqiza amaseli amabili endodakazi afanayo ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question14: Kuyini i-meiosis II?
answer14: Umjikelezo wesibili wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic ngemuva kwe-meiosis I; ama-chromatids angodadewabo ahlukaniswa ngama-chromosome ngamanye, futhi umphumela uba amaseli amane e-haploid ahlukile
distractor14a: Umjikelezo wokuqala wokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli e-meiotic lapho ama-chromosome afanayo ehlukana khona
distractor14b: Isikhathi esifushane sokuphumula phakathi kwe-meiosis I ne-meiosis II
distractor14c: Isigaba lapho izinga le-ploidy lincishiswa khona kusukela ku-diploid kuya ku-haploid
question15: Ayini amaqhubu e-recombination?
answer15: Imihlangano yamaprotheni eyakhiwe ku-synaptonemal complex ephawula amaphuzu emicimbi ye-crossover futhi iqondise inqubo yezinyathelo eziningi zokuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade
distractor15a: Amaprotheni ahlanganisa ama-chromatids angodade ndawonye kuma-centromere awo kuze kube yi-anaphase II
distractor15b: Izakhiwo ezakheka ezindaweni ezivundlile ngemva kokushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo
distractor15c: Ama-lattice amaprotheni akha phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-prophase I
question16: Kuyini ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa?
answer16: Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-nuclear okukhiqiza i-nuclei yendodakazi ngayinye enamaqoqo ama-chromosome anguhhafu njenge-nucleus yomzali; i-meiosis I ukuhlukaniswa kokunciphisa
distractor16a: Ukuhlukaniswa kwenyukliya okukhiqiza i-nuclei yendodakazi enenani elifanayo lama-chromosome njenge-nucleus yomzali
distractor16b: Ukuhlukaniswa lapho ama-chromatids angodade ehlukana khona ngaphandle kokunciphisa inombolo yesethi yama-chromosome
distractor16c: Ukuhlanganiswa kwama-nuclei amabili e-haploid okubuyisela inombolo yesethi yama-chromosome e-diploid
question17: Iyini iseli le-somatic?
answer17: Wonke amangqamuzana ento ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi ngaphandle kwama-gametes noma amangqamuzana okuzala
distractor17a: Umugqa weseli okhethekile okhiqiza ama-gametes, njengamaqanda noma isidoda
distractor17b: Iseli le-haploid elingakhiqiza i-haploid multicellular organism
distractor17c: Isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila we-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza ama-gametes
question18: Iyini i-spore?
answer18: Iseli le-haploid elingakhiqiza isilwane esinezinhlayiya eziningi ze-haploid noma elingahlangana nesinye isiponji ukuze sakhe iseli le-diploid
distractor18a: Iseli elikhethekile okumele lihlangane ne-gamete ukuze lihlale li-haploid
distractor18b: Isigaba se-diploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza amangqamuzana e-haploid nge-meiosis
distractor18c: Iseli le-diploid elakhiwe ukuhlangana kwama-gametes amabili e-haploid
answer19: Isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila we-diploid enamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza ama-haploid spores nge-meiosis
distractor19a: Isigaba somjikelezo wokuphila we-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi esikhiqiza ama-gametes
distractor19b: Iseli le-haploid elingakhiqiza i-haploid multicellular organism
distractor19c: Umugqa weseli okhethekile okhiqiza amaqanda noma isidoda
answer20: Ukwakheka kobudlelwano obuseduze phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor20a: Ukushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona angodade
distractor20b: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-anaphase I
distractor20c: Ukuhlangana kwamaseli amabili e-haploid ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa
answer21: I-lattice yamaprotheni eyakheka phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-prophase I, esekela i-crossover
distractor21a: I-protein complex ehlanganisa ama-chromatids angodade ndawonye kuma-centromere awo
distractor21b: Isakhiwo esakheka endaweni yokuhlangana ngemva kokushintshaniswa kwezinto zofuzo
distractor21c: Ukuhlanganiswa kwamaprotheni okunamathisela ama-chromosomes kuma-fibre e-spindle ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa
answer22: Ama-chromosome amabili aphindaphindiwe afanayo (ama-chromatids amane) ahlanganiswe ndawonye yi-chiasmata ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor22a: Ama-chromatids amabili angodade ahlanganiswe ndawonye ku-centromere eyodwa ngesikhathi se-meiosis II
distractor22b: Ama-chromosome amane angewona awekhomfologo aqoqwe ndawonye ngesikhathi se-metaphase II
distractor22c: Amaseli amabili endodakazi e-haploid akhiwe ekupheleni kwe-meiosis I

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.4 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 11. I-Meiosis Nokuzala Ngocansi | 11.4 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
11.1 Inqubo ye-Meiosis
Ukuzala ngokocansi kudinga ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid zikhiqize amangqamuzana e-haploid angahlangana ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa ukuze akhe inzalo ye-diploid. Njengase-mitosis, ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kwenzeka ngaphambi kwe-meiosis ngesikhathi se-S-phase yomjikelezo weseli. I-Meiosis uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ezihlela futhi zihlukanise ama-chromosome nama-chromatid abe amaseli endodakazi. Ngesikhathi se-interphase ye-meiosis, i-chromosome ngayinye iyaphindaphindwa. Ku-meiosis, kunezindilinga ezimbili zokuhlukaniswa kwe-nyukliya okuholela kuma-nuclei amane futhi ngokuvamile amaseli endodakazi amane, ngalinye linengxenye yenani lama-chromosome njengeseli lomzali. Elokuqala lihlukanisa ama-homologs, kanti elesibili—njenge-mitosis—lihlukanisa ama-chromatid abe ama-chromosome ngamanye. Ngesikhathi se-meiosis, ukuhlukahluka kuma-nuclei endodakazi kwethulwa ngenxa ye-crossover ku-prophase I kanye nokuqondaniswa okungahleliwe kwama-tetrad ku-metaphase I. Amaseli akhiqizwa yi-meiosis ahlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo.

 I-Meiosis ne-mitosis zifana, kodwa zinemiphumela ehlukile. Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-Mitotic kuwukuhlukaniswa okukodwa kwe-nuclear okukhiqiza i-nuclei yendodakazi efana ngofuzo futhi enenani elifanayo lamasethi e-chromosome njengeseli lokuqala. Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-Meiotic kufaka phakathi ukuhlukaniswa okubili kwe-nuclear okukhiqiza i-nuclei yendodakazi emine ehlukile ngofuzo futhi enesethi eyodwa ye-chromosome esikhundleni samasethi amabili ama-chromosome kuseli lomzali. Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwezinqubo uvela ekuhlukanisweni kokuqala kwe-meiosis, lapho ama-chromosome afanayo ebhangqwa futhi eshintshana ngezigaba ze-chromatid ezingezona ezikadadewabo. Ama-chromosome afanayo ahlukana abe yi-nuclei ehlukene ngesikhathi se-meiosis I, okubangela ukwehla kwezinga le-ploidy ekuhlukanisweni kokuqala. Ukuhlukaniswa kwesibili kwe-meiosis kufana kakhulu nokuhlukaniswa kwe-mitotic, ngaphandle kokuthi amaseli endodakazi awaqukethe ama-genome afanayo ngenxa ye-crossover.

 11.2 Ukuzala Ngocansi
Cishe wonke ama-eukaryote azalwa kabusha ngokocansi. Ukwehluka okulethwa kumaseli okuzala yi-meiosis kubonakala kungenye yezinzuzo zokuzala kabusha ngokocansi okuye kwenza kwaba yimpumelelo kangaka. I-Meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa kuyashintshana emijikelezweni yokuphila ngokocansi. Inqubo ye-meiosis ikhiqiza amangqamuzana okuzala ahlukile abizwa ngokuthi ama-gametes, anesigamu senani lama-chromosome njengeseli lomzali. Ukuzala, ukuhlanganiswa kwama-gametes e-haploid avela kubantu ababili, kubuyisela isimo se-diploid. Ngakho-ke, izinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi ziyashintshana phakathi kwezigaba ze-haploid neze-diploid. Kodwa-ke, izindlela amangqamuzana okuzala akhiqizwa ngazo kanye nesikhathi esiphakathi kwe-meiosis nokuzala ziyahlukahluka kakhulu. Kunezinhlobo ezintathu eziyinhloko zemijikelezo yokuphila: okubusa nge-diploid, okubonakala ezilwaneni eziningi; okubusa nge-haploid, okubonakala kuzo zonke izikhunta kanye nolwelwe oluthile; kanye nokushintshana kwezizukulwane, okubonakala ezitshalweni kanye nolwelwe oluthile.
question1: Mangaki futhi hlobo luni lwamaseli endodakazi akhiqizwa yi-meiosis?
answer1: I-haploid ezine
question2: Yisiphi isakhiwo esibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ama-tetrad?
question3: Kukusiphi isigaba se-meiosis lapho ama-chromatids angodade ahlukaniswa khona?
answer3: I-anaphase II
question4: Ku-metaphase I, ama-chromosome afanayo axhunywe kuziphi izakhiwo kuphela?
answer4: I-chiasmata
question5: Yisiphi isigaba(izigaba) se-mitotic interphase esingekho ku-meiotic interkinesis?
answer5: Isigaba se-S
question6: Iyiphi ingxenye ye-meiosis efana kakhulu ne-mitosis?
answer6: I-meiosis II
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esingelona iqiniso maqondana nokuwela ngaphesheya?
answer7: Ama-microtubules e-spindle aqondisa ukunyakaza kwezinto ze-chromosome
distractor7b: Ama-chromatids angewona adade ashintshana ngezinto zofuzo
question8: Kungasiphi isigaba se-meiosis lapho kwenzeka khona umjikelezo wesibili wokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer8: I-metaphase I
distractor8c: Ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi se-prophase I
question9: Yiluphi uhlobo lomjikelezo wokuphila olunesigaba samaseli amaningi se-haploid kanye nesigaba se-diploid?
answer9: Ukushintshana kwezizukulwane
question10: Iyini umthombo wokwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ekuzaleni okungenabo ubulili?
answer10: Ukuguqulwa kwe-DNA
question11: Iyini inzuzo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yokuzala ngokocansi kunokuzala okungenabo ubulili?
distractor11b: Ukuzala ngokocansi kusebenza kahle kakhulu ngokwendlela umzimba osebenza ngayo
distractor11c: Ukuzala ngokocansi kusebenzisa izinsiza ezimbalwa endaweni ethile
question12: Iyini inkinga yokuzala ngokocansi kunezinhlobo zokuzala ezingahambisani nocansi?
distractor12b: Ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ezishintsha ngokushesha kunzima kakhulu
distractor12c: Amanani okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ahamba kancane
question13: Isikhunta ngokuvamile sibonisa uhlobo luni lomjikelezo wokuphila?
question14: Nikeza igama leseli le-haploid elikhiqizwa yi-meiosis entweni ephilayo elawulwa yi-diploid
answer14: I-gamete
question15: Chaza ukuthi kwenzekani kuma-tetrad ngemva kokwakheka kwawo
answer15: I-Prophase I ye-meiosis yakha ama-tetrad. Ahlangana endaweni ephakathi kwezinsika ezimbili zeseli ukuze akhe ipuleti le-metaphase. Kunethuba elilinganayo lokuthi i-microtubule fiber ihlangane ne-chromosome ezuzwe njengomama noma njengoyise. Ukuqondiswa kwe-tetrad ngayinye akuxhomekile ekuqondisweni kwamanye ama-tetrad.
distractor15a: I-Prophase II ye-meiosis yakha ama-tetrad. Ahlangana endaweni ephakathi kwezinsika ezimbili zeseli ukuze akhe ipuleti le-metaphase. Kunethuba elilinganayo lokuthi i-microtubule fiber ihlangane ne-chromosome ezuzwe njengomama noma njengoyise. Ukuqondiswa kwe-tetrad ngayinye akuxhomekile ekuqondisweni kwamanye ama-tetrad.
distractor15b: I-Prophase I ye-mitosis yakha ama-tetrad. Ahlangana phakathi kwezigxobo ezimbili zeseli ukuze akhe ipuleti le-metaphase. Kunethuba elincane lokuthi i-fiber ye-microtubule ihlangane ne-chromosome ezuzwe njengomama kanye neyobaba. Ukuqondiswa kwe-tetrad ngayinye akuxhomekile ekuqondisweni kwamanye ama-tetrad.
distractor15c: I-Prophase I ye-meiosis yakha ama-tetrad. Ahlangana phakathi kwezigxobo ezimbili zeseli ukuze akhe ipuleti le-metaphase. Kukhona ithuba lokuthi i-microtubule fiber ihlangane ne-chromosome ezuzwe njengomama. Ukuqondiswa kwe-tetrad ngayinye akuxhomekile ekuqondisweni kwamanye ama-tetrad.
question16: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuhlukanisa i-metaphase I ne-metaphase II?
answer16: I-Metaphase I yenzeka lapho ama-chromosome amabili afanayo ehlangana epuletini le-metaphase. I-Metaphase II inama-chromatids angodadewabo ama-chromosome ahlangene epuletini le-metaphase.
distractor16a: I-Metaphase I yenzeka lapho ama-chromosome evela ngama-homologous pairs epuletini le-metaphase. I-Metaphase II inama-chromatids angama-single ama-chromosomes ku-spindle.
distractor16b: I-Metaphase I yenzeka lapho ama-chromosome ehlukanisa ama-homologous pairs ku-spindle. I-Metaphase II inomugqa owodwa wama-chromosomes ku-plate
distractor16c: I-Metaphase I yenzeka lapho ama-chromosome evela ngamabili afanayo ku-spindle. Ngesikhathi se-metaphase II, ama-chromosome alandelana ngomugqa ophindwe kabili ku-spindle.
question17: Nakuba izigaba ze-meiosis zinamagama afanayo nezigaba ze-mitosis, zibonisa umehluko oyisisekelo. Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise izinqubo ezimbili ukuze usho ngokunembile umehluko wazo oyinhloko.
answer17: I-Meiosis ihlukile ku-mitosis ngokuthi inani lama-chromosome lincishiswa ngesigamu futhi ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kungeniswa ku-meiosis, kodwa hhayi ku-mitosis.
distractor17a: I-Meiosis ihlukile ku-mitosis ngokuthi inani lama-chromosome lincishiswa ngesigamu futhi ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuncishisiwe ku-meiosis, kodwa hhayi ku-mitosis.
distractor17b: Izingxenye ze-metaphase kanye ne-telophase ze-meiosis kanye ne-mitosis ziyafana, kodwa izingxenye ze-anaphase kanye ne-prophase zihlukile. I-Meiosis kanye ne-mitosis ziyahlukahluka ngokujwayelekile ngenani lama-chromosome ahilelekile.
distractor17c: Izingxenye ze-prophase ne-telophase ze-meiosis ne-mitosis ziyafana, kodwa i-anaphase I ne-anaphase zihlukile. I-Meiosis II ne-mitosis nazo ziyafana futhi zinenani elifanayo lama-chromosome.
question18: Chaza ukuthi ukuqondiswa kwama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-meiosis kunikela kanjani ekwahlukeni okukhulu kwama-gametes
answer18: Ukuqondana okungahleliwe kwama-chromosome afanayo kupuleti le-metaphase kuqinisekisa indawo engahleliwe yama-chromosome kumaseli endodakazi.
distractor18a: Ngenxa yokuthi ama-chromosome afanayo ahlukana nemicu ye-spindle ngesikhathi se-metaphase I, athuthela ngokungahleliwe kumaseli endodakazi.
distractor18b: Ama-chromosome afanayo ahlanganiswa ngokuqinile ngesikhathi se-metaphase I futhi adlula ku-crossover njengoba i-synaptonemal complex yakha i-lattice ewazungezile.
distractor18c: Ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwama-chromosome kamama nobaba kwenzeka ku-metaphase I ngoba ama-chromosome afanayo awaxhunyiwe kuma-centromere awo
question19: I-Red Queen hypothesis, okubhekiselwa kuyo encwadini kaLewis Carrolls, ethi Through the Looking Glass, ihlose ukuchaza izici ezithile zokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Chaza ukuthi inkulumo ethi “Red Queen” ithi “Kuthatha konke ukugijima ongakwenza ukuze uhlale endaweni efanayo,” ichaza ukuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezincintisanayo.
answer19: Uma uhlobo olulodwa luthola inzuzo ngokuguquguquka okuhle, ingcindezi yokukhetha iyanda kolunye uhlobo oluncintisana nalo. Lolu hlobo kumele futhi luthuthukise inzuzo kungenjalo luzonqotshwa. Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili ziyaguquka ukuze zihlale endaweni efanayo.
distractor19a: Uma uhlobo oluzalanayo ngokocansi kanye nohlobo oluzalanayo ngokungahambisani ngokocansi luncintisana ngezinsiza ezifanayo, zombili ziyavela endaweni efanayo” ngoba ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo okwandisiwe kohlobo oluzalanayo ngokocansi kulinganisela ukulahlekelwa kwamandla asetshenziswa yizinhlobo ukuthola nokuheha abangane.
distractor19b: Uma uhlobo olulodwa luba noguquko olunciphisa ikhono lalo lokusinda, uhlobo oluncintisanayo luzokwazi ukusinda kangcono yize lungakashintshi nganoma iyiphi indlela. Empeleni, lolu hlobo lwesibili luyashintsha ukuze luhlale endaweni efanayo.
distractor19c: Lapho izinhlobo ezimbili ezizalana ngokungahambisani nobulili zibhekana noshintsho olusheshayo lwemvelo, izinhlobo ezikwaziyo ukuzala ngokocansi zizoncintisana nezinye. Ngale ndlela zingaqhubeka [ziguquke] ukuze zihlale endaweni efanayo.”
question20: Yiziphi izinqubo ezintathu eziholela ekuhlukeni phakathi kwezingane ezinabazali ababili abafanayo?
distractor20b: Ukuwela, ukuhlukahluka kwama-chromosome okungahleliwe, ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor20c: I-meiosis, ukuwela, ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo
question21: Qhathanisa izinhlobo ezintathu eziyinhloko zemijikelezo yokuphila ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi njengoba kuchaziwe ngezansi. Thola ukuthi yikuphi ukuqhathanisa okunembile nokuthi yikuphi okunikeza isibonelo esifanele sento ephilayo esebenzisa uhlobo ngalunye
answer21: Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid, isigaba samaseli amaningi se-diploid sikhona, njengakubantu. Imijikelezo yokuphila elawulwa yi-Haploid inesigaba samaseli amaningi se-haploid, njengaku-fungi. Ekushintsheni kwezizukulwane, zombili izigaba ezilawulwa yi-haploid kanye nezigaba ezilawulwa yi-diploid ziyizinhlobo eziningi futhi izigaba ziyashintshana, njengasezitshalweni.
distractor21a: Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid, isigaba se-unicellular sikhona, njengakubantu. Imijikelezo yokuphila elawulwa yi-Haploid inesigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi, njengaku-fungi. Ekushintsheni kwezizukulwane, zombili izigaba ezilawulwa yi-haploid kanye nezigaba ezilawulwa yi-diploid ziyizinhlobo eziningi futhi izigaba ziyashintshana, njengasezitshalweni.
distractor21b: Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid, isigaba samaseli amaningi se-haploid sikhona, njengakubantu. Imijikelezo yokuphila elawulwa yi-haploid inesigaba samaseli amaningi se-haploid, njengakufungi. Ekushintsheni kwezizukulwane, zombili izigaba ezilawulwa yi-haploid kanye nezigaba ezilawulwa yi-diploid ziyizinhlobo eziningi futhi izigaba ziyashintshana, njengasezitshalweni.
distractor21c: Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-diploid, isigaba se-diploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi sikhona, njengase-algae. Emjikelezweni wokuphila olawulwa yi-haploid, isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi sikhona, njengasezitshalweni. Ekushintsheni kwezizukulwane, zombili izigaba ze-haploid-dominant kanye nezigaba ze-diploid-dominant ziyizinhlobo eziningi futhi izigaba ziyashintshana, njengakubantu.
question22: Amaseli okuzala ezinhlotsheni eziningi ahlukile kumaseli akha ingxenye esele yezinto eziphilayo. Abizwa kanjani amaseli omzimba futhi ahluke kanjani kumaseli okuzala?
answer22: Amaseli omzimba abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-somatic futhi anenani eliphindwe kabili lama-chromosome atholakala kumaseli okuzala.
distractor22a: Amaseli omzimba abizwa ngokuthi ama-gametes futhi anesigamu senani lama-chromosome atholakala kumaseli okuzala.
distractor22b: Amaseli omzimba abizwa ngokuthi amaseli e-somatic futhi anenani elifanayo lama-chromosomes namaseli okuzala.
distractor22c: Amaseli omzimba abizwa ngokuthi ama-gametes futhi anenani eliphindwe kabili lama-chromosome atholakala kumaseli okuzala.
question23: Ama-spores ayizakhiwo ezikhiqizwa ezinye izitshalo kanye nazo zonke izikhunta. Sebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho ukuthi yini echaza izinhlobo zamaseli izinto eziphilayo ezinawo kanye nemisebenzi yalawo maseli ukuze uthole isitatimende esichaza futhi sichaze ama-spores ngokunembile.
answer23: Ama-spores angamaseli okuzala e-haploid angakhiqiza izinto eziphilayo ze-haploid nge-mitosis
distractor23a: Ama-spores ayizinto ezandulela ama-gametes ezidala ama-gametes lapho izimo zemvelo zivuma.
distractor23b: Ama-spores angamaseli okuzala e-haploid angakhiqiza amaseli e-diploid ngaphandle kokuvundisa
distractor23c: Ama-spores angamaseli e-somatic e-diploid akhiwa kuphela ngesikhathi sokuzala okungenabo ubulili ngakho awakhiwa yi-meiosis
question24: Ku-prophase I, ama-chromosome afanayo ayahlanganiswa futhi axhunywe ndawonye. Iyiphi incazelo echaza kangcono izakhiwo kanye nezindlela ezibangela lesi senzo?
answer24: I-synaptonemal complex iyi-lattice yamaprotheni ebopha ama-chromosome ndawonye ubude bawo futhi igcine ukuhambisana kwawo okuqinile
distractor24a: Ama-tetrad asebenza njengohlobo lweglue oluvimbela ama-chromosome ukuthi ahlukane ngobude bawo futhi agcine ukuhambisana kwama-chromosome
distractor24b: I-centromere iqukethe amaprotheni e-cohesin abopha ama-chromosome abhangqiwe eziqongweni zawo
distractor24c: Amaprotheni e-Cohesin akha i-synaptonemal complex ehlanganisa ama-chromosome ndawonye kuma-centromere awo
question25: Enye yezindlela ukuzala ngokocansi okuthuthukisa ngazo ukuhlukahluka kwenzalo evela kubazali abafanayo ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi ukuwela ngaphesheya. Nikeza isizathu esisekela lo mqondo ngokuhlonza izakhiwo kanye nesigaba se-meiotic esihilelekile ekuweleni ngaphesheya
answer25: Ukuwela kwenzeka phakathi kwama-chromatids angewona odade bama-chromosome afanayo ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor25a: Ukuwela kwenzeka phakathi kwe-tetrads ngesikhathi se-prophase I
distractor25b: Ukuwela kwenzeka phakathi kwama-chromatids angodade ngesikhathi se-metaphase I
distractor25c: Ukuwela kwenzeka phakathi kwama-chromosome angewona awe-homologous ngesikhathi se-telophase I kanye ne-cytokinesis
question26: Kunemithombo emithathu yokwehlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo ekuzaleni ngokocansi. Thola ukuthi yiziphi izitatimende ezilandelayo ezichaza ngokunembile ukuthi yiziphi kulezi ezibhekwa njengezingahleliwe nokuthi yiziphi ezingezona
answer26: Zonke izinhlobo ezintathu zokushintshashintsha kwezakhi zofuzo zibhekwa njengezingahleliwe
distractor26a: Ukuwela kubhekwa njengokungahleliwe; ukukhulelwa kweqanda nesidoda kanye nokuqondana kwe-tetrad ku-meiotic spindle akuwona
distractor26b: Ukuqondana kwe-tetrad ku-spindle kanye nokuwela kubhekwa njengokungahleliwe; ukukhulelwa kweqanda kanye nesidoda akusikho
distractor26c: Ukukhulelwa kweqanda nesidoda kanye nokuqondana kwe-tetrad ku-spindle kubhekwa njengokungahleliwe; ukuwela phezu kwe-spindle akuyona into engavamile.
question27: Yiluphi uhlobo lwemijikelezo yokuphila yezinhlobo ezintathu zezinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo ngokocansi olungenaso isigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi?
distractor27c: Zonke zinesigaba se-haploid esinamangqamuzana amaningi emijikelezweni yazo yokuphila
question28: Ama-spores akhiqizwa kanjani ekushintsheni kwemijikelezo yokuphila kwesizukulwane?
question29: Ukuqhathaniswa kwemijikelezo yokuphila elawulwa yi-haploid kanye nokushintshana kwemijikelezo yokuphila yesizukulwane kwembula ukuthi bafana ngokufana kodwa futhi babonisa umehluko. Yisiphi kulezi zinqubo noma izakhiwo ezilandelayo esitholakala emijikelezweni yokuphila elawulwa yi-haploid kodwa hhayi ukushintshana kwemijikelezo yokuphila yesizukulwane?

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Phakathi nekhulu le-19, esikhathini eside ngaphambi kokuba kutholakale ama-chromosome noma izakhi zofuzo, uJohann Gregor Mendel wabeka uhlaka lwezakhi zofuzo ngokutadisha uhlelo olulula lwezinto eziphilayo, i-garden pea. Wenza ukuhlaziywa okuhlelekile nokwezibalo esebenzisa ubukhulu obukhulu besampula. Umsebenzi kaMendel wabeka isisekelo sezimiso eziyisisekelo zofuzo. Manje sesiyazi ukuthi izakhi zofuzo, eziqhutshwa kuma-chromosome, ziyiyunithi eziyisisekelo zokusebenza zofuzo ezinamandla okuphindaphindwa, ukuvezwa, ukucindezelwa, ukuguqulwa nokuguqulwa. Namuhla, ama-postulates abekwe nguMendel akha isisekelo sezakhi zofuzo zakudala, noma i-Mendelian. Izakhi zofuzo azilandeli zonke izimiso zezakhi zofuzo zikaMendelian, kodwa ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kusebenza njengendawo enhle yokuqala yokucabanga ngefa.

 Ukuqonda ifa lezakhi zofuzo kwenza ososayensi bakwazi ukufunda nokuchaza izenzakalo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Isibonelo, ososayensi bafunda izinsalela zezinja zasendulo ezingu-84 ezivela eNyakatho naseNingizimu Melika. Bathole ukuthi ezinye zezinja zazinokuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo, okubonisa ukuthi lezi zinja kungenzeka ukuthi zazizalana nezimpisi zaseMelika. Ezinye izinja ezikusampula yazo zazinokwehlukahluka okuphansi, okubonisa ukuthi abantu basendulo babezala izinja ngamabomu. Ucwaningo luthole nokuthi izinja zathuthela eMelika nabantu eminyakeni engaba yi-10,000 edlule. Bheka Umfanekiso 12.1
question1: Kungani izivivinyo zikaMendel zibhekwa njengesisekelo sezakhi zofuzo zanamuhla?
answer1: Basungula izimiso eziyisisekelo zefa ngokutadisha ukuthi izici zidluliselwa kanjani kubazali ziya ezinganeni
distractor1c: Bafakazele ukuthi ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuwukuphela komthombo wokwehluka
question2: Kungani ubhontshisi bensimu wawuyisilwane esifanelekile sokuhlolwa kukaMendels?
answer2: Zinezici ezibonakala kalula, zizalana ngokushesha, futhi zingakwazi ukuzivundisa ngokwazo noma ngokuzihlanganisa
question3: Izakhi zofuzo zanamuhla zibonise ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zithwalwa yiziphi izakhiwo zamaseli?
answer3: Ama-chromosome
question4: Kungani uMendel asebenzisa amasampula amakhulu osayizi ekuhlolweni kwakhe?
answer4: Amasampula amakhulu amvumela ukuthi abone amaphethini efa ahambisanayo naphezu kokushintsha okungahleliwe
distractor4a: Izitshalo ze-pea zikhiqiza inzalo encane kakhulu
question5: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA yezinja zasendulo kwabonisa ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zazinokwehlukahlukana okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo kunezinye. Iyiphi incazelo engaba khona kakhulu?
answer5: Ezinye izinja zasendulo zazalaniswa nezimpisi zaseMelika
distractor5b: Izinja zazinezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo ngenxa yokuzalana okukhethiwe
distractor5c: Zonke izinja zasendulo zavela ngokuzimela eMelika
question6: Ososayensi bathole ukuthi ezinye izinja zasendulo zazinokwehlukahluka okuncane kwezakhi zofuzo. Iyiphi incazelo engaba khona kakhulu?
answer6: Abantu basendulo babezizalanisa ngokukhetha izinja
question7: Kungani imithetho kaMendel ihlala ibalulekile yize kungezona zonke izakhi zofuzo ezilandela ifa likaMendelian?
answer7: Zihlinzeka ngohlaka oluyisisekelo lokuqonda amaphethini efa
distractor7a: Zonke izakhi zofuzo zilandela imithetho kaMendels ngaphandle kokukhetha
distractor7b: Izakhi zofuzo zanamuhla zithathe indawo yezimiso zikaMendels ngokuphelele

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye nemithetho yokungenzeka | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Izakhi zofuzo yisayensi yofuzo. Indela yase-Austria uGregor Mendel yabeka uhlaka lwezakhi zofuzo kudala ngaphambi kokuba kutholakale ama-chromosome noma izakhi zofuzo, ngesikhathi lapho i-meiosis yayingaqondakali kahle. Esebenza ngama-peas asegadini, uMendel wathola ukuthi ukuxutshwa phakathi kwabazali bokuzalanisa ngempela (P) okwahluka ngesici esisodwa (isb., umbala: uphizi oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka uma kuqhathaniswa nophizi ophuzi) kwakhiqiza inzalo yesizukulwane sokuqala (F1) eyayiveza isici somzali oyedwa (isb., yonke iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka noma yonke iphuzi). UMendel wasebenzisa igama elithi dominant ukubhekisela kusici esabonwa, kanye nelithi recessive ukubhekisela kusici esingavezwanga, noma isici esasinyamalele” kulesi sizukulwane sokuqala. Lapho inzalo ye-F1 ihlanganiswa, inzalo ye-F2 yabonisa zombili izici ngesilinganiso esingu-3:1. Ezinye iziphambano (isb., ukuphakama: izitshalo ezinde uma kuqhathaniswa nezitshalo ezimfushane) zakhiqiza isilinganiso esifanayo esingu-3:1 (kulesi sibonelo, ubude kuya kufushane) enzalweni ye-F2. Ngokuhlola ngokwezibalo osayizi besampula, uMendel wabonisa ukuthi iziphambano zezakhi zofuzo zaziziphatha ngokwemithetho yamathuba, nokuthi izici zazuzwa njengezehlakalo ezizimele. Ngamanye amazwi, uMendel wasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo ukwakha imodeli yakhe yefa.

 Njengoba kungenzeka ukuthi uqaphele, inkambo ye-AP Biology igcizelela ukusetshenziswa kwezibalo. Imithetho emibili yamathuba ingasetshenziswa ukuthola izilinganiso ezilindelekile zezici ezahlukene enzalweni ezivela eziphambanweni ezahlukene. Ukuze uthole amathuba emicimbi emibili noma ngaphezulu ezimele (imicimbi lapho umphumela wesenzakalo esisodwa ungenalo ithonya emphumeleni wesinye isenzakalo) eyenzeka ndawonye, sebenzisa umthetho womkhiqizo bese uphinda amathuba omuntu ngamunye. izenzakalo. Ukuze uthole amathuba okuthi kwenzeke esinye sezenzakalo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu, sebenzisa umthetho wesamba bese uhlanganisa amathuba azo ndawonye.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ze-AP® zihlanganisa okuqukethwe kolwazi olubalulekile nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa. Lezi zinhloso zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okusekelwe ekuphenyweni kwelebhu, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®.

Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

3.14 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela zezibalo ukunquma amaphethini efa kaMendelian anikezwa ngamasethi edatha.
UJohann Gregor Mendel (1822–1884) (Isithombe 12.2) wayengumfundi, uthisha, usosayensi, kanye nendoda yokholo impilo yakhe yonke. Njengomuntu osemusha, wajoyina i-Augustinian Abbey yaseSt. Thomas eBrno endaweni manje eyiCzech Republic. Esekelwa yi-monastery, wafundisa izifundo ze-physics, i-botany, kanye nesayensi yemvelo emazingeni aphezulu naseyunivesithi. Ngo-1856, waqala ucwaningo oluthathe iminyaka eyishumi oluhilela amaphethini efa ezinyosi nasezitshalweni, ekugcineni wahlala ezitshalweni zikabhontshisi njengohlelo lwakhe oluyinhloko (uhlelo olunezici ezilula ezisetshenziselwa ukutadisha into ethile yezinto eziphilayo okufanele isetshenziswe kwezinye izinhlelo). Ngo-1865, uMendel wethula imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwakhe ngezitshalo zikabhontshisi ezingaba ngu-30,000 ku-Natural History Society yendawo. Wabonisa ukuthi izici zidluliselwa ngokwethembeka kusuka kubazali kuya ezinganeni ngaphandle kwezinye izici kanye namaphethini amakhulu nalawo aphindaphindayo. Ngo-1866, washicilela umsebenzi wakhe, i-Experiments in Plant Hybridization,1 ezinqubweni ze-Natural History Society yaseBrünn.

 Umsebenzi kaMendel awuzange uqashelwe umphakathi wesayensi owawukholelwa, ngokungalungile, ukuthi inqubo yefa ihilela ukuhlanganiswa kwezimpawu zabazali ezikhiqiza ukubukeka okuphakathi komzimba enzalweni; le nqubo ecatshangelwayo ibonakala ilungile ngenxa yalokho esikwaziyo manje njengokuqhubekayo. ukuhlukahluka. Ukuhlukahluka okuqhubekayo kuvela esenzweni sezakhi zofuzo eziningi ukunquma isici esifana nokuphakama komuntu. Inzalo ibonakala iyinhlanganisela "yezimpawu zabazali bayo uma sibheka izici ezibonisa ukuhlukahluka okuqhubekayo. Inkolelo-mbono yokuxuba yefa yagomela ngokuthi izici zokuqala zabazali zalahleka noma zamuncwa ukuxubana kwenzalo, kodwa manje sesiyazi ukuthi akunjalo. UMendel wayengumcwaningi wokuqala ukukubona. Esikhundleni sezimpawu eziqhubekayo, uMendel wasebenza nezici ezazuzwa ngezigaba ezihlukene (ikakhulukazi, izimbali eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngokumelene nezimhlophe); lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuhlukahluka okungaguquki. Ukukhetha kukaMendel lezi zinhlobo zezimpawu kwamvumela ukuba abone ngokuhlola ukuthi lezi zimpawu azizange zihlanganiswe enzalweni, futhi azizange zimuncwe, kodwa kunalokho zazigcina ukuhluka kwazo futhi zingadluliselwa. Ngo-1868, uMendel waba yi-abbot yesigodlo futhi washintsha imisebenzi yakhe yesayensi ngemisebenzi yakhe yokwalusa. Wayengaziwa ngeminikelo yakhe emangalisayo yesayensi ngesikhathi sokuphila kwakhe. Eqinisweni, kwaze kwaba ngo-1900 lapho umsebenzi wakhe waphinde watholakala, wakhiqizwa kabusha, futhi wavuselelwa ososayensi abaseceleni kokuthola isisekelo se-chromosome sofuzo.
