chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Uhlelo Lwemodeli lukaMendel
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Uhlelo Lwemodeli lukaMendel
chapterContent: Umsebenzi oyinhloko kaMendel wenziwa kusetshenziswa uphizi wasegadini, i-Pisum sativum, ukuze kufundwe ngefa. Lolu hlobo luzivundisa ngokwemvelo, ukuze impova ihlangane namaqanda ngaphakathi kwezimbali ngazinye. Amacembe ezimbali ahlala evalwe ngokuqinile kuze kube yilapho kuphuma impova, okuvimbela ukuvundiswa kwezinye izitshalo. Umphumela uba ukufuywa kakhulu, noma ukuzalanisa kweqiniso,” izitshalo zepizi. Lezi yizitshalo ezihlala zikhiqiza inzalo efana nomzali. Ngokuzama izitshalo zepizi ezizalanisa ngempela, uMendel wagwema ukubonakala kwezici ezingalindelekile enzalo ezingase zenzeke uma izitshalo zingazalanisa ngempela. Uphizi wasegadini nawo ukhula uvuthwe phakathi nesizini eyodwa, okusho ukuthi izizukulwane eziningana zingahlolwa ngesikhathi esifushane. Ekugcineni, inani elikhulu lepizi lasegadini lingatshalwa ngasikhathi sinye, okuvumela uMendel ukuthi aphethe ngokuthi imiphumela yakhe ayizange ivele ngengozi nje.
question1: Kungani i-pea yasegadini (i-Pisum sativum) yayiyisilwane esifanelekile sokuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo zikaMendels?
answer1: Iyazalanisa ngempela, iyazalela ngokwayo, ikhula ngokushesha, futhi iveza inzalo eningi
question2: Kusho ukuthini ukuzalanisa ngeqiniso?
answer2: Isitshalo sihlala sikhiqiza inzalo enezimpawu ezifanayo nezomzali uma sizivundisa
distractor2a: Isitshalo sihlala sikhiqiza imbewu efana nezakhi zofuzo nge-mitosis
distractor2c: Isitshalo siveza inzalo enezinhlobo eziningi zezici
question3: Izimbali ze-pea zikuvimbela kanjani ngokwemvelo ukuthuthwa kwempova kwezinye izitshalo?
answer3: Amacembe ezimbali ahlala evalwe ngokuqinile kuze kube yilapho kuphuma impova
question4: Kungani ukuzivundisa ngokwakho kwakuzuzisa ekuhlolweni kukaMendels?
answer4: Kwamvumela ukuthi alondoloze imigqa yokuzalanisa yangempela enezimpawu ezibikezelwayo
question5: Kungani uMendel asebenzisa inani elikhulu lezitshalo zama-pea ekuhlolweni kwakhe?
answer5: Amasampula amakhulu anciphise amathuba okuba imiphumela yakhe yenzeke ngengozi
distractor5a: Imiphakathi emikhulu iqeda ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
question6: Yisiphi isici sama-peas engadini esivumele uMendel ukuthi afunde izizukulwane eziningi ngesikhathi esifushane?
answer6: Zikhula zize zivuthwe phakathi nesizini eyodwa
question7: Kungani uMendel aqala iziphambano zakhe ngezitshalo ezizalanisa ngempela?
answer7: Ukugwema izici ezingalindelekile ezizuzwe njengefa nokuthola amaphethini acacile efa
question8: Umcwaningi ufuna ukufunda amaphethini ofuzo esitshalweni esiqhakazayo esisanda kutholakala. Yisiphi isici esingenza sifaneleke kakhulu njengesidalwa esiyimodeli saseMendelian?
answer8: Ikhiqiza imigqa yokuzalanisa yangempela futhi inesikhathi esifushane sokukhiqiza
distractor8a: Izala kanye kuphela njalo eminyakeni engama-20
distractor8b: Ihlala ikhiqiza inzalo ehlukene ngokwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Iziphambano zikaMendelian
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Iziphambano zikaMendelian
chapterContent:
UMendel wenza ukuhlanganiswa, okuhlanganisa ukuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezimbili ezizalana ngempela ezinezimpawu ezahlukene. Ku-pea, ezizivundisa ngokwemvelo, lokhu kwenziwa ngokudlulisa impova ngesandla kusuka ku-anther yesitshalo se-pea esivuthiwe sohlobo olulodwa kuya ku-stigma yesitshalo se-pea esivuthiwe esihlukile sohlobo lwesibili. Ezitshalweni, impova ithwala ama-gametes esilisa (isidoda) iye ku-stigma, isitho esinamathelayo esibamba impova futhi sivumele isidoda ukuthi sihambe phansi kwe-pistil siye kuma-gametes esifazane (ama-ova) ngezansi. Ukuze avimbele isitshalo se-pea esasithola impova ekuzivundiseni futhi siphazamise imiphumela yakhe, uMendel wasusa ngokucophelela zonke izi-anther ezimbalini zesitshalo ngaphambi kokuba zithole ithuba lokuvuthwa.

 Izitshalo ezisetshenziswa ezivunweni zesizukulwane sokuqala zazibizwa ngokuthi i-P0, noma isizukulwane sokuqala sabazali, izitshalo (Isithombe 12.3). UMendel waqoqa imbewu yezitshalo ze-P0 ezivela ku-cross ngayinye futhi wazikhulisa ngesizini elandelayo. Lezi nzalo zazibizwa ngokuthi isizukulwane se-F1, noma isizukulwane sokuqala se-filial (isizukulwane se-filial = inzalo, indodakazi noma indodana). Lapho uMendel ehlola izici esizukulwaneni se-F1 sezitshalo, wazivumela ukuthi zizivundise ngokwemvelo. Wabe eseqoqa futhi ekhulisa imbewu ezitshalweni ze-F1 ukuze akhiqize isizukulwane se-F2, noma isizukulwane sesibili se-filial. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kwadlulela ngale kwesizukulwane se-F2 kuya esizukulwaneni se-F3 ne-F4, njalo njalo, kodwa kwakuyisilinganiso sezici ezizukulwaneni ze-P0−F1−F2 esasithakazelisa kakhulu futhi saba yisisekelo sezibikezelo zikaMendel.
question1: Kungani uMendel asusa ama-anther ezimbalini zezitshalo ezazithola impova?
answer1: Ukuvimbela ukuzivundisa ukuze umzali okhethiwe kuphela anikele ngempova
question2: Ezitshalweni eziqhakazayo, uyini umsebenzi wempova?
question3: Isifinyezo u-P0 simelelani kuzivivinyo zikaMendels?
answer3: Isizukulwane sokuqala sabazali esisetshenziswe esiphambanweni sezakhi zofuzo
question4: I-F1 ibhekisela ku-genetics yaseMendelian?
answer4: Isizukulwane sokuqala sokuzalwa esikhiqizwe esiphambanweni sabazali
distractor4c: Isizukulwane sokuqala sabazali abakhulisa izingane ngempela
question5: UMendel wakhiqiza kanjani isizukulwane se-F2?
answer5: Wavumela izitshalo ze-F1 ukuthi zizivundise
distractor5c: Wafaka umanyolo ezitshalweni ze-F1 ngempova evela ezinhlotsheni ezingahlobene.
question6: Yiziphi izizukulwane ezanikeza ubufakazi obubalulekile obaholela emithethweni yamaMendels yefa?
answer6: Izizukulwane ze-P0, F1, kanye ne-F2
question7: Umfundi ufuna ukuphinda ucwaningo lukaMendels esebenzisa izitshalo zokuzalanisa ubhontshisi zangempela. Ngemva kokuwela izitshalo ezimbili ezihlukene zabazali, zonke inzalo ye-F1 zibonisa isici esifanayo. Yini okufanele umfundi ayenze ngokulandelayo ukuze abone iphethini yefa likaMendelian elihlukile?
answer7: Vumela izitshalo ze-F1 ukuthi zizivundise futhi zihlaziye isizukulwane se-F2
distractor7a: Hlukanisa izitshalo ze-F1 nezitshalo zabazali bokuqala
distractor7b: Susa ama-anther ezitshalweni ze-F1 ukuze uvimbele ukukhulelwa
distractor7c: Khulisa isizukulwane sabazali kuphela ukuze uthole esinye isizini
question8: Kungani uMendel aqhubeka nokuhlola kwakhe ngale kwesizukulwane se-F1?
answer8: Isizukulwane se-F2 sembule ukuvela kabusha kwezimpawu eziphindaphindayo kanye nezilinganiso zefa lesici
distractor8b: Isizukulwane se-F2 sasiqukethe izici ezivelele kuphela

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Izici Zobhontshisi Bengadi Zembula Izisekelo Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Izici Zobhontshisi Bengadi Zembula Izisekelo Zofuzo
chapterContent:
Encwadini yakhe ka-1865, uMendel wabika imiphumela yeziphambano zakhe ezihlanganisa izici eziyisikhombisa ezahlukene, ngasinye sinezici ezimbili eziphikisanayo. Isici sichazwa njengokwehluka ekubukekeni ngokomzimba kwesici esizuzwa njengefa. Izici zazihlanganisa ukuphakama kwesitshalo, ukuthungwa kwembewu, umbala wembewu, umbala wembali, usayizi we-pea pod, umbala we-pea pod, kanye nendawo yembali. Ngokwesici sombala wembali, isibonelo, izici ezimbili eziphikisanayo zazimhlophe uma kuqhathaniswa ne-violet. Ukuze ahlole ngokugcwele isici ngasinye, uMendel wakhiqiza inani elikhulu lezitshalo ze-F1 ne-F2, ebika imiphumela yezitshalo ze-F2 ezingu-19,959 zodwa. Okutholakele kwakhe kwakuhambisana.

 Yimiphi imiphumela uMendel ayithola eziphambanweni zakhe zombala wembali? Okokuqala, uMendel waqinisekisa ukuthi unezitshalo ezizala ngempela umbala wembali omhlophe noma ophuzi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zingaki izizukulwane uMendel azihlola, zonke izizukulwane zabazali abazihlanganisayo ezinezimbali ezimhlophe zazinezimbali ezimhlophe, futhi zonke izizukulwane zabazali abazihlanganisayo ezinezimbali eziphuzi zazinezimbali eziphuzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMendel waqinisekisa ukuthi, ngaphandle kombala wembali, izitshalo ze-pea zazifana ngokomzimba.

 Lapho lokhu kuqinisekiswa sekuqediwe, uMendel wasebenzisa impova evela esitshalweni esinezimbali eziluhlaza okotshani esitsheni esinezimbali ezimhlophe. Ngemva kokuqoqa nokuhlwanyela imbewu ephume kulesi siphambano, uMendel wathola ukuthi amaphesenti ayi-100 esizukulwane se-F1 hybrid ayenezimbali eziluhlaza okotshani. Ukuhlakanipha okuvamile ngaleso sikhathi kwakuyobikezela ukuthi izimbali eziluhlaza okotshani ziyi-violet ephaphathekile noma ukuthi izitshalo eziluhlaza okotshani zibe nenani elilinganayo lezimbali ezimhlophe neziluhlaza okotshani. Ngamanye amazwi, izici zabazali eziphikisanayo kwakulindeleke ukuthi zihlangane enzalweni. Esikhundleni salokho, imiphumela kaMendel yabonisa ukuthi isici sezimbali ezimhlophe esizukulwaneni se-F1 sase sinyamalale ngokuphelele.

 Okubalulekile, uMendel akazange ayeke ukuhlola kwakhe lapho. Wavumela izitshalo ze-F1 ukuthi zizivundise futhi wathola ukuthi, ezitshalweni zesizukulwane se-F2, ezingu-705 zazinezimbali eziluhlaza okotshani kanti ezingu-224 zazinezimbali ezimhlophe. Lesi kwakuyisilinganiso sezimbali eziluhlaza okotshani ezingu-3.15 ngembali eyodwa emhlophe, noma cishe u-3:1. Lapho uMendel edlulisela impova esitshalweni esinezimbali eziluhlaza okotshani eya esihlahleni esinezimbali ezimhlophe futhi okuphambene nalokho, wathola cishe isilinganiso esifanayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yimuphi umzali, owesilisa noma owesifazane, ofake isandla kusiphi isici. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi isiphambano esivumelanayo—isiphambano esibhangqiwe lapho izici ezifanele zesilisa nezesifazane esiphambanweni esisodwa ziba izici ezifanele zesifazane nezesilisa kwesinye isiphambano. Kwezinye izici eziyisithupha uMendel azihlola, izizukulwane ze-F1 neze-F2 zaziziphatha ngendlela efanayo naleyo ezazinayo ngombala wembali. Esinye sezici ezimbili sasizonyamalala ngokuphelele esizukulwaneni se-F1 kodwa siphinde sivele esizukulwaneni se-F2 ngesilinganiso esingaba ngu-3:1.

 Lapho ehlanganisa imiphumela yakhe yezinkulungwane zezitshalo, uMendel waphetha ngokuthi izici zingahlukaniswa zibe izici eziveziwe nezifihliwe. Wabiza lezi, ngokulandelana, izici ezibusayo neziphindaphindayo. Izici ezivelele yilezo ezizuzwe njengefa zingashintshi ekuhlanganiseni. Izici eziphindaphindayo ziba zifihliwe, noma zinyamalale, enzalweni yokuhlanganiswa. Nokho, isici esiphindaphindayo siphinde sivele enzalweni yenzalo ehlanganisiwe. Isibonelo sesici esivelele yisici sembali e-violet. Kulesi sici esifanayo (umbala wembali), izimbali ezinombala omhlophe ziyisici esiphindaphindayo. Iqiniso lokuthi isici esiphindaphindayo saphinde savela esizukulwaneni se-F2 lisho ukuthi izici zahlala zihlukene (zingaxubene) ezitshalweni zesizukulwane se-F1. UMendel uphinde waphakamisa ukuthi izitshalo zinamakhophi amabili esici sesici sesici sembali, nokuthi umzali ngamunye wadlulisela enye yamakhophi ayo amabili enzalweni yakhe, lapho ahlangana khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubonwa ngokomzimba kwesici esivelele kungasho ukuthi ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zesilwane kwakuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezimbili ezivelele zesici noma ukuthi kwakuhlanganisa inguqulo eyodwa evelele nenye ephindaphindayo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukubonwa kwesici esiphindaphindayo kwasho ukuthi isilwane sasingenazo izinhlobo ezivelele zalesi sici.

 Ngakho kungani uMendel athola ngokuphindaphindiwe izilinganiso ezingu-3:1 eziphambanweni zakhe? Ukuze siqonde ukuthi uMendel wazithatha kanjani izindlela eziyisisekelo zokuthola ifa eziholela kulezi zilinganiso, kumelwe siqale sibukeze imithetho yamathuba.
question1: UMendel wakubiza ngokuthini ukushintshashintsha kokubukeka komzimba kwesici esizuzwa njengefa?
answer1: Isici
question2: Ezingqungqutheleni zeMendels, yiliphi iphesenti lesizukulwane se-F1 elibonise isici esivelele?
question3: Cishe yiliphi isilinganiso se-phenotypic esivele esizukulwaneni se-F2 seziphambano ze-Mendels monohybrid?
question4: Yimuphi umbala wembali owawuvelele ekuhlolweni kwezitshalo ze-pea zaseMendels?
answer4: I-violet
question5: Kuboniseni ukuvela kabusha kwesici esiphindaphindayo esizukulwaneni se-F2?
answer5: Izici zofuzo zahlala zihlukile kunokuba zihlangane ndawonye
distractor5a: I-allele ephindaphindayo yadalwa kabusha esizukulwaneni se-F2
distractor5b: Ama-allele amakhulu aguqulwa unomphela abe ama-allele aphindaphindayo
distractor5c: Isici esivelele sanyamalala ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
question6: Kuyini ukuphambana okuhambisanayo?
answer6: Isiphambano esibhangqiwe lapho abazali besilisa nabesifazane beshintshana khona ukuthi yisiphi isici esifaka isandla
distractor6c: Isiphambano esihilela abazali ababili abakhulelwe kuphela
question7: Yisiphi isiphetho uMendel asifinyelela ngemva kokuthola imiphumela efanayo ezimpambanweni ezihambisanayo?
answer7: Ifa lalesi sici alixhomekile ekutheni livela kumzali wesilisa noma wesifazane.
distractor7a: Umzali wesifazane kuphela onquma izici zokuzala
distractor7b: Umzali wesilisa kuphela onquma izici zokuzala
distractor7c: Iziphambano eziphindaphindwayo zihlala zikhiqiza izici ezixubile
question8: Ngokusho kukaMendel, yisiphi isici esivelele?
answer8: Isici esivezwa singashintshi esizukulwaneni esixubile
distractor8b: Isici esitholakala kuphela ezitshalweni ezizalanisa ngempela
question9: Ngokusho kukaMendel, iyini isici esiphindaphindayo?
answer9: Isici esifihliwe ezinhlotsheni ezixubile kodwa singaphinde sivele ezizukulwaneni ezizayo
question10: Yikuphi okwaphawula inselele inkolelo-mbono yokuxuba ifa?
answer10: Isici esiphindaphindayo sanyamalala esizukulwaneni se-F1 kodwa saphinde savela singashintshi esizukulwaneni se-F2.
distractor10b: Izici ezivelele zancipha kancane kancane ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane
distractor10c: Isizukulwane se-F1 sasiqukethe inani elilinganayo lazo zombili izici zomzali
question11: Iyiphi incazelo yezakhi zofuzo uMendel ayiphakamisayo ngezinto eziphilayo ezibonisa isici esivelele?
answer11: Bangaba nezinguqulo ezimbili ezilawulayo noma eyodwa elawulayo kanye nenye ephindaphindayo yesici esizuzwe njengefa
distractor11c: Bahlala benenguqulo eyodwa evelele kanye nezimbili eziphindaphindayo
question12: Yini engaphethwa ngayo uma isidalwa sibonisa isici esiphindaphindayo?
answer12: Ayinalo uhlobo oluvelele lwaleso sici esizuzwe njengefa
distractor12a: Iqukethe inguqulo eyodwa evelele kanye nenguqulo eyodwa ephindaphindayo
question13: Umcwaningi uhlanganisa izitshalo zama-pea amade ezizalanisa ngempela nezitshalo zama-pea ama-dwarf ezizalanisa ngempela. Zonke inzalo ye-F1 zinde, kanti isizukulwane se-F2 siqukethe cishe izitshalo ezintathu ezinde zesitshalo ngasinye sama-dwarf. Yisiphi isiphetho esisekelwa kangcono?
answer13: Ubude bunamandla kune-dwarf, futhi izici zofuzo zihlala zihlukile kunokuba zihlangane
distractor13a: Izici ezinde nezimfushane ziyahlangana esizukulwaneni se-F1
distractor13c: Ukuphakama kwesitshalo kunqunywa ngokuphelele yizimo zemvelo
question14: Kungani uMendel ahlola izinkulungwane zezitshalo ze-F2 ngesici ngasinye?
answer14: Amasampula amakhulu enza izilinganiso zefa ezibonwe zithembeke kakhulu futhi zingabi nokwenzeka ngengozi.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Izisekelo Zokwenzeka
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Izisekelo Zokwenzeka
chapterContent: Amathuba ayizilinganiso zezibalo zokungenzeka. Amathuba okwenzeka komcimbi abalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani lezikhathi umcimbi owenzeka ngazo ngenani eliphelele lamathuba okwenzeka komcimbi. Kungenzeka futhi ukubala amathuba okwenzeka ngombono ngokuhlukanisa inani lezikhathi okulindeleke ukuthi umcimbi wenzeke ngazo ngenani lezikhathi ongenzeka ngazo. Amathuba okwenzeka avela ekubonweni, njengalawo kaMendel. Amathuba okwenzeka ngombono avela ekwazini ukuthi izehlakalo zenziwa kanjani futhi kucatshangwa ukuthi amathuba emiphumela ngayinye ayalingana. Amathuba okwenzeka komunye umcimbi abonisa ukuthi kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi uzokwenzeka, kanti amathuba okwenzeka okungu-zero abonisa ukuthi kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke. Isibonelo sesehlakalo sofuzo yimbewu eyindilinga ekhiqizwa isitshalo se-pea. Ekuhlolweni kwakhe, uMendel wabonisa ukuthi amathuba okuba kwenzeke imbewu eyindilinga "ayenye yenzalo ye-F1 yabazali abazalanisa ngempela, enye yayo enembewu eyindilinga kanti enye inembewu eshwabene. Lapho izitshalo ze-F1 zihlanganiswa ngokwazo kamuva, amathuba okuba noma iyiphi inzalo ye-F2 ibe nembewu eyindilinga manje ayeyizintathu kwezine. Ngamanye amazwi, kubantu abaningi benzalo ye-F2 ekhethwe ngokungahleliwe, amaphesenti angama-75 kulindeleke ukuthi abe nembewu eyindilinga, kanti amaphesenti angama-25 kulindeleke ukuthi abe nembewu eshwabene. Esebenzisa inani elikhulu lembewu eshwabene, uMendel wakwazi ukubala amathuba futhi wawasebenzisa ukubikezela imiphumela yezinye izinhlobo ezishwabene.
question1: Kuyini amathuba okwenzeka ngokwesayensi?
answer1: Amathuba abalwe ngemiphumela ebonwe
question2: Ibalwa kanjani amathuba okuhlola okwenzekayo?
answer2: Inani lezikhathi umcimbi owenzeka ngazo lihlukaniswe ngenani eliphelele lamathuba okuba wenzeke.
distractor2a: Inani eliphelele lemiphumela engaba khona lihlukaniswe ngenani lemicimbi ebonwe
distractor2b: Inani lemiphumela ephumelelayo liphindwe ngenani eliphelele lezilingo
distractor2c: Inani lemiphumela elindelekile lihlukaniswe ngenani lemicimbi ebonwe
question3: Iyini amathuba okuqondakala?
answer3: Amathuba abalwa kusukela emiphumeleni elindelekile uma kucatshangelwa ukuthi yonke imiphumela inamathuba alinganayo
distractor3c: Amathuba abonwe ngemuva kwezilingo eziningi eziphindaphindwayo
question4: Amathuba angu-1 abonisa ukuthi umcimbi uwukuthi:
answer4: Kuqinisekile ukuthi kuzokwenzeka
distractor4b: Kungenzeka ukuthi kwenzeke noma kungenzeki ngokufanayo

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye Nemithetho Yokungenzeka | Umthetho Womkhiqizo kanye Nomthetho Wesamba
chapterContent:
UMendel wabonisa ukuthi izici zesitshalo sikabhontshisi azifundayo zazidluliselwa njengamayunithi ahlukene ukusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni. Njengoba kuzoxoxwa ngakho, uMendel uphinde wanquma ukuthi izici ezahlukene, njengombala wembewu kanye nokuthungwa kwembewu, zazidluliselwa ngokuzimela komunye nomunye futhi zingacatshangelwa ekuhlaziyeni kwamathuba ahlukene. Isibonelo, ukwenza ukuphambana phakathi kwesitshalo esinembewu eluhlaza, eshwabene kanye nesitshalo esinembewu ephuzi, eyindilinga esakhiqiza inzalo enesilinganiso esingu-3:1 sembewu eluhlaza: ephuzi (ukunganaki ukuthungwa kwembewu) kanye nesilinganiso esingu-3:1 sembewu eyindilinga: eshwabene (ukunganaki umbala wembewu). Izici zombala kanye nokuthungwa azizange zithintane.

 Umthetho womkhiqizo wamathuba ungasetshenziswa kulesi simo sokudluliselwa kwezimpawu ngokuzimela. Umthetho womkhiqizo uthi amathuba emicimbi emibili ezimele eyenzeka ndawonye angabalwa ngokuphindaphinda amathuba ngamanye esigameko ngasinye esenzeka sodwa. Ukuze ubonise umthetho womkhiqizo, cabanga ukuthi ugingqa idayisi elinezinhlangothi eziyisithupha (D) bese uphonsa ipeni (P) ngesikhathi esifanayo. Idayi ingagoqa noma yiliphi inombolo kusukela ku-1–6 (D#), kanti idayi ingaphakama ngamakhanda (PH) noma imisila (PT). Umphumela wokugoqa idayisi awunawo umthelela emphumeleni wokugoqa idayi futhi okuphambene nalokho. Kunemiphumela engu-12 engaba khona yalesi senzo, futhi umcimbi ngamunye kulindeleke ukuthi wenzeke ngamathuba alinganayo.

 Emiphumeleni engu-12 engaba khona, idayi inethuba elingu-2/12 (noma 1/6) lokugoqa u-two, kanti ipeni linethuba elingu-6/12 (noma 1/2) lokuvela kwamakhanda. Ngokomthetho womkhiqizo, amathuba okuthi uzothola umphumela ohlanganisiwe ongu-2 namakhanda angu-: (D2) x (PH) = (1/6) x (1/2) noma 1/12. Qaphela igama elithi “futhi” encazelweni yamathuba. I-“futhi” iyisignali yokusebenzisa umthetho womkhiqizo. Isibonelo, cabanga ngendlela umthetho womkhiqizo osetshenziswa ngayo esiphambanweni se-dihybrid: amathuba okuba nezici ezimbili ezibusayo (isibonelo, ophuzi noyindilinga) enzalweni ye-F2 umkhiqizo wamathuba okuba nezici ezibusayo zesici ngasinye, njengoba kuboniswe lapha:

 3/4⁢ × ⁢3/4⁢ = 9/16
Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umthetho wesamba samathuba usetshenziswa lapho kucatshangelwa imiphumela emibili ehlukene engavela ngezindlela ezingaphezu kweyodwa. Umthetho wesamba uthi amathuba okuba kwenzeke umcimbi owodwa noma omunye umcimbi, wemicimbi emibili ehlukene, yisamba samathuba azo ngamanye. Qaphela igama elithi noma” encazelweni yamathuba. I-“or” ikhombisa ukuthi kufanele usebenzise umthetho wesamba. Kulesi simo, ake sicabange ukuthi uphonsa ipeni (P) kanye nekota (Q). Iyini amathuba okuba uhlamvu olulodwa lwemali luvele amakhanda kanye nohlamvu olulodwa lwemali luvele imisila? Lo mphumela ungafinyelelwa ngamacala amabili: ipeni ingaba amakhanda (PH) kanti ikota ingaba yimisila (QT), noma ikota ingaba amakhanda (QH) kanti ipeni ingaba yimisila (PT). Noma yiliphi icala ligcwalisa umphumela. Ngomthetho wesamba, sibala amathuba okuthola ikhanda elilodwa nomsila owodwa njengo-[(PH) × (QT)] + [(QH) × (PT)] = [(1/2) × (1/2)] + [(1/2) × (1/2)] = 1/2 (Ithebula 12.3). Kufanele futhi uqaphele ukuthi sisebenzise umthetho womkhiqizo ukubala amathuba e-PH ne-QT, kanye namathuba e-PT ne-QH, ngaphambi kokuba siwafingqe. Futhi, umthetho wesamba ungasetshenziswa ukukhombisa amathuba okuba nesici esisodwa esivelele esizukulwaneni se-F2 sesiphambano se-dihybrid:

 (1/4×3/4)+(3/4×1/4)=3/16+3/16=6/16=3/8

Inani elikhulu lezitshalo zephizi uMendel azihlola lamvumela ukuba abale amathuba ezici ezivela esizukulwaneni sakhe se-F2. chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.2 Izici kanye Nezimpawu | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Izici uMendel azihlola ezitshalweni zakhe zama-pea zazivezwa njengenye yezinguqulo ezimbili, noma izici (isb., uphizi oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngokumelene nophizi ophuzi). Njengoba sizohlola ngokuningiliziwe ezahlukweni ezizayo, ukubonakaliswa ngokomzimba kwezici kufezwa ngokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo (ukulandelana kwe-DNA), okuqhutshwa kuma-chromosome. Ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zama-pea kuqukethe amakhophi amabili afanayo, noma afanayo (khumbula leli gama elivela eSahlukweni 11), amakhophi e-chromosome ngayinye, elilodwa elivela kumzali ngamunye. Nge-meiosis, izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid zisebenzisa i-meiosis ukukhiqiza ama-gametes e-haploid (1n) ahlanganyela ekukhulelweni. Ezimweni lapho i-gene eyodwa ilawula isici esisodwa, njengombala we-pea, into eziphilayo ze-diploid inamakhophi ezakhi zofuzo angase afake noma angafaki inguqulo efanayo yesici. Lokhu kuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo (isb., uphizi oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngokumelene nophizi ophuzi) kubizwa ngokuthi ama-allele.

 Ama-allele ahlukene esakhi sofuzo esithile esakhi sofuzo ayasebenzisana ukuveza izici zomzimba njengombala we-pea ezitshalweni noma ukubukeka kwezinwele kubantu. Izici ezibonakalayo zesidalwa zibizwa ngokuthi i-phenotype yaso. Ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo okuyisisekelo kwalesi sidalwa, okungukuthi, inhlanganisela yama-allele, kubizwa ngokuthi uhlobo lwaso lwe-genotype. Lapho izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid ziphethe ama-allele afanayo esicini esithile, kuthiwa ziyi-homozygous kuhlobo lwe-genotype; uma ziphethe ama-allele ahlukene, kuthiwa ziyi-heterozygous. Kwi-gene ebonakala ngayo i-Mendelian (Isigaba 12.1), izinto eziphilayo eziyi-homozygous dominant kanye ne-heterozygous zizobukeka zifana; okungukuthi, zizoba nezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-genotype kodwa uhlobo olufanayo lwe-phenotype. Izici ze-allele ephindaphindayo zizobonakala kuphela kubantu abayi-homozygous recessive.

 Kodwa-ke, ama-allele awahlali eziphethe ngendlela ephindaphindayo nephindaphindayo. Ngamanye amazwi, kunezimo ezihlukile kumodeli kaMendel yefa. Isibonelo, ukubusa okungaphelele kuchaza isimo lapho i-heterozygote ibonisa uhlobo oluphakathi kwezinhlobo ze-homozygous phenotypes (isb., inzalo enezimbali ezipinki ikhiqizwa ngokuhlanganisa umzali onezimbali ezibomvu nomzali onezimbali ezimhlophe). I-Codominance ichaza ukuvezwa ngasikhathi sinye kwama-allele womabili ku-heterozygote (isb., izinhlobo zegazi lomuntu). Kuvamile futhi ukuthi kube nama-allele angaphezu kwamabili esakhi sofuzo kubantu (isb., ukuhlukahluka kobukhulu bamathanga). Kubantu, njengasezilwaneni eziningi nakwezinye izitshalo, abesifazane banama-chromosome amabili e-X, kanti abesilisa bane-chromosome eyodwa ye-X kanye ne-chromosome eyodwa ye-Y. Ama-gene ku-chromosome ye-X axhumene ne-X, futhi abesilisa bazuza futhi baveze i-allele eyodwa kuphela yesakhi sofuzo (isb., i-hemophilia, ubumpumputhe bombala). Amanye ama-allele nawo angaba yingozi, ngakho-ke uhlobo lwawo ngeke lubonwe.

 Izifo eziningi zofuzo zabantu, okuhlanganisa i-albinism, i-cystic fibrosis, kanye nesifo sikaHuntington zingachazwa ngokusekelwe kumaphethini alula efa le-Mendelian adalwe ukuhlaziywa kozalo. (Ezahlukweni ezizayo sizofunda ukuthi ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kungasetshenziswa kanjani ukuhlonza izifo zofuzo). Izikwele ze-Punnett zingamathuluzi awusizo asebenzisa imithetho yamathuba kanye ne-meiosis ukubikezela imiphumela engaba khona yeziphambano zofuzo. Iziphambano zokuhlola zenziwa ukuze kunqunywe ukuthi umuntu u-homozygous noma u-heterozygous ngokunqamula umuntu one-homozygous recessive.

 Izici eziyisikhombisa uMendel azihlola ezitshalweni zakhe zama-pea zazivezwa njengenye yezinguqulo ezimbili, noma izici. Ukubonakaliswa kwezimpawu zomzimba kufezwa ngokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithwalwa kuma-chromosome. Ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kwama-peas kuqukethe amakhophi amabili afanayo noma afanayo e-chromosome ngayinye, elilodwa elivela kumzali ngamunye. I-pair ngayinye yama-chromosome afanayo inohlelo olufanayo lwezakhi zofuzo. Ngamanye amazwi, ama-peas ayizinto eziphilayo ze-diploid ngoba anamakhophi amabili e-chromosome ngayinye. Kunjalo nakwezinye izitshalo eziningi kanye nakuzo zonke izilwane. Izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid zisebenzisa i-meiosis ukukhiqiza ama-gametes e-haploid, aqukethe ikhophi eyodwa ye-chromosome ngayinye efanayo ehlangana ekukhulelweni ukuze kudalwe i-zygote ye-diploid.

 Ezimweni lapho i-gene eyodwa ilawula isici esisodwa, into eziphilayo ze-diploid inamakhophi amabili ezakhi zofuzo angase afake noma angafaki inguqulo efanayo yaleso sici. Izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo ezivela ngokuguqulwa futhi ezikhona ezindaweni ezifanayo kuma-chromosome afanayo zibizwa ngokuthi ama-allele. UMendel wahlola ifa lezakhi zofuzo ngezinhlobo ezimbili ze-allele, kodwa kuvamile ukuhlangana nama-allele angaphezu kwamabili kunoma iyiphi i-gene enikeziwe emphakathini wemvelo.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.2 Izici kanye nezimpawu | Izinhlobo kanye nezinhlobo zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.2 Izici kanye nezimpawu | Izinhlobo kanye nezinhlobo zofuzo
chapterContent:
Ama-allele amabili esakhi sofuzo esithile ku-diploid organism ayavezwa futhi ayasebenzisana ukuze akhiqize izici zomzimba. Izici ezibonakalayo ezivezwa yisidalwa zibizwa ngokuthi i-phenotype yaso. Ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kwesidalwa, okuhlanganisa ama-allele abonakalayo ngokomzimba nangabonakali, kubizwa ngokuthi i-genotype yaso. Ukuhlolwa kwe-hybridization kukaMendel kubonisa umehluko phakathi kwe-phenotype ne-genotype. Lapho izitshalo ezizalana ngempela lapho umzali oyedwa wayenama-pod aphuzi kanti omunye wayenama-pod aluhlaza zazivundiswa ngokuxubana, yonke inzalo ye-F1 hybrid yayinama-pod aphuzi. Okusho ukuthi, inzalo ye-hybrid yayifana kakhulu nomzali ozalana ngempela one-pod aphuzi. Kodwa-ke, siyazi ukuthi i-allele enikelwe ngumzali ene-pod eluhlaza ayizange ilahleke nje ngoba yaphinde yavela kwezinye zezingane ze-F2. Ngakho-ke, izitshalo ze-F1 kumele ukuthi zazihlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo kumzali one-pod aphuzi.

 Izitshalo ze-P1 uMendel azisebenzisa ekuhlolweni kwakhe zazifana ngokwezakhi zofuzo ayezifunda. Izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid ezi-homozygous ku-gene ethile, noma i-locus, zine-alleles ezimbili ezifanayo zaleyo gene kuma-chromosome azo afanayo. Izitshalo zikaPea zomzali kaMendel zazihlala zizala ngokweqiniso ngoba zombili i-gametes ezikhiqizwe zazinesici esifanayo. Lapho izitshalo ze-P1 ezinezimpawu eziphikisanayo zivundiswa ngokuxubana, zonke inzalo zaziyi-heterozygous ngenxa yesici esiphikisanayo, okusho ukuthi uhlobo lwazo lwe-genotype lwalubonisa ukuthi zine-alleles ezahlukene ze-gene ehlolwayo.

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.2 Izici kanye nezimpawu | Izinhlobo kanye nezinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo | Ama-allele anamandla nanamandla
chapterContent:
Ingxoxo yethu ngezinto eziphilayo ze-homozygous kanye ne-heterozygous isiletha ekutheni kungani inzalo ye-F1 heterozygous yayifana nomunye wabazali, kunokuba iveze ama-allele womabili. Kuzo zonke izici eziyisikhombisa zezitshalo ze-pea, enye yama-allele amabili ahlukene yayinamandla, kanti enye yayiyi-recessive. UMendel wabiza i-allele eyinhloko ngokuthi i-unit factor eveziwe; i-allele ephindaphindayo yayibizwa ngokuthi i-latent unit factor. Manje sesiyazi ukuthi lezi zinto ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-unit factor empeleni ziyizakhi zofuzo ezibhangqweni ze-chromosome ze-homologous. Kwizakhi zofuzo ezivezwa ngephethini ephindaphindayo nephindaphindayo, izinto eziphilayo ze-homozygous dominant kanye ne-heterozygous zizobukeka zifana (okungukuthi, zizoba nezinhlobo ezahlukene zezakhi zofuzo kodwa i-phenotype efanayo). I-allele ephindaphindayo izobonakala kuphela kubantu abaphindaphindayo be-homozygous.

 Kunezindlela eziningana zokubhekisela kuzakhi zofuzo nama-allele. Ngenhloso yalesi sahluko, sizofinyeza izakhi zofuzo sisebenzisa uhlamvu lokuqala lwesici esiyinhloko sezakhi zofuzo. Isibonelo, i-violet iyisici esiyinhloko sombala wembali yesitshalo se-pea, ngakho-ke izakhi zofuzo ezinombala wembali zingafinyezwa njengo-V (qaphela ukuthi kuyinto evamile ukwenza izinkomba zezakhi zofuzo zibhalwe ngophawu). Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizosebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu nezincane ukumela ama-allele amakhulu namancane ngokulandelana. Ngakho-ke, singabhekisela kuhlobo lwesitshalo se-pea esinobuthi obufanayo ne-homozygous esinezimbali eziluhlaza okotshani njenge-VV, isitshalo se-pea esinobuthi obufanayo ne-homozygous esinezimbali ezimhlophe njenge-vv, kanye nesitshalo se-pea esinobuthi obufanayo ne-heterozygous esinezimbali eziluhlaza okotshani njenge-Vv.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Indlela Yesikwele sikaPunnett Yesiphambano Esihlanganisiwe
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Indlela Yesikwele sikaPunnett Yesiphambano Esihlanganisiwe
chapterContent:
Uma ukukhulelwa kwenzeka phakathi kwabazali ababili abazalana ngempela abahlukile ngesici esisodwa kuphela, inqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-monohybrid cross, kanti inzalo ephumayo iyi-monohybrid. UMendel wenza iziphambano eziyisikhombisa ze-monohybrid ezibandakanya izici eziphikisanayo zesici ngasinye. Ngokusekelwe emiphumeleni yakhe ezizukulwaneni ze-F1 ne-F2, uMendel wacabanga ukuthi umzali ngamunye esiphambanweni se-monohybrid unikele ngesinye sezici ezimbili ezibhangqiwe zeyunithi kumntwana ngamunye, futhi yonke inhlanganisela engenzeka yezici zeyunithi yayingenzeka ngokulinganayo.

 Ukuze ubonise isiphambano se-monohybrid, cabanga ngendaba yezitshalo ze-pea ezizalana ngempela ezinembewu ye-pea ephuzi neluhlaza. Umbala wembewu oyinhloko uphuzi; ngakho-ke, izinhlobo zofuzo zabazali zaziyi-YY yezitshalo ezinembewu ephuzi kanye ne-yy yezitshalo ezinembewu eluhlaza, ngokulandelana. Isikwele sasePunnett, esakhiwe yisazi sezakhi zofuzo saseBrithani uReginald Punnett, singadwetshwa esisebenzisa imithetho yamathuba okubikezela imiphumela engaba khona yesiphambano sezakhi zofuzo noma ukuhlangana kanye nemvamisa yazo elindelekile. Ukuze kulungiselelwe isikwele sikaPunnett, zonke izinhlanganisela ezingenzeka zama-allele omzali zibhalwe phezulu (komzali oyedwa) kanye nohlangothi (komunye umzali) lwegridi, okumelela ukuhlukaniswa kwawo kwe-meiotic kube ama-gametes e-haploid. Bese kwenziwa izinhlanganisela zeqanda nesidoda emabhokisini etafuleni ukukhombisa ukuthi yimaphi ama-allele ahlanganayo. Ibhokisi ngalinye limelela uhlobo lwe-genotype lwe-diploid lwe-zygote, noma iqanda elivundisiwe, olungavela kulokhu kuhlangana. Ngenxa yokuthi kungenzeka ngakunye, izilinganiso ze-genotypic zinganqunywa kusukela kusikwele sikaPunnett. Uma iphethini yefa (elawulayo noma ephindaphindayo) iyaziwa, izilinganiso ze-phenotypic nazo zingacatshangwa. Ngesiphambano se-monohybrid sabazali ababili abazalana ngempela, umzali ngamunye unikela ngohlobo olulodwa lwe-allele. Kulokhu, uhlobo olulodwa lwe-genotype lungenzeka. Zonke inzalo zingu-Yy futhi zinembewu ephuzi (Isithombe 12.4).

 I-self-cross yesinye sezizukulwane ze-Yy heterozygous ingamelwa esikweleni se-Punnett esingu-2 × 2 ngoba umzali ngamunye anganikela ngeyodwa yama-allele amabili ahlukene. Ngakho-ke, inzalo ingaba nenye yezinhlanganisela ezine ze-allele: YY, Yy, yY, noma yy (Isithombe 12.4). Qaphela ukuthi kunezindlela ezimbili zokuthola i-genotype ye-Yy: u-Y ovela eqandeni kanye no-y ovela esidodaneni, noma u-y ovela eqandeni kanye no-Y ovela esidodaneni. Womabili la mathuba kumele abalwe. Khumbula ukuthi izici zesitshalo sika-pea sikaMendel zaziziphatha ngendlela efanayo ezinhlanganisweni ezilandelanayo. Ngakho-ke, izinhlanganisela ezimbili ze-heterozygous ezingaba khona zikhiqiza inzalo efana ngokwe-genotypically nangokwe-phenotypically naphezu kwama-allele azo amakhulu nangokwe-recessive avela kubazali abahlukene. Zihlanganiswe ndawonye. Ngenxa yokuthi ukukhulelwa kuyisenzakalo esingahleliwe, silindele ukuthi inhlanganisela ngayinye ibe nokwenzeka ngokulinganayo nokuthi inzalo ibonise isilinganiso sama-genotypes ka-YY:Yy:yy angu-1:2:1 (Isithombe 12.4). Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngenxa yokuthi inzalo ka-YY no-Yy inembewu ephuzi futhi ifana kakhulu, sisebenzisa umthetho we-sum of probability, silindele ukuthi inzalo ibonise isilinganiso sama-phenotypic esingu-3 ophuzi:1 oluhlaza. Ngempela, esebenza ngobukhulu obukhulu besampula, uMendel waqaphela cishe lesi silinganiso kuzo zonke izizukulwane ze-F2 ezivela ekuhlanganisweni kwezimpawu ngazinye.

 UMendel waqinisekisa le miphumela ngokwenza isiphambano se-F3 lapho azihlanganisa khona nezitshalo ze-F2 eziveza amandla amakhulu neziphindaphindayo. Lapho ezihlanganisa nezitshalo eziveza imbewu eluhlaza, yonke inzalo yayinembewu eluhlaza, okuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imbewu eluhlaza yayinezinhlobo zama-genotypes ezi-homozygous ze-yy. Ngesikhathi ezihlanganisa nezitshalo ze-F2 eziveza imbewu ephuzi, wathola ukuthi ingxenye yesithathu yezitshalo zazala ngokweqiniso, kanti izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zezitshalo zazala ngokwesilinganiso esingu-3:1 sembewu ephuzi: eluhlaza. Kulesi simo, izitshalo ezizala ngokweqiniso zazinezinhlobo ze-homozygous (YY), kanti izitshalo ezizala ngokwehlukile zazifana nezinhlobo ze-heterozygous (Yy). Lapho lezi zitshalo zizizala ngokwazo, umphumela wawufana ne-F1 ezizala ngokwayo.

question5: Iyini isilinganiso se-genotypic esilindelekile esivela ku-Yy × Yy monohybrid cross?
answer5: 1 Unyaka: 2 Unyaka: 1 Unyaka
question6: Iyiphi isilinganiso se-phenotypic esilindelekile esivela ku-Yy × Yy monohybrid cross uma ophuzi evelele?
answer6: 3 ophuzi: 1 oluhlaza
question7: Kungani izinhlobo zofuzo u-Yy no-yY zibhekwa njengezilingana esikweleni sikaPunnett?
answer7: Ziqukethe ama-allele afanayo futhi ngenxa yalokho zinezinhlobo ezifanayo zofuzo kanye nezinhlobo ze-phenotype.
distractor7b: Zikhiqiza izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-phenotypes kuye ngokuthi yimuphi umzali ofaka isandla ku-allele eyinhloko
question8: Yimuphi umthetho wamathuba okusetshenziswa ukuhlanganisa inzalo ye-YY kanye ne-Yy efana ne-phenotypic ku-3:1 phenotypic ratio?
answer8: Umthetho wesamba
question9: Izitshalo ze-F2 eziphuzi ezizihlanganisele zona. Iyiphi ingxenye yalezi zitshalo eziphuzi ezizalwe ngempela?
answer9: Ingxenye yesithathu
question10: Kungani izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zezitshalo ze-F2 eziphuzi zaveza inzalo enesilinganiso esingu-3:1 esiphuzi kuya koluhlaza lapho zihlanganiswa zodwa?
answer10: Babeyi-heterozygous (Yy)
distractor10c: Babephethe ama-allele amathathu ukuze bathole umbala wembewu

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa Nofuzo KwakwaMendels | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Indlela Yesikwele YasePunnett Yesiphambano Esihlanganisiwe | Isiphambano Sokuhlola Sihlukanisa Uhlobo Oluvelele
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa Nofuzo KwakwaMendels | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Indlela Yesikwele YasePunnett Yesiphambano Esihlanganisiwe | Isiphambano Sokuhlola Sihlukanisa Uhlobo Oluvelele
chapterContent:
Ngaphandle kokubikezela inzalo yesiphambano phakathi kwabazali abaziwayo be-homozygous noma i-heterozygous, uMendel uphinde wasungula indlela yokunquma ukuthi ngabe isidalwa esiveza isici esibusayo siyi-heterozygote noma i-homozygote. Esibizwa ngokuthi isiphambano sokuhlola, le ndlela isasetshenziswa ngabafuyi bezitshalo nezilwane. Esiphambanweni sokuhlola, isidalwa esibusayo sihlanganiswa nesidalwa esibusayo se-homozygous ngenxa yesici esifanayo. Uma isidalwa esibusayo siyi-homozygote, khona-ke yonke inzalo ye-F1 izoba yi-heterozygotes eveza isici esibusayo (Isithombe 12.5). Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma isidalwa esibusayo siyi-heterozygote, inzalo ye-F1 izobonisa isilinganiso esingu-1:1 sama-heterozygotes nama-homozygotes abusayo (Isithombe 12.5). Isiphambano sokuhlola siqinisekisa ngokwengeziwe umbono kaMendel wokuthi ama-unit factor amabili ahlukanisa ngokulinganayo.

 Izifo eziningi zabantu zizuzwe ngofuzo. Umuntu ophilile emndenini lapho amanye amalungu ehlushwa isifo sofuzo esiphindaphindayo angase afune ukwazi ukuthi unaso yini isakhi sofuzo esibangela lesi sifo nokuthi iyiphi ingozi yokudlulisela lesi sifo enzalweni yakhe. Yiqiniso, ukwenza isivivinyo sokuhlola kubantu akunangqondo futhi akunakwenzeka. Esikhundleni salokho, izazi zofuzo zisebenzisa ukuhlaziywa kozalo ukuze zifunde iphethini yefa lezifo zofuzo zabantu (Isithombe 12.6)
question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yesiphambano sokuhlola?
answer1: Ukunquma ukuthi umuntu one-phenotype evelele ungumuntu ofana no-homozygous noma ofana no-heterozygous
distractor1a: Ukunquma ukuthi isici siyabusa noma siyaphindaphinda
question2: Esivivinyweni sokuhlola, umuntu oveza i-phenotype evelele uhlanganiswa nohlobo luni lwe-genotype?
distractor2c: Noma yimuphi umuntu oveza i-phenotype evelele
question3: Uma umzali we-dominant-phenotype esivivinyweni esihlanganisiwe eyi-homozygous dominant (AA), yiziphi izinhlobo ze-phenotype ezilindelekile phakathi kwenzalo?
answer3: Zonke inzalo zizoveza uhlobo oluvelele
question4: Uma umzali we-dominant-phenotype ku-test cross engu-heterozygous (Aa), yisiphi isilinganiso se-phenotypic esilindelekile phakathi kwenzalo?
answer4: 1 olawulayo: 1 ophindaphindayo
question5: Uma isidalwa esilawulayo esihlanganiswe nesidalwa esilawulayo esilingana ne-homozygous sikhiqiza noma yisiphi isizukulwane esilawulayo, kumelwe sibe yini i-genotype yabazali abalawulayo?
answer5: I-Heterozygous
question6: Kungani i-test cross iwusizo kubalimi bezitshalo nezilwane?
answer6: Kwembula ukuthi umuntu ophethe i-phenotype eyinhloko uphethe i-allele ephindaphindayo
question7: Kungani iziphambano zokuhlola zingenziwa kubantu?
answer7: Azinasimilo futhi azinamsebenzi
distractor7c: Izakhi zofuzo zomuntu azikwazi ukuhlaziywa ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question8: Iyiphi indlela izazi zezakhi zofuzo ezivame ukuyisebenzisa esikhundleni sezindlela zokuhlola ukuze zithole ifa kubantu?
answer8: Ukuhlaziywa kozalo
question9: Umuntu ophilile unomfowabo othintekile yisifo sofuzo esibucayi. Kungani lo muntu engase afune ukuhlolwa kofuzo?
answer9: Ukunquma ukuthi banesifo esithathelwanayo yini kanye nengozi yokusidlulisela ezinganeni zabo
distractor9a: Ukunquma ukuthi bazoyithola yini ngempela le nkinga
distractor9b: Ukunquma ukuthi lesi sifo sibangelwa yi-allele eyinhloko
distractor9c: Ukushintsha uhlobo lwabo lwezakhi zofuzo ngaphambi kokuba babe nezingane
question10: Uhlu lozalo olubonisiwe lubonisa ufuzo lwe-alkaptonuria, isifo sofuzo esiphindaphindayo, emndenini othintekile. Hlaziya uhlu lozalo ukuze ubikezele izinhlobo zozalo zabantu ababhalwe ukuthi 1, 2, no-3.
answer10: 1-aa, 2-Aa, 3-Aa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka
chapterContent: Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel ngezitshalo zama-pea kusikisele ukuthi: (1) amayunithi amabili” noma ama-allele akhona ku-gene ngayinye; (2) ama-allele agcina ubuqotho bawo esizukulwaneni ngasinye (akukho ukuxubana); kanye (3) lapho kukhona i-allele ebusayo, i-allele ebusayo ifihliwe futhi ayinikezi lutho ku-phenotype. Ngakho-ke, ama-allele abusayo angathwalwa” futhi angavezwa ngabantu ngabanye. Abantu abanjalo abane-heterozygous ngezinye izikhathi babizwa ngokuthi abathwali.” Izifundo ezengeziwe zezakhi zofuzo kwezinye izitshalo nezilwane zikhombisile ukuthi kukhona ubunzima obukhulu, kodwa izimiso eziyisisekelo zezakhi zofuzo zikaMendelian zisasebenza. Ezigabeni ezilandelayo, sicabangela ezinye zezandiso zeMendelism. Ukube uMendel wayekhethe uhlelo lokuhlola olubonisa lobu bunzima bezakhi zofuzo, kungenzeka ukuthi ubengeke aqonde ukuthi imiphumela yakhe isho ukuthini.
question1: Ngokusho kwemodeli kaMendels, zingaki ama-alleles e-diploid ephilayo enawo ku-gene ngayinye?
answer1: Ama-allele amabili
question2: Yini uMendel aphetha ngayo ngama-allele ngesikhathi sokuzalwa?
distractor2b: Zithathelwa indawo yizinhlayiya ezintsha esizukulwaneni ngasinye
question3: Kumuntu one-heterozygous ophethe ngokuphelele, i-allele ephindaphindayo inamuphi umphumela ku-phenotype?
answer3: Ifihlwe yi-allele eyinhloko futhi ayithinti i-phenotype
question4: Kusho ukuthini igama elithi umthwali ku-genetics?
answer4: Umuntu one-heterozygous ophethe i-allele ephindaphindayo engavezwa
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuchaza kangcono umthwali wesifo sofuzo esiphindaphindayo?
answer5: Umuntu ngokuvamile akabonisi lesi sifo kodwa angadlulisela i-allele ephindaphindayo kubantwana
distractor5a: Umuntu uhlala eba nalesi sifo kamuva ekuphileni
distractor5b: Umuntu akakwazi ukudlulisela i-allele ephindaphindayo kubantwana
distractor5c: Umuntu uveza kokubili ama-phenotypes amakhulu kanye nama-recessive ngasikhathi sinye
question6: Yini eye yaboniswa yizifundo zofuzo zakamuva mayelana nezimiso zikaMendels?
answer6: Amaphethini amaningi efa ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, kodwa izimiso eziyisisekelo zikaMendels zisasebenza
distractor6a: Izimiso zikaMendels zisebenza kuphela ezitshalweni ze-pea
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sephethini yezakhi zofuzo edlula ngale kwefa elilula laseMendelian?
answer7: Ukubusa okungaphelele
question8: Kungani ukubusa okungaphelele kanye nokulawula okufana kubhekwa njengokwandiswa kwezakhi zofuzo zikaMendelian?
answer8: Balandela izimiso eziyisisekelo zefa likaMendels kodwa bahilela amaphethini ahlukene okubonakaliswa kwe-allele
question9: Kungani uMendel aphumelela ekutholeni imithetho eyisisekelo yefa?
answer9: Wafunda izici ezilandela amaphethini alula okubusa kanye nokubuyisa ifa
distractor9a: Wakhetha izici ezilawulwa yizakhi zofuzo eziningi ezisebenzisanayo
distractor9b: Wasebenzisa izinto eziphilayo ezazizalana kuphela ngaphandle kocansi
distractor9c: Wathola i-DNA ngaphambi kokwenza izivivinyo zakhe
question10: Kungani uMendel ayengaba nobunzima bokuhumusha imiphumela yakhe ukube wayefunde izici ezibonisa ukubusa okungaphelele noma ukubusa ndawonye?
answer10: Amaphethini efa ngabe abe yinkimbinkimbi kakhulu futhi ngabe awazange akhiqize izilinganiso ezilula ezibusayo neziphindaphindayo azibonile.
distractor10b: Izitshalo beziyobe zingasenazo izimila ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
distractor10c: Izakhi zofuzo ngabe zanyamalala ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ukubusa Okungaphelele
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ukubusa Okungaphelele
chapterContent: Imiphumela kaMendel, yokuthi izici zizuzwa njengemibhangqwana ebusayo neyi-recessive, yaphikisana nombono ngaleso sikhathi wokuthi inzalo ibonise inhlanganisela yezimpawu zabazali bayo. Kodwa-ke, i-phenotype ye-heterozygote ngezinye izikhathi ibonakala iphakathi kwabazali ababili. Isibonelo, ku-snapdragon, i-Antirrhinum majus (Isithombe 12.7), ukuphambana phakathi komzali we-homozygous onezimbali ezimhlophe (CWCW) kanye nomzali we-homozygous onezimbali ezibomvu (CRCR) kuzokhiqiza inzalo enezimbali ezipinki (CRCW). (Qaphela ukuthi izifinyezo ezahlukene ze-genotypic zisetshenziselwa izandiso ze-Mendelian ukuhlukanisa la maphethini ekubuseni okulula kanye nokubukisa.) Le patheni yefa ichazwa njengokubusa okungaphelele, okubonisa ukubonakaliswa kwama-allele amabili ahlukene kangangokuthi umuntu ubonisa i-phenotype ephakathi. Lolu uhlobo lokuxhumana kwezakhi zofuzo lapho kungekho khona i-allele ebusayo ngokuphelele kunenye. Kodwa-ke, imiphumela ye-heterozygote self-cross isengabikezelwa, njengoba kunjalo ngeziphambano ze-Mendelian ezibusayo nezibukisayo. Kulesi simo, isilinganiso se-genotypic sizoba yi-1 CRCR:2 CRCW:1 CWCW, kanti isilinganiso se-phenotypic sizoba yi-1:2:1 ku-red:pink:white
question1: Yimuphi umdwebo wefa oboniswayo lapho i-heterozygote inohlobo oluphakathi kwabazali ababili be-homozygous?
answer1: Ukubusa okungaphelele
question2: Kuma-snapdragon, ukunqamula isitshalo esinezimbali ezibomvu ezifana ne-homozygous (CRCR) nesitshalo esinezimbali ezimhlophe ezifana ne-homozygous (CWCW) kuveza inzalo enayiphi i-phenotype?
question3: Kungani izimbali ze-pink snapdragon zibhekwa njengesibonelo sokubusa okungaphelele?
answer3: Akukho allele ebusayo ngokuphelele, okukhiqiza i-phenotype ephakathi
distractor3b: I-allele ephindaphindayo ifihla ngokuphelele i-allele eyinhloko
distractor3c: Ama-allele ahlangana unomphela futhi awakwazi ukuhlukanisa
question4: Yimuphi uhlobo lwe-genotype olukhiqiza izimbali ezipinki kuma-snapdragons?
answer4: I-CRCW
question5: Iyini isilinganiso esilindelekile se-genotypic esivela ku-self-cross yama-snapdragon amabili apinki (CRCW × CRCW)?
answer5: 1 CRCR: 2 CRCW: 1 CWCW
question6: Iyini isilinganiso se-phenotypic esilindelekile esivela ku-CRCW × CRCW cross?
answer6: 1 obomvu: 2 opinki: 1 omhlophe
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esihlukanisa ngokufanele ukubusa okungaphelele nokubusa okuphelele?
answer7: Ekubuseni okungaphelele, i-heterozygote ine-phenotype ephakathi kune-phenotype ebusayo
distractor7a: Ukubusa okungaphelele kuveza inzalo efana ne-homozygous kuphela
distractor7b: Ukubusa okungaphelele kuvimbela ukuhlukaniswa kwe-allele ngesikhathi se-meiosis
question8: Naphezu kwe-phenotype ephakathi ebonakala ekubuseni okungaphelele, yisiphi isimiso se-genetics saseMendelian esisasebenza?
answer8: Ama-allele ahlukana ngokujwayelekile ngesikhathi se-meiosis futhi kukhiqizwa izilinganiso ze-genotype ezibikezelwayo
distractor8b: Ama-allele anamandla ayanyamalala ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
distractor8c: Isizukulwane ngasinye sizuza i-allele eyodwa kuphela
question9: Isazi sezitshalo sihlanganisa ama-snapdragon amabili apinki. Angakanani amathuba okuba inzalo ibe nezimbali ezimhlophe?
question10: Umfuyi uhlanganisa i-snapdragon ebomvu (CRCR) ne-snapdragon epinki (CRCW). Iyiphi ingxenye yenzalo okulindeleke ukuthi ibe nezimbali ezipinki?

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ukubusa Okufanayo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ukubusa Okufanayo
chapterContent: Ukwehluka kokubusa okungaphelele yi-codominance, lapho womabili ama-allele esici esifanayo evezwa ngasikhathi sinye ku-heterozygote. Isibonelo se-codominance amaqembu egazi e-MN abantu. Ama-allele e-M kanye ne-N avezwa ngesimo se-antigen ye-M noma i-N ekhona ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi. Ama-Homozygotes (LMLM kanye ne-LNLN) aveza i-M noma i-N allele, kanti ama-heterozygotes (LMLN) aveza womabili ama-allele ngokulinganayo. Ekuzihlanganiseni phakathi kwama-heterozygotes aveza isici esihambisanayo, izinhlobo ezintathu ze-genotypes zenzalo ezingenzeka zihlukile ngokwe-phenotypic. Kodwa-ke, isici se-1:2:1 genotypic ratio se-Mendelian monohybrid cross sisasebenza.
question1: Kuyini i-codominance?
answer1: Iphethini yefa lapho ama-allele womabili evezwa khona ngokugcwele nangesikhathi esifanayo ku-heterozygote
distractor1a: Iphethini lapho i-allele eyodwa ifihla khona enye ngokuphelele
distractor1c: Iphethini lapho ama-allele ehlangana khona unomphela
question2: Yisiphi isimiso seqembu legazi lomuntu esichazwe kulesi sigaba esibonisa ukubusa ndawonye?
question3: Yini evezwa ebusweni bamaseli abomvu egazi kubantu abane-genotype LMLN?
answer3: Kokubili ama-antigen e-M kanye ne-N
question4: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-genotype olukhiqiza i-antigen ye-M kuphela?
answer4: I-LMLM
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-genotype olukhiqiza i-antigen ye-N kuphela?
answer5: I-LNLN
question6: Iyini isilinganiso esilindelekile se-genotypic esivela ku-self-cross yabantu ababili be-heterozygous (LMLN × LMLN)?
answer6: 1 LMLM: 2 LMLN: 1 LNLN
question7: Iyini isilinganiso se-phenotypic esilindelekile esivela ku-self-cross yabantu ababili be-LMLN?
answer7: 1 M : 2 MN : 1 N
question8: I-codominance ihluke kanjani ekubuseni okungaphelele?
answer8: Ku-codominance, womabili ama-allele abonakala ngokugcwele, kanti ekubuseni okungaphelele i-heterozygote ine-phenotype ephakathi.
distractor8b: Ukubusa okungaphelele kuveza ama-allele womabili ngokulinganayo
distractor8c: Ukubusa kwe-codominance kwenzeka ezitshalweni kuphela, kanti ukubusa okungaphelele kwenzeka ezilwaneni kuphela
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-codominance esivumelana nezakhi zofuzo zikaMendelian?
answer9: Isilinganiso se-genotypic esivela ku-heterozygote self-cross sihlala singu-1:2:1
distractor9c: Kungaba khona izinhlobo ezimbili kuphela ze-genotype
question10: Umcwaningi uhlanganisa abantu ababili abane-genotype LMLN. Angakanani amathuba okuthi inzalo izoveza ama-antigen e-M kanye ne-N?

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ama-Allele Amaningi
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ama-Allele Amaningi
chapterContent:
UMendel wasikisela ukuthi kungaba khona ama-allele amabili kuphela, elilodwa elibusayo nelilodwa eliphindaphindayo, ku-gene ethile. Manje sesiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuwukwenza kube lula ngokweqile. Nakuba abantu ngabanye (kanye nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezine-diploid) bengaba nama-allele amabili kuphela ku-gene ethile, ama-allele amaningi angaba khona ezingeni labantu kangangokuthi kubhekwe inhlanganisela eminingi yama-allele amabili. Qaphela ukuthi uma kukhona ama-allele amaningi esakhini esifanayo, inqubo iwukukhombisa uhlobo oluvame kakhulu lwe-phenotype noma i-genotype phakathi kwezilwane zasendle njengohlobo lwasendle (oluvame ukufushaniswa +”); lokhu kubhekwa njengokuvamile noma okujwayelekile. Zonke ezinye izinhlobo ze-phenotype noma i-genotype zibhekwa njengezihlukahlukene zalesi simiso, okusho ukuthi ziyaphambuka ohlotsheni lwasendle. Uhlobo lungaba yi-recessive noma i-dominant ku-allele yohlobo lwasendle.

 Isibonelo sama-allele amaningi umbala wejazi konogwaja (Isithombe 12.8). Lapha, kukhona ama-allele amane esakhini se-c. Uhlobo lwe-wild-type, i-C+C+, luvezwa njengoboya obunsundu. I-chinchilla phenotype, i-cchcch, ivezwa njengoboya obumhlophe obuneziqongo ezimnyama. I-Himalayan phenotype, i-chch, inoboya obumnyama emaphethelweni kanye noboya obumhlophe kwenye indawo. Ekugcineni, i-albino, noma i-phenotype engenambala, i-cc, ivezwa njengoboya obumhlophe. Ezimweni zama-allele amaningi, kungaba khona amazinga okubusa. Kulesi simo, i-allele yohlobo lwasendle inamandla ngaphezu kwazo zonke ezinye, i-chinchilla inamandla ngaphezu kwe-Himalayan ne-albino ngokuphelele, kanti i-Himalayan inamandla ngaphezu kwe-albino. Lolu hlu lwe-hierarchy, noma uchungechunge lwe-allelic, lwembulwa ngokubheka izinhlobo zenzalo ngayinye ye-heterozygote engaba khona.

 Ukubusa okuphelele kwe-phenotype yohlobo lwasendle phezu kwazo zonke ezinye izakhi zofuzo kuvame ukwenzeka njengomphumela womthamo "womkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo othize, kangangokuthi i-allele yohlobo lwasendle ihlinzeka ngenani elifanele lomkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo kuyilapho ama-allele aguquliwe engakwazi. Ochungechungeni lwe-allele konogwaja, i-allele yohlobo lwasendle ingahlinzeka ngomthamo othile we-pigment yoboya, kuyilapho ama-mutant ehlinzeka ngomthamo omncane noma angabi nhlobo nhlobo. Ngokuthakazelisayo, i-phenotype yaseHimalaya ingumphumela we-allele ekhiqiza umkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo ozwela ukushisa okhiqiza kuphela umbala emaphethelweni apholile omzimba wonogwaja.

 Ngaphandle kwalokho, i-allele eyodwa eguquliwe ingaba namandla phezu kwazo zonke ezinye izakhi zofuzo, kufaka phakathi uhlobo lwasendle. Lokhu kungenzeka lapho i-allele eguquliwe ngandlela thile iphazamisa umlayezo wezakhi zofuzo kangangokuthi ngisho ne-heterozygote enekhophi eyodwa ye-allele yohlobo lwasendle iveza i-phenotype eguquliwe. Enye indlela i-allele eguquliwe engaphazamisa ngayo ukuthuthukisa umsebenzi womkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo zohlobo lwasendle noma ukushintsha ukusatshalaliswa kwawo emzimbeni. Isibonelo esisodwa salokhu ukuguqulwa kwe-Antennapedia ku-Drosophila (Isithombe 12.9). Kulesi simo, i-allele eguquliwe yandisa ukusatshalaliswa komkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo, futhi ngenxa yalokho, i-Antennapedia heterozygote ikhula imilenze ekhanda layo lapho kufanele kube khona izimpondo zayo.
question1: Kusho ukuthini igama elithi ama-allele amaningi?
answer1: Kukhona ama-allele angaphezu kwamabili esakhini sofuzo ngaphakathi kwesibalo sabantu, yize umuntu ngamunye ephethe amabili kuphela
distractor1a: Umuntu ngamunye uphethe ama-allele angaphezu kwamabili ku-gene ngayinye
distractor1c: I-allele eyodwa ilawula izakhi zofuzo eziningi
question2: Zingaki ama-alleles e-gene ethile umuntu we-diploid angaba nawo?
question3: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi uhlobo lwasendle ku-genetics?
answer3: Uhlobo lwe-phenotype noma i-genotype oluvame kakhulu olutholakala kubantu bemvelo
distractor3c: I-phenotype etholakala kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo zaselabhorethri
question4: Ochungechungeni lwe-allelic olunombala wejazi lomvundla, iyiphi i-allele ebusa ngaphezu kwazo zonke ezinye?
answer4: I-allele yohlobo lwasendle (C+)
question5: Yimuphi umkhuba wonogwaja ophuma ku-genotype chch?
answer5: Uboya obumhlophe obunoboya obumnyama emaphethelweni (eHimalayan)
question6: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-genotype lonogwaja olukhiqiza i-phenotype ye-albino?
answer6: I-cc
question7: Kungani unogwaja waseHimalaya umnyama ezindlebeni zawo, ekhaleni, ezinyaweni, kanye nasemsila?
answer7: I-allele yayo ikhiqiza umbala ozwela ukushisa osebenza kuphela ezindaweni zomzimba ezipholile
distractor7a: Lezo zifunda zithola ukukhanya kwelanga okwengeziwe
distractor7b: I-pigment gene isebenza kuphela ngemva kokuzalwa
question8: Yisiphi isizathu esisodwa esivamile sokuthi i-allele yohlobo lwasendle ibusa ngaphezu kwe-alleles eziguquliwe?
answer8: I-allele yohlobo lwasendle ikhiqiza inani elijwayelekile lomkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo ezisebenzayo, kanti ama-allele aguquliwe akhiqiza okuncane noma awakhiqizi nhlobo.
distractor8a: Ama-allele ezinhlobo zasendle ahlala eshintsha kancane kancane
distractor8c: Ama-allele ezinhlobo zasendle ahlala ekhona ngokuphindwe kabili
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuguqulwa kwe-Antennapedia ku-Drosophila?
answer9: I-allele eguquguqukayo evelele ibangela ukuba imilenze yakheke lapho ngokuvamile kwakheka khona izimpondo
distractor9b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubangela ukuthi kukhule izimpondo emilenzeni
distractor9c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kususa imilenze kanye nezimpondo zombili
question10: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo esithuthukayo sithola i-allele eguquliwe ekhiqiza uhlobo olungavamile ngisho noma kukhona i-allele evamile yasendle. Iyiphi incazelo efanelana kahle nalokhu okubonwayo?
answer10: I-allele eguquliwe inamandla ngoba ishintsha noma iphazamisa umsebenzi noma ukusatshalaliswa komkhiqizo ojwayelekile wezakhi zofuzo
distractor10a: I-allele eguquliwe i-recessive futhi ayikwazi ukuthinta i-phenotype
distractor10b: Umuntu kumele aphathe ama-allele amathathu ukuze athole i-gene
distractor10c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome ngesikhathi se-meiosis

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka Komzimba | Ama-Allele Amaningi Anikeza Ukumelana Nemithi Ku-Malaria Parasite
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka Komzimba | Ama-Allele Amaningi Anikeza Ukumelana Nemithi Ku-Malaria Parasite
chapterContent:
Umalaleveva yisifo esibangelwa yizinambuzane kubantu esidluliselwa omiyane besifazane abathelelekile, okuhlanganisa i-Anopheles gambiae (Isithombe 12.10a), futhi sibonakala ngemfiva ephezulu, ukubanda, izimpawu ezifana nomkhuhlane, kanye nokuntuleka kwegazi okukhulu. I-Plasmodium falciparum kanye ne-P. vivax yizona zinto ezivame kakhulu ezibangela umalaleveva, kanti i-P. falciparum iyona ebulalayo kakhulu (Isithombe 12.10b). Uma ilashwa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele, umalaleveva we-P. falciparum unesilinganiso sokufa esingamaphesenti angu-0.1. Kodwa-ke, kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba, lesi silwanyana siye samelana nokwelashwa umalaleveva okusetshenziswa njalo, ngakho-ke ukwelashwa umalaleveva okusebenza kahle kakhulu kungahluka ngokwezindawo.

 ENingizimu-mpumalanga ye-Asia, e-Afrika, naseNingizimu Melika, i-P. falciparum iye yamelana nemithi yokulwa nomalaleveva i-chloroquine, i-mefloquine, kanye ne-sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine. I-P. falciparum, okuyi-haploid ngesikhathi sokuphila lapho itheleleka khona kubantu, ithuthukise ama-allele amaningi angaguquki e-gene ye-dhps. Amazinga ahlukahlukene okumelana ne-sulfadoxine ahlotshaniswa ne-allele ngayinye yalezi. Njengoba iyi-haploid, i-P. falciparum idinga i-allele eyodwa kuphela engaguquki emithi ukuveza lesi sici.

 ENingizimu-mpumalanga ye-Asia, ama-allele ahlukene angaguquki e-gene ye-dhps atholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe. Lesi yisenzakalo esivamile sokuziphendukela kwemvelo esenzeka ngoba ama-mutant angaguquki emithi avela kubantu futhi azalana nezinye izinhlobo ze-P. falciparum eziseduze. Ama-parasite angaguquki e-sulfadoxine abangela ubunzima obukhulu kubantu ezindaweni lapho lo muthi usetshenziswa kabanzi njengomuthi we-malaria ongathengwa ngaphandle kwemithi. Njengoba kuvamile ngamagciwane anda abe ngamanani amakhulu ngaphakathi komjikelezo wokutheleleka, i-P. falciparum ishintsha ngokushesha okukhulu (ngaphezu kweminyaka eyishumi noma ngaphezulu) ngenxa yengcindezi ekhethiwe yemithi evame ukusetshenziswa yokulwa ne-malaria. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, ososayensi kumele basebenze njalo ukuthuthukisa imithi emisha noma inhlanganisela yemithi yokulwa nomthwalo womhlaba wonke we-malaria.
question1: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-Plasmodium oluyimbangela ebulalayo kakhulu yomalaleveva kubantu?
answer1: I-Plasmodium falciparum
question2: I-malaria idluliselwa kanjani kubantu?
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungafakwanga ohlwini lomuthi lapho i-P. falciparum ishintshe khona ukumelana kwezinye izindawo?
answer3: I-Penicillin
question4: Yisiphi isakhi sofuzo esiqukethe ama-allele amaningi aguquliwe ahlobene nokumelana ne-sulfadoxine ku-P. falciparum?
answer4: Ama-dhps
question5: Kungani i-P. falciparum ingathuthuka ngokushesha ukumelana nemithi?
answer5: Ikhiqiza inani elikhulu kakhulu labantu futhi ithola ukukhetha okunamandla kokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa okusabalele
distractor5a: Izala kanye kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphila kwayo
question6: Kungani ama-allele ahlukene amelana ne-sulfadoxine evame ukutholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe?
answer6: Izinguquko ezingamelani nemithi zivela endaweni futhi zisakazeke ngezinhlobo zezinambuzane eziseduze
distractor6a: Omiyane bavimbela izimuncagazi ukuthi zingahambi phakathi kwezindawo
distractor6b: Isifunda ngasinye siqukethe izinhlobo ezahlukene zePlasmodium
question7: Yimaphi amandla okuziphendukela kwemvelo asekela ngokuyinhloko ama-allele angamelani nemithi ezifweni ezibangelwa umalaleveva?
answer7: Ukukhetha kwemvelo okubangelwa ukusetshenziswa kabanzi kwemithi yokulwa nomalaleveva
question8: Kungani ososayensi kufanele bahlale bethuthukisa imithi emisha yokulwa nomalaleveva?
answer8: Ngoba izimuncagazi ze-malaria zihlala zikhula ukumelana nemithi ekhona
distractor8a: Ngoba omiyane balahlekelwa ngokushesha ikhono lokudlulisa umalaleveva
distractor8b: Ngoba abantu baba sengozini yokumelana nezakhi zofuzo kuyo yonke imithi
distractor8c: Ngoba i-parasite iyayeka ukuzala ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
question9: Kungani ukuqonda ama-allele amaningi kubalulekile ekufundweni kokumelana nemithi kamalaleveva?
answer9: Ama-allele ahlukene aguquliwe esakhini esifanayo angakhiqiza amazinga ahlukene okumelana
distractor9a: I-parasite ngayinye iphethe amakhophi amaningi alo lonke uhlobo lofuzo
distractor9b: Ukumelana nemithi kulawulwa yizici zemvelo zodwa
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 12.10. Kungani i-P. falciparum idinga i-allele eyodwa ye-dhps engazweli emithi ukuze iveze isici sokumelana nemithi?
answer10: Kukhona i-allele eyodwa kuphela ye-dhps lapho i-P. falciparum ithelelana
distractor10a: I-allele ye-dhps engazweli emithini ihambisana kakhulu ne-allele yohlobo lwasendle
distractor10b: I-allele eyodwa kuphela ye-dhps ekhona kuzo zonke izigaba zomjikelezo wokuphila we-P. falciparum
distractor10c: I-allele ye-dhps engamelana nemithi ivimbela i-allele yohlobo lwasendle ukuthi ingavezwa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Izici Ezixhunywe Ku-X
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Izici Ezixhunywe Ku-X
chapterContent:
Kubantu, kanye nakwezinye izilwane eziningi kanye nezitshalo ezithile, ubulili bomuntu ngamunye bunqunywa ama-chromosome ocansi. Ama-chromosome ocansi ayibhangqa elilodwa lama-chromosome angewona awe-homologous. Kuze kube manje, besicabangele kuphela amaphethini ofuzo phakathi kwama-chromosome angewona awe-sex, noma ama-autosome. Ngaphezu kwama-pair angu-22 e-homologous ama-autosome, abesifazane babantu banebhangqa elilodwa lama-chromosome X, kanti abesilisa babantu banebhangqa le-chromosome XY. Nakuba i-chromosome Y iqukethe indawo encane yokufana ne-chromosome X ukuze bakwazi ukuhlangana ngesikhathi se-meiosis, i-chromosome Y imfushane kakhulu futhi iqukethe izakhi zofuzo eziningi ezimbalwa. Uma isakhi sofuzo esihlolwayo sikhona ku-chromosome X, kodwa hhayi ku-chromosome Y, kuthiwa sixhunywe ku-X.

 Umbala wamehlo ku-Drosophila wawungenye yezimpawu zokuqala ezixhunywe ku-X ezatholakala. UThomas Hunt Morgan wahlanganisa lesi sici ne-chromosome X ngo-1910. Njengabantu, abesilisa base-Drosophila banebhangqa le-chromosome XY, kanti abesifazane bangama-XX. Ezimpukaneni, umbala wamehlo wohlobo lwasendle ubomvu (XW) futhi unamandla kunombala wamehlo omhlophe (Xw) (Isithombe 12.11). Ngenxa yendawo yejini lombala wamehlo, ukuphambana okuhambisanayo akuvezi izilinganiso ezifanayo zenzalo. Abesilisa kuthiwa bane-hemizygous, ngoba bane-allele eyodwa kuphela yanoma yisiphi isici esixhunywe ku-X. I-Hemizygosity yenza izincazelo zokubusa kanye nokuphambana zingabalulekile kwabesilisa be-XY. Abesilisa be-Drosophila abanayo ikhophi yesibili ye-allele ku-chromosome ye-Y; okungukuthi, uhlobo lwabo lwe-genotype lungaba yi-XWY noma i-XwY kuphela. Ngokuphambene, abesifazane banamakhophi amabili e-allele alesi jini futhi bangaba yi-XWXW, i-XWXw, noma i-XwXw.

 Esiphambanweni esixhunywe ku-X, izinhlobo ze-genotype zenzalo ye-F1 ne-F2 zincike ekutheni isici esiphambanayo savezwa yindoda noma owesifazane esizukulwaneni se-P1. Ngokuphathelene nombala wamehlo e-Drosophila, lapho owesilisa we-P1 eveza uhlobo lwe-white-eye kanti owesifazane une-homozygous red-eyed, wonke amalungu esizukulwane se-F1 abonisa amehlo abomvu (Isithombe 12.12). Owesifazane be-F1 bangama-heterozygous (XWXw), kanti owesilisa wonke angama-XWY, njengoba ethole i-X chromosome yawo kowesifazane we-homozygous dominant P1 kanye ne-Y chromosome yawo kowesilisa we-P1. Ukuhlanganiswa okulandelayo phakathi kowesifazane we-XWXw kanye nowesilisa we-XWY kuzokhiqiza abesifazane abanamehlo abomvu kuphela (abane-XWXW noma i-XWXw genotypes) kanye nabesilisa abanamehlo abomvu namhlophe (abane-XWY noma i-XwY genotypes). Manje, cabanga ngokuhlanganiswa phakathi kowesifazane onemehlo amhlophe kanye nowesilisa onamehlo abomvu. Isizukulwane se-F1 sizobonisa abesifazane abanamehlo abomvu be-heterozygous kuphela (XWXw) kanye nabesilisa abanamehlo amhlophe kuphela (XwY). Ingxenye yabesifazane be-F2 izoba namehlo abomvu (XWXw) kanti ingxenye izoba namehlo amhlophe (XwXw). Ngokufanayo, ingxenye yabesilisa be-F2 izoba namehlo abomvu (XWY) kanti ingxenye izoba namehlo amhlophe (XwY)
question1: Iyini isici esixhunywe ku-X?
answer1: Isici esinqunywa yi-gene etholakala ku-chromosome X kodwa hhayi ku-chromosome Y
distractor1a: Isici esinqunywa izakhi zofuzo kuma-chromosomes amabili u-X no-Y
question2: Kungani abesilisa abangabantu bechazwa njengabane-hemizygous kuma-gene axhunyiwe ku-X?
answer2: Bane-chromosome eyodwa kuphela ye-X ngakho-ke bane-allele eyodwa kuphela yezakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-X.
distractor2b: I-chromosome yabo engu-Y inamakhophi afanayo ezakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-X
question3: Ku-Drosophila, iyiphi i-allele yombala wamehlo evelele?
answer3: Obomvu (XW)
question4: Kungani ukuphambana okuhambisanayo okubandakanya izakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-X kuvame ukukhiqiza izilinganiso zenzalo ezihlukene?
answer4: Ngoba abesilisa nabesifazane bazuza ama-chromosome X ngendlela ehlukile
distractor4a: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-X azihlukanisi ngesikhathi se-meiosis
distractor4b: Ngoba ama-chromosomes e-Y aphethe ama-allele amakhulu azo zonke izakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-X
distractor4c: Ngoba abesifazane banikela ngama-chromosomes e-Y kuphela enzalweni
question5: Owesifazane unesifo esihlobene ne-X esiphindaphindayo. Iyiphi ingxenye yamadodana akhe okulindeleke ukuthi izuze futhi iveze lesi sifo uma uyise engathintekile?
question6: Kungani izifo ezixhumene ne-X eziphindaphindayo zivame kakhulu kwabesilisa kunakwabesifazane?
answer6: Abesilisa bane-chromosome eyodwa kuphela engu-X, ngakho-ke i-allele eyodwa ephindaphindayo iyavezwa
distractor6b: Abesifazane abakwazi ukuzuza izifo ezixhumene ne-X
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesifo esixhumene ne-X somuntu?
answer7: I-Hemophilia
question8: Uma owesifazane ene-homozygous ngenxa yesici esixhumene ne-X, yiliphi inani lamadodana akhe elizoveza lesi sici?
question9: Ezinyonini, yisiphi isini esivame ukuba yi-hemizygous ngezici ezihambisana nobulili?
answer9: Abesifazane
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 12.12. Yisiphi isilinganiso senzalo esingavela ekuhlanganiseni impukane yesilisa enamehlo amhlophe kanye nempukane yesifazane ene-heterozygous ngombala wamehlo abomvu?
answer10: Ama-25% enzalo ngabesilisa kanti ama-hemizygous abusayo anamehlo abomvu kanti ama-25% angabesilisa nabesifazane abanamehlo amhlophe. Ama-25% angabesifazane nabesifazane abanamehlo abomvu kanti ama-25% angabesifazane nabesifazane abanamehlo amhlophe.
distractor10a: Ama-50% enzalo angamadoda kanti ama-hemizygous abusayo anamehlo abomvu kanti ama-50% angamadoda ahlala e-hemizygous anamehlo amhlophe. Ama-50% angowesifazane kanti ama-heterozygous anamehlo abomvu kanti ama-50% angowesifazane futhi ahlala e-homozygous anamehlo amhlophe.
distractor10b: Amaphesenti angama-25 abesilisa anamandla kakhulu anamehlo abomvu kanti amaphesenti angama-50 abesilisa anamandla kakhulu anamehlo amhlophe. Amaphesenti angama-25 abesifazane anombala ofana nowe-heterozygous anamehlo abomvu kanti amaphesenti angama-50 abesifazane banombala ofana nowe-homozygous anamehlo amhlophe.
distractor10c: Amaphesenti angama-50 abesilisa anamandla kakhulu anamehlo abomvu kanti amaphesenti angama-25 abesilisa anamandla kakhulu anamehlo amhlophe. Amaphesenti angama-50 abesifazane anamandla kakhulu anamehlo abomvu kanti amaphesenti angama-25 amantombazane kanti anamandla kakhulu anamehlo amhlophe.
