chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka Komzimba | Izinkinga Ezihlobene Nobulili Bomuntu
chapterContent: Izifundo zokuxhumanisa ubulili elabhorethri kaMorgan zinikeze izisekelo zokuqonda izifo ezixhunyaniswe no-X kubantu, okuhlanganisa ubumpumputhe bombala obomvu noluhlaza okotshani, kanye ne-Healthy Types A kanye ne-B. Ngenxa yokuthi abesilisa kudingeka bazuze i-allele eyodwa kuphela ye-X eguquguqukayo ukuze bathinteke, izifo ezixhunyaniswe no-X zibonakala ngokungalingani kwabesilisa. Abesifazane kumele bazuze ama-allele axhunyaniswe no-X aguquguqukayo kubo bobabili abazali babo ukuze baveze lesi sici. Uma bezuza i-allele eyodwa ye-X eguquguqukayo kanye ne-allele eyodwa ye-wild-type evelele ye-X, bangabathwali balesi sici futhi ngokuvamile abathinteki. Abesifazane abathwala lesi sici bangabonakalisa izinhlobo ezincane zalesi sici ngenxa yokungasebenzi kwe-allele eyinhloko etholakala kwenye yama-chromosomes e-X. Kodwa-ke, abathwali besifazane banganikela ngalesi sici emadodaneni abo, okuholela ekutheni indodana ibonise lesi sici, noma banganikela nge-allele eguquguqukayo emadodakazini abo, okuholela ekutheni amantombazane abe ngabathwali balesi sici (Isithombe 12.13). Nakuba kukhona ezinye izifo ezibangelwa ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-Y, ngokuvamile zihlotshaniswa nokungazali kwabesilisa ngakho-ke azidluliselwa ezizukulwaneni ezilandelayo.
question1: Kungani izifo ezixhumene ne-X zibonakala kaningi kwabesilisa kunakwabesifazane?
answer1: Abesilisa badinga ukuzuza i-allele eyodwa kuphela eguquguqukayo ku-chromosome yabo eyodwa ye-X ukuze baveze lesi sifo.
distractor1a: Abesilisa bazuza ama-chromosome amabili e-X aphethe i-allele eguquliwe
distractor1b: I-chromosome Y ibangela ukuthi ama-allele aphindaphindayo ku-chromosome X abe namandla amakhulu
distractor1c: Abesifazane abakwazi ukuzuza izifo ezixhumene ne-X
question2: Kungani abesifazane benamathuba amancane okuveza isifo esixhunyaniswe ne-X kunabesilisa?
answer2: Abesifazane kumele bazuze ama-allele e-recessive mutant kuwo womabili ama-chromosomes e-X
distractor2a: Abesifazane bahlala bethola i-allele ebusayo koyise
distractor2b: Abesifazane bane-chromosome engu-Y efihla ama-allele aphindaphindayo
distractor2c: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhumene no-X azisebenzi kwabesifazane
question3: Uyini owesifazane othwala izifo ezibangelwa yi-X-linked recessive disorder?
answer3: Owesifazane one-allele eyodwa eguquguqukayo kanye ne-allele eyodwa evamile engavamile ukuthintwa
distractor3a: Owesifazane uveza lesi sifo ngoba une-chromosome eyodwa kuphela ye-X
distractor3c: Owesifazane ophethe izakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-Y kuphela
question4: Kungani abanye besifazane abathwala lesi sifo bebonisa izimpawu ezincane zesifo esixhumene ne-X?
answer4: Ukungasebenzi kwe-chromosome ye-X okungahleliwe kungavimba ukusebenza kwe-chromosome ye-X ephethe i-allele evamile kwamanye amaseli
distractor4a: I-chromosome yabo engu-Y icindezela i-allele eyinhloko
distractor4b: Izinsikazi ezithwalayo zikhiqiza amaprotheni engeziwe aguquliwe
distractor4c: I-allele ephindaphindayo iba yinto evelele ngesikhathi sobudala
question5: Uma owesifazane ophethe lesi sifo enezingane nowesilisa ongathintekile, yiliphi inani lamadodana okulindeleke ukuthi azuze lesi sifo njengefa?
question6: Uma owesifazane othwala igciwane eba nezingane nowesilisa ongathintekile, yiliphi inani lamadodakazi okulindeleke ukuba abe nalo?
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesifo sokulahlekelwa yingqondo esixhumene no-X somuntu?
answer7: I-Hemophilia A
question8: Kungani izifo zofuzo ezixhumene no-Y zingadluliselwa ezizukulwaneni ezizayo?
answer8: Zivame ukuhlotshaniswa nokungazali kwabesilisa, okuvimbela ukudluliselwa
distractor8b: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-Y ziyasuswa ngesikhathi se-meiosis
question9: Owesifazane unesifo se-hemophilia (XHXh) kanti umlingani wakhe akathinteki (XHY). Angakanani amathuba okuba indodana ibe ne-hemophilia?
question10: Uhlu lozalo lubonisa ukuthi isifo sofuzo esixhumene ne-X sivela kakhulu kwabesilisa futhi sidluliselwa ngabesifazane abangathintekile. Yisiphi isincazelo esifanelana kahle nale ndlela yofuzo?
answer10: Abesifazane abathwala i-allele ehlanganisiwe ne-X badlulisela i-allele ehlanganisiwe nengxenye yamadodana abo, aveza lesi sifo ngoba ane-chromosome eyodwa kuphela ye-X.
distractor10a: Obaba abathintekile badlulisela lesi sifo kuwo wonke amadodana abo nge-chromosome Y
distractor10b: Abesifazane kuphela abazuza izifo ezixhumene ne-X ngoba banama-chromosome amabili e-X.
distractor10c: Lesi sifo sinamandla futhi ngenxa yalokho sibonakala ngokulinganayo kubo bobabili ubulili

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ukubulala
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu | Ezinye Izindlela Zokubusa Nokuwohloka | Ukubulala
chapterContent:
Ingxenye enkulu yezakhi zofuzo ku-genome yomuntu ibalulekile ukuze asinde. Ngezinye izikhathi, i-allele engasebenzi yesakhi sofuzo esibalulekile ingavela ngokuguquka futhi idluliselwe kubantu uma nje abantu abanale allele nabo benekhophi esebenzayo yohlobo lwasendle. I-allele yohlobo lwasendle isebenza ngamandla anele ukusekela impilo ngakho-ke ibhekwa njengebusayo phezu kwe-allele engasebenzi. Kodwa-ke, cabanga ngabazali ababili be-heterozygous abanesakhi sofuzo se-wild-type/nonfunctional mutant yesakhi sofuzo esibalulekile esicatshangelwayo. Kwingxenye eyodwa kwezine yenzalo yabo, singalindela ukubona abantu abanesakhi sofuzo se-homozygous yesakhi sofuzo esingasebenzi. Ngenxa yokuthi isakhi sofuzo sibalulekile, laba bantu bangase bahluleke ukuthuthukisa ukukhulelwa, bafe esibelethweni, noma bafe kamuva ekuphileni, kuye ngokuthi yisiphi isigaba sokuphila esidinga lesi sakhi sofuzo. Iphethini yefa lapho i-allele ibulala kuphela ngesimo se-homozygous futhi lapho i-heterozygote ingaba yinto evamile noma ibe ne-phenotype engeyona ebulalayo eshintshiwe ibizwa ngokuthi i-recessive lethal.

 Uma kuqhathaniswa phakathi kwabantu abane-heterozygous abane-allele ebulalayo ebangela ukufa ngaphambi kokuzalwa lapho i-homozygous ifana, kuzobonakala kuphela ama-homozygotes nama-heterozygotes e-wild-type. Ngakho-ke, isilinganiso se-genotypic singaba ngu-2:1. Kwezinye izimo, i-allele ebulalayo ebulalayo ingase ibonise i-phenotype eyinhloko (kodwa hhayi ebulalayo) ku-heterozygote. Isibonelo, i-allele ebulalayo ebulalayo e-Curly e-Drosophila ithinta ukuma kwephiko ngesimo se-heterozygote kodwa iyabulala ku-homozygote.

 Ikhophi eyodwa ye-allele ye-wild-type ayihlali yanele ukusebenza okuvamile noma ngisho nokusinda. Iphethini yefa elibulalayo eyinhloko yile lapho i-allele ibulala khona kokubili ku-homozygote kanye ne-heterozygote; le-allele ingadluliselwa kuphela uma i-phenotype ye-lethality yenzeka ngemva kweminyaka yokuzala. Abantu abanezinguquko eziholela kuma-allele ebulalayo eyinhloko behluleka ukusinda ngisho nasesimweni se-heterozygote. Ama-allele abulalayo avamile kakhulu ngoba, njengoba ungalindela, i-allele ihlala isizukulwane esisodwa kuphela futhi ayidluliselwa. Kodwa-ke, njengoba nje i-allele ebulalayo ephindaphindayo ingase ingabonisi ngokushesha uhlobo lokufa, ama-allele abulalayo angase angavezwa kuze kube yilapho umuntu esemdala. Uma umuntu efika eminyakeni yokuzala, i-allele ingadluliselwa ngokungazi, okuholela ekufeni okubambezelekile kuzo zombili izizukulwane. Isibonelo salokhu kubantu yisifo sikaHuntington, lapho isimiso sezinzwa siphela khona kancane kancane (Isithombe 12.14). Abantu abane-heterozygous ye-allele eyinhloko yeHuntington (Hh) bazoba nesifo esibulalayo ngokungenakugwenywa. Kodwa-ke, ukuqala kwesifo sikaHuntington kungase kungenzeki kuze kube yilapho umuntu eneminyaka engu-40, lapho abantu abahluphekile kungenzeka ukuthi sebedlulisele i-allele kumaphesenti angu-50 enzalo yabo.
question1: Iyini i-allele ebulalayo ebulalayo?
answer1: I-allele ebangela ukufa kuphela uma ikhona ku-genotype ye-homozygous recessive
distractor1a: I-allele ebangela ukufa noma nini lapho izuzwe njengefa kubaba
distractor1b: I-allele ebangela ukufa kubantu abane-heterozygous kuphela
distractor1c: I-allele ehlala ibusa phezu kwe-allele yohlobo lwasendle
question2: Kungani ama-allele abulalayo angapheli kubantu abaningi?
answer2: Izidalwa ezi-Heterozygous ziyasinda ngoba i-allele yohlobo lwasendle inikeza umsebenzi owanele
distractor2a: I-allele ebulalayo ephindaphindayo ihlale ivezwa ngemva kokuzala
question3: Uma kuhlukaniswa abathwali ababili be-heterozygous be-allele ebulalayo ephindaphindayo, yisiphi isilinganiso se-genotypic esibonakala phakathi kwenzalo ephilayo uma ama-embryo aphindaphindayo e-homozygous efa ngaphambi kokuzalwa?
answer3: Ama-heterozygote amabili: 1 homozygous dominant
distractor3c: Sat Dec 30 1899 01:02:01 GMT+1000 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
question4: Kungani isilinganiso esibonwayo senzalo ephilayo evela esiphambanweni esibulalayo sihlukile kunesilinganiso esilindelwe seMendelian?
answer4: Abantu abane-homozygous recessive bafa ngaphambi kokuba babonwe.
distractor4a: I-allele ebusayo iyashintsha ibe yi-allele ephindaphindayo
question5: Iyini i-allele ebulalayo ebusayo?
answer5: I-allele ebangela ukufa kubantu ababili aba-heterozygous kanye naba-homozygous
distractor5a: I-allele ebangela ukufa kubantu abane-homozygous recessive kuphela
question6: Kungani ama-allele abulalayo avamile ukungavamile kubantu abaningi?
answer6: Ngokuvamile zivimbela abantu ukuthi baphile isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukuze bazale
question7: Kungani isifo sikaHuntington singadluliselwa ebantwaneni yize sibangelwa yi-allele ebulalayo enamandla?
answer7: Izimpawu zivame ukuvela ngemva kweminyaka yokuzala, okuvumela abantu abathintekile ukuba babe nezingane ngaphambi kokuba lesi sifo siqale.
distractor7b: Abantu abane-homozygous kuphela abathola isifo sikaHuntington
question8: Umuntu une-genotype Hh yesifo sikaHuntington. Angakanani amathuba okuba ingane ngayinye ithole i-allele ebangela lesi sifo uma omunye umzali eyi-hh?
question9: I-allele egobile ku-Drosophila ishintsha ukuma kwephiko kuma-heterozygotes kodwa iyabulala kuma-homozygotes. Lesi yisibonelo salokhu:
answer9: I-allele ebulalayo ephindaphindayo ene-phenotype ebonakalayo evelele
question10: Umbhangqwana womabili u-heterozygous (Aa) we-allele ebulalayo ephindaphindayo. Ngaphambi kokuzalwa, yiliphi inani lama-embryo avundisiwe okulindeleke ukuthi abe yi-homozygous recessive (aa)?

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Nezakhi Zofuzo ZeMendels | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo Ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Nezakhi Zofuzo ZeMendels | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo Ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphambilini, uMendel waphakamisa ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zizuzwe njengezakhi zofuzo eziziphatha ngendlela ebusayo neyangemuva. Ngesikhathi se-meiosis, ama-allele ayahlukanisa, noma ahlukane, kangangokuthi i-gamete ngayinye kungenzeka ukuthi ithole noma iyiphi yama-allele amabili akhona kumuntu ngamunye we-diploid. UMendel wabiza lesi simo ngokuthi umthetho wokuhlukanisa, ongabonakaliswa esiphambanweni se-monohybrid. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izakhi zofuzo ezithwalwa kuma-chromosome ahlukene zihlelwa zibe ama-gametes ngokuzimela komunye nomunye. Lona umthetho kaMendel wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele. Lo mthetho ungabonakaliswa esiphambanweni se-dihybrid esihilela izici ezimbili ezihlukene ezitholakala kuma-chromosome ahlukene. Izikwele zikaPunnett zingasetshenziswa ukubikezela izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo kanye nezinhlobo zenzalo ezihilela izakhi zofuzo eyodwa noma ezimbili.

 Nakuba ama-chromosome ehlelwa ngokuzimela abe ama-gametes ngesikhathi se-meiosis, umthetho kaMendel wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele ubhekisela kuzakhi zofuzo, hhayi ama-chromosome. Kubantu, ama-chromosome angawodwa angathwala izakhi zofuzo ezingaphezu kwe-1,000. Izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala eduze kwe-chromosome efanayo kuthiwa ziyizakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe. Uma izakhi zofuzo ziseduze kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo, ama-allele azo avame ukutholwa njengefa ndawonye ngaphandle kokuthi kwenzeka ukuhlangana kabusha. Lokhu kuphumela ezilinganisweni zenzalo eziphula umthetho kaMendel wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele. Izakhi zofuzo eziqhelelene kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo cishe zizohlukana ngokuzimela. Imithetho yamathuba ingasiza ekuxazululeni lokhu (inhloso ye-pun). Umthetho uthi ama-allele ezakhi zofuzo ezahlukene ayahlukana ngokuzimela ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwe-gamete.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo ezigqanyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zithola, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 3.11][I-APLO 3.15][I-APLO 3.14][I-APLO 3.17][I-APLO 3.12]

 UMendel wahlanganisa imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwakhe kwesitshalo sikabhontshisi yaba yizici ezine, ezinye zazo ngezinye izikhathi ezibizwa ngokuthi imithetho,” echaza isisekelo sefa elibusayo neliphindaphindayo ezintweni eziphilayo ze-diploid. Njengoba usufundile, kukhona izandiso eziyinkimbinkimbi ze-Mendelism ezingabonisi izilinganiso ezifanayo ze-F2 phenotypic (3:1). Noma kunjalo, le mithetho ifingqa izisekelo zezakhi zofuzo zakudala
question1: Ngokomthetho kaMendels wokuhlukanisa, kwenzekani kuma-allele amabili esakhi sofuzo ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer1: Ziyahlukana ukuze i-gamete ngayinye ithole i-allele eyodwa kuphela
distractor1a: Bahlala ndawonye kuzo zonke izinhlobo ze-gamete
question2: Umthetho kaMendels wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele usebenza ku:
answer2: Izakhi zofuzo ezihluka ngokuzimela zibe ama-gametes, ikakhulukazi uma zitholakala kuma-chromosome ahlukene
distractor2b: Izakhi zofuzo zitholakala kuphela ku-chromosome X
question3: Yiluphi uhlobo lokwehlukaniswa kwezakhi zofuzo olubonisa kangcono umthetho kaMendels wokuhlukaniswa?
answer3: Isiphambano se-monohybrid
question4: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesiphambano sezakhi zofuzo oluvame ukusetshenziswa ukubonisa umthetho kaMendels wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele?
answer4: Isiphambano se-dihybrid
question5: Kungani izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ngezinye izikhathi zephula umthetho kaMendels wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele?
answer5: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala eduze ku-chromosome efanayo zivame ukutholwa njengefa ndawonye ngaphandle kokuthi zihlukaniswe ngokwehlukana.
distractor5a: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zihlala zihluka ngokuzimela
distractor5b: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zitholakala kuphela kuma-chromosome ocansi
distractor5c: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe azikaze zibhekane ne-meiosis
question6: Izakhi zofuzo eziqhelelene kakhulu kwi-chromosome efanayo zinamathuba amaningi oku:
answer6: Hlukanisa ngokuzimela ngoba ukuwela ngaphesheya kuvame ukuhlukanisa
question7: Iyiphi inqubo engahlukanisa izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer7: Ukuwela (ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo)
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esihlukanisa kangcono umthetho kaMendels wokuhlukahluka okuzimele ekuziphatheni kwama-chromosome?
answer8: Umthetho ubhekisela kuzakhi zofuzo, noma ngabe ama-chromosome ahlukana ngokomzimba ngesikhathi se-meiosis
distractor8a: Umthetho usebenza kuma-chromosome kuphela, hhayi kuma-genes
distractor8b: Izakhi zofuzo nama-chromosome zihlala zihlukana ngokuzimela kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zixhumene kanjani
distractor8c: Ama-chromosome ocansi kuphela alandela ukuhlukahluka okuzimele
question9: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo sifunda ngezakhi zofuzo ezimbili eziseduze kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo. Yimuphi umphumela ongaba khona?
answer9: Izakhi zofuzo zivame ukutholwa njengefa ndawonye ngaphandle kokuthi kwenzeka ukuwela phakathi kwazo.
distractor9b: Izakhi zofuzo zizohlukaniswa zibe ama-gametes ahlukene njalo nge-meiosis
question10: Kungani izikwele zikaPunnett ziwusizo ekucwaningweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: Babikezela izinhlobo zofuzo ezilindelekile kanye nezinhlobo zenzalo besebenzisa imithetho kaMendels kanye namathuba
distractor10b: Bakhomba ngqo izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe kuma-chromosome
distractor10c: Balinganisa amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ama-Pairs of Unit Factors, noma Izakhi Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ama-Pairs of Unit Factors, noma Izakhi Zofuzo
chapterContent: UMendel waqale waphakamisa ukuthi izici zamayunithi ezibhangqiwe zofuzo zidluliselwa ngokwethembeka kusuka esizukulwaneni kuya kwesinye ngokuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezinto ezibhangqiwe ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwe-gametogenesis kanye nokukhulelwa, ngokulandelana. Ngemva kokuhlanganisa ubhontshisi nezici eziphikisanayo futhi wathola ukuthi lesi sici esiphindaphindayo saphinde savela esizukulwaneni se-F2, uMendel waphetha ngokuthi izici zofuzo kumele zizuzwe njengezingxenye ezihlukene. Lokhu okutholakele kwaphikisana nenkolelo yangaleso sikhathi yokuthi izici zomzali zazixutshwe enzalweni.
question1: Yini uMendel aphetha ngayo ngemva kokubona ukuthi isici esiphindaphindayo siphinde savela esizukulwaneni se-F2?
answer1: Izici ezizuzwe njengefa zizuzwa njengezingxenye ezihlukene kunokuba zihlanganiswe ndawonye
distractor1a: Izici eziphindaphindayo ziyanyamalala unomphela ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
distractor1b: Izici ezivelele ziyaguquka zibe izici eziphindaphindayo
question2: Ngokusho kukaMendel, kwenzekani ezintweni ezizuzwe njengefa ezibhangqiwe ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwe-gamete?
answer2: Izici ezibhangqiwe ziyahlukana ukuze i-gamete ngayinye ithole isici esisodwa
distractor2a: Izinto ezibhangqiwe zihlala ndawonye kuwo wonke ama-gamete
distractor2c: Izinto ezibhangqiwe ziyahlangana zibe yinto entsha
question3: Ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, uMendel wasikisela ukuthi izici zofuzo:
answer3: Hlanganisa kabusha lapho into eyodwa evela kumzali ngamunye ihlangana enzalweni
question4: Yimuphi umbono wangaphambilini wofuzo owaphikiswa yimiphumela kaMendels?
answer4: Inkolelo-mbono yokuxuba ifa
question5: Yiliphi igama lesimanje lezinto eziphilayo elihambisana nezinto zeyunithi zeMendels?
answer5: Izakhi zofuzo (ama-allele)
question6: Kungani ukuvela kabusha kwesici esiphindaphindayo esizukulwaneni se-F2 kwakubalulekile?
answer6: Kubonise ukuthi izici zofuzo eziphindaphindayo zagcinwa ngisho noma zingavezwanga esizukulwaneni se-F1
distractor6a: Kwafakazela ukuthi izici ezivelele ziyanyamalala ekugcineni
distractor6b: Kwabonisa ukuthi izinguquko zenzeka kuzo zonke izizukulwane
distractor6c: Kubonise ukuthi izimo zemvelo zinquma ifa
question7: Iyiphi inqubo ehlukanisa izinto ezizuzwe njengefa ezihlanganiswe yi-Mendels zibe ama-gametes ahlukene?
answer7: I-Meiosis
question8: Inhlanganisela phakathi kwezitshalo ze-pea ezikhula ngempela ezinsomi nezimhlophe iveza zonke inzalo ye-F1 ensomi, kodwa izimbali ezimhlophe ziyavela esizukulwaneni se-F2. Yisiphi isiphetho esichaza kangcono lo mphumela?
answer8: I-allele emhlophe yahlala ingashintshi esizukulwaneni se-F1 futhi yahlukaniswa ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwe-gamete.
distractor8a: I-allele emhlophe yanyamalala futhi yaguqulwa esizukulwaneni se-F2
distractor8b: I-allele ensomi yaguquka yaba i-allele emhlophe
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kahle umbono kaMendels wokuqala mayelana nezici zofuzo?
answer9: Izinto eziphilayo zithola amakhophi amabili esici ngasinye sofuzo, elilodwa livela kumzali ngamunye
distractor9a: Izinto eziphilayo zizuza kuphela izici eziyinhloko zefa
distractor9b: Umzali ngamunye unikeza izici ezifanayo zofuzo
distractor9c: Isici ngasinye silawulwa ama-chromosome amaningi angahlobene
question10: Umcwaningi uthi izici zokuzala zihlala ziyinhlanganisela yezimpawu zobuzali. Yikuphi ukubonwa okuvela ekuhlolweni kukaMendels okunikeza ubufakazi obuqine kakhulu obuphikisana nalesi simangalo?
answer10: Izici eziphindaphindayo zanyamalala esizukulwaneni se-F1 kodwa zaphinde zavela zingashintshi esizukulwaneni se-F2.
distractor10c: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-pea zinemibala ehlukene yezimbali

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ama-Allele Angaba Ngamandla Noma Angalawuleki
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ama-Allele Angaba Ngamandla Noma Angalawuleki
chapterContent:
Umthetho kaMendel wokubusa uthi ku-heterozygote, isici esisodwa sizofihla ukuba khona kwesinye isici sesici esifanayo. Esikhundleni sokuthi womabili ama-allele afake isandla ku-phenotype, i-allele ebusayo izovezwa kuphela. I-allele ebusayo izohlala ifihliwe "kodwa izodluliselwa enzalweni ngendlela efanayo lapho i-allele ebusayo idluliselwa ngayo. Isici ebusayo sizovezwa kuphela yinzalo enamakhophi amabili ale allele (Isithombe 12.15), futhi le nzalo izozala iqiniso uma izihlanganisa.

 Kusukela ekuhlolweni kukaMendel ngezitshalo zama-pea, abanye abacwaningi bathole ukuthi umthetho wokubusa awuhlali uyiqiniso. Esikhundleni salokho, kutholakale ukuthi kukhona amaphethini amaningana ahlukene efa.
question1: Ngokomthetho kaMendels wokubusa, kwenzekani kumuntu one-heterozygous?
answer1: I-allele eyinhloko ivezwa ngenkathi i-allele ephindaphindayo ifihliwe
distractor1a: Zombili izi-allele ziyahlangana ukuze zikhiqize i-phenotype ephakathi
question2: Isici esiphindaphindayo sibonakaliswa nini ngokwefa likaMendelian?
answer2: Kuphela uma umuntu ezuza ama-allele amabili aphindaphindayo
distractor2a: Noma nini lapho kukhona i-allele eyodwa ephindaphindayo
question3: Kwenzekani ku-allele ephindaphindayo emzimbeni we-heterozygous?
answer3: Akukacaciswa kodwa kusengadluliselwa ebantwaneni
distractor3c: Iba yinto engasebenzi futhi ayikwazi ukutholwa njengefa
question4: Kungani abazali ababili abanezimpawu ezivelele bengakwazi ukukhiqiza inzalo enezimpawu eziphindaphindayo?
answer4: Bobabili abazali bangaba yi-heterozygous futhi ngamunye udlulisela i-allele ephindaphindayo ebantwaneni
distractor4a: Ama-allele amakhulu aphenduka abuyele emuva ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa
distractor4c: Ama-allele aphindaphindayo ahlala eqa isizukulwane esisodwa
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-genotype oluzohlala luveza i-phenotype ephindaphindayo ngendlela elula ye-Mendelian?
answer5: I-Homozygous recessive
question6: Kusho ukuthini uma isici esiphindaphindayo siqala ukuba yiqiniso ngemva kokuzizalela?
answer6: Zonke izizukulwane nazo ziveza uhlobo lwe-recessive ngoba zithola ifa le-recessive alleles kuphela
question7: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-genotype olune-phenotype efanayo nomuntu olawulayo ofana nowe-homozygous ekubuseni okuphelele?
answer7: I-Heterozygous
question8: Yikuphi ukuqaphela okwaholela ososayensi ekuphetheni ngokuthi umthetho kaMendels wokubusa awuwona wonke umuntu?
answer8: Ezinye izakhi zofuzo zibonisa amaphethini ofuzo njengokubusa okungaphelele kanye nokulawulana
distractor8b: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezinhlobo ze-allele eziphindaphindayo kuphela
distractor8c: Izakhi zofuzo zidluliselwa kuphela ngefa likamama
question9: Isitshalo se-pea esinezimbali ezinsomi sine-genotype Pp, lapho okunsomi kubusa khona ngaphezu kokumhlophe. Yiluphi uhlobo lwesitshalo oluzoboniswa yilesi sitshalo?
answer9: Izimbali ezinsomi
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kahle umthetho kaMendels wokubusa?
answer10: Ku-heterozygote, i-allele eyinhloko inquma uhlobo lwe-phenotype kuyilapho i-allele ephindaphindayo ihlala ikhona kodwa ingavezwa.
distractor10a: Zombili izi-allele zihlala zinikela ngokulinganayo ku-phenotype
distractor10c: Ama-allele amakhulu abonakaliswa kuphela kubantu abane-homozygous

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukuhlukaniswa Okulinganayo Kwama-Allele
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukuhlukaniswa Okulinganayo Kwama-Allele
chapterContent: Eqaphela ukuthi izitshalo zama-pea ezizalanisa ngempela ezinezimpawu ezihlukile zaveza izizukulwane ze-F1 ezaziveza isici esibusayo kanye nezizukulwane ze-F2 ezaziveza izici ezibusayo nezibusayo ngesilinganiso esingu-3:1, uMendel waphakamisa umthetho wokuhlukanisa. Lo mthetho uthi izici zeyunithi ezibhangqiwe (izakhi zofuzo) kumele zihlukaniswe ngokulinganayo zibe ama-gametes ukuze inzalo ibe nethuba elilinganayo lokuthola noma iyiphi i-factor. Esizukulwaneni se-F2 se-monohybrid cross, inhlanganisela emithathu elandelayo yezinhlobo ze-genotype ingabangela: i-homozygous dominant, i-heterozygous, noma i-homozygous recessive. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-heterozygotes angavela ezindleleni ezimbili ezahlukene (ukwamukela i-allele eyodwa ebusayo neyodwa ebusayo kunoma yimuphi umzali), futhi ngenxa yokuthi ama-heterozygotes kanye nabantu ababusayo be-homozygous bafana ngendlela efanayo, umthetho usekela isilinganiso sikaMendel se-phenotypic esingu-3:1 esibonwe. Ukuhlukaniswa ngokulinganayo kwama-allele yisona sizathu sokuthi singasebenzisa isikwele sikaPunnett ukubikezela ngokunembile inzalo yabazali abanezinhlobo ze-genotype ezaziwayo. Isisekelo esingokoqobo somthetho kaMendel wokuhlukaniswa yisigaba sokuqala se-meiosis, lapho ama-chromosome afanayo anezinguqulo zawo ezihlukene zezakhi zofuzo ngasinye ahlukaniswa khona abe yi-nuclei yendodakazi. Indima yokuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome okungajwayelekile ekuzalweni ngokocansi ayizange iqondwe umphakathi wesayensi ngesikhathi sokuphila kukaMendel.
question1: Uthini umthetho kaMendels wokuhlukaniswa?
answer1: Ama-allele amabili esakhi sofuzo ahlukana ngokulinganayo ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwe-gamete ngakho i-gamete ngayinye ithola i-allele eyodwa kuphela.
distractor1a: Zombili i-allele zihlala ndawonye kuzo zonke i-gamete
distractor1b: Ama-allele anamandla azuzwa kaningi kune-allele ephindaphindayo
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezintathu ze-genotypes ezingenzeka esizukulwaneni se-F2 se-monohybrid cross phakathi kwama-heterozygote amabili?
answer2: I-homozygous dominant, heterozygous, kanye ne-homozygous recessive
distractor2a: I-homozygous dominant kanye ne-homozygous recessive kuphela
question3: Kungani isilinganiso se-genotypic esilindelekile esizukulwaneni se-F2 sesiphambano se-monohybrid singu-1:2:1?
answer3: Ama-Heterozygotes angakhiqizwa yizinhlanganisela ezimbili ze-allele ezinokwenzeka ngokulinganayo
distractor3a: Ama-allele anamandla azuzwa njengefa ngokuphindwe kabili kune-allele ephindaphindayo
distractor3b: Ama-allele aphindaphindayo aguquka abe ama-allele abusayo
distractor3c: Ukuwela ngaphesheya kuhlala kukhiqiza ama-heterozygote engeziwe
question4: Kungani isilinganiso se-phenotypic esilindelekile esizukulwaneni se-F2 esi-monohybrid singu-3:1?
answer4: Abantu abanamandla be-homozygous kanye nabantu abanamandla be-heterozygous bane-phenotype efanayo ebusayo
distractor4a: Ama-allele anamandla adlula ama-allele aphindaphindayo kuma-gametes
distractor4c: Kuphela abantu abanamandla afanayo kuphela abasindayo
question5: Iyiphi inqubo yezinto eziphilayo enikeza isisekelo esingokwenyama somthetho kaMendels wokuhlukaniswa?
answer5: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosomes afanayo ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
question6: Kungani uPunnett ekwazi ukubikezela ngokunembile izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo zenzalo?
answer6: Ngoba ama-allele ahlukana ngokulinganayo abe ama-gametes ngesikhathi se-meiosis
distractor6c: Ngoba i-meiosis ikhiqiza ama-gametes afanayo ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question7: Isitshalo esibizwa ngokuthi i-heterozygous (Aa) sikhiqiza ama-gametes. Yiliphi ingxenye yama-gametes aso okulindeleke ukuthi athwale i-allele ye-A?
question8: Izitshalo ezimbili ze-heterozygous pea (Yy × Yy) zihlanganisiwe. Yimaphi amathuba okulindeleka ukuthi inzalo ibe ne-homozygous recessive?
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani umthetho kaMendels wokuhlukaniswa kwabantu wawungaqondwa ngokugcwele ngesikhathi esaphila?
answer9: Indima yama-chromosome kanye ne-meiosis ekuzalweni kwefa yayingakatholakali.
distractor9a: I-DNA yayisivele itholakele kodwa ayizange inakwe
distractor9b: Ososayensi babekholelwa ukuthi i-meiosis yenzeka ezitshalweni kuphela
distractor9c: Ama-chromosome ayehlelwe ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuhlolwa kukaMendels
question10: I-heterozygous individual (Bb) ikhiqiza ama-gametes ayi-1,000. Cishe bangaki okulindeleke ukuthi bathwale i-allele ephindaphindayo?

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele
chapterContent:
Umthetho kaMendel wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele uthi izakhi zofuzo azithintani maqondana nokuhlela ama-allele zibe ama-gamete, futhi yonke inhlanganisela engenzeka yama-allele kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo kungenzeka ukuthi yenzeke ngokufanayo. Ukuhlanganiswa okuzimele kwezakhi zofuzo kungaboniswa nge-dihybrid cross, inhlanganisela phakathi kwabazali ababili abazalanisa ngempela abaveza izici ezahlukene zezici ezimbili. Cabanga ngezici zombala wembewu kanye nokuthungwa kwembewu yezitshalo ezimbili zama-pea, enye enembewu eluhlaza, eshwabene (yyrr) kanye nenye enembewu ephuzi, eyindilinga (YYRR). Ngenxa yokuthi umzali ngamunye ungumuntu oyedwa, umthetho wokuhlukanisa ubonisa ukuthi ama-gamete esitshalo esiluhlaza/esishwabene wonke angonyaka, kanti ama-gamete esitshalo esiphuzi/esiyindilinga wonke angama-YR. Ngakho-ke, isizukulwane se-F1 senzalo sonke siyi-YyRr (Isithombe 12.16).

 Esizukulwaneni se-F2, umthetho wokuhlukanisa udinga ukuthi i-gamete ngayinye ithole i-R allele noma i-r allele kanye ne-Y allele noma i-y allele. Umthetho wezinhlobonhlobo ezizimele uthi i-gamete lapho i-allele ihlungwe khona cishe izoba ne-allele ka-Y noma i-allele ka-y. Ngakho-ke, kune-gamete ezine ezingenzeka ngokulinganayo ezingakhiwa lapho i-heterozygote ka-YyRr izihlanganisa, kanje: YR, Yr, yR, kanye nonyaka. Ukuhlela la ma-gamete phezulu nangakwesobunxele sesikwele esingu-4 × 4 se-Punnett (Isithombe 12.16) kusinika izinhlanganisela ezingu-16 ezingenzeka ngokulinganayo. Kusukela kulezi zinhlobo ze-genotypic, siphetha ngokuthi isilinganiso se-phenotypic esingu-9 esiyindilinga/ephuzi:3 esiyindilinga/eluhlaza:3 esibhincile/ephuzi:1 esibhincile/eluhlaza (Isithombe 12.16). Lezi yizilinganiso zenzalo esingazilindela, uma sicabanga ukuthi senze iziphambano ngosayizi omkhulu wesampula.

 Ngenxa yokuhlukahluka okuzimele kanye nokubusa, isilinganiso se-dihybrid phenotypic esingu-9:3:3:1 singahlukaniswa sibe yizilinganiso ezimbili ezingu-3:1, ezibonakala kunoma yisiphi isiphambano se-monohybrid esilandela iphethini ebusayo nephindaphindayo. Uma singanaki umbala wembewu futhi sicabangela kuphela ukuthungwa kwembewu esiphambanweni se-dihybrid esingenhla, singalindela ukuthi izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zenzalo yesizukulwane se-F2 zizoba yindilinga, kanti ingxenye eyodwa kwezine izobe imibimbi. Ngokufanayo, uma sihlukanisa umbala wembewu kuphela, singacabanga ukuthi izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zenzalo ye-F2 zizoba phuzi kanti ingxenye eyodwa kwezine izobe iluhlaza. Ukuhlungwa kwama-alleles okuthungwa nombala kuyimicimbi ezimele, ngakho-ke singasebenzisa umthetho womkhiqizo. Ngakho-ke, isilinganiso senzalo ye-F2 eyindilinga nephuzi kulindeleke ukuthi sibe yi-(3/4) × (3/4) = 9/16, kanti isilinganiso senzalo emibimbi neluhlaza kulindeleke ukuthi sibe yi-(1/4) × (1/4) = 1/16. Lezi zilinganiso ziyafana nalezo ezitholakale kusetshenziswa isikwele se-Punnett. Inzalo eyindilinga, eluhlaza kanye nenemibimbi, ephuzi nayo ingabalwa kusetshenziswa umthetho womkhiqizo, njengoba ngayinye yalezi genotype ihlanganisa i-phenotype eyodwa evelele kanye ne-recessive eyodwa. Ngakho-ke, isilinganiso saleso naleso sibalwa njengo-(3/4) × (1/4) = 3/16.

 Umthetho we-assortment ezimele uphinde ubonise ukuthi ukuphambana phakathi kwabazali abaphuzi, abanemibimbi (YYrr) kanye nohlaza, abayindilinga (yyRR) kuzoveza inzalo efanayo ye-F1 kanye ne-F2 njengasesiphambanweni se-YYRR x yyrr.

 Isisekelo esingokomzimba somthetho we-assortment ezimele siphinde sibe ku-meiosis I, lapho amabhangqa ahlukene afanayo ehlangana khona ngokuqondiswa okungahleliwe. I-gamete ngayinye ingaqukatha noma yikuphi ukuhlanganiswa kwama-chromosome kayise kanye nonina (ngakho-ke izakhi zofuzo ezikuwo) ngoba ukuqondiswa kwama-tetrad endizeni ye-metaphase kuhleliwe
question1: Uthini umthetho kaMendels wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele?
answer1: Ama-allele ezizakhi zofuzo ezahlukene ahlukahluka ngokuzimela abe ama-gametes lapho izakhi zofuzo zingaxhunyanisiwe
distractor1a: Ama-allele e-gene efanayo ahlala ehlangana ndawonye
distractor1b: Ama-allele anamandla ahlala ehlukahlukana ngaphambi kwama-allele aphindaphindayo
distractor1c: Izakhi zofuzo eziku-chromosome efanayo zihlala zihlukaniswa ngokuzimela
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesiphambano sezakhi zofuzo olusetshenziswa ukukhombisa umthetho wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele?
question3: Izitshalo ezimbili zikabhontshisi ezizalanisa ngempela ezinezinhlobo zofuzo i-YYRR ne-yyrr ziyahlanganiswa. Iyini uhlobo lofuzo lwazo zonke inzalo ye-F1?
answer3: YyRr
question4: Zingaki izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-gametes umuntu ngamunye angawakhiqiza ngokwezinhlobo ezahlukene ezizimele?
answer4: Okune: Unyaka, Unyaka, Unyaka, kanye nonyaka
question5: Iyini isilinganiso se-phenotypic esilindelekile sesizukulwane se-F2 esivela ku-YyRr × YyRr dihybrid cross?
distractor5b: Sat Dec 30 1899 01:02:01 GMT+1000 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
question6: Iyini amathuba okukhiqiza inzalo enezinhlobo ezimbili ezivelele (ophuzi, oyisiyingi) esiphambanweni se-YyRr × YyRr?
answer6: Wed Sep 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1000 (Australian Eastern Standard Time)
distractor6a: Mon Mar 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1100 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
distractor6b: Fri Jan 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1100 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
distractor6c: Sun Jan 04 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1100 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
question7: Iyini amathuba okukhiqiza inzalo enezinhlobo ezimbili eziphindaphindayo (eziluhlaza okotshani, ezishwabene) esiphambanweni se-YyRr × YyRr?
answer7: Fri Jan 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1100 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
distractor7a: Mon Mar 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1100 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
distractor7b: Sun Jan 04 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1100 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)
distractor7c: Wed Sep 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1000 (Australian Eastern Standard Time)
question8: Yisiphi isimiso esichaza ukuthi kungani amathuba enzalo ephuzi, eyindilinga elingana no-(3/4) × (3/4) = 9/16?
answer8: Umthetho womkhiqizo wamathuba usetshenziswa ezizakhi zofuzo ezihlukanisiwe ngokuzimela
question9: Iyini isisekelo esingokoqobo somthetho kaMendels wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele?
answer9: Ukuqondiswa okungahleliwe kwama-chromosome amabili ahambisanayo ngesikhathi se-metaphase I ye-meiosis
question10: Kungani iziphambano ze-YYRR × yyrr kanye ne-YYrr × yyRR ziveza imiphumela efanayo ye-F1 kanye ne-F2?
answer10: Ngoba ama-allele ezizakhi zofuzo ezimbili ahlukahluka ngokuzimela ngesikhathi se-meiosis, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yimuphi umzali ofaka isandla ku-allele ngayinye ebusayo noma ephindaphindayo.
distractor10a: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo zihlala zizuzwa ndawonye ku-chromosome efanayo
distractor10b: Ngoba iziphambano ezilandelanayo zihlala zisusa ama-allele aphindaphindayo
distractor10c: Ngoba ama-allele abusayo ahlala evela kumzali wesilisa
question11: Bheka Umfanekiso 12.16. Ezitshalweni ze-pea, izimbali ezinsomi (P) zinamandla kunezimbali ezimhlophe (p) kanti uphizi ophuzi (Y) zinamandla kune-pea eluhlaza (y). Yiziphi izinhlobo zofuzo kanye nezinhlobo ze-phenotypes ezingaba khona zokuxutshwa phakathi kwezitshalo ze-pea ze-PpYY ne-ppYy? Yiliphi inani elincane lezikwele ozidingayo ukuze wenze ukuhlaziywa kwesikwele kwe-Punnett kwalesi sikwele?
answer11: Izimbali eziphuzi eziveza i-PpYY, i-PpYy, i-ppYY, i-ppYy ziveza izimbali ezinsomi ezinobhontshisi ophuzi, kanye nezimbali ezimhlophe ezinobhontshisi ophuzi. Ungakuthola lokhu ngesikwele se-Punnett esingu-2 × 2
distractor11a: PpYY, Ppyy, ppYY, izimbali ezimhlophe ezikhiqiza i-ppyy ezinobhontshisi ophuzi, izimbali ezinsomi ezinobhontshisi ophuzi, kanye nezimbali ezimhlophe ezinobhontshisi oluhlaza. Ungakuthola lokhu ngesikwele sikaPunnett esingu-3 × 3
distractor11b: I-PPYY, i-PpYy, i-ppYY, izimbali eziphuzi ezikhiqiza i-ppyy ezinobhontshisi ophuzi, izimbali ezimhlophe ezinobhontshisi ophuzi, kanye nezimbali ezimhlophe ezinobhontshisi oluhlaza. Ungakuthola lokhu ngesikwele sikaPunnett esingu-2 × 2
distractor11c: I-Ppyy, i-PpYy, i-ppYY, izimbali eziphuzi ezikhiqizayo ezi-pyy ezinobhontshisi oluhlaza, izimbali ezinsomi ezinobhontshisi ophuzi, izimbali ezimhlophe ezinobhontshisi ophuzi, kanye nezimbali ezimhlophe ezinobhontshisi oluhlaza. Ungakuthola lokhu ngesikwele sikaPunnett esingu-3 × 3

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele | Indlela Yomugqa Ohlanganisiwe
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele | Indlela Yomugqa Ohlanganisiwe
chapterContent:
Uma kucatshangelwa izakhi zofuzo ezingaphezu kwezimbili, indlela yesikwele se-Punnett iba nzima ukuyiphatha. Isibonelo, ukuhlola isiphambano esihilela izakhi zofuzo ezine kungadinga igridi engu-16 × 16 equkethe amabhokisi angu-256. Kungaba nzima kakhulu ukufaka ngesandla uhlobo ngalunye lwe-genotype. Ukuze uthole iziphambano eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, izindlela zomugqa ogobekile kanye namathuba ziyathandwa.

 Ukuze silungiselele umdwebo womugqa ogobekile wesiphambano phakathi kwama-heterozygote e-F1 avela esiphambanweni phakathi kwabazali be-AABBCC nabe-aabbcc, siqala sakha imigqa elingana nenani lezakhi zofuzo ezicatshangelwayo, bese sihlukanisa ama-allele emgqeni ngamunye emigqeni egobekile ngokwezimo zamathuba eziphambano ze-monohybrid ngayinye (Isithombe 12.17). Sibe sesiphindaphinda amanani endleleni ngayinye egobekile ukuze sithole amathuba enzalo ye-F2. Qaphela ukuthi le nqubo iyinguqulo yesazobe yomthetho womkhiqizo. Amanani endleleni ngayinye egobekile angaphindaphindwa ngoba izakhi zofuzo ngayinye ziyahlukahluka ngokuzimela. Ngesiphambano se-trihybrid, isilinganiso se-F2 phenotypic singu-27:9:9:9:3:3:3:1
question1: Kungani indlela yomugqa ogobile ikhethwa kunesikwele sikaPunnett seziphambano ezihilela izakhi zofuzo eziningi?

answer4: Ngoba i-gene ngayinye ihluka ngokuzimela

question5: Ukuze kwakhiwe umdwebo womugqa onjengefoloko, mangaki imigqa okufanele iqalwe ekuqaleni?
answer5: Umugqa owodwa wesakhi ngasinye sofuzo uyacatshangelwa
distractor5c: Imigqa emine kungakhathaliseki inani lezakhi zofuzo

answer7: I-AABBCC × i-aabbcc
question8: Yikuphi ukucabanga okumele kube yiqiniso ngendlela yomugqa ogobekile ukuze kukhiqizwe amathuba anembile?
answer8: Izakhi zofuzo ziyahlukahluka ngokuzimela

question9: Isazi sezakhi zofuzo sihlaziya izakhi zofuzo ezinhlanu ezihlukene ngokuzimela. Iyiphi indlela engaba ngcono kakhulu?
answer9: Indlela yomugqa ogobile
question10: Kungani indlela yomugqa ogobile iba usizo kakhulu njengoba inani lezakhi zofuzo landa?
answer10: Ngoba izikwele zePunnett zanda ngobukhulu obukhulu, kuyilapho indlela yomugqa ogobekile isalula ukuyihlela kusetshenziswa amathuba
distractor10a: Ngoba indlela yomugqa ogobekile ayinaki ama-allele aphindaphindayo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele | Indlela Yokungenzeka
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele | Indlela Yokungenzeka
chapterContent:
Nakuba indlela yomugqa ogobekile iyindlela echazayo yokugcina umkhondo wamathuba esiphambanweni, indlela yokwenzeka inikeza izilinganiso zenzalo okulindeleke ukuthi ibonise uhlobo ngalunye (noma uhlobo lwe-genotype) ngaphandle kosizo olubonakalayo olwengeziwe. Zombili lezi zindlela zisebenzisa umthetho womkhiqizo futhi zicabangela ama-alleles esakhini ngasinye ngokwehlukana. Ngaphambilini, sihlole izilinganiso ze-phenotypic zesiphambano se-trihybrid sisebenzisa indlela yomugqa ogobekile; manje sizosebenzisa indlela yokwenzeka ukuhlola izilinganiso ze-genotypic zesiphambano esinama-gene amaningi nakakhulu.

 Ngesiphambano se-trihybrid, ukubhala indlela yomugqa ogobekile kuyadina, yize kungesidina njengokusebenzisa indlela yesikwele ye-Punnett. Nokho, ukuze sibonise ngokugcwele amandla endlela yokwenzeka, singacabangela izibalo ezithile zezakhi zofuzo. Isibonelo, ngesiphambano se-tetrahybrid phakathi kwabantu abangama-heterozygotes kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo ezine, futhi lapho zonke izakhi zofuzo ezine zihlela ngokuzimela futhi ngendlela ebusayo neyokugoba, yiliphi inani lenzalo elizolindeleka ukuthi libe yi-homozygous recessive kuzo zonke ama-allele amane? Esikhundleni sokubhala yonke i-genotype engenzeka, singasebenzisa indlela yokukhomba amathuba. Siyazi ukuthi ku-gene ngayinye, ingxenye ye-homozygous recessive puberty izoba yi-1/4. Ngakho-ke, siphindaphinda le ngxenye ye-gene ngayinye ye-homozygous recessive, (1/4) × (1/4) × (1/4) × (1/4), sinquma ukuthi i-1/256 yenzalo izoba yi-homozygous recessive ephindwe kane.

 Nge-tetrahybrid cross efanayo, iyini ingxenye elindelekile yenzalo ene-phenotype evelele kuzo zonke izindawo ezine? Singaphendula lo mbuzo sisebenzisa i-phenotypic proportions, kodwa ake sikwenze ngendlela enzima—sisebenzisa i-genotypic proportions. Umbuzo ubuza ingxenye yenzalo engu-1) i-homozygous dominant ku-A noma i-heterozygous ku-A, kanye no-2) i-homozygous ku-B noma i-heterozygous ku-B, njalo njalo. Ukuqaphela i-or” kanye ne-futhi” kuzo zonke izimo kwenza kucace ukuthi kufanele kusetshenziswe kuphi imithetho yesamba kanye nomkhiqizo. Amathuba okuba ne-homozygous dominant ku-A angu-1/4 kanti amathuba okuba ne-heterozygote ku-A angu-1/2. Amathuba okuba ne-homozygote noma i-heterozygote angu-1/4 + 1/2 = 3/4 kusetshenziswa umthetho wesamba. Amathuba afanayo angatholakala ngendlela efanayo kuzo zonke ezinye izakhi zofuzo, ukuze amathuba okuba ne-phenotype dominant ku-A no-B no-C no-D, kusetshenziswa umthetho womkhiqizo, alingane no-3/4 × 3/4 × 3/4 × 3/4, noma u-81/256. Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi ungahlanganisa kanjani amathuba, ukubuyela endleleni ye-forked-line kufanele kukwenze kucace.
question1: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yendlela yamathuba kunendlela yesikwele yePunnett?
answer1: Ivumela ukubalwa okuphumelelayo kwamathuba enzalo ezinhlanganisela ezihilela izakhi zofuzo eziningi
distractor1c: Ingakwazi ukubala ama-phenotype kuphela, hhayi ama-genotype
question2: Kokubili indlela yamathuba kanye nendlela yomugqa ogobekile kuncike kumthetho wamathuba?
question3: Esixukwini se-tetrahybrid (AaBbCcDd × AaBbCcDd), iyiphi ingxenye yenzalo okulindeleke ukuthi ibe yi-homozygous recessive kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo ezine?
distractor3c: Fri Jan 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1100 (Australian Eastern Daylight Time)

answer4: Umthetho wesamba

distractor5b: Wed Sep 16 2026 00:00:00 GMT+1000 (Australian Eastern Standard Time)
question6: Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi ungawahlanganisa kanjani amathuba usebenzisa indlela yokuthi kungenzeka, iyiphi indlela engasiza ekucaciseni ukubala?
answer6: Buyela endleleni yomugqa ogobekile ukuze ubone ngeso lengqondo amathuba
distractor6c: Ake sithi zonke inzalo zingenzeka ngokulinganayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhlobo luni lwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele | Imithetho Yokuvundisa Okune-Multihybrid
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kweMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Ukwahlukahluka Okuzimele | Imithetho Yokuvundisa Okune-Multihybrid
chapterContent:
Ukubikezela izinhlobo zofuzo kanye nezinhlobo zenzalo ezivela eziphambanweni ezinikeziwe kuyindlela engcono kakhulu yokuhlola ulwazi lwakho lwezakhi zofuzo zaseMendelian. Njengoba unikezwe isiphambano se-multihybrid esilalela ukuhlukahluka okuzimele futhi silandela iphethini ebusayo nephindaphindayo, kunemithetho eminingana ejwayelekile; ungasebenzisa le mithetho ukuhlola imiphumela yakho njengoba usebenza ngokubala kwezakhi zofuzo (Ithebula 12.5). Ukuze usebenzise le mithetho, okokuqala kufanele unqume u-n, inani lama-gene pair e-heterozygous (inani lama-gene ahlukanisa ama-allele amabili ngalinye). Isibonelo, isiphambano phakathi kwama-heterozygotes e-AaBb kanye ne-AaBb sino-n ongu-2. Ngokuphambene nalokho, isiphambano phakathi kwe-AABb kanye ne-AABb sino-n ongu-1 ngoba u-A akayona i-heterozygous.

 Njengoba kunikezwe ifa elibusayo neliphindaphindayo, inani lezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-F2

answer4: 2n

answer6: 2n

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Izakhi Zofuzo Ezixhumene Zephula Umthetho Wokuhlukahluka Okuzimele
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho Yefa | Izakhi Zofuzo Ezixhumene Zephula Umthetho Wokuhlukahluka Okuzimele
chapterContent:
Nakuba zonke izici zikaMendel ze-pea zazisebenza ngokomthetho wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele, manje sesiyazi ukuthi ezinye izinhlanganisela ze-allele azizuzwa njengefa ngokuzimela. Izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala kuma-chromosome ahlukene angewona awe-homologous zizohlala zihlela ngokuzimela. Kodwa-ke, i-chromosome ngayinye iqukethe amakhulu noma izinkulungwane zezakhi zofuzo, ezihlelwe ngokulandelana kuma-chromosome njengezinhlayiya entanjeni. Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-allele abe ama-gametes kungathonywa ukuxhumana, lapho izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala eduze komunye nomunye ngokomzimba ku-chromosome efanayo cishe zizuzwa njengezakhi zofuzo ezimbili. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yenqubo yokuhlanganiswa kabusha, noma i-crossover,” kungenzeka ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ezimbili ku-chromosome efanayo ziziphathe ngokuzimela, noma sengathi azixhunyiwe. Ukuze siqonde lokhu, ake sicabangele isisekelo sebhayoloji sokuxhumanisa izakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha.

 Ama-chromosome afanayo anezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo ngokulandelana okufanayo. Ama-allele angahluka kuma-chromosome amabili afanayo, kodwa izakhi zofuzo ezihambisana nazo azifani. Ukulungiselela ukuhlukaniswa kokuqala kwe-meiosis, ama-chromosome afanayo ayaphindaphinda futhi ahlanganisa i-synapse. Njengezakhi zofuzo kuma-homologue ziyavumelana. Kulesi sigaba, izingxenye zama-chromosome afanayo zishintshana izingxenye eziqondile zezinto zofuzo (Isithombe 12.18). Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-recombination, noma i-crossover, futhi kuyinqubo evamile yezakhi zofuzo. Ngenxa yokuthi izakhi zofuzo zihambisana ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa kabusha, ukuhleleka kwezakhi zofuzo akushintshi. Esikhundleni salokho, umphumela wokuhlanganiswa kabusha ukuthi ama-allele omama nobaba ahlanganiswa ku-chromosome efanayo. Kuyo yonke i-chromosome ethile, kungase kwenzeke izehlakalo eziningana zokuhlanganiswa kabusha, okubangela ukuxubana okukhulu kwama-allele.

 Uma izakhi zofuzo ezimbili ziseduze kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo, zibhekwa njengezixhumene, futhi ama-allele azo avame ukudluliselwa nge-meiosis ndawonye. Ukuze ubonise lokhu, cabanga ngesiphambano se-dihybrid esihilela umbala wembali nokuphakama kwesitshalo lapho izakhi zofuzo ziseduze komunye nomunye ku-chromosome. Uma i-chromosome eyodwa efana nayo inama-allele ezitshalo ezinde nezimbali ezibomvu, kanti enye i-chromosome inezakhi zofuzo zezitshalo ezimfushane nezimbali eziphuzi, khona-ke lapho kwakheka ama-gamete, ama-allele amade nabomvu azohlangana abe yi-gamete kanti ama-allele amafushane naphuzi azongena kwamanye ama-gamete. Lawa abizwa ngokuthi ama-genotypes abazali ngoba azuzwe njengefa kubazali bama-gamete akhiqizayo. Kodwa ngokungafani nokuthi izakhi zofuzo bezikuma-chromosome ahlukene, ngeke kube nama-gamete anama-allele amade naphuzi futhi ngeke kube nama-gamete anama-allele amafushane nabomvu. Uma udala isikwele se-Punnett ngala ma-gamete, uzobona ukuthi isibikezelo se-Mendelian sakudala somphumela we-9:3:3:1 wesiphambano se-dihybrid ngeke kusebenza. Njengoba ibanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili likhula, amathuba okuthi kube khona ukuhlangana okukodwa noma ngaphezulu phakathi kwazo ayanda, futhi izakhi zofuzo ziziphatha njengokungathi zikuma-chromosome ahlukene. Izazi zezakhi zofuzo zisebenzise isilinganiso sama-gametes aphindaphindayo (lawo angafani nabazali) njengesilinganiso sokuthi izakhi zofuzo ziqhelelene kangakanani kuma-chromosome. Besebenzisa lolu lwazi, bakhe amamephu ayinkimbinkimbi ezakhi zofuzo kuma-chromosome ezinto eziphilayo ezifundwe kahle, okuhlanganisa nabantu.

 Incwadi kaMendel eyinhloko ayikhulumi ngokuxhumana, futhi abacwaningi abaningi baye babuza ukuthi ngabe uhlangane nokuxhumana kodwa bakhetha ukungashicileli lezo ziphambano ngenxa yokukhathazeka ukuthi zizoyiqeda i-postulate yakhe ezimele. I-pea yasegadini inama-chromosome amabili ayisikhombisa, futhi abanye basikisele ukuthi ukukhetha kwakhe izici eziyisikhombisa kwakungeyona into eyenzeka ngengozi. Kodwa-ke, noma ngabe izakhi zofuzo azihlola zazingekho kuma-chromosome ahlukene, kungenzeka ukuthi akazange abone ukuxhumana ngenxa yemiphumela eminingi yokushintshashintsha kokuhlangana.
question1: Yiziphi izakhi zofuzo ezihlala zihluka ngokuzimela ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer1: Izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala kuma-chromosome ahlukene (angewona awe-homologous)
distractor1a: Izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala eduze kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo
question2: Kusho ukuthini ukuxhumanisa izakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Izakhi zofuzo ezisondelene ngokomzimba ku-chromosome efanayo zivame ukutholwa njengefa ndawonye
distractor2a: Izakhi zofuzo kuma-chromosome afanayo zihlala zihlukana ndawonye
distractor2b: Izakhi zofuzo kuma-chromosome ahlukene zizuzwa ndawonye
distractor2c: Izakhi zofuzo ezifaka izici ezifanayo zizuzwa ndawonye kungakhathaliseki indawo
question3: Iyiphi inqubo engabangela ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ezixhumene zisebenze sengathi ziyahlukahluka ngokuzimela?
answer3: Ukuwela (ukuhlanganiswa kabusha) ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
question4: Ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa kabusha, kwenzekani kuma-chromosome afanayo?
answer4: Bashintshana ngezigaba ze-DNA ezilinganayo ngenkathi begcina ukuhleleka okufanayo kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor4b: Ukuhleleka kwezakhi zofuzo zabo kuhlelwe kabusha ngokungahleliwe
question5: Uma izakhi zofuzo ezimbili zixhumene ngokuphelele futhi kungekho ukuphambana okwenzekayo phakathi kwazo, yimaphi ama-gametes akhiqizwayo?
answer5: Ukuhlanganiswa kwabazali kuphela kwama-allele
distractor5b: Izinombolo ezilinganayo zokuhlanganiswa kwabazali kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha
question6: Njengoba ibanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili ezixhumene likhula, kwenzekani?
answer6: Ukuwela kuba namathuba amaningi, ngakho-ke izakhi zofuzo ziziphatha njengozakhi zofuzo ezizihlukanisa ngokuzimela
distractor6c: Izakhi zofuzo ziyeka ngokuphelele ukuhlanganiswa kabusha
question7: Izazi zezakhi zofuzo zilinganisela ibanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili ku-chromosome ngokulinganisa:
answer7: Ingxenye yama-gametes noma inzalo ephindaphindwayo
question8: Ukuxhumana okuphelele kuthinta kanjani isilinganiso se-F2 phenotypic esilindelwe sesiphambano se-dihybrid?
answer8: Isilinganiso se-Mendelian esingu-9:3:3:1 esijwayelekile asibonwa
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zingahlali zixhunyiwe?
answer9: Ukuwela kungahlukanisa ama-allele axhunyiwe ngokushintshanisa i-DNA phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo
distractor9a: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ziya kuma-chromosome ahlukene ngesikhathi se-mitosis
distractor9b: Izakhi zofuzo zishintsha indawo ye-chromosome ngokungahleliwe ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa
distractor9c: Iqoqo elizimele lihlukanisa zonke izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe njalo nge-meiosis
question10: Kungani uMendel kungenzeka ukuthi wehlulekile ukubona ukuxhumana kwezakhi zofuzo ekuhlolweni kwakhe kwezitshalo zepizi?
answer10: Izakhi zofuzo azicwaninga kungenzeka ukuthi zazikuma-chromosome ahlukene noma zaziqhelelene kakhulu kuma-chromosome afanayo lapho ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kuvame ukuwahlukanisa khona
distractor10b: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhumene zenzeka ezilwaneni kuphela, hhayi ezitshalweni
distractor10c: UMendel wafunda kuphela amaseli e-haploid, lapho ukuxhumana kungenzeki khona

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho yefa | I-Epistasis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye nofuzo | 12.3 Imithetho yefa | I-Epistasis
chapterContent:
Izifundo zikaMendel ezitshalweni ze-pea zisho ukuthi isamba se-phenotype yomuntu siqu sasilawulwa izakhi zofuzo (noma njengoba azibiza kanjalo, izici zeyunithi), kangangokuthi zonke izici zazilawulwa ngokusobala nangokuphelele yizakhi zofuzo esisodwa. Eqinisweni, izici ezibonakalayo ezilodwa cishe njalo zingaphansi kwethonya lezakhi zofuzo eziningi (ngalinye linezinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu) ezisebenza ndawonye. Isibonelo, okungenani izakhi zofuzo eziyisishiyagalombili zinegalelo embala wamehlo kubantu.

 Kwezinye izimo, izakhi zofuzo eziningana zingaba negalelo ezicini ze-phenotype evamile ngaphandle kokuthi imikhiqizo yazo yezakhi zofuzo ihlanganyele ngqo. Endabeni yokuthuthukiswa kwezitho, isibonelo, izakhi zofuzo zingavezwa ngokulandelana, lapho isakhi sofuzo ngasinye sinezela ebunzimeni nasekuqondeni kwesitho. Izakhi zofuzo zingasebenza ngezindlela ezihambisanayo noma ezihambisanayo, kangangokuthi izakhi zofuzo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu kudingeka zivezwe ngesikhathi esisodwa ukuze zithinte i-phenotype. Izakhi zofuzo zingaphikisana futhi, lapho isakhi sofuzo esisodwa siguqula ukubonakaliswa kwesinye.

 Ku-epistasis, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo kuyaphikisana, kangangokuthi isakhi sofuzo esisodwa sifihla noma siphazamise ukubonakaliswa kwesinye. "I-Epistasis"igama elakhiwe ngezimpande zesiGreki elisho ukuma phezu."Ama-allele afihlwayo noma athuliswa kuthiwa angama-hypostatic kuma-allele e-epistatic enza i-masking. Ngokuvamile isisekelo se-biochemical se-epistasis siyindlela yezakhi zofuzo lapho ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo eyodwa kuncike emsebenzini wezakhi zofuzo ezandulelayo noma ezilandela endleleni.

 Isibonelo se-epistasis ukuguquka kwemibala emagundwini. Umbala wejazi lohlobo lwasendle, i-agouti (AA), ulawula uboya obunombala oqinile (aa). Kodwa-ke, i-gene ehlukile (C) iyadingeka ekukhiqizweni kwemibala. Igundane eline-allele ye-recessive c kule ndawo alikwazi ukukhiqiza umbala futhi liyi-albino kungakhathaliseki ukuthi i-allele ikhona ku-locus A (Isithombe 12.20). Ngakho-ke, izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo i-AAcc, i-Aacc, ne-aacc zonke zikhiqiza i-phenotype efanayo ye-albino. Ukuxutshwa kwama-heterozygote kuzo zombili izakhi zofuzo (i-AaCc x i-AaCc) kuzokhiqiza inzalo enesilinganiso se-phenotypic esingu-9 agouti:3 umbala oqinile: i-albino engu-4 (Isithombe 12.20). Kulesi simo, i-gene ye-C ifana kakhulu ne-gene ye-A.

 I-Epistasis ingenzeka futhi lapho i-allele ebusayo ifihla ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezihlukile. Umbala wezithelo ku-squash yasehlobo uvezwa ngale ndlela. Ukubonakaliswa kwe-homozygous recessive kwe-gene ye-W (ww) kuhlanganiswe nokubonakaliswa kwe-homozygous dominant noma heterozygous kwe-gene ye-Y (YY noma Yy) kuveza izithelo eziphuzi, kanti i-genotype ye-wwyy iveza izithelo eziluhlaza. Kodwa-ke, uma ikhophi ebusayo ye-gene ye-W ikhona ngesimo se-homozygous noma se-heterozygous, i-squash yasehlobo izokhiqiza izithelo ezimhlophe kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yi-Y alleles. Inhlanganisela phakathi kwama-heterozygote amhlophe kuzo zombili izakhi zofuzo (WwYy × WwYy) izokhiqiza inzalo enesilinganiso se-phenotypic esingu-12 omhlophe:3 ophuzi:1 oluhlaza.

 Okokugcina, i-epistasis ingaba ngokufana kangangokuthi noma iyiphi i-gene, uma ikhona ngesimo esiyinhloko (noma esiphindaphindayo), iveza i-phenotype efanayo. Esitshalweni sesikhwama sikamalusi (i-Capsella bursa-pastoris), isici sokuma kwembewu silawulwa izakhi zofuzo ezimbili ebuhlotsheni obuyinhloko be-epistatic. Lapho izakhi zofuzo u-A no-B zombili ziyi-homozygous recessive (aabb), imbewu iba yi-ovoid. Uma i-allele eyinhloko yanoma iyiphi yalezi zakhi zofuzo ikhona, umphumela uba imbewu engunxantathu. Okusho ukuthi, yonke i-genotype engenzeka ngaphandle kwe-aabb iphumela embewini engunxantathu, kanti inhlanganisela phakathi kwama-heterozygote kuzo zombili izakhi zofuzo (AaBb x AaBb) izoveza inzalo enesilinganiso se-phenotypic esingu-15 esingunxantathu:1 ovoid.

 Njengoba usebenza ngezinkinga zezakhi zofuzo, khumbula ukuthi noma yisiphi isici esisodwa esiholela ku-phenotypic ratio ehlanganisa i-16 sijwayelekile ekusebenzisaneni kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili. Khumbula iphethini yefa le-phenotypic ye-dihybrid cross kaMendel, eyacabangela izakhi zofuzo ezimbili ezingasebenzisani—9:3:3:1. Ngokufanayo, singalindela ukuthi ama-gene pair asebenzisanayo nawo abonise izilinganiso ezivezwe njengezingxenye ezingu-16. Qaphela ukuthi sicabanga ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ezisebenzisanayo azixhunyiwe; zisahlukaniswa ngokuzimela zibe ama-gametes.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.4 Amagama Ayisihluthulelo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.4 Amagama Ayisihluthulelo
chapterContent:
i-allele
ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okuvela ngokuguquka futhi okukhona ezindaweni ezifanayo ezihambisanayo kuma-chromosome afanayo

 ama-autosome
noma yimaphi ama-chromosome angewona awesini

 inkolelo-mbono yokuxuba yefa
iphethini yefa elicatshangelwayo lapho izici zabazali zihlanganiswa khona ndawonye enzalweni ukuze kukhiqizwe ukubukeka okungokwenyama okuphakathi

 i-codominance
ekubonakalisweni okuphelele nokuhlangene kwama-allele womabili kwesici esifanayo

 ukuhlukahluka okuqhubekayo
iphethini yefa lapho umlingiswa ebonisa khona uhla lwamanani ezici anezinga elincane kunezikhala ezinkulu phakathi kwazo

 i-dihybrid
umphumela wokuphambana phakathi kwabazali ababili abazalana ngempela abaveza izici ezahlukene zezici ezimbili

 ukuhlukahluka okungaguquki
iphethini yefa lapho izici zihlukile futhi zidluliselwa ngokuzimela komunye nomunye

 dominant
isici esinikeza ukubukeka okufanayo ngokomzimba kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umuntu unamakhophi amabili alesi sici noma ikhophi eyodwa yesici esibusayo kanye nekhophi eyodwa yesici esibusayo

 dominant lethal
iphethini yefa lapho i-allele ibulala khona kokubili ku-homozygote kanye ne-heterozygote; le allele ingadluliselwa kuphela uma i-phenotype ye-lethality yenzeka ngemva kweminyaka yokuzala

 epistasis
ukuxhumana okungqubuzanayo phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo kangangokuthi i-gene eyodwa ifihla noma iphazamisa ukubonakaliswa kwesinye

 F1
isizukulwane sokuqala se-filial esiphambanweni; inzalo yesizukulwane sabazali

 F2
isizukulwane sesibili se-filial esikhiqizwa lapho abantu be-F1 bezihlanganisa noma bevundiswa omunye nomunye

 genotype
ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo okuyisisekelo, okuhlanganisa kokubili ama-allele abonakalayo ngokomzimba nangabonakali, ento ephilayo

 hemizygous
ukuba khona kwe-allele eyodwa kuphela yesici, njengaku-X-linkage; i-hemizygosity yenza izincazelo zokubusa kanye nokubuyela emuva zingabalulekile

 heterozygous
ukuba nama-allele amabili ahlukene esakhini esithile ku-chromosome ye-homologous

 homozygous
ukuba nama-allele amabili afanayo esakhini esithile ku-chromosome ye-homologous

 hybridization
inqubo yokuhlanganisa abantu ababili abangafani ngenhloso yokufeza isici esithile enzalweni yabo

 ukubusa okungaphelele
ku-heterozygote, ukubonakaliswa kwama-allele amabili ahlukene kangangokuthi umuntu ubonisa i-phenotype ephakathi

 umthetho wokubusa
ku-heterozygote, isici esisodwa sizofihla ukuba khona kwesinye isici sesici esifanayo

umthetho wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele
 izakhi zofuzo azithintani maqondana nokuhlunga ama-allele abe ama-gametes; yonke inhlanganisela engenzeka yama-allele kungenzeka ukuthi yenzeke ngokulinganayo

umthetho wokuhlukanisa
 izici zeyunithi ezibhangqiwe (okungukuthi, izakhi zofuzo) zihlukanisa ngokulinganayo kuma-gametes ukuze inzalo ibe nethuba elilinganayo lokuthola noma iyiphi inhlanganisela yezinto

ukuxhumana
 isenzakalo lapho ama-allele atholakala eduze komunye nomunye ku-chromosome efanayo kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi azuzwe ndawonye

uhlelo lwemodeli
 izinhlobo noma uhlelo lwezinto eziphilayo olusetshenziselwa ukutadisha isenzakalo esithile sezinto eziphilayo esizosetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlobo ezahlukene

i-monohybrid
 umphumela wokuxutshwa phakathi kwabazali ababili bokuzalana kweqiniso abaveza izici ezahlukene zesici esisodwa kuphela

P0
isizukulwane sabazali esiphambanweni

 i-phenotype
izici ezibonakalayo ezivezwa yisidalwa

 umthetho womkhiqizo
amathuba emicimbi emibili ezimele eyenzeka ngasikhathi sinye angabalwa ngokuphindaphinda amathuba ngamanye emcimbi ngamunye owenzeka wodwa

 Isikwele sikaPunnett
ukumelwa okubonakalayo kwesiphambano phakathi kwabantu ababili lapho ama-gametes omuntu ngamunye ekhonjiswa phezulu nasohlangothini lwegridi, ngokulandelana, futhi izinhlobo ze-zygotic ezingenzeka zihlanganiswa kabusha ebhokisini ngalinye kugridi

 i-recessive
isici esibonakala sicashile” noma esingavezwa lapho umuntu ephethe isici esivelele saleso sici esifanayo; uma sikhona njengamakhophi amabili afanayo, isici esiphindaphindayo sivezwa

 recessive lethal
iphethini yefa lapho i-allele ibulala kuphela ngesimo se-homozygous; i-heterozygote ingaba evamile noma ibe ne-phenotype eshintshiwe, engeyona ebulalayo

 reciprocal cross
pair cross lapho izici ezifanele zesilisa nezesifazane esiphambanweni esisodwa ziba izici ezifanele zesifazane nezesilisa kwesinye isiphambano

 sex-linked
noma yiliphi ijini ku-chromosome yocansi

 sum rule
amathuba okuba khona okungenani okukodwa kwezehlakalo ezimbili ezihlukene yisamba samathuba azo ngabanye

 test cross
cross phakathi komuntu ovezayo ophethe i-genotype engaziwa kanye nomuntu ophindaphindayo ophindaphindayo ophindaphindayo ophindaphindayo; inzalo ama-phenotype abonisa ukuthi umzali ongaziwa u-heterozygous noma u-homozygous yini ngesici esiyinhloko

 isici
ukuhlukahluka kokubukeka ngokomzimba kwesici esizuzwa njengefa

 I-X-linked
i-gene ikhona ku-X, kodwa hhayi ku-chromosome ye-Y

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.5 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 12. Ukuhlolwa kukaMendels kanye Nofuzo | 12.5 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
12.1 Ukuhlolwa kukaMendel kanye nemithetho yokungenzeka
Esebenza nezitshalo zikabhontshisi ezingadini, uMendel wathola ukuthi ukuxutshwa kwabazali okwahluka ngesici esisodwa kwaveza inzalo ye-F1 eyayiveza zonke izici zomzali oyedwa. Izici ezibonakalayo zibizwa ngokuthi ziphakeme, kanti izici ezingavezwanga zichazwa njengeziphindaphindayo. Lapho inzalo ekuhlolweni kukaMendel izixuba ngokwayo, inzalo ye-F2 yabonisa isici esibusayo noma isici esiphindaphindayo ngesilinganiso esingu-3:1, okuqinisekisa ukuthi isici esiphindaphindayo sasidluliselwe ngokwethembeka kumzali wokuqala we-P0. Ukuxutshwa okuphindaphindiwe kwaveza izilinganiso zenzalo ze-F1 ne-F2 ezifanayo. Ngokuhlola osayizi besampula, uMendel wabonisa ukuthi ukuxutshwa kwakhe kwaziphatha ngokuphindaphindiwe ngokwemithetho yokungenzeka, nokuthi izici zazuzwa njengezehlakalo ezizimele.

 Imithetho emibili yokungenzeka ingasetshenziswa ukuthola izilinganiso ezilindelekile zenzalo yezimpawu ezahlukene ezivela ezixubeni ezahlukene. Ukuze uthole amathuba emicimbi emibili noma ngaphezulu ezimele eyenzeka ndawonye, sebenzisa umthetho womkhiqizo bese uphinda amathuba emicimbi ngayinye. Ukusetshenziswa kwegama elithi “futhi” kusikisela ukusetshenziswa okufanele komthetho womkhiqizo. Ukuze uthole amathuba okuba kwenzeke izenzakalo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ngokuhlanganiswa, sebenzisa umthetho wesamba bese wengeza amathuba azo ngamanye ndawonye. Ukusetshenziswa kwegama elithi “noma” kusikisela ukusetshenziswa okufanele komthetho wesamba.

 12.2 Izici Nezimpawu
Lapho abantu abazala ngokweqiniso noma abantu abane-homozygous abahlukile kusici esithile behlanganiswa, bonke abantwana bazoba ama-heterozygotes aleso sici. Uma izici zizuzwa njengezamandla neziphindaphindayo, abantwana be-F1 bonke bazobonisa uhlobo olufanayo njengomzali we-homozygous kusici esiphindaphindayo. Uma laba bantwana abane-heterozygous beziphindaphindayo, abantwana be-F2 abaphumayo bazoba namathuba afanayo okuzuza ama-gametes aphethe isici esiphindaphindayo noma esiphindaphindayo, okwenza kube nenzalo lapho ingxenye yesine yayo i-homozygous dominant, ingxenye i-heterozygous, kanti ingxenye yesine i-homozygous recessive. Ngenxa yokuthi abantu abane-homozygous dominant kanye ne-heterozygous bafana ngendlela efanayo, izici ezibonwayo enzalweni ye-F2 zizobonisa isilinganiso sezintathu ezibusayo kunesinye esibusayo.

 Ama-allele awahlali eziphethe ngendlela ebusayo neyasemuva. Ukubusa okungaphelele kuchaza izimo lapho i-heterozygote ibonisa khona uhlobo oluphakathi phakathi kwezinhlobo ze-homozygous phenotypes. I-Codominance ichaza ukuvezwa ngasikhathi sinye kwama-allele womabili ku-heterozygote. Nakuba izinto eziphilayo ze-diploid zingaba nama-allele amabili kuphela kunoma yisiphi isizukulwane esinikeziwe, kuvamile ukuthi kube nama-allele angaphezu kwamabili esizukulwane kubantu. Kubantu, njengasezilwaneni eziningi nakwezinye izitshalo, abesifazane banama-chromosome amabili e-X kanti abesilisa bane-chromosome eyodwa ye-X kanye neyodwa ye-Y. Ama-gene akhona ku-X kodwa hhayi ku-chromosome ye-Y kuthiwa axhumene ne-X, kangangokuthi abesilisa bazuza i-allele eyodwa kuphela yesizukulwane, kanti abesifazane bazuza ama-allele amabili. Okokugcina, amanye ama-allele angaba yingozi. Ama-allele abulalayo aphindaphindayo abulala kuphela kuma-homozygote, kodwa ama-allele abulalayo anamandla abulala nama-heterozygote.

 12.3 Imithetho Yefa
UMendel wacabanga ukuthi izakhi zofuzo (izici) zizuzwa njengezakhi zofuzo (izici) eziziphatha ngendlela ebusayo neyaphindaphindayo. Ama-allele ahlukana abe ama-gametes kangangokuthi i-gamete ngayinye inamathuba afanayo okuthola noma iyiphi yama-allele amabili akhona kumuntu one-diploid. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izakhi zofuzo zihlukaniswa zibe ama-gametes ngokuzimela komunye nomunye. Okusho ukuthi, ama-allele ngokuvamile awavamile ukuhlukaniswa abe yi-gamete ene-allele ethile yesinye isakhi sofuzo. Isiphambano se-dihybrid sibonisa ukuhlukahluka okuzimele lapho izakhi zofuzo okukhulunywa ngazo zikuma-chromosome ahlukene noma zikude komunye nomunye ku-chromosome efanayo. Ngeziphambano ezibandakanya izakhi zofuzo ezingaphezu kwamabili, sebenzisa umugqa ogoqekile noma izindlela zamathuba ukubikezela izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo kanye nezinhlobo ze-phenotypes esikhundleni sesikwele sikaPunnett.

 Nakuba ama-chromosome ehlela ngokuzimela abe ama-gametes ngesikhathi se-meiosis, umthetho kaMendel wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele ubhekisela kuma-gene, hhayi ama-chromosome, futhi i-chromosome eyodwa ingathwala ama-gene angaphezu kwe-1,000. Uma ama-gene eseduze kakhulu ne-chromosome efanayo, ama-allele awo avame ukutholwa njengefa ndawonye. Lokhu kuphumela ezilinganisweni zenzalo eziphula umthetho kaMendels wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele. Kodwa-ke, ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kusebenza ukushintshanisa izinto zofuzo kuma-chromosome afanayo ukuze ama-allele kamama nobaba angahlanganiswa kabusha kwi-chromosome efanayo. Yingakho ama-allele ku-chromosome ethile engahlali ezuzwa ndawonye. Ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kuyisenzakalo esingahleliwe esenzeka noma kuphi ku-chromosome. Ngakho-ke, ama-gene ahlukene kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo cishe asazohlukaniswa ngokuzimela ngenxa yezehlakalo zokuhlanganiswa kabusha ezenzeke esikhaleni se-chromosome esiphakathi.

 Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ahlela ngokuzimela noma cha, ama-gene angasebenzisana ezingeni lemikhiqizo yezakhi zofuzo kangangokuthi ukuvezwa kwe-allele yezakhi zofuzo olulodwa kufihla noma kuguqula ukuvezwa kwe-allele yezakhi zofuzo ezahlukene. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-epistasis

question35: Qinisekisa isimangalo sokuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwezici kuholela ekuhlanganisweni okuhlukene ekupheleni kwe-meiosis ngokunikeza incazelo eningiliziwe yezindlela ezihilelekile

Amandla okunambitha i-PTC awekho ngokuphelele futhi alawulwa yi-gene ku-chromosome 7.

Sebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho amaphethini okubusa okungaphelele ukubikezela amathuba okuthi indodana yakhe ithanda amahlumela aseBrussels (ngamanye amazwi, ayikwazi ukunambitha i-PTC)
question39: Isifo i-Tay-Sachs siyisifo esibangelwa yi-autosomal recessive disorder esibangela izinkinga ezinkulu kuma-neuron. Ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo, umbhangqwana utshelwa ukuthi bobabili abalingani baphethe isakhi sofuzo esibangelwa yi-recessive. Hlobo luni lwenzuzo olutholwa yilo mbhangqwana ngokwazi lolu lwazi?
question40: Umbhangqwana unamadodakazi amathathu. Angakanani amathuba okuba ingane elandelayo abazoba nayo ibe yindodakazi?
question41: Umbhangqwana ohlela umndeni unethemba lokuthi ekugcineni uzoba nezingane ezintathu. Angakanani amathuba okuba lo mbhangqwana ube namadodakazi amathathu? Xoxa ngesizathu sakho
answer41: 1/8; lokhu kungenzeka ukuthi ube nendodakazi eyodwa, eboshwe ngamaketanga

question42: Ama-petunia angaba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, obomvu, noma onsomi. Uma imbali eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ihlanganiswe nembali ebomvu, zonke izimbali eziphumayo ziba nsomi. question46: Amakati angaba mnyama, aphuzi, noma abe yi-calico (amabala amnyama naphuzi). Umbala wesikhumba uthwalwa yi-chromosome X. Hlobo luni lwefa oluyi-color coat emakatini?
