chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent: Ngokusho kweHhovisi Lezizwe Ezihlangene Lezidakamizwa Nobugebengu, cishe ama-95% alabo ababulala abantu ngamadoda. Nakuba ukuziphatha kubunjwa yindawo umuntu akhulela kuyo futhi ahlala kuyo, izakhi zofuzo nazo zidlala indima. Isibonelo, ososayensi bathole izakhi zofuzo ezibonakala zandisa ukuthambekela komuntu kokubonisa ukuziphatha okunolaka. Elinye lala ma-gene, elibizwa ngokuthi i-MAOA, litholakala ku-chromosome X. Kolunye ucwaningo lwamuva nje oluhilela iqembu leziboshwa zesilisa eFinland, ososayensi bathole ukuthi iziboshwa ezazuza uhlobo oluthile lwale gene zazinamathuba aphakathi kuka-5% no-10% okwenza ubugebengu obunobudlova. Amadoda anekhophi eyodwa kuphela yezakhi zofuzo, njengoba amadoda ene-chromosome X eyodwa kuphela. Nokho, abesifazane banamakhophi amabili e-chromosome X ngakho-ke amakhophi amabili ezakhi zofuzo. Ngakho-ke, abesifazane abazuza i-allele ehlukile cishe bazoba ne-allele evamile yokulwa nemiphumela yayo. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi amadoda amaningi azuza ikhophi ehlukile ye-MAOA futhi amanye kuphela enza ubugebengu obunobudlova. Indawo ibonakala idlala indima ebaluleke kakhulu. Bheka Umfanekiso 13.1
question1: Kungani uhlobo lwezakhi zofuzo oluxhunywe ku-X olufana ne-MAOA lungaba nomphumela oqinile kwabesilisa kunabesifazane?
answer1: Abesilisa bane-chromosome eyodwa kuphela engu-X, ngakho-ke banekhophi eyodwa kuphela yejini.
distractor1a: Abesilisa bazuza amakhophi amabili e-X-linked gene ngayinye
distractor1b: Abesifazane abazuzi ifa lezakhi zofuzo ezixhunywe ku-X
question2: Kungani owesifazane ozuza i-allele ye-MAOA ehlukile engase athinteke kancane kunowesilisa onohlobo olufanayo?
answer2: Angase futhi athole i-allele evamile ku-chromosome yakhe yesibili ye-X
distractor2c: I-chromosome yakhe engu-Y ivimba i-allele ehlukile
question3: Isibonelo se-MAOA sibonisani ngobudlelwano phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo nokuziphatha?
answer3: Izakhi zofuzo zingathonya ukuziphatha, kodwa indawo ezungezile nayo idlala indima ebalulekile
distractor3c: Izakhi zofuzo eyodwa kuphela elawula konke ukuziphatha okunolaka
question4: Kungani kungalungile ukuphetha ngokuthi bonke abesilisa abane-MAOA bazokwenza ubugebengu obunobudlova?
answer4: Abantu abaningi bazuza lolu hlobo kodwa abenzi ubugebengu obunobudlova ngoba ukuziphatha kuthonywa izici eziningi.
distractor4c: Bonke abesilisa bazuza ama-allele amabili ajwayelekile e-MAOA
question5: Yisiphi isitatimende esiveza kahle indima yendawo ekuhlaselweni?
answer5: Izimo zemvelo zingathonya kakhulu ukuthi ukuthambekela kwezakhi zofuzo kuyavezwa yini
distractor5a: Imvelo ihlala inqoba yonke imiphumela yezakhi zofuzo
distractor5c: Indawo ezungezile ishintsha inani lama-chromosomes X azuzwe njengefa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Ye-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Ye-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
I-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance, eyaphakanyiswa ngokuzimela nguSutton noBoveri ekuqaleni kwawo-1900, ithi ama-chromosome ayizinqola zofuzo. Njengoba sesitholile, amaphethini ofuzo ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunalokho uMendel ayengakucabanga. UMendel wayehlola ukuziphatha kwama-gene. Wayenenhlanhla ekukhetheni izici ezibhalwe ama-gene ezenzeka ukuthi zikuma-chromosome ahlukene noma eziqhelelene kakhulu kuma-chromosome afanayo. Lapho ama-gene exhumene noma eseduze komunye nomunye kuma-chromosome afanayo, amaphethini okuhlukanisa kanye nokuhlanganiswa okuzimele kuyashintsha. Ngo-1913, uSturtevant wasungula indlela yokuhlola imvamisa yokuphindaphinda futhi aphethe izikhundla ezihambisanayo kanye namabanga ama-gene axhumene kuma-chromosome ngokusekelwe enanini elimaphakathi lama-crossovers phakathi kwawo ngesikhathi se-meiosis.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ze-AP® zihlanganisa okuqukethwe kolwazi olubalulekile nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa. Lezi zinhloso zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okusekelwe ekuphenyweni kwelebhu, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izimo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.10 Umfundi uyakwazi ukumela ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-meiosis kanye nokwanda kokwehlukahlukana kwezakhi zofuzo okudingekayo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.3 Isisekelo sefa se-chromosome sinikeza ukuqonda iphethini yokudluliselwa (ukudluliselwa) kwezakhi zofuzo kusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angakha izethulo namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngumuntu kuleso sizinda.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izizinda) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuhlala njalo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.12 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha isethulo esixhumanisa inqubo ye-meiosis nokudluliselwa kwezimpawu kusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yomkhuba Wesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 3.2][I-APLO 3.11][I-APLO 3.14][I-APLO 3.15][I-APLO 3.28][I-APLO 3.26][I-APLO 3.17][I-APLO 4.22]

 Esikhathini eside ngaphambi kokuba ama-chromosome abonwe ngaphansi kwe-microscope, ubaba wezakhi zofuzo zanamuhla, uGregor Mendel, waqala ukufunda ngofuzo ngo-1843. Ngokuthuthuka kwamasu amancane ngasekupheleni kwawo-1800, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zamaseli zazikwazi ukungcolisa nokubona izakhiwo ezingaphansi kwamangqamuzana ngamadayi futhi zibone izenzo zazo ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kanye ne-meiosis. Ngokuhlukaniswa ngakunye kwe-mitotic, ama-chromosome aphindaphindwa, afinyelelwe kusuka ku-amorphous (akukho simo esiqhubekayo) senuzi abe yimizimba ehlukile enobunjwa be-X (amabhangqa ama-chromatids afanayo), futhi athuthele ezigxotsheni zamaseli ezihlukene.
question1: Ithini i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance?
answer1: Ama-chromosome ayizindlela zofuzo
distractor1a: Izakhi zofuzo zizuzwa ngamaprotheni esikhundleni sama-chromosome
distractor1c: Ama-chromosome ocansi kuphela aphethe ulwazi oluzuzwe njengefa
question2: Ubani owaphakamisa ngokuzimela i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance?
question3: Kungani uMendel aqaphela izinhlobo ezahlukene zezici azifundile?
answer3: Amajini ayetholakala kuma-chromosome ahlukene noma aqhelelene kakhulu kwi-chromosome efanayo.
distractor3a: Zonke izakhi zofuzo zazitholakala ku-chromosome efanayo
distractor3c: UMendel wafunda kuphela izici ezihlobene nobulili
question4: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zithinta kanjani amaphethini efa?
answer4: Izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala eduze kwe-chromosome efanayo zivame ukutholwa njengefa ndawonye
distractor4a: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zihlala zihlukaniswa ngokuzimela
distractor4b: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zitholakala kuphela kuma-chromosome ocansi
distractor4c: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe azikwazi ukuhlanganiswa kabusha
question5: Yini eyakhiwa yiSturtevant ngo-1913?
answer5: Indlela yokulinganisa imvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha nokubeka imephu yezindawo ezihlobene zezakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe kuma-chromosome
question6: Yiluphi ulwazi olungasetshenziswa ukuqagela imvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha?
answer6: Izikhundla ezihambisanayo kanye nebanga lezakhi zofuzo ku-chromosome
distractor6c: Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi i-gene iyabusa noma iyadlula
question7: Iyiphi intuthuko yezobuchwepheshe esize ososayensi ukuxhumanisa ama-chromosome nefa?
answer7: Amasu amancane athuthukisiwe avumela ama-chromosome ukuthi afakwe umbala futhi abonwe ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
question8: Ngesikhathi se-mitosis, ama-chromosome ahlangana abe yisiphi isakhiwo esibonakalayo?
answer8: Imizimba efana no-X equkethe ama-chromatids amabili afanayo
distractor8c: Ama-chromatid amane afanayo ahlanganiswe ndawonye njenge-tetrad

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal kanye Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Yefa
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal kanye Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Yefa
chapterContent:
Ukuqagela ukuthi ama-chromosome angase abe yisihluthulelo sokuqonda ufuzo kwaholela ososayensi abaningana ukuba bahlole izincwadi zikaMendel futhi bahlole kabusha imodeli yakhe ngokwendlela ama-chromosome aziphatha ngayo ngesikhathi se-mitosis kanye ne-meiosis. Ngo-1902, uTheodor Boveri waphawula ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa okufanele kwama-sea urchins okuzalwa akwenzeki ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona ama-chromosome. Ngawo lowo nyaka, uWalter Sutton waqaphela ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosome kumaseli endodakazi ngesikhathi se-meiosis (Isithombe 13.2). Ndawonye, lokhu kuhlola kwaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance, eyakhomba ama-chromosome njengezinto zofuzo ezibangela ifa likaMendelian.

 I-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance yayihambisana nemithetho kaMendel futhi yasekelwa yizinto ezilandelayo:

 Ngesikhathi se-meiosis, ama-chromosome pair homologous ahamba njengezakhiwo ezihlukene ezizimele kwezinye izinhlangothi ze-chromosome.
Ukuhlungwa kwama-chromosome kusuka kumbhangqwana ngamunye homologous kuya kuma-pre-gametes kubonakala kungahleliwe.
Umzali ngamunye wenza ama-gametes aqukethe ingxenye kuphela ye-chromosomal complement yawo.
Ngisho noma ama-gametes abesilisa nabesifazane (isidoda neqanda) ehlukene ngobukhulu kanye nesimo, anenani elifanayo lama-chromosome, okuphakamisa iminikelo yofuzo elinganayo evela kumzali ngamunye.
Ama-chromosome e-gametic ahlangana ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa ukuze akhiqize inzalo enenombolo efanayo yama-chromosome nabazali bayo.
Naphezu kokuntuleka kobufakazi obuqondile bokuthi ama-chromosome anezici, ukuhlobana okunamandla phakathi kokuziphatha kwama-chromosome ngesikhathi se-meiosis kanye nemithetho engaqondakali kaMendels kwaholela ososayensi ukuba baphakamise i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance. Abagxeki baveze ukuthi abantu babenezici ezihlukanisa ngokuzimela kakhulu kunalezo ababenazo ama-chromosome. Kwakungemva kweminyaka eminingana yokwenza iziphambano nempukane yezithelo, i-Drosophila melanogaster, lapho uThomas Hunt Morgan anikeze khona ubufakazi bokuhlola ukusekela i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance
question1: Yikuphi okubonwe ososayensi ababili okwaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance?
answer1: UTheodor Boveri noWalter Sutton
question2: Yini uTheodor Boveri ayitholile ngesikhathi efunda ngama-sea urchin?
answer2: Ukuthuthukiswa okufanele kombungu akwenzeki ngaphandle kokuba kukhona ama-chromosomes
distractor2a: Ama-sea urchin athola izici ngokuzimela ngaphandle kwama-chromosome
question3: Yini uWalter Sutton ayibonile ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer3: Ama-chromosome ahlukana abe amaseli endodakazi ngesikhathi se-meiosis
distractor3a: Ama-chromosome ayanyamalala ngaphambi kokuba i-meiosis iqale
question4: Yikuphi ukuqaphela okusekela umthetho kaMendels wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele?
answer4: Ama-chromosome pair homologous ahamba ngokuzimela kwamanye ama-chromosome pair ngesikhathi se-meiosis
distractor4a: Wonke ama-chromosome ahamba ndawonye njengeyunithi eyodwa
distractor4b: Ama-chromosome ocansi kuphela ahlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis
question5: Ama-chromosome ahlelwa kanjani abe ama-gametes ngesikhathi se-meiosis ngokusho kwe-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance?
answer5: Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-chromosomes kusuka kubhangqa ngalinye elifana nawo kube ama-gametes kubonakala kungahleliwe
question6: Kungani ama-gametes equkethe ingxenye kuphela yenani lama-chromosome atholakala emangqamuzaneni omzimba?
answer6: I-Meiosis ikhiqiza ama-gametes anengxenye ye-complement ye-chromosome yomzali
question7: Yikuphi ukuphawulwa okusikisela ukuthi bobabili abazali baneqhaza elilinganayo ekwakheni izakhi zofuzo zezingane?
answer7: Ama-gamete esilisa nabesifazane anenani elifanayo lama-chromosome naphezu kokungafani ngobukhulu nokubukeka
distractor7a: Amaseli eqanda aqukethe ama-chromosome aphindwe kabili kunesidoda
question8: Kwenzekani ngenombolo ye-chromosome ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa?
answer8: Ama-chromosome e-gametic ahlangana ukubuyisela inani lama-chromosome labazali
distractor8b: Inombolo ye-chromosome iphindwe kabili ngomzali ngamunye ngokuzimela
question9: Kungani i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance yaqala ukungatshazwa ososayensi abathile?
answer9: Abantu babonakala benezici ezizuzwe ngokuzimela kakhulu kunalabo ababenama-chromosome
distractor9b: Ososayensi babekholelwa ukuthi ama-chromosome akhona ezitshalweni kuphela
question10: Ubani onikeze ubufakazi bokuhlola obusekela i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance ngokufunda ngezimpukane zezithelo?
answer10: UThomas Hunt Morgan

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo kanye Namabanga
chapterContent: Umsebenzi kaMendel uphakamise ukuthi izici zizuzwa ngokuzimela komunye nomunye. UMorgan ukhombe ukuxhumana okungu-1:1 phakathi kwesici esihlukanisayo kanye ne-chromosome X, okuphakamisa ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa okungahleliwe kwama-chromosome kwakuyisisekelo esibonakalayo semodeli kaMendel. Lokhu kubonise nokuthi izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ziphazamisa imiphumela ebikezelwe kaMendel. Iqiniso lokuthi i-chromosome ngayinye ingathwala izakhi zofuzo eziningi ezixhunyiwe lichaza ukuthi abantu bangaba kanjani nezici eziningi kakhulu kunalezo abanazo ama-chromosome. Kodwa-ke, okubonwe ngabacwaningi elabhorethri kaMorgan kusikisele ukuthi ama-allele abekwe ku-chromosome efanayo awazange azuzwe njengefa ndawonye. Ngesikhathi se-meiosis, izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ngandlela thile zahlukaniswa.
question1: Yini eyasikiselwa umsebenzi kaMendels mayelana nofuzo lwezimpawu?
answer1: Izici zizuzwa njengefa ngokuzimela komunye nomunye
distractor1a: Izici eziku-chromosome efanayo zihlala zizuzwa ndawonye
distractor1b: Izici ezihlobene nobulili kuphela ezizuzwa njengefa ngokuzimela
question2: Yini uThomas Hunt Morgan ayithola esekela i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance?
answer2: Ukuxhumana okungu-1:1 phakathi kwesici esihlukanisayo kanye ne-chromosome engu-X
distractor2a: Ukuthi zonke izakhi zofuzo zitholakala kuma-autosome
question3: Okutholakele kukaMorgan kwasikisela ukuthi kwakuyini isisekelo esingokoqobo semodeli kaMendels?
answer3: Ukuhlukaniswa okungahleliwe kwama-chromosome
question4: Yimuphi umphumela izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ezinawo kumaphethini efa abikezelwe nguMendels?
answer4: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ziyaphazamisa imiphumela ebikezelwe nguMendels
distractor4a: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zihlala ziqinisa imithetho kaMendels
distractor4b: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe azinawo umthelela ekuzuzeni ifa
distractor4c: Izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zithinta kuphela ama-chromosome ocansi
question5: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zingaba nezici eziningi ezizuzwe njengefa kunezinama-chromosome?
answer5: I-chromosome ngayinye ingathwala izakhi zofuzo eziningi ezixhunyiwe
distractor5a: I-chromosome ngayinye iqukethe i-gene eyodwa kuphela
question6: Yikuphi ukuqaphela okwenziwe abacwaningi elabhorethri likaMorgans okwaphonsela inselelo umqondo wokuxhumana okuphelele?
answer6: Ama-allele aku-chromosome efanayo awazange azuzwe njengefa ndawonye njalo
distractor6a: Ama-allele kuma-chromosome ahlukene ayehlala ezuzwa ndawonye
distractor6b: Izakhi zofuzo azizange zihlukane ngesikhathi se-meiosis
question7: Kukuyiphi inqubo yamaseli lapho izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe zabonwa ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi azixhumani?
answer7: I-Meiosis

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo kanye Namabanga | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezakhi zofuzo Okufanayo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo kanye Namabanga | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezakhi zofuzo Okufanayo
chapterContent:
Ngo-1909, uFrans Janssen wabona i-chiasmata—indawo lapho ama-chromatid exhumana khona futhi angase ashintshane ngezigaba—ngaphambi kokuhlukaniswa kokuqala kwe-meiosis. Wasikisela ukuthi ama-allele abe angaxhumani futhi ama-chromosome ashintshane ngezigaba ngokomzimba. Njengoba ama-chromosome ehlangana futhi ebhangqwa nama-homologs awo, abonakala exhumana ngamaphuzu ahlukene. UJanssen wasikisela ukuthi la maphuzu ahambisana nezindawo lapho izingxenye zama-chromosome zashintshana khona. Manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi ukuhlangana kanye nokusebenzisana phakathi kwama-chromosome angama-homologous, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-synapsis, kwenza okungaphezu nje kokuhlela ama-homologs ukuze athuthele kumaseli endodakazi ahlukene. Lapho ehlanganiswa, ama-chromosome angama-homologous ashintshana ngemizimba elandelanayo ezingalweni zawo enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-homologous recombination, noma kalula, ewela.”

 Ukuze uqonde kangcono uhlobo lwemiphumela yokuhlola abacwaningi ababeyithola ngalesi sikhathi, cabanga ngomuntu oyedwa ofana no-heterozygous owathola ama-allele omama amakhulu ezizakhi zofuzo ezimbili ku-chromosome efanayo (njenge-AB) kanye nama-allele amabili ahlobene nobaba kulawo ma-gene afanayo (njenge-ab). Uma ama-gene exhunyiwe, umuntu angalindela ukuthi lo muntu akhiqize ama-gametes angu-AB noma u-ab anesilinganiso esingu-1:1. Uma ama-gene engaxhunywanga, umuntu kufanele akhiqize ama-gametes e-AB, Ab, aB, kanye ne-ab anama-frequency alinganayo, ngokusho komqondo we-Mendelian wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele. Ngenxa yokuthi ahambisana nokuhlanganiswa okusha kwe-allele, ama-genotypes u-Ab no-aB ayizinhlobo ezingezona ezabazali ezivela ekuhlanganisweni okufanayo ngesikhathi se-meiosis. Izinhlobo zabazali ziyinzalo ekhombisa inhlanganisela efanayo ye-allelic nabazali bazo. Nokho, uMorgan nozakwabo bathole ukuthi lapho abantu abanjalo abangafani nobaba behlolwa bedluliselwa kumzali ofana no-homozygous (AaBb × aabb), kwenzeka amacala womzali nowangaphandle komzali. Isibonelo, inzalo engu-950 ingase itholakale eyayiyi-AaBb noma i-aabb, kodwa inzalo engu-50 nayo yayizotholakala eyayiyi-Aabb noma i-aaBb. Le miphumela iphakamise ukuthi ukuxhumana kwenzeka kaningi, kodwa inzalo encane kakhulu yayiyimikhiqizo yokuhlanganiswa kabusha.
question1: Yiziphi izakhiwo uFrans Janssen azibona ngo-1909 ezamholela ekuphakamiseni ukushintshaniswa kwengxenye yama-chromosome?
answer1: I-Chiasmata
question2: Yini uJanssen ayiphakamisayo ukuthi yenzeke e-chiasmata?
answer2: Ama-chromosome ashintshana izingxenye ngokomzimba, okwenza ama-allele ahlukane
question3: Kubizwa ngokuthini ukuhlanganiswa kwama-chromosome e-homologous ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer3: I-Synapsis
question4: Iyiphi inqubo eyenzeka phakathi kwama-chromosomes e-homologous ngesikhathi se-synapsis?
answer4: Ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwe-Homologous (ukuwela ngaphesheya)
question5: Iyiphi enye igama le-homologous recombination?
answer5: Ukuwela
question6: Uma izakhi zofuzo ezimbili zixhumene ngokuphelele, yimaphi ama-gametes alindeleke kumuntu one-genotype AB/ab?
answer6: I-AB ne-ab ngesilinganiso esingu-1:1
distractor6a: AB, Ab, aB, kanye no-ab ngamaza alinganayo
question7: Uma izakhi zofuzo ezimbili zihluka ngokuzimela, yimaphi ama-gametes alindeleke kumuntu one-genotype AB/ab?
answer7: I-AB, i-Ab, i-aB, kanye ne-ab enemvamisa efanayo
question8: Yiziphi izinhlobo ze-gamete ezibhekwa njengezingabalulekile kumuntu one-genotype AB/ab?
answer8: U-Ab no-aB
question9: Izinhlobo zabazali zichazwa kanjani?
answer9: Zinezinhlanganisela ze-allele ezifanayo nezabazali bazo
question10: Yini uMorgan nozakwabo abayibonile ekuhlolweni okuhilela izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe?
answer10: Iningi lenzalo laliyizinhlobo zabazali, kodwa inani elincane laliyizinhlobo eziphindaphindayo (ezingezona ezabazali)
distractor10b: Zonke inzalo zilandele isilinganiso esiphelele esingu-9:3:3:1
question11: Kubonisani ukuba khona kwenzalo ephinde yahlanganiswa?
answer11: Ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwe-homologous kwenzeka ngesikhathi se-meiosis

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Ngefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo kanye Namabanga | Izimpawu Zezakhi zofuzo Zomdlavuza
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Ngefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo kanye Namabanga | Izimpawu Zezakhi zofuzo Zomdlavuza
chapterContent: Ososayensi basebenzise ukuxhumanisa izakhi zofuzo ukuthola indawo ku-genome yomuntu yezakhi zofuzo eziningi ezibangela izifo. Bathola izakhi zofuzo zesifo ngokulandela ifa lezimpawu ezizukulwaneni zemindeni nokudala amamephu okuxhumanisa alinganisa ukuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwamaqembu ezimpawu zezakhi zofuzo.” Izakhi zofuzo ezimbili ze-BRCA, izinguquko ezingaholela kumdlavuza webele nowesibeletho, zazingezinye zezakhi zofuzo zokuqala ezitholakale ngokuhlela izakhi zofuzo. Abesifazane abanomlando womndeni walezi zakhi zofuzo manje sebengahlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi elilodwa noma womabili lawa ma-gene anezinguquko. Uma kunjalo, bangakhetha ukuhlinzwa ngokususwa amabele nama-ovari abo. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba abo okuthola umdlavuza kamuva ekuphileni. Umlingisi u-Angelia Jolie waletha lokhu emphakathini lapho ekhetha ukuhlinzwa ngo-2014 futhi ngo-2015 ngemuva kokuba odokotela bethole ukuthi wayenezakhi zofuzo ze-BRCA1 eziguquliwe.
question1: Ososayensi basebenzise kanjani ukuxhumanisa izakhi zofuzo ukuze bathole izakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo kubantu?
answer1: Ngokulandelela ifa ngemindeni nokwakha amamephu okuxhumana asekelwe ekuhlanganisweni kabusha phakathi kwezimpawu zofuzo
distractor1a: Ngokubala inani eliphelele lama-chromosome kubantu abathintekile
distractor1c: Ngokulinganisa amazinga amaprotheni esikhundleni sezimpawu ze-DNA
question2: Amamephu okuxhumanisa alinganisani?
answer2: Ukuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwamaqembu ezimpawu zofuzo
question3: Yiziphi izakhi zofuzo ze-BRCA ezihlotshaniswa nazo uma ziguquliwe?
answer3: Ingozi eyengeziwe yomdlavuza webele kanye nowesibeletho
question4: Kungani abantu abanomlando oqinile womndeni womdlavuza webele noma wesibeletho bengase bahlolwe izakhi zofuzo ze-BRCA?
answer4: Ukunquma ukuthi banesifo sofuzo esandisa ingozi yabo yomdlavuza
distractor4c: Ukuthola ukuthi ngabe baxhumanise izakhi zofuzo nombala wamehlo
question5: Yisiphi inketho yokuvimbela engacatshangelwa ngabantu abanezinguquko ze-BRCA eziyingozi?
answer5: Ukususwa kwamabele nama-ovari ngokuhlinzwa ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yomdlavuza esikhathini esizayo
question6: Kungani izimpawu zofuzo ziwusizo ekutholeni izakhi zofuzo zesifo?
answer6: Zingalandelelwa ngezizukulwane futhi zixhunyaniswe nofuzo olubangela izifo.
question7: Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo esichaza kahle kakhulu isifo sokukhulelwa kwabantu?
answer7: Izakhi zofuzo ezibangela isimo sengqondo zise-chromosome efanayo nezakhi zofuzo ezibangela izici ezithile zobuso
distractor7a: Ikhodi eyodwa yezakhi zofuzo kokubili isimo sengqondo kanye nezici ezithile zobuso, njengosayizi womhlathi
distractor7b: Izakhi zofuzo ezibangela isimo sengqondo esimnene zivezwa kuphela lapho izakhi zofuzo ezibhala ubuso obuhle zikhona futhi
distractor7c: Imikhiqizo yezakhi zofuzo ebhala isimo sengqondo isebenzisana nemikhiqizo yezakhi zofuzo ebhala izici zobuso

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo kanye Namabanga | Amamephu Ezakhi zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.1 Ithiyori Yama-Chromosomal Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezakhi zofuzo kanye Namabanga | Amamephu Ezakhi zofuzo
chapterContent:
UJanssen wayengenabo ubuchwepheshe bokukhombisa ukuwela ngaphesheya ngakho kwahlala kungumqondo ongaqondakali owawungamukelwa kabanzi. Ososayensi babecabanga ukuthi i-chiasmata yayiwuhlobo lwe-synapsis futhi babengenakukuqonda ukuthi ama-chromosome angaphuka kanjani futhi aphinde ahlangane. Noma kunjalo, idatha yayicacile ukuthi ukuxhumanisa kwakungenzeki njalo. Ekugcineni, kwathatha umfundi osemusha we-undergraduate kanye nomuntu owayehlala ubusuku bonke "ukuchaza ngokwezibalo inkinga yokuxhumanisa kanye nokuhlangana kabusha.

 Ngo-1913, u-Alfred Sturtevant, umfundi elabhorethri kaMorgan, waqoqa imiphumela evela kubacwaningi elabhorethri, futhi wayithatha wayiyisa ekhaya ngobusuku obubodwa ukuze ayicabangele. Ngakusasa ekuseni, wayesedale imephu yokuqala ye-chromosome,"ukumelwa okuqondile kokuhlelwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nebanga elihlobene ku-chromosome (Isithombe 13.4).

 Njengoba kuboniswe ku-Isithombe 13.4, ngokusebenzisa imvamisa yokuhlangana kabusha ukubikezela ibanga lezakhi zofuzo, ukuhleleka okuhlobene kwezakhi zofuzo ku-chromosome 2 kungacatshangwa. Amanani abonisiwe amele amabanga emephu kuma-centimorgans (cM), ahambisana nama-recombination frequency (ngamaphesenti). Ngakho-ke, izakhi zofuzo zombala womzimba kanye nosayizi wephiko zazihlukene ngo-65.5 − 48.5 = 17 cmM, okubonisa ukuthi ama-allele kamama nobaba balezi zakhi zofuzo ahlangana kabusha kumaphesenti angu-17 enzalo, ngokwesilinganiso.

 Ukuze akhe imephu ye-chromosome, uSturtevant wacabanga ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zihlelwe ngokulandelana kuma-chromosome afana nentambo. Wacabanga nokuthi ukwenzeka kokuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwama-chromosome amabili afanayo kungenzeka ngokufana noma kuphi ngobude be-chromosome. Esebenza ngaphansi kwalokhu kucabanga, uSturtevant wacabanga ukuthi ama-allele ayeqhelelene kakhulu kwi-chromosome ayenamathuba amaningi okuhlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis ngoba nje kwakukhona indawo enkulu lapho ukuhlangana kabusha kwakungenzeka khona. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-allele ayesondelene kakhulu kwi-chromosome cishe ayezozuzwa ndawonye. Inani elimaphakathi lama-crossover phakathi kwama-allele amabili—okungukuthi, imvamisa yawo yokuphinda-phinda—lihambisana nebanga lawo lezakhi zofuzo ukusuka komunye nomunye, uma kuqhathaniswa nezindawo zezinye izakhi zofuzo kuleyo chromosome. Uma ucabangela isibonelo esiphakathi kwe-AaBb ne-aabb ngenhla, imvamisa yokuphinda-phinda ingabalwa njengo-50/1000 = 0.05. Okusho ukuthi, amathuba okudlula phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo i-A/a ne-B/b kwakungu-0.05, noma amaphesenti ama-5. Umphumela onjalo ungabonisa ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zazixhumene ngokuqinisekile, kodwa zaziqhelelene kakhulu ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi kwenzeke ama-crossover. USturtevant wahlukanisa imephu yakhe yezakhi zofuzo ngamayunithi emephu, noma ama-centimorgans (cM), lapho imvamisa yokuphinda-phinda engu-0.01 ihambelana ne-1 cM.

 Ngokumelela ama-allele kumephu eqondile, uSturtevant wasikisela ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zingasukela ekuxhumekeni ngokuphelele (imvamisa yokuhlanganisa kabusha = 0) kuya ekuxhumekeni ngokuphelele (imvamisa yokuhlanganisa kabusha = 0.5) lapho izakhi zofuzo zikuma-chromosome ahlukene noma izakhi zofuzo zihlukaniswe kude kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo. Izakhi zofuzo ezingaxhumekile ngokuphelele zihambisana nemvamisa eyabikezelwa nguMendel ukuze zihlukane ngokuzimela esiphambanweni se-dihybrid. Imvamisa yokuhlanganisa kabusha engu-0.5 ikhombisa ukuthi amaphesenti angu-50 enzalo angama-recombinant kanti amanye amaphesenti angu-50 ayizinhlobo zabazali. Okusho ukuthi, zonke izinhlobo zokuhlanganiswa kwe-allele zimelelwa ngemvamisa efanayo. Lokhu kumelela kwavumela uSturtevant ukubala ngokungeziwe amabanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo eziningana ku-chromosome efanayo. Kodwa-ke, njengoba amabanga ezakhi zofuzo esondela ku-0.50, izibikezelo zakhe zaba zincane ngoba kwakungacaci ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zaziqhelelene kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo noma kuma-chromosome ahlukene.

 Ngo-1931, uBarbara McClintock noHarriet Creighton babonisa ukuhlangana kwama-chromosome afanayo ezitshalweni zommbila. Ngemva kwamasonto, ukuhlangana kabusha kwe-homologous ku-Drosophila kwaboniswa nge-microscope nguCurt Stern. UStern wabona izinhlobo eziningana ze-X-linked phenotypes ezazihlotshaniswa ne-pair ye-chromosome X engavamile ngokwesakhiwo futhi engafani lapho i-X eyodwa yayingenaso ingxenye encane yokugcina, kanti enye i-X yahlanganiswa nengxenye ye-chromosome Y. Ngokuhlanganisa izimpukane, ukubuka inzalo yazo, bese ubona ngeso lengqondo ama-chromosome enzalo, uStern wabonisa ukuthi njalo lapho inhlanganisela ye-allele yenzalo iphambuka kunoma yikuphi ukuhlanganiswa kwabazali, kwakukhona ukushintshana okuhambisanayo kwengxenye ye-chromosome Y. Ukusebenzisa izimpukane eziguquliwe ezinama-chromosome X ahlukile ngokwesakhiwo kwakuyisihluthulelo sokubuka imikhiqizo yokuhlangana kabusha ngoba ukulandelana kwe-DNA namanye amathuluzi e-molecule kwakungatholakali. Manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi ama-chromosome e-homologous ashintshana njalo izingxenye ku-meiosis ngokuphula nokujoyina kabusha i-DNA yawo ezindaweni eziqondile.
question1: Kungani umqondo kaJanssens wokuwela ngaphesheya ungazange wamukelwe kabanzi ekuqaleni?
answer1: Wayengenabo ubuchwepheshe bokukhombisa ukuwela ngaphesheya ngqo, ngakho-ke kwahlala kungumqondo ongaqondakali
distractor1a: Ukuwela ngaphesheya kwase kuvele kungaqinisekiswanga ngokuhlola
distractor1b: Ososayensi babekholelwa ukuthi ama-chromosome awaqukethe izakhi zofuzo
question2: Ubani owadala imephu yokuqala ye-chromosome ngo-1913?
question3: Iyini imephu ye-chromosome?
answer3: Ukumelwa okuqondile kokuhlelwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye namabanga ahlobene eduze kwe-chromosome
distractor3b: Umdwebo obonisa inombolo ye-chromosome ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene
question4: USturtevant walinganisa kanjani ibanga lezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Ngokusebenzisa imvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe
question5: Iyini i-centimorgan (cM)?
answer5: Iyunithi yemephu ehambisana nemvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha engu-1%
question6: Yisiphi isiphetho uSturtevant asenza mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo lapho akha amamephu e-chromosome?
answer6: Ukuwela kungenzeka cishe noma kuphi eduze kwe-chromosome
distractor6b: Ukuwela kwenzeka kuphela phakathi kwama-chromosome ahlukene
distractor6c: Ukuwelana akuzange kwenzeke phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe
question7: Kungani izakhi zofuzo eziqhelelene kakhulu kwi-chromosome zinamathuba amaningi okuhlangana kabusha?
answer7: Ngoba kunendawo enkulu lapho ukuwela khona kungenzeka khona
question8: Ibalwa kanjani imvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha?
answer8: Ngokuhlukanisa inani lenzalo ephinde yahlanganiswa ngenani eliphelele lenzalo
distractor8a: Ngokuhlukanisa inzalo yabazali ngenzalo ephinde yahlanganiswa
distractor8b: Ngokususa inzalo yabazali enzuzweni ephinde yahlanganiswa
question9: I-cross ikhiqiza inzalo engu-50 ephinde yahlanganiswa ezizukulwaneni eziyi-1000. Iyini imvamisa yokuphinda yahlanganiswa?
answer9: 0.05 (5%), okuhambisana no-5 cM
question10: Kusho ukuthini ukuphindaphindwa kwe-0?
answer10: Izakhi zofuzo zixhumene ngokuphelele futhi zihlala zizuzwa ndawonye
question11: Kusho ukuthini ukuphindaphindwa kwe-recombination okungu-0.5?
answer11: Izakhi zofuzo ziziphatha sengathi azixhumene, zikhiqiza inani elilinganayo lenzalo ephinde yahlanganiswa kanye nenzalo yabazali.
question12: Kungani amamephu e-chromosome eba mancane njengoba ibanga lezakhi zofuzo lisondela ku-50 cmM?
answer12: Ngoba kuba nzima ukuhlukanisa izakhi zofuzo eziqhelelene kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo nezakhi zofuzo ezitholakala kuma-chromosome ahlukene.
question13: Ubani owaqala ukubonisa ukuphambuka kwe-chromosome efanayo ngokuhlola ezitshalweni zommbila?

question15: Yibuphi ubufakazi obubalulekile uCurt Stern abubonile obuqinisekisa ukuthi bawela ngaphesheya?
answer15: Inzalo enezinhlobo ze-recombinant phenotypes ihlala ineziguquguquko ezifanayo zezingxenye ze-chromosome X

answer16: Bavumela ukushintshana kwama-chromosome ukuthi kubonwe ngqo ngaphansi kwe-microscope
question17: Manje sekuqondakala kanjani ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwe-homologous kwenzeka kanjani?
answer17: Ama-chromosome ahambisanayo ahlukana futhi aphinde ahlangane ne-DNA ezindaweni eziqondile ngesikhathi se-meiosis

question18: Bheka uMfanekiso 13.4. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esiyiqiniso?
answer18: Ukuhlanganiswa kombala womzimba kanye nama-allele obude be-aristae kuzokwenzeka kaningi kunokuhlanganiswa kwama-allele abomvu/onsundu kanye nama-allele obude be-aristae.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosomal Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosomal Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Inombolo, usayizi, ukuma, kanye namaphethini okubamba ama-chromosome kuwenza abonakale kalula ku-karyogram futhi kuvumela ukuhlolwa kokuphazamiseka okuningi kwe-chromosome. Nakuba umjikelezo weseli, i-mitosis, kanye ne-meiosis kulawulwa kakhulu ukuvimbela amaphutha, izinqubo aziphelele. Isibonelo esisodwa ukwehluleka kwama-chromosome afanayo noma ama-chromatids angodadewabo ukuhlukanisa kahle ngesikhathi se-meiosis I noma i-meiosis II (into ebizwa ngokuthi i-nondisjunction). Lokhu kuphumela kuma-gametes anama-chromosome amaningi kakhulu noma ambalwa kakhulu. Ukuphazamiseka kwenombolo ye-chromosome (i-aneuploidy) kuvame ukubulala umbungu, yize izinhlobo ezimbalwa ze-trisomic genotypes zisebenza (isb., i-Down syndrome). Ngenxa yokungasebenzi kwe-X, ukuguquguquka kuma-chromosome ocansi ngokuvamile kunemiphumela ye-phenotypic emnene (isb., i-Turner syndrome) kune-aneuploidy. Ngezinye izikhathi izingxenye ze-chromosome ziyaphindwa, zisuswe, noma zihlelwe kabusha ngokuguqulwa noma ukudluliselwa. Lokhu kuguquguquka kungabangela imiphumela ye-phenotypic eyinkinga. Ukuhlolwa kokuxilonga kungathola eziningi zalezi zinkinga ze-chromosome kubantu ngaphambi kokuzalwa, okuholela ezinkingeni zezokwelapha, zokuziphatha, kanye nezomphakathi, njengelungelo lobumfihlo.

 Isimo lapho into ephilayo inenani elingaphezu kwelejwayelekile lamasethi e-chromosome (amabili ezinhlobo ze-diploid) sibizwa ngokuthi i-polyploidy. I-Polyploidy ebangela izinombolo ezingavamile zama-chromosome ayivamile ngoba iholela ezintweni eziphilayo ezingenalutho. Isethi eyodwa yama-chromosome ayinazo izinhlangothi ezimbili ngakho-ke i-meiosis ayikwazi ukuqhubeka ngendlela evamile. Ngokuphambene nalokho, i-polyploidy ebangela izinombolo ze-chromosome ezifanayo ivame kakhulu embusweni wezitshalo. Izitshalo ze-Polyploid zivame ukuba zikhulu futhi ziqine kakhulu kunabantu abanenani elijwayelekile lama-chromosome.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Ze-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis kanye nokukhulelwa.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.9 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha incazelo, esebenzisa izethulo ezibonakalayo noma izindaba, mayelana nendlela i-DNA kuma-chromosome edluliselwa ngayo esizukulwaneni esilandelayo nge-mitosis, noma i-meiosis elandelwa ukukhulelwa.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.3 Isisekelo sefa se-chromosome sinikeza ukuqonda iphethini yokudluliselwa (ukudluliselwa) kwezakhi zofuzo kusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
3.1 Umfundi angabuza imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.13 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubuza imibuzo mayelana nezinkinga zokuziphatha, zenhlalo noma zezokwelapha ezizungeze izifo zofuzo zomuntu.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.C
Ukucutshungulwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo akuphelele futhi kungumthombo wokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo.
Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.3 Izinguquko kuhlobo lwezakhi zofuzo zingabangela izinguquko ku-phenotype.
Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izizinda) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.24 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela ukuthi ushintsho ku-genotype, uma luvezwa njenge-phenotype, lunikeza kanjani ukwehluka okungaba ngaphansi kokukhethwa kwemvelo.

 Izinkinga ezizuzwe njengefa zingavela lapho ama-chromosome eziphatha ngendlela engavamile ngesikhathi se-meiosis. Izinkinga ze-chromosome zingahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezimbili: ukungalingani kwenombolo ye-chromosome kanye nokuhlelwa kabusha kwesakhiwo se-chromosome. Ngoba ngisho nezingxenye ezincane zama-chromosome zingahlanganisa izakhi zofuzo eziningi, ukuphazamiseka kwe-chromosome kuyinto ephawulekayo futhi ngokuvamile kuyabulala

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosome Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | Ukuhlonza Ama-Chromosome
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosome Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | Ukuhlonza Ama-Chromosome
chapterContent:
Ukuhlukaniswa kanye nokubuka ama-chromosome nge-microscopic kwakha isisekelo se-cytogenetics futhi kuyindlela eyinhloko odokotela abathola ngayo ukukhubazeka kwe-chromosome kubantu. I-karyotype iyinombolo kanye nokubonakala kwama-chromosome, futhi ifaka ubude bawo, iphethini yokubhanqa, kanye nendawo ye-centromere. Ukuze bathole umbono we-karyotype yomuntu, ososayensi be-cytologists bathatha izithombe zama-chromosome bese besika futhi banamathisele i-chromosome ngayinye eshadini, noma i-karyogram, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-ideogram (Isithombe 13.5).

 Ohlotsheni oluthile, ama-chromosome angabonakala ngenombolo yawo, usayizi, indawo ye-centromere, kanye nephethini yokubhanqa. Ku-karyotype yomuntu, ama-autosome noma ama-chromosome omzimba” (wonke ama-chromosome angewona abesilisa nabesifazane) ngokuvamile ahlelwe ngokulandelana kobukhulu kusukela kokukhulu (i-chromosome 1) kuya kokuncane kakhulu (i-chromosome 22). (Ama-chromosomes ka-X no-Y, i-pair yama-23, awawona ama-autosome.) Kodwa-ke, i-chromosome 21 empeleni imfushane kune-chromosome 22. Lokhu kwatholakala ngemuva kokuqanjwa kwe-Down syndrome njenge-trisomy 21, okubonisa ukuthi lesi sifo sibangelwa kanjani ukuba ne-chromosome eyodwa eyengeziwe engu-21 (ezintathu sezizonke). Bengafuni ukushintsha igama lalesi sifo, ososayensi bagcina uhlelo lokuqala lokubhala izinombolo. Izingalo ze-chromosome” ezivela kunoma iyiphi ingxenye ye-centromere zingabizwa ngokuthi zimfushane noma zinde, kuye ngobude bazo obuhlobene. Ingalo emfushane ifushanisiwe ngokuthi p (ye-petite”), kanti ingalo ende ifushanisiwe ngokuthi q (ngoba ilandela u-p” ngokwe-alfabhethi). Ingalo ngayinye ihlukaniswe futhi iboniswe ngenombolo. Isibonelo, i-locus 3 engalweni emfushane ye-chromosome 21 iboniswe ngokuthi 21p3. Kusetshenziswa lolu hlelo lokuqamba amagama, izindawo kuma-chromosome zingachazwa ngokuqhubekayo ezincwadini zesayensi

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Izazi Zezakhi zofuzo Zisebenzisa i-Karyo amagremu Ukuhlonza Ukuphazamiseka Kwe-Chromosome
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Izazi Zezakhi zofuzo Zisebenzisa i-Karyo amagremu Ukuhlonza Ukuphazamiseka Kwe-Chromosome
chapterContent:
Nakuba uMendel ebizwa ngokuthi uyise wezakhi zofuzo zanamuhla,” wenza izivivinyo zakhe ngaphandle kwamathuluzi asetshenziswa njalo yizazi zofuzo zanamuhla. Enye indlela enamandla kangaka ye-cytological yi-karyotyping, indlela lapho izici ezibonakala ngokungahambi kahle kwe-chromosome zingabonakala khona kusuka kuseli elilodwa. Ukuze kubonwe i-karyotype yomuntu, amangqamuzana omuntu (njengamaseli amhlophe egazi) aqoqwa kuqala kusuka kusampula yegazi noma kwezinye izicubu. Elabhorethri, amangqamuzana ahlukanisiwe ayakhuthazwa ukuba aqale ukuhlukana ngenkuthalo. Ikhemikhali ebizwa ngokuthi i-colchicine ibe isisetshenziswa kumaseli ukubopha ama-chromosome ahlanganisiwe ku-metaphase. Amangqamuzana abe esenziwa ukuba avuvuke kusetshenziswa isisombululo se-hypotonic ukuze ama-chromosome asakazeke. Ekugcineni, isampula igcinwa ku-fixative bese ifakwa ku-slide.

 Isazi sofuzo sibe sesifaka ama-chromosome ngenye yamadayi amaningana ukuze sibone kangcono amaphethini okubopha ahlukile futhi aphindaphindwayo e-pair ngayinye ye-chromosome. Ngemva kokufaka amadayi, ama-chromosome abukwa kusetshenziswa i-bright-field microscopy. Ukukhetha okuvamile kwamadayi yi-Giemsa stain. Ukufaka amadayi e-Giemsa kuphumela cishe ku- Amabhendi angu-400–800 (e-DNA ehlanganiswe ngokuqinile namaprotheni ahlanganisiwe) ahlelwe kuzo zonke izibhangqa ze-chromosome ezingu-23; isazi sezakhi zofuzo esinolwazi singabona ibhendi ngayinye. Ngaphezu kwamaphethini okubamba, ama-chromosome aphinde akhonjwe ngesisekelo sobukhulu nendawo ye-centromere. Ukuze athole umfanekiso ojwayelekile we-karyotype lapho izibhangqa ze-chromosome ezifanayo ziqondaniswa ngokulandelana kwezinombolo kusukela kwezinde kakhulu kuya kwezifushane kakhulu, isazi sezakhi zofuzo sithola isithombe sedijithali, sihlonza i-chromosome ngayinye, bese sihlela ama-chromosome ngesandla kule phethini (Isithombe 13.5).

 Ngokuyisisekelo, i-karyogram ingaveza ukukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo lapho umuntu enama-chromosome amaningi kakhulu noma ambalwa kakhulu ngeseli ngalinye. Izibonelo zalokhu yi-Down Syndrome, ehlonzwa yikhophi yesithathu ye-chromosome 21, kanye ne-Turner Syndrome, ebonakala ngokuba khona kwe-chromosome eyodwa kuphela ye-X kwabesifazane esikhundleni sezimbili ezijwayelekile. Izazi zezakhi zofuzo zingabona nokususwa okukhulu noma ukufakwa kwe-DNA. Isibonelo, i-Jacobsen Syndrome—ehilela izici zobuso ezihlukile kanye nokukhubazeka kwenhliziyo nokopha—ibonakala ngokususwa kwe-chromosome 11. Okokugcina, i-karyotype ingakhomba ukudluliselwa, okwenzeka lapho ingxenye yezinto zofuzo iphuka kusuka ku-chromosome eyodwa bese inamathela kwenye i-chromosome noma engxenyeni ehlukile ye-chromosome efanayo.

 Ngesikhathi sokuphila kukaMendel, ifa laliwumqondo ongaqondakali owawungatholakala kuphela ngokwenza iziphambano nokubuka izici ezivezwa yinzalo. Ngokubuka i-karyogram, izazi zofuzo zanamuhla zingabona ngeso lengqondo ukwakheka kwe-chromosome yomuntu ukuqinisekisa noma ukubikezela ukukhubazeka kofuzo ezinganeni, ngisho nangaphambi kokuzalwa.
question1: Kuyini i-karyotyping?
answer1: Indlela ye-cytological esetshenziselwa ukuhlonza ukukhubazeka kwe-chromosome ngokuhlola ama-chromosomes ngamanye
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zamaseli ezivame ukuqoqwa ukuze kwenziwe i-karyotyping?
answer2: Amaseli amhlophe egazi noma amanye amaseli ezicubu ahlukanisayo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Izinkinga Ezinombolweni Ze-Chromosome
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Izinkinga Ezinombolweni Ze-Chromosome
chapterContent:
Kuzo zonke izifo ze-chromosome, ukungalingani kwenombolo ye-chromosome yikona okubonakala kakhulu kwi-karyogram. Ukuphazamiseka kwenombolo ye-chromosome kufaka phakathi ukuphindaphindeka noma ukulahlekelwa yi-chromosome yonke, kanye nezinguquko enanini lamasethi aphelele ama-chromosome. Kubangelwa ukungahlangani, okwenzeka lapho ama-chromosome amabili afanayo noma ama-chromatids angodadewabo ehluleka ukuhlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis. I-synapsis engalingani kahle noma engaphelele, noma ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-spindle apparatus okusiza ukufuduka kwe-chromosome, kungabangela ukungahlangani. Ingozi yokungahlangani iyanda ngokweminyaka yabazali.

 Ukungahlangani kungenzeka ngesikhathi se-meiosis I noma II, ngemiphumela ehlukene (Isithombe 13.6). Uma ama-chromosome afanayo ehluleka ukuhlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis I, umphumela uba ama-gametes amabili angenayo leyo chromosome ethile nama-gametes amabili anamakhophi amabili e-chromosome. Uma ama-chromatids angodadewabo ehluleka ukuhlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis II, umphumela uba yi-gamete eyodwa engenawo lowo chromosome, ama-gametes amabili ajwayelekile anekhophi eyodwa ye-chromosome, kanye ne-gamete eyodwa enamakhophi amabili e-chromosome.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosomal Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | I-Aneuploidy
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosomal Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | I-Aneuploidy
chapterContent: Umuntu onenani elifanele lama-chromosome ohlobo lwakhe ubizwa ngokuthi i-euploid; kubantu, i-euploidy ihambisana nama-autosome angu-22 kanye ne-pair eyodwa yama-chromosome ocansi. Umuntu onephutha enombolweni yama-chromosome uchazwa njenge-aneuploid, igama elihlanganisa i-monosomy (ukulahlekelwa yi-chromosome eyodwa) noma i-trisomy (ukuzuza kwe-chromosome yangaphandle). Ama-zygote abantu angama-monosomic angenayo ikhophi eyodwa ye-autosome ahlala ehluleka ukukhula aze azalwe ngoba awanazo izakhi zofuzo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kugcizelela ukubaluleka komthamo wezakhi zofuzo "kubantu. Ama-trisomie amaningi e-autosomal nawo ayahluleka ukukhula kuze kube yilapho ezalwa; nokho, ukuphindaphindwa kwamanye ama-chromosome amancane (13, 15, 18, 21, noma 22) kungabangela inzalo ephila amasonto amaningana kuya eminyakeni eminingi. Abantu abane-trisomic bahlushwa uhlobo oluhlukile lokungalingani kwezakhi zofuzo: ukweqisa komthamo wezakhi zofuzo. Abantu abane-chromosome eyengeziwe bangase bakhiqize inqwaba yemikhiqizo yezakhi zofuzo efakwe yileyo chromosome. Lo mthamo owengeziwe (amaphesenti angu-150) wezakhi zofuzo ezithile ungaholela ezinseleleni eziningi zokusebenza futhi uvame ukuvimbela intuthuko. I-trisomy evame kakhulu phakathi kokuzalwa okusebenzayo yile ye-chromosome 21, ehambisana ne-Down Syndrome. Abantu abanalesi sifo esizuzwe njengefa babonakala ngobude obufushane kanye nezinombolo ezimfushane, ukuhlukaniswa kobuso okuhlanganisa ugebhezi olubanzi nolimi olukhulu, kanye nokubambezeleka okukhulu kwentuthuko. Ukwanda kwe-Down syndrome kuhlobene nobudala bomama; abesifazane asebekhulile banamathuba amaningi okukhulelwa ngezingane ezithwele i-genotype ye-trisomy 21 (Isithombe 13.7)

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosomal Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | I-Polyploidy
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosomal Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | I-Polyploidy
chapterContent: Umuntu onenani elingaphezu kwelenele lamasethi e-chromosome (amabili ezinhlobo ze-diploid) ubizwa ngokuthi i-polyploid. Isibonelo, ukukhulelwa kweqanda le-diploid elingavamile ngesidoda esivamile se-haploid kungaveza i-triploid zygote. Izilwane ze-polyploid azivamile kakhulu, kunezibonelo ezimbalwa kuphela phakathi kwezibungu ezisicaba, ama-crustacean, ama-amphibians, izinhlanzi, kanye nezibankwa. Izilwane ze-polyploid azinazo izinzalo ngoba i-meiosis ayikwazi ukuqhubeka ngendlela evamile futhi kunalokho ikhiqiza ikakhulukazi amangqamuzana endodakazi ye-aneuploid angakwazi ukukhiqiza ama-zygote asebenzayo. Akuvamile, izilwane ze-polyploid zingazala ngaphandle kocansi nge-haplodiploidy, lapho iqanda elingavundisiwe lihlukana khona nge-mitotic ukuze likhiqize inzalo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, i-polyploidy ivame kakhulu embusweni wezitshalo, futhi izitshalo ze-polyploid zivame ukuba zikhulu futhi ziqine kakhulu kune-euploid yezinhlobo zazo (Isithombe 13.8)

distractor2c: Ngokufaka isidoda ezimbili ze-haploid ngeqanda elilodwa le-haploid

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Ngefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Ukungaxhunyaniswa Kwe-Chromosome Yobulili Kubantu
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Ngefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Ukungaxhunyaniswa Kwe-Chromosome Yobulili Kubantu
chapterContent:
Abantu babonisa imiphumela emibi kakhulu ngama-trisomies e-autosomal kanye nama-monosomies. Ngakho-ke, kungase kubonakale kungqubuzana ukuthi abesifazane nabesilisa kubantu bangasebenza ngendlela evamile, naphezu kokuthwala izinombolo ezahlukene ze-chromosome X. Esikhundleni sokwanda noma ukulahlekelwa ama-autosome, ukwehluka kwenani lama-chromosome ocansi kuhlotshaniswa nemiphumela emnene. Ngokwengxenye, lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yenqubo yama-molecule ebizwa ngokuthi i-X inactivation. Ekuqaleni kokukhula, lapho imibungu yesifazane yezilwane ezincelisayo yakhiwa amaseli ayizinkulungwane ezimbalwa nje (uma kuqhathaniswa nama-trillions kumntwana osanda kuzalwa), i-chromosome eyodwa ye-X kuseli ngalinye iyayeka ukusebenza ngokujiya ngokuqinile esakhiweni esithule (esingalali) esibizwa ngokuthi umzimba we-Barr. Ithuba lokuthi i-chromosome ye-X (ethathwe ngumama noma ngubaba) ingasebenzi kuseli ngalinye liyiphutha, kodwa uma i-inactivation ivele, wonke amaseli atholakala kulelo azoba ne-chromosome ye-X efanayo noma umzimba we-Barr. Ngale nqubo, abesifazane bakhokhela umthamo wabo wofuzo ophindwe kabili we-chromosome ye-X. Kumakati okuthiwa ama-tortoiseshell”, ukungasebenzi kwe-embryonic X kubonakala njengokwehlukahluka kombala (Isithombe 13.9). Abesifazane abango-heterozygous ku-gene yombala we-coat exhunywe ku-X bazoveza omunye wemibala emibili ehlukene ye-coat ezindaweni ezahlukene zomzimba wabo, okuhambisana nanoma iyiphi i-chromosome ye-X engasebenzi ku-embryonic cell progenitor yaleso sifunda.

 Umuntu ophethe inani elingavamile lama-chromosome e-X uzovimba wonke ngaphandle kwe-chromosome eyodwa ye-X kuseli ngalinye lakhe. Kodwa-ke, ngisho nama-chromosome e-X angasebenzi ayaqhubeka nokuveza izakhi zofuzo ezimbalwa, futhi ama-chromosome e-X kumele avuseleleke ukuze kukhule kahle ama-ovari abesifazane. Ngenxa yalokho, ukukhubazeka kwe-chromosome ye-X kuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nokukhubazeka okuncane kwengqondo nokomzimba, kanye nokungabi nanzalo. Uma i-chromosome ye-X ingekho nhlobo, umuntu ngeke akhule esibelethweni.

 Amaphutha amaningana enombolweni ye-chromosome yobulili achazwe. Abantu abanama-chromosome amathathu e-X, abizwa ngokuthi i-triplo-X, bangabesifazane ngokwe-phenotypically kodwa baveza ukubambezeleka kokukhula kanye nokuncipha kokuzala. I-XXY uhlobo lwe-genotype, oluhambisana nohlobo olulodwa lwe-Klinefelter syndrome, luhambisana nabantu besilisa abaphila ngendlela ye-phenotypic abanama-testes amancane, amabele amakhulu, kanye nezinwele zomzimba ezinciphile. Kunezinhlobo eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ze-Klinefelter syndrome lapho umuntu eba nama-chromosomes angu-X amahlanu. Kuzo zonke izinhlobo, yonke i-chromosome ye-X ngaphandle kweyodwa ivinjelwa ukusebenza ukuze kulungiswe umthamo owengeziwe wezakhi zofuzo. Lokhu kungabonakala njengemizimba eminingana ye-Barr ku-nucleus ngayinye yeseli. I-Turner syndrome, echazwa njenge-genotype ye-X0 (okungukuthi, i-chromosome eyodwa yobulili kuphela), ihambisana nomuntu wesifazane ophila ngendlela ye-phenotypic onesimo esifushane, isikhumba esinolwembu esifundeni sentamo, ukukhubazeka kokuzwa kanye nenhliziyo, kanye nokungabi nanzalo.

answer1: Ngoba ukungasebenzi kwe-X kunciphisa ama-chromosome e-X engeziwe, kunciphisa imiphumela yomthamo wezakhi zofuzo.

answer6: Bazuza i-chromosome X engasebenzi efanayo neseli lokuqala

distractor6b: Zivuselela womabili ama-chromosomes e-X ngemva kwe-mitosis
question7: Kungani amakati egobolondo le-tortoise eveza amabala anemibala ehlukene yoboya?
answer7: Ukungasebenzi kwe-X okungahleliwe kubangela ukuthi ama-allele ahlukene ombala wejazi elixhunywe ku-X azwakale ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli
distractor7b: Izakhi zofuzo zabo zombala woboya zitholakala kuma-autosome
distractor7c: Izinwele ngayinye zishintsha umbala ngokungahleliwe ngesikhathi sokukhula
question8: Kubantu abane-chromosome X eyengeziwe, zingaki i-chromosome X ezisasebenza kuseli ngayinye?
answer8: Eyodwa kuphela
question9: Kungani ukukhubazeka kwe-chromosome ye-X kusengaveza izimpawu naphezu kokungasebenzi kwe-X?
answer9: Amanye ama-gene ahlala esebenza kuma-chromosome e-X angasebenzi, kanti ama-chromosome e-X kumele aphinde asebenze ngesikhathi sokukhula kwama-ovari.
distractor9a: Izidumbu ze-Barr azisebenzi nhlobo futhi azinawo umphumela
distractor9c: Izakhi zofuzo ze-chromosome Y kuphela ezinquma i-phenotype
question10: Iyini i-phenotype evamile yabantu abane-triplo-X syndrome?
answer10: Ngokuvamile abesifazane abanokulibaziseka kokukhula kanye nokuzala okunciphile
distractor10b: Ngokuvamile abesifazane abangakwazi ukuzala ngokuphelele futhi ababambezeleki ekukhuleni
question11: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-genotype oluhlotshaniswa ne-Klinefelter syndrome?
question12: Yiziphi izici ezihlotshaniswa ne-Klinefelter syndrome?
answer12: Ngokwejwayelekile, abesilisa abanama-testes amancane, amabele amakhulu, kanye nezinwele zomzimba ezinciphile
distractor12b: Ngokwemvelo, abesilisa abanokuzala okuvamile futhi abangenazo izinguquko zomzimba
question13: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-genotype olubangela i-Turner syndrome?
question14: Yiziphi izici ezivame ukuhlotshaniswa ne-Turner syndrome?
answer14: Ubude obufushane, intamo enezintambo, ukukhubazeka kokuzwa kanye nenhliziyo, kanye nokungazali
distractor14a: Ubude obude, amasende amakhulu, kanye nezinwele eziningi emzimbeni
question15: Kwenzekani uma umbungu ungenayo i-chromosome X ngokuphelele?
answer15: Akukhuli esibelethweni

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosome Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | Ukuphindaphindwa Nokususwa
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Se-Chromosome Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa | Ukuphindaphindwa Nokususwa
chapterContent: Ngaphezu kokulahlekelwa noma ukutholakala kwe-chromosome yonke, ingxenye ye-chromosome ingaphindaphindwa noma ilahleke. Ukuphindaphinda nokususwa kuvame ukukhiqiza inzalo esindayo kodwa ekhombisa ukukhubazeka ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo. Izingxenye ze-chromosome eziphindaphindwe zingase zihlangane nama-chromosome akhona noma zingase zikhululeke ku-nucleus. I-Cri-du-chat (evela kwelesiFulentshi elisho ukukhala kwekati”) iyisifo esihlotshaniswa nokukhubazeka kwesistimu yezinzwa kanye nezici zomzimba ezibonakalayo ezibangelwa ukususwa kwengxenye enkulu ye-5p (ingalo encane ye-chromosome 5) (Isithombe 13.10). Izinsana ezinalolu hlobo lwe-genotype zikhipha ukukhala okukhulu okuphawulekayo okusekelwe kukho igama lesifo.
question1: Ngaphandle kokuthola noma ukulahlekelwa yi-chromosome yonke, yiziphi ezinye izinguquko ze-chromosome ezingaba khona?
answer1: Ingxenye ye-chromosome ingaphindaphindwa noma isuswe
question2: Yimiphi imiphumela evamile yokuphindaphinda nokususwa kwama-chromosome?
answer2: Ngokuvamile ziveza inzalo esindayo kodwa ekhombisa ukukhubazeka ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo
distractor2a: Zihlala ziphumela ekufeni kwengane esanda kuzalwa
question3: Yini engenzeka engxenyeni ye-chromosome ephindaphindiwe?
answer3: Ingahlangana ne-chromosome ekhona noma ihlale ikhululekile ku-nucleus
question4: I-Cri-du-chat syndrome ibangelwa yiluphi uhlobo lokukhubazeka kwe-chromosome?
answer4: Ukususwa kwengxenye enkulu yengalo emfushane (5p) ye-chromosome 5
question5: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi Cri-du-chat?
answer5: Ukukhala kwekati.
question6: Yisiphi isimiso somzimba esithinteka kakhulu yi-Cri-du-chat syndrome?
answer6: Uhlelo lwezinzwa
question7: Yisiphi isici esihlukile esivame ukubonwa ezinganeni ezine-Cri-du-chat syndrome?
answer7: Ukukhala okuphezulu okuphawulekayo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Ukuhlelwa Kabusha Kwesakhiwo Se-Chromosome | Ukuguqulwa Kwe-Chromosome
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Ukuhlelwa Kabusha Kwesakhiwo Se-Chromosome | Ukuguqulwa Kwe-Chromosome
chapterContent:
Izazi ze-cytologists zichaze ukuhlelwa kabusha kwesakhiwo okuningi kuma-chromosome, kodwa ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome kanye nokudluliselwa kwawo yikona okuvame kakhulu. Kokubili kutholakala ngesikhathi se-meiosis ngokuhlanganiswa okuguqukayo kwama-chromosome ahlelwe kabusha nama-homologs awo angaphambili ukuze kulondolozwe ukulungelelana okufanele kwezakhi zofuzo. Uma izakhi zofuzo eziqhutshwa kuma-homologs amabili zingaqondiswanga kahle, umcimbi wokuphinda kuhlanganiswe ungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezivela kwi-chromosome eyodwa kanye nokuzuza kwezakhi zofuzo kolunye. Lokhu kungakhiqiza ama-gametes e-aneuploid.

 Ukuguqulwa kwama-Chromosome
Ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome kuwukuhlukaniswa, ukujikeleza okungu-180°, kanye nokufakwa kabusha kwengxenye ye-chromosome. Ukuguqulwa kungenzeka emvelweni ngenxa yokugunda kwemishini, noma ngenxa yesenzo sezinto eziguquguqukayo (ukulandelana okukhethekile kwe-DNA okukwazi ukwenza lula ukuhlelwa kabusha kwezingxenye ze-chromosome ngosizo lwama-enzyme asika futhi anamathisele ukulandelana kwe-DNA). Ngaphandle kokuthi kuphazamise ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuguqulwa kushintsha kuphela ukuqondiswa kwezakhi zofuzo futhi kungenzeka kube nemiphumela emnene kakhulu kunamaphutha e-aneuploid. Kodwa-ke, ukushintsha kokwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kungabangela izinguquko zokusebenza ngoba abalawuli bokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo bangasuswa endaweni yabo maqondana nezinhloso zabo, okubangela amazinga angajwayelekile emikhiqizo yezakhi zofuzo.

 Ukuguqulwa kungaba yi-pericentric futhi kufake i-centromere, noma i-paracentric futhi kwenzeke ngaphandle kwe-centromere (Isithombe 13.11). Ukuguqulwa kwe-pericentric okungalingani mayelana ne-centromere kungashintsha ubude obuhlobene bezingalo ze-chromosome, okwenza lokhu kuguqulwa kubonakale kalula.

 Lapho i-chromosome eyodwa efana nayo idlula ekuguqulweni kodwa enye ingenzeki, umuntu uchazwa njenge-heterozygote yokuguqulwa. Ukuze kugcinwe i-synapsis yephoyinti ngesikhathi se-meiosis, i-homolog eyodwa kumele yakhe i-loop, kanti enye i-homolog kumele ibumbe nxazonke. Nakuba le topology ingaqinisekisa ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zihambisana kahle, iphoqa futhi ama-homologs ukuthi anwebeke futhi angahlotshaniswa nezindawo ze-synapsis engacacile (Isithombe 13.12)
question1: Yikuphi ukuhlelwa kabusha kwesakhiwo se-chromosome okuvame kakhulu?
answer1: Ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome kanye nokudluliselwa kwamanye ama-chromosome
question2: Kungani ama-chromosome ahlelwe kabusha ehlangana ngendlela evumelana nezimo nama-homologs awo ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer2: Ukugcina ukuhambisana kahle kwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Yini engenzeka uma izakhi zofuzo ezifanayo zingavumelani kahle ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa kabusha?
answer3: Izakhi zofuzo zingalahleka kusuka ku-chromosome eyodwa bese zitholwa ngenye, okukhiqiza ama-gametes aneuploid
question4: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome?
answer4: Ukuhlukaniswa, ukujikeleza okungu-180°, kanye nokufakwa kabusha kwengxenye ye-chromosome
distractor4b: Ukushintshana kwe-DNA phakathi kwama-chromosome angewona awekho
question5: Yini engabangela ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome ngokwemvelo?
answer5: Ukucheba ngomshini noma isenzo sezinto eziguqulwayo
question6: Ziyini izinto eziguqulwayo?
answer6: Ukulandelana kwe-DNA okungasiza ekuhleleni kabusha kwe-chromosome kusetshenziswa ama-enzyme asika futhi anamathisele i-DNA
question7: Uma ukuguqulwa kwe-chromosome kungaphazamisi ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo, uyini umphumela wako oyinhloko?
answer7: Kushintsha indlela izakhi zofuzo eziqondiswa ngayo
question8: Kungani ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome kungashintsha i-phenotype noma ngabe izakhi zofuzo aziphazamiseki?
answer8: Abalawuli bezakhi zofuzo bangasuswa uma kuqhathaniswa nezakhi zofuzo zabo eziqondiwe, okushintsha ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question9: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwe-pericentric?
answer9: Ukuguqulwa okuhlanganisa i-centromere
question10: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwe-paracentric?
answer10: Ukuguqulwa okwenzeka ngaphandle kwe-centromere
question11: Kungani kulula ukubona ama-pericentric inversions angalingani?
question12: Kuyini i-heterozygote yokuguqulwa?
answer12: Umuntu lapho i-chromosome eyodwa efana nayo ithwala ukuguqulwa kanti enye ayinakho
question13: I-synapsis efanele igcinwa kanjani ku-heterozygote ye-inversion ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer13: I-homolog eyodwa yakha iluphu kanti enye ihambisana nayo
question14: Iyiphi imiphumela engaba nayo i-inversion loop ngesikhathi se-meiosis?
answer14: Kungadala izindawo ze-synapsis engacacile ngenxa yokwelulwa kwama-chromosome

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Ukuhlelwa Kabusha Kwesakhiwo Se-Chromosome | Ukuguqulwa Kwe-Chromosome 18
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Kwefa | 13.2 Isisekelo Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Ngefa Nge-Chromosome | Ukuhlelwa Kabusha Kwesakhiwo Se-Chromosome | Ukuguqulwa Kwe-Chromosome 18
chapterContent:
Akuzona zonke izinhlobo zokuhlela kabusha kwama-chromosome ezikhiqiza abantu abangaphili, abakhubazekile, noma abangenanzalo. Ezimweni ezingavamile, ushintsho olunjalo lungabangela ukuvela kohlobo olusha. Eqinisweni, ukuvela kwe-pericentric ku-chromosome 18 kubonakala sengathi kube negalelo ekuveleni kwabantu. Lokhu kuguquka akukho ezihlotsheni zethu eziseduze kakhulu zezakhi zofuzo, ama-chimpanzee. Abantu nama-chimpanzee bahluka ngokwe-cytogenetically ngokuvela kwe-pericentric kuma-chromosome amaningana kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwama-chromosome amabili ahlukene kuma-chimpanzee ahambisana ne-chromosome yesibili kubantu.

 Ukuvela kwe-pericentric chromosome 18 kukholakala ukuthi kwenzeka kubantu bokuqala ngemuva kokuhlukana kwabo nokhokho ofanayo nama-chimpanzee cishe eminyakeni eyizigidi ezinhlanu edlule. Abacwaningi abachaza lokhu kuguquka basikisele ukuthi cishe izisekelo ze-nucleotide eziyi-19,000 zaphindaphindwa ngo-18p, futhi indawo ephindaphindiwe yaguqulwa futhi yafakwa kabusha ku-chromosome 18 yomuntu wasendulo.

 Ukuqhathaniswa kwezakhi zofuzo zomuntu neze-chimpanzee esifundeni salokhu kuguqulwa kubonisa ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ezimbili—i-ROCK1 ne-USP14—eziseduze kwe-chromosome ye-chimpanzee 17 (ehambisana ne-chromosome yomuntu 18) zibekwe kude kakhulu kwi-chromosome yomuntu 18. Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi enye yezindawo zokuguqulwa zenzeka phakathi kwalezi zakhi zofuzo ezimbili. Ngokuthakazelisayo, abantu nama-chimpanzee baveza i-USP14 emazingeni ahlukene ezinhlotsheni ezithile zamaseli, kufaka phakathi amaseli e-cortical kanye nama-fibroblast. Mhlawumbe ukuguqulwa kwe-chromosome 18 kumuntu wasendulo kwabeka kabusha izakhi zofuzo ezithile futhi kwasetha kabusha amazinga azo okuvezwa ngendlela ewusizo. Ngenxa yokuthi zombili i-ROCK1 ne-USP14 zibhala ama-enzyme eseli, ushintsho ekubonakalisweni kwazo lungashintsha ukusebenza kweseli. Akwaziwa ukuthi lokhu kuguqulwa kwaba negalelo kanjani ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo kwe-hominid, kodwa kubonakala kuyisici esibalulekile ekuhlukeni kwabantu kwezinye izilwane.
question1: Ingabe ukuhlelwa kabusha kwesakhiwo se-chromosome kungaba nemiphumela emihle yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Yebo, ezimweni ezingavamile zingaba negalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlobo ezintsha
question2: Yikuphi ukuhlelwa kabusha kwama-chromosome okukholelwa ukuthi kube negalelo ekuziphendukeleni komuntu?
question3: Ingabe i-chromosome 18 pericentric inversion iyatholakala kuma-chimpanzee?
answer3: Cha, ayikho ezinkawu
question4: Ngaphandle kokuguqulwa kwe-chromosome 18, yimuphi omunye umehluko omkhulu we-chromosome okhona phakathi kwabantu nama-chimpanzee?
answer4: I-chromosome yomuntu 2 eyakhiwe ngokuhlanganiswa kwama-chromosome amabili ahlukene e-chimpanzee
distractor4a: Abantu bane-autosome eyodwa encane ngenxa yokususwa
question5: Cishe nini lapho kukholelwa ukuthi ukuguqulwa kwe-chromosome 18 kwenzeke khona?
answer5: Ngemva kokuba abantu behlukene nokhokho oyedwa onezinkawu eminyakeni engaba yizigidi ezinhlanu edlule
distractor5c: Ngaphambi kokuba abantu nezimfene babenokhokho ofanayo
question6: Cishe zingaki izisekelo ze-nucleotide ezaphindaphindwa ngesikhathi somcimbi wokuguqulwa kwe-chromosome 18?
answer6: Izisekelo ze-nucleotide ezingaba ngu-19,000
question7: Kwenzekani engxenyeni ye-DNA ephindaphindiwe ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa kwe-chromosome 18?
answer7: Yaphinde yaphindwa, yaguqulwa, yaphinde yafakwa ku-chromosome 18
question8: Yiziphi izakhi zofuzo ezimbili ezahlukaniswa yi-chromosome 18 inversion?
answer8: I-ROCK1 kanye ne-USP14
question9: Uma kuqhathaniswa nezimfene, i-ROCK1 ne-USP14 zibekwe kanjani kubantu?
answer9: Zitholakala kude kakhulu ku-chromosome 18
question10: Kukuziphi izinhlobo zamaseli lapho abantu nama-chimpanzee bebonisa amazinga ahlukene okubonakaliswa kwe-USP14?
answer10: Amaseli e-cortical nama-fibroblast
question11: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi ukuguqulwa kwe-chromosome 18 kwathonya ukuvela kwemvelo?
answer11: Ngokushintsha izakhi zofuzo nokushintsha amazinga azo okuvezwa
question12: Yini efakwa yizakhi zofuzo ze-ROCK1 kanye ne-USP14?
question13: Baqiniseka kangakanani ososayensi ngendima eqondile yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yokuguqulwa kwe-chromosome 18?
answer13: Indima yayo eqondile ayaziwa, kodwa kubonakala sengathi yayibalulekile ekwehlukeni kwabantu kwezinye izilwane zasendle.
distractor13a: Indima yayo ifakazelwe ukuthi ayihlobene nokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor13b: Kuyaziwa ukuthi kubangele ulimi lwabantu lwanamuhla
distractor13c: Kuye kwabonakala ukuthi akunamthelela ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo
question14: Ngokusho kwendima, yisiphi isenzakalo okukholelwa ukuthi senzeke ngemva kokuba abantu behlukene nokhokho wabo ofanayo nama-chimpanzee?
answer14: Cishe izisekelo ze-nucleotide ezingu-19,000 zaphindaphindwa, zaguqulwa, zafakwa kabusha ku-chromosome yomuntu 18
distractor14a: Ukuguqulwa kwe-Paracentric kwenzeke kuma-chromosome amaningana, kufaka phakathi i-chromosome 18
distractor14b: Ama-chromosome amabili aqale aguqulwa abe yi-pericentric inversion abese ehlanganiswa ukuze akhe i-chromosome yomuntu 2
distractor14c: Izakhi zofuzo ze-ROCK1 kanye ne-USP14 ziphindwe kabili, okwandisa ukubonakaliswa kwazo

chapterContent:
Izazi ze-cytologists zichaze ukuhlelwa kabusha kwesakhiwo okuningi kuma-chromosome, kodwa ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome kanye nokudluliselwa kwawo yikona okuvame kakhulu. Zombili zitholakala ngesikhathi se-meiosis ngokuhlanganiswa okuguqukayo kwama-chromosome ahlelwe kabusha nama-homologue awo angaphambili ukuze kulondolozwe ukulingana okufanele kwezakhi zofuzo. Uma izakhi zofuzo eziqhutshwa kuma-homologue amabili zingaqondiswanga kahle, umcimbi wokuphinda kuhlanganiswe ungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezivela kwi-chromosome eyodwa kanye nokuzuza kwezakhi zofuzo kolunye. Lokhu kungakhiqiza ama-gametes aneuploid.

 Ukudluliselwa kwenzeka lapho ingxenye ye-chromosome ihlukana futhi inamathela ku-chromosome ehlukile, engekho homologous. Ukudluliselwa kungaba yingozi noma kube nemiphumela emibi kuye ngokuthi izikhundla zezakhi zofuzo zishintshwa kanjani maqondana nokulandelana kokulawula. Ukudluliselwa okuphindaphindiwe kuvela ekushintsheni kwezingxenye ze-chromosome phakathi kwama-chromosome amabili angekho homologous kangangokuthi akukho nzuzo noma ukulahleka kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo (Isithombe 13.13)
question1: Kuyini ukudluliselwa kwe-chromosome?
answer1: Ukuhamba kwengxenye ye-chromosome kuya kwenye i-chromosome engeyona eyomuntu oyedwa
distractor1a: Ukuguqulwa kwengxenye ye-chromosome ngaphakathi kwe-chromosome efanayo
question2: Ingxenye ye-chromosome edluliselwe inamathela kuluphi uhlobo lwe-chromosome?
question3: Imiphumela yokudluliselwa kwesinye isilwane ingahluka kanjani?
answer3: Zingaba yingozi noma zibe nemiphumela emibi kuye ngokuthi izikhundla zezakhi zofuzo zihlobene nokulandelana kokulawula
question4: Yini enquma ukuthi ukufuduselwa kwesinye isilwane kuyingozi yini?
answer4: Indlela izikhundla zezakhi zofuzo ezishintshwa ngayo uma kuqhathaniswa nokulandelana kokulawula
question5: Kuyini ukudluliselwa kwengane endaweni ehlukene?
answer5: Ukushintshana kwezingxenye ze-chromosome phakathi kwama-chromosome amabili angewona awekho
distractor5a: Ukuphindaphinda kwezingxenye ze-chromosome ngaphakathi kwe-chromosome eyodwa
distractor5c: Ukususwa kwezingxenye ze-chromosome kuzo zombili i-homologs
question6: Kwenzekani enanini eliphelele lolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuphindaphindiwe?
answer6: Akukho nzuzo noma ukulahleka kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo
