chapterContent:
aneuploid
umuntu onephutha enombolweni ye-chromosome; kufaka phakathi ukususwa kanye nokuphindaphindwa kwezingxenye ze-chromosome

 autosome
noma yimaphi ama-chromosome angewona ubulili

 centimorgan (cM)
(futhi, iyunithi yemephu) ibanga elihlobene elihambisana nemvamisa yokuphinda kuhlanganiswe engu-0.01

 Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance
ithiyori ephakamisa ukuthi ama-chromosome ayizithuthi zezakhi zofuzo nokuthi ukuziphatha kwawo ngesikhathi se-meiosis kuyisisekelo esibonakalayo samaphethini efa uMendel awabona

 ukuguqulwa kwe-chromosome
ukuhlukaniswa, ukujikeleza okungu-180°, kanye nokufakwa kabusha kwengalo ye-chromosome

 euploid
umuntu onenani elifanele lama-chromosome ezinhlobo zawo

 ukuhlanganiswa kwe-homologous
inqubo lapho ama-chromosome e-homologous eshintshana khona ngokomzimba ngokuphindaphindiwe ezingalweni zawo, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukuwela phezu

 i-karyogram
isithombe sesithombe se-karyotype

 i-karyotype
inombolo nokubonakala kwama-chromosome ngamanye; kufaka phakathi usayizi, amaphethini okubamba, kanye nesikhundla se-centromere

 i-monosomy
kungenjalo i-genotype ye-diploid lapho i-chromosome eyodwa ingekho khona

 ukungahlangani
ukwehluleka kwama-homologs ahlanganisiwe ukuhlukanisa ngokuphelele nokuthuthela ezigxotsheni ezihlukene ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kweseli kokuqala kwe-meiosis

 uhlobo olungeyona i-parental (recombinant)
inzalo ebangelwa ukuhlanganiswa kwe-homologous okubonisa inhlanganisela ehlukile ye-allele uma kuqhathaniswa nabazali bayo

 i-paracentric
ukuguqulwa okwenzeka ngaphandle kwe-centromere

 izinhlobo zabazali
inzalo ebonisa inhlanganisela efanayo ye-allelic nabazali bayo

 i-pericentric
ukuguqulwa okubandakanya i-centromere

 i-polyploid
umuntu ngamunye onenombolo engalungile yamasethi e-chromosome

 imvamisa yokuphinda kuhlanganiswe
inani elimaphakathi lama-crossovers phakathi kwama-allele amabili; kubhekwe njengenani lezinhlobo ezingezona ezabazali kubantu benzalo

 ukudluliselwa
inqubo lapho ingxenye eyodwa ye-chromosome ihlukana futhi inamathele ku-chromosome ehlukile, engeyona eye-homologous
i-trisomy
ngaphandle kwalokho uhlobo lwe-diploid genotype lapho i-chromosome eyodwa ephelele iphindaphindwa khona

 X inactivation
ukujiya kwama-chromosomes e-X emizimbeni ye-Barr ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu kwabesifazane ukuze kunxeshezelwe umthamo wofuzo ophindwe kabili
question1: Kuyini i-aneuploidy?
answer1: Isimo lapho umuntu enenombolo ye-chromosome engavamile, okuhlanganisa ukuzuza noma ukulahlekelwa yi-chromosome
question2: Ziyini izimoto?
question3: Iyini i-centimorgan (cM)?
answer3: Iyunithi yemephu yezakhi zofuzo ehambisana nemvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha okungu-0.01
question4: Iyini i-Chromosomal Theory yefa?
answer4: Inkolelo-mbono yokuthi ama-chromosome athwala izakhi zofuzo kanye nokuziphatha kwazo ngesikhathi se-meiosis ichaza ifa likaMendelian
distractor4a: Inkolelo-mbono yokuthi izakhi zofuzo zithwalwa amaprotheni kuphela
distractor4b: Inkolelo-mbono yokuthi ama-chromosome akhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa
distractor4c: Inkolelo-mbono yokuthi izici zizuzwa njengefa ngezici ezihlanganisiwe
question5: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwama-chromosome?
answer5: Ukuhlukaniswa, ukujikeleza okungu-180°, kanye nokufakwa kabusha kwengxenye ye-chromosome
question6: Uyini umuntu obizwa ngokuthi i-euploid?
answer6: Umuntu onenani elifanele lama-chromosomes ohlobo lwakhe
question7: Kuyini ukuhlanganiswa kwe-homologous?
answer7: Ukushintshana okuphindaphindiwe kwezingxenye ze-chromosome phakathi kwama-chromosome e-homologous ngesikhathi se-meiosis
distractor7a: Ukushintshaniswa kwe-DNA phakathi kwama-chromatids angodade ngesikhathi se-mitosis
question8: Iyini i-karyogram?
answer8: Isithombe se-karyotype
question9: Iyini i-karyotype?
answer9: Inombolo kanye nokubonakala kwama-chromosomes ngamanye, okuhlanganisa usayizi, amaphethini okubamba, kanye nezikhundla ze-centromere
question10: Kuyini i-monosomy?
answer10: Uhlobo lwe-diploid olungenayo i-chromosome eyodwa
question11: Kuyini ukungahlanganisi?
answer11: Ukwehluleka kwama-chromosome afanayo ukuhlukanisa kahle ngesikhathi se-meiosis I
question12: Yiziphi izinhlobo ze-nonparental (recombinant)?
answer12: Inzalo enezinhlanganisela ze-allele ihlukile kweyabazali bayo ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa kwe-homologous
distractor12a: Inzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo nabazali bobabili
question13: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwe-paracentric?
question14: Yiziphi izinhlobo zabazali?
answer14: Inzalo enezinhlanganisela ze-allele ezifanayo nabazali bayo
question15: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwe-pericentric?
answer15: Ukuguqulwa okuhlanganisa i-centromere
question16: Kuyini umuntu one-polyploid?
answer16: Umuntu onenani elingavamile lamasethi aphelele e-chromosome
question17: Kuyini imvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha?
answer17: Imvamisa emaphakathi yokuhlangana phakathi kwama-allele amabili, elinganiswa yinzalo ephindaphindayo
distractor17c: Ukuvama kokuguqulwa kwama-chromosome
question18: Kuyini ukudluliselwa kwe-chromosome?
answer18: Ukuhamba kwengxenye ye-chromosome kuya kwenye i-chromosome engeyona eyomuntu oyedwa
answer19: Uhlobo lwe-diploid olunekhophi eyodwa eyengeziwe ye-chromosome yonke
answer20: Ukujiya kwama-chromosomes e-X emizimbeni ye-Barr ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu wesifazane ukuze kulinganiswe umthamo wezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Ngefa | 13.4 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 13. Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla Ngefa | 13.4 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
13.1 I-Chromosomal Theory kanye Nokuxhumana Kwezakhi Zofuzo
I-Chromosomal Theory yefa, ephakanyiswe nguSutton noBoveri, ithi ama-chromosome ayizinqola zofuzo. Izakhi zofuzo zaseMendelian noma ukuxhumana kwezakhi zofuzo akunembile ngokuphelele; esikhundleni salokho, ukuziphatha kwe-chromosome kuhilela ukuhlukaniswa, ukuhlanganiswa okuzimele, futhi ngezinye izikhathi, ukuxhuma. USturtevant waklama indlela yokuhlola imvamisa yokuhlangana kabusha futhi aphethe izikhundla ezihambisanayo kanye namabanga ezakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe ku-chromosome ngokusekelwe enanini elimaphakathi lama-crossovers esifundeni esiphakathi kwamazakhi zofuzo. USturtevant wacabanga ngokufanele ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zihlelwe ngokulandelana kwama-chromosome nokuthi ukuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwama-homologs kungenzeka noma kuphi ku-chromosome ngokungenzeka okufanayo. Ngenkathi ukuhlangana kubangela ukuthi ama-allele ku-chromosome efanayo azuzwe ndawonye, ukuhlangana kabusha okufanayo kukhetha ama-alleles ephethini yefa lokuhlanganiswa okuzimele.

 13.2 Isisekelo se-Chromosomal Sezinkinga Ezizuzwe Njengefa
Inombolo, usayizi, ukuma, kanye nephethini yokubopha yama-chromosome kuwenza abonakale kalula ku-karyogram futhi kuvumela ukuhlolwa kokuphazamiseka okuningi kwe-chromosome. Ukuphazamiseka kwenombolo ye-chromosome, noma ama-aneuploidies, kuvame ukubulala umbungu, yize izinhlobo ezimbalwa ze-trisomic genotypes zisebenza. Ngenxa yokungasebenzi kwe-X, ukuphazamiseka kuma-chromosome ocansi ngokuvamile kunemiphumela emincane ye-phenotypic. Ama-Aneuploidies afaka nezimo lapho izingxenye ze-chromosome ziphindaphindwa noma zisulwa. Izakhiwo ze-chromosome zingahlelwa kabusha, isibonelo ngokuguqulwa noma ukudluliselwa. Zombili lezi ziphazamiso zingabangela imiphumela ye-phenotypic eyinkinga. Ngoba ziphoqa ama-chromosome ukuthi athathe ama-topology angewona awemvelo ngesikhathi se-meiosis, ukuguqulwa kanye nokudluliselwa kuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nokuncipha kokuzala ngenxa yamathuba okungaxhunyani.
question1: Uma kuqhathaniswa abantu (noma i-Drosophila), izici ezixhunyaniswe no-X ziyabonwa.
answer1: Kaningi kwabesilisa kunabesifazane
distractor1c: Ngokwabiwa okuhlukene kuye ngokuthi isici sini
question2: Yikuphi ukuphindaphindwa kwemvamisa okuhambisana nokuxhumana okuphelele futhi okwephula umthetho wokuhlanganiswa okuzimele?
question3: Yikuphi ukuphindaphindwa kwemvamisa okuhambisana nokuhlukahluka okuzimele kanye nokungabikho kokuxhumana?
question4: Ngokusekelwe kuMfanekiso 13.14, yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nokuphindaphinda kwe-recombination esinembile?
answer4: Ukuhlanganiswa kombala womzimba kanye nama-allele obude be-aristae kuzokwenzeka kaningi kunokuhlanganiswa kwama-allele abomvu/onsundu kanye nama-allele obude be-aristae.
distractor4a: Ukuhlangana kombala womzimba kanye nama-allele abomvu/amehlo e-cinnabar kuzokwenzeka kaningi kunokuhlangana kobude bephiko kanye nama-allele angobude be-aristae.
distractor4b: Ukuhlanganiswa kombala womzimba ompunga/omnyama kanye nama-allele amade/amafushane e-aristae ngeke kwenzeke
distractor4c: Ukuhlangana kabusha kwe-alleles yeso elibomvu/elinsundu kanye ne-aristae ende/emfushane kuzokwenzeka kaningi kunokuhlangana kabusha kwe-alleles yobude bephiko nombala womzimba.
question5: Iyiphi ikhodi ye-cytogenetic echaza indawo engu-12 engalweni ende ye-chromosome 13?
question6: Uma i-homolog eyodwa ine-pericentric inversion kanti enye ijwayelekile, yisiphi isakhiwo esakhayo ngesikhathi se-meiosis ukuvumela ukubhanqa okufanele?
answer6: Iluphu
question7: Yikuphi okuchaza kangcono i-Chromosomal Theory of Inheritance?
answer7: Le mbono yaphakanyiswa nguBoveri-Sutton. Ichaza ukuxhumana, ukuhlanganiswa kabusha, kanye nokuwela futhi ithi izakhi zofuzo zaseMendelian zinezindawo ezithile kuma-chromosome, ezihlukaniswa futhi zihlukaniswe ngokuzimela.
distractor7a: Le mbono yaphakanyiswa nguCharles Darwin. Ichaza amayunithi efa phakathi kwabazali nezingane kanye nezinqubo lawo mayunithi alawula ngazo ukukhula kwezingane.
distractor7b: Le mbono yaphakanyiswa nguCharles Darwin. Ithi izakhi zofuzo zaseMendelian zinezinhlobo ezimbili ezihlukile futhi zidlula ekuhlanganiseni okuzimele. Yasiza ekwandiseni ukuqonda ukuxhumana kanye nokuhlanganiswa kabusha.
distractor7c: Le mbono yaphakanyiswa nguBoveri-Sutton. Ichaza amayunithi efa phakathi kwabazali nenzalo kanye nezinqubo lawo mayunithi alawula ngazo intuthuko enzalweni.
question8: Esivivinyweni sokuqhathanisa izici ezimbili (isiphambano se-dihybrid), ingabe imvamisa ebikezelwe yenzalo ephindaphindayo ingaba ngu-60%?
answer8: Cha. Imvamisa ebikezelwe yenzalo ephinde yatholakala isukela ku-0% (yezimpawu ezixhunyiwe) kuya ku-50% (yezimpawu ezingaxhunyiwe) ngenxa yamacala abazali kanye namacala angewona abazali.
distractor8a: Yebo. Imvamisa ebikezelwe yenzalo ephindaphindayo ingaba ngu-60% uma izakhi zofuzo zitholakala kude kakhulu komunye nomunye.
distractor8b: Yebo. Imvamisa ebikezelwe ingaba ngu-60% uma ukuwela kwenzeka ngesikhathi ngasinye semicimbi ye-meiotic
distractor8c: Cha. Imvamisa ebikezelwe ayisoze yaba ngu-60% ngenxa yokuba khona kwezinguquko ezifana nokususwa
question9: Khetha isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi ukungahlangani kungabangela kanjani i-aneuploid zygote
answer9: I-Nondisjunction ukwehluleka kwama-chromosome afanayo ukwahlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis I noma ukwehluleka kwama-chromatids angodadewabo ukwahlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis II, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwama-chromosome e-n+1/n-1/n
distractor9a: I-Nondisjunction yenzeka kuphela uma ama-chromosome afanayo engahlukani ngesikhathi se-meiosis I, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwama-gametes aqukethe ama-chromosome angu-n+1 kanye no-n-1.
distractor9b: I-Nondisjunction yenzeka kuphela uma ama-chromatids angodade engahlukani ku-meiosis II, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwama-gametes aqukethe ama-chromosomes e-n+1 kanye ne-n-1.
distractor9c: Ukungahlangani kwenzeka lapho ama-chromatids angodadewabo ehluleka ukuhlukana ngesikhathi se-mitosis II, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwama-gametes aqukethe ama-chromosomes angu-n+1 kanye no-n-1/n
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza ngokunembile ukuphazamiseka okuvamile kwe-chromosome kanye nemiphumela yako yezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: Ukungahlanganisi - ama-gametes aneuploid; ukuphindaphinda - ukukhubazeka ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo; ukususwa - okubulalayo emvelweni we-diploid; ukuguqulwa - ukuqhekeka kwe-chromosome ku-gene; ukudluliselwa kwezindawo - imiphumela incike ekutheni izikhundla zezakhi zofuzo zishintshwa kanjani
distractor10a: Ukungahlanganisi - ukukhubazeka ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo; ukuguqulwa - ukungalingani kwezakhi zofuzo; ukuphindaphindwa - ama-gametes angenawo ama-anuploid; ukudluliselwa - ukuqhekeka kwe-chromosome ku-gene; ukususwa - imiphumela incike ekutheni izikhundla zezakhi zofuzo zishintshwa kanjani
distractor10b: Ukususwa - ama-gametes aneuploid; ukudluliselwa - ukukhubazeka ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo; ukuphindaphinda - imiphumela incike ezikhundleni zezakhi zofuzo; ukungahlangani - kubangela ukungalingani kwezakhi zofuzo okubulalayo kunto ephilayo ene-diploid; i-aneuploidy - kuholela ezifweni ezahlukahlukene
distractor10c: Ukungahlanganisi - ukuqhekeka kwe-chromosome ku-gene; ukuphindaphindwa - ukukhubazeka ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo; ukususwa - ukungalingani kwezakhi zofuzo okubulalayo ku-diploid ophilayo; ukuguqulwa - ama-gametes aneuploid; ukudluliselwa - imiphumela incike ezikhundleni zezakhi zofuzo
question11: Bheka uMfanekiso 13.15. Lesi sibalo simelela imephu yokuxhumanisa ye-Drosophila yezakhi zofuzo i-A-E. Izinombolo eziphakathi kwe-gene loci ziyiyunithi yemephu ehlobene phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ngasinye. Ngokusekelwe kumephu yokuxhumanisa, bikezela futhi ukhombe izakhi zofuzo ezimbili okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi zihlukanise ndawonye.
question12: Kwenziwa isiphambano sokuhlola se-dihybrid (izici ezimbili) phakathi kwezimpukane ze-EEWW ezizalanisa ngempela nezimpukane ze-eeww. Isizukulwane se-F1 esaphumela sabe sesihlanganiswa nezimpukane ze-eeww. Inzalo eyi-100 esizukulwaneni se-F2 yahlolwa futhi kwatholakala ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ze-E ne-W azixhumene. Hlukanisa phakathi kwezinhlobo zofuzo ezifanele zenzalo ye-F2 yezakhi zofuzo ezingaxhumene kanye nezinhlobo zofuzo ezibikezelwe uma izakhi zofuzo zitholakale zixhumene.
answer12: Akuxhunyiwe: 25% EeWw, 25% Eeww, 25% eeWw, kanye 25% eeww; kuxhunyiwe: 50% EeWw kanye 50% eeww
distractor12a: Akuxhunyiwe: izinhlobo zofuzo zabazali u-EeWw kanye no-eeww; kuxhunyiwe: 25% u-Eeww, 50% u-eeWw
distractor12b: Izinhlobo ze-genotype ezixhunyiwe (EeWw kanye ne-eeww) kanye nezinhlobo ze-genotype ezihlanganisiwe (Eeww kanye ne-eeWw) esizukulwaneni se-F2 zicishe zifane kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zixhumene kanjani.
distractor12c: Akuxhunyiwe: 25% EeWw kanye ne-eeww kanye ne-75% Eeww kanye ne-eeWw; kuxhunywe: ikakhulukazi ngezinhlobo zofuzo zabazali, Eeww kanye ne-eeWw
question13: Bheka uMfanekiso 13.16. Kwenziwa isiphambano ngezimpukane ze-AABB ezizalana ngokweqiniso kanye nezimpukane ze-aabb ezizalana ngokweqiniso. Isizukulwane se-F1 esalandela sabe sesihlanganiswa nezimpukane ze-aabb ezizalana ngokweqiniso. Ngokusekelwe kumephu yokuxhumanisa, iyiphi kulezi zilinganiso ze-genotype zesizukulwane se-F2 ezilandelayo okungenzeka ukuthi ibonwe?
answer13: Inani Eliqashelwe: AaBb (46), Aabb (4), aaBb (4), aabb (4)
distractor13a: Inombolo Eqashelwe: AaBb (4), Aabb (46), aaBb (46), aabb (4)
distractor13b: Inani Eliqashelwe: AaBb (25), Aabb (25), aaBb (25), aabb (25)
distractor13c: Inombolo Eqashelwe: AaBb (50), Aabb (0), aaBb (0), aabb (50)
question14: Bheka uMfanekiso 13.17. Yiziphi izimpawu ezilandelayo okungenzeka ukuthi zihlotshaniswa nesifo esiboniswe ku-karyotype?
answer14: Ubude obufushane nokukhula okunciphile
question15: Bheka uMfanekiso 13.17. Chaza uhlobo lwe-karyotype olukhonjisiwe ukuze ukhombe isitatimende esichaza kahle isifo esibangelwa yilolu hlobo lwe-karyotype futhi sichaze izinkinga ezingaba khona zomphakathi, zokuziphatha, noma zezokwelapha ezihlobene naleso sifo.
answer15: I-Down syndrome (47 XY +21) ibangela ukukhubazeka kwengqondo, izinkinga zokubona, isifo senhliziyo esizalwa naso, kanye nokuthambekela ekuhlaselweni umdlavuza. Abahlinzeki bezempilo bavame ukungaxoxi ngezici ezinhle zokukhulisa ingane ene-Down syndrome futhi bavame ukunikeza ulwazi oluphelelwe yisikhathi.
distractor15a: I-Klinefelter syndrome (47 XY +21) ibangela ukukhubazeka kwengqondo, izinkinga zokubona, isifo senhliziyo esizalwa naso, kanye nokuthambekela ekuhlaselweni umdlavuza. Ngokuvamile kuphakama izimpikiswano ngokumelene nokukhishwa kwesisu kombungu othintekile.
distractor15b: I-Klinefelter syndrome (47 XXY) ibangela ukungazali kanye nokwehla kokukhiqizwa kwe-testosterone. Ngokuvamile kuphakama izimpikiswano eziphikisana nokwazisa izinkampani zomshuwalense mayelana nokuxilongwa kwalesi sifo.
distractor15c: I-Down syndrome (47 XXY) ibangela ukungazali kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-testosterone ephansi. Izimpikiswano zivame ukwenziwa ngokumelene nokwazisa izinkampani zomshuwalense mayelana nokuxilongwa kwalesi sifo.
question16: Bheka uMfanekiso 13.18. Hlola imephu yokuxhumanisa ebonisiwe. Qagela ukuthi iyiphi kulezi zindlela ezilandelayo zezakhi zofuzo engaba umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu wokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ku-chromosome ebonisiwe.
answer16: I-RTSUV
question17: Bheka uMfanekiso 13.6. Ngosizo lomdwebo onikeziwe, khetha isitatimende esifanele kakhulu esichaza ukungahlangani kanye nemiphumela yako yezakhi zofuzo
answer17: I-Nondisjunction ukwehluleka kwama-chromosome afanayo ukwahlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis I noma ukwehluleka kwama-chromatids angodadewabo ukwahlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis II. Lokhu kuphumela kuma-gametes aneuploid
distractor17a: I-nondisjunction yenzeka lapho umbhangqwana ofana nawo ungakwazi ukwahlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis I, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwama-gametes aqukethe ama-chromosome e-n+1 kanye ne-n-1. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-aneuploidy
distractor17b: Ukungahlangani kwenzeka ngenxa yokungakwazi kwama-chromatids angodadewabo ukwahlukana ngesikhathi se-meiosis II, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwama-gametes aqukethe ama-chromosomes e-n+1 kanye ne-n-1. Lokhu kuphumela ezifweni zenhliziyo nokopha kwegazi.
distractor17c: I-nondisjunction yenzeka lapho ama-chromosome amabili afanayo ehluleka ukuhlukanisa ngesikhathi se-meiosis II okuholela ekwakhekeni kwama-gametes aqukethe izinombolo zama-chromosomes ezingu-n+1, n-1, noma n. Lokhu kuphumela emaphethini okukhula angajwayelekile.
question18:
Uma imiphumela ye-Klinefelter syndrome iqhathaniswa nemiphumela ye-Down Syndrome, lesi sifo
_
answer18: Okungekubi kangako kune-Down syndrome, ngenxa yokungasebenzi kwe-X kulesi sifo
distractor18a: Kuyingozi kakhulu kune-Down syndrome, ngenxa yokususwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulesi sifo
distractor18b: Kunzima kakhulu kune-Down syndrome, ngenxa ye-trisomy ku-Klinefelter syndrome
distractor18c: Okungekubi kangako kune-Down syndrome, ngenxa ye-monosomy ku-Down Syndrome

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
I-DNA yomuntu ngamunye ihlukile, futhi kungenzeka ukuthola umehluko phakathi kwabantu ngaphakathi kohlobo oluthile ngokusekelwe kulezi zici ezihlukile. Ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kunezindlela eziningi ezisebenzayo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlonza izigebengu (i-forensics), ukunquma ubaba, ukulandelela uhlu lozalo, ukuhlonza izifo, ukucwaninga okutholwe ngezinto zakudala, ukulandelela ukuqubuka kwezifo, kanye nokufunda amaphethini okufuduka kwabantu. Emkhakheni wezokwelapha, i-DNA isetshenziswa ekuxilongeni, ekuthuthukisweni okusha kwemithi yokugoma, kanye nokwelashwa komdlavuza. Ngokuvamile kungenzeka ukunquma ukuthi izifo zibangelwa yini ngokulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ngezinye izikhathi umuntu ongenacala ulahlwa yicala ngephutha ngecala bese eboshwa. Phakathi kuka-2000 no-2015, ubufakazi obuvela ku-DNA basetshenziswa ukukhulula abantu abangaphezu kuka-250 abangenacala. Abangamashumi amabili kulabo bantu babesohlwini lokufa ngemuva kokulahlwa yicala lokubulala abangalenzanga.
question1: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kunezindlela eziningi ezisebenzayo. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungakhulunywa ngakho embhalweni njengenye yezindlela zokusetshenziswa kwayo?
answer1: Ukubikezela ukuzamazama komhlaba

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.1 Isisekelo Somlando Sokuqonda Kwanamuhla | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Namuhla izinhlamvu ezintathu ze-DNA "ziye zafana nokuxazulula ubugebengu, ukuhlolwa kobaba, ukuhlonza abantu, kanye nokuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Zonke lezi zinqubo zingenzeka ngenxa yokutholakala, maphakathi nekhulu lama-20, ukuthi i-DNA iyizinto zofuzo. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa okuningana okuvamile yabeka isisekelo sokwanda kolwazi lwethu mayelana ne-DNA nokuthi igcina futhi idlulise kanjani ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo. I-DNA yaqala ukuhlukaniswa kumaseli amhlophe egazi nguMiescher ngawo-1860. Eminyakeni engaphezu kwamashumi amahlanu kamuva, umsebenzi kaGriffith wokuguqula izinhlobo zebhaktheriya i-Streptococcus pneumoniae wanikeza inkomba yokuqala yokuthi i-DNA hhayi iphrotheni (njengoba abanye bephikisana) iyi-molecule yendawo yonke yofuzo. Iziphetho zikaGriffith kamuva zasekelwa ngu-Avery, uMacLeod, noMcCarty.

 Ukuhlolwa okulandelayo kukaHershey noChase besebenzisa i-bacteriophage T2 kwafakazela ngokusobala ukuthi i-DNA iyizinto zofuzo. Ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho, uChargaff wanquma izilinganiso ze-adenine, i-thymine, i-cytosine, ne-guanine ku-DNA, ephakamisa ubudlelwano obuhlangene (A = T kanye no-C = G). Wathola nokuthi Amaphesenti ka-A, T, C, kanye no-G ahlukile ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene. Zonke lezi zivivinyo ezibalulekile emlandweni zakha ukuqonda kwethu kwamanje kwe-DNA.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Ideas 3 kanye no-4 we-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso zokufunda ze-AP® zihlanganisa okuqukethwe kolwazi olubalulekile nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa. Lezi zinhloso zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okusekelwe embuzweni ngelebhu, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.1 Isisekelo Somlando Sokuqonda Kwanamuhla | Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla kwe-DNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.1 Isisekelo Somlando Sokuqonda Kwanamuhla | Ukuqonda Kwanamuhla kwe-DNA
chapterContent:
Ukuqonda kwesimanje nge-DNA kuye kwavela ekutholakaleni kwe-nucleic acid kuya ekuthuthukisweni kwemodeli ye-double-helix. Ngawo-1860, uFriedrich Miescher (Isithombe 14.2), udokotela ngokomsebenzi, wayengumuntu wokuqala ukuhlukanisa amakhemikhali acebile nge-phosphate kumaseli amhlophe egazi noma ama-leukocyte. Waqamba la makhemikhali (azogcina aziwa ngokuthi i-RNA ne-DNA) ngokuthi i-nuclein ngoba ayehlukaniswe nama-nuclei amaseli.

 Ngemva kwengxenye yekhulu leminyaka, isazi samabhaktheriya saseBrithani uFrederick Griffith mhlawumbe wayengumuntu wokuqala ukukhombisa ukuthi ulwazi lwefa lungadluliselwa kusuka kwelinye iseli liye kwelinye ngokuvundlile,” kunokuba kube ngokuhla. Ngo-1928, wabika ukubonakaliswa kokuqala kokuguqulwa kwamabhaktheriya, inqubo lapho i-DNA yangaphandle ithathwa khona yiseli, ngaleyo ndlela ishintsha isimo somzimba kanye ne-physiology. Wayesebenza ne-Streptococcus pneumoniae, igciwane elibangela i-pneumonia. UGriffith wasebenza ngezinhlobo ezimbili, i-rough (R) kanye ne-smooth (S). Uhlobo lwe-R alunazo izifo (alubangeli izifo) futhi lubizwa ngokuthi i-rough ngoba ubuso balo bangaphandle buwudonga lweseli futhi alunalo i-capsule; ngenxa yalokho, ubuso beseli bubonakala bungalingani ngaphansi kwe-microscope. Uhlobo lwe-S lubangela izifo (lubangela izifo) futhi lune-capsule ngaphandle kodonga lweseli lalo. Ngenxa yalokho, lubukeka lubushelelezi ngaphansi kwe-microscope. UGriffith wafaka uhlobo lwe-R oluphilayo emagundwini futhi asinda. Kokunye ukuhlola, lapho efaka amagundane ngohlobo lwe-S olubulawe ukushisa, nawo asinda. Kokunye ukuhlola kwesithathu, ingxube yohlobo lwe-R oluphilayo kanye nohlobo lwe-S olubulawe ukushisa kwafakwa emagundwini, futhi—okwammangaza—amagundane afa. Lapho ehlukanisa amabhaktheriya aphilayo egundwini elifile, kwatholakala uhlobo lwe-S kuphela lwamabhaktheriya. Lapho lolu hlobo lwe-S oluhlukanisiwe lufakwa emagundwini amasha, amagundane afa. UGriffith waphetha ngokuthi kukhona okudlulile kusuka kohlobo lwe-S olubulawe ukushisa lwaya kohlobo lwe-R oluphilayo futhi waluguqula lwaba uhlobo lwe-S olubangela izifo, futhi wabiza lokhu ngokuthi isimiso sokuguqula (Isithombe 14.3). Lezi zivivinyo manje zaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi izivivinyo zokuguqula zikaGriffiths.

 Ososayensi u-Oswald Avery, uColin MacLeod, noMaclyn McCarty (1944) babenesifiso sokuhlola lesi simiso sokuguqula kabanzi. Bahlukanisa uhlobo lwe-S emagundwini afile futhi bahlukanisa amaprotheni nama-nucleic acid, okungukuthi i-RNA ne-DNA, njengoba lokhu kwakungaba yi-molecule yofuzo. Benza ucwaningo lokususa okuhlelekile. Basebenzise ama-enzyme anciphisa ngqo ingxenye ngayinye base besebenzisa ingxube ngayinye ngokwehlukana ukuguqula uhlobo lwe-R. Bathole ukuthi lapho i-DNA yonakala, ingxube eyavela yayingasakwazi ukuguqula amabhaktheriya, kanti zonke ezinye izinhlanganisela zazikwazi ukuguqula amabhaktheriya. Lokhu Kwabaholela ekuphetheni ngokuthi i-DNA yayiyisimiso sokuguqula.

 Ukuhlolwa okwenziwe nguMartha Chase no-Alfred Hershey ngo-1952 kwanikeza ubufakazi obuqinisekisayo bokuthi i-DNA yayiyizinto zofuzo hhayi amaprotheni. UChase noHershey babefunda i-bacteriophage, okuyigciwane elithelela amagciwane. Amagciwane ngokuvamile anesakhiwo esilula: i-protein coat, ebizwa ngokuthi i-capsid, kanye ne-nucleic acid core equkethe izinto zofuzo, kungaba i-DNA noma i-RNA. I-bacteriophage ithelela iseli lebhaktheriya eliphethe ngokunamathela ebusweni balo, bese ifaka ama-nucleic acid alo ngaphakathi kweseli. I-phage DNA yenza amakhophi amaningi ayo isebenzisa umshini we-host, futhi ekugcineni iseli le-host liyaqhuma, likhulule inani elikhulu lama-bacteriophages. UHershey noChase babhale ibhetshi elilodwa le-phage nge-radioactive sulfur, 35S, ukuze balebhele i-protein coat. Elinye ibhetshi le-phage labhalwa nge-radioactive phosphorus, 32P. Ngenxa yokuthi i-phosphorus itholakala ku-DNA, kodwa hhayi ku-protein, i-DNA hhayi iphrotheni yayizobekwa i-radioactive phosphorus.

 Iqoqo ngalinye le-phage lavunyelwa ukuthi lithelele amangqamuzana ngokwahlukene. Ngemva kokutheleleka, i-phage bacterial suspension yafakwa ku-blender, okwabangela ukuba i-phage coat isuswe esitokisini somsingathi. I-phage kanye ne-bacterial suspension zaphonswa phansi nge-centrifuge. Amangqamuzana e-bacteria anzima ahlala phansi akha i-pellet, kanti izinhlayiya ze-phage ezikhanyayo zahlala ku-supernatant. Ethubhini elaliqukethe i-phage ebhalwe nge-35S, i-supernatant yayiqukethe i-phage ebhalwe nge-radioactive, kanti akukho radioactivity eyatholakala ku-pellet. Ethubhini elaliqukethe i-phage ebhalwe nge-32P, radioactivity yatholakala ku-pellet eyayiqukethe amangqamuzana e-bacteria anzima, futhi akukho radioactivity eyatholakala ku-supernatant. UHershey noChase baphetha ngokuthi kwakuyi-phage DNA eyafakwa esitokisini futhi yathwala ulwazi lokukhiqiza izinhlayiya ze-phage ezengeziwe, ngaleyo ndlela banikeza ubufakazi bokuthi i-DNA yayiyizinto zofuzo hhayi amaprotheni (Isithombe 14.4).

 Cishe ngalesi sikhathi esifanayo, isazi se-biochemist sase-Austria u-Erwin Chargaff wahlola okuqukethwe yi-DNA ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene. futhi wathola ukuthi amanani e-adenine, i-thymine, i-guanine, ne-cytosine awatholakalanga ngobuningi obulinganayo, nokuthi ayehlukahluka kuye ngohlobo, kodwa hhayi phakathi kwabantu bohlobo olufanayo. Wathola ukuthi inani le-adenine lilingana nenani le-thymine, kanti inani le-cytosine lilingana nenani le-guanine, noma u-A = T no-G = C. Lokhu kwaziwa nangokuthi imithetho kaChargaff. Lokhu okutholakele kwaba wusizo kakhulu lapho uWatson noCrick belungiselela ukuphakamisa imodeli yabo ye-DNA double helix.

chapterContent:
Imodeli eyamukelwa njengamanje yesakhiwo se-DNA yaphakanyiswa ngo-1953 nguWatson noCrick, abenza imodeli yabo ngemuva kokubona isithombe se-DNA uFranklin ayesithathile esebenzisa i-X-ray crystallography. Isithombe sabonisa ukuma nobukhulu be-molecule ye-double-helix. Izintambo ezimbili ezakha i-double helix ziyahambisana futhi azihambisani ngokwemvelo. Okusho ukuthi, intambo eyodwa isebenza ohlangothini lwe-5 kuya ku-3, kanti intambo ehambisanayo isebenza ohlangothini lwe-3 kuya ku-5. (Ukubaluleka kokuqondisa kuzobaluleka lapho sihlola ukuthi i-DNA izikopisha kanjani.) I-DNA iyi-polymer yama-nucleotide aqukethe ushukela we-deoxyribose, iqembu le-phosphate, kanye nesinye sezisekelo ezine ze-nitrogenous—A, T, C, kanye ne-G—ene-purine ehlala ihambisana ne-pyrimidine (njengoba uChargaff etholile). Ulimi lwezakhi zofuzo lwe-DNA lutholakala ngokulandelana kwama-nucleotide. Ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli iseli ngalinye lendodakazi lithola ikhophi ye-DNA enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi ukuphindaphindwa. Eminyakeni kusukela ekutholakaleni kwesakhiwo se-DNA, ubuchwepheshe obuningi, okuhlanganisa nokulandelana kwe-DNA, kuye kwathuthukiswa okusenza sikwazi ukuqonda kangcono i-DNA nendima yayo kuma-genome ethu.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | Amabhlogo okwakha i-DNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | Amabhlogo okwakha i-DNA
chapterContent:
Amabhlogo okwakha i-DNA ama-nucleotide. Izingxenye ezibalulekile ze-nucleotide yi-base ene-nitrogen, i-deoxyribose (ushukela we-carbon ongu-5), kanye neqembu le-phosphate (Isithombe 14.5). I-nucleotide iqanjwe kuye nge-base ene-nitrogen. I-base ene-nitrogen ingaba i-purine efana ne-adenine (A) ne-guanine (G), noma i-pyrimidine efana ne-cytosine (C) ne-thymine (T).

 Ama-nucleotide ahlangana ngezibopho ze-covalent ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-phosphodiester bonds noma ama-linkages. Ama-purine anesakhiwo sendandatho ephindwe kabili esinendandatho enamalungu ayisithupha ehlanganiswe nendandatho enamalungu amahlanu. Ama-pyrimidines mancane ngobukhulu; anesakhiwo sendandatho eyodwa enamalungu ayisithupha. Ama-athomu ekhabhoni kashukela wekhabhoni amahlanu anezinombolo 1, 2, 3, 4, kanye no-5 (1 ifundwa njenge-prime eyodwa). I-phosphate residue inamathele eqenjini le-hydroxyl lekhabhoni eli-5 likashukela elilodwa le-nucleotide eyodwa kanye neqembu le-hydroxyl lekhabhoni eli-3 likashukela le-nucleotide elandelayo, ngaleyo ndlela kwakha isibopho se-phosphodiester esingu-5-3.

 Ngawo-1950, uFrancis Crick noJames Watson basebenzisana ukuthola isakhiwo se-DNA eNyuvesi yaseCambridge, eNgilandi. Abanye ososayensi abanjengoLinus Pauling noMaurice Wilkins nabo babehlola ngenkuthalo le nsimu. UPauling wayethole isakhiwo sesibili samaprotheni esebenzisa i-X-ray crystallography. Elabhorethri likaWilkins, umcwaningi uRosalind Franklin wayesebenzisa izindlela ze-X-ray diffraction ukuze aqonde isakhiwo se-DNA. UWatson noCrick bakwazi ukuhlanganisa iphazili ye-molecule ye-DNA ngokusekelwe kudatha kaFranklin ngoba uCrick wayefunde ne-X-ray diffraction (Isithombe 14.6). Ku Ngo-1962, uJames Watson, uFrancis Crick, noMaurice Wilkins banikezwa uMklomelo kaNobel kwezokwelapha. Ngeshwa, ngaleso sikhathi uFranklin wayeseshonile, futhi imiklomelo kaNobel ayinikezwa ngemva kokufa.

 UWatson noCrick basikisela ukuthi i-DNA yakhiwe ngemicu emibili ejikeleziswayo ukuze yakhe i-helix yesandla sokunene. Ukuhlanganiswa kwesisekelo kwenzeka phakathi kwe-purine ne-pyrimidine; okungukuthi, imicu ye-A enemicu ye-T ne-G ene-C. I-Adenine ne-thymine ziyimicu yesisekelo ehambisanayo, kanti i-cytosine ne-guanine nazo ziyimicu yesisekelo ehambisanayo. Imicu yesisekelo iqiniswa yizibopho ze-hydrogen; i-adenine ne-thymine zakha izibopho ezimbili ze-hydrogen kanti i-cytosine ne-guanine zakha izibopho ezintathu ze-hydrogen. Imicu emibili ayihambisani ngokwemvelo; okungukuthi, ukuphela kwe-3 kwentambo eyodwa kubhekene nokuphela kwe-5 kwenye intambo. Ushukela ne-phosphate yama-nucleotide kwakha umgogodla wesakhiwo, kanti izisekelo ze-nitrogenous zibekwe ngaphakathi. I-base pair ngayinye ihlukaniswe kwenye i-base pair ngebanga elingu-0.34 nm, futhi ukujika ngakunye kwe-helix kulinganisa u-3.4 nm. Ngakho-ke, kukhona ama-base pair ayishumi ngokujika ngakunye kwe-helix. Ububanzi be-DNA double helix bungu-2 nm, futhi buyafana kuyo yonke indawo. Ukuhlangana kuphela phakathi kwe-purine ne-pyrimidine okungachaza ububanzi obufanayo. Ukusonta kwezintambo ezimbili ezizungezile kuphumela ekwakhekeni kwemisele emikhulu nemincane ehlukaniswe ngokulinganayo (Isithombe 14.7)

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | Amasu Okulandelana kwe-DNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | Amasu Okulandelana kwe-DNA
chapterContent:
Kuze kube ngawo-1990, ukulandelana kwe-DNA (ukufunda ukulandelana kwe-DNA) kwakuyinqubo ebiza kakhulu futhi ende. Ukusebenzisa ama-nucleotide ane-radiolabeled nakho kwandisa inkinga ngokukhathazeka ngokuphepha. Ngobuchwepheshe obukhona njengamanje kanye nemishini ezenzakalelayo, inqubo ishibhile, iphephile, futhi ingaqedwa ngehora elilodwa. UFred Sanger wasungula indlela yokulandelana esetshenziswa kuphrojekthi yokulandelana kwe-genome yomuntu, esetshenziswa kabanzi namuhla (Isithombe 14.8).

 Le ndlela yaziwa ngokuthi indlela yokuqeda uchungechunge lwe-dideoxy. Indlela yokulandelana isekelwe ekusetshenzisweni kwama-chain terminators, ama-dideoxynucleotides (ddNTPs). Ama-dideoxynucleotides, noma ama-ddNTP, ahlukile kuma-deoxynucleotides ngokuntuleka kweqembu lama-3 OH lamahhala kushukela we-carbon emihlanu. Uma i-ddNTP ingezwa ku-DNA strand ekhulayo, uchungechunge alunwetshwa ngoba iqembu lama-3 OH lamahhala elidingekayo ukwengeza enye i-nucleotide alitholakali. Ngokusebenzisa isilinganiso esinqunyiwe sama-deoxynucleotides nama-dideoxynucleotides, kungenzeka ukukhiqiza izingcezu ze-DNA ezinobukhulu obuhlukene.

 Isampula ye-DNA ezolandelaniswa iyahlukaniswa noma ihlukaniswe ibe yimicu emibili ngokuyifudumeza emazingeni okushisa aphezulu. I-DNA ihlukaniswe ngamashubhu amane lapho kufakwa khona i-primer, i-DNA polymerase, kanye nawo wonke ama-nucleotide amane (A, T, G, kanye no-C). Ngaphezu kweshubhu ngalinye kulawa amane, inani elilinganiselwe lenye yama-dideoxynucleotide amane lifakwa eshubhu ngalinye ngokulandelana. Amashubhu abhalwe ngokuthi A, T, G, kanye no-C ngokusho kwe-ddNTP engeziwe. Ngezinjongo zokuthola, ngalinye lama-dideoxynucleotide amane liphethe ilebula elihlukile le-fluorescent. Ukwandiswa kweketanga kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho kufakwa i-dideoxy nucleotide e-fluorescent, ngemva kwalokho kungabikho ukwanda okuqhubekayo okwenzekayo. Ngemva kokuphela kokusabela, i-electrophoresis yenziwa. Ngisho nomehluko ngobude besisekelo esisodwa ungatholakala. Ukulandelana kufundwa kusithwebuli se-laser. Ngomsebenzi wakhe wokulandelana kwe-DNA, uSanger wathola uMklomelo kaNobel kwezekhemistri ngo-1980.

 I-gel electrophoresis iyindlela esetshenziswa ukuhlukanisa izingcezu ze-DNA zobukhulu obuhlukene. Ngokuvamile ijeli yenziwe ngekhemikhali ebizwa ngokuthi i-agarose. Impuphu ye-agarose ifakwa ku-buffer bese ifudunyezwa. Ngemva kokupholisa, isixazululo sejeli sithelwa kuthreyi yokuphonsa. Uma ijeli isiqinile, i-DNA ifakwa kujeli bese kusetshenziswa ugesi. I-DNA ineshaja engalungile futhi isuka ku-electrode engalungile iye ku-electrode elungile. Ugesi usetshenziswa isikhathi esanele ukuvumela i-DNA ihlukane ngokobukhulu; izingcezu ezincane kakhulu zizoba kude kakhulu nomthombo (lapho i-DNA yayilayishwe khona), kanti izingcezu ezisindayo zesisindo sama-molecule zizoba seduze nomthombo. Uma i-DNA isihlukanisiwe, ijeli ifakwa umbala okhethekile we-DNA ukuze uyibuke (Isithombe 14.9)

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | I-Neanderthal Genome: Sihlobene Kanjani?
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | I-Neanderthal Genome: Sihlobene Kanjani?
chapterContent:
Uchungechunge lokuqala lwe-genome ye-Neanderthal lusanda kushicilelwa nguRichard E. Green nabanye ngo-2010.1 Ama-Neanderthal angokhokho abaseduze kakhulu babantu banamuhla. Kwakwaziwa ukuthi ahlala eYurophu naseNtshonalanga ye-Asia ngaphambi kokuba anyamalale emarekhodini ezinsalela cishe eminyakeni engama-30,000 eyedlule. Ithimba likaGreen lifunde izinsalela zezinsalela ezineminyaka ecishe ibe ngu-40,000 ubudala ezakhethwa ezindaweni emhlabeni jikelele. Kwasetshenziswa izindlela eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu zokulungiselela amasampula kanye nokulandelana kwe-DNA ngenxa yobuthakathaka bamathambo kanye nokungcola okukhulu kwamagciwane. Esifundweni sabo, ososayensi bakwazi ukulandelana ngamabili eziyisisekelo angaba yizigidigidi ezine. Uchungechunge lwe-Neanderthal luqhathaniswa nolwabantu banamuhla abavela emhlabeni wonke. Ngemva kokuqhathanisa uchungechunge, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-genome ye-Neanderthal yayinokufana okukhulu ngamaphesenti amabili kuya kwamathathu nabantu abahlala ngaphandle kwe-Afrika kunabantu base-Afrika. Ngenkathi imibono yamanje isikisela ukuthi bonke abantu banamuhla bangalandelelwa kubantu abambalwa base-Afrika, idatha evela ku-genome ye-Neanderthal ingase iphikisane nalo mbono. UGreen nozakwabo bathole nezingxenye ze-DNA phakathi kwabantu baseYurophu nase-Asia ezifana kakhulu nezilandelana ze-Neanderthal kunezinye izilandelana zabantu banamuhla. Okunye okuthakazelisayo okwabonwayo ukuthi ama-Neanderthal ahlobene kakhulu nabantu basePapua New Guinea njengoba kunjalo nangalabo abavela eShayina noma eFrance. Lokhu kuyamangaza ngoba izinsalela zezinsalela ze-Neanderthal zitholakale eYurophu naseNtshonalanga Asia kuphela. Cishe, ukushintshana kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka phakathi kwama-Neanderthal nabantu banamuhla njengoba abantu banamuhla bephuma e-Afrika, ngaphambi kokuhlukana kwabaseYurophu, abase-East Asia, kanye nabasePapua New Guinea.

 Izakhi zofuzo eziningana zibonakala sengathi ziye zashintsha kuma-Neanderthal ngesikhathi sokuvela kwabantu banamuhla. Lezi zakhi zofuzo zihilelekile esakhiweni se-cranial, metabolism, morphology yesikhumba, kanye nentuthuko yokuqonda. Enye yezakhi zofuzo ethakazelisa kakhulu yi-RUNX2, ehlukile kubantu banamuhla kanye nama-Neanderthal. Le zakhi zofuzo inesibopho samathambo angaphambili avelele, i-rib cage enesimo sensimbi, kanye nomehluko wamazinyo obonakala kuma-Neanderthal. Kucatshangwa ukuthi ushintsho lokuziphendukela kwemvelo ku-RUNX2 lwalubalulekile ekudalweni kwabantu banamuhla, futhi lokhu kwathinta ubuchopho kanye nomzimba ongaphezulu.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | Ukupakishwa kwe-DNA Kumaseli
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.2 Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nokulandelana | Ukupakishwa kwe-DNA Kumaseli
chapterContent:
Uma kuqhathaniswa amangqamuzana e-prokaryotic namaseli e-eukaryotic, ama-prokaryotes alula kakhulu kune-eukaryotes ezicini zawo eziningi (Isithombe 14.10). Ama-prokaryotes amaningi aqukethe i-chromosome eyodwa, eyindilinga etholakala endaweni ye-cytoplasm ebizwa ngokuthi i-nucleoid.

 Usayizi we-genome kwenye yama-prokaryotes afundwe kahle kakhulu, i-E.coli, ungama-base pair ayizigidi ezingu-4.6 (cishe ama-1.1 mm, uma enqunyiwe futhi enwetshiwe). Ngakho-ke lokhu kungena kanjani ngaphakathi kweseli elincane lebhaktheriya? I-DNA ijijekile yilokho okwaziwa ngokuthi i-supercoiling. I-Supercoiling isho ukuthi i-DNA ingaphansi kwenxeba (ngaphansi kokujika okukodwa kwe-helix ngama-base pair ayi-10) noma ingaphezulu kwenxeba (ngaphezu kokujika okukodwa ngama-base pair ayi-10) kusuka esimweni sayo esivamile sokuphumula. Amanye amaprotheni ayaziwa ukuthi ahilelekile ku-supercoiling; amanye amaprotheni nama-enzyme afana ne-DNA gyrase asiza ekugcineni isakhiwo se-supercoiled.

 Ama-Eukaryote, ama-chromosome awo ngalinye lakhiwe yi-molecule ye-DNA eqondile, asebenzisa uhlobo oluhlukile lwesu lokupakisha ukuze afane ne-DNA yawo ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus (Isithombe 14.11). Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, i-DNA izungezwe amaprotheni aziwa ngokuthi ama-histone ukuze akhe izakhiwo ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-nucleosome. Ama-histone angamaprotheni agcinwe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo acebile ngama-amino acid ayisisekelo futhi akha i-octamer. I-DNA (eshajelwa kabi ngenxa yamaqembu e-phosphate) izungezwe ngokuqinile enkabeni ye-histone. Le nucleosome ixhunywe kwelandelayo ngosizo lwe-linker DNA. Lokhu kwaziwa nangokuthi ubuhlalu obusesimeni sentambo”. Lokhu kuhlanganiswe kube yi-fiber engu-30 nm, okuwububanzi besakhiwo. Esigabeni se-metaphase, ama-chromosome aqinile kakhulu, angaba ngu-700 nm ububanzi, futhi atholakala ehlangene namaprotheni e-scaffold.

 Esigabeni esiphakathi, ama-chromosome e-eukaryotic anezindawo ezimbili ezihlukile ezingahlukaniswa ngokudaya. Indawo ehlanganiswe ngokuqinile yaziwa ngokuthi i-heterochromatin, kanti indawo engaphansi kakhulu yaziwa ngokuthi i-euchromatin. I-Heterochromatin ivame ukuqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezingavezwa, futhi itholakala ezindaweni ze-centromere kanye ne-telomeres. I-euchromatin ivame ukuqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezibhalwe phansi, ne-DNA ehlanganiswe eduze kwama-nucleosome kodwa engahlanganiswanga kakhulu.

question16: Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, ukwakheka kwe-DNA ne-RNA kwenzeka endaweni ehlukile ekuhlanganisweni kwamaprotheni. Kumaseli e-prokaryotic, zombili izinqubo zenzeka ndawonye. Yiziphi izinzuzo ezingaba khona zokuhlukanisa izinqubo? Yiziphi izinzuzo ezingaba khona zokuba zenzeke ndawonye?
answer16: Ukuhlukanisa amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic kwenza kube nokwakhiwa kwamaprotheni ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kanye nemikhiqizo ye-RNA. Kuma-prokaryotes, inzuzo ukuthi ukwenziwa kwe-RNA kanye namaprotheni kwenzeka ngokushesha kakhulu ngoba kwenzeka endaweni eyodwa.
distractor16a: Ukuhlukanisa amangqamuzana e-prokaryotic kwenza kube nokwakhiwa kwamaprotheni ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kanye nemikhiqizo ye-RNA. Kuma-eukaryotes, inzuzo ukuthi ukwakheka kwe-RNA kanye namaprotheni kwenzeka ngokushesha kakhulu ngoba kwenzeka endaweni eyodwa.
distractor16b: Ukuhlukanisa amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic kwenza kube nokwakhiwa kwamaprotheni alula kanye nemikhiqizo ye-RNA. Kuma-prokaryotes, inzuzo iwukuba amaprotheni alula kanye nemikhiqizo ye-RNA ngoba ayinkimbinkimbi awadingeki.
distractor16c: Ukuhlukanisa amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic kwenza kube nokwakhiwa kwamaprotheni ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kanye nemikhiqizo ye-RNA. Kuma-prokaryotes, inzuzo ukuthi ukwenziwa kwe-RNA kanye namaprotheni kuthatha isikhathi eside ngoba kwenzeka endaweni eyodwa.

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.3 Izisekelo Zokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Imodeli kaWatson noCrick yaphakamisa indlela i-DNA engaphindaphindwa ngayo ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Ngokuyisisekelo, le migqa emibili iyakhululeka futhi ihlukane lapho izibopho ze-hydrogen zixhumanisa khona ama-nucleotide. Intambo ngayinye yomzali ibe isisebenza njengethempulethi yentambo entsha, ehambisanayo yendodakazi. Ukuphindaphinda kuthiwa kuyinto egcinayo ngoba ulwazi lokuqala olufakwe kuntambo ngayinye yomzali lugcinwa (lugcinwe) kuma-molecule endodakazi. Ngakho-ke, i-molecule entsha ye-DNA iqukethe "intambo"eyodwa endala kanye nentambo entsha. UMeselson noStahl basebenzise umehluko wobuningi kuma-isotope e-nitrogen ukuze bahlole ukuphindaphinda, futhi ukuhlolwa kwabo kwasekela imodeli ye-semi-conservative. Kodwa-ke, inqubo yokuphindaphinda iyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunencazelo elula yemodeli yabo.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.3 Izisekelo Zokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA | Ukucaciswa kwesakhiwo se-double helix
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.3 Izisekelo Zokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA | Ukucaciswa kwesakhiwo se-double helix
chapterContent:
Ukucaciswa kwesakhiwo se-double helix kunikeze umbono wokuthi i-DNA ihlukana kanjani futhi yenze amakhophi ayo. Lo modeli usikisela ukuthi imicu emibili ye-double helix iyahlukana ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa, futhi umucu ngamunye usebenza njengethempulethi lapho kukopishwa khona umucu omusha ohambisanayo. Okwakungacaci ukuthi ukuphindaphindwa kwenzeke kanjani. Kwakunamamodeli amathathu aphakanyisiwe (Isithombe 14.12): ogcinayo, ogcinayo kancane, kanye nohlakazayo.

 Ekuphindaphindweni ogcinayo, i-DNA yomzali ihlala ndawonye, futhi imicu yendodakazi esanda kwakheka ihlangene. Indlela egcinayo kancane isikisela ukuthi umucu ngamunye we-DNA yomzali usebenza njengethempulethi yokuthi i-DNA entsha yenziwe; ngemuva kokuphindaphindwa, i-DNA ngayinye enemicu emibili ihlanganisa umucu owodwa womzali noma omdala kanye nomucu owodwa omusha. Kumodeli yokuhlakaza, womabili amakhophi e-DNA anezingxenye ezimbili ze-DNA yomzali kanye ne-DNA esanda kuhlanganiswa ehlanganisiwe.

 UMeselson noStahl babenesifiso sokuqonda ukuthi i-DNA iphindaphindwa kanjani. Bakhulisa i-E. coli izizukulwane eziningana endaweni equkethe i-isotope esindayo ye-nitrogen (15N) efakwa ezisekelweni ze-nitrogen, futhi ekugcineni ibe yi-DNA (Isithombe 14.13).

 Isiko le-E. coli labe selishintshwa laba yindawo equkethe i-14N futhi lavunyelwa ukukhula isizukulwane esisodwa. Amaseli avunwa futhi i-DNA yahlukaniswa. I-DNA yafakwa phakathi ngesivinini esiphezulu ku-ultracentrifuge. Amanye amaseli avunyelwa ukukhula komunye umjikelezo wokuphila ku-14N futhi aphinde ajikelezwe. Ngesikhathi se-density gradient centrifugation, i-DNA ilayishwa ku-gradient (ngokuvamile usawoti ofana ne-cesium chloride noma i-sucrose) futhi ijikelezwe ngesivinini esiphezulu esingu-50,000 kuya ku-60,000 rpm. Ngaphansi kwalezi zimo, i-DNA izokwakha ibhendi ngokuya ngobuningi bayo ku-gradient. I-DNA ekhuliswe ku-15N izongena endaweni ephakeme yobuningi kunaleyo ekhuliswe ku-14N. UMeselson noStahl baphawula ukuthi ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa sokukhula ku-14N ngemva kokuba sebeshintshiwe kusuka 15N, ibhendi elilodwa elibonwe laliphakathi nendawo phakathi kwe-DNA yamaseli akhuliswe ku-15N kanye no-14N kuphela. Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi imodi yokuphindaphinda e-semi-conservative noma e-dispersive. I-DNA eqoqwe kumaseli akhuliswe izizukulwane ezimbili ku-14N yakha amabhendi amabili: ibhendi elilodwa le-DNA lalisendaweni ephakathi kwe-15N kanye no-14N, kanti elinye lalihambisana nebhendi le-DNA ye-14N. Le miphumela ingachazwa kuphela uma i-DNA iphindaphinda ngendlela e-semi-conservative. Ngakho-ke, ezinye izindlela ezimbili zakhishwa.

 Ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA, izintambo ezimbili ezakha i-double helix zisebenza njengethempulethi lapho kukopishwa khona izintambo ezintsha. Intambo entsha izohambisana nentambo yomzali noma endala. Lapho kwakhiwa amakhophi amabili e-DNA yendodakazi, anokulandelana okufanayo futhi ahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo kumaseli amabili endodakazi.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.4 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Prokaryotes | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.4 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Prokaryotes | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunokumane uvule i-double helix bese wenza imicu emisha ehambisanayo. Ukuphindaphindwa kuma-prokaryotes kuqala ngokulandelana kwama-nucleotide ku-chromosome okubizwa ngokuthi umsuka wokuphindaphindwa—indawo lapho i-DNA ivuleka noma ivuleka khona. I-enzyme helicase ivula i-DNA endaweni lapho izibopho ze-hydrogen zixhuma khona imicu, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwefoloko lokuphindaphindwa elinomumo ka-Y. Amaprotheni okubopha imicu eyodwa agcina ifoloko livulekile. I-enzyme primase ihlanganisa ama-primer e-RNA ukuze iqalise ukwenziwa kwe-DNA yi-DNA polymerase, engangeza ama-nucleotide kuphela ohlangothini lwe-5 kuya ku-3. I-DNA polymerase ibona ukuphela kwe-3-OH njengendawo yayo yokufika; ngakho-ke, i-polymerase ifunda "umucu wethempulethi ohlangothini lwe-3 kuya ku-5 futhi yakha i-polymer ye-DNA ehambisanayo ohlangothini lwe-5 kuya ku-3. Umucu owodwa—obizwa ngokuthi umucu oholayo—wenziwa ngokuqhubekayo ohlangothini lwe-replication fork (indlela lapho i-helicase ihlukanisa khona imicu emibili), i-polymerase ifaka ama-nucleotide amasha ngamunye ngamunye. Kodwa-ke, ukuphindaphindwa komunye umucu—obizwa ngokuthi umucu ohlala ukhona—kwenzeka ohlangothini olukude ne-replication fork, ezindaweni ezimfushane ze-DNA eyaziwa ngokuthi izingcezu ze-Okazaki. (Cabanga ngemisebenzi emucu ohlala ukhona njengefana nokuzama ukuhamba endleleni ehambayo ehamba ngakolunye uhlangothi.) Ama-primer e-RNA athathelwa indawo ama-nucleotide e-DNA, futhi i-ligase ivala i-DNA, idale izibopho ze-phosphodiester phakathi kwe-3-OH kolunye uhlangothi kanye ne-5-phosphate yolunye umucu. Ama-molecule e-DNA aphindaphindwayo manje aqukethe umucu owodwa wethempulethi wokuqala kanye nomucu owodwa osanda kuhlanganiswa.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo ezigqanyisiwe esigabeni, imiqondo yokusekela echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.4 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Prokaryotes
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.4 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Prokaryotes
chapterContent:
Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kufundwe kahle kakhulu kuma-prokaryotes ikakhulukazi ngenxa yobukhulu obuncane be-genome kanye nama-mutant atholakalayo. I-E. coli inama-base pair ayizigidi ezingu-4.6 ku-chromosome eyodwa eyindilinga futhi konke kuphindaphindwa cishe ngemizuzu engu-42, kusukela emsuka owodwa wokuphindaphindwa futhi kuqhubeke kuzungeze indilinga kuzo zombili izinhlangothi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kunezelwa cishe ama-nucleotide ayi-1000 ngomzuzwana. Inqubo ishesha kakhulu futhi yenzeka ngaphandle kwamaphutha amaningi.

 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kusebenzisa inani elikhulu lamaprotheni nama-enzyme, ngalinye lidlala indima ebalulekile phakathi nenqubo. Omunye wabadlali ababalulekile yi-enzyme i-DNA polymerase, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-DNA pol, enezela ama-nucleotide ngayinye kuchungechunge lwe-DNA olukhulayo oluhambisana nentambo yethempulethi. Ukwengezwa kwama-nucleotide kudinga amandla; la mandla atholakala kuma-nucleotide anama-phosphate amathathu anamathiselwe kuwo, afana ne-ATP enamaqembu amathathu e-phosphate anamathiselwe. Uma isibopho phakathi kwama-phosphate siphukile, amandla akhishwayo asetshenziselwa ukwakha isibopho se-phosphodiester phakathi kwe-nucleotide engenayo kanye nochungechunge olukhulayo. Kuma-prokaryotes, izinhlobo ezintathu eziyinhloko zama-polymerase zaziwa: i-DNA pol I, i-DNA pol II, kanye ne-DNA pol III. Manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi i-DNA pol III iyi-enzyme edingekayo ekuhlanganisweni kwe-DNA; i-DNA pol I kanye ne-DNA pol II ziyadingeka kakhulu ekulungisweni.

 Umshini wokuphindaphinda wazi kanjani ukuthi uqale kuphi? Kuvela ukuthi kunezilandelana ezithile ze-nucleotide ezibizwa ngokuthi izizinda zokuphindaphinda lapho ukuphindaphinda kuqala khona. Ku-E. coli, enomthombo owodwa wokuphindaphinda ku-chromosome yayo eyodwa (njengoba kwenza ama-prokaryotes amaningi), cishe ingama-base pair angu-245 ubude futhi icebile ngezilandelana ze-AT. Imvelaphi yokuphindaphinda iqashelwa ngamaprotheni athile abopha kule ndawo. I-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-helicase ikhulula i-DNA ngokuphula izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwezilandelana ze-nitrogenous base. I-ATP hydrolysis iyadingeka kule nqubo. Njengoba i-DNA ivuleka, kwakheka izakhiwo ezibunjwe ngo-Y ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-replication forks. Ama-replication forks amabili akhiwa ekuqaleni kokuphindaphinda futhi lawa anwetshwa ngendlela ephindwe kabili njengoba ukuphindaphinda kuqhubeka. Amaprotheni okubopha umucu owodwa amboza imicu eyodwa ye-DNA eduze kwe-replication fork ukuvimbela i-single-strand ukuthi ibuyele emuva ibe yi-double helix. I-DNA polymerase iyakwazi ukwengeza ama-nucleotide kuphela ohlangothini lwe-5 kuya ku-3 (umucu omusha we-DNA unganwetshwa kuphela kulolu hlangothi). Idinga futhi iqembu le-3-OH lamahhala lapho ingangeza khona ama-nucleotide ngokwakha isibopho se-phosphodiester phakathi kokuphela kwe-3-OH kanye ne-5 phosphate ye-nucleotide elandelayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ayikwazi ukwengeza ama-nucleotide uma iqembu le-3-OH lamahhala lingatholakali. Khona-ke iyifaka kanjani i-nucleotide yokuqala? Inkinga ixazululwa ngosizo lwe-primer enikeza ukuphela kwe-3-OH kwamahhala. Enye i-enzyme, i-RNA primase, ihlanganisa i-RNA primer engaba ama-nucleotide amahlanu kuya kwayishumi ubude futhi ehambisana ne-DNA. Ngenxa yokuthi lolu chungechunge luhlanganisa ukwakheka kwe-DNA, lubizwa ngokufanele ngokuthi i-primer. I-DNA polymerase manje inganweba le-RNA primer, ingeze ama-nucleotide ngalinye ngalinye elihambisana ne-template strand (Isithombe 14.14).

 I-replication fork ihamba ngesivinini sama-nucleotide ayi-1000 ngomzuzwana. I-DNA polymerase inganweba kuphela ohlangothini lwe-5 kuya ku-3, okudala inkinga encane ku-replication fork. Njengoba sazi, i-DNA double helix ayihambisani; okungukuthi, i-strand eyodwa isendleleni ye-5 kuya ku-3 kanti enye iqondiswe ohlangothini lwe-3 kuya ku-5. I-strand eyodwa, ehambisana ne-DNA parent strand engu-3 kuya ku-5, ihlanganiswa njalo ibheke ku-replication fork ngoba i-polymerase ingangeza ama-nucleotide kulolu hlangothi. Le strand ehlanganiswa njalo yaziwa njenge-strand ehamba phambili. Enye intambo, ehambisana ne-DNA yabazali engu-5 kuya ku-3, inwetshwa kude nefoloko lokuphindaphinda, ngezingcezu ezincane ezaziwa ngokuthi izingcezu ze-Okazaki, ngayinye idinga i-primer ukuqala ukwenziwa. Izingcezu ze-Okazaki ziqanjwe ngososayensi waseJapan owazithola okokuqala. Intambo enezingcezu ze-Okazaki yaziwa ngokuthi intambo ehlala isikhathi eside.

 Intambo ehamba phambili inganwetshwa nge-primer eyodwa kuphela, kanti intambo ehlala isikhathi eside idinga i-primer entsha yezingcezu ze-Okazaki ezimfushane. Isiqondiso esiphelele sentambo ehlala isikhathi eside sizoba ngu-3 kuya ku-5, kanti eyentambo ehamba phambili izoba ngu-5 kuya ku-3. Iphrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-sliding clamp ibamba i-DNA polymerase endaweni yayo njengoba iqhubeka nokwengeza ama-nucleotide. I-sliding clamp iyiphrotheni emise okwendandatho ebopha i-DNA futhi ibambe i-polymerase endaweni yayo. I-Topoisomerase ivimbela ukugoqa ngokweqile kwe-DNA double helix ngaphambi kwefoloko lokuphindaphinda njengoba i-DNA ivuleka; yenza lokho ngokubangela ukugoqa kwesikhashana ku-DNA helix bese iyivala kabusha. Njengoba ukwenziwa kuqhubeka, ama-primer e-RNA athathelwa indawo yi-DNA. Ama-primer asuswa ngumsebenzi we-exonuclease we-DNA pol I, kanti izikhala zigcwaliswa yi-deoxyribonucleotides. Ama-nick asele phakathi kwe-DNA esanda kuhlanganiswa (ethathe indawo ye-RNA primer) kanye ne-DNA enziwe ngaphambilini avalwa yi-enzyme i-DNA ligase ekhuthaza ukwakheka kokuxhumana kwe-phosphodiester phakathi kokuphela kwe-3-OH kwe-nucleotide eyodwa kanye nokuphela kwe-phosphate okungu-5 kwesinye isiqeshana.

 Uma i-chromosome isiphindaphindwe ngokuphelele, amakhophi amabili e-DNA athuthela kumaseli amabili ahlukene ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Inqubo yokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ingafingqwa kanje:

 I-DNA iyavuleka ekuqaleni kokuphindaphinda.
I-Helicase ivula ama-fork okuphindaphinda okwakha i-DNA; lawa anwetshwa ngendlela ephindwe kabili.
Amaprotheni okubopha umucu owodwa amboza i-DNA ezungeze i-fork yokuphindaphinda ukuvimbela ukubuyela emuva kwe-DNA.
I-Topoisomerase ibopha endaweni engaphambi kwefoloko yokuphindaphinda ukuze ivimbele ukugoqana.
I-Primase ihlanganisa ama-primer e-RNA ahambisana nentambo ye-DNA.
I-DNA polymerase iqala ukwengeza ama-nucleotide ekugcineni kwe-3-OH kwentambo.
Ukwelulwa kokubili kwentambo ebambekayo kanye nentambo ehamba phambili kuyaqhubeka.
Ama-primer e-RNA asuswa ngumsebenzi we-exonuclease.
Izikhala zigcwaliswa yi-DNA pol ngokungeza ama-dNTP.
Igebe phakathi kwezingcezu ezimbili ze-DNA livalwe yi-DNA ligase, esiza ekwakhekeni kwezibopho ze-phosphodiester.

 Ithebula elingezansi lifingqa ama-enzyme ahilelekile ekuphindaphindweni kwe-prokaryotic DNA kanye nemisebenzi yento ngayinye.

 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-Prokaryotic DNA: Ama-Enzyme kanye Nemisebenzi Yawo
I-Enzyme/iphrotheni
Umsebenzi Othile

 I-DNA pol I
Umsebenzi we-Exonuclease ususa i-RNA primer bese uthatha indawo ye-DNA esanda kuhlanganiswa

 I-DNA pol II
Umsebenzi wokulungisa

 I-DNA pol III
I-enzyme eyinhloko enezela ama-nucleotide ohlangothini lwe-5-3

 I-Helicase
Ivula i-DNA helix ngokuphula izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwezisekelo ze-nitrogenous

 I-Ligase
Ivala izikhala phakathi kwezingcezu ze-Okazaki ukuze idale umucu owodwa we-DNA oqhubekayo

 I-Primase
Ihlanganisa ama-primer e-RNA adingekayo ukuqala ukuphindaphinda

Isiza ukubamba i-DNA polymerase endaweni lapho kufakwa ama-nucleotide

 I-Topoisomerase
Kusiza ekunciphiseni ukucindezeleka ku-DNA lapho kuqaqeka ngokubangela ukuqhekeka bese kuvalwa kabusha i-DNA

Amaprotheni okubopha umucu owodwa (SSB)
 Kubopha ku-DNA enemucu owodwa ukuze kugwenywe ukubuyela emuva kwe-DNA.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.5 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.5 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Imiqondo nezibonelo ezichazwe kulesi sigaba azikho emkhakheni we-AP. Kodwa-ke, izindima zama-telomeres nama-telomerase ekugugeni nasemdlavuza ziyafundisa futhi zakha ulwazi lwakho ngokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-prokaryotes.

 Ama-genome e-Eukaryotic ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu futhi makhulu ngobukhulu kunama-genome e-prokaryotic. I-genome yomuntu inama-base pair ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezintathu ngesethi yama-haploid yama-chromosome, kanti ama-base pair ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyisithupha ayaphindaphindwa ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S somjikelezo weseli. Kunemvelaphi eminingi yokuphindaphindwa ku-chromosome ye-eukaryotic; abantu bangaba nemvelaphi yokuphindaphindwa efika ku-100,000. Izinga lokuphindaphindwa licishe libe yi-nucleotide eyi-100 ngomzuzwana, okuhamba kancane kakhulu kunokuphindaphindwa kwe-prokaryotic. Ku-yeast, okuyi-eukaryote, ama-sequences akhethekile aziwa ngokuthi yi-Autonomously Replicating Sequences (ARS) atholakala kuma-chromosome. Lokhu kufana nomsuka wokuphindaphindwa ku-E. coli.

 Inani lama-DNA polymerase kuma-eukaryotes lingaphezu kakhulu kwama-prokaryotes: angu-14 ayaziwa, amahlanu kuwo aziwa ukuthi anezindima ezinkulu ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda futhi afundwe kahle. Aziwa ngokuthi ama-pol α, pol β, pol γ, pol δ, kanye nama-pol ε.

 Izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuphindaphinda ziyafana nakuma-prokaryotes. Ngaphambi kokuba ukuphindaphinda kuqale, i-DNA kufanele yenziwe itholakale njengethempulethi. I-Eukaryotic DNA iboshelwe kumaphrotheni ayisisekelo aziwa ngokuthi ama-histones ukwakha izakhiwo ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-nucleosomes. I-chromatin (inhlanganisela phakathi kwe-DNA namaphrotheni) ingase ishintshe amakhemikhali athile, ukuze i-DNA ikwazi ukushelela kumaphrotheni noma ifinyeleleke kuma-enzyme omshini wokuphindaphinda we-DNA. Ekuqaleni kokuphindaphinda, kwenziwa i-pre-replication complex namanye amaphrotheni okuqala. Amanye amaphrotheni abe eseqashwa ukuqala inqubo yokuphindaphinda (Umehluko weThebula phakathi kwe-Prokaryotic kanye ne-Eukaryotic Replication ngezansi).

 I-helicase esebenzisa amandla avela ku-ATP hydrolysis ivula i-DNA helix. Amafoloko okuphindaphinda akhiwa endaweni ngayinye yokuphindaphindeka njengoba i-DNA ihlukana. Ukuvulwa kwe-double helix kubangela ukugoqa ngokweqile, noma i-supercoiling, ku-DNA ngaphambi kwefoloko lokuphindaphinda. Lokhu kuxazululwa ngesenzo sama-topoisomerases. Ama-primer akhiwa yi-enzyme primase, futhi kusetshenziswa i-primer, i-DNA pol ingaqala ukwenziwa. Ngenkathi intambo ehamba phambili ihlanganiswa njalo yi-enzyme pol δ, intambo ebambekayo ihlanganiswa yi-pol ε. Iphrotheni ye-sliding clamp eyaziwa ngokuthi i-PCNA (Proliferating Cell Nuclear Antigen) ibamba i-DNA pol endaweni yayo ukuze ingasheleli ku-DNA. I-RNase H isusa i-RNA primer, bese ithathelwa indawo yi-DNA nucleotides. Izingcezu ze-Okazaki ku-lagging strand zihlanganiswa ndawonye ngemva kokufakwa esikhundleni kwama-RNA primers nge-DNA. Izikhala ezisele zivalwe yi-DNA ligase, eyakha isibopho se-phosphodiester.

 Umehluko phakathi kokuphindaphinda kwe-Prokaryotic kanye ne-Eukaryotic

5_____14

question1: Uchwepheshe welebhu uqhathanisa ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA yebhaktheriya nokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA yomuntu. Kungani ama-chromosome abantu edinga imvelaphi eminingi yokuphindaphindwa?
answer1: Ama-chromosome abantu makhulu, ngakho-ke imvelaphi eminingi ivumela ukuphindaphindeka ukuthi kwenzeke kahle kulo lonke i-genome.
distractor1a: Ama-chromosome abantu ayindilinga, ngakho-ke i-chromosome ngayinye idinga imvelaphi eyodwa nge-gene ngayinye
distractor1b: I-DNA polymerase yomuntu ingakhiqiza i-DNA kuphela ohlangothini lwe-3 kuya ku-5
distractor1c: Amangqamuzana omuntu awasebenzisi amafoloko okuphindaphinda ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
question2: Ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S esiseleni somuntu, cishe ingakanani i-DNA ephindaphindwayo esiseleni se-diploid?
question3: Umcwaningi uthola ukuthi i-chromosome yemvubelo iqukethe i-Autonomously Replicating Sequences. Uyini umsebenzi walezi zilandelaniso?
answer3: Zisebenza njengemvelaphi yokuphindaphinda
distractor3b: Basusa ama-primer e-RNA ku-DNA esanda kwenziwa
question4: Ngaphambi kokuba i-DNA ye-eukaryotic ikwazi ukuphindaphindwa, kungani kufanele kushintshwe isakhiwo se-chromatin?
answer4: I-DNA ehlanganiswe nama-histones kumele itholakale kuma-enzyme okuphindaphinda
distractor4a: Ama-Histones kumele akopishe i-DNA ngaphambi kokuba i-polymerase ikwazi ukubopha
distractor4b: I-Chromatin kumele iguqulwe ibe ama-chromosome ayindilinga
distractor4c: Izisekelo ze-DNA kumele zishintshwe zibe izisekelo ze-RNA
question5: Umuthi uvimba umsebenzi we-helicase ekuhlukaniseni amaseli e-eukaryotic. Yisiphi isinyathelo sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA esingathinteka kakhulu?
answer5: Ukuvulwa kwe-DNA double helix kumafoloko okuphindaphinda
question6: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela i-topoisomerase ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ye-eukaryotic. Iyiphi inkinga okungenzeka ukuthi ivele?
answer6: I-Supercoiling izokwakheka ngaphambi kwefoloko yokuphindaphinda
distractor6b: I-DNA polymerase izoqala ukuhlanganisa i-RNA esikhundleni se-DNA
question7: Isazi sezinto eziphilayo zamaseli siphawula ukuthi i-DNA polymerase iyaqhubeka nokuwa entanjeni yethempulethi ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindeka. Yiliphi iphrotheni okungenzeka ukuthi ayisebenzi kahle?
answer7: I-PCNA sliding clamp
question8: Ngesikhathi sokwenziwa kwe-lagging-strand, ama-primer e-RNA kumele asuswe ngaphambi kokuba kuhlanganiswe izingcezu. Yimuphi i-enzyme osusa la ma-primer e-RNA?
answer8: I-RNase H
question9: Umfundi ubonisa ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ye-eukaryotic futhi ubonisa izikhala ezisele phakathi kwezingcezu ze-Okazaki ngemva kokuba ama-primer e-RNA ethathelwe indawo yi-DNA. Yimuphi i-enzyme okufanele ifakwe ukuze kuqedwe imodeli?
answer9: I-DNA ligase
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kangcono inqubo yonke yokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes?
answer10: Izinyathelo ezibalulekile ziyafana, kodwa ukuphindaphinda kwe-eukaryotic kuhilela ama-chromosome amakhulu, i-chromatin, imvelaphi eminingi, kanye nama-DNA polymerase amaningi.
distractor10a: Ama-Eukaryote asebenzisa i-RNA njengethempulethi yezakhi zofuzo, kuyilapho ama-prokaryote esebenzisa i-DNA
distractor10b: Ama-prokaryotes adinga ama-histone nama-nucleosome, kuyilapho ama-eukaryotes engawadingi
distractor10c: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ye-Eukaryotic akudingi ama-primer noma amafoloko okuphindaphinda

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.5 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-Telomere
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.5 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-Telomere
chapterContent:
Bheka Umfanekiso 14.15. Ngokungafani nama-chromosome e-prokaryotic, ama-chromosome e-eukaryotic aqondile. Njengoba usufundile, i-enzyme i-DNA pol ingangeza ama-nucleotide kuphela ohlangothini lwe-5 kuya ku-3. Ku-strand ehamba phambili, ukwenziwa kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho kufinyelelwa ekugcineni kwe-chromosome. Ku-strand engemuva, i-DNA yenziwa ngezikhawu ezimfushane, ngayinye eqalwa yi-primer ehlukile. Lapho ifoloko lokuphindaphinda lifika ekugcineni kwe-chromosome eqondile, akukho ndawo lapho i-primer ingakopishwa khona ekugcineni kwe-chromosome eqondile. Ngakho-ke lezi ziphetho zihlala zingabhangqiwe, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi lezi ziphetho zingaba zifushane kancane kancane njengoba amaseli eqhubeka nokuhlukana.

 Iziphetho zama-chromosome aqondile zaziwa ngokuthi ama-telomere, anezilandelana eziphindaphindayo ezikhombe i-gene ethile. Ngandlela thile, la ma-telomere avikela izakhi zofuzo ekususweni njengoba amaseli eqhubeka nokuhlukana. Kubantu, i-six base pair sequence, i-TTAGGG, iphindwa izikhathi eziyi-100 kuya kweziyi-1000. Ukutholakala kwe-enzyme i-telomerase (Isithombe 14.16) kusize ekuqondeni ukuthi iziphetho ze-chromosome zigcinwa kanjani. I-enzyme ye-telomerase iqukethe ingxenye ye-catalytic kanye nethempulethi ye-RNA eyakhelwe ngaphakathi. Inamathela ekugcineni kwe-chromosome, futhi izisekelo ezihambisanayo kwithempulethi ye-RNA zengezwa eziphethweni ezi-3 ze-DNA strand. Uma iziphetho ezi-3 zethempulethi ye-strand elagging sezinde ngokwanele, i-DNA polymerase ingangeza ama-nucleotide ahambisanayo eziphethweni zama-chromosome. Ngakho-ke, iziphetho zama-chromosome ziyaphindaphindwa.

 I-Telomerase ivame ukusebenza kumaseli egciwane kanye namaseli e-stem amadala. Ayisebenzi kumaseli e-somatic amadala. Ngokuthola kwakhe i-telomerase kanye nokusebenza kwayo, u-Elizabeth Blackburn (Isithombe 14.16) wathola uMklomelo weNobel weMithi kanye nePhysiology ngo-2009
question1: Umcwaningi uqhathanisa ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-chromosome ebhaktheriya nawesintu. Kungani ama-chromosome abantu edinga indlela yokugcina iziphetho ze-chromosome kuyilapho ama-chromosome ebhaktheriya ngokuvamile engadingi?
answer1: Ama-chromosome abantu aqondile, ngakho-ke iziphetho zawo azikwazi ukuphindaphindwa ngokugcwele ngemva komjikelezo ngamunye wokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
distractor1a: Ama-chromosome abantu aqukethe i-RNA esikhundleni se-DNA emaphethelweni awo
distractor1b: I-polymerase ye-DNA yebhaktheriya ingakhiqiza i-DNA kuzo zombili izinhlangothi
question2: Kungani ama-telomere eba mafushane kumaseli amaningi omzimba ngemva kokuhlukana kwamaseli ngokuphindaphindiwe?
answer2: I-primer yokugcina ye-RNA emugqeni osele emuva ayinakushintshwa yi-DNA ekugcineni kwe-chromosome.
distractor2a: I-DNA polymerase isusa ama-telomere ngemva komjikelezo ngamunye wokuphindaphinda
distractor2b: Ukwenziwa kwe-leading-strand kuyama ngaphambi kokufinyelela ekugcineni kwe-chromosome
distractor2c: I-Topoisomerase inquma iziphetho ze-chromosome ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda
question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-telomere?
answer3: Zivikela izakhi zofuzo ekulahlekeni njengoba ama-chromosome efinyela ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okuphindaphindiwe
distractor3a: Babhala amaphrotheni abalulekile ahilelekile ekuphindaphindweni kwe-DNA
distractor3c: Banamathisela ama-chromosomes ku-spindle fibers ngesikhathi se-mitosis
question4: Usosayensi uthola uguquko olukhubaza ngokuphelele i-telomerase. Yimaphi amangqamuzana angathinteka kakhulu ngqo?
answer4: Amaseli egciwane kanye namaseli okuqala abantu abadala
question5: Yisiphi isici esivumela i-telomerase ukuthi yandise iziphetho ze-chromosome?
answer5: Iqukethe ithempulethi yangaphakathi ye-RNA esetshenziselwa ukuhlanganisa ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
distractor5a: Iphethe ama-primer amaningi e-DNA ukuze ikopishwe
question6: Ngemva kokuba i-telomerase yandise ingxenye yesithathu ye-chromosome, yini engase yenzeke ngokulandelayo?
answer6: I-DNA polymerase ihlanganisa umucu we-DNA ohambisanayo
distractor6a: I-RNA polymerase iguqula i-telomere ibe yi-RNA
distractor6c: I-Helicase isusa ukuphindaphinda kwe-telomere okusanda kuhlanganiswa
question7: Kutholakale ukuthi iseli lomdlavuza linomsebenzi we-telomerase ophakeme ngendlela engavamile. Lokhu cishe kuzuzisa kanjani iseli lomdlavuza?
answer7: Kuyasiza ukugcina ubude be-telomere, okuvumela iseli ukuthi liqhubeke nokuhlukana
distractor7b: Iqeda zonke izinguquko ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
question8: Kungani ukulandelana kwama-telomere kuvame ukuchazwa njenge-DNA engabhalisi ikhodi?
answer8: Ziqukethe ukulandelana kwe-DNA okuphindaphindiwe okungafaki ikhodi yamaprotheni
distractor8b: Ziyasuswa ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor8c: Ziqukethe ama-intron kuphela avela ku-genes-coding genes
question9: Umfundi uthi i-telomerase iyasebenza kuwo wonke amangqamuzana omuntu kukho konke ukuphila. Yisiphi isitatimende esilungisa kangcono lesi simangalo?
answer9: I-Telomerase isebenza kakhulu kumaseli egciwane kanye namaseli e-stem abantu abadala, kodwa ngokuvamile ayisebenzi kumaseli amaningi abantu abadala asebenza ngokomzimba.
distractor9b: I-Telomerase isebenza kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA yombungu futhi ngeke isetshenziswe ngemva kwalokho.
question10: Kungani ama-telomere enciphisa ingozi yokulahlekelwa ulwazi olubalulekile lwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA?
answer10: Ukulandelana kwazo okuphindaphindiwe kungafinyezwa ngaphandle kokususa izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni
distractor10a: Zivimbela i-DNA polymerase ukuthi ifinyelele emaphethelweni e-chromosome
distractor10c: Zithatha indawo yazo zonke izakhi zofuzo ezonakele ngemva kokuhlukaniswa kweseli ngakunye

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.5 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-Telomere | I-Telomerase kanye nokuguga
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye nomsebenzi | 14.5 Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-Telomere | I-Telomerase kanye nokuguga
chapterContent:
Amaseli ahlukaniswa ngamaseli ayaqhubeka nokuba nama-telomere awo afinyezwe ngoba iningi lamaseli omzimba awenzi i-telomerase. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukufinyezwa kwama-telomere kuhlotshaniswa nokuguga. Ngokufika kwemithi yesimanje, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuvimbelayo, kanye nendlela yokuphila enempilo, isikhathi sokuphila komuntu sikhulile, futhi kunesidingo esikhulayo sokuba abantu babukeke bebancane futhi babe nekhwalithi engcono yokuphila njengoba bekhula.

 Ngo-2010, ososayensi bathole ukuthi i-telomerase ingaguqula ezinye izimo ezihlobene nokuguga kumagundane. Lokhu kungaba namandla kwezokwelapha ezivuselelayo.2 Amagundane antula i-telomerase asetshenziswa kulezi zifundo; la magundane anokuwohloka kwezicubu, ukuncipha kwamaseli esiqu, ukwehluleka kwesistimu yezitho, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwezimpendulo zokulimala kwezicubu. Ukuvuselelwa kwe-telomerase kula magundane kubangele ukwanda kwama-telomere, ukuncipha komonakalo we-DNA, ukuguqulwa kokuguga kwemizwa, futhi kuthuthukise ukusebenza kwama-testes, i-spleen, namathumbu. Ngakho-ke, ukuvuselelwa kwe-telomere kungaba namandla okwelapha izifo ezihlobene nokuguga kubantu.

 Umdlavuza ubonakala ngokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawuleki kwamaseli angajwayelekile. Amaseli aqoqa izinguquko, anda ngokungalawuleki, futhi angathuthela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomzimba ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-metastasis. Ososayensi baqaphele ukuthi amangqamuzana anomdlavuza anciphise kakhulu ama-telomere nokuthi i-telomerase iyasebenza kula maseli. Ngokuthakazelisayo, kuphela ngemva kokuba ama-telomere efinyeziwe emaseli omdlavuza lapho i-telomerase yaqala ukusebenza. Uma isenzo se-telomerase kula maseli singavinjelwa yimithi ngesikhathi sokwelashwa komdlavuza, khona-ke amangqamuzana anomdlavuza angamiswa ekuhlukaneni okuqhubekayo.

 Umehluko phakathi kokuphindaphinda kwe-Prokaryotic kanye ne-Eukaryotic
Impahla
Ama-Prokaryotes_____Ama-Eukaryotes

 Umsuka wokuphindaphinda
Okukodwa_____Okuningi

 Izinga lokuphindaphinda
Ama-nucleotide ayi-1000/s_____50 kuya ku-100 nucleotides/s

 Izinhlobo ze-DNA polymerase
5_____14

 I-Telomerase
Ayikho_____Ikhona

 Ukususwa kwe-primer ye-RNA
I-DNA pol I_____RNase H

 Ukunwebeka kwe-Strand
I-DNA pol III_____Pol δ, pol ε

 I-Sliding clamp
I-Sliding clamp_____PCNA
question1: Kungani ama-telomere ngokuvamile eba mafushane njengoba abantu bekhula?
answer1: Amaseli amaningi omzimba awakhiqizi i-telomerase, ngakho-ke ama-telomere ayafinyela ngokuhlukaniswa kweseli ngakunye
distractor1a: I-DNA polymerase isusa ama-telomere ngemva kwe-mitosis ngayinye
distractor1b: I-Telomerase inciphisa ama-telomere kumaseli amadala ngenkuthalo
distractor1c: Ama-histone alahleka kancane kancane emaphethelweni e-chromosome ngesikhathi sokuguga
question2: Ososayensi baphinde bavuselela i-telomerase emagundwini antula i-telomerase. Yayiyini imiphumela eyodwa ebalulekile?
answer2: Ama-Telomere ande futhi amaphutha amaningana ezicubu ahlobene nokuguga abuyiselwa emuva
distractor2a: Amagundane amisa ngokushesha konke ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
distractor2b: Ama-chromosome aba yindilinga esikhundleni sokuba aqondile
question3: Kungani izifundo ze-telomerase zibhekwa njengezithembisayo kwezokwelapha ezivuselelayo?
answer3: Ukubuyisela umsebenzi we-telomerase kungathuthukisa ukulungiswa kwezicubu futhi kubuyisele emuva umonakalo othile wamaseli ohlobene nokuguga
distractor3a: I-Telomerase ivimbela unomphela zonke izinguquko ze-DNA
distractor3b: I-Telomerase iguqula amangqamuzana omzimba abe amaseli egciwane ngqo
question4: Kungani i-telomerase ibhekwa njengenhloso yokwelapha umdlavuza?
answer4: Amaseli amaningi omdlavuza athembele ku-telomerase ukuze alondoloze ama-telomere futhi aqhubeke nokuhlukana unomphela
distractor4a: I-Telomerase ibangela ngqo zonke izinguquko ze-DNA ezitholakala kumdlavuza
distractor4c: I-Telomerase ivimbela amangqamuzana omdlavuza ukuthi angaphindaphindi i-DNA yawo
question5: Inkampani yemithi yakha umuthi ovimba umsebenzi we-telomerase ikakhulukazi kumaseli omdlavuza. Uyini umphumela olindelekile?
answer5: Amaseli omdlavuza ekugcineni azolahlekelwa ubude be-telomere futhi angakwazi ukuqhubeka nokuhlukana
distractor5a: Amaseli omdlavuza azolungisa ngokushesha wonke umonakalo we-DNA
distractor5b: Amaseli omdlavuza azoqala ukuhlukana ngokushesha okukhulu
distractor5c: Amaseli omdlavuza angaguqulwa abe amaseli ajwayelekile
question6: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kangcono ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes?
answer6: Zombili zisebenzisa izindlela ezifanayo zokuphindaphinda, kodwa ama-eukaryote anemvelaphi eminingi yokuphindaphinda kanye ne-telomerase
distractor6a: Ama-prokaryotes kuphela adinga i-DNA polymerase ukuze aphindaphindwe
distractor6c: Ama-prokaryotes aphindaphinda i-DNA ngaphandle kwamafoloko okuphindaphinda
question7: Umfundi uqhathanisa isivinini sokuphindaphinda kwamagciwane nakubantu. Yisiphi isitatimende esinembile?
answer7: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-Prokaryotic DNA kushesha kakhulu kunokuphindaphindwa kwe-eukaryotic DNA
distractor7a: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ye-Eukaryotic kushesha ngokuphindwe kayishumi kunokuphindaphinda kwe-prokaryotic
distractor7b: Zombili i-DNA ephindaphindayo cishe ngesilinganiso esifanayo
distractor7c: Ijubane lokuphindaphinda lincike kuphela kusayizi we-chromosome, hhayi ohlotsheni lwezinto eziphilayo
question8: Yimuphi i-enzyme esusa ama-primer e-RNA ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ye-eukaryotic?
answer8: I-RNase H
question9: Yiliphi iphrotheni elisebenza njenge-sliding clamp ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ye-eukaryotic?
answer9: I-PCNA
question10: Uma kuqhathaniswa nama-prokaryotes, kungani amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic edinga izinhlobo eziningi ze-DNA polymerases?
answer10: Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA ye-Eukaryotic kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu futhi kudinga ama-polymerase akhethekile emisebenzini ehlukene yokuphindaphinda
distractor10a: I-chromosome ngayinye idinga i-DNA polymerase ehlukile
distractor10b: Ama-polymerase e-Eukaryotic DNA akhiqiza kokubili i-DNA namaprotheni
distractor10c: Ama-Eukaryote aphindaphinda i-RNA esikhundleni se-DNA ngesikhathi sesigaba se-S

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.6 Ukulungiswa kwe-DNA | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.6 Ukulungiswa kwe-DNA | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
I-DNA polymerase iyi-enzyme esebenza kahle kodwa ingenza amaphutha ngenkathi ifaka ama-nucleotide ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa. Ihlela i-DNA ngokufunda kabusha zonke isisekelo esisha esengeziwe. Isisekelo esingalungile siyasuswa bese sithathelwa indawo yisisekelo esifanele. Uma isisekelo sihlala singalingani, ama-enzyme okulungisa akhethekile avame ukubona isisekelo esifakwe kabi, asikhiphe ku-DNA, bese esifaka esikhundleni sesisekelo esifanele. Amaphutha amaningi ayalungiswa, kodwa uma engekho angabangela ukuguqulwa, okuchazwa njengoshintsho oluhlala njalo kuchungechunge lwe-DNA. Ukuguqulwa kungadluliselwa kumaseli endodakazi ngokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kanye nokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli. Kunezinhlobo eziningana zokuguqulwa kwe-DNA, okuhlanganisa ukufaka esikhundleni, ukususa, ukufaka, kanye nokudluliselwa kwenye indawo. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo zokulungisa kungaholela emiphumeleni emibi, njengomdlavuza. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungabangelwa yizici zemvelo, njengemisebe ye-UV, noma kungenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo. (Sizohlola imiphumela yokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuningiliziwe esahlukweni esilandelayo. Khumbula ukuthi ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo akuhlali kulimaza. Kungaba nenzuzo, futhi. Izinguquko ku-DNA zandisa ukushintsha kwezakhi zofuzo—isisekelo sokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo.)

6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izizinda) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuhlala njalo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

3.C.1 Izinguquko kuhlobo lwe-genotype zingabangela izinguquko kuhlobo lwe-phenotype.

1.1 Umfundi angadala izethulo namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kulesi sizinda.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.25 Umfundi angadala isethulo esibonakalayo ukuze abonise ukuthi izinguquko kuchungechunge lwe-nucleotide ye-DNA zingaholela kanjani ekushintsheni ku-polypeptide ekhiqizwayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
