question1: Ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, i-DNA polymerase ifaka i-nucleotide engalungile. Yimuphi umshini ongase ulungise iphutha ngokushesha?
answer1: Ukuhlolwa kabusha yi-DNA polymerase kususa i-nucleotide engalungile bese kufakwa efanelekile esikhundleni sayo
distractor1a: I-DNA ligase ikhipha i-nucleotide engalungile bese ifaka efanele
distractor1b: I-Helicase ibuyisela emuva i-DNA kuze kube yilapho iphutha liphela
question2: Ukungafani kwe-DNA kuyaphunyuka ekufundeni amaphutha ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda. Yini okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi yenzeke ngokulandelayo?
answer2: Ama-enzyme okulungisa ukungalingani angase abone futhi athathe indawo ye-nucleotide engalungile
distractor2b: I-DNA polymerase iqala kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuphindaphindwa kusukela ekuqaleni
question3: Uma iphutha ku-DNA lingalungiswa ngaphambi komjikelezo olandelayo wokuphindaphindwa, yimuphi umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer3: Ukuguqulwa okuhlala njalo kungafakwa ochungechungeni lwe-DNA
question4: Umcwaningi uveza amangqamuzana akhuliswe emisebeni ye-ultraviolet (UV). Kungani lokhu kulindeleke ukuthi kwandise imvamisa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Imisebe ye-UV ingalimaza i-DNA, idale izinguquko uma umonakalo ungalungiswa
distractor4a: Imisebe ye-UV ikhulisa ngqo ukunemba kwe-DNA polymerase
distractor4b: Imisebe ye-UV iguqula i-DNA ibe yi-RNA
distractor4c: Imisebe ye-UV ivimbela ama-chromosome ukuthi angaphindaphindi
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuguqulwa kwe-DNA?
answer5: Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide eyengeziwe kuchungechunge lwe-DNA
question6: Isiguli sizuza ifa lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okubangela ukulungiswa kwe-DNA. Yimuphi umphumela okungenzeka kakhulu?
answer6: Ingozi eyengeziwe yokuqongelela izakhi zofuzo ezingaba nomthelela kumdlavuza
distractor6a: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA ngeke kusadinga i-DNA polymerase
distractor6b: Isiguli ngeke sikwazi ukwenza ukwakheka kwamaprotheni
question7: Umfundi uthi zonke izinguquko ziyingozi. Yisiphi isitatimende esihlola kangcono lesi simangalo?
answer7: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungaba yingozi, kungathathi hlangothi, noma kube nenzuzo kuye ngemiphumela yako
distractor7a: Zonke izinguquko ziyingozi ngoba zihlala zibangela izifo
distractor7b: Zonke izinguquko zezakhi zofuzo zithuthukisa impilo yomzimba
distractor7c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka kuphela ngenxa yokucindezeleka kwemvelo
question8: Kungani ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubhekwa njengokubalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo?
answer8: Zakha ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo lapho ukukhetha kwemvelo kungasebenza khona
distractor8a: Baqinisekisa ukuthi isizukulwane ngasinye sivumelana kangcono
question9: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo esikhundleni sazo kushintsha i-nucleotide eyodwa ku-gene. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer9: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA luyashintshwa futhi lungashintsha noma lungashintsha iphrotheni ephumayo
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani ukuhlolwa kokuhlolwa kanye nokulungiswa kwe-DNA kubalulekile?
answer10: Ndawonye zinciphisa kakhulu inani lezinguquko ezisele ku-genome ngemva kokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA.
distractor10c: Zisusa yonke imonakalo ye-DNA yemvelo ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukuphindaphindwa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.6 Ukulungiswa kwe-DNA | Izindlela Zokulungisa i-DNA kanye Nezinguquko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.6 Ukulungiswa kwe-DNA | Izindlela Zokulungisa i-DNA kanye Nezinguquko
chapterContent:
Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kuyinqubo enembe kakhulu, kodwa amaphutha angenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile, njengokufaka i-DNA polymerase esisekelweni esingalungile. Amaphutha angalungiswanga ngezinye izikhathi angase abangele imiphumela emibi kakhulu, njengomdlavuza. Izindlela zokulungisa zilungisa amaphutha. Ezimweni ezingavamile, amaphutha awalungiswa, okuholela ekuguqukeni; kwezinye izimo, ama-enzyme okulungisa ngokwawo aguquliwe noma anephutha.

 Amaphutha amaningi ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA alungiswa ngokushesha yi-DNA polymerase ngokuhlola isisekelo esisanda kungezwa (Isithombe 14.17). Ekuhlolweni kokuhlola, i-DNA pol ifunda isisekelo esisha esingeziwe ngaphambi kokwengeza esilandelayo, ukuze kwenziwe ukulungiswa. I-polymerase ihlola ukuthi isisekelo esisha esingeziwe sihambisane kahle nesisekelo esisesithenjini sethempulethi. Uma kuyisisekelo esifanele, kufakwe i-nucleotide elandelayo. Uma kufakwe isisekelo esingalungile, i-enzyme isika isibopho se-phosphodiester futhi ikhulule i-nucleotide engalungile. Lokhu kwenziwa ngesenzo se-exonuclease se-DNA pol III. Uma i-nucleotide engalungile isisusiwe, kuzongezwa entsha futhi.

 Amanye amaphutha awalungiswa ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda, kodwa esikhundleni salokho alungiswa ngemva kokuba ukuphindaphinda sekuqediwe; lolu hlobo lokulungisa lwaziwa ngokuthi ukulungiswa kokungalingani (Isithombe 14.18). Ama-enzyme ayayibona i-nucleotide engezwe ngendlela engafanele futhi ayikhiphe; lokhu kuthathelwa indawo yisisekelo esifanele. Uma lokhu kungalungiswa, kungaholela ekulimaleni okungapheli. Ama-enzyme okulungisa ukungalingani aqaphela kanjani ukuthi yisiphi isisekelo esingalungile kulezi ezimbili? Ku-E. coli, ngemva kokuphindaphinda, i-adenine yesisekelo se-nitrogenous ithola iqembu le-methyl; i-strand ye-DNA yomzali izoba namaqembu e-methyl, kanti i-strand esanda kuhlanganiswa ayinazo. Ngakho-ke, i-DNA polymerase iyakwazi ukususa izisekelo ezifakwe ngendlela engafanele kusuka ku-strand esanda kuhlanganiswa, engeyona i-methylated. Kuma-eukaryotes, le ndlela ayiqondwa kahle, kodwa kukholakala ukuthi ihilela ukuqashelwa kwama-nick angavalwanga entanjeni entsha, kanye nokuhlangana kwesikhashana okuqhubekayo kwamanye amaprotheni okuphindaphinda nentambo entsha ngemva kokuba ukuphindaphinda sekuqediwe.

 Kolunye uhlobo lwendlela yokulungisa, ukulungiswa kokususwa kwe-nucleotide, ama-enzyme athatha indawo yezisekelo ezingalungile ngokwenza ukusika kuzo zombili iziphetho ezi-3 nezi-5 zesisekelo esingalungile (Isithombe 14.19). Ingxenye ye-DNA iyasuswa futhi ithathelwe indawo ngama-nucleotide abhangqiwe kahle ngesenzo se-DNA pol. Uma izisekelo sezigcwalisiwe, igebe elisele livalwa ngoxhumano lwe-phosphodiester oluqhutshwa yi-DNA ligase. Le ndlela yokulungisa ivame ukusetshenziswa lapho ukuvezwa kwe-UV kubangela ukwakheka kwama-dimer e-pyrimidine.

 Isibonelo esifundwe kahle samaphutha angalungiswa sibonakala kubantu abahlushwa yi-xeroderma pigmentosa (Isithombe 14.20). Abantu abathintekile banesikhumba esizwela kakhulu emisebeni ye-UV evela elangeni. Uma abantu bevezwa ku-UV, kwakheka ama-pyrimidine dimers, ikakhulukazi lawo e-thymine; abantu abane-xeroderma pigmentosa abakwazi ukulungisa umonakalo. Lokhu akulungiseki ngenxa yephutha kuma-enzyme okulungisa i-nucleotide excision, kanti kubantu abavamile, ama-thymine dimers ayasuswa bese kulungiswa iphutha. Ama-thymine dimers aphambukisa isakhiwo se-DNA double helix, futhi lokhu kungabangela izinkinga ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA.

 Amaphutha ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA akusona ukuphela kwesizathu esenza kuvele izinguquko ku-DNA. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuhlukahluka kokulandelana kwe-nucleotide ye-genome, nakho kungenzeka ngenxa yomonakalo ku-DNA. Ukuguqulwa okunjalo kungaba yizinhlobo ezimbili: okubangelwa noma okungahleliwe. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okubangelwa yilokho okubangelwa ukuvezwa kumakhemikhali, imisebe ye-UV, ama-x-ray, noma esinye isithako semvelo. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuzenzekelayo kwenzeka ngaphandle kokuvezwa kunoma yisiphi isithako semvelo; kungumphumela wokusabela kwemvelo okwenzeka emzimbeni.

 Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungaba nemiphumela ehlukahlukene. Ezinye izinguquko azivezwa; lezi zaziwa ngokuthi ukuguqulwa okuthule. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo yilezo zinguquko ezithinta isisekelo esisodwa. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvame kakhulu ukutshintshwa, lapho isisekelo esisodwa sithathelwa indawo ngesinye. Lokhu kungaba izinhlobo ezimbili, kungaba ukuguqulwa noma ukuguqulwa. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kubhekisela ku-purine noma i-pyrimidine ethathelwa indawo yisisekelo sohlobo olufanayo; isibonelo, i-purine efana ne-adenine ingathathelwa indawo yi-purine guanine. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kubhekisela ku-purine ethathelwa indawo yi-pyrimidine, noma okuphambene nalokho; isibonelo, i-cytosine, i-pyrimidine, ithathelwa indawo yi-adenine, i-purine. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungaba umphumela wokwengezwa kwesisekelo, esaziwa ngokuthi ukufakwa, noma ukususwa kwesisekelo, esaziwa nangokuthi ukususwa. Ngezinye izikhathi ucezu lwe-DNA oluvela kwi-chromosome eyodwa lungadluliselwa kwenye i-chromosome noma kwesinye isifunda se-chromosome efanayo; lokhu kwaziwa nangokuthi ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Lezi zinhlobo zokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ziboniswe kuMfanekiso 14.22.

 Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo zokulungisa kuye kwaziwa ukuthi kubangela umdlavuza. Izakhi zofuzo eziningi zokulungisa eziguquliwe ziye zahlotshaniswa nezinhlobo ezithile zomdlavuza we-pancreatic, umdlavuza wamathumbu amakhulu, kanye nomdlavuza we-colorectal. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungathinta amangqamuzana omzimba noma amangqamuzana egciwane. Uma izinguquko eziningi ziqongelela esitokisini somzimba womuntu, zingase ziholele ezinkingeni ezifana nokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli okungalawulwa okubonwa kumdlavuza. Uma ukuguquka kwenzeka kumaseli egciwane, ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuzodluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo, njengasendabeni ye-hemophilia kanye ne-xeroderma pigmentosa.

ukuguqulwa okuzenzakalelayo

question1: Iyiphi indlela yelabhorethri ehlukanisa izingcezu ze-DNA ngokusekelwe kubukhulu bazo?

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.8 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 14. Isakhiwo se-DNA kanye Nomsebenzi | 14.8 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
14.1 Isisekelo Somlando Sokuqonda Kwanamuhla
I-DNA yaqala ukuhlukaniswa emangqamuzaneni amhlophe egazi nguFriedrich Miescher, owayibiza ngokuthi i-nuclein ngoba yayihlukaniswe nama-nuclei. Ukuhlolwa kukaFrederick Griffiths ngezinhlobo ze-Streptococcus pneumoniae kwanikeza umbono wokuqala wokuthi i-DNA ingaba yisimiso sokuguqula. U-Avery, uMacLeod, noMcCarty bafakazele ukuthi i-DNA iyadingeka ekuguqulweni kwamagciwane. Ukuhlolwa kwakamuva kukaHershey noChase besebenzisa i-bacteriophage T2 kwafakazele ukuthi i-DNA iyizinto zofuzo. UChargaff wathola ukuthi isilinganiso sika-A = T no-C = G, nokuthi okuqukethwe kwephesenti lika-A, T, G, no-C kuhlukile ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene.

 14.2 Ukwakheka kwe-DNA Nokulandelana
Imodeli eyamukelwa njengamanje yesakhiwo se-double-helix se-DNA yaphakanyiswa nguWatson noCrick. Ezinye zezici eziphawulekayo ukuthi imicu emibili eyakha i-double helix iyahambisana futhi ayihambisani ngokwemvelo. Ushukela nama-phosphate e-Deoxyribose akha umgogodla wesakhiwo, kanti izisekelo ze-nitrogenous zibekwe ngaphakathi. Ububanzi be-double helix, 2 nm, buyafana kuyo yonke indawo. I-purine ihlala ihambisana ne-pyrimidine; Ama-pair ane-T, kanye nama-pair e-G ane-C. Ukujika okukodwa kwe-helix kunezisekelo eziyishumi. Ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kweseli, iseli ngalinye lendodakazi lithola ikhophi ye-DNA ngenqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-DNA replication. Ama-Prokaryotes alula kakhulu kune-eukaryotes ezicini zawo eziningi. Ama-prokaryotes amaningi aqukethe i-chromosome eyodwa, eyindilinga. Ngokuvamile, ama-chromosome e-eukaryotic aqukethe i-molecule ye-DNA eqondile ehlanganiswe kuma-nucleosomes, futhi anezindawo ezimbili ezihlukile ezingahlukaniswa ngokudaya, okubonisa izimo ezahlukene zokupakishwa kanye nokuqina.

 14.3 Izisekelo Zokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
Imodeli yokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA iphakamisa ukuthi izicucu ezimbili ze-double helix ziyahlukana ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda, futhi intambo ngayinye isebenza njengethempulethi lapho kukopishwa khona intambo entsha ehambisanayo. Ekuphindaphindeni okulondoloziwe, i-DNA yomzali iyalondolozwa, kanti i-DNA yendodakazi isanda kwakhiwa. Indlela ye-semi-conservative isikisela ukuthi umucu ngamunye we-DNA yomzali usebenza njengethempulethi ye-DNA entsha ezokwenziwa; ngemva kokuphindaphinda, i-DNA ngayinye enezintambo ezimbili ifaka umucu owodwa womzali noma omdala kanye nomucu owodwa omusha. Imodi yokuhlakaza iphakamise ukuthi amakhophi amabili e-DNA abe nezingxenye ze-DNA yomzali kanye ne-DNA entsha enziwe.

 14.4 Ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA kuma-Prokaryotes
Ukuphindaphindeka kuma-prokaryotes kuqala ngokulandelana okutholakala ku-chromosome okubizwa ngokuthi umsuka wokuphindaphinda—indawo lapho i-DNA ivuleka khona. I-Helicase ivula i-DNA double helix, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-replication fork. Amaprotheni okubopha umucu owodwa abopha ku-DNA enezintambo eyodwa eduze kwe-replication fork ukugcina i-fork ivulekile. I-Primase ikhiqiza i-RNA primer ukuze iqalise ukuhlanganiswa yi-DNA polymerase, engangeza ama-nucleotide kuphela ohlangothini lwe-5 kuya ku-3. Umucu owodwa wenziwa ngokuqhubekayo ohlangothini lwefoloko lokuphindaphinda; lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi umucu oholayo. Omunye umucu wenziwa ngendlela ekude nefoloko lokuphindaphinda, ngezindlela ezimfushane ze-DNA ezaziwa ngokuthi izingcezu ze-Okazaki. Lo mucu waziwa ngokuthi umucu ohlala ukhona. Uma ukuphindaphinda sekuqediwe, ama-primer e-RNA athathelwa indawo yi-nucleotide ye-DNA bese i-DNA ivalwa nge-DNA ligase, edala izibopho ze-phosphodiester phakathi kwe-3-OH yokuphela okukodwa kanye ne-phosphate engu-5 yolunye umucu.

 14.5 Ukuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kuma-Eukaryotes
Ukuphindaphinda kuma-eukaryotes kuqala emithonjeni eminingi yokuphindaphinda. Indlela yokusebenza ifana kakhulu nama-prokaryotes. Kudingeka i-primer ukuze kuqalwe ukuhlanganiswa, okube sekwandiswa yi-DNA polymerase njengoba ingeza ama-nucleotide ngamunye ngamunye kuchungechunge olukhulayo. Umucu oholayo wenziwa ngokuqhubekayo, kanti umucu ohlala ukhona wenziwa ngezindlela ezimfushane ezibizwa ngokuthi izingcezu ze-Okazaki. Ama-primer e-RNA athathelwa indawo ngama-nucleotide e-DNA; i-DNA ihlala iyintambo eyodwa eqhubekayo ngokuxhumanisa izingcezu ze-DNA ne-ligase ye-DNA. Iziphetho zama-chromosome zibangela inkinga njengoba i-polymerase ingakwazi ukuzinweba ngaphandle kwe-primer. I-Telomerase, i-enzyme ene-template ye-RNA eyakhelwe ngaphakathi, yelula iziphetho ngokukopisha i-template ye-RNA futhi yelula umkhawulo owodwa we-chromosome. I-DNA polymerase ingabe seyinweba i-DNA isebenzisa i-primer. Ngale ndlela, iziphetho zama-chromosome ziyavikelwa.

 14.6 Ukulungiswa kwe-DNA
I-DNA polymerase ingenza amaphutha ngenkathi ingeza ama-nucleotide. Ihlela i-DNA ngokuhlola zonke izisekelo ezisanda kwengezwa. Izisekelo ezingalungile ziyasuswa futhi zithathelwe indawo yisisekelo esifanele, bese kufakwa isisekelo esisha. Amaphutha amaningi ayalungiswa ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa, yize uma lokhu kungenzeki, kusetshenziswa indlela yokulungisa ukungafani. Ama-enzyme okulungisa ukungafani ayaqaphela isisekelo esifakwe kabi futhi asikhiphe ku-DNA, asithathele indawo ngesisekelo esifanele. Kolunye uhlobo lokulungisa, ukulungiswa kwe-nucleotide excision, isisekelo esingalungile siyasuswa kanye nezisekelo ezimbalwa ekugcineni kwesi-5 nesesi-3, futhi lokhu kuthathelwa indawo ngokukopisha ithempulethi ngosizo lwe-DNA polymerase. Iziphetho zesiqeshana esisanda kuhlanganiswa zinamathiselwe ku-DNA esele kusetshenziswa i-DNA ligase, edala isibopho se-phosphodiester.

 Amaphutha amaningi ayalungiswa, futhi uma engalungiswa, angabangela ukuguqulwa okuchazwe njengoshintsho oluhlala njalo ku-DNA sequence. Ukuguqulwa kungaba ngezinhlobo eziningi, njengokushintsha, ukususa, ukufaka, kanye nokudluliselwa kwenye indawo. Ukuguqulwa kungabangelwa noma kungenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo

question48: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA ye-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic

answer60: Isampula ye-DNA isuswa ngokushisa bese ifakwa emapayipini amane. Kufakwa i-primer, i-DNA polymerase kanye nawo wonke ama-nucleotide amane. Inani elilinganiselwe lenye yama-dideoxynucleotide amane (ddNTPs) lifakwa epayipini ngalinye ngokulandelana. Ngayinye yazo inelebula elithile le-fluorescent. Ukwelulwa kweketanga kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho kufakwe i-ddNTP ekhanyayo eketsheni elikhulayo, ngemva kwalokho kwenzeka ukuphela kweketanga. question63: Ama-flamingo anezinhlobo zofuzo zezimpaphe ezimhlophe kodwa avame ukuvela nezimpaphe ezipinki ngaphakathi kwesibalo esifanayo. Yini okungenzeka ukuthi ithinta uhlobo lwama-flamingo athile, okubangela ukuthi izimpaphe zawo zibe pinki kubantu abahlukene?

question66: Bheka uMfanekiso 14.26. Ithebula libonisa ukuthi yimaphi ama-codon aqopha ikhodi yama-amino acid ku-DNA. Ngenxa yokuguquka, ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide i-ATC-CAG-AGA kuba yi-ATT-CAG-AGA ku-gene. Lolu hlobo lokuguquka kungaba yiluphi?
question67: Ubheka izingcezu ezimbili ze-DNA. Zombili zine-sequence CATTCTG kolunye ulayini kanye ne-GTAGAC kolunye. Esinye sezingcezu sichayeke ekukhanyeni kwe-UV, esinye asichayeke. Kuzokwenzekani kulezi zingcezu futhi lezi zinguquko zingalungiswa kanjani?
answer67: Ingcezu evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV iqukethe ama-dimer e-thymine. Ama-thymine alele eduze komunye nomunye angakha ama-dimer e-thymine uma evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV. Angalungiswa ngokusikwa kwe-nucleotide
distractor67a: Ingcezu evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV iqukethe ama-dimer e-adenine. Ama-Adenine alele eduze komunye nomunye angakha ama-dimer uma evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV. Angalungiswa ngokusikwa kwe-nucleotide
distractor67b: Ingcezu evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV iqukethe ama-dimer e-thymine. Ama-thymine alele ndawonye angakha ama-dimer e-thymine uma evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV. Angalungiswa ngokusikwa kwe-nucleotide
distractor67c: Ingcezu evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV iqukethe ama-dimer e-thymine. Ama-thymine alele eduze komunye nomunye angakha ama-dimer e-thymine uma evezwe ekukhanyeni kwe-UV. Angakhiwa ngokusikwa kwe-nucleotide
question68: Xoxani ngokuthi ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungandisa kanjani ukwehluka phakathi kwabantu
answer68: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungabangela ukuthi kubekwe i-amino acid ehlukile endaweni ethile, okubangela izinguquko ezincane kuprotheni. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuvame ukubangela izinguquko eziningi ze-amino acid, okwandisa amathuba okuthi iprotheni entsha izokwakheka, okuholela ezicini ezihluke kakhulu enzalweni.
distractor68a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo esikhundleni kungabangela izinguquko eziningi ze-amino acid, okwandisa amathuba okuthi iprotheni entsha izokwakheka, okuholela ezicini ezihluke kakhulu enzalweni. Ukuguqulwa kwe-Frameshift kungabangela ukuthi i-amino acid ehlukile ibekwe endaweni ethile, okubangela izinguquko ezincane kuprotheni.
distractor68b: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungabangela ukuthi i-amino acid ehlukile ibekwe endaweni ethile, okuholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu kuprotheni futhi kuholele ezicini ezihluke kakhulu enzalweni. Ukuguqulwa kwe-Frameshift kubangela umehluko omningi we-amino acid kuprotheni, okuholela ezinguqukweni ezincane kuprotheni.
distractor68c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuholela ekubekweni kwe-amino acid ehlukile endaweni ethile kuphrotheni, okubangela izinguquko ezincane. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungaholela ezicini ezintsha ezinazo inzalo lapho i-stop codon ithathelwa indawo i-amino acid.

chapterContent: Incazelo yezakhi zofuzo ithuthuke kusukela ekubeni yiyunithi engabonakali yofuzo ngesikhathi sikaMendel kuya emcabangweni wethu wamanje wento ebambekayo yama-molecule ekwazi ukuphindaphinda, ukuveza, kanye nokuguquka (Isithombe 15.1). Njengamanje, singenza izivivinyo zezifo eziningi zofuzo, kodwa lezi zivivinyo zidala izinkinga zokuziphatha nezomthetho. Isibonelo, ubungathanda yini ukuhlolwa isifo sofuzo esibuthakathaka uma bekungenzeka ukuthi izinkampani zomshuwalense zingasebenzisa lolo lwazi ukuze zikunqabele ukumbozwa? Ngenhlanhla, uMthetho Wokungabandlululi Ngolwazi Lwezakhi Zofuzo ka-2008 uvikela izakhamuzi zaseMelika ekubandlululweni yizinkampani zomshuwalense kanye nabaqashi ngokusekelwe olwazini lwezakhi zofuzo.
question1: Incazelo yesakhi sofuzo ishintshe kanjani kusukela ngesikhathi sikaMendels?
answer1: Izakhi zofuzo manje seziqondwa njengeyunithi yama-molecule yofuzo engaphindaphinda, ivezwe, futhi iguquke.
distractor1a: I-gene manje ichazwa njenge-chromosome enquma isici esisodwa
distractor1b: Izakhi zofuzo manje sezibhekwa njengohlobo lweprotheni ephethe ulwazi oluzuzwe njengefa
distractor1c: I-gene manje seyaziwa ngokuthi i-genome ephelele ngaphakathi kweseli ngalinye
question2: Yisiphi isici esingeyona ingxenye yencazelo yesimanje yesakhi sofuzo?
question3: Isiguli sinikezwa ukuhlolwa kwesifo sofuzo esingenalo ikhambi okwamanje. Yikuphi ukukhathazeka okuhlobene ngqo nalolu hlobo lokuhlolwa?
answer3: Imiphumela ingase iphakamise izinkinga zokuziphatha nezomthetho mayelana nokusetshenziswa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor3b: Ukuhlolwa kuqinisekisa ukuthi lesi sifo sizokhula
distractor3c: Ukuhlolwa kuvimbela ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo esikhathini esizayo
question4: Umuntu ukhathazeka ngokuthi imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo ingathinta amathuba emisebenzi esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kumele luhlobo luni lwenkinga?
answer4: Ukuhlukaniswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: E-United States, yimuphi umthetho osiza ekuvikeleni abantu ekubandlululweni ngokusekelwe kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Umthetho Wokungabandlululi Ngolwazi Lwezakhi Zofuzo (i-GINA) ka-2008
question6: Ngokusho koMthetho Wokungabandlululi Ngezakhi Zofuzo (i-GINA), yiziphi izinhlangano ezivinjelwe ukubandlulula ngokusekelwe olwazini lwezakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Izinkampani zomshuwalense kanye nabaqashi
question7: Kungani ukuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungaphakamisa imibuzo yokuziphatha ngisho noma ubuchwepheshe bunembile?
answer7: Ulwazi lungathonya izinqumo ezibalulekile zomuntu siqu, zezokwelapha, zomsebenzi, noma zomshuwalense
distractor7a: Ukuhlolwa kofuzo kuhlale kubikezela izifo ngokuqiniseka okuphelele
distractor7b: Ukuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo kushintsha i-DNA ehlaziywayo
distractor7c: Wonke umuntu ohlolwe ngokomthetho uyadingeka ukuthi abelane ngemiphumela yakhe
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima yezakhi zofuzo ku-biology yesimanje?
answer8: Izakhi zofuzo zigcina ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo olungaphindaphindwa, luvezwe, futhi lushintshwe ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor8a: Izakhi zofuzo amaprotheni akha ngqo ama-chromosome
distractor8b: Izakhi zofuzo zikhona kuphela kumaseli okuzala
distractor8c: Izakhi zofuzo zikhiqizwa kuphela uma kwenzeka izinguquko

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.1 Ikhodi Yezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.1 Ikhodi Yezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Kusukela ekutholakaleni kabusha komsebenzi kaMendel ngawo-1900, ososayensi bafunde okuningi ngokuthi amapulani ezakhi zofuzo agcinwe ku-DNA akwazi kanjani ukuphindaphinda, ukuveza, kanye nokuguquka. Njengoba nje izinhlamvu ezingu-26 zezinhlamvu zesiNgisi zingahlelwa zibe yilokho okubonakala kuyinani elingenamkhawulo lamagama, kanye namasha anezelwa kusichazamazwi minyaka yonke, ama-nucleotide amane e-DNA—A, T, C, kanye no-G—angakhiqiza ukulandelana kwe-DNA okubizwa ngokuthi izakhi zofuzo ezichaza amashumi ezinkulungwane zama-polymer ama-amino acid. Lokhu kulandelana kungahunyushwa kube yi-mRNA futhi kuhunyushwe kube amaprotheni ahlela cishe yonke imisebenzi yeseli. Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo ibhekisela kuzinhlamvu ze-DNA (A, T, C, G), izinhlamvu ze-RNA (A, U, C, G), kanye nezinhlamvu ze-polypeptide (ama-amino acid angu-20). Kodwa izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala ku-chromosome zigcina kanjani zikhiqiza i-polypeptide engabangela uhlobo olubonakalayo njengombala wezinwele noma wamehlo—noma isifo esifana ne-cystic fibrosis noma i-hemophilia?

 I-Central Dogma ichaza ukugeleza okuvamile kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo oluvela ku-DNA luye ku-mRNA luye kuphrotheni: I-DNA kuma-gene ichaza ukulandelana kwe-mRNA, yona echaza ukulandelana kwama-amino acid kumaphrotheni. Le nqubo idinga izinyathelo ezimbili, ukubhala kanye nokuhumusha. Ngesikhathi sokubhala, izakhi zofuzo zisetshenziselwa ukwenza i-messenger RNA (mRNA). Kanti futhi, i-mRNA isetshenziselwa ukuqondisa ukuhlanganiswa kwamaprotheni ngesikhathi senqubo yokuhumusha. Ukuhumusha kudinga nezinye izinhlobo ezimbili ze-RNA: i-transfer RNA (tRNA) kanye ne-ribosomal RNA (rRNA). Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo iyikhodi ye-triplet, lapho i-RNA codon ngayinye iqukethe ama-nucleotide amathathu alandelanayo achaza i-amino acid eyodwa noma ukukhululwa kwe-polypeptide chain esanda kwakhiwa; isibonelo, i-mRNA codon CAU ichaza i-amino acid histidine. Ikhodi iyawohloka; okungukuthi, amanye ama-amino acid achazwa ama-codon angaphezu kweyodwa, njengamazwi afanayo owafunda ekilasini lakho lesiNgisi (amagama ahlukene, incazelo efanayo). Isibonelo, i-CCU, i-CCC, i-CCG, kanye ne-CCG wonke angama-codon e-proline. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ikhodi efanayo yezakhi zofuzo itholakala cishe kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni. Kunezinhlobo ezincane zokwabiwa kwe-codon kuma-mitochondria nakwamanye ama-microorganism.

 Ukuphambuka ohlelweni olulula lwemfundiso ephakathi kutholakala njengoba abacwaningi behlola ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngobuchwepheshe obusha. Isibonelo, igciwane le-human immunodeficiency (HIV) liyi-retrovirus egcina ulwazi lwayo lwezakhi zofuzo kuma-molecule e-RNA ahlanganisiwe. Lapho iseli eliphethe seli lithelelekile, i-RNA isetshenziswa njengethempulethi yi-enzyme ebhalwe ngegciwane, i-reverse transcriptase, ukuhlanganisa i-DNA. I-DNA yegciwane kamuva iguqulwa ibe yi-mRNA futhi ihunyushwe ibe amaprotheni. Amanye amagciwane e-RNA njengegciwane le-influenza awakaze adlule esinyathelweni se-DNA. I-genome ye-RNA iphindaphindwa yi-RNA polymerase encike ku-RNA ebhalwe ngegciwane.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye ne-Big Idea 3 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso zokufunda zihlanganisa okuqukethwe kolwazi olubalulekile nenye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa. Lezi Zinjongo Zokufunda zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okusekelwe ekuphenyweni kwelebhu, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka kanye nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B
Izinto eziphilayo zixhunyaniswe yimigqa yozalo oluvela kubazali abafanayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyinhloko ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ezizindeni nakuzo zonke izindawo ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Umgomo Wokufunda
1.15 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza izibonelo ezithile zezinqubo zezinto eziphilayo ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezabiwe yizo zonke izizinda noma ngaphakathi kwesizinda esisodwa sokuphila, nokuthi lezi zinqubo kanye nezici ezigciniwe ezabiwe, ezigciniwe zisekela kanjani umqondo wozalo olufanayo lwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi olugciniwe luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.1 I-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo i-RNA, ingumthombo oyinhloko wolwazi olugciniwe.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa isakhiwo nemisebenzi ye-DNA ne-RNA ukusekela isimangalo sokuthi i-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo, ukuthi i-RNA iyimithombo eyinhloko yolwazi olufanele ukutholwa.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 3.4][I-APLO 3.25]

 Inqubo yeselula yokubhala ikhiqiza i-messenger RNA (mRNA), ikhophi yeselula yezakhi zofuzo eyodwa noma ngaphezulu enezinhlamvu ze-A, C, G, kanye ne-uracil (U). Ukuhumusha ithempulethi ye-mRNA kuguqula ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo olusekelwe ku-nucleotide lube umkhiqizo weprotheni. Ukulandelana kwamaphrotheni kuqukethe ama-amino acid angu-20 avame ukuvela; ngakho-ke, kungashiwo ukuthi izinhlamvu zephrotheni ziqukethe izinhlamvu ezingu-20 (Isithombe 15.2). I-amino acid ngayinye ichazwa ngokulandelana kwezinhlamvu ze-nucleotide ezintathu ezibizwa ngokuthi i-triplet codon. Ama-amino acid ahlukene anamakhemikhali ahlukene (njenge-acidic vs basic, noma i-polar kanye ne-nonpolar) kanye nemikhawulo ehlukene yesakhiwo. Ukwehluka kokulandelana kwama-amino acid kudala ukwehluka okukhulu kwesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi wamaprotheni.
question1: Ngokwemfundiso eyinhloko, kuyini ukugeleza okuvamile kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli amaningi?
answer1: I-DNA → i-mRNA → iphrotheni
question2: Iyini indima yokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
question3: Iyini indima yokuhumusha?
answer3: Isebenzisa ukulandelana kwama-codon e-mRNA ukuhlanganisa iphrotheni
question4: Yiziphi izinhlobo ze-RNA ezihlanganyela ngqo ekuhumusheni?
answer4: I-mRNA, i-tRNA, kanye ne-rRNA
question5: Kusho ukuthini ukuthi i-genetic code iyi-triplet code?
answer5: I-codon ngayinye iqukethe ama-nucleotide amathathu e-RNA achaza i-amino acid eyodwa noma isignali yokuma
distractor5a: I-amino acid ngayinye ifakwa ama-gene amathathu ahlukene
distractor5b: I-codon ngayinye iqukethe ama-amino acid amathathu
question6: I-mRNA codon CAU icacisa ukuthi iyiphi i-amino acid?
answer6: I-Histidine
question7: Kungani ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo ichazwa njengewohlokile?
answer7: Ama-codon angaphezu kweyodwa angacacisa i-amino acid efanayo
distractor7a: I-codon ngayinye ichaza ama-amino acid angaphezu kweyodwa
question8: Yiliphi iqembu lama-codon elichaza i-amino acid proline?
answer8: I-CCU, i-CCC, i-CCA, kanye ne-CCG
question9: Kungani ukuba khona kwekhodi yezakhi zofuzo kubhekwa njengobufakazi bokuthi okhokho bakhona bafana?
answer9: Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa ama-codon afanayo ukuze zichaze ama-amino acid afanayo
distractor9a: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezigcawu ze-DNA ezifanayo
distractor9c: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinenani elifanayo lezakhi zofuzo
question10: Yimuphi umolekyuli ogcina ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuma-retrovirus njenge-HIV?
answer10: I-RNA enezintambo eyodwa
question11: Yiliphi i-enzyme elivumela i-HIV ukuthi ikhiqize i-DNA kusuka ku-genome yayo ye-RNA?
question12: Amanye amagciwane e-RNA, njengegciwane lomkhuhlane, aphindaphinda izakhi zofuzo zawo esebenzisa yiphi i-enzyme?
question13: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle ukuphindaphindana kwegciwane lomkhuhlane?
answer13: I-genome yayo ye-RNA iphindaphindwa ngaphandle kwe-DNA intermediate
distractor13a: I-genome yayo ye-RNA iqala ukuguqulwa ibe yi-DNA nge-reverse transcriptase
distractor13b: Ihlanganisa unomphela i-DNA ku-chromosome yomnikazi ngaphambi kokuphindaphinda
question14: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zithonya kanjani izici zomzimba njengombala wamehlo?
answer14: Izakhi zofuzo zichaza amaprotheni, kanti amaprotheni akhiqiza izici ezibonwa ezintweni eziphilayo
distractor14a: Izakhi zofuzo ziba izici ezibonakalayo ngqo ngaphandle kokukhiqiza amaprotheni
distractor14b: Amaprotheni anquma ukulandelana kwe-DNA ngemva kokuzalwa
distractor14c: Izici zemvelo kuphela ezinquma izici zomzimba
question15: Yimaphi ama-alfabhethi asetshenziswa ku-RNA?
answer15: A, U, C, G
question16: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-messenger RNA (mRNA)?
answer16: Ukuthwala ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo oluvela ku-DNA luye ku-ribosome ukuze kuhlanganiswe amaprotheni
question17: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-RNA oluletha ama-amino acid ku-ribosome ngesikhathi sokuhumusha?
answer17: I-tRNA
distractor17c: I-snRNA
question18: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-RNA oluyisakhiwo nesakhi esibangela ukwakheka kwama-ribosome?
answer18: I-rRNA

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.1 Ikhodi Yezakhi zofuzo | Imfundiso Eyinhloko: I-DNA Ibhala i-RNA; I-RNA Ibhala iphrotheni
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.1 Ikhodi Yezakhi zofuzo | Imfundiso Eyinhloko: I-DNA Ibhala i-RNA; I-RNA Ibhala iphrotheni
chapterContent: Ukugeleza kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli kusuka ku-DNA kuya ku-mRNA kuya kuphrotheni kuchazwa yi-Central Dogma (Isithombe 15.3), esithi izakhi zofuzo zichaza ukulandelana kwama-mRNA, okubuye kuchaze ukulandelana kwamaphrotheni. Ukuchazwa kwe-molecule eyodwa kuya kwenye kwenziwa ngamaprotheni athile nama-RNA. Ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi olugcinwe ku-DNA luyisici esibalulekile ekusebenzeni kwamaseli, kunengqondo ukuthi iseli lingenza amakhophi e-mRNA alolu lwazi ukuze kwakhiwe amaprotheni, kuyilapho ligcina i-DNA ngokwayo ingashintshi futhi ivikelwe. Ukukopishwa kwe-DNA ku-RNA kulula kakhulu, lapho i-nucleotide eyodwa ingezwa ku-mRNA strand kuyo yonke i-nucleotide efundwa ku-DNA strand. Ukuhunyushwa kuphrotheni kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ngoba ama-nucleotide amathathu e-mRNA ahambisana ne-amino acid eyodwa ku-polypeptide sequence. Kodwa-ke, ukuhunyushwa kuphrotheni kusahlelekile futhi ku-colinear, kangangokuthi ama-nucleotide 1 kuya ku-3 ahambisana ne-amino acid 1, ama-nucleotide 4 kuya ku-6 ahambisana ne-amino acid 2, njalo njalo.
question1: Ngokwemfundiso eyinhloko, kuyini ukugeleza okuvamile kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli amaningi?
answer1: I-DNA → i-mRNA → iphrotheni
question2: Kungani amangqamuzana evame ukukhiqiza i-mRNA esikhundleni sokusebenzisa i-DNA ngqo ngesikhathi sokwenziwa kwamaprotheni?
answer2: I-mRNA iphethe ikhophi yolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuyilapho i-DNA ihlala ivikelwe esitokisini
distractor2a: I-mRNA iqukethe ulwazi oluningi lwezakhi zofuzo kune-DNA
distractor2b: I-DNA ayikwazi ukufundwa yi-ribosomes ngoba ayinawo ama-codon
question3: Ngesikhathi sokubhalwa phansi, ukulandelana kwe-mRNA kukhiqizwa kanjani kusuka ku-DNA?
answer3: I-nucleotide eyodwa ye-RNA ehambisanayo ingeziwe ku-nucleotide ngayinye efundwayo ku-template ye-DNA strand.
distractor3a: Kufakwa ama-nucleotide amathathu e-RNA kuyo yonke i-nucleotide ye-DNA
distractor3b: Ama-nucleotide e-DNA akopishwa ngqo ku-mRNA strand ngaphandle kokushintsha
distractor3c: Amaprotheni akhiqiza i-DNA ngqo kusuka ku-RNA
question4: Kungani ukuhumusha kubhekwa njengokuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunokubhala phansi?
answer4: Ama-nucleotide amathathu e-mRNA (i-codon eyodwa) achaza i-amino acid eyodwa
distractor4a: I-amino acid ngayinye ifakwa ikhodi ngama-molecule amathathu ahlukene e-mRNA
distractor4b: Ukuhumusha kudinga ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwamaprotheni
question5: I-molecule ye-mRNA iqukethe ama-codons AUG-GCU-AAA. Mangaki ama-amino acid azongezwa ku-polypeptide ekhulayo evela kula ma-codons?
answer5: Ama-amino acid amathathu
question6: Uma ama-nucleotide 4 kuya ku-6 e-molecule ye-mRNA eshintshwa ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo, iyiphi ingxenye yeprotheni ephumayo ethinteka kakhulu?
answer6: I-amino acid yesibili
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-codon e-mRNA nama-amino acid ngesikhathi sokuhumusha?
answer7: Ukulandelana kwama-codon kunquma ukulandelana kwama-amino acid kuprotheni
distractor7a: I-amino acid ngayinye inquma ukuthi yimaphi ama-nucleotide e-DNA akhiqizwayo
distractor7c: I-nucleotide ngayinye ihambelana ne-amino acid eyodwa
question8: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kushintsha i-codon yokuqala ye-molecule ye-mRNA. Iyiphi ingxenye yeprotheni okungenzeka ukuthi ithinteke kakhulu kuqala?
answer8: I-amino acid yokuqala ku-polypeptide

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.1 Ikhodi Yezakhi Zofuzo | Imfundiso Eyinhloko: I-DNA Ibhala I-RNA; I-RNA Ibhala Iphrotheni | Ikhodi Yezakhi Zofuzo Iyawohloka Futhi Iyindawo Yonke
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.1 Ikhodi Yezakhi Zofuzo | Imfundiso Eyinhloko: I-DNA Ibhala I-RNA; I-RNA Ibhala Iphrotheni | Ikhodi Yezakhi Zofuzo Iyawohloka Futhi Iyindawo Yonke
chapterContent:
Njengoba kunezinombolo ezahlukene zezinhlamvu "ezibhalweni ze-mRNA kanye nezinhlamvu zamaprotheni,"ososayensi bacabanga ukuthi inhlanganisela yama-nucleotide ihambisana nama-amino acid angawodwa. Ama-nucleotide doublets ngeke anele ukucacisa yonke i-amino acid ngoba kunezinhlanganisela ezingu-16 kuphela ze-nucleotide ezimbili (42). Ngokuphambene nalokho, kunezinhlayiya ezintathu ze-nucleotide ezingama-64 (43) ezingaba khona, okungaphezu kakhulu kwenani lama-amino acid. Ososayensi bacabanga ukuthi ama-amino acid abhalwe ngama-nucleotide triplets nokuthi ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo yayiwohloka. Ngamanye amazwi, i-amino acid ethile ingabhalwa ngama-nucleotide triplets angaphezu kweyodwa. Lokhu kwaqinisekiswa kamuva ngokuhlola; uFrancis Crick noSydney Brenner basebenzise i-chemical mutagen proflavin ukufaka i-nucleotide eyodwa, ezimbili, noma ezintathu ku-gene yegciwane. Lapho kufakwa i-nucleotide eyodwa noma ezimbili, ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kwaqedwa ngokuphelele. Lapho kufakwa ama-nucleotide amathathu, iphrotheni yakhiqizwa futhi yasebenza. Lokhu kwabonisa ukuthi ama-nucleotide amathathu achaza i-amino acid ngayinye. Lawa ma-nucleotide triplets abizwa ngokuthi ama-codon. Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide eyodwa noma ezimbili kushintshe ngokuphelele uhlaka lokufunda lwe-triplet, ngaleyo ndlela kushintsha umlayezo we-amino acid ngayinye elandelayo (Isithombe 15.4). Nakuba ukufakwa kwama-nucleotide amathathu kubangele ukuthi kufakwe i-amino acid eyengeziwe ngesikhathi sokuhumusha, ubuqotho beprotheyini esele bugcinwe.

 Ososayensi baxazulula ngokucophelela ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo ngokuhumusha ama-mRNA okwenziwa ngaphakathi kwe-vitro nokulandelanisa amaprotheni abawachazile (Isithombe 15.5).

 Ngaphezu kokufundisa ukungezwa kwe-amino acid ethile kuchungechunge lwe-polypeptide, ama-codon amathathu kwangu-64 aqeda ukwenziwa kweprotheyini futhi akhulule i-polypeptide emishinini yokuhumusha. Lawa ma-triplets abizwa ngokuthi ama-nonsense codons, noma ama-stop codons. Enye i-codon, i-AUG, nayo inomsebenzi okhethekile. Ngaphezu kokucacisa i-amino acid methionine, iphinde isebenze njenge-codon yokuqala ukuqala ukuhumusha. Uhlaka lokufunda lokuhumusha lusethwa yi-codon yokuqala ye-AUG eduze kokuphela kwesi-5 se-mRNA.

 Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo iyinto yonke. Ngaphandle kwezimbalwa ezihlukile, cishe zonke izinhlobo zisebenzisa ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo efanayo yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni. Ukulondolozwa kwama-codon kusho ukuthi i-mRNA ehlanziwe ebhala iphrotheni ye-globin emahhashini ingadluliselwa kuseli le-tulip, kanti i-tulip izokhiqiza i-globin yehhashi. Ukuthi kunekhodi yezakhi zofuzo eyodwa kuphela kuwubufakazi obunamandla bokuthi konke ukuphila eMhlabeni kwabelana ngemvelaphi efanayo, ikakhulukazi uma ucabanga ukuthi kunezinhlanganisela ezingaba ngu-1084 zama-amino acid angu-20 kanye nama-codon angu-64 e-triplet.

 Ukuwohloka kukholelwa ukuthi kuyindlela yeselula yokunciphisa umthelela omubi wokuguqulwa okungahleliwe. Ama-Codon achaza i-amino acid efanayo ngokuvamile ahluka nge-nucleotide eyodwa kuphela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-amino acid anezintambo eziseceleni ezifanayo zamakhemikhali abhalwa ngama-codon afanayo. Lokhu kuhlukahluka kwekhodi yezakhi zofuzo kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuguqulwa kokushintshaniswa kwe-nucleotide eyodwa kungacacisa i-amino acid efanayo kodwa kungabi namphumela noma kucacise i-amino acid efanayo, okuvimbela iphrotheni ukuthi ingasebenzi nhlobo.
question1: Kungani ososayensi baphetha ngokuthi ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo kumelwe ibe nama-codon amathathu kunokuba ama-doublet?
answer1: Ama-triplets ahlinzeka ngezinhlanganisela ezingu-64 ezingaba khona, ezanele ukufaka wonke ama-amino acid angu-20
distractor1a: Ama-Doublet ahlinzeka ngezinhlanganisela ezingaphezu kokwanele ukufaka ikhodi kuwo wonke ama-amino acid
distractor1c: I-amino acid ngayinye idinga ama-codon amathathu ahlukene
question2: Yini uFrancis Crick noSydney Brenner abayibonisa ngokufaka i-nucleotide eyodwa, ezimbili, noma ezintathu ku-gene yegciwane?
answer2: Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide eyodwa noma ezimbili kwaphazamisa uhlaka lokufunda, kanti ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide ezintathu kwalondoloza uhlaka lokufunda futhi kwavumela ukuthi kukhiqizwe iphrotheni esebenzayo.
distractor2a: Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide eyodwa akuzange kube nomthelela, kuyilapho ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide ezintathu kwakuhlala kumisa ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni
distractor2b: Ukufakwa kwama-nucleotide amabili kuthuthukise ukusebenza kweprotheni ngokudala ama-amino acid amasha
distractor2c: Ukufakwa kwama-nucleotide amathathu kuhlale kubangela ukuguqulwa kwe-frameshift
question3: Kungani ukufaka i-nucleotide eyodwa kuhlelo lokubhala ikhodi ngokuvamile kuba nomphumela onzima kakhulu kunokufaka i-nucleotide ezintathu?
answer3: Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide okukodwa kushintsha uhlaka lokufunda, kushintsha yonke i-codon esezansi komfula
distractor3a: Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide eyodwa kususa i-codon yokuqala kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo
distractor3b: Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide okuthathu kuhlala kungenisa i-stop codon
distractor3c: Ukufakwa kwe-nucleotide okuthathu kuvimbela ukubhalwa kwe-transcription ukuthi kungenzeki
question4: Kusho ukuthini ukuthi isitatimende sokuthi ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo ayisebenzi?
answer4: Ama-codon angaphezu kweyodwa angacacisa i-amino acid efanayo
distractor4a: I-codon ngayinye ichaza ama-amino acid amaningi
distractor4b: I-amino acid ngayinye ifakwa ikhodi eyodwa ngqo
distractor4c: Amanye ama-codon awasho noma iyiphi i-amino acid noma isignali yokuma
question5: Uyini umsebenzi we-codon ye-AUG?
answer5: Icacisa i-methionine futhi isebenza njenge-codon yokuqala yokuhumusha
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-stop codons?
answer6: Ziqeda ukwakheka kwamaprotheni bese zikhulula i-polypeptide ephelele
question7: Umcwaningi udlulisela i-mRNA ye-horse globin esitokisini se-tulip, bese i-tulip ikhiqiza iphrotheni ye-horse globin. Lokhu kubonisani?
answer7: Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo cishe iyinto yonke phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo
distractor7b: Amaseli ezitshalo kuphela angahumusha i-mRNA yezilwane
distractor7c: Iseli le-tulip liguqule i-mRNA ibe yi-DNA ngaphambi kokuhumusha
question8: Kungani ukuba khona kwekhodi yezakhi zofuzo emhlabeni wonke kubhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinile bokuthi okhokho abafanayo bavelaphi?
answer8: Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa ama-codon afanayo ukuze zichaze ama-amino acid afanayo
distractor8a: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezigcawu ze-DNA ezifanayo
distractor8b: Zonke izinto eziphilayo ziqukethe inani elifanayo lezakhi zofuzo
distractor8c: Zonke izinto eziphilayo zikhiqiza amaprotheni afanayo
question9: Ukuwohloka kwekhodi yezakhi zofuzo kunganciphisa kanjani imiphumela yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okungahleliwe?
answer9: Ukufakwa esikhundleni kwe-nucleotide eyodwa kungacacisa i-amino acid efanayo noma efana namakhemikhali, kunciphisa izinguquko emsebenzini weprotheni
distractor9a: Ukuwohloka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela zonke izinguquko ezenzekayo
distractor9b: Ukuwohloka kwezakhi zofuzo kubangela ukuthi zonke izinguquko zikhiqize ama-stop codon
distractor9c: Ukuwohloka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvumela ama-ribosome ukuthi anganaki izinguquko ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
question10: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kushintsha i-codon eyodwa ibe yi-codon eyodwa echaza i-amino acid efanayo. Yisiphi isici sekhodi yezakhi zofuzo esichaza ukuthi kungani iphrotheni ingashintshi?
answer10: Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo iyawohloka

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ngesikhathi sokubhalwa phansi, i-enzyme i-RNA polymerase ihamba eceleni kwethempulethi ye-DNA, ifunda ama-nucleotide ngendlela engu-3′ kuya ku-5′, kanti u-U uhambisana no-A no-C no-G, futhi ihlanganisa umbhalo we-mRNA ngendlela engu-5′ kuya ku-3′. Kuma-prokaryotes, ukwenziwa kwe-mRNA kuqaliswa ngokulandelana kwe-promoter kuthempulethi ye-DNA. Ukubhalwa phansi kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho i-RNA polymerase ifinyelela ukulandelana kokuma noma kokuphela kokuphela kwe-gene. Ukuphela kukhulula i-mRNA futhi kuvame ukwenzeka ngokwakhiwa kwe-hairpin ye-mRNA.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluyifa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.1 I-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo i-RNA, ingumthombo oyinhloko wolwazi oluyifa.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.5 Umfundi angahlola ezinye izincazelo zesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa izakhiwo kanye nezindlela ze-DNA ne-RNA ukusekela isimangalo sokuthi i-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo, ukuthi i-RNA iyimithombo eyinhloko yolwazi oluyifa.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yomkhuba Wesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 2.23][I-APLO 3.28][I-APLO 4.8][I-APLO 4.24]

 Ama-prokaryotes, afaka phakathi amabhaktheriya nama-archaea, ikakhulukazi ayizinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa, ngokwencazelo, ezingenazo i-nuclei eziboshwe nge-membrane kanye nezinye i-organelles. I-chromosome yebhaktheriya iyindilinga evalekile evalekile, ngokungafani nama-chromosome e-eukaryotic, engahlelekile eduze kwamaprotheni e-histone. Isifunda esiphakathi seseli lapho kuhlala khona i-DNA ye-prokaryotic sibizwa ngokuthi i-nucleoid. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-prokaryotes avame ukuba nama-plasmid amaningi, angama-molecule e-DNA amafushane ajikelezayo angaqukatha izakhi zofuzo ezimbalwa kuphela. Ama-plasmid angadluliselwa ngokuzimela kwe-chromosome yebhaktheriya ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli futhi avame ukuba nezici ezifana nokumelana nama-antibiotic.

 Ukubhalwa kwama-prokaryotes (naku-eukaryotes) kudinga i-DNA double helix ukuze ikhululeke kancane esifundeni sokwenziwa kwe-mRNA. Isifunda sokukhululeka sibizwa ngokuthi i-transcription bubble. Ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuhlale kuvela ku-DNA strand efanayo yezakhi zofuzo ngayinye, ebizwa ngokuthi i-template strand. Umkhiqizo we-mRNA uyahambisana ne-template strand futhi ucishe ufane nolunye u-DNA strand, olubizwa ngokuthi i-nontemplate strand. Umehluko kuphela ukuthi ku-mRNA, wonke ama-T nucleotide athathelwa indawo ama-U nucleotide. Ku-RNA double helix, i-A ingabopha i-U ngezibopho ezimbili ze-hydrogen, njengoba kunjalo ekubhanqeni kwe-A–T ku-DNA double helix.

 I-nucleotide pair ku-DNA double helix ehambisana nendawo lapho kuqoshwa khona i-nucleotide yokuqala ye-5 mRNA ibizwa ngokuthi i-+1 site, noma indawo yokuqalisa. Ama-Nucleotide angaphambi kwendawo yokuqalisa anikezwa izinombolo ezingezinhle futhi aqokwa phezulu. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-nucleotide alandela indawo yokuqalisa aboniswa nge-+” numbering futhi abizwa ngokuthi ama-downstream nucleotide.
question1: Ngesikhathi sokubhala, i-RNA polymerase ifunda ngakuphi intambo yethempulethi ye-DNA?
answer1: 3 kuya ku-5
question2: I-molecule ye-mRNA yenziwa ngakuphi ngesikhathi sokubhalwa?
question3: Yiluphi uchungechunge lwe-DNA ye-prokaryotic oluphawula indawo lapho kuqala khona ukukopishwa?
answer3: Umthuthukisi
question4: Yini evame ukubangela ukuthi ukubhalwa kuphele kuma-prokaryotes?
answer4: I-RNA polymerase ifinyelela kuchungechunge lwe-terminator, okuvame ukuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-mRNA hairpin
question5: Yimuphi umucu we-DNA osetshenziswa njengethempulethi yokubhalwa kwesakhi sofuzo esithile?
answer5: Intambo yesifanekiso
distractor5b: Noma yimuphi umucu we-DNA ungasetshenziswa ngokushintshana
question6: Ukulandelana kwe-molecule ye-mRNA kuqhathaniswa kanjani ne-DNA nontemplate strand?
answer6: Zicishe zifane ngaphandle kokuthi i-uracil (U) ithatha indawo ye-thymine (T) ku-RNA.
question7: Iyini ibhamuza lokubhala umbhalo?
answer7: Indawo ye-DNA lapho i-double helix ivuleka khona ngesikhathi sokubhalwa
distractor7a: Indawo lapho kuqala khona ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor7b: Indawo lapho ama-ribosome abopha khona i-mRNA
question8: Iyini isayithi le-+1 ekubhalweni?
answer8: I-nucleotide ye-DNA ehambisana ne-nucleotide yokuqala eguqulwe yaba yi-mRNA
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle ama-plasmid kuma-prokaryotes?
answer9: Zingama-molecule amancane e-DNA ayindilinga avame ukuthwala izakhi zofuzo ezifana nalezo zokumelana nama-antibiotic futhi angadluliselwa ngokuzimela ngaphandle kwe-chromosome yebhaktheriya.
distractor9a: Zingama-chromosome aqondile aqukethe zonke izakhi zofuzo ezibalulekile
question10: Umcwaningi uqhathanisa i-DNA yebhaktheriya kanye ne-mRNA yayo esanda kuhlanganiswa. Yikuphi ukuhlanganiswa kwesisekelo okwenzeka ngesikhathi sokubhalwa?
answer10: Amabhangqa angu-A ano-U, kanye no-C ano-G
distractor10a: Amabhangqa angu-A ano-T, kanye no-C ano-G
distractor10b: Amabhangqa angu-A ano-C, kanye namabhangqa angu-G ano-U
distractor10c: Amabhangqa angu-A ano-G, kanye no-C ano-U

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotes
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotes
chapterContent:
Ama-Prokaryote awanawo ama-nuclei afakwe ulwelwesi. Ngakho-ke, izinqubo zokubhalwa, ukuhumusha, kanye nokuwohloka kwe-mRNA konke kungenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izinga langaphakathi kweseli leprotheyini yebhaktheriya lingakhuliswa ngokushesha yizehlakalo eziningi zokubhalwa kanye nokuhumusha ezenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa kuthempulethi efanayo ye-DNA. Ukubhalwa kwe-prokaryotic kuvame ukumboza izakhi zofuzo ezingaphezu kweyodwa futhi kukhiqize ama-mRNA e-polycistronic achaza amaprotheni angaphezu kweyodwa.

 Ingxoxo yethu lapha izobonisa ukubhalwa ngokuchaza le nqubo ku-Escherichia coli, uhlobo lwebhaktheriya olufundwe kahle. Nakuba kukhona umehluko phakathi kokubhalwa ku-E. coli kanye nokubhalwa ku-archaea, ukuqonda ukubhalwa kwe-E. coli kungasetshenziswa cishe kuzo zonke izinhlobo zebhaktheriya.
question1: Kungani ukukopishwa nokuhumusha kungenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa kumaseli e-prokaryotic?
answer1: Ama-prokaryotes awanawo i-nucleus eboshiwe yi-membrane, okuvumela ama-ribosome ukuthi aqale ukuhumusha i-mRNA ngenkathi isabhalwa.
distractor1a: Ama-Prokaryote anama-nuclei amaningi ahlukanisa ukuhunyushwa kombhalo ekuhunyushweni
distractor1c: Ukuhumusha kwenzeka ngaphambi kokubhalwa phansi kuma-prokaryotes
question2: Iyini inzuzo eyodwa yokubhalwa kanye nokuhumusha ngasikhathi sinye kuma-prokaryotes?
answer2: Amaprotheni angakhiqizwa ngokushesha ngoba imijikelezo eminingi yokubhalwa nokuhumusha kwenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor2c: Izakhi zofuzo zivuselelwa unomphela ngemva komjikelezo owodwa wokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Iyini i-polycistronic mRNA?
answer3: I-molecule ye-mRNA equkethe ukulandelana kokubhala ikhodi kwamaprotheni angaphezu kweyodwa
distractor3b: I-molecule ye-mRNA equkethe ama-codon amaningi okuqala kodwa ebhala iphrotheni eyodwa
question4: Kungani ama-mRNA e-polycistronic ewusizo kumaseli e-prokaryotic?
answer4: Zivumela amaprotheni amaningana ahlobene nokusebenza ukuthi akhiqizwe kusukela kumbhalo owodwa we-mRNA
distractor4b: Zivumela iphrotheni eyodwa ukuthi ihunyushwe isuka kuma-mRNA amaningana ngesikhathi esisodwa
question5: Yisiphi isidalwa esivame ukusetshenziswa njengesibonelo sokutadisha ukubhalwa kwe-prokaryotic?
answer5: I-Escherichia coli
question6: Kungani i-Escherichia coli isetshenziswa kabanzi ukutadisha ukubhalwa kwamagciwane?
answer6: Izindlela zayo zokubhala zimelela izinhlobo eziningi zamagciwane
distractor6b: Izakhi zofuzo zayo zifana nezazo zonke ezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor6c: Yenza ukubhalwa ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus eboshwe yi-membrane
question7: Umcwaningi ubona ama-ribosome ehumusha i-mRNA molecule kuyilapho i-RNA polymerase isayenza ibe yi-synthesis. Yiluphi uhlobo lweseli olubonwayo?
answer7: Iseli le-prokaryotic

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuqaliswa kokubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic kuma-Prokaryotic | I-Prokaryotic RNA Polymerase
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuqaliswa kokubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic kuma-Prokaryotic | I-Prokaryotic RNA Polymerase
chapterContent: Ama-prokaryote asebenzisa i-RNA polymerase efanayo ukuloba zonke izakhi zofuzo zawo. Ku-E. coli, i-polymerase yakhiwe ngama-subunit amahlanu e-polypeptide, amabili awo afanayo. Amane kulawa ma-subunit, abizwa ngokuthi i-α, i-α, i-β, kanye ne-β ahlanganisa i-enzyme eyinhloko ye-polymerase. Lawa ma-subunit ahlangana njalo lapho i-gene ibhalwa, futhi ayahlukana uma ukubhalwa sekuqediwe. I-subunit ngayinye inendima ehlukile; ama-subunit amabili e-α ayadingeka ukuhlanganisa i-polymerase ku-DNA; i-β-subunit ibopha ku-ribonucleoside triphosphate ezoba yingxenye ye-"mRNA molecule"esanda kuzalwa; futhi i-β ibopha umucu wethempulethi ye-DNA. I-subunit yesihlanu, i-σ, ihilelekile kuphela ekuqalisweni kokubhalwa kombhalo. Inikeza ukucaciswa kokubhalwa kombhalo kangangokuthi i-polymerase iqala ukukhiqiza i-mRNA kusuka endaweni efanele yokuqaliswa kombhalo. Ngaphandle kwe-σ, i-enzyme eyinhloko izobhalwa kusuka kumasayithi angahleliwe futhi izokhiqiza ama-molecule e-mRNA achaza i-protein gibberish. I-polymerase eyakhiwe yizo zonke izi-subunit ezinhlanu ibizwa ngokuthi i-holoenzyme.
question1: Mangaki ama-subunit e-polypeptide akha i-RNA polymerase holoenzyme ku-Escherichia coli?
answer1: Ezinhlanu
question2: Yisiphi i-RNA polymerase subunit esinomthwalo wemfanelo wokuqaphela i-promoter efanele nokuqala ukubhalwa kwe-transcription?
question3: Yini ebingenzeka kakhulu uma i-subunit engu-σ (sigma) ibingekho ku-RNA polymerase?
answer3: I-enzyme eyinhloko izoqala ukubhalwa ezindaweni ezingahleliwe, ikhiqize ama-mRNA angalungile
distractor3a: I-RNA polymerase ngeke ikwazi ukubopha ama-ribonucleotide
question4: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-β subunit ye-prokaryotic RNA polymerase?
answer4: Ibopha ama-triphosphate e-ribonucleoside afakwa ku-mRNA ekhulayo
question5: Yisiphi i-RNA polymerase subunit ebopha umucu wethempulethi ye-DNA ngesikhathi sokubhalwa?
answer5: Iyunithi encane ye-β (beta prime)
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-subunit amabili e-α (alpha) ku-prokaryotic RNA polymerase?
answer6: Zisiza ekuhlanganiseni i-RNA polymerase ku-DNA
question7: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwe-RNA polymerase core enzyme kanye ne-holoenzyme?
answer7: I-holoenzyme iqukethe i-σ (sigma) subunit, kanti i-enzyme eyinhloko ayinayo
distractor7a: I-enzyme eyinhloko iqukethe i-σ, kodwa i-holoenzyme ayinayo
distractor7c: I-enzyme eyinhloko iqukethe ama-α subunit amabili kuphela
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono i-prokaryotic RNA polymerase?
answer8: Uhlobo olulodwa lwe-RNA polymerase lubhala zonke izakhi zofuzo kuma-prokaryotes
distractor8a: Izakhi zofuzo ze-prokaryotic ngayinye zidinga i-RNA polymerase ehlukile
distractor8b: Ama-Prokaryotes asebenzisa ama-polymerase amathathu ahlukene e-RNA ukuze abhale phansi
distractor8c: I-RNA polymerase isetshenziswa kuphela ukubhala izakhi zofuzo ze-rRNA

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic Kuma-Prokaryotic | Abagqugquzeli be-Prokaryotic
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic Kuma-Prokaryotic | Abagqugquzeli be-Prokaryotic
chapterContent: I-promoter iwuchungechunge lwe-DNA lapho umshini wokubhala ubopha khona futhi uqalise ukubhalwa. Ezimweni eziningi, ama-promoter akhona phezulu kwezakhi zofuzo azilawulayo. Uchungechunge oluthile lwe-promoter lubaluleke kakhulu ngoba lunquma ukuthi i-gene ehambisanayo ibhalwa ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngezinye izikhathi, noma kaningi. Nakuba ama-promoter ehluka phakathi kwama-genome e-prokaryotic, kunezinto ezimbalwa ezigciniwe. Ezifundeni ezingu--10 no-35 phezulu kwendawo yokuqalisa, kunezinhlu ezimbili zokuvumelana kwama-promoter, noma izifunda ezifanayo kuzo zonke ama-promoter nakuzo zonke izinhlobo ezahlukene zamagciwane (Isithombe 15.7). Uchungechunge lokuvumelana lwe--10, olubizwa ngokuthi isifunda esingu--10, yi-TATAAT. Uchungechunge lwe--35, i-TTGACA, luqashelwa futhi luboshwe yi-σ. Uma lokhu kusebenzisana sekwenziwe, ama-subunit e-enzyme eyinhloko anamathela endaweni. Isifunda esingu-A-T-rich -10 senza kube lula ukukhululeka kwethempulethi ye-DNA, futhi kwenziwa izibopho eziningana ze-phosphodiester. Isigaba sokuqala kokubhalwa kwemibhalo siphela ngokukhiqizwa kwemibhalo engasebenzi, okuyi-polymers yama-nucleotide angaba yi-10 enziwa futhi akhishwe.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko womgqugquzeli ku-DNA ye-prokaryotic?
answer1: Kuwuchungechunge lwe-DNA lapho umshini wokubhala ubopha khona ukuqala ukubhala
distractor1b: Kuphawula ukuphela kwesakhi sofuzo se-RNA polymerase
distractor1c: Yindawo lapho kuqala khona ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
question2: Zitholakala kuphi izikhuthazi ezivame ukutholakala uma kuqhathaniswa nezakhi zofuzo ezizilawulayo?
question3: Kungani ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide kwe-promoter kubalulekile?
answer3: Kuthinta ukuthi i-gene ehlobene ibhalwa kangaki
question4: Yikuphi ukulandelana kokuvumelana okutholakala esifundeni se--10 sabathuthukisi abaningi bamabhaktheriya?
answer4: I-TATAAT
question5: Yikuphi ukulandelana kokuvumelana okutholakala esifundeni sama-promoter amaningi amagciwane angama--35?
answer5: I-TTGACA
question6: Yisiphi isakhi se-RNA polymerase esiqaphela futhi sibophe ngqo i-promoter sequence ye--35?
answer6: Iyunithi encane engu-σ (sigma)
question7: Kungani isifunda esingu--10 sicebile ngezisekelo ze-adenine ne-thymine?
answer7: Ama-base pair e-AT alula ukuwahlukanisa, okwenza kube lula ukukhululeka kwe-DNA ngesikhathi sokuqala kokubhalwa kwe-transcription
distractor7a: Ama-AT pair aqukethe izibopho ezintathu ze-hydrogen, okwenza ukuqoshwa kuzinze kakhudlwana
distractor7b: I-RNA polymerase ingabopha kuphela i-adenine ne-thymine nucleotides
question8: Yiziphi izinguqulo ezingasebenzi ezikhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokuqala ukubhala umbhalo?
answer8: Ama-molecule amafushane e-RNA anama-nucleotide angaba ngu-10 akhiqizwa futhi akhishwe ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukuqoshwa okukhiqizwayo
distractor8a: Ama-molecule amade e-mRNA aqukethe izakhi zofuzo eziningi
distractor8b: Ama-primer e-RNA akhiwe ngaphambi kokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor8c: Izingcezu ze-mRNA eyonakele zisusiwe ngemva kokuhumusha

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukwandiswa kanye nokuqedwa kwama-Prokaryotes
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukwandiswa kanye nokuqedwa kwama-Prokaryotes
chapterContent: Isigaba sokwandiswa kokubhalwa kwe-transcription siqala ngokukhululwa kwe-subunit ye-σ kusuka ku-polymerase. Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-σ kuvumela i-enzyme eyinhloko ukuthi iqhubeke ngethempulethi ye-DNA, ihlanganise i-mRNA ngendlela engu-5 kuya ku-3 ngesivinini esingaba ngu-nucleotide ezingama-40 ngomzuzwana. Njengoba ukwanda kuqhubeka, i-DNA iyaqhubeka ivuleka ngaphambi kwe-enzyme eyinhloko bese ibuyela emuva ngemuva kwayo (Isithombe 15.8). Ukuhlanganiswa kwesisekelo phakathi kwe-DNA ne-RNA akuzinzile ngokwanele ukugcina ukuzinza kwezingxenye zokwenziwa kwe-mRNA. Esikhundleni salokho, i-RNA polymerase isebenza njengesixhumi esizinzile phakathi kwethempulethi ye-DNA kanye nezintambo ze-RNA ezisafufusa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwanda akuphazanyiswa ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
question1: Yisiphi isenzakalo esiphawula ukuqala kwesigaba sokwandiswa kokubhalwa kwama-prokaryotes?
answer1: I-subunit ye-σ (sigma) iyahlukana ne-RNA polymerase
question2: I-mRNA ikhiqizwa ngayiphi indlela ngesikhathi sokwandiswa kokubhalwa kwe-transcription?
question3: Cishe i-RNA polymerase ikhiqiza ngokushesha kangakanani i-mRNA ngesikhathi sokunwebeka ku-Escherichia coli?
answer3: Cishe ama-nucleotide angu-40 ngomzuzwana
question4: Kwenzekani ku-DNA double helix njengoba i-RNA polymerase ihamba ngesikhathi sokwandiswa?
answer4: I-DNA ivuleka ngaphambi kwe-RNA polymerase bese ibuyela emuva ngemuva kwayo
distractor4a: I-DNA ihlala ivulekile ngokuphelele kulo lonke ukubhalwa kwayo
distractor4b: I-DNA ibuyiselwa emuva ngaphambi kwe-RNA polymerase bese ivuleka ngemuva kwayo
distractor4c: Imicu ye-DNA ihlukana unomphela ngemva kokuqala kokubhalwa kwe-transcription
question5: Kungani i-molecule ye-RNA ekhulayo ihlala ihlotshaniswa nethempulethi ye-DNA ngesikhathi sokunwebeka?
answer5: I-RNA polymerase isebenza njengesixhumi esizinzile phakathi kwethempulethi ye-DNA kanye ne-RNA esafufusa
distractor5a: Izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwe-DNA ne-RNA zodwa ziqine ngokwanele ukugcina inkimbinkimbi
distractor5b: I-subunit engu-σ (sigma) ibamba i-RNA unomphela ku-DNA
distractor5c: I-DNA ligase ihlanganisa i-RNA nethempulethi ye-DNA
question6: Kungani izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwethempulethi ye-DNA kanye ne-RNA esanda kuhlanganiswa zinganele zodwa ngesikhathi sokubhalwa?
answer6: Azizinzile ngokwanele ukugcina i-transcription complex ngaphandle kwe-RNA polymerase
distractor6a: Zivimbela i-RNA polymerase ukuthi ingahambi nge-DNA
distractor6b: Zinamandla kunezibopho ze-covalent futhi kumele ziphulwe ngokushesha
distractor6c: Zenziwa kuphela ngemva kokuba ukulotshwa sekuqediwe
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima yeyunithi encane engu-σ (sigma) ngemva kokuqala kokubhalwa kwemibhalo?
answer7: Iyahlukana ne-RNA polymerase, ivumela i-enzyme eyinhloko ukuthi iqhubeke nokwelulwa
distractor7a: Ihlala inamathele unomphela ku-RNA polymerase kulo lonke ukubhalwa kwayo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic | Izimpawu Zokuphela kwe-Prokaryotic
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.2 Ukubhalwa kwe-Prokaryotic | Izimpawu Zokuphela kwe-Prokaryotic
chapterContent:
Uma i-gene isibhaliwe, i-prokaryotic polymerase idinga ukuyalwa ukuba ihlukane ne-DNA template futhi ikhulule i-mRNA esanda kwenziwa. Kuye ngokuthi i-gene ibhaliwe, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezimpawu zokuphela. Enye isekelwe kumaprotheni kanti enye isekelwe ku-RNA. Ukuphela okuncike ku-Rho kulawulwa yi-rho (ρ) protein, elandela ngemuva kwe-polymerase ku-mRNA chain ekhulayo. Ngasekupheleni kwe-gene, i-polymerase ihlangana nokugijima kwama-nucleotide e-G ku-DNA template bese iyama. Ngenxa yalokho, i-rho protein ishayisana ne-polymerase. Ukusebenzisana ne-rho kukhipha i-mRNA ku-transcription bubble.

 Ukuphela okuxhomeke ku-Rho kulawulwa yizilandelaniso ezithile ku-DNA template strand. Njengoba i-polymerase isondela ekupheleni kwe-gene ebhaliwe, ihlangana nesifunda esicebile ngama-nucleotide e-C-G. I-mRNA iyazigoqa futhi, futhi ama-nucleotide e-C-G ahambisanayo ayahlangana. Umphumela uba yi-hairpin ezinzile ebangela ukuthi i-polymerase ime ngokushesha nje lapho iqala ukubhala indawo ecebile ngama-nucleotide e-A-T. Isifunda se-U-A esihambisanayo se-mRNA transcript sakha ukusebenzisana okubuthakathaka ne-DNA yethempulethi. Lokhu, kuhlanganiswe ne-polymerase eme, kubangela ukungazinzi okwanele ukuze i-enzyme eyinhloko ihlukane futhi ikhulule i-mRNA transcript entsha.

 Lapho kuphela, inqubo yokubhala isiphelile. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka ukuphela, i-prokaryotic transcript ngabe isivele isetshenziswe ukuqala ukuhlanganiswa kwamakhophi amaningi eprotheyini efakiwe ngoba lezi zinqubo zingenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. Ukuhlanganiswa kokubhala, ukuhumusha, ngisho nokuwohloka kwe-mRNA kungenzeka ngoba zonke lezi zinqubo zenzeka ngendlela efanayo engu-5 kuya ku-3, futhi ngoba akukho ukuhlanganiswa kwe-membranous kuseli le-prokaryotic (Isithombe 15.9). Ngokuphambene, ukuba khona kwe-nucleus kumaseli e-eukaryotic kuvimbela ukubhalwa kanye nokuhumusha ngasikhathi sinye.
question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yesignali yokuphela kokubhalwa kwemibhalo kuma-prokaryotes?
answer1: Ukwenza i-RNA polymerase ihlukane nethempulethi ye-DNA futhi ikhulule i-mRNA esanda kuhlanganiswa
question2: Yiliphi iphrotheni elibangela ukuphela kwe-rho-dependent?
question3: Ukuphela kokuphela kwe-rho-dependent kuphetha kanjani ukulotshwa?
answer3: Iprotheyini ye-rho ibamba i-RNA polymerase emisiwe bese ikhipha i-mRNA kusuka kubhamuza lokubhala.
distractor3a: Iphrotheni ye-rho ibopha iphromotha futhi ivimbele ukuqaliswa kokubhalwa
distractor3b: Iphrotheni ye-rho inquma ithempulethi ye-DNA phakathi
question4: Yini ebangela ukuthi i-RNA polymerase ime ngesikhathi sokuphela kwe-rho-independent?
answer4: Ukwakheka kwe-hairpin ye-mRNA eqinile kulandelwa ukuqoshwa kwesifunda esicebile nge-A-T
question5: Kungani isakhiwo se-hairpin esakhiwe ngesikhathi sokuphela kwe-rho-independent sizinzile kakhulu?
answer5: Yakhiwa ngokulandelana kwe-C-G-rich okuhambisanayo ku-mRNA
distractor5c: Ibanjwe ndawonye ngezibopho ze-phosphodiester phakathi kwemicu ye-DNA
question6: Kungani isifunda esicebile nge-A-U sinikeza isandla ekuqedweni kokuzimela kwe-rho?
answer6: Ukusebenzisana kwe-U-A phakathi kwethempulethi ye-mRNA ne-DNA kubuthakathaka kakhulu, okuvumela umbhalo ukuthi uhlukaniswe
distractor6a: Ama-base pair e-A-U aqukethe izibopho ezintathu ze-hydrogen, okwenza ziqine kakhulu
distractor6b: Isifunda se-A-U siqasha iphrotheni ye-rho kubhamuza lokubhala
distractor6c: Isifunda se-A-U sibangela ukuthi ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kume
question7: Kungani ukukopishwa nokuhumusha kungenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa kuma-prokaryotes kodwa hhayi kuma-eukaryotes?
answer7: Ama-prokaryote awanawo i-nucleus eboshelwe ulwelwesi, okuvumela ukuthi zombili izinqubo zenzeke endaweni efanayo yeselula.
distractor7b: Ama-prokaryotes anama-nuclei amaningi asheshisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor7c: Ukuhumusha kuma-eukaryotes kwenzeka njalo ngaphambi kokubhalwa phansi
question8: Iyiphi inqubo okungenzeka ukuthi isivele yenzeka ngaphambi kokuba ukubhalwa kuphele kuseli le-prokaryotic?
answer8: Ukuhunyushwa kwe-mRNA efanayo ibe yiprotheni

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba kulindelekile, ukubhalwa kwe-eukaryotes kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunokubhalwa kwe-prokaryotes. Okokuqala, ukubhalwa kwe-eukaryotes kuhilela olunye lwezinhlobo ezintathu ze-RNA polymerase, kuye ngokuthi i-gene ibhalwa kanjani. Okwesibili, ukuqala kokubhalwa kwe-transcription kuhilela ukubopha izici eziningana zokubhalwa kwe-transcription kubagqugquzeli abayinkimbinkimbi abavame ukutholakala phezulu kwe-gene ekopishwayo. Izici zokubhalwa kwe-transcription zingasebenza noma zivimbele ukuvezwa kwe-gene. Ukuphela kokubhalwa kwe-transcription kuhilela ama-RNA polymerase.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluyifa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.1 I-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo i-RNA, ingumthombo oyinhloko wolwazi oluyifa.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.5 Umfundi angahlola ezinye izincazelo zesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa izakhiwo kanye nezindlela ze-DNA ne-RNA ukusekela isimangalo sokuthi i-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo, ukuthi i-RNA iyimithombo eyinhloko yolwazi oluyifa.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yomkhuba Wesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 3.3][APLO 3.22][APLO 2.36][APLO 1.14][APLO 2.22][APLO 4.5]

 Ama-Prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes enza inqubo efanayo yokubhala, ngomehluko obalulekile. Umehluko obaluleke kakhulu phakathi kwama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes yi-nucleus nama-organelle aboshwe yi-membrane. Njengoba izakhi zofuzo ziboshwe ku-nucleus, iseli le-eukaryotic kumele likwazi ukuthutha i-mRNA yalo liye ku-cytoplasm futhi kumele livikele i-mRNA yalo ekuwohlokeni ngaphambi kokuba lihunyushwe. Ama-Eukaryotes asebenzisa futhi ama-polymerase amathathu ahlukene ngalinye elibhala i-subset ehlukile yezakhi zofuzo. Ama-mRNA e-Eukaryotic avame ukuba yi-monogenic, okusho ukuthi achaza iphrotheni eyodwa.
question1: Yisiphi isici esenza ukubhalwa kwe-eukaryotes kube nzima kakhulu kunakuma-prokaryotes?
answer1: Ama-Eukaryote asebenzisa ama-polymerase amathathu ahlukene e-RNA kanye nezici eziningi zokubhala ukuze aqalise ukubhala
distractor1a: Ama-Eukaryote asebenzisa i-RNA polymerase eyodwa kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo
question2: Zingaki ama-polymerase e-RNA asetshenziswa ekubhalweni kwamaseli e-eukaryotic?
question3: Iyini indima eyinhloko yezinto ezibangela ukubhalwa kwemibhalo ekubhalweni kwe-eukaryotic?
answer3: Zibopha abagqugquzeli futhi zilawula ukuthi ukulotshwa kuyasebenza noma kuvinjelwe
question4: Kungani amaseli e-eukaryotic kumele athuthe i-mRNA esuka ku-nucleus iye ku-cytoplasm?
answer4: Ukuhumusha kwenzeka ku-cytoplasm, kuyilapho ukubhalwa kwenzeka ku-nucleus
question5: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle ama-mRNA e-prokaryotic kanye nama-eukaryotic?
answer5: Ama-mRNA e-Eukaryotic ngokuvamile ayi-monocistronic, kanti ama-mRNA e-prokaryotic avame ukuba yi-polycistronic
distractor5c: Ama-mRNA e-Prokaryotic ahlala e-monocistronic, kanti ama-mRNA e-eukaryotic ahlala e-polycistronic
question6: Kungani i-mRNA ye-eukaryotic ivikelwe ngaphambi kokuhumusha?
answer6: Kumelwe ihlale izinzile ngenkathi icutshungulwa futhi ithuthwa isuka ku-nucleus iye ku-cytoplasm
distractor6b: I-DNA polymerase yonakalisa i-mRNA ngesikhathi sokubhalwa
distractor6c: Ama-Ribosome awakwazi ukubona i-mRNA esanda kuhlanganiswa
question7: Yisiphi isakhiwo seseli esivimbela ukukopishwa nokuhumusha ukuthi kwenzeke ngesikhathi esisodwa kuma-eukaryotes?
answer7: I-nucleus eboshwe yi-membrane
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kangcono ukulotshwa kwama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes?
answer8: Zombili zenza inqubo efanayo eyisisekelo yokubhala, kodwa ama-eukaryote adinga ama-polymerase e-RNA engeziwe, izici zokubhala, kanye nokuthuthwa kwe-mRNA kusuka ku-nucleus.
distractor8b: Ama-prokaryotes kuphela adinga ama-promoter kanye ne-RNA polymerase
distractor8c: Ama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes asebenzisa izindlela ezifanayo zokubhala ngaphandle komehluko omkhulu

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic Kuma-Eukaryotes | Ama-Polymerases Amathathu E-Eukaryotic RNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic Kuma-Eukaryotes | Ama-Polymerases Amathathu E-Eukaryotic RNA
chapterContent:
Ngokungafani ne-prokaryotic polymerase engazibopha kuthempulethi ye-DNA ngokwayo, ama-eukaryote adinga amanye amaprotheni amaningana, abizwa ngokuthi ama-transcription factor, ukuze aqale abophe endaweni yomkhuthazi bese esiza ekutholeni i-polymerase efanele.

 Ama-Eukaryotic RNA Polymerases Amathathu
Izici zokwenziwa kwe-eukaryotic mRNA ziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kuneze-prokaryotes. Esikhundleni se-polymerase eyodwa equkethe ama-subunit amahlanu, ama-eukaryote anama-polymerase amathathu akhiwe ama-subunit ayi-10 noma ngaphezulu. I-polymerase ngayinye ye-eukaryotic idinga nesethi ehlukile yama-transcription factor ukuze ayilethe kuthempulethi ye-DNA.

 I-RNA polymerase I itholakala ku-nucleolus, isakhiwo esikhethekile senuzi lapho i-ribosomal RNA (rRNA) ibhalwa khona, icutshungulwe, futhi ihlanganiswe ibe ama-ribosome (Ithebula 15.1). Ama-molecule e-rRNA abhekwa njengama-RNA esakhiwo ngoba anendima yeselula kodwa awahunyushwa abe yiprotheni. Ama-rRNA ayizingxenye ze-ribosome futhi abalulekile enkambisweni yokuhumusha. I-RNA polymerase I ihlanganisa wonke ama-rRNA ngaphandle kwe-molecule ye-5S rRNA. Igama elithi “S” lisebenza kumayunithi e-Svedberg”, inani elingelona elongeziwe elichaza isivinini lapho inhlayiya iphuma khona ngesikhathi sokukhuphula.

 Izindawo, Imikhiqizo, kanye Nokuzwela Kwama-Three Eukaryotic RNA Polymerases
I-RNA Polymerase
Igumbi Leselula_____Umkhiqizo Wokuqoshwa_____α-Ukuzwela kwe-Amanitin

 I
I-Nucleolus_____Wonke ama-rRNA ngaphandle kwe-5S rRNA_____Akuzweli

 II
I-Nucleus_____Wonke ama-pre-mRNA enuzi abhala amaprotheni_____Azwela kakhulu

 III
I-Nucleus_____5S rRNA, ama-tRNA, kanye nama-RNA amancane enuzi_____Izwela ngokulingene

 I-RNA polymerase II itholakala ku-nucleus futhi ihlanganisa wonke ama-pre-mRNA enuzi aqukethe amaprotheni. Ama-pre-mRNA e-Eukaryotic acutshungulwa kabanzi ngemva kokubhalwa kodwa ngaphambi kokuhumusha. Ukuze kucace, ingxoxo yale module mayelana nokubhalwa nokuhumusha kuma-eukaryotes izosebenzisa igama elithi mRNA” ukuchaza kuphela ama-molecule avuthiwe, acutshunguliwe alungele ukuhunyushwa. I-RNA polymerase II inesibopho sokubhala iningi elikhulu lama-gene e-eukaryotic.

 I-RNA polymerase III nayo itholakala ku-nucleus. Le polymerase ibhala izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-RNA esakhiwo afaka phakathi i-5S pre-rRNA, ukudlulisa ama-pre-RNA (ama-pre-tRNA), kanye nama-pre-RNA amancane enuzi. Ama-tRNA anendima ebalulekile ekuhumusheni; asebenza njengama-molecule e-adaptor phakathi kwethempulethi ye-mRNA kanye nochungechunge lwe-polypeptide olukhulayo. Ama-RNA amancane enuzi anemisebenzi eyahlukahlukene, kufaka phakathi ukuhlanganisa ama-pre-mRNA kanye nokulawula izici zokubhalwa.

 Usosayensi ochaza i-gene entsha anganquma ukuthi iyiphi i-polymerase eyibhala ngokuhlola ukuthi i-gene ivezwa yini lapho kukhona ubuthi obuthile be-mushroom, i-α-amanitin (Ithebula 15.1). Ngokuthakazelisayo, i-α-amanitin ekhiqizwa yi-Amanita phalloides, i-Death Cap mushroom, ithinta ama-polymerase amathathu ngendlela ehlukile kakhulu. I-RNA polymerase I ayizweli nhlobo ku-α-amanitin, okusho ukuthi i-polymerase ingabhala i-DNA ngaphakathi kwe-vitro lapho kukhona lobu buthi. Ngokuphambene nalokho, i-RNA polymerase II inozwela kakhulu ku-α-amanitin, kanti i-RNA polymerase III inozwela ngokulinganayo. Ukwazi i-polymerase ebhalayo kungamsiza umcwaningi ukuthi aqonde umsebenzi ojwayelekile we-gene efundwayo. Ngenxa yokuthi i-RNA polymerase II ibhala iningi lama-gene, sizogxila kule polymerase ezingxoxweni zethu ezilandelayo mayelana nezici zokubhalwa kwe-eukaryotic kanye nabagqugquzeli.
question1: Kungani ama-polymerase e-RNA e-eukaryotic edinga izici zokubhala ngaphambi kokuba kuqalwe ukubhala?
answer1: Izinto zokubhala zibopha umgqugquzeli kuqala bese ziqasha i-RNA polymerase efanele kuthempulethi ye-DNA
distractor1a: Izici zokubhala phansi zenza i-RNA primer edingekayo ukuze kubhalwe phansi
distractor1b: Izinto zokubhala zithatha indawo ye-RNA polymerase ngesikhathi sokunwebeka
distractor1c: Izinto zokubhala zihlukanisa i-mRNA ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukubhala
question2: Yimuphi i-RNA polymerase enesibopho sokubhala iningi lama-gene abhala amaprotheni kuma-eukaryotes?
question3: Yimuphi i-RNA polymerase etholakala ku-nucleolus futhi ehlanganisa cishe wonke ama-ribosomal RNA?
answer3: I-RNA polymerase I
question4: Yiliphi i-molecule ye-RNA ENGAKWENZIWA yi-RNA polymerase I?
answer4: I-5S rRNA
question5: Yikuphi i-RNA polymerase ehlanganisa i-5S rRNA, i-tRNA, kanye ne-RNA encane yenuzi?
answer5: I-RNA polymerase III
question6: I-gene esanda kutholakala iyaqhubeka nokubhalwa phansi lapho kukhona i-α-amanitin. Yimuphi i-RNA polymerase okungenzeka ukuthi ibhala phansi le gene?
answer6: I-RNA polymerase I
distractor6c: Zonke izinhlobo ezintathu ze-polymerase zivinjelwe ngokulinganayo yi-α-amanitin
question7: Yimuphi i-RNA polymerase ezwela kakhulu ku-α-amanitin?
answer7: I-RNA polymerase II
question8: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-RNA yokudlulisa (i-tRNA)?
answer8: Isebenza njenge-molecule ye-adaptha phakathi kwama-codon e-mRNA nama-amino acid ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
distractor8a: Ithwala ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kusukela ku-DNA kuya ku-ribosome
question9: Yimuphi umsebenzi obalulekile wama-RNA amancane enuzi (ama-snRNA)?
answer9: Bahlanganyela ekuhlanganisweni kwe-pre-mRNA kanye nokulawulwa kwezinto zokubhala
question10: Kungani i-α-amanitin ingaba usizo ekuboneni umsebenzi wesakhi sofuzo esisanda kutholakala?
answer10: Ama-polymerase e-RNA ahlukene anokuzwela okuhlukile ku-α-amanitin, okuvumela abacwaningi ukuthi banqume ukuthi iyiphi i-polymerase ebhala i-gene
distractor10a: Ibhala unomphela yonke i-molecule ye-RNA ekhiqizwa esitokisini
distractor10b: Ibopha kuphela ku-DNA polymerase, ivimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA
distractor10c: Ivimbela ngqo ukuhumusha ngaphandle kokuthinta ukulotshwa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotes | Isakhiwo Somgqugquzeli we-RNA Polymerase II
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotes | Isakhiwo Somgqugquzeli we-RNA Polymerase II
chapterContent:
Ngokungafani ne-prokaryotic polymerase engazibopha kuthempulethi ye-DNA ngokwayo, ama-eukaryote adinga amanye amaprotheni amaningana, abizwa ngokuthi ama-transcription factors, ukuze aqale abophe endaweni yomkhuthazi bese esiza ekutholeni i-polymerase efanele.

 Isakhiwo se-RNA Polymerase II Promoter
Abakhuthazi be-Eukaryotic bakhulu kakhulu futhi bayinkimbinkimbi kune-promoters ye-prokaryotic, kodwa bobabili banebhokisi le-TATA. Isibonelo, ku-gene yegundane i-thymidine kinase, ibhokisi le-TATA litholakala cishe ku--30 uma kuqhathaniswa nendawo yokuqala (+1) (Isithombe 15.10). Kuleli gene, ukulandelana kwebhokisi le-TATA ngqo yi-TATAAAA, njengoba kufundwe esiqondisweni sesi-5 kuya ku-3 ku-strand engekho ithempulethi. Lokhu kulandelana akufani nebhokisi le-E. coli TATA, kodwa kulondoloza isici esicebile se-A-T. Ukuqina kokuqina kwezibopho ze-A-T kuphansi futhi lokhu kusiza ithempulethi ye-DNA ukuthi ikhululeke endaweni lapho ilungiselela ukubhala.

 I-genome yegundane ihlanganisa i-gene eyodwa kanye nama-pseudogene amabili e-cytoplasmic thymidine kinase. Ama-pseudogene ayizakhi zofuzo ezilahlekelwe ikhono lazo lokubhala amaprotheni noma ezingasavezwa yiseli. Lawa ma-pseudogene akopishwa kusuka ku-mRNA futhi afakwa ku-chromosome. Isibonelo, i-mouse thymidine kinase promoter nayo inebhokisi le-CAAT eligciniwe (GGCCAATCT) cishe ku--80. Lolu chungechunge lubalulekile futhi luhilelekile ezintweni zokubopha ukubhalwa. Ngaphezulu kwebhokisi le-TATA, ama-eukaryotic promoters angase abe nebhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu elicebile nge-GC (GGCG) noma amabhokisi e-octamer (ATTGCAT). Lezi zakhi zibopha izici zeseli ezandisa ukusebenza kahle kokuqala ukubhalwa futhi zivame ukutholakala kuma-gene asebenzayo kakhulu avezwa njalo yiseli.
question1: Kungani ama-polymerase e-RNA e-eukaryotic edinga izici zokubhala ngaphambi kokuba kuqalwe ukubhala?
answer1: Izinto zokubhala ziqala ngokubopha umgqugquzeli bese ziqasha i-RNA polymerase efanele ku-DNA
distractor1a: Izici zokubhala zenza ama-primer e-RNA e-RNA polymerase
distractor1b: Izici zokuloba ziqeda ukuloba ngemva kokwelulwa
