distractor1c: Izinto zokubhala zisusa ama-intron ku-mRNA ngaphambi kokubhala
question2: Yisiphi isici somkhuthazi esivame ukutholakala kokubili kubakhuthazi be-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic?
question3: Cishe likuphi ibhokisi le-TATA ku-gene yegundane i-thymidine kinase?
answer3: Cishe -30 uma kuqhathaniswa nesayithi lokuqala lokubhala umbhalo (+1)
question4: Kungani ibhokisi le-TATA licebile ngama-nucleotide e-adenine ne-thymine?
answer4: Ama-base pair e-AT awazinzile kangako ekushiseni, okwenza kube lula ukuphumula i-DNA ukuze ibhalwe phansi
distractor4a: Ama-base pair e-AT aqukethe izibopho ezintathu ze-hydrogen eziqinisa ukubopha kwe-promoter
distractor4b: Izifunda ezicebile nge-A-T zibhala ikhodi ye-start ngqo
distractor4c: I-RNA polymerase II ingabopha kuphela i-adenine ne-thymine nucleotides
question5: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko webhokisi le-CAAT kubagqugquzeli abaningi be-eukaryotic?
answer5: Isebenza njengendawo yokubopha izinto zokubhala ezidingekayo ukuze kubhalwe kahle
distractor5b: Ifaka ikhodi ye-amino acid yokuqala yeprotheni
question6: Yiziphi izakhi zokukhuthaza ezivame ukuhlotshaniswa nezakhi zofuzo ezivezwa emazingeni aphezulu?
answer6: Amabhokisi ane-GC amaningi kanye namabhokisi e-octamer
question7: Iyini i-pseudogene?
answer7: Izakhi zofuzo ezilahlekelwe ikhono lazo lokubhala amaprotheni noma ezingasavezwa yiseli
distractor7a: Izakhi zofuzo ezikhiqiza amaprotheni amaningi avela ku-mRNA eyodwa
question8: Ama-pseudogene amaningi akhiwa kanjani?
answer8: Zikopishwa kusuka ku-mRNA bese zifakwa emuva ku-chromosome
distractor8a: Zivela lapho ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kwehluleka ukuqeda
distractor8c: Zakhiwa ngokususwa kwama-intron ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa kwe-RNA
question9: Umcwaningi ushintsha ibhokisi le-CAAT lomgqugquzeli we-eukaryotic. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer9: Ukuncipha kokubopha kwezinto zokubhala kanye nokwehla kokuqala kokubhala
distractor9b: Iphrotheni ebhalwe phansi izothola ama-amino acid engeziwe
distractor9c: I-RNA polymerase izophinda i-DNA esikhundleni sokuyibhala kabusha
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 15.11. Usosayensi uhlanganisa i-eukaryotic promoter phambi kwe-bacterial gene bese efaka i-gene ku-bacterial chromosome. Ubungalindela ukuthi i-bacteria ibhale i-gene?
answer10: Cha, ama-prokaryotes asebenzisa ama-promoter ahlukile kune-eukaryotes
distractor10a: Ekuqaleni igciwane ngeke liyibhale phansi, kodwa lizoyibhala phansi ngemva kokuvala okungu-5'
distractor10b: Ngeke ikubhale ngoba akukho umsila we-poly A kuma-prokaryotes

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotes | Izici Zokubhalwa Kwe-RNA Polymerase II
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotes | Izici Zokubhalwa Kwe-RNA Polymerase II
chapterContent:
Ubunzima bokubhalwa kwe-eukaryotic abupheli ngama-polymerase kanye nama-promoter. Ibutho lezinto eziyisisekelo zokubhalwa kwe-basal, izithuthukisi, kanye nezithulisi nazo ziyasiza ekulawuleni imvamisa lapho i-pre-mRNA ikhiqizwa khona kusuka ku-gene. Izithuthukisi kanye nezithulisi zithinta ukusebenza kahle kokubhalwa kwe-transcription kodwa azidingeki ukuze ukubhalwa kwe-transcription kuqhubeke. Izinto eziyisisekelo zokubhalwa kwe-transcription zibalulekile ekwakhiweni kwe-preinitiation complex kuthempulethi ye-DNA kamuva eqoqa i-RNA polymerase II ukuze iqalise ukubhalwa kwe-transcription.

 Amagama ezici zokubhala eziyisisekelo aqala ngo-TFII” (lena yi-transcription factor ye-RNA polymerase II) futhi achazwe ngezinhlamvu u-A–J. Izici zokubhala zihlangana ngokuhlelekile endaweni yethempulethi ye-DNA, ngayinye iqinisa i-preinitiation complex futhi inegalelo ekubuthweni kwe-RNA polymerase II.

 Izinqubo zokuletha i-RNA polymerases I kanye ne-III kuthempulethi ye-DNA zihilela ukuqoqwa okuncane kwezici zokubhala eziyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa ingqikithi evamile iyafana. Ukubhala kwe-Eukaryotic kuyinqubo elawulwa ngokuqinile edinga amaprotheni ahlukahlukene ukuze asebenzisane futhi asebenzisane ne-DNA strand. Nakuba inqubo yokubhala kuma-eukaryotes ihilela ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu kwe-metabolic kunakuma-prokaryotes, iqinisekisa ukuthi iseli libhala ngqo ama-pre-mRNA ayidingayo ukuze kwakhiwe amaprotheni.

 Ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kombungu womuntu, i-transcription factor ebhalwe yi-SRY gene iqala uchungechunge lwezehlakalo, okubangela ukuthi umbungu uthuthukise izici zobulili zesilisa. Le gene ikwi-chromosome ye-Y kubantu nakwezinye izilwane eziningi ezincelisayo. Ukususwa noma ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ze-SRY kungabangela ukuthi umbungu womuntu ungakhuli ube ngowesilisa yize umuntu ene-genotype ye-XY, isimo esibizwa ngokuthi i-Swyer syndrome
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yezinto eziyisisekelo zokubhala umbhalo ekubhalweni kwe-eukaryotic?
answer1: Zihlangana zibe yi-complex yokuqala eqoqa i-RNA polymerase II kumgqugquzeli.
distractor1c: Ziqeda ukubhalwa ngokukhulula i-RNA polymerase II
question2: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono izithuthukisi kanye nezithulisi?
answer2: Zilawula ukusebenza kahle kokubhalwa kombhalo kodwa azidingeki ukuze ukubhalwa kombhalo kwenzeke
distractor2a: Zibalulekile ukuze i-RNA polymerase II ibophe i-DNA
distractor2c: Zivuselela noma zivale izakhi zofuzo unomphela
question3: Iyini i-preinitiation complex?
answer3: Iqembu lezinto eziyisisekelo zokubhala ezihlanganiswe kuphromotha eqoqa i-RNA polymerase II
distractor3b: I-DNA replication complex ehlanganiswe ekuqaleni kokuphindaphinda
question4: Izici zokubhala eziyisisekelo ezihlobene ne-RNA polymerase II ziqokwa ndawonye ngasiphi isiqalo?
answer4: I-TFII
question5: Izici eziyisisekelo zokubhala phansi zinegalelo kanjani ekuqalisweni kokubhala phansi?
answer5: Zibopha ngokulandelana kumkhuthazi, ziqinise i-preinitiation complex futhi ziqashe i-RNA polymerase II.
distractor5c: Zithatha indawo ye-RNA polymerase II ngesikhathi sokwandiswa
question6: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle ukuqoshwa yi-RNA polymerases I, II, kanye ne-III?
answer6: Zonke zidinga izici zokubhala, yize i-RNA polymerase II idinga isethi eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu
distractor6a: I-RNA polymerase II kuphela edinga izici zokubhala
distractor6b: Ama-polymerase e-RNA I no-III adinga ama-complexes afanayo e-transcription factor njenge-RNA polymerase II
distractor6c: Akukho neyodwa yalezi polymerase ezintathu edinga izici zokubhala
question7: Kungani ukubhalwa kwe-eukaryotic kubhekwa njengokulawulwa kakhulu kunokubhalwa kwe-prokaryotic?
answer7: Kudinga ukusebenzisana okuhlelekile phakathi kwezinto eziningi zokubhala, izakhi ze-DNA ezilawulayo, kanye nama-polymerase e-RNA ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zivezwa kuphela uma kudingeka.
distractor7a: I-RNA polymerase II ingabhala i-DNA ngaphandle kokulandelana kwephromotha
distractor7b: Amaseli e-Eukaryotic abhala yonke i-gene ngokuqhubekayo
distractor7c: I-transcription factor eyodwa kuphela elawula zonke izakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic
question8: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ukwakheka kwe-preinitiation complex ku-promoter. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer8: I-RNA polymerase II ayikwazi ukutholwa kahle, okunciphisa kakhulu noma kuvimbele ukuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor8a: Ukuhumusha kuqhubeka ngokujwayelekile ngaphandle kokubhalwa phansi
distractor8b: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuyama kulo lonke i-chromosome
question9: Umkhiqizo weprotheyini we-SRY gene uyiprotheyini ebopha i-DNA. Kanye neprotheyini ebizwa ngokuthi i-SF1, iprotheyini ye-SRY isebenza njengesici sokubhala esivula izakhi zofuzo ezithile. Yisiphi kwezitatimende ezilandelayo esichaza kahle ukuthi ushintsho kula maprotheni amabili lungathinta kanjani intuthuko yobulili yabesilisa?
answer9: Bheka uMfanekiso 15.12. Kokubili ukuguqulwa kweprotheni ye-SRY kanye nokuguqulwa kwe-SF1 okwaqeda umsebenzi kungaholela ekushodeni kwentuthuko yezimpawu zobulili besilisa.
distractor9a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuqede umsebenzi we-SF1 kuzokwandisa umphumela wokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwe-SRY, okwenza umuntu abe ngowesifazane kakhulu.
distractor9b: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okwaqeda umsebenzi we-SF1 kungasusa ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ku-SRY, ngakho-ke uma zombili lezi zakhi zofuzo zenzeka ndawonye izici zobulili zesilisa zizokhula ngendlela evamile.
distractor9c: Ukuguqulwa kweprotheni ye-SRY okwaqeda umsebenzi kungabangela ukuthuthukiswa okungavamile kwezici zobulili besilisa kodwa ukuguqulwa kwe-SF1 ngeke

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotes | Izakhiwo Zomgqugquzeli We-RNA Polymerases I kanye ne-III
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuqaliswa Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotes | Izakhiwo Zomgqugquzeli We-RNA Polymerases I kanye ne-III
chapterContent: Kuma-eukaryotes, izakhi zokukhuthaza ezigciniwe ziyahlukahluka kuma-gene abhalwe yi-RNA polymerases I, II, kanye ne-III. I-RNA polymerase I ibhala izakhi zofuzo ezinezilandelana ezimbili ze-GC-rich promoter esifundeni esingu--45 kuya ku-+20. Lezi zilandelana zodwa zanele ukuthi ukuqaliswa kokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeke, kodwa ama-promoter anezilandelana ezengeziwe esifundeni kusukela ku--180 kuya ku--105 phezulu kwendawo yokuqalisa azothuthukisa kakhulu ukuqaliswa. Ama-gene abhalwe yi-RNA polymerase III anama-promoter noma ama-promoter avela ngaphakathi kwama-gene ngokwawo.
question1: Izakhiwo ze-promoter zihluke kanjani phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezibhalwe yi-RNA polymerases I, II, kanye ne-III?
answer1: I-RNA polymerase ngayinye ibona izakhi ezihlukile zokuphromotha eziqondene nezakhi zofuzo ezizibhalayo.
distractor1a: Zonke i-RNA polymerase ezintathu ziqaphela ukulandelana okufanayo kwebhokisi le-TATA
distractor1b: I-RNA polymerase II kuphela edinga ukulandelana kwe-promoter
distractor1c: Ama-polymerase e-RNA I no-III abophezela kuphela kuchungechunge lwe-enhancer
question2: Zikuphi izilandelaniso eziyinhloko zomkhuthazi eziqashelwa yi-RNA polymerase engivame ukuzithola?
answer2: Phakathi kuka--45 no-+20 uma kuqhathaniswa nendawo yokuqala ukubhala umbhalo
question3: Iyini indlela yokwakheka kwe-core promoter eqashelwa yi-RNA polymerase I?
answer3: Uchungechunge olubili lwabakhuthazi abacebile nge-GC
question4: Yimuphi umphumela okhona ochungechungeni lwe-promoter oluphezulu oluphakathi kuka--180 no--105 ekubhalweni kwe-RNA polymerase I?
answer4: Zithuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokuqaliswa kokubhalwa kwemibhalo
distractor4c: Baguqula i-RNA polymerase I ibe yi-RNA polymerase II
question5: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle abagqugquzeli bezakhi zofuzo ezibhalwe yi-RNA polymerase III?
answer5: Abagqugquzeli babo bangase batholakale phezulu kwe-gene noma ngaphakathi kwe-gene uqobo
distractor5a: Zihlala zitholakala ngaphezu kwama-nucleotide angu-500 phezulu komfula
distractor5c: Zitholakala kuphela ngaphansi kochungechunge lokubhala amakhodi
question6: Umcwaningi uthola i-gene enomgqugquzeli wayo ongaphakathi kwesifunda sokubhala ikhodi ye-gene uqobo. Yiliphi i-RNA polymerase okungenzeka ukuthi libhala le gene?
answer6: I-RNA polymerase III
question7: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kususa indawo yesithuthukisi esingaphezulu esiphakathi kuka--180 no--105 sezakhi zofuzo ezibhalwe yi-RNA polymerase I kodwa kushiya i-core promoter ingathintekile. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer7: Ukubhalwa phansi kusengenzeka, kodwa ukuqaliswa kungenzeka kungasebenzi kahle
distractor7b: I-gene esikhundleni salokho izobhalwa yi-RNA polymerase II
distractor7c: Ukuhumusha kuzokwenzeka ngokujwayelekile ngaphandle kokubhalwa phansi

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuvela Kwabagqugquzeli
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuvela Kwabagqugquzeli
chapterContent:
Ukuvela kwezakhi zofuzo kungaba ngumqondo ojwayelekile. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungenzeka ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, futhi umphumela ungase ube yinzuzo noma ungabi yinzuzo kuseli. Ngokushintsha i-enzyme, iphrotheni yesakhiwo, noma esinye isici, inqubo yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ingaguqula imisebenzi noma izici zomzimba. Kodwa-ke, abagqugquzeli be-eukaryotic kanye nezinye izilandelana zokulawula izakhi zofuzo nazo zingavela. Isibonelo, cabanga ngezakhi zofuzo, ezizukulwaneni eziningi, eziba yigugu kakhulu kuseli. Mhlawumbe izakhi zofuzo zibhala iphrotheni yesakhiwo iseli eliyidingayo ukuze liyihlanganise ngobuningi ukuze lisebenze umsebenzi othile. Uma kunjalo, kungaba yinzuzo kuseli ukuthi umgqugquzeli waleyo zakhi zofuzo athole izici zokubhala ngendlela ephumelelayo futhi andise ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ososayensi abahlola ukuvela kwezilandelana zezakhi zofuzo babike imiphumela ehlukahlukene. Ngokwengxenye, lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kunzima ukuphetha ngqo ukuthi umgqugquzeli we-eukaryotic uqala futhi uphela kuphi. Amanye ama-promoter avela ngaphakathi kwezakhi zofuzo; amanye atholakala phezulu kakhulu, noma ngisho nangaphansi, kwezakhi zofuzo azilawulayo. Kodwa-ke, lapho abacwaningi bekhawulela ukuhlolwa kwabo ezilandelaneni zomgqugquzeli womuntu ezichazwe ngokuhlola njengezilandelaniso ezibopha i-preinitiation complex, bathole ukuthi abagqugquzeli bashintsha ngokushesha kakhulu kunezakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni.

 Akukacaci ukuthi ukuvela komgqugquzeli kungahambisana kanjani nokuvela kwabantu noma ezinye izinto eziphilayo eziphakeme. Kodwa-ke, ukuvela komgqugquzeli wokwenza umkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo ngempumelelo kuyindlela ethakazelisayo yokuvela kwezakhi zofuzo ngokwazo.
question1: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungayithinta kanjani into ephilayo?
answer1: Bangashintsha izinga lokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokushintsha indlela izinto zokubhala kanye ne-RNA polymerase ezitholakala ngayo ngempumelelo.
distractor1a: Zihlala zishintsha ukulandelana kwama-amino acid eprotheni efakiwe
distractor1c: Zithinta kuphela ukuhlukaniswa kwe-RNA ngemva kokubhalwa kwe-transcription
question2: Kungani ukukhetha kwemvelo kungase kuthande ukuguquka okuqinisa umgqugquzeli?
answer2: Kungakhulisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezizuzisayo, kukhiqize iphrotheni eningi edingekayo
distractor2a: Kuhlala kunciphisa ukuqoshwa, kulondoloza amandla eseli
distractor2b: Ishintsha ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo esetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
distractor2c: Kukhulisa izinga lokuguqulwa kochungechunge lokubhala ikhodi
question3: Kungani kunzima kososayensi ukutadisha ukuvela kwezinto ezikhuthaza i-eukaryotic?
answer3: Abagqugquzeli bangahluka kakhulu endaweni, okwenzeka ngaphakathi kwezakhi zofuzo noma ngaphezulu noma phansi kwezakhi zofuzo abazilawulayo.
distractor3c: Abagqugquzeli bayafana kuzo zonke izinhlobo ze-eukaryotic
question4: Yimaphi ama-promoter sequences atholakale ethuthuka ngokushesha kunezakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni?
answer4: Abagqugquzeli abayinhloko ababopha i-preinitiation complex
distractor4a: Ama-promoter ayinhloko avela ngaphakathi kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Kungani ukuvela kwezinhlelo zokuphromotha kungaba yinto ebalulekile noma ngabe uhlelo lokufaka ikhodi yamaprotheni luhlala lungashintshi?
answer5: Izinguquko ezilandelaneni zephromotha zingashintsha ukuthi kukhiqizwa nini, kuphi, nokuthi kukhiqizwa umkhiqizo ongakanani wezakhi zofuzo
distractor5a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zomthuthukisi kudala ngokuzenzakalelayo amaprotheni amasha
distractor5b: Ukuvela kwe-Promoter kushintsha ukulandelana kwe-amino acid ngaphandle kokuthinta ukulotshwa
distractor5c: Abagqugquzeli banquma ukulandelana kwama-codon ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
question6: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kwandisa ukuzwelana komgqugquzeli wezinto zokubhala. Yini engaba umphumela omkhulu?
answer6: I-gene ibhalwa kahle kakhulu, okwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-RNA kanye neprotheni yayo
distractor6b: Ukulandelana kwama-amino acid eprotheni kuyashintsha ngokushesha
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kahle ukubaluleka kokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabagqugquzeli?
answer7: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kungashintsha ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA okulawulayo ngaphandle kokushintsha indawo yokubhala amaphrotheni uqobo.
distractor7a: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kusebenza kuphela ngokulandelana kokubhala ikhodi yamaprotheni futhi akusebenzi kubathuthukisi
distractor7b: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo komthuthukisi kuhlala kukhiqiza amaprotheni amasha anezinhlu ezahlukene zama-amino acid
distractor7c: Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo komthuthukisi kuthinta kuphela izinto eziphilayo ze-prokaryotic

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ososayensi bathole umucu we-mRNA ohunyushwe waba uchungechunge lwama-amino acid (i-polypeptide) olufushane kune-molecule ye-mRNA ethathwe ku-DNA. Ngaphambi kokuba ulwazi oluku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic luhunyushwe lube yiprotheni, luyaguqulwa noma luhlelwe ngezindlela eziningana. I-5′ methylguanosine (noma i-GTP) cap kanye nomsila we-poly-A ongu-3′ kuyangezwa ukuvikela i-mRNA evuthiwe ekuwohlokeni futhi kuvumele ukuthunyelwa kwayo kusuka ku-nucleus. Ama-pre-mRNA nawo adlula ku-splicing, lapho ama-intron esuswa khona bese ama-exons ephinde axhunywe. Ama-Exons angaxhunyaniswa kabusha ngokulandelana okuhlukene, into ebizwa ngokuthi i-alternative gene splicing, evumela i-gene eyodwa ye-eukaryotic ukuthi ibhale amaphrotheni ahlukene. (Sizohlola ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa ama-gene alternative ngokuningiliziwe kwezinye izahluko.)

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.1 I-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo i-RNA, ingumthombo oyinhloko wolwazi oluzuzwayo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.5 Umfundi angahlola ezinye izincazelo zesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zesayensi ezisebenzisa izakhiwo kanye nezindlela ze-DNA ne-RNA ukusekela isimangalo sokuthi i-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo, ukuthi i-RNA iyimithombo eyinhloko yolwazi olufanele ukutholwa.

 Ngemva kokubhalwa phansi, ama-pre-mRNA e-eukaryotic kumele adlule ezinyathelweni eziningana zokucubungula ngaphambi kokuba ahunyushwe. Ama-tRNA nama-rRNA e-Eukaryotic (kanye nama-prokaryotic) nawo aqhubekela phambili ekucutshungulweni ngaphambi kokuba asebenze njengezingxenye emshinini wokwenziwa kwamaprotheni.
question1: Kungani i-eukaryotic pre-mRNA kufanele icutshungulwe ngaphambi kokuba ihunyushwe?
answer1: Kumelwe iguqulwe ibe yi-mRNA evuthiwe ngokungeza i-5 cap, i-poly-A tail, bese isusa ama-intron
distractor1c: Kumelwe ibophe ngqo kwi-RNA polymerase II ngaphambi kokuhumusha
question2: Yini engezwa ekugcineni kwe-5 kwe-eukaryotic pre-mRNA ngesikhathi sokucubungula?
question3: Yini engezwa emaphethelweni amathathu e-eukaryotic pre-mRNA ngesikhathi sokucubungula?
answer3: Umsila we-poly-A
question4: Yimiphi imisebenzi emibili emikhulu ye-5 cap kanye ne-poly-A tail?
answer4: Zivikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi zenza kube lula ukuthunyelwa kwayo kusuka ku-nucleus
distractor4a: Baqala ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kanye nokufinyela kwama-chromosome
distractor4b: Basusa ama-intron bese behlanganisa ama-exons ndawonye
question5: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa kwe-RNA?
answer5: Ama-intron ayasuswa futhi ama-exons ahlanganiswa ndawonye
distractor5a: Ama-exon ayasuswa futhi ama-intron ahlanganiswa ndawonye
distractor5b: Umsila we-poly-A ufakwa esikhundleni se-5 cap
question6: Kuyini ukuhlanganisa izakhi zofuzo ngendlela ehlukile?
answer6: Inqubo lapho ama-exons ehlanganiswa khona ngezinhlanganisela ezahlukene, okuvumela i-gene eyodwa ukuthi ikhiqize amaprotheni ahlukene
distractor6a: Ukuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA
distractor6b: Ukufakwa esikhundleni se-RNA nge-DNA ngaphambi kokuhumusha
distractor6c: Ukuhlanganiswa kwama-molecule amaningi e-mRNA avela kuma-chromosome ahlukene
question7: Iyiphi inzuzo ebalulekile yokuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile?
answer7: Izakhi zofuzo eyodwa zingakhiqiza amaprotheni amaningi ahlukene
distractor7a: Ivumela i-mRNA eyodwa ukufaka ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo eziningi ezingahlobene
question8: Ngaphandle kwe-mRNA, yimaphi ama-molecule e-RNA aphinde acutshungulwe ngaphambi kokuba asebenze kuma-eukaryotes?
answer8: Ama-tRNA nama-rRNA
question9: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ukungezwa komsila we-poly-A ku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic. Iyini imiphumela engaba khona kakhulu?
answer9: I-mRNA ngeke ihlale isikhathi eside futhi izokonakala kalula ngaphambi kokuhumusha

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukucutshungulwa kwe-mRNA | 5 Ukugoqa, 3 Umsila we-Poly-A, Ukuhlanganisa i-Pre-mRNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukucutshungulwa kwe-mRNA | 5 Ukugoqa, 3 Umsila we-Poly-A, Ukuhlanganisa i-Pre-mRNA
chapterContent:
I-pre-mRNA ye-eukaryotic icutshungulwa kabanzi ngaphambi kokuba ilungele ukuhunyushwa. Izinyathelo ezengeziwe ezihilelekile ekuvuthweni kwe-mRNA ye-eukaryotic zakha i-molecule enempilo ende kakhulu kune-mRNA ye-prokaryotic. Ama-mRNA e-Eukaryotic ahlala amahora amaningana, kanti i-mRNA ejwayelekile ye-E. coli ihlala imizuzwana emihlanu.

 Ama-pre-mRNA aqala ukumbozwa ngamaprotheni azinzisa i-RNA; lawa avikela i-pre-mRNA ekuwohlokeni ngenkathi icutshungulwa futhi ikhishwa yi-nucleus. Izinyathelo ezintathu ezibaluleke kakhulu zokucubungula i-pre-mRNA ukwengeza izici ezizinzisa nezimpawu emaphethelweni ama-5 nama-3 e-molecule, kanye nokususwa kokulandelana okuphakathi okungachazi ama-amino acid afanele. Ezimweni ezingavamile, umbhalo we-mRNA ungahlelwa” ngemva kokuba ubhaliwe.

 5 Ukuvala
Ngenkathi i-pre-mRNA isakhiwa, i-cap engu-7-methylguanosine ingezwa ekugcineni kwesi-5 kombhalo okhulayo ngokuxhumanisa kwe-phosphate. Le ngxenye (iqembu elisebenzayo) ivikela i-mRNA esafufusa ekuwohlokeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izici ezihilelekile ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni ziqaphela i-cap ukusiza ukuqala ukuhumusha ngama-ribosome.

 3 Umsila we-Poly-A
Uma ukunwebeka sekuqediwe, i-pre-mRNA ihlukaniswa yi-endonuclease phakathi kokulandelana kokuvumelana kwe-AAUAAA kanye nokulandelana okucebile kwe-GU, okushiya ukulandelana kwe-AAUAAA ku-pre-mRNA. I-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-poly-A polymerase ibe isinezela uchungechunge lwezinsalela ezingaba ngu-200 ze-A, ezibizwa ngokuthi umsila we-poly-A. Lokhu kuguqulwa kuvikela i-pre-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi kusayine ukuthunyelwa kwezinto zeseli ezidingwa umbhalo ku-cytoplasm.

 Ukuhlukaniswa Kwangaphambi Kwe-mRNA
Izakhi zofuzo ze-Eukaryotic zakhiwe ngama-exons, ahambisana nokulandelana kokubhala amaprotheni (i-ex-on isho ukuthi ivezwa), kanti ukulandelana okungena okubizwa ngokuthi ama-intron (int-ron isho indima yawo yokungena), okungase kuhileleke ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo kodwa kususwe ku-pre-mRNA ngesikhathi sokucubungula. Ukulandelana kwe-Intron ku-mRNA akufaki ikhodi yamaprotheni asebenzayo.

 Ukutholakala kwama-intron kwamangaza abacwaningi ngawo-1970 ababelindele ukuthi ama-pre-mRNA azocacisa ukulandelana kwamaprotheni ngaphandle kokucubungula okwengeziwe, njengoba babebonile kuma-prokaryotes. Izakhi zofuzo zama-eukaryotes aphezulu zivame ukuqukethe i-intron eyodwa noma ngaphezulu. Lezi zifunda zingahambisana nokulandelana okulawulayo; noma kunjalo, ukubaluleka kwezinto eziphilayo kokuba nama-intron amaningi noma ukuba nama-intron amade kakhulu ku-gene akucaci. Kungenzeka ukuthi ama-intron anciphisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngoba kuthatha isikhathi eside ukubhala ama-pre-mRNA ngama-intron amaningi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ama-intron angaba yizinsalela zochungechunge ezingasebenzi ezisele ekuhlanganisweni kwezakhi zofuzo zasendulo kuyo yonke intuthuko. Lokhu kusekelwa iqiniso lokuthi ama-exon ahlukene avame ukufaka ama-subunit noma ama-domain ahlukene amaprotheni. Ingxenye enkulu, ukulandelana kwama-intron kungashintshwa ngaphandle kokuthinta umkhiqizo wamaprotheni ekugcineni.

 Wonke ama-intron e-pre-mRNA kumele asuswe ngokuphelele nangokunembile ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwamaprotheni. Uma inqubo iphambuka ngisho ne-nucleotide eyodwa, uhlaka lokufunda lwama-exon ahlanganisiwe luzoshintsha, futhi iphrotheni ephumayo izoba yinto engasebenzi kahle. Inqubo yokususa ama-intron nokuxhuma kabusha ama-exon ibizwa ngokuthi i-splicing (Isithombe 15.14). Ama-intron asuswa futhi onakaliswe ngenkathi i-pre-mRNA isese-nucleus. I-splicing yenzeka ngendlela ethile yokulandelana eqinisekisa ukuthi ama-intron azosuswa futhi ama-exon ahlanganiswe kabusha ngokunemba nangokunembile kwe-nucleotide eyodwa. I-splicing yama-pre-mRNA yenziwa yizinhlanganisela zamaprotheni nama-molecule e-RNA abizwa ngokuthi ama-spliceosome.

 Qaphela ukuthi ama-intron angaphezu kuka-70 angakhona, futhi ngalinye kufanele lidlule enkambisweni yokuhlanganisa—ngaphezu kokuvala okungu-5 kanye nokwengezwa komsila we-poly-A—ukuze nje kukhiqizwe i-molecule eyodwa ye-mRNA ehunyushwayo.
question1: Kungani ama-mRNA e-eukaryotic ngokuvamile ephila isikhathi eside kakhulu kune-mRNA ye-prokaryotic?
answer1: Zicutshungulwa kabanzi, okuhlanganisa nokwengezwa kwe-5 cap, i-poly-A tail, kanye namaprotheni azinza i-RNA.
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-5 cap efakwe ku-eukaryotic mRNA?
answer2: Ivikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi isiza ekuqaliseni ukuhumusha ngama-ribosome
question3: Iyiphi i-enzyme enezela umsila we-poly-A emaphethelweni amathathu e-pre-mRNA?
answer3: I-polymerase ye-Poly-A
question4: Yimuphi umsebenzi obalulekile womsila we-poly-A?
answer4: Ivikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi ikhuthaza ukuthunyelwa kwe-nucleus
question5: Yiluphi uchungechunge lwezehlakalo oluholela ekufakweni komsila we-poly-A?
answer5: I-pre-mRNA ihlukaniswe phakathi kochungechunge lokuvumelana lwe-AAUAAA kanye nochungechunge olucebile nge-GU, ngemva kwalokho i-poly-A polymerase inezela cishe ama-nucleotide angu-200 e-adenine.
distractor5a: I-RNA polymerase II inezela umsila we-poly-A ngqo ngesikhathi sokubhalwa
distractor5b: I-spliceosome ifaka ama-nucleotide e-adenine ngaphambi kokuhlukana
distractor5c: I-ribosome yengeza umsila we-poly-A ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
question6: Ayini ama-exons?
answer6: Ukulandelana kokubhala amaphrotheni okuhlala ku-mRNA evuthiwe ngemva kokuhlanganiswa
distractor6a: Ukulandelana okungabhalwanga ikhodi kususiwe ngesikhathi sokufaka ikhodi
question7: Ayini ama-intron?
answer7: Ukulandelana okungenela okususiwe ku-pre-mRNA ngaphambi kokuhumusha
distractor7a: Ukulandelana kokubhala amaphrotheni okuhunyushwe kuma-amino acid
distractor7b: Kudingeka izifunda zomphromotha ukuze kuqalwe ukubhalwa kwemibhalo
question8: Kungani ama-intron kufanele asuswe ngokunemba kwe-nucleotide eyodwa?
answer8: Iphutha le-nucleotide eyodwa lingaguqula uhlaka lokufunda futhi likhiqize iphrotheni engasebenzi kahle
distractor8a: Noma yiliphi iphutha livimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA
distractor8c: Amaphutha okuhlanganisa athinta kuphela umsila we-poly-A
question9: Yisiphi isakhiwo seseli esenza i-pre-mRNA splicing?
answer9: I-spliceosome
question10: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ukwakheka kwama-spliceosome asebenzayo kuseli le-eukaryotic. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer10: Ama-intron ngeke asuswe ngendlela efanele, okukhiqiza ama-mRNA angajwayelekile avame ukufaka ikhodi yamaprotheni angasebenzi kahle
distractor10a: Ukuhumusha kuzoqhubeka ngokujwayelekile ngoba ama-ribosome asusa ama-intron
distractor10b: Umsila we-poly-A kuphela ozohluleka ukwakheka, kuyilapho ukuxhumanisa kuqhubeka ngokujwayelekile
distractor10c: Ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuzoma, kodwa ukubhalwa nokuhumusha ngeke kuthinteke
question11: Bheka uMfanekiso 15.14. Amaphutha ekuhlanganiseni ahlotshaniswa nomdlavuza nezinye izifo zabantu. Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ezingaholela emaphutheni okuhlanganisa? Cabanga ngemiphumela ehlukene engaba khona uma kwenzeka amaphutha okuhlanganisa
answer11: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-intron ne-exon, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kwengeze nezindawo ezintsha zokuqaphela i-spliceosome futhi kususe amasayithi akhona.
distractor11a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ochungechungeni lokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-intron, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kwengeze nezindawo ezintsha zokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome.
distractor11b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ochungechungeni lokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-exon, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kwengeze nezindawo ezintsha zokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome.
distractor11c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ochungechungeni lokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-intron, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kususe nezindawo ezikhona zokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukucutshungulwa kwe-mRNA | Ukuhlela i-RNA kuma-Trypanosomes
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukucutshungulwa kwe-mRNA | Ukuhlela i-RNA kuma-Trypanosomes
chapterContent:
Ama-trypanosome ayiqembu lama-protozoa ahlanganisa i-pathogen i-Trypanosoma brucei, ebangela isifo sokulala kubantu (Isithombe 15.13). Ama-Trypanosome, kanye nawo wonke amanye ama-eukaryote, anama-organelle abizwa ngokuthi i-mitochondria anikeza iseli amandla amakhemikhali. Ama-Mitochondria angama-organelle aveza i-DNA yawo futhi kukholakala ukuthi ayizinsalela zobudlelwano be-symbiotic phakathi kwe-eukaryote ne-prokaryote ehlanganisiwe. I-DNA ye-mitochondrial yama-trypanosomes ibonisa okuhlukile okuthakazelisayo kwi-The Central Dogma: ama-pre-mRNA awo awanalo ulwazi olufanele lokucacisa iphrotheni esebenzayo. Ngokuvamile, lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-mRNA ayinazo i-U nucleotide eziningana. Iseli lenza isinyathelo esengeziwe sokucubungula i-RNA esibizwa ngokuthi i-RNA editing ukuze kulungiswe lokhu.

 Amanye ama-gene ku-genome ye-mitochondrial afaka ama-RNA angumhlahlandlela we-nucleotide angu-40 kuya ku-80. Elinye noma ngaphezulu lala ma-molecule lisebenzisana ngokuhlanganiswa kwesisekelo okuhambisanayo namanye ama-nucleotide ku-pre-mRNA transcript. Kodwa-ke, i-guide RNA inama-nucleotide amaningi e-A kune-pre-mRNA enama-nucleotide e-U okufanele ihlangane nawo. Kulezi zifunda, i-guide RNA iyaphuma. Iziphetho ezintathu zama-guide RNA zinomsila omude we-poly-U, futhi lezi zisekelo ze-U zifakwa ezindaweni ze-pre-mRNA transcript lapho ama-guide RNA ehlanganiswa khona. Le nqubo ilawulwa ngokuphelele ama-molecule e-RNA. Okusho ukuthi, ama-guide RNA—kunokuba amaprotheni—asebenza njengezinto ezibangela ukwakheka kwe-RNA.

 Ukuhlela i-RNA akuyona nje into eyenziwa yi-trypanosomes. Ku-mitochondria yezinye izitshalo, cishe wonke ama-pre-mRNA ayahlelwa. Ukuhlela i-RNA kuye kwatholakala nasezincelweni ezincelisayo njengezimpuku, onogwaja, ngisho nabantu. Yini engaba yimbangela yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yalesi sinyathelo esengeziwe ekucutshungulweni kwe-pre-mRNA? Okunye okungenzeka ukuthi i-mitochondria, njengezinsalela zama-prokaryotes asendulo, inendlela yakudala esekwe kwi-RNA yokulawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukusekela lo mbono, ukuhlelwa okwenziwe kuma-pre-mRNA kuyahluka kuye ngezimo zamaseli. Nakuba kucatshangelwa, inqubo yokuhlela i-RNA ingaba yinto ebambekile kusukela esikhathini sasendulo lapho ama-molecule e-RNA, esikhundleni samaprotheni, ayenesibopho sokuvuselela ukusabela.
question1: Kungani ama-pre-mRNA e-mitochondrial ku-Trypanosoma brucei edinga ukuhlelwa kwe-RNA?
answer1: Ngokuvamile azinawo uchungechunge olufanele lwe-nucleotide, ngokuvamile azinawo ama-nucleotide amaningana e-uracil (U) adingekayo ukukhiqiza iphrotheni esebenzayo.
distractor1a: Ziqukethe ama-nucleotide amaningi kakhulu e-adenine okumele asuswe
question2: Yimaphi ama-molecule aqondisa ukuhlela i-RNA ku-Trypanosoma brucei?
question3: Ama-RNA aqondisa kanjani ukuhlela i-RNA kuma-trypanosome?
answer3: Zihambisana ne-pre-mRNA kanye nokufakwa okuqondile kwama-uracil nucleotide lapho zingekho khona.
question4: Yimuphi i-nucleotide efakwa ngokuyinhloko kuma-pre-mRNA e-trypanosome mitochondrial ngesikhathi sokuhlela i-RNA?
answer4: I-Uracil (U)
question5: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono i-catalyst ebangela ukuhlela i-RNA ku-Trypanosoma brucei?
answer5: Ama-molecule e-RNA asebenza njengezinto ezibangela ukucindezeleka hhayi amaprotheni
distractor5c: Ama-Ribosome akhuthaza ukuhlelwa kwe-RNA ngaphambi kokuhumusha
question6: Kuye kwabonakala nokuthi kuziphi ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezihlelwa yi-RNA?
answer6: Izitshalo nezilwane ezincelisayo, kuhlanganise nabantu
question7: Enye incazelo ephakanyisiwe yokuziphendukela kwemvelo yokuhlela i-RNA ku-mitochondria ukuthi:
answer7: Iyinsalela yesistimu yasendulo esekelwe kwi-RNA yokulawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor7a: Yathuthukiswa ukuze ithathe indawo yokubhalwa ngokuphelele
distractor7c: Ivumela i-mitochondria ukuthi isebenze ngaphandle kwama-ribosome
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 15.13. Kuma-eukaryotes, ama-pre-mRNA ayacutshungulwa ukuze akhe ama-mRNA avuthiwe. Ukuhlelwa kwe-mRNA okwenzeka ku-Trypanosoma brucei kuhluke kanjani ekucutshungulweni kwe-mRNA okwenzeka kuwo wonke ama-eukaryotes?
answer8: Ukuhlela i-mRNA kushintsha ukulandelana kokubhala ikhodi kwe-mRNA, kodwa ukucubungula i-mRNA akwenzi
distractor8a: Ukuhlela i-mRNA kuhlukanisa i-RNA engabhalisi ikhodi, kodwa ukucubungula i-mRNA akwenzi lokho
distractor8b: Ukuhlela i-mRNA kunezela isivalo se-5’-methylguanosine ku-mRNA, kodwa ukucubungula i-mRNA akwenzi lokho
distractor8c: Ukuhlela i-mRNA kunezela umsila we-poly-A ongu-3’, kodwa ukucubungula i-mRNA akwenzi lokho
question9: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela ukwakheka kwama-RNA aqondisayo ku-Trypanosoma brucei. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer9: Ama-mRNA amaningi e-mitochondrial azohlala ehlelwe ngendlela engafanele futhi ahluleke ukufaka ikhodi yamaprotheni asebenzayo
distractor9b: Iseli ngeke lisakwazi ukwenza i-pre-mRNA splicing
distractor9c: Ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kuzokwanda ngoba ukuhlela i-RNA akusadingeki
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 15.14. Amaphutha ekuhlanganiseni ahlotshaniswa nomdlavuza nezinye izifo zabantu. Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ezingaholela emaphutheni okuhlanganisa? Cabanga ngemiphumela ehlukene engaba khona uma kwenzeka amaphutha okuhlanganisa
answer10: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-intron ne-exon, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kwengeze nezindawo ezintsha zokuqaphela i-spliceosome futhi kususe amasayithi akhona.
distractor10a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ochungechungeni lokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-intron, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kwengeze nezindawo ezintsha zokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome.
distractor10b: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ochungechungeni lokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-exon, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kwengeze nezindawo ezintsha zokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome.
distractor10c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ochungechungeni lokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome ekugcineni ngakunye kwe-intron, noma kumaprotheni nama-RNA akha i-spliceosome, kungenzeka. Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kungase kususe nezindawo ezikhona zokuqashelwa kwe-spliceosome.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukucutshungulwa kwama-tRNA nama-rRNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.4 Ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes | Ukucutshungulwa kwama-tRNA nama-rRNA
chapterContent:
Ama-tRNA nama-rRNA angama-molecule ahlelekile anendima ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni; noma kunjalo, lawa ma-RNA awahunyushwa ngokwawo. Ama-pre-rRNA ayabhalwa, acutshungulwe, futhi ahlanganiswe abe ama-ribosome ku-nucleolus. Ama-pre-tRNA ayabhalwa futhi acutshungulwe ku-nucleus bese ekhishwa aye ku-cytoplasm lapho axhunyaniswa khona nama-amino acid amahhala ukuze kwakhiwe amaprotheni.

 Iningi lama-tRNA nama-rRNA kuma-eukaryotes nama-prokaryotes aqala abhalwe njenge-molecule ende eyandulelayo ehlanganisa ama-rRNA amaningi noma ama-tRNA. Ama-enzyme abe esehlukanisa ama-precursor abe ama-subunit ahambisana ne-RNA ngayinye yesakhiwo. Ezinye zezisekelo zama-pre-rRNA zi-methylated; okungukuthi, i-–CH3 moiety (iqembu elisebenzayo le-methyl) liyangezwa ukuze kuqiniswe. Ama-molecule e-pre-tRNA nawo adlula e-methylation. Njengakuma-pre-mRNA, ukususwa kwama-subunit kwenzeka kuma-pre-RNA e-eukaryotic ahloselwe ukuba ama-tRNA noma ama-rRNA.

 Ama-rRNA avuthiwe akha cishe amaphesenti angama-50 e-ribosome ngayinye. Amanye ama-molecule e-RNA e-ribosome akhiwe kuphela, kanti amanye anemisebenzi yokubopha noma yokuhlanganisa. Ama-tRNA avuthiwe athatha isakhiwo esinezilinganiso ezintathu ngokusebenzisa ukubopha kwe-hydrogen kwangaphakathi kwama-molecule ukuze abeke indawo yokubopha i-amino acid kolunye uhlangothi kanye ne-anticodon kolunye uhlangothi (Isithombe 15.15). I-anticodon iwuchungechunge lwe-nucleotide oluthathu ku-tRNA olusebenzisana ne-mRNA codon ngokusebenzisa ukuhlanganisa okuyisisekelo okuhambisanayo.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yama-tRNA nama-rRNA esitokisini?
answer1: Zisebenza njengama-RNA ahlelekile futhi asebenzayo ahilelekile ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni kodwa ngokwazo azihunyushwa
distractor1a: Zihunyushwa zibe ama-enzyme adingekayo ukuze kubhalwe phansi
question2: Ama-pre-rRNA abhalwa kuphi, acutshungulwa, futhi ahlanganiswa abe ama-ribosome kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
question3: Kuphi lapho ama-pre-tRNA acutshungulwa khona ngaphambi kokubamba iqhaza ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni?
answer3: Zicutshungulwa ku-nucleus bese zithunyelwa ku-cytoplasm
question4: Ama-tRNA nama-rRNA amaningi akhiwa kanjani ekuqaleni kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes?
answer4: Njengama-molecule e-RNA amade angaphambi kwesikhathi ahlukaniswa kamuva abe ama-RNA ngamanye
distractor4a: Njengama-molecule e-RNA avuthiwe angadingi ukucutshungulwa okwengeziwe
distractor4b: Njengabaxhumanisi be-DNA abaguqulwa kamuva babe yi-RNA
question5: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa okuvamile okwenzeka kuma-pre-rRNA kanye nama-pre-tRNA ngesikhathi sokucubungula?
answer5: I-Methylation yezisekelo ezithile ze-nucleotide
question6: Cishe iyiphi ingxenye ye-ribosome equkethe i-rRNA?
answer6: Cishe amaphesenti angu-50
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono imisebenzi ye-rRNA ngaphakathi kwe-ribosome?
answer7: Amanye ama-molecule e-rRNA ahlinzeka ngokusekelwa kwesakhiwo, kanti amanye anemisebenzi yokuhlanganisa noma yokubopha
distractor7a: Wonke ama-molecule e-rRNA asebenza kuphela njengezingxenye zesakhiwo
distractor7b: Wonke ama-molecule e-rRNA asebenza kuphela njengama-enzyme akhiqiza i-DNA
distractor7c: I-rRNA isebenza kuphela ukuthutha ama-amino acid kuma-ribosome
question8: Yisiphi isici se-tRNA evuthiwe esivumela ukuthi ihlanganyele ekuhumusheni?
answer8: Ukubopha kwe-hydrogen ngaphakathi kwama-molecule kugoqa i-molecule ukuze indawo yokunamathisela i-amino acid kanye ne-anticodon kubekwe emaphethelweni ahlukene
distractor8a: I-tRNA ihlala iyintambo ye-RNA eqondile engenaso isakhiwo sesibili
distractor8b: I-anticodon itholakala ekugcineni okufanayo nendawo yokunamathisela i-amino acid
distractor8c: I-tRNA yakha i-double helix ene-mRNA ngaphambi kokubopha i-amino acid
question9: Uyini umsebenzi we-anticodon ku-molecule ye-tRNA?
answer9: I-base-pairs ne-codon ehambisanayo ku-mRNA ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
distractor9a: Ibopha ngqo kwi-DNA ngesikhathi sokubhalwa kwe-transcription
question10: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela i-tRNA ukuthi igoqeke ibe yisakhiwo sayo esijwayelekile esinezinhlangothi ezintathu. Iyini imiphumela engaba khona?
answer10: I-tRNA ingase yehluleke ukubeka kahle indawo yayo yokunamathisela i-anticodon kanye ne-amino acid, okunciphisa ukunemba kokuhumusha
distractor10b: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuzovimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA kodwa hhayi ukuhumusha
distractor10c: I-ribosome ngeke isadinga ama-tRNA ukuze kuhlanganiswe amaprotheni

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ngemva kokuba ulwazi olusezakhini zofuzo seluhunyushwe lwaba yi-mRNA, selulungele ukuhunyushwa lube yi-polypeptide. Abadlali abahumushayo bafaka ithempulethi ye-mRNA, ama-ribosome, ama-molecule e-tRNA, ama-amino acid, nama-enzyme ahlukahlukene. Ama-ribosome aqukethe ama-subunit amancane namakhulu e-protein kanye ne-rRNA ahlangana ne-mRNA; ama-ribosome amaningi angahamba nge-mRNA efanayo ngesikhathi. Ukuhumusha kuqala ekuqaleni kwe-AUG ku-mRNA, kuchazwe i-methionine, i-amino acid yokuqala kunoma iyiphi i-polypeptide. I-amino acid ngayinye ithwalwa iye ku-ribosome ngokunamathela ku-molecule ethile ye-tRNA. I-molecule ye-tRNA ivame ukuboniswa njengeqabunga le-clover, eline-anticodon kolunye uhlangothi, kanye nendawo yokunamathisela i-amino acid kolunye uhlangothi. Ama-enzyme okushaja i-amino-acid aqinisekisa ukuthi i-amino acid efanele inamathele ku-tRNA efanele. Ama-anticodon ku-tRNA ayahambisana nama-codon ku-mRNA; isibonelo, i-anticodon AAA ku-tRNA ihambelana ne-TTT ku-mRNA. Ama-amino acid alandelanayo axhunyaniswa yizibopho ze-peptide. I-mRNA iyahunyushwa, inwebe i-polypeptide, kuze kube yilapho kufinyelelwa i-STOP noma i-nonsense codon. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, i-release factor ihlukanisa izingxenye futhi ikhulule i-polypeptide entsha. Ukugoqwa kweprotheni kwenzeka ngesikhathi nangemva kokuguqulwa. Uma i-polypeptide isihlanganisiwe, indima yayo njengeprotheni iyasungulwa, njengokunquma uhlobo olubonakalayo lwesidalwa.

 Ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kudla amandla amaningi esisele kunanoma iyiphi enye inqubo yokuguqula umzimba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amaprotheni abala ubunzima obukhulu kunanoma iyiphi enye ingxenye yezinto eziphilayo (ngaphandle kwamanzi), futhi amaprotheni enza cishe yonke imisebenzi yeseli. Inqubo yokuhumusha, noma ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni, ihilela ukuqopha umlayezo we-mRNA ube umkhiqizo we-polypeptide. Ama-amino acid ahlanganiswa ndawonye ngokuxhumanisa izibopho ze-peptide ngobude obusukela cishe kuma-amino acid residues angu-50 kuya kwangaphezu kwe-1,000. I-amino acid ngayinye ineqembu lama-amino (NH2) kanye neqembu le-carboxyl (COOH). Ama-polypeptide akhiwa lapho iqembu lama-amino le-amino acid eyodwa lakha isibopho se-amide (okungukuthi, i-peptide) neqembu le-carboxyl lenye i-amino acid (Isithombe 15.16). Lokhu kusabela kuqhutshwa yi-ribosomes futhi kukhiqize i-molecule yamanzi eyodwa.
question1: Iyini inqubo yokuhumusha?
answer1: Ukuguqulwa kochungechunge lwe-mRNA lube yi-polypeptide (iphrotheni)
question2: Yimaphi ama-molecule akha ama-ribosome?
answer2: Amaprotheni kanye ne-ribosomal RNA (rRNA) ahlelwe ngama-subunit amakhulu namancane
question3: Yimuphi i-codon ovame ukuqala ukuhumusha?
answer3: U-Agasti
question4: Yimuphi i-amino acid echazwe yi-codon yokuqala i-AUG ngesikhathi sokuhumusha?
answer4: I-Methionine
question5: Uyini umsebenzi we-aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases (ama-enzyme okushaja ama-amino acid)?
answer5: Banamathisela i-amino acid efanele ku-tRNA yayo ehambisanayo
distractor5a: Zihlanganisa ama-amino acid kanye nama-peptide bonds
question6: Uyini umsebenzi we-anticodon ku-molecule ye-tRNA?
answer6: I-base-pairs ne-codon ehambisanayo ku-mRNA ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
distractor6c: Inika i-RNA polymerase uphawu lokuthi iyeke ukukopishwa
question7: Yini ebangela ukuthi ukuhumusha kuphele?
answer7: Kufinyelelwa i-stop codon, okuvumela i-release factor ukuthi ikhulule i-polypeptide ephelele
question8: Kungani ama-ribosome amaningana ekwazi ukuhumusha i-mRNA efanayo ngesikhathi esisodwa?
answer8: Ama-ribosome amaningi angabopha i-mRNA efanayo, akhe i-polysome futhi andise ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni
distractor8a: I-ribosome ngayinye ikopisha i-mRNA ibe yi-DNA
distractor8b: Ama-Ribosome anamathela unomphela ku-DNA ngemva kokubhalwa
distractor8c: I-mRNA ngayinye ingabopha i-amino acid eyodwa kuphela ngesikhathi
question9: Ama-amino acid ahlanganiswa kanjani ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa kwamaprotheni?
answer9: Ama-Ribosome akhuthaza ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-peptide phakathi kwama-amino acid aseduze
distractor9a: I-DNA polymerase yakha izibopho ze-phosphodiester phakathi kwama-amino acid
distractor9b: I-RNA polymerase ihlanganisa ama-amino acid isebenzisa izibopho ze-hydrogen
distractor9c: I-Ligase ihlangana ndawonye ngama-amino acid ngemva kokuhumusha
question10: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kushintsha i-codon yokuqala ye-AUG ye-mRNA ibe yi-ACG. Iyini imiphumela engaba khona kakhulu?
answer10: Ukuhumusha cishe kuzohluleka ukuqala ngendlela efanele, kunciphisa kakhulu noma kuvimbele ukukhiqizwa kwephrotheni
distractor10a: Iphrotheni izoqukatha i-amino acid eyodwa eyengeziwe kodwa uma kungenjalo iyoba evamile
distractor10b: Ukuhumusha kuzoqala endaweni efanayo ngoba wonke ama-codon angasebenza njengama-codon okuqala
distractor10c: Kuzothinteka ukubhalwa phansi kuphela; ukuhumusha ngeke kushintshe

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Imishini Yokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ama-Ribosome, ama-tRNA, Ama-Aminoacyl tRNA Synthetases
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Imishini Yokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ama-Ribosome, ama-tRNA, Ama-Aminoacyl tRNA Synthetases
chapterContent:
Ngaphezu kwethempulethi ye-mRNA, ama-molecule amaningi nama-macromolecule afaka isandla enkambisweni yokuhumusha. Ukwakheka kwengxenye ngayinye kungahluka kuzo zonke izinhlobo; isibonelo, ama-ribosome angase abe nenani elihlukile lama-rRNA nama-polypeptide kuye ngokuthi umzimba unjani. Kodwa-ke, izakhiwo ezijwayelekile kanye nemisebenzi yemishini yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni iyafana kusukela kubhaktheriya kuya kumaseli abantu. Ukuhumusha kudinga ukufakwa kwethempulethi ye-mRNA, ama-ribosome, ama-tRNA, kanye nezici ezahlukahlukene ze-enzyme.

 Ama-Ribosome
Ngisho nangaphambi kokuba i-mRNA ihunyushwe, iseli kumele litshale amandla ukwakha i-ribosome yalo ngayinye. Ku-E. coli, kune-ribosomes ephakathi kuka-10,000 no-70,000 ekhona kuseli ngalinye nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. I-ribosome iyi-macromolecule eyinkimbinkimbi eyakhiwe ama-rRNA esakhiwo kanye nama-catalytic, kanye nama-polypeptide amaningi ahlukile. Kuma-eukaryotes, i-nucleolus ikhethekile ngokuphelele ekuhlanganiseni nasekuhlanganiseni ama-rRNA.

 Ama-Ribosome akhona ku-cytoplasm kuma-prokaryotes naku-cytoplasm kanye ne-rough endoplasmic reticulum kuma-eukaryotes. Ama-Mitochondria nama-chloroplast nawo anama-ribosome awo ku-matrix kanye ne-stroma, abukeka efana kakhulu nama-ribosome e-prokaryotic (futhi anemizwa efanayo yezidakamizwa) kunama-ribosome angaphandle nje kwe-membrane yawo yangaphandle ku-cytoplasm. Ama-Ribosome ahlukana abe ama-subunit amakhulu namancane uma engahlanganisi amaprotheni futhi aphinde ahlangane ngesikhathi sokuqala kokuhumusha. Ku-E. coli, i-subunit encane ichazwa njenge-30S, kanti i-subunit enkulu ingu-50S, okungu-70S iyonke (khumbula ukuthi amayunithi e-Svedberg awayona into eyengeziwe). Ama-ribosome ezilwane ezincelisayo ane-subunit encane engu-40S kanye ne-subunit enkulu engu-60S, okungu-80S iyonke. I-subunit encane inesibopho sokubopha ithempulethi ye-mRNA, kanti i-subunit enkulu ibopha ama-tRNA ngokulandelana. I-molecule ngayinye ye-mRNA ihunyushwa ngasikhathi sinye ngama-ribosome amaningi, wonke enza iphrotheni ngendlela efanayo: ukufunda i-mRNA kusuka ku-5 kuya ku-3 kanye nokwenza i-polypeptide kusuka ku-N terminus kuya ku-C terminus. Isakhiwo esiphelele se-mRNA/poly-ribosome sibizwa ngokuthi i-polysome.

 ama-tRNA
Ama-tRNA angama-molecule e-RNA akhiwe ahunyushwe kusuka kuma-gene yi-RNA polymerase III. Kuye ngohlobo, kunezinhlobo ezingama-40 kuya kwezingama-60 zama-tRNA ku-cytoplasm. Esebenza njengama-adapter, ama-tRNA athile abopha ukulandelana kuthempulethi ye-mRNA futhi engeza i-amino acid ehambisanayo ku-polypeptide chain. Ngakho-ke, ama-tRNA angama-molecule empeleni ahumusha "ulimi lwe-RNA lube ulimi lwamaprotheni.

 Kuma-codon angu-64 e-mRNA angaba khona—noma inhlanganisela ye-triplet ye-A, U, G, kanye ne-C—amathathu achaza ukuphela kokwenziwa kwamaprotheni kanye no-61 achaza ukungezwa kwama-amino acid ku-polypeptide chain. Kulawa angu-61, i-codon eyodwa (AUG) nayo ifaka ikhodi yokuqaliswa kokuhumusha. I-anticodon ngayinye ye-tRNA ingasekela umbhangqwana nenye yama-codon e-mRNA futhi ingeze i-amino acid noma iqede ukuhumusha, ngokusho kwekhodi yezakhi zofuzo. Isibonelo, uma ukulandelana kwe-CUA kwenzeka kuthempulethi ye-mRNA ohlakeni lokufunda olufanele, kuzobopha i-tRNA eveza ukulandelana okuhambisanayo, i-GAU, ezoxhunyaniswa ne-amino acid leucine.

 Njengama-molecule e-adaptor okuhumusha, kuyamangaza ukuthi ama-tRNA angangena ukucaciswa okungaka ephaketheni elincane kangaka. Cabanga ukuthi ama-tRNA adinga ukusebenzisana nezici ezintathu: 1) kumele aqashelwe yi- i-aminoacyl synthetase efanele (bheka ngezansi); 2) kumele zibonwe ngama-ribosome; kanye no-3) kumele zibophe ngokulandelana okufanele ku-mRNA.

 Ama-Aminoacyl tRNA Synthetases
Inqubo yokwenziwa kwe-pre-tRNA yi-RNA polymerase III idala kuphela ingxenye ye-RNA ye-molecule ye-adaptha. I-amino acid ehambisanayo kumele ingezwe kamuva, uma i-tRNA isicutshungulwe futhi ithunyelwa kwi-cytoplasm. Ngenqubo yokushaja i-tRNA,” i-molecule ngayinye ye-tRNA ixhunyaniswe ne-amino acid yayo efanele yiqembu lama-enzyme abizwa ngokuthi ama-aminoacyl tRNA synthetases. Okungenani uhlobo olulodwa lwe-aminoacyl tRNA synthetase lukhona ku-amino acid ngayinye yama-20; inani eliqondile lama-aminoacyl tRNA synthetases liyahlukahluka ngezinhlobo. Lawa ma-enzyme aqala ngokubopha futhi afake i-hydrolyze i-ATP ukuze avuselele isibopho esinamandla aphezulu phakathi kwe-amino acid ne-adenosine monophosphate (AMP); i-molecule ye-pyrophosphate iyakhishwa kulokhu kusabela. I-amino acid esebenzayo idluliselwa ku-tRNA, bese i-AMP ikhishwa

answer6: I-molecule eyodwa ye-mRNA ehunyushwa ngasikhathi sinye ngama-ribosome amaningi

answer7: Isebenza njenge-adaptha efanisa ama-codon e-mRNA nama-amino acid awo ahambisanayo

question8: Yimuphi u-enzyme onesibopho sokunamathisela i-amino acid efanele ku-tRNA?
answer8: I-Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase
question9: Yimuphi umthombo wamandla osetshenziswa ngqo yi-aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases lapho kushajwa ama-tRNA?
answer9: I-ATP
question10: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kubangela ukuthi i-aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase inamathisele i-amino acid engalungile ku-tRNA. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer10: Ama-amino acid angalungile angafakwa kumaprotheni, okungase kushintshe isakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi wamaprotheni.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Indlela Yokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ukuqaliswa Kokuhumusha
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Indlela Yokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ukuqaliswa Kokuhumusha
chapterContent:
Njengoba kunjalo ngokwenziwa kwe-mRNA, ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kungahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezintathu: ukuqaliswa, ukunwetshwa, kanye nokuphela. Inqubo yokuhumusha ifana kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes. Lapha sizohlola ukuthi ukuhumusha kwenzeka kanjani ku-E. coli, i-prokaryote emele, futhi sichaze noma yimuphi umehluko phakathi kokuhumusha kwe-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic.

 Ukuqaliswa Kokuhumusha
Ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kuqala ngokwakhiwa kwe-initiation complex. Ku-E. coli, le complex ihilela i-ribosome encane ye-30S, ithempulethi ye-mRNA, izinto ezintathu zokuqalisa (ama-IF; i-IF-1, i-IF-2, kanye ne-IF-3), kanye ne-initiator tRNA ekhethekile, ebizwa ngokuthi i-tRNAMet
f
. I-initiator tRNA ixhumana ne-start codon AUG (noma ngokungavamile, i-GUG), ixhumanisa ne-formylated methionine ebizwa ngokuthi i-fMet, futhi ingabopha ne-IF-2. I-methionine efakwe ngendlela ehlelekile ifakwa yi-fMet−tRN⁢AMet
f
ekuqaleni kwayo yonke iketanga le-polypeptide elenziwe yi-E. coli, kodwa ivame ukunqunywa ngemva kokuba ukuhumusha sekuqediwe. Lapho i-AUG engaphakathi kwefreyimu ihlangana ngesikhathi sokwandiswa kokuhumusha, i-methionine engafakwanga ngendlela ehlelekile ifakwa yi-Met-tRNAMet ejwayelekile.

 Ku-E. coli mRNA, ukulandelana okungaphezulu kwe-codon yokuqala ye-AUG, ebizwa ngokuthi i-Shine-Dalgarno sequence (AGGAGG), isebenzisana nama-molecule e-rRNA akha i-ribosome. Lokhu kusebenzisana kuqinisa i-30S ribosomal subunit endaweni efanele kuthempulethi ye-mRNA. I-Guanosine triphosphate (GTP), okuyi-purine nucleotide triphosphate, isebenza njengomthombo wamandla ngesikhathi sokuhumusha—kokubili ekuqaleni kokwandiswa kanye nangesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwe-ribosome.

 Kuma-eukaryotes, i-initiation complex efanayo yakha, equkethe i-mRNA, i-40S small ribosomal subunit, ama-IF, kanye nama-nucleoside triphosphates (GTP kanye ne-ATP). I-charged initiator tRNA, ebizwa ngokuthi i-Met-tRNAi, ayibophi i-fMet kuma-eukaryotes, kodwa ihlukile kwamanye ama-Met-tRNA ngoba ingabopha ama-IF.

 Esikhundleni sokufakwa ku-Shine-Dalgarno sequence, i-eukaryotic initiation complex ibona i-7-methylguanosine cap ekugcineni kwesi-5 se-mRNA. Iphrotheni ebopha i-cap (CBP) kanye namanye ama-IF amaningana asiza ukunyakaza kwe-ribosome kuya ku-5 cap. Uma isise-cap, i-initiation complex ilandela i-mRNA ngendlela yesi-5 kuya kweyesi-3, ifuna i-AUG start codon. Ama-eukaryotic mRNA amaningi ahunyushwa kusukela ku-AUG yokuqala, kodwa lokhu akuhlali kunjalo. Ngokusho kwemithetho kaKozak, ama-nucleotide azungeze i-AUG abonisa ukuthi ngabe yi-codon yokuqala efanele yini. Imithetho kaKozak ithi ukulandelana okulandelayo kokuvumelana kumele kuvele eduze kwe-AUG yezakhi zofuzo zezilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla: i-5-gccRccAUGG-3. I-R (ye-purine) ikhombisa indawo engaba yi-A noma i-G, kodwa ayikwazi ukuba yi-C noma i-U. Empeleni, lapho ukulandelana kusondelene nalokhu kuvumelana, kulapho ukusebenza kahle kokuhumusha kukhuphuka khona.

 Uma i-AUG efanele isitholakele, amanye amaprotheni kanye ne-CBP kuyahlukana, futhi i-subunit engu-60S ibopha ku-complex ye-Met-tRNAi, i-mRNA, kanye ne-subunit engu-40S. Lesi sinyathelo siqedela ukuqaliswa kokuhumusha kuma-eukaryotes
question1: Yiziphi izigaba ezintathu ezinkulu zokwenziwa kwamaprotheni?
answer1: Ukuqaliswa, ukunwetshwa, kanye nokuphela
question2: Yimuphi i-amino acid ekhethekile ethwalwa yi-initiator tRNA ku-E. coli?
question3: Yiluphi uchungechunge olusiza ukubeka i-ribosome ngendlela efanele ku-prokaryotic mRNA?
answer3: Uchungechunge lwe-Shine-Dalgarno
question4: Iyini indima eyinhloko yochungechunge lwe-Shine-Dalgarno?
answer4: Ivumelanisa i-ribosomal subunit encane ne-codon yokuqala efanele ku-prokaryotic mRNA
question5: Yimuphi umolekyuli wamandla osetshenziswa ngqo ngesikhathi sokuqaliswa kokuhumusha kanye nokudluliselwa kwe-ribosome?
answer5: I-GTP
question6: Ukuqala kokuhumusha kuhluke kanjani kuma-eukaryotes uma kuqhathaniswa nama-prokaryotes?
answer6: I-eukaryotic initiation complex ibopha isivalo se-methylguanosine esingu-5 bese ihlola i-codon yokuqala ye-AUG, kuyilapho ama-prokaryotes esebenzisa i-Shine-Dalgarno sequence ukubeka i-ribosome.
distractor6a: Ama-Eukaryote aqala ukuhumusha ngqo e-stop codon
distractor6c: Ama-eukaryote kuphela asebenzisa ama-ribosome ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
question7: Uyini umsebenzi wokulandelana kokuvumelana kweKozak ku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic?
answer7: Kusiza i-ribosome ukuthi ibone i-AUG yokuqala i-codon efanele ukuze kuqalwe ukuhumusha okuphumelelayo
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle ama-tRNA okuqala ama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes?
answer8: I-prokaryotic initiator tRNA ithwala i-formylmethionine (fMet), kanti i-eukaryotic initiator tRNA ithwala i-methionine engafakwanga ifomu.
question9: Ngemva kokuthi i-codon yokuqala efanele ye-AUG iqashelwe kuma-eukaryotes, yini eqeda ukuqaliswa kokuhumusha?
answer9: I-subunit enkulu ye-ribosomal engu-60S ijoyina le nhlanganisela ngemva kokuthi izici zokuqala kanye namaprotheni ahlanganisa i-cap ahlukane.
distractor9c: Uchungechunge lwe-Shine-Dalgarno lubopha i-subunit enkulu ye-ribosomal
question10: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kususa uchungechunge lwe-Shine-Dalgarno ku-mRNA yebhaktheriya. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer10: I-ribosome izoba nobunzima bokubona indawo efanele yokuqala ukuhumusha, okunciphisa kakhulu ukuqala kokuhumusha
distractor10a: I-ribosome izobona umsila we-poly-A esikhundleni salokho
distractor10c: Iseli lebhaktheriya lizoqala ukusebenzisa uchungechunge lweKozak ukuze kuqalwe ukuhumusha

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Indlela Yokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ukuhumusha, Ukwelula, Nokuqedwa
chapterContent:
Njengoba kunjalo ngokwenziwa kwe-mRNA, ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni kungahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezintathu: ukuqaliswa, ukunwetshwa, kanye nokuphela. Inqubo yokuhumusha iyafana kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes. Lapha sizohlola ukuthi ukuhumusha kwenzeka kanjani ku-E. coli, i-prokaryote emele, futhi sichaze noma yimuphi umehluko phakathi kokuhumusha kwe-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic.

 Ukuhumusha, Ukunwetshwa, kanye Nokuphela
Kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes, izisekelo zokwandiswa ziyafana, ngakho-ke sizobuyekeza ukunwetshwa ngokombono we-E. coli. I-50S ribosomal subunit ye-E. coli inezingxenye ezintathu: indawo ye-A (aminoacyl) ibopha ama-aminoacyl tRNA angenayo ashajekile. Indawo ye-P (peptidyl) ibopha ama-tRNA ashajekile aphethe ama-amino acid ayenze izibopho ze-peptide ne-polypeptide chain ekhulayo kodwa awakahlukani ne-tRNA yawo ehambisanayo. Isayithi le-E (exit) likhipha ama-tRNA ahlukanisiwe ukuze aphinde agcwaliswe ngama-amino acid amahhala. Kukhona okuhlukile kulo mugqa wokuhlangana wama-tRNA: ku-E. coli, i-fMet−tRN⁢AMet
f
iyakwazi ukungena ngqo kusayithi le-P ngaphandle kokungena kuqala kusayithi le-A. Ngokufanayo, i-eukaryotic Met-tRNAi, ngosizo oluvela kwamanye amaprotheni e-initiation complex, ibopha ngqo kusayithi le-P. Kuzo zombili izimo, lokhu kudala i-initiation complex enesayithi le-A elikhululekile elilungele ukwamukela i-tRNA ehambisana ne-codon yokuqala ngemuva kwe-AUG.

 Ngesikhathi sokwandiswa kokuhumusha, ithempulethi ye-mRNA inikeza ukucaciswa. Njengoba i-ribosome ihamba nge-mRNA, i-codon ngayinye ye-mRNA ingena kwirejista, futhi ukubopha okuthile ne-anticodon eshajelwe ye-tRNA ehambisanayo kuyaqinisekiswa. Uma i-mRNA ingekho ku-elongation complex, i-ribosome ibingabopha ama-tRNA ngokungaqondile.

 Ukwandiswa kuqhubeka nama-tRNA ashajwe angena endaweni ye-A bese eshintshela endaweni ye-P kulandelwe indawo ye-E ngesinyathelo ngasinye se-single-codon” se-ribosome. Izinyathelo ze-ribosomal zibangelwa izinguquko zokwakheka ezithuthukisa i-ribosome ngezisekelo ezintathu ohlangothini lwe-3. Amandla esinyathelo ngasinye se-ribosome anikezwa yi-elongation factor e-hydrolyzes GTP. Ama-Peptide bonds akha phakathi kweqembu lama-amino le-amino acid elinamathiselwe kwi-A-site tRNA kanye neqembu le-carboxyl le-amino acid elinamathiselwe kwi-P-site tRNA. Ukwakheka kwesibopho ngasinye se-peptide kuqhutshwa yi-peptidyl transferase, i-enzyme esekelwe kwi-RNA ehlanganiswe ne-50S ribosomal subunit. Amandla okwakheka kwesibopho ngasinye se-peptide atholakala ku-GTP hydrolysis, eqhutshwa yi-elongation factor ehlukile. I-amino acid eboshwe kwi-P-site tRNA nayo ixhunywe ku-polypeptide chain ekhulayo. Njengoba i-ribosome idlula kwi-mRNA, i-P-site tRNA yangaphambili ingena Indawo ye-E, ihlukana ne-amino acid, bese ikhishwa (Isithombe 15.17). Ngokumangalisayo, idivayisi yokuhumusha i-E. coli ithatha imizuzwana engu-0.05 kuphela ukwengeza i-amino acid ngayinye, okusho ukuthi iphrotheni ye-amino acid engu-200 ingahunyushwa ngemizuzwana eyi-10 kuphela.

 Ukuphela kokuhumusha kwenzeka lapho kuhlangana i-codon engenangqondo (UAA, UAG, noma i-UGA). Lapho ihambisana nendawo ye-A, la ma-codon angenangqondo aqashelwa yizici zokukhululwa kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes ayalela i-peptidyl transferase ukuthi ingeze i-molecule yamanzi ekugcineni kwe-carboxyl ye-amino acid ye-P-site. Lokhu kusabela kuphoqa i-amino acid ye-P-site ukuthi ihlukane ne-tRNA yayo, bese iphrotheni esanda kwenziwa iyakhishwa. Ama-subunit amancane namakhulu e-ribosomal ayahlukana ne-mRNA futhi komunye nomunye; aqoqwa cishe ngokushesha kwenye inkimbinkimbi yokuqalisa ukuhumusha. Ngemva kokuthi ama-ribosome amaningi eseqedile ukuhumusha, i-mRNA iyawohloka ukuze ama-nucleotide aphinde asetshenziswe kwenye indawo. ukusabela kokubhalwa phansi
question1: Uyini umsebenzi we-A site ye-ribosome ngesikhathi sokuhumusha?
answer1: Ibopha ama-aminoacyl-tRNA angenayo ashajekile
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-P site ye-ribosome?
answer2: Ibamba i-tRNA ethwele uchungechunge lwe-polypeptide olukhulayo
question3: Iyini indima yesayithi le-E le-ribosome?
answer3: Ikhipha ama-tRNA angakashajwa ngemva kokudlulisa ama-amino acid awo
distractor3a: Ibopha i-initiator tRNA ngesikhathi sokuqaliswa kokuhumusha
question4: Yimuphi i-enzyme ekhuthaza ukwakheka kwesibopho se-peptide ngesikhathi sokuhumusha?
answer4: I-Peptidyl transferase
question5: Kungani i-mRNA ibalulekile ngesikhathi sokwandiswa?
answer5: Iqinisekisa ukuthi i-codon ngayinye ihambisana ne-anticodon ye-tRNA efanele, okuvumela ukuthi kuhlanganiswe ukulandelana kwe-amino acid efanele
question6: Yini enikeza amandla okudluliselwa kwe-ribosome ngesikhathi sokunwetshwa?
answer6: I-Hydrolysis ye-GTP ngezici zobude
question7: Yimaphi ama-codon abonisa ukuphela kokuhumusha?
answer7: I-UAA, i-UAG, kanye ne-UGA
question8: Kwenzekani uma i-stop codon ingena endaweni ye-A ye-ribosome?
answer8: Isici sokukhulula siyabopha, okubangela ukuthi i-polypeptide ephelele ikhishwe ku-ribosome
distractor8a: I-tRNA eshajiwe iyabopha futhi yengeze i-amino acid eyodwa yokugcina
distractor8c: I-ribosome ibuyisela emuva isiqondiso eceleni kwe-mRNA
question9: Kwenzekani kuma-subunit e-ribosomal ngemva kokuphela kokuhumusha?
answer9: Amayunithi amancane namakhulu ayahlukana futhi angasetshenziswa futhi komunye umjikelezo wokuhumusha
question10: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela izici zokukhululwa ekuboneni ama-stop codon. Iyini imiphumela engaba khona kakhulu?
answer10: Ukuhumusha kuzohluleka ukuphela kahle, kukhiqize ama-polypeptide amade ngokungavamile kuze kube yilapho i-ribosome igcina ukuma.
distractor10c: I-mRNA ngeke ikwazi ukubopha i-subunit encane ye-ribosomal

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ukugoqwa Kwamaprotheni, Ukuguqulwa, Nokuqondiswa
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.5 Ama-Ribosome Nokwenziwa Kwamaprotheni | Ukugoqwa Kwamaprotheni, Ukuguqulwa, Nokuqondiswa
chapterContent:
Ngesikhathi nangemva kokuguqulwa, ama-amino acid ngamanye angashintshwa ngamakhemikhali, ukulandelana kwesignali kungafakwa, futhi iphrotheni entsha igoqeka ibe yisakhiwo esihlukile esinezinhlangothi ezintathu ngenxa yokusebenzisana kwangaphakathi kwama-molecule. Ukulandelana kwesignali kuwumsila omfushane wama-amino acid aqondisa iphrotheni endaweni ethile yeselula. Lokhu kulandelana ekugcineni kwama-amino noma ekugcineni kwe-carboxyl yephrotheni kungacatshangwa njengethikithi lesitimela lephrotheni "eya endaweni yayo yokugcina. Ezinye izici zamaseli ziyaqaphela ukulandelana kwesignali ngayinye futhi zisize ukuthutha iphrotheni isuka ku-cytoplasm iye endaweni yayo efanele. Isibonelo, ukulandelana okuthile ekugcineni kwama-amino kuzoqondisa iphrotheni kuma-mitochondria noma kuma-chloroplast (ezitshalweni). Uma iphrotheni ifika endaweni yayo yeselula, ukulandelana kwesignali kuvame ukunqunywa.

 Amaprotheni amaningi agoqeka ngokuzenzekelayo, kodwa amanye amaprotheni adinga ama-molecule asizayo, abizwa ngokuthi ama-chaperones, ukuze awavimbele ekuhlanganeni ngesikhathi senqubo eyinkimbinkimbi yokugoqeka. Ngisho noma iphrotheni ichazwe kahle yi-mRNA yayo ehambisanayo, ingathatha isimo esingasebenzi kahle uma izinga lokushisa elingavamile noma izimo ze-pH ziyivimbela ekugoqekeni kahle.
question1: Yini engenzeka kuphrotheni esanda kuhlanganiswa ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa noma ngemva kokuguqulwa?
answer1: Ingashintshwa ngamakhemikhali, ithole ukulandelana kwesignali, bese igoqeka ibe yisakhiwo sayo esisebenzayo esinezinhlangothi ezintathu.
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wokulandelana kwesignali?
answer2: Iqondisa iphrotheni esanda kuhlanganiswa endaweni yayo efanele yamaseli
question3: Kukuphi lapho izigcawu zesignali zivame ukutholakala khona kuphrotheni?
answer3: Ekupheleni kwe-amino (N) noma ekugcineni kwe-carboxyl (C)
question4: Kwenzekani ngokuvamile ngokulandelana kwesignali ngemva kokuba iphrotheni ifike lapho iya khona?
answer4: Ngokuvamile isuswa kuphrotheni
question5: Iphrotheni iqukethe uchungechunge lwesignali ye-amino-terminal oluhlose i-mitochondria. Cishe iphrotheni izothuthwa kuphi?
answer5: I-mitochondrion
question6: Bayini abaphelezeli?
answer6: Amaprotheni asiza amanye amaprotheni ekugoqeni kahle nasekuvimbeleni ukuhlangana
distractor6b: Amaprotheni abhidliza amaprotheni agoqwe ngendlela engafanele ngokushesha
distractor6c: Ama-molecule e-RNA avuselela ukwakheka kwesibopho se-peptide
question7: Kungani amaprotheni e-chaperone edingeka ngezinye izikhathi?
answer7: Amanye amaprotheni awakwazi ukugoqa kahle ngokwawo futhi adinga usizo ukuze afinyelele isimo sawo sokusebenza
distractor7a: Ziyadingeka kuzo zonke izibopho ze-peptide ezakhiwe ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
question8: Ukushisa okungajwayelekile noma i-pH kungathinta kanjani iphrotheni esanda kuhlanganiswa?
answer8: Kungavimbela ukugoqeka okufanele, okuholela ephrotheni engasebenzi naphezu kokulandelana kwe-amino acid okulungile
distractor8a: Ishintsha unomphela ukulandelana kwe-DNA yesakhi sofuzo
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani ukugoqwa kwamaprotheni kubalulekile?
answer9: Umsebenzi wamaphrotheni uncike esakhiweni sawo esifanele esinezinhlangothi ezintathu
distractor9a: Umsebenzi weprotheyini uncike kuphela kubude bayo
distractor9b: Amaprotheni ahlala esebenza kungakhathaliseki ukuthi anjani
distractor9c: Ukugoqana kwamaprotheni kwenzeka kuphela ngemva kokuba iphrotheni yonakele
question10: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kususa ukulandelana kwezimpawu kuphrotheni evame ukusebenza ku-mitochondria. Uyini umphumela ongaba khona kakhulu?
answer10: Iphrotheni cishe izohlala ku-cytoplasm futhi yehluleke ukufinyelela ku-mitochondria, okunciphisa noma kuqede ukusebenza kwayo okuvamile.
distractor10b: Iphrotheni izogoqeka kahle futhi isebenze ngokujwayelekile kunoma iyiphi indawo yamaseli

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.6 Amagama Ayinhloko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 15. Izakhi zofuzo namaphrotheni | 15.6 Amagama Ayinhloko
chapterContent:
Isivalo se-7-methylguanosine
ukuguqulwa kufakwe emaphethelweni ama-5 e-pre-mRNA ukuvikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni nasekusizeni ukuhumusha

 i-aminoacyl tRNA synthetase
i-enzyme eshaja "ama-molecule e-tRNA ngokusungula isibopho phakathi kwe-tRNA kanye ne-amino acid ehambisanayo

i-anticodon
 ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide ezintathu ku-molecule ye-tRNA ehambisana ne-codon ye-mRNA

Ibhokisi le-CAAT
 (GGCCAATCT) ukulandelana kwe-promoter ye-eukaryotic ebalulekile ehilelekile ezintweni zokubopha zokubhala

I-Central Dogma
 ithi izakhi zofuzo zichaza ukulandelana kwama-mRNA, okuthi nakho kuchaze ukulandelana kwamaprotheni

i-codon
 ama-nucleotide amathathu alandelanayo ku-mRNA achaza ukufakwa kwe-amino acid noma ukukhishwa kweketanga le-polypeptide ngesikhathi sokuhumusha

i-colinear
 ngokwe-RNA kanye ne-protein, amayunithi amathathu"e-RNA (ama-nucleotide) achaza iyunithi eyodwa"yeprotheni (i-amino acid) ngendlela elandelanayo

ukuvumelana
Uchungechunge lwe-DNA olusetshenziswa izinhlobo eziningi ukwenza imisebenzi efanayo noma efanayo

 i-enzyme eyinhloko
i-prokaryotic RNA polymerase equkethe i-α, α, β, kanye ne-β kodwa ingenayo i-σ; le nhlanganisela yenza ukunwebeka

 ukuwohloka
(kwekhodi yezakhi zofuzo) ichaza ukuthi i-amino acid ethile ingafakwa ikhodi ngama-nucleotide triplet angaphezu kweyodwa; ikhodi iyawohloka, kodwa ayicaci

 phansi
ama-nucleotide alandela indawo yokuqala ngokuya ngokubhalwa kwe-mRNA; ngokuvamile, ukulandelana okubheke ekugcineni kwe-3 maqondana nendawo eku-mRNA

 i-exon
ukulandelana kukhona ku-mRNA ebhala amaprotheni ngemuva kokuqedwa kokuhlanganiswa kwe-pre-mRNA

 IQINISO
inkimbinkimbi evumela ukubhalwa kwe-chromatin” ngokuyihlukanisa ama-nucleosome angaphambi kwe-RNA polymerase II eqophayo bese ehlanganiswa kabusha ngemva kokuba i-polymerase idlule

 Ibhokisi elicebile nge-GC
(GGCG) uchungechunge lwe-promoter ye-eukaryotic olungeyona ebalulekile olubopha izici zeseli ukwandisa ukusebenza kahle kokubhalwa; lungaba khona izikhathi eziningana ku-promoter

 i-hairpin
isakhiwo se-RNA lapho igoqa futhi yakha izibopho ze-hydrogen zangaphakathi kwama-molecule phakathi kwama-nucleotide ahambisanayo

 i-holoenzyme
i-prokaryotic RNA polymerase equkethe i-α, α, β, β, kanye ne-σ; le nhlanganisela inesibopho sokuqaliswa kokubhalwa

 indawo yokuqalisa
i-nucleotide lapho ukwenziwa kwe-mRNA kuqhubeka khona ngendlela engu-5 kuya ku-3; ekhonjiswe nge-+1

 i-initiator tRNA
kuma-prokaryotes, abizwa ngokuthi i-t⁢R⁢N⁢AM⁢e⁢tf; kuma-eukaryotes, abizwa ngokuthi i-tRNAi; i-tRNA esebenzisana ne-codon yokuqala, ibopha ngqo kusayithi le-ribosome P, futhi ixhumane ne-methionine ekhethekile ukuqala uchungechunge lwe-polypeptide

 intron
ukulandelana okungenawo amaprotheni okufaka ikhodi okuhlanganisiwe kusuka ku-mRNA ngesikhathi sokucubungula

 Imithetho kaKozak
inquma i-AUG yokuqala efanele ku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic; ukulandelana okulandelayo kokuvumelana kumele kuvele ku-AUG: 5’-GCC(purine)CCAUGG-3’; izisekelo ezinesibindi zibaluleke kakhulu

 i-codon engenamsebenzi
enye yama-codon amathathu e-mRNA ecacisa ukuphela kokuhumusha

 umucu ongesiwo umfuziselo
umucu we-DNA ongasetshenziselwa ukubhala i-mRNA; lo mucu ufana ne-mRNA ngaphandle kokuthi ama-nucleotide e-T ku-DNA athathelwa indawo ama-nucleotide e-U ku-mRNA

 Ibhokisi le-Octamer
(ATTGCAT) uchungechunge lwe-promoter ye-eukaryotic olungeyona ebalulekile olubopha izici zeseli ukwandisa ukusebenza kahle kokubhala; lungaba khona izikhathi eziningana ku-promoter

 i-peptidyl transferase
i-enzyme esekelwe ku-RNA ehlanganiswe ne-subunit ye-ribosomal engu-50S futhi ivuselela ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-peptide

 i-plasmid
i-extrachromosome, i-covalently closed, i-molecule ye-DNA eyindilinga engase iqukathe i-gene eyodwa noma ezimbalwa kuphela; evamile kuma-prokaryotes

 umsila we-poly-A
 ukuguqulwa kwengezwe emaphethelweni amathathu e-pre-mRNA ukuvikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni nasekusizeni ukuthunyelwa kwe-mRNA kusuka ku-nucleus

i-polysome
 i-molecule ye-mRNA ihunyushwa ngasikhathi sinye ngama-ribosome amaningi wonke ahamba ngendlela efanayo

i-preinitiation complex
 iqoqo lezinto zokubhala kanye namanye amaprotheni aqoqa i-RNA polymerase II ukuze ibhalwe ithempulethi ye-DNA

umgqugquzeli
 Uchungechunge lwe-DNA lapho i-RNA polymerase nezinto ezihlobene zibopha futhi ziqalise khona ukubhalwa

uhlaka lokufunda
 Uchungechunge lwama-codon e-triplet ku-mRNA achaza iphrotheni ethile; ukushintsha kwe-ribosome kwe-nucleotide eyodwa noma ezimbili kunoma iyiphi indlela kuqeda ngokuphelele ukwenziwa kwaleyo phrotheni

Ukuphela okuncike ku-Rho
 kuma-prokaryotes, ukuqedwa kokubhalwa kwe-transcription ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwe-RNA polymerase kanye ne-rho protein ekugijimeni kwama-nucleotide e-G kuthempulethi ye-DNA

Ukungaxhomekeki ku-Rho
 ukuqedwa kokuhlanganiswa kwe-prokaryotic mRNA okuncike ekuqedweni kokulandelana; okubangelwa ukwakheka kwe-hairpin ku-mRNA evimba i-polymerase

Ukuhlela i-RNA
 ukuguqulwa okuqondile kwe-nucleotide eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ku-mRNA esevele yenziwe

Ukulandelana kwe-Shine-Dalgarno
 (AGGAGG); iqala ukuhumusha kwe-prokaryotic ngokusebenzisana nama-molecule e-rRNA aqukethe i-ribosome ye-30S

Ukulandelana kwesignali
 Umsila omfushane wama-amino acid aqondisa iphrotheni endaweni ethile yeselula

i-RNA encane yenuzi
 ama-molecule enziwe yi-RNA polymerase III anemisebenzi eyahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlanganisa ama-pre-mRNA kanye nokulawula izici zokubhala

ukuhlanganisa
 inqubo yokususa ama-intron nokuxhuma kabusha ama-exons ku-pre-mRNA

qala i-codon
 I-AUG (noma okungajwayelekile, i-GUG) ku-mRNA lapho ukuhumusha kuqala khona; njalo icacisa i-methionine

Ibhokisi le-TATA
 ukulandelana kwe-promoter okulondoloziwe kuma-eukaryotes nama-prokaryotes okusiza ukusungula indawo yokuqalisa yokubhala

ithempulethi i-strand
 i-strand ye-DNA ecacisa i-molecule ye-mRNA ehambisanayo

ibhamuza lokubhala
 isifunda se-DNA engahlanganisiwe endaweni evumela ukubhalwa kwe-mRNA

phezulu
 ama-nucleotide angaphambi kwendawo yokuqalisa; ngokuvamile, ukulandelana okuya ekugcineni okungu-5 maqondana nesayithi eliku-mRNA
question1: Uyini umsebenzi wesivalo se-7-methylguanosine ku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic?
answer1: Ivikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi isiza ekuqaliseni ukuhumusha
question2: Iyini indima ye-aminoacyl tRNA synthetase?
answer2: Inamathisela i-amino acid efanele ku-tRNA yayo ehambisanayo
question3: Iyini i-anticodon?
answer3: Uchungechunge lwe-nucleotide oluthathu ku-tRNA oluhambisana ne-codon ye-mRNA ehambisanayo
distractor3a: Uchungechunge lwe-nucleotide ezintathu ku-DNA oluqala ukubhalwa
question4: Uyini umsebenzi webhokisi le-CAAT kuma-eukaryotes?
answer4: Kuwuchungechunge lwephromotha oluhilelekile ezintweni ezibophayo zokubhala
question5: Ichaza ukuthini i-Central Dogma?
answer5: Izakhi zofuzo zichaza ukulandelana kwe-mRNA, okuthi kamuva kuchaze ukulandelana kweprotheni
question6: Iyini i-codon?
answer6: Uchungechunge lwama-nucleotide amathathu e-mRNA oluchaza i-amino acid noma isignali yokuma
distractor6a: Uchungechunge lwama-nucleotide amathathu e-DNA olutholakala kuphela kuma-promoter
question7: Kusho ukuthini ukuthi ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo i-colinear?
answer7: I-triplet ngayinye elandelanayo yama-nucleotide ihambelana ne-amino acid eyodwa elandelanayo kuprotheni
distractor7b: I-amino acid ngayinye ifakwa ikhodi yi-nucleotide eyodwa
question8: Kuyini ukulandelana kwe-DNA okuvumelanayo?
answer8: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA oluvame ukwabelwana phakathi kwezinhlobo eziningi ezenza umsebenzi ofanayo
distractor8a: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA oluyingqayizivele entweni eyodwa ephilayo
question9: Iyini i-enzyme eyinhloko ye-prokaryotic RNA polymerase?
answer9: Ama-subunit angu-α, α, β, kanye no-β angenawo i-σ factor
question10: Kusho ukuthini ukuwohloka kwekhodi yezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: Ama-codon angaphezu kweyodwa angacacisa i-amino acid efanayo
distractor10a: I-codon eyodwa ichaza ama-amino acid amaningana ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor10b: I-amino acid ngayinye ine-codon eyodwa kuphela
distractor10c: Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo iyashintsha phakathi kwamaseli ento efanayo
question11: Kusho ukuthini okulandelayo ku-genetics?
answer11: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA noma lwe-RNA olutholakala ngemuva kwendawo yokuqala yokubhala phansi ngasendleleni yokubhala phansi
question12: Iyini i-exon?
answer12: Uchungechunge oluhlala ku-mRNA evuthiwe ngemva kokuhlanganiswa futhi ngokuvamile lufaka ikhodi kumaprotheni
distractor12a: Uchungechunge olungafaki ikhodi lususiwe ngesikhathi sokufaka ikhodi
question13: Uyini umsebenzi we-FACT complex?
answer13: Ihlukanisa okwesikhashana ama-nucleosome ngaphambi kwe-RNA polymerase II bese iwahlanganisa kabusha ngemva kokubhalwa kwe-transcription.
question14: Iyini indima yebhokisi elicebile nge-GC kumgqugquzeli we-eukaryotic?
answer14: Ibopha izici zamaseli ezikhulisa ukusebenza kahle kokubhala
question15: Iyini i-RNA hairpin?
answer15: Isakhiwo esakhiwe lapho i-molecule ye-RNA izigoqa ngokwayo ngokuhlanganisa isisekelo okuhambisanayo
question16: Iyini i-holoenzyme ekubhalweni kwe-prokaryotic?
answer16: I-RNA polymerase ephelele equkethe i-α, α, β, β, kanye ne-σ eqala ukubhalwa kwe-transcription
distractor16a: I-enzyme eyinhloko ye-RNA polymerase ngaphandle kwe-σ
question17: Iyini indawo yokuqala yokubhala umbhalo?
answer17: I-nucleotide ye-+1 lapho kuqala khona ukwenziwa kwe-RNA
distractor17c: Uchungechunge lwe-Shine-Dalgarno
question18: Iyini indima yomqalisi we-tRNA?
answer18: Ibona i-codon yokuqala bese ingena ngqo endaweni ye-P ukuze iqale ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni
answer19: Uchungechunge olungeyona iphrotheni olususwe ku-pre-mRNA ngesikhathi sokuhlanganisa
distractor19a: Isifunda sokubhala amaphrotheni esigcinwe ku-mRNA evuthiwe
answer20: I-codon yokuqala ye-AUG efanele yokuqaliswa kokuhumusha ku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic
answer22: Umucu we-DNA ongabhalwanga futhi onochungechunge olucishe lufane ne-mRNA ngaphandle kwe-T uthatha indawo ye-U
distractor22a: Umucu we-DNA ufundwa ngqo yi-RNA polymerase
answer23: Kuyisici sokukhuthaza esibopha izici zokuloba ukuze kwandiswe ukusebenza kahle kokuloba
answer24: I-enzyme esekelwe kwi-RNA engxenyeni enkulu ye-ribosomal ekhuthaza ukwakheka kwesibopho se-peptide
answer25: I-molecule encane eyindilinga ye-extrachromosome DNA evame ukutholakala kuma-prokaryotes
answer26: Ivikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi ikhuthaza ukuthunyelwa kwe-nucleus
answer27: Ama-ribosome amaningi ahumusha i-mRNA efanayo ngasikhathi sinye
distractor27b: Iqembu lama-tRNA aphethe i-amino acid efanayo
answer28: Iqoqo lezinto zokubhala kanye namaprotheni athola i-RNA polymerase II kumkhuthazi
answer29: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA lapho i-RNA polymerase kanye nezici ezihlobene zibopha khona ukuqala ukubhalwa kwe-transcription
distractor29c: Isifunda lapho kwakheka khona izibopho ze-peptide
answer30: Ukuqoqwa kwama-nucleotide e-mRNA abe ama-codon amathathu alandelanayo anquma ukulandelana kwama-amino acid
answer31: Indlela yokusebenza kuma-prokaryotes lapho iphrotheni ye-rho ibangela khona ukuthi i-RNA polymerase ihlukane ne-DNA, iqede ukulotshwa kwayo
