chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 15. Izakhi Zofuzo Namaprotheni | 15.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
15.1 Ikhodi Yezakhi Zofuzo
Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo ibhekisela ku-alfabhethi ye-DNA (A, T, C, G), i-alfabhethi ye-RNA (A, U, C, G), kanye ne-alfabhethi ye-polypeptide (ama-amino acid angu-20). I-Central Dogma ichaza ukugeleza kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo esitokisini kusuka ku-genes kuya ku-mRNA kuya kumaprotheni. Izakhi zofuzo zisetshenziselwa ukwenza i-mRNA ngenqubo yokubhala; i-mRNA isetshenziselwa ukuhlanganisa amaprotheni ngenqubo yokuhumusha. Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo iyawohloka ngoba ama-codon angu-64 e-triplet ku-mRNA achaza ama-amino acid angu-20 kuphela kanye nama-codon amathathu angenangqondo. Cishe zonke izinhlobo emhlabeni zisebenzisa ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo efanayo.

 15.2 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Prokaryotic
Kuma-prokaryotes, ukwakheka kwe-mRNA kuqaliswa ngokulandelana kwe-promoter kuthempulethi ye-DNA equkethe ukulandelana okubili kokuvumelana okuqoqa i-RNA polymerase. I-prokaryotic polymerase iqukethe i-enzyme eyinhloko yama-subunit amane amaprotheni kanye ne-σ protein esiza kuphela ekuqalisweni. Ukwandiswa kuhlanganisa i-mRNA ngendlela engu-5 kuya kwengu-3 ngesivinini sama-nucleotide angu-40 ngomzuzwana. Ukuphela kukhulula i-mRNA futhi kwenzeka ngokusebenzisana kwe-rho protein noma ngokwakhiwa kwe-hairpin ye-mRNA.

 15.3 Ukubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic
Ukubhalwa Kwe-eukaryotic kuma-eukaryotes kuhilela enye yezinhlobo ezintathu zama-polymerase, kuye ngokuthi i-gene ibhalwa kanjani. I-RNA polymerase II ibhala zonke izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni, kuyilapho i-RNA polymerase I ibhala izakhi zofuzo ze-rRNA, kanti i-RNA polymerase III ibhala izakhi zofuzo ze-rRNA, i-tRNA, kanye nezakhi zofuzo ezincane ze-nuclear RNA. Ukuqaliswa kokubhalwa Kwe-eukaryotes kuhilela ukubopha izici eziningana zokubhalwa Kwe-transcription ku-complex promoter sequences ezivame ukutholakala phezulu kwe-gene ekopishwayo. I-mRNA yenziwa ngendlela engu-5 kuya kwengu-3, futhi i-FACT complex inyakazisa futhi ihlanganise kabusha ama-nucleosome njengoba i-polymerase idlula. Ngenkathi i-RNA polymerases I kanye ne-III ziqeda ukubhalwa ngezindlela ezincike ku-protein noma ku-RNA hairpin, i-RNA polymerase II ibhala ama-nucleotide ayi-1,000 noma ngaphezulu ngale kwethempulethi yezakhi zofuzo futhi ihlukanise okungaphezulu ngesikhathi sokucubungula i-pre-mRNA.

 15.4 Ukucubungula i-RNA kuma-Eukaryotes
Ama-pre-mRNA e-Eukaryotic aguqulwa nge-cap ye-methylguanosine engu-5 kanye nomsila we-poly-A. Lezi zakhiwo zivikela i-mRNA evuthiwe ekuwohlokeni futhi zisiza ukuyithumela kusuka ku-nucleus. Ama-pre-mRNA nawo afakwa ku-splicing, lapho ama-intron asuswa khona futhi ama-exons aphinde axhunywe ngokunemba kwe-nucleotide eyodwa. Ama-mRNA aqediwe kuphela adlule ku-5 capping, i-polyadenylation engu-3, kanye ne-intron splicing athunyelwa kusuka ku-nucleus kuya ku-cytoplasm. Ama-pre-rRNA nama-pre-tRNA angacutshungulwa ngokuhlukaniswa kwangaphakathi kwama-molecular, i-splicing, i-methylation, kanye nokuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali kwama-nucleotide. Akuvamile, ukuhlela i-RNA kwenziwa futhi ukuze kufakwe izisekelo ezingekho ngemuva kokuba i-mRNA ihlanganisiwe.

 15.5 Ama-Ribosome kanye ne-Protein Synthesis
Abadlali abahumushiwe bafaka ithempulethi ye-mRNA, ama-ribosome, ama-tRNA, kanye nezici ezahlukahlukene ze-enzyme. I-subunit encane ye-ribosomal yakha ithempulethi ye-mRNA kungaba ku-Shine-Dalgarno sequence (ama-prokaryotes) noma i-5 cap (ama-eukaryotes). Ukuhumusha kuqala ku-AUG yokuqala ku-mRNA, kuchaza i-methionine. Ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-peptide kwenzeka phakathi kwama-amino acid alandelanayo achazwe ithempulethi ye-mRNA ngokuya ngekhodi yezakhi zofuzo. Ama-tRNA ashajiwe angena kusayithi le-ribosomal A, kanye nezibopho zawo ze-amino acid ne-amino acid kusayithi le-P. I-mRNA yonke ihunyushwa ngezinyathelo ezintathu ze-nucleotide” ze-ribosome. Lapho kuhlangana ne-codon engenangqondo, i-release factor ibopha futhi ihlukanise izingxenye bese ikhulula iphrotheni entsha. Ukugoqwa kwephrotheni kwenzeka ngesikhathi nangemva kokuguqulwa.

question31: Chaza ukuqala kokubhalwa kwemibhalo kuma-prokaryotes. Faka wonke amaprotheni ahilelekile
answer31: Kuma-prokaryotes, i-polymerase yakhiwe ngama-subunit amahlanu e-polypeptide, amabili awo afanayo. Amane kulawa ma-subunit, abizwa ngokuthi i-α, i-α, i-β, kanye ne-β’, ahlanganisa i-enzyme eyinhloko ye-polymerase. I-subunit yesihlanu, i-σ, ihileleke kuphela ekuqalisweni kokubhalwa kwe-transcription. I-polymerase eyakhiwe yiwo wonke ama-subunit amahlanu ibizwa ngokuthi i-holoenzyme.
distractor31a: Kuma-prokaryotes, i-polymerase yakhiwe ngama-subunit amane e-polypeptide, amabili awo afanayo. Lawa ma-subunit, abizwa ngokuthi i-α, i-α, i-β, ne-β’, ahlanganisa i-enzyme eyinhloko ye-polymerase. Kukhona i-subunit yesihlanu ehilelekile ekuqalisweni kokuhumusha. I-polymerase eyakhiwe yiwo wonke ama-subunit amane ibizwa ngokuthi i-holoenzyme.
distractor31b: Kuma-prokaryotes, i-polymerase yakhiwe ngama-subunit amahlanu e-polypeptide, amabili awo afanayo. Amane kulawa ma-subunit, abizwa ngokuthi i-α, i-α, i-β, kanye ne-β’, ahlanganisa i-polymerase holoenzyme. I-subunit yesihlanu, i-σ, ihileleke kuphela ekuqalisweni kokubhalwa kwe-transcription. I-polymerase eyakhiwe yiwo wonke ama-subunit amahlanu ibizwa ngokuthi i-enzyme eyinhloko.
distractor31c: Kuma-prokaryotes, i-polymerase yakhiwe ngama-subunit amahlanu e-polypeptide, amabili awo afanayo. Amane kulawa ma-subunit, abizwa ngokuthi i-α, i-α, i-α, i-β, kanye ne-β’, ahlanganisa i-enzyme eyinhloko ye-polymerase. I-subunit yesihlanu, i-σ, ihileleke kuphela ekuqedeni. I-polymerase eyakhiwe yiwo wonke ama-subunit amahlanu ibizwa ngokuthi i-holoenzyme.
question32: Ngamazwi akho, chaza umehluko phakathi kokuqedwa kokubhalwa kwe-ρ okuxhomeke ku-ρ kanye nokungaxhomeke ku-ρ ku-prokaryotes
answer32: Ukuphela okuncike ku-Rho kulawulwa yi-rho protein kanye nama-polymerase stalls eduze kokuphela kwe-gene ekugijimeni kwama-G nucleotides kuthempulethi ye-DNA. Ekuphelelisweni okungaxhomeke ku-rho, lapho i-polymerase ihlangana nesifunda esicebile ngama-C-G nucleotides, i-mRNA igoqeka ibe yi-hairpin loop ebangela ukuthi i-polymerase ime.
distractor32a: Ukuphela kwe-Rho-independent kulawulwa yi-rho protein kanye ne-polymerase stalls eduze kokuphela kwe-gene ekugijimeni kwama-G nucleotides kuthempulethi ye-DNA. Ekuphelelisweni kwe-rho-independent, lapho i-polymerase ihlangana nesifunda esicebile ngama-C-G nucleotides, i-mRNA igoqeka ibe yi-hairpin loop ebangela ukuthi i-polymerase ime.
distractor32b: Ukuphela okuncike ku-Rho kulawulwa yi-rho protein kanti i-polymerase iqala eduze kokuphela kwe-gene lapho kugijima ama-nucleotide e-G kuthempulethi ye-DNA. Ekuphelelisweni okuxhomeke ku-rho, lapho i-polymerase ihlangana nesifunda esicebile ngama-nucleotide e-C-G, i-mRNA idala i-hairpin loop ebangela ukuthi i-polymerase ime.
distractor32c: Ukuphela okuncike ku-Rho kulawulwa yi-rho protein kanye nama-polymerase stalls eduze kokuphela kwe-gene ekugijimeni kwama-G nucleotides kuthempulethi ye-DNA. Ekuphelelisweni okungaxhomeke ku-rho, lapho i-polymerase ihlangana nesifunda esicebile ngama-A-T nucleotides, i-mRNA idala i-hairpin loop ebangela ukuthi i-polymerase ime.

distractor38b: I-molecule ye-mRNA yayizophuma kuyi-nucleus futhi idale amakhophi engeziwe e-molecule ye-mRNA

question39: Bheka uMfanekiso 15.5. Bhala futhi uhumushe ukulandelana okulandelayo kwe-DNA (umucu ongewona owethempulethi): 5’-ATGGCCGGTTAAGCA-3’
answer39: I-mRNA izoba ngu-5’-AUGGCCGGUUAUUAAGCA-3’ kanti iphrotheni izoba yi-MAGY

distractor39b: I-mRNA izoba ngu-5’-ATGGCCGGTTAAGCA-3’ kanti iphrotheni izoba yi-MAGY
distractor39c: I-mRNA izoba ngu-5’-AUGGCCGGUUAUUAAGCA-3’ kanti iphrotheni izoba yi-MACY
question40: I-RNA world hypothesis iphakamisa ukuthi i-molecule yokuqala eyinkimbinkimbi kwakuyi-RNA futhi yandulela ukwakheka kwamaprotheni. Yimuphi umsebenzi omkhulu we-ribosomal RNA osekela le mbono?
answer40: I-rRNA inezakhiwo zokuvuselela ku-subunit enkulu futhi ihlanganisa amaprotheni
distractor40a: I-rRNA iyi-molecule yamaprotheni esiza ekwakhiweni kwamanye amaprotheni
distractor40c: I-rRNA idlala indima enkulu ezinqubweni zangemva kokuhumusha
question41: I-tRNA iguqulwa ngamakhemikhali ukuze i-amino acid eboshiwe ihluke kuneleyo echazwe yi-anticodon yayo. Yimuphi i-codon ku-mRNA i-tRNA engayibona: leyo echazwe yi-anticodon yayo noma leyo ehambisana ne-amino acid eguquliwe eyithwalayo?
distractor41a: I-anticodon izohambisana ne-amino acid eguquliwe eyithwalayo

question42: Yisiphi isici sekhodi yezakhi zofuzo esibonisa ukuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zinozalo olufanayo?
answer42: Ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo cishe iyinto yonke

question44: Uma kuqhathaniswa ukuqoshwa kolwazi oluzuzwayo kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes, yiziphi izenzakalo ezifanayo?
answer44: Ukubhalwa phansi yi-polymerase, ukuqashelwa kochungechunge lokuvumelana kuphromotha, kanye nokuqedwa yi-hairpin loop kuyalondolozwa.
distractor44a: Ukuhumusha nge-polymerase, ukuqashelwa kokulandelana kokuvumelana kuphromotha, kanye nokuqedwa yi-hairpin loop kuyalondolozwa.
distractor44b: Ukubhalwa phansi yi-polymerase, ukuqashelwa kochungechunge oluguquguqukayo kakhulu kuphromotha, kanye nokuqedwa yi-hairpin loop kuyalondolozwa.
distractor44c: Ukubhalwa phansi yi-polymerase, ukuqashelwa kochungechunge lokuvumelana kuphromotha, kanye nokwandiswa yi-hairpin loop kuyalondolozwa.
question45: Yisiphi isakhiwo samaseli esilandelayo esingenalo ulwazi olufanele ufuzo?
question46: I-enzyme reverse transcriptase iphula kanjani imfundiso eyinhloko ye-molecular biology ku-HIV?
answer46: I-enzyme reverse transcriptase reverse iguqula i-RNA ku-genome ye-HIV ibe yi-DNA
distractor46a: I-enzyme reverse transcriptase ihumusha i-RNA ye-HIV ibe yiprotheni bese ibuyela ku-DNA.
distractor46b: I-enzyme reverse transcriptase iguqula i-DNA ibe ama-molecule amaprotheni ngqo
distractor46c: I-enzyme reverse transcriptase iguqula i-DNA ibe yi-RNA, bese iphinda ibe yi-DNA. Akukho ukwakheka kwamaprotheni
question47: I-radioactive deoxythymidine triphosphate inikezwa i-protist u-Euglena ukuze ayisebenzisele ukuphindaphinda. Yiliphi ingxenyana yamaseli engeke ibhalwe nge-radioactive?
question48: Uhlela i-gene oyithandayo bese uhlukanisa i-mRNA ehambisanayo. Uthola ukuthi i-mRNA imfushane kakhulu kunochungechunge lwe-DNA. Kungani kunjalo?
answer48: I-mRNA ecutshunguliwe imfushane ngoba ama-intron asusiwe
distractor48a: Kube nephutha lokuhlola. I-mRNA kufanele ibe nobude obufanayo nobejini
distractor48b: I-mRNA kufanele ibe yinde kune-DNA sequence ngoba i-promoter nayo ibhaliwe
distractor48c: I-mRNA imfushane ngoba ukulandelana kwesignali yokuwela ulwelwesi lwenuzi kususiwe
question49: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo esifundeni se-promoter se-gene ye-beta-globin kungabangela i-beta-thalassemia, isimo esizuzwa njengefa esibangela i-anemia. Kungani ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo esifundeni se-promoter kungaholela emazingeni aphansi e-hemoglobin?
answer49: Amaketanga e-globin ambalwa akhiqizwa ngoba i-mRNA encane iyabhalwa
distractor49a: Amaketanga e-globin akhiqizwayo made kakhulu ukuthi angakha i-hemoglobin esebenzayo
distractor49b: Amaketanga e-globin amafushane kakhulu ukuba akhe i-hemoglobin esebenzayo
distractor49c: Amaketanga e-Globin awagoqeki kahle futhi awasebenzi
question50:

Bheka uMfanekiso 15.18. Unikezwa izilandelaniso ezintathu ze-mRNA:
5’-UCG-GCA-AAU-UUA-GUU-3’
5’-UCU-GCA-AAU-UUA-GUU-3’

Usebenzisa i-peptide ebhalwe yiyo ngayinye engenhla, qhathanisa ama-peptide amathathu atholiwe. Ama-peptide 2 no-3 ahluke kanjani ku-1? Uyoba yini umphumela weseli esimweni ngasinye?
answer51: Kukhona ukuguquka okuthule ku-peptide 2 kanti i-peptide 3 ine-codon yokuma ngenxa yokuguquka

distractor51b: Kukhona i-amino acid ehlukile ku-peptide 2 kanti i-peptide 3 ine-stop codon ngenxa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor51c: Akukho ukuguquka kwe-peptide 2 futhi i-peptide 3 ine-codon yokuma ngenxa yokuguquka kwe-peptide.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Iningi labantu liyazi ukuthi ukuzivocavoca njalo kubalulekile ukuze kulondolozwe impilo enhle. Kukhuthaza impilo yenhliziyo nemithambo yegazi futhi kusiza ekuvimbeleni ukukhuluphala. Ososayensi manje sebethole ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kokukhuthazela isikhathi eside kushintsha nendlela izakhi zofuzo ezivezwa ngayo ezicutshini zemisipha. Ocwaningweni lwamuva nje, abantu abangu-23 abanempilo bavivinya umlenze owodwa imizuzu engu-45 izinsuku ezine ngesonto ngenkathi bephumuza omunye umlenze. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezintathu, imisipha evela emilenzeni yabahlanganyeli yahlolwa nge-biopsy, futhi ososayensi bahlaziya izinga lomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo ezingaphezu kuka-20,000 kumasampula ezicubu.

 Bathole ukuthi kumhlanganyeli ngamunye umlenze ovivinya umzimba wawunciphise ukuvuvukala futhi uthuthukise imetabolism uma kuqhathaniswa nomlenze ongavivinywanga. Lo mehluko wawuhambisana nezinguquko kuzakhi zofuzo ezihlobene nemetabolism kanye nokuvuvukala. Kodwa-ke, ukulandelana kwangempela kwezakhi zofuzo akuzange kushintshwe. Esikhundleni salokho, ezinye izakhi zofuzo zazine-methylated, okusho ukuthi amaqembu e-methyl ayenamathele kuma-nucleotide athile ngokulandelana. Lokhu, empeleni, kwacima izakhi zofuzo” noma kwashintsha indlela ezazivezwa ngayo. I-DNA methylation iyisibonelo se-epigenetics, okuyinqubo eshintsha izakhi zofuzo ngaphandle kokuthinta ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide yezakhi zofuzo. Bheka Umfanekiso 16.1
question1: Yayiyini imiphumela eyinhloko yokuqeqeshwa kokukhuthazela kwesikhathi eside okwabonwa ocwaningweni?
answer1: Ukuzivocavoca okushintshiwe kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo nge-methylation ye-DNA ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor1a: Ukuzivocavoca kushintshe unomphela ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide ye-DNA yemisipha
distractor1b: Ukuzivocavoca kubangele ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okusabalele
distractor1c: Ukuzivocavoca kuthathe indawo ye-DNA nge-RNA emangqamuzaneni emisipha
question2: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic okuhlotshaniswa nezinguquko ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ngemva kokuzivocavoca?
question3: Ngokusho kocwaningo, yikuphi ukungafani komzimba okwabonakala emlenzeni ovivinywayo?
answer3: Ukuvuvukala okuncishisiwe kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwe-metabolism
distractor3a: Ukuvuvukala okwandisiwe kanye nokusetshenziswa kancane kwe-metabolism
distractor3c: Amazinga aphezulu okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokwehla kwe-metabolism
question4: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono i-epigenetics?
answer4: Ishintsha ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide ye-DNA
distractor4b: Ithatha indawo ye-DNA nge-RNA ngesikhathi sokwenziwa kwamaprotheni
distractor4c: Ishintsha ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo esetshenziswa ama-ribosome
question5: I-DNA methylation yathinta kanjani izakhi zofuzo emisipheni evivinywayo?
answer5: Kwacima ezinye izakhi zofuzo noma kwashintsha indlela ezazivezwa ngayo
distractor5b: Yaguqula izakhi zofuzo zaba ama-molecule e-RNA
question6: Kungani i-methylation ye-DNA ibhekwa njengenqubo ye-epigenetic?
answer6: Ngoba ishintsha umsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor6a: Ngoba kudala izinguquko ezihlala njalo ku-DNA
question7: Yisiphi isiphetho esivela ocwaningweni esibonisa kangcono ithonya lendawo ezungezile ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ukuzivocavoca kushintshe amaphethini e-methylation kanye nomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor7a: Ukuzivocavoca kubangele izinguquko ze-DNA ezizuzisayo emaseli emisipha
distractor7b: Ukuzivocavoca kushintshe ikhodi yofuzo yomhlaba wonke

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.1 Ukulawulwa Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.1 Ukulawulwa Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Isakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi ku-biology kuvela ekubeni khona kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuvezwa okufanele kwalolu lwazi. Esahlukweni esimayelana nesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi we-DNA, sihlole ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zihunyushwa kanjani zibe amaprotheni, okuholela ekutheni kunqunywe uhlobo lweseli. Kodwa iseli liyazi kanjani ukuthi kufanele livule nini i-DNA yalo? Ngaphandle kwezimbalwa ezimbalwa, iseli ngalinye emzimbeni wakho liqukethe ulwazi olufanayo lwezakhi zofuzo. Uma iseli ngalinye linesakhiwo esifanayo se-DNA, kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi iseli lesibindi lihluke kuseli lemizwa noma lemisipha?

 Njengoba sizobona, yize iseli ngalinye lihlanganyela i-genome efanayo kanye nochungechunge lwe-DNA, iseli ngalinye alivezi izakhi zofuzo ezifanayo ncamashi. Izici eziningi zinquma ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zivezwa nini futhi kanjani kuseli elithile. Ngisho nohlobo lwe-chromosome isakhi sofuzo esikuyo, njengokuthi ngabe siyi-chromosome yobulili noma cha, singanquma iphethini yaso yokuvezwa, njengoba kungaba nokuguqulwa noma izinguquko kuchungechunge lwe-DNA nezinye izici zangaphandle. Kuma-prokaryotes, ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa ngokuyinhloko ezingeni lokubhalwa phansi, lapho i-DNA ikopishwa ku-RNA. Kodwa-ke, ama-eukaryotes athuthukise izindlela zokulawula ekuvezweni kwezakhi zofuzo emazingeni amaningi. Kuzo zonke izimo, ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kunquma uhlobo kanye nenani lamaprotheni akhiqizwa kuseli. Amaphutha ezinqubweni zokulawula angabangela izifo eziningi zabantu kanye nezimo, kufaka phakathi umdlavuza.

 Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka ezindaweni ezahlukene ku Ama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes. Izinto eziphilayo ze-prokaryotes ziveza i-genome yazo yonke kuwo wonke amaseli, kodwa hhayi zonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ngokuvamile, i-gene ivezwa kuphela uma kudingeka umkhiqizo wayo weprotheni ethile. Khumbula ukuthi iseli ngalinye esidalwa liphethe i-DNA efanayo namanye amaseli. Kodwa amaseli ezinto eziphilayo ze-eukaryotic ngalinye liveza i-subset ehlukile ye-DNA kuye ngohlobo lweseli. Ukuze kuvezwe iphrotheni, i-DNA iqale ihunyushwe ibe yi-RNA, bese ihunyushwa ibe amaprotheni. Kumaseli e-prokaryotic, ukubhalwa nokuhumusha kwenzeka cishe ngasikhathi sinye. Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, ukubhalwa kwenzeka kuyi-nucleus, okuhlukile ekuhunyushweni okwenzeka kuyi-cytoplasm eduze kwama-ribosome anamathele ku-endoplasmic reticulum. Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-prokaryotes kulawulwa ezingeni lokubhalwa, kanti kuma-eukaryotes, ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa emazingeni amaningi, kufaka phakathi i-epigenetic (DNA), ukubhalwa, ngaphambi nangemva kokubhalwa, kanye namazinga okuhumusha.

 Isayensi ye-epigenetics ifunda izinguquko ezizuzwa njengefa ku-genome ezingathinti ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo ze-DNA okuyisisekelo.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ze-AP® zihlanganisa okuqukethwe kolwazi olubalulekile nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.  Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.B
Ukuvezwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuhilela izindlela zamaseli nama-molecule.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.B.1 Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphumela ekuvezweni kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile, okuholela ekukhetheni kweseli

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izimo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.
Inhloso Yokufunda
3.18 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuxhumana phakathi kokulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokwehluka okubonwe phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ukuze iseli lisebenze kahle, amaprotheni adingekayo kumele akhiqizwe ngesikhathi esifanele. Wonke amaseli alawula noma alawule ukwakheka kwamaprotheni kusuka kolwazi olufakwe ku-DNA yawo. Inqubo yokuvula i-gene ukuze ikhiqize i-RNA kanye neprotheni ibizwa ngokuthi ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ku-unicellular organism elula noma ku-multicellular organism eyinkimbinkimbi, iseli ngalinye lilawula ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zalo zivezwa nini futhi kanjani. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kumele kube nendlela yokulawula ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zivezwa nini ukuze zenze i-RNA kanye neprotheni, ukuthi ingakanani iprotheni eyenziwayo, nokuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuyeka ukwenza leyo protheni ngoba ayisadingeki.

 Nakuba ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwezinhlobo kanye nabantu ngabanye ngaphakathi kohlobo kuvame ukuba nesibopho sokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo, enye indlela engadala ukwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo ukwehluka kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Isibonelo, nakuba iseli ngalinye ku-organic liqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezifanayo, amangqamuzana ethambo ku-organic abonakala ehlukile kuma-fat cell ngenxa yokwehluka lapho Izakhi zofuzo zibonakaliswa yiliphi iseli. Ngokufanayo, nakuba amagundane nabantu babelana cishe ngama-97.5% ezakhi zofuzo zabo, ziyizinto eziphilayo ezihlukene kakhulu ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezahlukene zivulwa ngezikhathi ezahlukene ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kanye nasemaseli ahlukene. Ngisho nezinto eziphilayo ezabelana ngo-100% kuma-genome azo (okwaziwa nangokuthi ama-clone) zingagcina zihlukile uma ziveza izakhi zofuzo zazo ngendlela ehlukile ngenxa yezimo zemvelo ezahlukene, isibonelo. Ngisho naphakathi kwabantu, amawele afanayo angaba nezimpawu zokuzalwa ezahlukene, imibimbi, noma ezinye izici ezivela ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa ngezinye izikhathi ngenxa yokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile.

 Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kulondoloza amandla nendawo. Kuzodinga inani elikhulu lamandla ukuze into ephilayo iveze izakhi zofuzo zonke ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho-ke kungcono kakhulu ukuvula izakhi zofuzo kuphela uma kudingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuveza i-subset yezakhi zofuzo kuphela esitokisini ngasinye kusindisa isikhala ngoba i-DNA kumele isuswe esakhiweni sayo esiboshwe ngokuqinile ukuze ibhale futhi ihumushe i-DNA. Amaseli bekuzodingeka abe makhulu kakhulu uma yonke iphrotheni ingavezwa esitokisini ngasinye ngaso sonke isikhathi.

 Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo Kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Ukungasebenzi kahle kule nqubo kuyingozi kuseli futhi kungaholela ekukhuleni kwezifo eziningi
question1: Kungani isibindi, imisipha, kanye namaseli ezinzwa angaba nezakhiwo nemisebenzi ehlukene yize equkethe i-DNA efanayo?
answer1: Ziveza izinhlobo ezahlukene zezakhi zofuzo
distractor1c: Izakhi zofuzo zisuswa unomphela ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli
question2: Kukuliphi izinga lapho ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa khona ngokuyinhloko kuma-prokaryotes?
question3: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-eukaryotes?
answer3: Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa emazingeni amaningi, kufaka phakathi amazinga e-epigenetic, transcriptional, post-transcriptional, kanye namazinga okuhumusha
distractor3a: Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa kuphela ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
distractor3b: Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka kuphela ngokuguqulwa kwe-DNA
distractor3c: Zonke izakhi zofuzo zibonakaliswa njalo kuwo wonke amaseli
question4: Iyini isayensi ye-epigenetics?
answer4: Ucwaningo lwezinguquko ezizuzwa njengefa ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezingashintshi ukulandelana kwe-DNA
question5: Kungani ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kubalulekile ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer5: Ivumela izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ukuthi zikhiqize amaprotheni ahlukene naphezu kokuba ne-genome efanayo
distractor5a: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi iseli ngalinye liveza yonke i-gene njalo
distractor5b: Kubangela izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ukuthi zibe nochungechunge oluhlukile lwe-DNA
question6: Kungani ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kubhekwa njengokusebenzisa kahle amandla?
answer6: Amaseli akhiqiza amaprotheni kuphela uma edingeka
distractor6a: Amaseli aphindaphinda i-DNA kuphela uma kudingeka amaprotheni
distractor6b: Amaseli asusa unomphela izakhi zofuzo ezingasetshenziswanga
distractor6c: Amaseli ayayeka ukukhiqiza i-RNA unomphela ngemva kokuthuthukiswa
question7: Amawele afanayo angakha kanjani izici zomzimba ezihlukene naphezu kokuba nama-genome afanayo?
answer7: Bangakwazi ukuveza izakhi zabo zofuzo ngendlela ehlukile ngenxa yezimo zemvelo
distractor7a: Ukulandelana kwe-DNA yabo kuguquka ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa
distractor7b: Iwele ngalinye lilahlekelwa ama-chromosome ahlukene ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa
distractor7c: Ikhodi yabo yezakhi zofuzo iyashintsha ngokuguga
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle ukulotshwa nokuhunyushwa kwama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes?
answer8: Kuma-prokaryotes kwenzeka cishe ngesikhathi esisodwa, kanti kuma-eukaryotes ukuhunyushwa kwenzeka kuyi-nucleus kanti ukuhunyushwa kwenzeka kuyi-cytoplasm.
distractor8a: Zombili izinqubo zenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa kuzo zombili izinhlobo zamaseli
question9: Umehluko ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ungawufaka kanjani isandla ekwehlukeni kwe-phenotypic phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo?
answer9: Izakhi zofuzo ezahlukene ziyavulwa noma zivaliwe ngezikhathi ezahlukene nasemaseli ahlukene
distractor9a: Yonke i-phenotype inqunywa kuphela ngomehluko wokulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor9b: Umehluko we-phenotypic uvela kuphela ngenxa yenombolo ye-chromosome
question10: Iyini imiphumela engaba khona yamaphutha ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: Zingaholela ezifweni ezifana nomdlavuza
distractor10c: Zivimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA kuwo wonke amaseli

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.1 Ukulawulwa Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukubonakaliswa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic vs Eukaryotic
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.1 Ukulawulwa Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukubonakaliswa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic vs Eukaryotic
chapterContent:
Ukuze siqonde ukuthi ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa kanjani, kumele siqale siqonde ukuthi i-gene ibhala kanjani iphrotheni esebenzayo esitokisini. Le nqubo yenzeka kokubili kumaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic, ngezindlela ezihlukile kancane.

 Izinto eziphilayo ze-Prokaryotic ziyizinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa ezingenayo i-nucleus yeseli, futhi i-DNA yazo intanta ngokukhululeka ku-cytoplasm yeseli. Ukuze kuhlanganiswe iphrotheni, izinqubo zokubhalwa nokuhumusha zenzeka cishe ngesikhathi esisodwa. Lapho iphrotheni ephumayo ingasadingeki, ukubhalwa kuyayeka. Ngenxa yalokho, indlela eyinhloko yokulawula ukuthi hlobo luni lwephrotheni nokuthi ingakanani iphrotheni ngayinye evezwa esitokisini se-prokaryotic ukulawula ukubhalwa kwe-DNA. Zonke izinyathelo ezilandelayo zenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo. Lapho kudingeka iphrotheni eningi, ukubhalwa okwengeziwe kwenzeka. Ngakho-ke, kumaseli e-prokaryotic, ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kusezingeni lokubhalwa.

 Amaseli e-Eukaryotic, ngokuphambene, ane-organelles yangaphakathi kweseli enezela ebunzimeni bawo. Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, i-DNA iqukethwe ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus yeseli bese iguqulwa ibe yi-RNA. I-RNA esanda kuhlanganiswa ithuthwa ikhishwe ku-nucleus iye kwi-cytoplasm, lapho ama-ribosome ehumusha i-RNA ibe yiprotheni. Izinqubo zokubhalwa nokuhumusha zihlukaniswa ngokomzimba yi-membrane yenuzi; ukubhalwa kwenzeka kuphela ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus, futhi ukuhumusha kwenzeka kuphela ngaphandle kwe-nucleus ku-cytoplasm. Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kungenzeka kuzo zonke izigaba zenqubo (Isithombe 16.2). Ukulawulwa kungenzeka lapho i-DNA ivulwa futhi ikhululwa kuma-nucleosome ukuze ibophe izici zokubhalwa (izinga le-epigenetic), lapho i-RNA ibhalwa (izinga lokubhalwa), lapho i-RNA icutshungulwa futhi ithunyelwa kwi-cytoplasm ngemva kokuba ibhalwe (izinga lokubhalwa ngemva kokubhalwa), lapho i-RNA ihunyushwa ibe yiprotheni (izinga lokuhumusha), noma ngemva kokuba iphrotheni seyenziwe (izinga lokuguqulwa ngemva kokubhalwa).

 Umehluko ekulawulweni kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes ufingqiwe kuthebula elingezansi. Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kuxoxwa ngakho ngokuningiliziwe kumamojula alandelayo.

 Umehluko Ekulawulweni Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Kwezinto Eziphilayo Ezinjenge-Prokaryotic Ne-Eukaryotic
Izinto eziphilayo Ezinjenge-Prokaryotic
Izinto eziphilayo Ezinjenge-Eukaryotic

 Ukuntuleka kwe-nucleus
Iqukethe i-nucleus

 I-DNA itholakala ku-cytoplasm
I-DNA ivalelwe engxenyeni yenuzi

 Ukubhalwa kwe-RNA nokwakheka kwamaprotheni kwenzeka cishe ngesikhathi esisodwa
Ukubhalwa kwe-RNA kwenzeka ngaphambi kokwakheka kwamaprotheni, futhi kwenzeka ku-nucleus. Ukuhunyushwa kwe-RNA ibe yiprotheni kwenzeka ku-cytoplasm.

 Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa ngokuyinhloko ezingeni lokubhalwa
Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa emazingeni amaningi (i-epigenetic, i-transcriptional, i-nuclear shuttling, i-post-transcriptional, i-translational, kanye ne-post-translational)
question1: Kungani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-prokaryotes kulawulwa ngokuyinhloko ezingeni lokubhalwa?
answer1: Ngenxa yokuthi ukubhalwa nokuhumusha kwenzeka cishe ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngakho ukulawula ukubhalwa kulawula ngempumelelo ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni
question2: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle ukubhalwa nokuhumusha kumaseli e-prokaryotic?
answer2: Ukubhalwa nokuhumusha kwenzeka cishe ngesikhathi esisodwa ku-cytoplasm
distractor2c: Ukubhalwa kwenzeka ku-nucleus kanye nokuhumusha ku-cytoplasm
question3: Kungani ukuqoshwa nokuhumusha kuhlukaniswa ngokomzimba kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
answer3: Ngoba ukuqoshwa kwenzeka ku-nucleus, kuyilapho ukuhunyushwa kwenzeka ku-cytoplasm
question4: Kukuliphi izinga lapho ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa khona ngokuyinhloko kuma-prokaryotes?
answer4: Izinga lokuloba
question5: Yiliphi izinga lokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo elihilela ukukhulula i-DNA kuma-nucleosome ukuze izici zokubhala zikwazi ukubopha?
answer5: Izinga le-Epigenetic
question6: Yisiphi isigaba salokhu okulandelayo lapho ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic kungalawulwa khona?
answer6: Amazinga e-Epigenetic, transcriptional, post-transcriptional, translational, kanye namazinga angemuva kokuhumusha
distractor6b: Amazinga okuhumusha kanye namazinga angemva kokuhumusha kuphela
question7: I-DNA itholakala kuphi kumaseli e-prokaryotic?
answer7: Ku-cytoplasm
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-eukaryotes?
answer8: Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungalawulwa ngaphambi, ngesikhathi, nangemva kokubhalwa kanye nangemva kokuhumusha
distractor8a: Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
distractor8b: Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka kuphela ngemva kokuba amaprotheni enziwe
distractor8c: Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.1 Ukulawulwa Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuvela Kokulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.1 Ukulawulwa Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi zofuzo | Ukuvela Kokulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterContent:
Amaseli e-Prokaryotic angalawula kuphela ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokulawula inani lokubhalwa. Njengoba amaseli e-eukaryotic ethuthuka, ubunzima bokulawulwa kokuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo banda. Isibonelo, ngokuvela kwamaseli e-eukaryotic kwavela ukuhlukaniswa kwezingxenye ezibalulekile zamaseli kanye nezinqubo zamaseli. Kwakhiwa indawo yenuzi equkethe i-DNA. Ukubhalwa nokuhumusha kwahlukaniswa ngokomzimba kwaba izingxenye ezimbili ezahlukene zamaseli. Ngakho-ke kwaba nokwenzeka ukulawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokulawula ukubhalwa ku-nucleus, kanye nokulawula amazinga e-RNA kanye nokuhumusha kwamaprotheni okukhona ngaphandle kwe-nucleus.

 Ezinye izinqubo zamaseli zavela ngenxa yesidingo sezinto eziphilayo ukuzivikela. Izinqubo zamaseli ezifana nokuthulisa izakhi zofuzo zathuthuka ukuvikela iseli ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane noma ama-parasitic. Uma iseli lingavala ngokushesha ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo isikhathi esifushane, lizokwazi ukusinda ekuthelelekeni lapho ezinye izinto eziphilayo zingakwazi. Ngakho-ke, izinto eziphilayo zathuthukisa inqubo entsha eyasiza ukuthi zisinde, futhi zakwazi ukudlulisela lokhu kuthuthukiswa okusha enzalweni.

 I-Cytochrome c iyisici esibalulekile sochungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron, ingxenye yokuphefumula kwamaseli, futhi ngokuvamile itholakala ku-organelle yeselula, i-mitochondrion. Le phrotheni ineqembu le-heme prosthetic, kanti i-hemes central ion iyanciphisa futhi i-oxidize ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwama-electron. Ngenxa yokuthi indima yale phrotheni ebalulekile ekukhiqizeni amandla amaseli ibalulekile, ayishintshanga kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi. Ukulandelana kwamaphrotheni kukhombisile ukuthi kunenani elikhulu le-cytochrome c amino acid sequence homology phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene. Ngamanye amazwi, singahlola ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokulinganisa ukufana noma umehluko phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-DNA noma amaphrotheni.
I-Cytochrome c oxidase iyiphrotheni elondolozwe kakhulu etholakala kumabhaktheriya naku-mitochondria yama-eukaryotes.
question1: Ukuvela kwamaseli e-eukaryotic kwakwandisa kanjani ubunzima bokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ukuhlukanisa ukulotshwa nokuhunyushwa kwezingxenye, okuvumela ukulawulwa ngezigaba eziningi
question2: Iyiphi inzuzo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo eyanikezwa ukuthuthukiswa kokuthulisa izakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Kwasiza amangqamuzana ukuba asinde ekuthelelekeni ngamagciwane noma ngama-parasites ngokuvala okwesikhashana ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor2c: Kwavimbela ukubhalwa kwe-transcription ukuthi kungenzeki ku-nucleus
question3: Kungani i-cytochrome c ingasetshenziswa ukutadisha ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinhlobo?
answer3: Ukulandelana kwayo kwama-amino acid kuye kwahlala kulondolozwe kakhulu phakathi nesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo
distractor3c: Ukulandelana kwayo kwe-DNA kuyafana kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-cytochrome c?
answer4: Idlulisela ama-electron kuchungechunge lokuthuthwa kwama-electron ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli
question5: Kungani i-cytochrome c ishintshe kancane kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi?
answer5: Indima yayo ebalulekile ekukhiqizweni kwamandla eseli ibeka ingcindezi enkulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo ekugcineni umsebenzi wayo
question6: I-cytochrome c oxidase ichazwa kangcono ngokuthi yiluphi uhlobo lweprotheni?
answer6: Iphrotheni elondolozwe kakhulu etholakala kumabhaktheriya naku-mitochondria yama-eukaryotes
question7: Ngokusekelwe olwazini lwakho ngobudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo, yiziphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo ongalindela ukuthi zibe yiqiniso ngokulandelana kwamaprotheni e-cytochrome c oxidase?
answer7: Iphrotheni yemvubelo izofana kakhulu nephrotheni yomuntu kunephrotheni yebhaktheriya
distractor7a: Iphrotheni yebhaktheriya izofana kakhulu nephrotheni yomuntu kunephrotheni yemvubelo
distractor7b: Iphrotheni yebhaktheriya izofana kakhulu nephrotheni yemvubelo kunephrotheni yomuntu
distractor7c: Amaprotheni ebhaktheriya kanye nemvubelo azokwabelana ngokulandelana okufanayo, kodwa amaprotheni abantu ngeke ahlobene

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli e-prokaryotic kwenzeka ezingeni lokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Kalula nje, uma iseli lingawuguquli umlayezo we-DNA ku-mRNA, ukuhumusha (ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni), akwenzeki. Izakhi zofuzo zama-bacteria zivame ukuhleleka ngezindlela noma izinqubo ezivamile ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-operon ukuze kulawulwe ukuvezwa okuhlelekile. Isibonelo, ku-E. coli, izakhi zofuzo ezibangela ukwakheka kwe-lactose zitholakala ndawonye ku-chromosome yamabhaktheriya. (Imodeli ye-operon ifaka izingxenye eziningana, ngakho-ke lapho ufunda ukuthi i-operon isebenza kanjani, kuyasiza ukubhekisela kumdwebo wemodeli. Bheka uMfanekiso 16.3 kanye noMfanekiso 16.4.) I-operon ifaka i-gene elawulayo ekhoda iphrotheni ecindezelayo ebopha kumqhubi, okuvimbela i-RNA polymerase ekubhaleni izakhi zofuzo ezithakaselwayo. Isibonelo salokhu sibonakala kuzakhi zofuzo ze-lactose metabolism. Kodwa-ke, uma i-repressor ingasebenzi, i-RNA polymerase ibopha ku-promoter, futhi ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo zesakhiwo kwenzeka.

 Kunezindlela ezintathu zokulawula ukuqoshwa kwe-operon: ukulawula okungabonakali, ukulawula okucindezelwayo, kanye nokulawula okusebenzayo. I-lac operon iyisibonelo sokulawula okungaguquki ngoba ukuba khona kwe-lactose kuvula "ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze kusebenze umzimba wazo. I-trp operon iyisibonelo sokulawula okucindezelwayo ngoba isebenzisa amaprotheni aboshwe kuchungechunge lwe-opharetha ukuvimbela ngokomzimba ukubopha kwe-RNA polymerase. Uma iseli lingadingi i-tryptophan, izakhi zofuzo ezidingekayo ukuze ziyikhiqize ziyavalwa. Ukulawulwa kwe-Activator (okufanekiswa yisenzo se-Catabolite Activator Protein) kwandisa ikhono lokubopha le-RNA polymerase kumgqugquzeli. Izakhi zofuzo ezithile ziqhubeka zivezwa ngale ndlela yokulawula.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.B
Ukuvezwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuhilela izindlela zamaseli nama-molecule.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.B.1 Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphumela ekuvezweni kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile, okuholela ekukhetheni amaseli

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.21 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo ukuchaza ukuthi ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuthinta kanjani imikhiqizo nomsebenzi weseli.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.B.2 Izinhlobonhlobo zokudluliselwa kwesignali phakathi kwamaseli nangaphakathi kwamaseli zilawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo.
Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.
Inhloso Yokufunda
3.23 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo ukuchaza izindlela zokulawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 I-DNA yama-prokaryotes ihlelwe yaba yi-chromosome eyindilinga ehlanganiswe endaweni ye-nucleoid ye-cytoplasm yeseli. Amaprotheni adingekayo emsebenzini othize, noma ahilelekile endleleni efanayo ye-biochemical, ahlanganiswa ndawonye ngamabhulokhi abizwa ngokuthi ama-operon. Isibonelo, wonke ama-gene adingekayo ukusebenzisa i-lactose njengomthombo wamandla afakwe ikhodi eduze komunye nomunye ku-lactose (noma i-lac) operon.

 Kumaseli e-prokaryotic, kunezinhlobo ezintathu zama-molecule alawulayo angathinta ukubonakaliswa kwama-operon: ama-repressors, ama-activator, kanye nama-inducers. Ama-repressors amaphrotheni acindezela ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ekuphenduleni isikhuthazo sangaphandle, kanti ama-activator amaphrotheni akhulisa ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ekuphenduleni isikhuthazo sangaphandle. Okokugcina, ama-inducer ama-molecule amancane avuselela noma acindezela ukubhalwa kuye ngezidingo zeseli kanye nokutholakala kwe-substrate
question1: Kukuliphi izinga lapho ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa khona kakhulu kumaseli e-prokaryotic?
answer1: Ukubhalwa phansi
question2: Kuyini i-operon?
answer2: Iqembu lezakhi zofuzo ezihlelwe ndawonye ezihilelekile emsebenzini ofanayo noma endleleni efanayo yamakhemikhali futhi zilawulwa ndawonye
distractor2a: Umgqugquzeli oyedwa olawula i-gene eyodwa engahlobene
distractor2b: Iqoqo lezakhi zofuzo ze-ribosomal RNA kuphela
distractor2c: Iphrotheni ebopha i-DNA ukuze iqalise ukuphindaphinda
question3: Iyini indima yeprotheyini yokucindezela ku-operon?
answer3: Ibopha opharetha futhi ivimbele i-RNA polymerase ekubhaleni izakhi zofuzo zesakhiwo
distractor3c: Isusa i-RNA polymerase ngemva kokuba ukuqoshwa sekuqediwe
question4: Yimuphi u-operon oyisibonelo sokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okungaguquki?
answer4: I-lac operon
question5: Ilawulwa kanjani i-lac operon?
answer5: Ukuba khona kwe-lactose kuvula ukuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ekugayweni kwe-lactose
distractor5a: Ukuba khona kwe-lactose kuvimbela unomphela ukubhalwa kwe-transcription
distractor5b: I-Lactose ibopha ngqo i-RNA polymerase futhi ivimbele ukuqoshwa kwayo
distractor5c: I-Lactose ibangela ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zesakhiwo zisuswe
question6: Yimuphi u-operon oyisibonelo sokulawula okucindezelwayo?
answer6: I-trp operon
question7: Uyini umsebenzi wokulawula i-activator kuma-prokaryotes?
answer7: Kwandisa ikhono le-RNA polymerase lokubopha i-promoter nokuqala ukubhalwa kwe-transcription
distractor7a: Ivimba i-RNA polymerase ukuthi ingafiki kuphromotha
question8: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezintathu zama-molecule alawulayo alawula ukubonakaliswa kwe-operon kumaseli e-prokaryotic?
answer8: Izicindezeli, iziqalisi, kanye nezikhuthazi

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | I-trp Operon: I-Repressor Operon
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | I-trp Operon: I-Repressor Operon
chapterContent:
Amabhaktheriya afana ne-E. coli adinga ama-amino acid ukuze asinde. I-Tryptophan ingenye yama-amino acid i-E. coli engayigwinya endaweni ezungezile. I-E. coli ingakhiqiza i-tryptophan isebenzisa ama-enzyme afakwe ama-gene amahlanu. Lawa ma-gene amahlanu aseduze komunye nomunye kulokho okubizwa ngokuthi i-tryptophan (trp) operon (Isithombe 16.3). Uma i-tryptophan ikhona endaweni ezungezile, khona-ke i-E. coli ayidingi ukuyihlanganisa futhi i-switch elawula ukusebenza kwama-gene ku-trp operon iyacinywa. Kodwa-ke, lapho ukutholakala kwe-tryptophan kuphansi, i-switch elawula i-operon iyavulwa, i-transcription iyaqalwa, ama-gene ayavezwa, bese i-tryptophan iyakhiwa.

 Uchungechunge lwe-DNA olubhala ama-protein lubizwa ngokuthi i-coding region. Izifunda ezinhlanu zokubhala ama-enzyme e-tryptophan biosynthesis zihlelwe ngokulandelana ku-chromosome ku-operon. Ngaphambi nje kwesifunda sokubhala ama-code kuyindawo yokuqala yokubhala ama-transcription. Lesi yisifunda se-DNA lapho i-RNA polymerase ibopha khona ukuze kuqalwe ukubhalwa. Uchungechunge lwe-promoter luphezulu kwendawo yokuqala yokubhalwa; i-operon ngayinye inochungechunge ngaphakathi noma eduze kwe-promoter lapho amaprotheni (ama-activators noma ama-repressors) angabopha futhi alawule ukubhalwa.

 Uchungechunge lwe-DNA olubizwa ngokuthi uchungechunge lwe-opharetha lufakwe ikhodi phakathi kwesifunda se-promoter kanye ne-gene yokuqala yokubhala ikhodi ye-trp. Lo msebenzi uqukethe ikhodi ye-DNA lapho iprotheyini ye-repressor ingabopha khona. Uma i-tryptophan ikhona esitokisini, ama-molecule amabili e-tryptophan abopha ku-trp repressor, eshintsha isimo ukuze ibopha ku-opharetha we-trp. Ukubopha i-tryptophan-repressor complex ku-opharetha kuvimbela ngokomzimba i-RNA polymerase ekubopheni, futhi kubhale ama-gene angezansi.

 Uma i-tryptophan ingekho esitokisini, i-repressor ngokwayo ayibopha ku-opharetha; ngakho-ke, i-operon iyasebenza futhi i-tryptophan iyakhiwa. Ngenxa yokuthi iphrotheni yokucindezela ibopha ngenkuthalo kumqhubi ukuze kugcinwe izakhi zofuzo zivaliwe, i-trp operon ilawulwa kabi futhi amaprotheni abopha kumqhubi ukuze kuthuliswe ukubonakaliswa kwe-trp angabalawuli ababi.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-trp operon ku-E. coli?
answer1: Ilawula ukwakheka kwe-tryptophan lapho i-tryptophan yemvelo ingekho
question2: I-trp operon ivulwa nini?
question3: Kungani i-E. coli ivala i-trp operon uma i-tryptophan iningi?
answer3: Ngoba ingathola i-tryptophan endaweni ezungezile futhi ayidingi ukuyihlanganisa
question4: Uyini umsebenzi wochungechunge lwe-opharetha ku-trp operon?
answer4: Kuwuchungechunge lwe-DNA lapho iphrotheni yokucindezela ibopha khona ukulawula ukuqoshwa
distractor4a: Yilapho ama-ribosome ebopha khona ukuqala ukuhumusha
question5: Kwenzekani lapho ama-molecule amabili e-tryptophan ebopha ku-trp repressor?
answer5: I-repressor ishintsha isimo futhi ibophe umqhubi, ivimbele ukulotshwa
question6: Kungani i-trp operon ichazwa njengelawulwa kabi?
answer6: Ngoba iphrotheni yokucindezela ibopha umqhubi ukuze avale ukulotshwa
distractor6a: Ngoba iphrotheni evuselelayo ivimba unomphela ukuqoshwa
distractor6c: Ngoba ukuhumusha kwenzeka ngaphambi kokubhalwa phansi
question7: Kwenzekani uma i-tryptophan ingekho esitokisini?
answer7: I-repressor ayikwazi ukubopha umqhubi, ngakho-ke ukuqoshwa kwe-trp operon kuyaqhubeka
question8: Yikuphi ukulandelana okukhona phakathi kwe-promoter kanye ne-gene yokuqala yesakhiwo se-trp operon?
answer8: Uchungechunge lwe-opharetha

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | Iphrotheni Yokwenza I-Catabolite (i-CAP): Umlawuli Wokwenza I-Activator
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | Iphrotheni Yokwenza I-Catabolite (i-CAP): Umlawuli Wokwenza I-Activator
chapterContent: Njengoba nje i-trp operon ilawulwa kabi ngama-molecule e-tryptophan, kunezinhlobo zamaprotheni ezibopha ku-opharetha ezisebenza njengomlawuli omuhle ukuvula izakhi zofuzo futhi zizenze zisebenze. Isibonelo, lapho i-glucose ingekho, amabhaktheriya e-E. coli angaphendukela kweminye imithombo kashukela ukuze abe uphethiloli. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, izakhi zofuzo ezintsha zokucubungula la ma-gene ahlukile kumele zibhalwe phansi. Lapho amazinga kashukela ehla, i-cyclic AMP (cAMP) iqala ukuqongelela esitokisini. I-molecule ye-cAMP iyi-molecule ekhombisayo ehilelekile ku-glucose kanye ne-metabolism yamandla ku-E. coli. Lapho amazinga kashukela ehla esitokisini, i-cAMP eqongelela ibopha ku-positive regulator catabolite activator protein (CAP), iphrotheni ebopha kubagqugquzeli bama-operon alawula ukucutshungulwa koshukela ohlukile. Lapho i-cAMP ibopha ku-CAP, i-complex ibopha esifundeni se-promoter sezakhi zofuzo ezidingekayo ukusebenzisa ezinye izinhlobo zikashukela (Isithombe 16.4). Kula ma-operon, indawo yokubopha i-CAP itholakala phezulu kwendawo yokubopha i-RNA polymerase ku-promoter. Lokhu kwandisa ikhono lokubopha le-RNA polymerase esifundeni se-promoter kanye nokuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yeprotheyini ye-catabolite activator (CAP) ku-E. coli?
answer1: Ivuselela ukuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezidingekayo ukuze kugaywe ushukela oluhlukile lapho i-glucose ingekho
question2: Kwenzekani emazingeni e-cAMP uma i-glucose iba yindlala?
question3: Yimuphi umolekyuli obopha ngqo ku-CAP ukuze usebenze?
answer3: I-cAMP
question4: Iyini imiphumela yokubopha kwe-CAP-cAMP complex kwi-DNA?
answer4: Kwandisa ukubopha kwe-RNA polymerase kumkhuthazi futhi kuthuthukisa ukuqoshwa
question5: Ikuphi indawo yokubopha i-CAP ngokuvamile etholakala kuyo?
answer5: Ngaphezulu kwendawo yokubopha i-RNA polymerase ku-promoter
question6: I-CAP iyisibonelo saluphi uhlobo lomlawuli wezakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Umlawuli omuhle
question7: Kungani i-E. coli ivuselela izakhi zofuzo ukuze kusetshenziswe okunye ukudla okushukela lapho i-glucose iphansi?
answer7: Ukusebenzisa amanye ushukela njengemithombo yamandla uma i-glucose ingatholakali
question8: Yisiphi isimo esiholela ekusebenzeni okukhulu kwama-operon alawulwa yi-CAP?
answer8: Amazinga aphansi kashukela aholela ekugxilweni okuphezulu kwe-cAMP
distractor8a: Amazinga aphezulu e-glucose kanye nokuhlushwa okuphansi kwe-cAMP

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | I-lac Operon: I-Inducer Operon
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Prokaryotic | I-lac Operon: I-Inducer Operon
chapterContent:
Uhlobo lwesithathu lokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli e-prokaryotic lwenzeka ngama-operon angena emzimbeni, anamaprotheni abopha ukuze asebenze noma acindezele ukubhalwa kuye ngendawo yasendaweni kanye nezidingo zeseli. I-lac operon iyi-operon ejwayelekile engena emzimbeni. Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, i-E. coli iyakwazi ukusebenzisa amanye ushukela njengemithombo yamandla lapho amazinga e-glucose ephansi. Ukuze wenze kanjalo, i-cAMP-CAP protein complex isebenza njengomlawuli omuhle wokukhuthaza ukubhalwa. Omunye umthombo onjalo kashukela yi-lactose. I-lac operon ifaka izakhi zofuzo ezidingekayo ukuze kutholakale futhi kucutshungulwe i-lactose endaweni yasendaweni. I-CAP ibopha kuchungechunge lwe-operator oluphezulu kwe-promoter eqala ukubhalwa kwe-lac operon. Kodwa-ke, ukuze i-lac operon isebenze, kumele kuhlangatshezwane nezimo ezimbili. Okokuqala, izinga le-glucose kumele libe liphansi kakhulu noma lingabi khona. Okwesibili, i-lactose kumele ibe khona. Kuphela lapho i-glucose ingekho futhi i-lactose ikhona lapho i-lac operon izobhalwa khona (Isithombe 16.5). Lokhu kunengqondo ngeseli, ngoba kungaba ukuchitha amandla ukudala amaprotheni ukucubungula i-lactose uma i-glucose yayiningi noma i-lactose yayingekho.

 Uma i-glucose ingekho, khona-ke i-CAP ingabopha kuchungechunge lwe-opharetha ukuze isebenze i-transcription. Uma i-lactose ingekho, i-repressor ibopha ku-opharetha ukuvimbela i-transcription. Uma noma iyiphi yalezi zidingo ihlangatshezwa, i-transcription ihlala ingasebenzi. Kuphela uma izimo zombili zaneliswa lapho i-lac operon ibhalwa khona (ithebula elingezansi).

question1: Uhlobo luni lwe-operon oluyi-lac operon?
answer1: I-operon engabonakali
question2: Yiliphi i-molecule elisebenza njengomlawuli omuhle we-lac operon lapho amazinga kashukela ephansi?
question3: Yiziphi izimo ezimbili ezidingekayo ukuze kubhalwe phansi i-lac operon kakhulu?
answer3: I-glucose kumele ingabi khona futhi i-lactose kumele ibe khona
distractor3a: I-glucose ne-lactose kumele kube khona kokubili
distractor3b: I-glucose kumele ingabi khona futhi i-tryptophan kumele ibe khona
distractor3c: I-glucose kumele ibe khona kanti i-lactose kumele ingabi khona
question4: Kwenzekani uma i-lactose ingekho?
answer4: I-lac repressor ibopha i-opharetha futhi ivimbele ukulotshwa
distractor4a: I-CAP ibopha futhi isebenzise ngokugcwele ukulotshwa
question5: Uyini umphumela we-glucose eningi ku-lac operon?
answer5: I-cAMP ephansi ivimbela ukusebenza kwe-CAP, inciphisa ukulotshwa
question6: Kungani i-lac operon ibhekwa njengeyonga amandla?
answer6: Ikhiqiza ama-enzyme aguqula i-lactose kuphela uma i-lactose itholakala futhi i-glucose ingekho.
distractor6a: Kuhlala kuvezwa kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izakhamzimba zitholakala kuphi
question7: Uma i-glucose ingekho kodwa i-lactose nayo ingekho, kwenzekani ku-lac operon?
answer7: Ukubhala kuvaliwe ngoba i-repressor ibopha umqhubi
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.5. Ku-E. coli, i-trp operon ivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, kuyilapho i-lac operon ivaliwe. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani kunjalo?
answer8: I-trp operon ikhiqiza i-tryptophan ebalulekile esitokisini ngakho-ke ihlala ivuliwe, kanti i-lac operon ikhiqiza ama-enzyme okubhidliza ushukela ongatholakali njalo futhi ohlala uvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
distractor8a: I-trp operon iyavuleka futhi ilawulwa kahle. Ngakho-ke ivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo kanti i-lac operon iyacindezelwa futhi ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
distractor8b: I-trp operon iyinto eyakhiwe futhi ihlala ivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, kanti i-lac operon iyacindezelwa ngakho-ke ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
distractor8c: I-lac operon incishiswa ukuqoshwa kwe-transcription ngakho-ke IVALIWE ngokuzenzakalelayo, kanti i-trp operon ayilawulwa yinoma iyiphi indlela enjalo futhi IVALIWE ngokuzenzakalelayo.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Epigenetic ze-Eukaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Epigenetic ze-Eukaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Esinye sezizathu ezenza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic kube nzima kakhulu kunokuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-prokaryotic ukuthi izinqubo zokubhalwa nokuhumusha zihlukaniswe ngokomzimba ngaphakathi kweseli le-eukaryotic. Amaseli e-eukaryotic nawo ahlanganisa ama-genome awo ngendlela eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namaseli e-prokaryotic. Ngenxa yalokho, amaseli e-eukaryotic angalawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo emazingeni amaningi, kuqala ngokulawula ukufinyelela ku-DNA. Ngenxa yokuthi i-DNA ye-genomic igoqwe eduze kwamaprotheni e-histone ukuze kudalwe ama-nucleosome complexes, ama-nucleosome alawula ngokomzimba ukufinyelela kwamaprotheni, njengezinto zokubhalwa kanye nama-enzyme, ku-DNA engaphansi. I-Methylation ye-DNA nama-histone ibangela ama-nucleosome ukuthi ahlangane ndawonye, kuvimbele izinto zokubhalwa ukuthi zingabosheli ku-DNA. Ama-nucleosome e-methylated aqukethe i-DNA engavezwa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-histone acetylation iphumela ekupakishweni okuxekethile kwama-nucleosome, okuvumela izinto zokubhalwa ukuthi ziboshele ku-DNA. Ama-nucleosome e-acetylated aqukethe i-DNA engase ivezwe.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.B
Ukuvezwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuhilela izindlela zamaseli nama-molecule.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.B.1 Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphumela ekuvezweni kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile, okuholela ekukhetheni amaseli.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi

Inhloso Yokufunda
3.19 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuxhumana phakathi kokulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nomehluko obonwe phakathi kwabantu ngabanye emphakathini
question1: Ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic kuqala ngaliphi izinga?
answer1: Ngokulawula ukufinyelela ku-DNA ngesakhiwo se-chromatin (umthethonqubo we-epigenetic)
question2: Kungani ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuvamile kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kuma-eukaryotes kunakuma-prokaryotes?
answer2: Ngoba ukuqoshwa nokuhumusha kuyahlukaniswa futhi i-DNA ifakwa ku-chromatin, okuvumela ukulawulwa emazingeni amaningi
distractor2a: Ngoba ama-eukaryotes ane-RNA polymerase eyodwa kuphela
distractor2c: Ngoba ama-prokaryotes ahlanganisa i-DNA eduze kwama-histones
question3: Ama-nucleosome athonya kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Zilawula ukufinyeleleka kwe-DNA ezintweni ezibhaliwe kanye namanye amaprotheni
question4: Uyini umphumela we-DNA kanye ne-histone methylation ku-chromatin?
answer4: Kubangela ukuthi ama-nucleosome ahlangane ndawonye, kunciphisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Uyini umphumela we-histone acetylation?
answer5: Ikhulula i-chromatin, ivumela izici zokubhala ukuthi zibophe futhi izakhi zofuzo zivezwe
question6: Kungani ama-nucleosome ane-methylated ngokuvamile engasebenzi ekubhalweni?
answer6: Ngoba i-chromatin ehlanganiswe kahle ivimbela izinto zokubhala ukuthi zingafinyeleli ku-DNA
distractor6b: Ngoba i-RNA polymerase ayikwazi ukubona i-mRNA
question7: Yini echaza kangcono i-epigenetics?
answer7: Izinguquko ezizuzwa njengefa ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezenzeka ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide ye-DNA
distractor7a: Izinguquko ezihlala njalo ezishintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor7b: Izinguquko ekulandeleni kwama-amino acid ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
question8: Amaseli amabili ane-DNA efanayo angenza kanjani imisebenzi ehlukene?
answer8: Izakhi zofuzo ezahlukene ziyavulwa noma zivaliwe ngokulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo, kufaka phakathi izindlela ze-epigenetic
distractor8c: Iseli ngalinye lisebenzisa ikhodi ehlukile yezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ze-Epigenetic Ze-Eukaryotic | Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ze-Epigenetic: Ukulawula Ukufinyelela Kuzakhi Zofuzo Ngaphakathi Kwe-Chromosome
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ze-Epigenetic Ze-Eukaryotic | Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ze-Epigenetic: Ukulawula Ukufinyelela Kuzakhi Zofuzo Ngaphakathi Kwe-Chromosome
chapterContent:
Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, esinye sezizathu ezenza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic kube nzima kakhulu kunokuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-prokaryotic ukuthi izinqubo zokubhalwa nokuhumusha zihlukaniswe ngokomzimba. Ngokungafani namaseli e-prokaryotic, amaseli e-eukaryotic angalawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo emazingeni amaningi ahlukene. Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic kuqala ngokulawula ukufinyelela ku-DNA. Lolu hlobo lokulawula, olubizwa ngokuthi ukulawulwa kwe-epigenetic, lwenzeka ngisho nangaphambi kokuba kuqalwe ukubhalwa.

 I-genome yomuntu ifaka izakhi zofuzo ezingaphezu kuka-20,000; ngalinye lama-pair angu-23 ama-chromosome omuntu lifaka izinkulungwane zama-gene. I-DNA ese-nucleus iboshwe kahle, igoqwe, futhi ihlanganiswe kuma-chromosome ukuze ilingane ne-nucleus. Ihlelwe futhi ukuze izingxenye ezithile zifinyelelwe njengoba kudingeka uhlobo oluthile lweseli.

 Izinga lokuqala lokuhlela, noma ukupakisha, ukugoqana kwezintambo ze-DNA ezizungeze amaprotheni e-histone. Ama-Histones apakisha futhi ahlele i-DNA ibe amayunithi esakhiwo abizwa ngokuthi ama-nucleosome complexes, angalawula ukufinyelela kwamaprotheni ezindaweni ze-DNA (Isithombe 16.6a). Ngaphansi kwe-microscope ye-electron, lokhu kugoqana kwe-DNA ezungeze amaprotheni e-histone ukuze kwakheke ama-nucleosomes kubukeka njengama-beads amancane entanjeni (Isithombe 16.6b). La ma-beads (amaprotheni e-histone) angahamba ngentambo (i-DNA) futhi ashintshe isakhiwo se-molecule.

 Uma i-DNA ebhala i-gene ethile izobhalwa ibe yi-RNA, ama-nucleosomes azungeze leso sifunda se-DNA angashelela phansi kwi-DNA ukuze avule leso sifunda esithile se-chromosome futhi avumele imishini yokubhala (i-RNA polymerase) ukuthi iqale ukubhala (Isithombe 16.7). Ama-nucleosomes angahamba ukuze avule isakhiwo se-chromosome ukuze adalule ingxenye ye-DNA, kodwa akwenze ngendlela elawulwa kakhulu.

 Indlela amaprotheni e-histone ahamba ngayo incike ezimpawini ezitholakala kokubili kumaphrotheni e-histone kanye naku-DNA. La ma-signals angamathegi afakwe kumaphrotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA atshela ama-histone ukuthi isifunda se-chromosome kufanele sivuleke noma sivalwe (Isithombe 16.8 sibonisa ukuguqulwa kwamaphrotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA). Lawa mathegi awahlali unomphela, kodwa angangezwa noma asuswe uma kudingeka. Angukuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali (amaqembu e-phosphate, i-methyl, noma i-acetyl) anamathele kuma-amino acid athile kuphrotheni noma kuma-nucleotide e-DNA. Amathegi awashintshi ukulandelana kwesisekelo se-DNA, kodwa ashintsha ukuthi i-DNA iboshwe kanjani eduze kwamaprotheni e-histone. I-DNA iyi-molecule eshajeke kabi; ngakho-ke, izinguquko ekushajeni kwe-histone zizoshintsha ukuthi i-molecule ye-DNA izoboshwa kanjani ngokuqinile. Uma ingashintshiwe, amaprotheni e-histone aneshaja enkulu enhle; ngokungeza ukuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali njengamaqembu e-acetyl, ishaja iba yincane kakhulu.

 I-molecule ye-DNA ngokwayo ingashintshwa futhi. Lokhu kwenzeka ezifundeni ezithile ezibizwa ngokuthi iziqhingi ze-CpG. Lezi zilula ezinemvamisa ephezulu yama-DNA pairs (CG) e-cytosine ne-guanine dinucleotide atholakala ezifundeni ze-promoter zezakhi zofuzo. Uma lokhu kulungiselelwa kukhona, ilungu le-cytosine lalo mbhangqwana lingaxutshwa (iqembu le-methyl liyangezwa). Lokhu kuguqulwa kushintsha indlela i-DNA esebenzisana ngayo namaprotheni, okuhlanganisa namaprotheni e-histone alawula ukufinyelela esifundeni. Izindawo ze-DNA ezine-methyl (hypermethylated) eziningi ezinama-histone angena-acetyl zigoqekile futhi azisebenzi ekubhalweni.

 Lolu hlobo lokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo lubizwa ngokuthi ukulawulwa kwe-epigenetic. I-Epigenetic isho okuzungeze izakhi zofuzo. Izinguquko ezenzeka kumaprotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA azishintshi ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide futhi azihlali njalo. Esikhundleni salokho, lezi zinguquko zingezesikhashana (yize zivame ukuqhubeka ngezigaba eziningi zokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli) futhi zishintsha isakhiwo se-chromosome (esivulekile noma esivaliwe) njengoba kudingeka. I-gene ingavulwa noma ivalwe kuye ngendawo kanye nokuguqulwa kwamaprotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA. Uma i-gene izobhalwa, amaprotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA kuyaguqulwa kuzungeze isifunda se-chromosome okufaka ikhodi kuleyo gene. Lokhu kuvula isifunda se-chromosome ukuvumela ukufinyelela kwe-RNA polymerase kanye namanye amaprotheni, abizwa ngokuthi izici zokubhala, ukubopha esifundeni sokukhuthaza, esitholakala phezulu nje kwe-gene, bese kuqalisa ukubhala. Uma i-gene izohlala ivaliwe, noma ithulisiwe, amaprotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA anokuguqulwa okuhlukile okubonisa ukucushwa kwe-chromosome okuvaliwe. Kulokhu kulungiswa okuvaliwe, i-RNA polymerase kanye nezici zokubhala azikwazi ukufinyelela i-DNA futhi ukubhala akukwazi ukwenzeka (Isithombe 16.7)
question1: Kuyini ukulawulwa kwe-epigenetic?
answer1: Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokushintsha isakhiwo se-chromatin ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide ye-DNA
question2: Iyini izinga lokuqala lokuhleleka kwe-DNA kuma-chromosome e-eukaryotic?
answer2: I-DNA izungezwe amaprotheni e-histone ukuze yakhe ama-nucleosome
question3: Ama-nucleosome angakulawula kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Zishelela eceleni kwe-DNA ukuze ziveze noma zifihle izakhi zofuzo emshinini wokubhala
question4: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali okuvamile ukukhulula i-chromatin futhi kukhuthaze ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: I-acetylation ye-Histone
question5: Ziyini iziqhingi ze-CpG?
answer5: Izindawo ze-DNA ezicebile ngama-dinucleotide e-CG avame ukutholakala ezindaweni ezikhuthaza izakhi zofuzo
question6: Iyini imiphumela ye-hypermethylation ye-DNA ehlanganiswe ne-histone deacetylation?
answer6: I-Chromatin iqina kakhulu futhi ayisebenzi ekubhalweni kwayo
distractor6a: I-Chromatin iyavuleka futhi ukuqoshwa kwayo kuyanda
question7: Kungani i-histone acetylation inciphisa ukubopha kwe-DNA-histone?
answer7: Kunciphisa ukushaja okuhle kwama-histone, kwenze buthaka ukusebenzisana kwawo ne-DNA ekhokhiswe kabi
question8: Kungani ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic kubhekwa njengokuguqulwayo?
answer8: Amathegi amakhemikhali angangezwa noma asuswe ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA
question9: Kungani i-RNA polymerase ingakwazi ukuqala ukubhalwa kwe-chromatin ehlanganiswe kahle?
answer9: I-DNA ayifinyeleleki ngoba ama-nucleosome avimba ukufinyelela kwabagqugquzeli
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.7. I-chromosome X inkulu kakhulu uma iqhathaniswa ne-chromosome Y. Ukuveza womabili amakhophi amaningi ala ma-gene kungadala izinkinga zokukhula. Le nselele inqotshwa kanjani ezincelisayo zesifazane?
answer10: I-Methylation ye-DNA kanye ne-hypo-acetylation yama-histones kubangela ukuthi ama-nucleosome ahlangane ndawonye, okwenza ukuthi enye yama-chromosomes e-X ingasasebenzi ngokungahleliwe kuseli ngalinye.
distractor10a: I-Methylation ye-DNA kanye ne-hypo-acetylation yama-histones kubangela ukuthi ama-nucleosome ahlangane ndawonye, okwenza ingxenye ephezulu ye-chromosome kababa kanye nengxenye engezansi ye-chromosome kamama ingasebenzi.
distractor10b: I-acetylation ye-DNA kanye ne-hyper-methylation yama-histones kubangela ukuthi ama-nucleosome akhululeke, okwenza enye yama-chromosomes e-X ingasebenzi ngokungahleliwe kuseli ngalinye.
distractor10c: I-acetylation ye-DNA kanye ne-hyper-methylation yama-histones kubangela ukuthi ama-nucleosome akhululeke, okwenza i-chromosome kababa kuphela isebenze.

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.4 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezibhalwe Nge-Eukaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukuze uqale ukubhala ngokuzenzakalelayo, izici zokubhala ngokuzenzakalelayo kumele ziqale zibophe endaweni ethile ku-DNA ebizwa ngokuthi ibhokisi le-TATA bese ziqoqa i-RNA polymerase kuleyo ndawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izindawo ku-DNA ezibizwa ngokuthi izifunda zokuthuthukisa zisiza ekwandiseni ukubhala ngokuzenzakalelayo. Izici zokubhala ngokuzenzakalelayo zingabopha ezindaweni zokuthuthukisa ukwandisa noma ukuvimbela ukubhala ngokuzenzakalelayo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo ezigqanyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Zebhayoloji lwe-AP®. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.B
Ukuvezwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuhilela izindlela zamaseli nama-molecule.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[I-APLO 3.18]

 Njengamaseli e-prokaryotic, ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-eukaryotes kudinga izenzo ze-RNA polymerase ukuze zibophe kuchungechunge oluphezulu lwezakhi zofuzo ukuze kuqalwe ukubhalwa. Kodwa-ke, ngokungafani namaseli e-prokaryotic, i-eukaryotic RNA polymerase idinga amanye amaprotheni, noma izici zokubhalwa, ukuze kube lula ukuqala ukubhalwa. Izici zokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngamaprotheni abopha kuchungechunge lwe-promoter kanye nezinye izilandelaniso zokulawula ukulawula ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo eziqondiwe. I-RNA polymerase ngokwayo ayikwazi ukuqala ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli e-eukaryotic. Izici zokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kumele zibophe endaweni ye-promoter kuqala bese ziqoqa i-RNA polymerase endaweni ukuze kusungulwe ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Umsebenzi wezinto zokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ungalawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile kumaseli, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemikhiqizo nemisebenzi yamaseli ahlukene. Isibonelo, ososayensi bathole ukuthi izici zobulili eziyinhloko zilawulwa izakhi zofuzo eziningana Umfanekiso 16.9. Ku-fruit fly Drosophila, isakhi sofuzo se-slx sinquma ubulili. Lesi sakhi sofuzo sivezwa lapho isidalwa sinamakhophi amabili e-chromosome ye-X. Umkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo we-slx ubopha i-mRNA ye-tra gene futhi ulawula ukuhlangana kwayo. Uma kukhona i-slx, i-tra ihlanganiswa ibe yifomu layo lowesifazane futhi ithonya ukuvezwa kwe-dsx ne-fru ukuze kuholele ezicini zobulili zowesifazane. Uma ingekho i-slx, i-tra ihlanganiswa ibe yifomu layo lowesilisa futhi umphumela waba izici zobulili zowesilisa
question1: Kungani i-RNA polymerase ingakwazi ukuqala ukubhalwa kwayo ngokwayo kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
answer1: Ngoba izici zokubhala kumele ziqale zibophe umgqugquzeli futhi ziqashe i-RNA polymerase
distractor1a: Ngoba i-RNA polymerase kumele iqale ibophe ama-ribosome
distractor1c: Ngoba i-RNA polymerase isebenza kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
question2: Yikuphi ukulandelana kwe-DNA okuhlanganisa izinto ezijwayelekile zokubhala phansi ngesikhathi sokuqala kokubhala phansi?
question3: Iyini indima eyinhloko yezifunda ezithuthukisayo?
answer3: Zibopha izinto zokubhala ezikhulisa noma zinciphisa ukubhalwa
question4: Uyini umsebenzi wezinto zokubhala kuma-eukaryotes?
answer4: Babopha ukulandelana kwe-DNA okulawulayo futhi baqashe i-RNA polymerase ukuze baqalise ukubhalwa kwe-transcription
question5: Kungani izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli zingaveza amasethi ahlukene ezakhi zofuzo naphezu kokuba ne-DNA efanayo?
answer5: Izici ezahlukene zokubhala zilawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezahlukene ohlotsheni ngalunye lweseli
distractor5a: Iseli ngalinye liqukethe ukulandelana kwe-DNA okuhlukile
distractor5b: Amaseli e-stem kuphela aqukethe izinto zokubhala
distractor5c: Amaseli ahlukene asebenzisa amakhodi ahlukene ezakhi zofuzo
question6: Iyiphi inqubo elawulwa ngqo yizici zokubhala?
answer6: Ukuqala kokubhalwa kombhalo
question7: Izici zokubhala eziboshelwe ekuthuthukisweni zithinta kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ziyandisa noma zivimbele izinga lokuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo eziqondiwe
question8: Ku-Drosophila, yini enquma ukuthi i-tra gene ihlanganiswe nesimo sayo sowesifazane?
answer8: Ukuvezwa kwe-sexlethal (slx) gene
question9: Iyini imiphumela yokubonakaliswa kwe-slx ku-Drosophila?
answer9: I-tra gene ihlanganiswa ibe yisimo sayo sowesifazane, okuholela ekukhuleni kowesifazane
distractor9c: Izakhi zofuzo ze-dsx ne-fru zithuliswa unomphela
question10: Izici zokubhala zingaba kanjani negalelo ekukhetheni amaseli?
answer10: Zilawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile, zikhiqiza amaprotheni ahlukene ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli
distractor10b: Baqinisekisa ukuthi yonke i-gene iyabonakala kuwo wonke amaseli

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.4 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezivela Eukaryotic | Umgqugquzeli kanye Nemishini Yokuqopha
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.4 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezivela Eukaryotic | Umgqugquzeli kanye Nemishini Yokuqopha
chapterContent:
Izakhi zofuzo zihlelwe ukuze kube lula ukulawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Isifunda somkhuthazi siphezulu ngokushesha kochungechunge lokubhala ikhodi. Lesi sifunda singaba sifushane (ama-nucleotide ambalwa kuphela ngobude) noma sibe side kakhulu (amakhulu ama-nucleotide amade). Uma umkhuthazi ende, kulapho isikhala esitholakala khona samaprotheni sokubopha. Lokhu kunezela nokulawula okwengeziwe enkambisweni yokubhala. Ubude bomkhuthazi buqondene nezakhi zofuzo futhi bungahluka kakhulu phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo. Ngenxa yalokho, izinga lokulawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo lingahluka kakhulu phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo. Inhloso yomkhuthazi ukubopha izinto zokubhala ezilawula ukuqala kokubhalwa.

 Ngaphakathi kwesifunda somkhuthazi, phezulu nje kwendawo yokuqala yokubhala, kuhlala ibhokisi le-TATA. Leli bhokisi limane liwukuphinda kwe-thymine kanye ne-adenine dinucleotides (ngokoqobo, ukuphindaphinda kwe-TATA). I-RNA polymerase ibopha enkingeni yokuqalisa ukubhalwa, okuvumela ukubhalwa kwenzeke. Ukuze kuqalwe ukubhalwa, i-transcription factor (TFIID) iyona yokuqala ukubopha ebhokisini le-TATA. Ukubopha kwe-TFIID kuhlanganisa ezinye izici zokubhala, okuhlanganisa i-TFIIB, i-TFIIIE, i-TFIIF, kanye ne-TFIIH ebhokisini le-TATA. Uma le nhlanganisela isihlanganisiwe, i-RNA polymerase ingabopha ukulandelana kwayo okuphezulu. Uma iboshwe kanye nezici zokubhala, i-RNA polymerase iyaphosphorylated. Lokhu kukhipha ingxenye yeprotheni evela ku-DNA ukuze kusebenze i-transcription initiation complex futhi kubeke i-RNA polymerase endaweni efanele ukuqala ukubhala; iphrotheni egoba i-DNA iletha i-enhancer, engaba kude kakhulu ne-gene, ukuthintana nezici zokubhala kanye namaprotheni omlamuleli (Isithombe 16.10).

 Ngaphezu kwezici zokubhala ezijwayelekile, ezinye izici zokubhala zingabopha kumthuthukisi ukulawula ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Lezi zici zokubhala zibopha kubathuthukisi besethi ethile yezakhi zofuzo. Akuzona izici zokubhala ezijwayelekile ezibopha kuzo zonke izinkimbinkimbi zokubhala, kodwa zibopha ukulandelana okuthile kumthuthukisi wezakhi zofuzo ezithile. Kunamakhulu ezici zokubhala esitokisini ngasinye esibopha ngqo ku-motif ethile yokulandelela i-DNA. Uma izici zokubhala zibopha kuphromotha ongaphezulu nje kwe-gene ebhalwe phansi, kubizwa ngokuthi i-cis-acting element, ngoba ikwi-chromosome efanayo eduze kwe-gene. Indawo lapho i-transcription factor ethile ibopha khona ibizwa ngokuthi indawo yokubopha i-transcription factor. Izici zokubhala zisabela ezintweni ezibangela ukuthi amaprotheni athole izindawo zawo zokubopha futhi aqale ukubhalwa kwe-gene okudingekayo.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko womgqugquzeli?
answer1: Ukubopha izici zokubhala ezilawula ukuqaliswa kokubhala
question2: Ubude bephromotha buyithinta kanjani imithethonqubo yezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Abagqugquzeli abade banikeza izindawo eziningi zokubopha amaprotheni alawulayo, okuvumela ukulawulwa okuyinkimbinkimbi kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor2a: Amaphromotha amade ahlala ekhiqiza amaprotheni amaningi
distractor2c: Abagqugquzeli abafushane kuphela ababopha izici zokubhala
question3: Yiluphi uchungechunge olutholakala phezulu nje kwendawo yokuqala kokuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo eziningi ze-eukaryotic?
answer3: Ibhokisi le-TATA
question4: Yisiphi isici sokubhala esibopha kuqala ebhokisini le-TATA?
answer4: I-TFIID
question5: Yisiphi isenzakalo esenzeka ngemva kokuba izici zokubhala ezijwayelekile zihlangene kumgqugquzeli?
answer5: I-RNA polymerase II iyabopha futhi ihlanganiswe ne-phosphorylated ukuze iqalise ukubhalwa kwe-transcription
question6: Iyini indima yamaprotheni agoba i-DNA ngesikhathi sokuqala kokubhalwa kwe-transcription?
answer6: Ziletha izithuthukisi ezikude ukuthi zihlangane nezinto zokubhala kanye namaprotheni omlamuleli
question7: Izici zokubhala eziqondene nezakhi zofuzo zihluke kanjani ezintweni zokubhala ezijwayelekile?
answer7: Zibopha kuphela izilandelaniso ezithile zokukhuthaza zezakhi zofuzo ezithile
question8: Iyini isici esisebenza nge-cis?
answer8: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA olulawulayo olutholakala ku-chromosome efanayo eduze kwe-gene eliyilawulayo
question9: Iyini indawo yokubopha i-transcription factor?
answer9: Uchungechunge oluthile lwe-DNA oluqashelwa yisici esithile sokubhala
distractor9a: Indawo lapho ama-ribosome abopha khona i-mRNA
question10: Izici eziningi zokubhala zilawula kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ekuphenduleni imvelo?
answer10: Izimpawu zemvelo zivuselela izici zokubhala, ezizivumela ukuthi zibophe izindawo zazo ezithile ze-DNA futhi zilawule izakhi zofuzo eziqondiwe
distractor10a: Izimpawu zemvelo zishintsha unomphela ukulandelana kwabakhuthazi
distractor10b: Izimpawu zemvelo ziguqula i-DNA ngqo ibe yiprotheni
distractor10c: Izimpawu zemvelo zisusa wonke ama-histone kuma-chromosome

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.4 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Eukaryotic Transcriptional | Izithuthukisi Nokubhalwa Kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.4 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo ze-Eukaryotic Transcriptional | Izithuthukisi Nokubhalwa Kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterContent:
Kwezinye izakhi zofuzo ze-eukaryotic, kunezindawo ezisiza ekwandiseni noma ekuthuthukiseni ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Lezi zindawo, ezibizwa ngokuthi izithuthukisi, azisondele kakhulu kulezo zakhi zofuzo ezizithuthukisayo. Zingatholakala phezulu kwezakhi zofuzo, ngaphakathi kwesifunda sokubhala ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo, phansi kwezakhi zofuzo, noma zingase zibe kude nezinkulungwane zama-nucleotide.

 Izindawo ze-Enhancer ziyizilandelaniso ezibophayo, noma izindawo, zezinto zokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Lapho iphrotheni egoba i-DNA ibopha, isimo se-DNA siyashintsha (Isithombe 16.10). Lokhu kushintsha kwesimo kuvumela ukusebenzisana kweziqalisi ezibophayo ku-enhancer nezinto zokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezibophayo esifundeni se-promoter kanye ne-RNA polymerase. Ngenkathi i-DNA ngokuvamile iboniswa njengomugqa oqondile ngobukhulu obubili, empeleni iyinto enezinhlangothi ezintathu. Ngakho-ke, uhlu lwe-nucleotide oluyizinkulungwane zama-nucleotide akude lungagoqeka futhi lusebenzisane nomthuthukisi othile.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wesithuthukisi?
answer1: Ukwandisa izinga lokubhalwa ngokubopha amaprotheni asebenzayo
question2: Zingatholakala kuphi izithuthukisi uma kuqhathaniswa nesakhi sofuzo ezisilawulayo?
answer2: Phezulu, phansi, noma ngaphakathi kwama-intron, ngezinye izikhathi izinkulungwane zama-base pair zikude
question3: Isithuthukisi esikude singayithinta kanjani indlela yokubhala kuphromotha?
answer3: Ama-DNA ajikeleza ukuze ama-activator aboshwe yi-enhancer axhumane nemishini yokubhala ngamaphrotheni e-mediator
distractor3c: I-RNA polymerase ihambisa isithuthukisi eduze kwesikhuthazi
question4: Yimaphi amaprotheni avame ukubopha ukulandelana kwezithuthukisi?
answer4: Izici zokubhala ze-activator
question5: Uyini umphumela wamaprotheni e-activator abopha kuma-enhancer?
answer5: Zandisa ukuqashwa noma umsebenzi we-RNA polymerase II, zandisa ukuqoshwa
question6: Iyiphi indima edlalwa ngamaprotheni omlamuleli emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa?
answer6: Zisiza ukuxhumanisa ama-activator aboshwe yi-enhancer ne-transcription initiation complex
question7: Kungani izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli zingaveza izakhi zofuzo ezahlukene zisebenzisa i-genome efanayo?
answer7: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ziqukethe inhlanganisela ehlukene yezinto zokubhala ezibopha izithuthukisi ezithile
distractor7a: Uhlobo ngalunye lweseli lunekhodi ehlukile yezakhi zofuzo
distractor7b: Iseli ngalinye lilahlekelwa izakhi zofuzo ezingadingekile
question8: Izithuthukisi zisiza kanjani ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo okunembile?
answer8: Zivumela izakhi zofuzo ukuthi ziphendule ezimpawini ezithile zokuthuthukiswa noma zemvelo ngokubopha izinto ezibhaliwe
distractor8a: Baqinisekisa ukuthi yonke i-gene ikhiqizwa njalo
question9: Yini engenzeka kakhulu uma ukulandelana kwesithuthukisi kungasuswa ku-gene?
answer9: Ukubhalwa kwalelo jini cishe kuzoncipha noma kuhluleke kumaseli ancike kulowo othuthukisayo
distractor9b: Ukuhumusha kuzoma kodwa ukubhala ngokuloba ngeke kuthinteke
distractor9c: Uchungechunge lokubhala ikhodi ye-DNA luzoshintsha ngokuzenzakalelayo
question10: Izithuthukisi zihluke kanjani kubathuthukisi?
answer10: Abagqugquzeli baqasha imishini eyisisekelo yokubhala umbhalo, kuyilapho abathuthukisi bebopha amaprotheni alawulayo akhulisa noma aguqula umbhalo
distractor10a: Ama-Enhancer aqala ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, kanti ama-promoter aqeda ukukopishwa
distractor10b: Ama-promoter asebenza kuma-prokaryotes kuphela, kanti ama-enhancer asebenza kuma-eukaryotes kuphela.
distractor10c: Izithuthukisi zibhala ikhodi yamaprotheni, kuyilapho izithuthukisi zibhala ikhodi ye-RNA
