chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.4 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezibhalwe Nge-Eukaryotic | Ukuvala Izakhi Zofuzo: Abacindezeli Bokubhalwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
chapterContent: Njengamaseli e-prokaryotic, amaseli e-eukaryotic nawo anezindlela zokuvimbela ukubhalwa kwemibhalo. Ama-repressor okubhalwa kwemibhalo angabopha ezindaweni zokuphromotha noma zokuthuthukisa futhi avimbele ukubhalwa kwemibhalo. Njengama-activator okubhalwa kwemibhalo, ama-repressor asabela ezicini zangaphandle ukuvimbela ukubopha kwezinto zokubhalwa kwemibhalo ezisebenzayo.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko womshini wokucindezela umbhalo?
answer1: Ukuvimbela noma ukunciphisa ukukopishwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Ama-repressor okubhala angabopha kuphi kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
question3: Ama-repressor okubhala akuvimbela kanjani ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Zivimba ukubopha noma umsebenzi wokusebenzisa izinto zokubhala
question4: Yini evame ukulawula umsebenzi wama-repressor okuqopha umbhalo?
answer4: Izinto ezishukumisayo zangaphandle noma zemvelo
question5: Ama-repressor e-eukaryotic transcriptional afana kanjani nama-repressor e-prokaryotic?
answer5: Kokubili kunciphisa ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuvimbela imishini yokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthi isebenze
question6: Uyini umphumela wokubopha i-repressor eduze komgqugquzeli?
answer6: Ukuqaliswa kokubhalwa kwemibhalo kuvinjelwe
question7: Ama-repressor okubhala anikela kanjani ekukhetheni amaseli?
answer7: Zisiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhi zofuzo ezingadingekile zihlala zivaliwe ezinhlotsheni ezithile zamaseli
distractor7a: Zisebenza ngokulinganayo kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo
question8: Yini engenzeka kakhulu uma umshini wokucindezela umbhalo ungasakwazi ukubopha i-DNA?
answer8: Izakhi zofuzo eziqondiwe zingase zibonakale ngokweqile

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.5 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.5 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukulawulwa kwangemva kokubhalwa kungenzeka kunoma yisiphi isigaba ngemuva kokubhalwa. Enye indlela ebalulekile yangemva kokubhalwa i-RNA splicing. Ngemva kokuba i-RNA ibhalwe, ivame ukuguqulwa ukuze kudalwe i-RNA evuthiwe esekulungele ukuhunyushwa. Njengoba sifundile ezahlukweni ezedlule, ukucubungula i-RNA yesithunywa kuhilela ukususwa kwama-intron angabhalisi amaprotheni. Ama-Spliceosome asusa ama-intron futhi ahlanganise ama-exons ndawonye, ngokuvamile ngokulandelana okuhlukile kunokulandelana kwawo kokuqala ku-RNA yesithunywa esanda kubhalwa (engavuthiwe). I-GTP cap ingezwa ekugcineni okungu-5' bese kufakwa umsila we-poly-A ekugcineni okungu-3'. Le RNA yesithunywa evuthiwe ibe isishiya i-nucleus bese ingena ku-cytoplasm. Uma isise-cytoplasm, ubude besikhathi i-RNA yesithunywa ehlala lapho ngaphambi kokuba yonakale—isikhathi sokuphila noma impilo yeshelufu” ye-molecule ebizwa ngokuthi ukuzinza kwe-RNA—bungashintshwa ukuze kulawulwe inani leprotheni elenziwayo. Ukuzinza kwe-RNA kulawulwa yizici eziningana, okuhlanganisa ama-microRNA (i-miRNA noma i-RNAi, ukuphazamiseka kwe-RNA); ama-miRNA ahlala ehlisa ukuzinza futhi akhuthaza ukubola kwe-RNA yesithunywa.

Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa njengefa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka impilo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.1 I-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo i-RNA, ingumthombo oyinhloko wolwazi oluzuzwayo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.6 Umfundi angabikezela ukuthi ushintsho luzokwenzeka kanjani Uchungechunge oluthile lwe-DNA noma lwe-RNA lungabangela izinguquko ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo.

 I-RNA iyabhalwa, kodwa kumele icutshungulwe ibe ifomu elivuthiwe ngaphambi kokuba kuqalwe ukuhumusha. Lokhu kucubungula ngemva kokuba i-molecule ye-RNA ibhalwe, kodwa ngaphambi kokuba ihunyushwe ibe yiprotheni, kubizwa ngokuthi ukuguqulwa kwangemva kokubhalwa. Njengoba kunjalo ngezigaba ze-epigenetic kanye ne-transcriptional zokucubungula, lesi sinyathelo sangemva kokubhalwa singalawulwa futhi ukulawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo esitokisini. Uma i-RNA ingacutshungulwa, ingahanjiswa, noma ingahunyushwa, akukho phrotheni ezokwenziwa.
question1: Uyini umthethonqubo wangemva kokuqoshwa?
answer1: Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okwenzeka ngemva kokubhalwa phansi kodwa ngaphambi noma ngesikhathi sokuhumusha
distractor1a: Umthetho owenzeka ngaphambi kokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA kuphela
distractor1b: Umthetho owenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi sokuqala ukubhala ngokubhala
distractor1c: Umthetho owenzeka kuphela ngemva kokuwohloka kwamaprotheni
question2: Iyiphi inqubo esusa ama-intron ku-pre-mRNA?
question3: Yiziphi izinguquko ezingeziwe ukuze kukhiqizwe i-mRNA ye-eukaryotic evuthiwe?
answer3: Isivalo se-5 GTP (7-methylguanosine) kanye nomsila we-3 poly-A
question4: Iyini injongo yokuhlanganisa i-RNA?
answer4: Ukususa ama-intron nokuhlanganisa ama-exons ku-mRNA evuthiwe
question5: Kuyini ukuzinza kwe-RNA?
answer5: Ubude besikhathi i-molecule ye-mRNA ihlala ingashintshi ngaphambi kokuwohloka
question6: Ama-microRNA (ama-miRNA) alawula kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Zinciphisa ukuzinza kwe-mRNA futhi zikhuthaza ukuwohloka kwayo, zinciphisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni
distractor6a: Zandisa ukuzinza kwe-mRNA futhi zithuthukisa ukuhumusha
question7: Kungani umthethonqubo wangemva kokuqoshwa ubalulekile?
answer7: Ilawula ukuthi i-mRNA ecutshungulwayo iyathunyelwa yini kwamanye amazwe, izinze, futhi ihunyushwe ibe yiprotheni
question8: Uyini umphumela uma i-mRNA ingacutshungulwa kahle noma ingathunyelwanga ngaphandle kwe-nucleus?
answer8: Ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni akunakwenzeka kulokho okubhaliwe

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.5 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezakhi zofuzo Kwe-RNA, Isigaba Sokuqala Sokulawulwa Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.5 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezakhi zofuzo Kwe-RNA, Isigaba Sokuqala Sokulawulwa Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterContent:
Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, umbhalo we-RNA uvame ukuqukatha izifunda, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-intron, ezisuswa ngaphambi kokuhumusha. Izifunda ze-RNA ezibhala ikhodi yeprotheyini zibizwa ngokuthi ama-exons (Isithombe 16.11). Ngemva kokuba i-molecule ye-RNA isibhaliwe, kodwa ngaphambi kokuba isuke ku-nucleus ezohunyushwa, i-RNA iyacutshungulwa bese ama-intron asuswa ngokuhlanganisa.

 Ukuhlanganisa i-RNA ehlukile
 Ngawo-1970, kwaqalwa ukubonwa izakhi zofuzo ezibonisa ukuhlanganisa i-RNA ehlukile. Ukuhlanganisa i-RNA ehlukile kuyindlela evumela imikhiqizo ehlukene yamaprotheni ukuthi ikhiqizwe kusuka ku-gene eyodwa lapho inhlanganisela ehlukene yama-intron, futhi ngezinye izikhathi ama-exons, isuswa ku-transcript (Isithombe 16.12). Lokhu kuhlanganisa okuhlukile kungaba okungahleliwe, kodwa kaningi kulawulwa futhi kusebenza njengendlela yokulawula izakhi zofuzo, kanye nokuvama kwezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlanganisa ezilawulwa yiseli njengendlela yokulawula ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo ehlukene yamaprotheni kumaseli ahlukene noma ezigabeni ezahlukene zokuthuthukiswa. Ukuhlanganisa izakhi zofuzo ngendlela ehlukile manje sekuqondwa njengendlela evamile yokulawula izakhi zofuzo kuma-eukaryotes; ngokusho kokunye ukulinganisela, amaphesenti angama-70 ezakhi zofuzo kubantu abonakaliswa njengamaprotheni amaningi ngokusebenzisa ukuhlanganisa ngendlela ehlukile.
question1: Ayini ama-intron?
answer1: Izindawo ze-RNA ezingabhalwanga ikhodi ezisuswa ngaphambi kokuhumusha
question2: Ayini ama-exons?
answer2: Izindawo ze-RNA ezisele ngemva kokuhlanganiswa kanye nekhodi yeprotheni
question3: Kwenzeka nini ukuhlanganiswa kwe-RNA?
answer3: Ngemva kokubhalwa phansi kodwa ngaphambi kokuba i-mRNA ishiye i-nucleus ukuze ihunyushwe
question4: Uyini umsebenzi wokuhlanganisa i-RNA?
answer4: Ukususa ama-intron nokuhlanganisa ama-exons ukukhiqiza i-mRNA evuthiwe
question5: Kuphi lapho kwenzeka khona ukuhlukaniswa kwe-RNA kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
answer5: Ku-nucleus
question6: Kungani ukuhlanganiswa kwe-RNA kubhekwa njengenqubo yangemva kokubhalwa?
answer6: Ngoba iguqula i-RNA ngemva kokuba sekuvele ukuqoshwa kodwa ngaphambi kokuhumusha
question7: Yini ebingenzeka kakhulu uma ama-intron engasuswanga ku-pre-mRNA?
answer7: Iphrotheni ephumayo cishe ingase ingabi yinto engavamile noma ingakhiqizwa ngendlela efanele
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.12. Ingabe ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlukile kuyandisa noma kunciphisa ukuguquguquka kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo? Chaza impendulo yakho
answer8: Ukuguquguquka kuyanda ngoba i-mRNA ingashintshwa ngemva kokuthi ukulotshwa kuqediwe
distractor8a: Ukuguquguquka kuyanda ngoba izakhi zofuzo zingahlukaniswa futhi zihlanganiswe kabusha zibe izakhi zofuzo ezintsha
distractor8b: Ukuguquguquka kwehla ngoba i-molecule ye-mRNA iba ncane
distractor8c: Ukuguquguquka kwehla ngoba i-DNA yonakala ngesikhathi sokuhlanganiswa okuhlukile

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.5 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukulawulwa Kokuzinza Kwe-RNA, Ukuqina Kwe-RNA kanye nama-microRNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.5 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ngemva Kokubhalwa Kwe-Eukaryotic | Ukulawulwa Kokuzinza Kwe-RNA, Ukuqina Kwe-RNA kanye nama-microRNA
chapterContent:
Ngaphambi kokuba i-mRNA isuke ku-nucleus, inikezwa izivalo ezimbili ezivikelayo ezivimbela ukuphela kwentambo ukuthi yonakale phakathi nohambo lwayo. Isivalo esingu-5, esibekwa ekugcineni kwesi-5 kwe-mRNA, ngokuvamile sakhiwe yi-molecule ye-methylated guanosine triphosphate (GTP). Umsila we-poly-A, onamathele ekugcineni kwesi-3, uvame ukwakhiwa uchungechunge lwama-nucleotide e-adenine. Uma i-RNA isithuthelwe ku-cytoplasm, ubude besikhathi i-RNA ehlala lapho bungalawulwa. I-molecule ngayinye ye-RNA inokuphila okuchaziwe futhi ibola ngesivinini esithile. Leli zinga lokubola lingathonya ukuthi ingakanani iphrotheni esesiseleni. Uma izinga lokubola lenyuka, i-RNA ngeke ibe khona ku-cytoplasm isikhathi eside, okunciphisa isikhathi sokuguqulwa. Ngokuphambene nalokho, uma izinga lokubola lehla, i-molecule ye-RNA izohlala ku-cytoplasm isikhathi eside futhi amaprotheni amaningi angahunyushwa. Leli zinga lokubola libizwa ngokuthi ukuzinza kwe-RNA. Uma i-RNA izinzile, izotholakala isikhathi eside ku-cytoplasm.

 Ukubopha amaprotheni kwi-RNA kungathonya ukuzinza kwayo. Amaprotheni, abizwa ngokuthi amaprotheni abophezelayo i-RNA, noma ama-RBP, angabopha ezindaweni ze-RNA ezingenhla noma ezansi kwesifunda esibhala amaphrotheni. Lezi zindawo eziku-RNA ezingahunyushwanga zibe yiphrotheni zibizwa ngokuthi izifunda ezingahunyushwanga, noma ama-UTR. Azizona izifunda ezilawula indawo ye-mRNA, ukuzinza, kanye nokuhumusha amaprotheni. Isifunda esingaphambi nje kwesifunda esibhala amaphrotheni sibizwa ngokuthi i-5 UTR, kanti isifunda esilandela isifunda esibhala amaphrotheni sibizwa ngokuthi i-3 UTR (Isithombe 16.13). Ukubopha kwama-RBP kulezi zindawo kungakhuphula noma kunciphise ukuzinza kwe-molecule ye-RNA, kuye nge-RBP ethile ebophayo.

 Ukuzinza kwe-RNA nama-microRNA
Ngaphezu kwama-RBP abopha futhi alawule (ukwandisa noma ukunciphisa) ukuzinza kwe-RNA, ezinye izinto ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-microRNA zingabopha kwi-molecule ye-RNA. Lawa ma-microRNA, noma ama-miRNA, angama-molecule amafushane e-RNA anobude obungama-nucleotide angu-21-24 kuphela. Ama-miRNA enziwa ku-nucleus njengama-pre-miRNA amade. Lawa ma-pre-miRNA anqunywa abe ama-miRNA avuthiwe yiprotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-dicer. Njengezinto zokubhala kanye nama-RBP, ama-miRNA avuthiwe aqaphela ukulandelana okuthile futhi abopha kwi-RNA; noma kunjalo, ama-miRNA aphinde ahlobane ne-ribonucleoprotein complex ebizwa ngokuthi i-RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC). I-RISC ibopha kanye ne-miRNA ukuze yonakalise i-mRNA eqondiwe. Ndawonye, ama-miRNA kanye ne-RISC complex zibhubhisa ngokushesha i-molecule ye-RNA.
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-5 cap kanye nomsila we-poly-A ongu-3 ku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic?
answer1: Zivikela i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi zandisa ukuzinza kwayo
question2: Ukuqina kwe-RNA okwandisiwe kuthinta kanjani ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni?
answer2: I-mRNA ihlala isikhathi eside ku-cytoplasm, okuvumela ukuthi kukhiqizwe amaprotheni amaningi
question3: Ziyini izifunda ezingahunyushwanga (ama-UTR)?
answer3: Izindawo ze-mRNA evuthiwe ezingahunyushwa zibe amaprotheni kodwa ezilawula indawo ye-mRNA, ukuzinza, kanye nokuhumusha
question4: Yimaphi amaprotheni abopha ku-5 UTR noma ku-3 UTR ukulawula ukuzinza kwe-RNA?
answer4: Amaprotheni ahlanganisa i-RNA (ama-RBP)
question5: Ayini ama-microRNA (ama-miRNA)?
answer5: Ama-molecule amafushane e-RNA angaba ngu-21-24 ama-nucleotide ubude alawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-mRNA
question6: Yimaphi ama-enzyme acubungula ama-pre-miRNA abe ama-miRNA avuthiwe?
answer6: I-Dicer
question7: Yisiphi isici esisebenzisana nama-miRNA ukubhubhisa ama-mRNA aqondiwe?
answer7: I-RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC)
question8: Iyini imiphumela ye-miRNA ebophayo ku-mRNA yayo eqondiwe?
answer8: Kukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-mRNA eqondiwe, kunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni
question9: Yisiphi isifunda se-mRNA esitholakala ngokushesha ngemva kochungechunge lokubhala ama-protein?
answer9: Isifunda esingahunyushiwe esingu-3 (3 UTR)
question10: Ama-miRNA anikela kanjani ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo ngemva kokubhalwa?
answer10: Zibopha ama-mRNA athile futhi ziqashe i-RISC ukuze yehlise ukuzinza kwe-RNA futhi yehlise ukwakheka kwamaprotheni

chapterContent:
Ukushintsha isimo se-RNA noma iphrotheni ngokwayo kungathinta inani lephrotheni elikhiqizwayo, umsebenzi wephrotheni, noma ukuthi iphrotheni ihlala isikhathi esingakanani esitokisini. Ukuguqulwa okufana ne-phosphorylation kanye nezisusa zemvelo kungathinta ukuzinza kanye nomsebenzi wephrotheni.

 Inhloso Enkulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.3 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto ezishukumisayo zangaphandle kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okulawulwayo kuholela ekukhetheni amaseli, izicubu kanye nezitho zomzimba.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.3 Umfundi angalungisa izethulo kanye namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu kulesi sizinda.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.7 Umfundi uyakwazi ukulungisa izethulo ukuze abonise ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto ezishukumisayo zangaphandle kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kuholela kanjani ekukhetheni amaseli, izicubu, kanye nezitho zomzimba.

 Ngemva kokuba i-RNA isithuthelwe ku-cytoplasm, ihunyushwa ibe yiprotheni. Ukulawulwa kwale nqubo kuncike kakhulu ku-molecule ye-RNA. Njengoba kuxoxwe ngaphambilini, ukuzinza kwe-RNA kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuhunyushweni kwayo ibe yiprotheni. Njengoba ukuzinza kushintsha, isikhathi esitholakalayo sokuhumusha naso siyashintsha.
question1: Kukusiphi isigaba lapho ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo zokuhumusha kwenzeka khona?
answer1: Ngemva kokuba i-mRNA ithuthwe iye kwi-cytoplasm nangesikhathi sokwenziwa kwamaprotheni
question2: Yisiphi isici esinomthelela omkhulu ekutheni ingakanani iphrotheni ehunyushwa kusuka ku-mRNA?
question3: Ukuqina kwe-mRNA okwandisiwe kuthinta kanjani ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni?
answer3: Ivumela i-mRNA ukuthi ihlale itholakala ukuze ihunyushwe isikhathi eside, okwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni
question4: Yiluphi uhlobo lokuguqulwa olungalawula ukusebenza kweprotheni ngemva kokuguqulwa?
answer4: I-Phosphorylation
question5: Umthethonqubo wangemva kokuhumusha uthinta kakhulu yikuphi okulandelayo?
answer5: Umsebenzi wamaprotheni, ukuzinza, kanye nesikhathi sokuphila
question6: Izinto ezibangela imvelo zingalawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuthinta yiphi i-molecule ngqo?
answer6: Iphrotheni ngemva kokuba isihlanganisiwe
question7: Yimuphi umqondo we-AP Biology ogcizelelwe kulesi sigaba?
answer7: Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto ezishukumisayo zangaphandle kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okulawulwayo kuholela ekukhetheni amaseli, izicubu, kanye nezitho zomzimba ngokukhethekile.
distractor7b: Ama-prokaryotes kuphela alawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question8: Kungani ukuzinza kwe-RNA kuthonya ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer8: Ngoba inquma ukuthi i-mRNA ihlala isikhathi esingakanani ukuze ihunyushwe
distractor8c: Ngoba ivimbela izinto zokubhala ukuthi zingabi yi-DNA ebophayo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.6 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Okuhunyushwayo Nokuhunyushwa Kwangemva Kokuhumusha | I-Initiation Complex kanye Nezinga Lokuhumusha
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.6 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Okuhunyushwayo Nokuhunyushwa Kwangemva Kokuhumusha | I-Initiation Complex kanye Nezinga Lokuhumusha
chapterContent: Njengokubhalwa phansi, ukuhumusha kulawulwa amaprotheni abopha futhi aqalise inqubo. Ekuhumusheni, i-complex ehlanganayo ukuqala inqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-initiation complex. I-protein yokuqala ebopha kwi-RNA ukuze iqalise ukuhumusha yi-eukaryotic initiation factor-2 (eIF-2). I-protein ye-eIF-2 iyasebenza uma ibopha kwi-molecule enamandla aphezulu i-guanosine triphosphate (GTP). I-GTP inikeza amandla okuqala ukusabela ngokuyeka i-phosphate bese iba yi-guanosine diphosphate (GDP). I-protein ye-eIF-2 ebopha kwi-GTP ibopha kwi-subunit encane ye-ribosomal engu-40S. Uma ibopha, i-methionine initiator tRNA ihlobana ne-eIF-2/40S ribosome complex, iletha kanye ne-mRNA ezohunyushwa. Kuleli qophelo, lapho i-initiator complex ihlanganiswa, i-GTP iguqulwa ibe yi-GDP futhi amandla ayakhishwa. I-phosphate kanye ne-protein ye-eIF-2 kuyakhishwa kwi-complex kanti i-subunit enkulu ye-60S ribosomal iyabopha ukuhumusha i-RNA. Ukubopha kwe-eIF-2 ku-RNA kulawulwa yi-phosphorylation. Uma i-eIF-2 i-phosphorylated, idlula ekushintsheni kwesimo futhi ayikwazi ukubopha ku-GTP. Ngakho-ke, i-initiation complex ayikwazi ukwakheka kahle futhi ukuhumusha kuyavinjelwa (Isithombe 16.14). Uma i-eIF-2 ihlala ingenayo i-phosphorylated, ibopha i-RNA futhi ihumushe ngenkuthalo iphrotheni.
question1: Yiliphi iphrotheni eliqala ukubopha ku-mRNA ukuze liqale ukuhumusha kumaseli e-eukaryotic?
answer1: I-Eukaryotic initiation factor-2 (eIF-2)
question2: Yimuphi umolekyuli onamandla aphezulu osebenzisa i-eIF-2 ngesikhathi sokuqaliswa kokuhumusha?
question3: Yiliphi i-ribosomal subunit eqala ukuhlotshaniswa ne-eIF-2 ngesikhathi sokuqaliswa kokuhumusha?
answer3: I-subunit encane ye-ribosomal engu-40S
question4: Yimuphi umolekyuli olethwa ku-initiation complex kanye ne-40S ribosomal subunit?
answer4: I-tRNA yokuqala i-methionine
question5: Kwenzekani ku-GTP ngemva kokuhlanganiswa kwe-initiation complex?
answer5: I-hydrolyzed ibe yi-GDP, ikhulula amandla
question6: Iyiphi imiphumela ebangelwa yi-phosphorylation ye-eIF-2?
answer6: Ivimbela i-eIF-2 ekubopheni i-GTP, ivimbele ukwakheka kwe-initiation complex
question7: Uma i-eIF-2 ihlala ingenayo i-phosphorylated, kwenzekani?
answer7: Ukuhumusha kuqhubeka kahle ngoba i-eIF-2 ingabopha i-GTP futhi iqalise ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni
question8: Yimuphi indlela elawula ngqo izinga lokuqaliswa kokuhumusha kule ndlela?
answer8: I-phosphorylation ye-eIF-2
question9: Yiliphi i-ribosomal subunit ejoyina i-initiation complex ngemva kokukhishwa kwe-eIF-2 kanye ne-GDP?
answer9: I-subunit enkulu ye-ribosomal yama-60S
question10: Kungani i-phosphorylation ye-eIF-2 iyindlela ephumelelayo yokulawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: Ngoba ilawula ukuthi ukuqaliswa kokuhumusha kungenzeka yini ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA noma i-mRNA
question11: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.14. Ukwanda kwamazinga e-phosphorylation e-eIF-2 kuye kwabonwa ezigulini ezinezifo eziwohlokayo zemizwa njenge-Alzheimers, Parkinsons, kanye ne-Huntingtons. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kungaba namuphi umthelela ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni?

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.6 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Okuhunyushwayo Nokuhunyushwa Kwangemva Kokuhumusha | Ukuguqulwa Kwamakhemikhali, Umsebenzi Wamaprotheni, Nokuphila Isikhathi Eside
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.6 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo Okuhunyushwayo Nokuhunyushwa Kwangemva Kokuhumusha | Ukuguqulwa Kwamakhemikhali, Umsebenzi Wamaprotheni, Nokuphila Isikhathi Eside
chapterContent:
Amaprotheni angashintshwa ngamakhemikhali ngokufakwa kwamaqembu afaka phakathi i-methyl, i-phosphate, i-acetyl, kanye namaqembu e-ubiquitin. Ukwengezwa noma ukususwa kwala maqembu kumaprotheni kulawula umsebenzi wawo noma ubude besikhathi akhona ngaso kuseli. Ngezinye izikhathi lokhu kuguqulwa kungalawula lapho kutholakala khona iphrotheni kuseli—isibonelo, ku-nucleus, i-cytoplasm, noma kunamathiselwe ku-plasma membrane.

 Ukuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto zangaphandle ezifana nokucindezeleka, ukuntuleka kwezakhamzimba, ukushisa, noma ukuvezwa kokukhanya kwe-ultraviolet. Lezi zinguquko zingashintsha ukufinyeleleka kwe-epigenetic, ukuqoshwa, ukuzinza kwe-mRNA, noma ukuhumusha—konke okuholela ekushintsheni ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezahlukahlukene. Lena indlela ephumelelayo yokuthi iseli lishintshe ngokushesha amazinga amaprotheni athile ekuphenduleni indawo ezungezile. Ngenxa yokuthi amaprotheni ahilelekile kuzo zonke izigaba zokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo, i-phosphorylation yeprotheni (kuye ngokuthi iphrotheni ishintshiwe) ingashintsha ukufinyeleleka kwe-chromosome, ingashintsha ukuhumusha (ngokushintsha ukubopha noma ukusebenza kwe-transcription factor), ingashintsha i-nuclear shuttling (ngokuthonya ukuguqulwa kwe-nuclear pore complex), ingashintsha ukuzinza kwe-RNA (ngokubopha noma ukungabophi kwi-RNA ukulawula ukuzinza kwayo), ingashintsha ukuhumusha (ukwanda noma ukwehla), noma ingashintsha ukuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha (engeza noma ususe ama-phosphate noma ezinye izinguquko zamakhemikhali).

 Ukwengezwa kweqembu le-ubiquitin kuphrotheni kuphawula leyo phrotheni yokuwohloka. I-Ubiquitin isebenza njengefulegi elibonisa ukuthi isikhathi sokuphila kwephrotheni siphelele. Lawa maprotheni athuthelwa ku-proteasome, i-organelle esebenza ukususa amaprotheni, ukuze yonakale (Isithombe 16.15). Enye indlela yokulawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo, ngakho-ke, ukushintsha isikhathi sokuphila kwephrotheni
question1: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali okungalawula umsebenzi wamaprotheni noma isikhathi eside?
answer1: Ukwengezwa noma ukususwa kwamaqembu e-methyl, i-phosphate, i-acetyl, kanye ne-ubiquitin
question2: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa okuphawula ngqo iphrotheni yokuwohloka?
question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-proteasome?
answer3: Ukonakalisa amaprotheni afakwe uphawu lwe-ubiquitin
question4: Yisiphi isikhuthazo semvelo esingabangela ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni okulawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Ukucindezeleka, ukulinganiselwa kwezakhamzimba, ukushisa, noma ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet
question5: I-phosphorylation yamaprotheni ingathonya yiliphi izinga lokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Amazinga amaningi, kufaka phakathi ukufinyeleleka kwe-chromatin, ukubhalwa kwemibhalo, ukuzinza kwe-RNA, ukuhumusha, kanye nokulawulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha
question6: Ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni kungakulawula kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Ngokushintsha umsebenzi weprotheyini, indawo, ukuzinza, noma ukusebenzisana namanye ama-molecule
question7: Isebenza kanjani i-ubiquitin uma ixhunywe kuphrotheni?
answer7: Isibonakaliso sokuthi iphrotheni kufanele yonakale
question8: Kungani ukuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokulawula izakhi zofuzo?
answer8: Ivumela amaseli ukuthi alungise ngokushesha umsebenzi wamaprotheni noma ubuningi bawo ngenxa yezinguquko zemvelo
question9: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungakhulunywa ngakho njengomphumela ongaba khona we-protein phosphorylation?
answer9: Ukushintsha ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide ye-DNA
question10: Enye indlela amaseli alawula ngayo ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngemva kokuhumusha iwukuthi:
answer10: Ukulawula isikhathi eside samaprotheni ngokuwohloka okubangelwa yi-ubiquitin

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Umdlavuza yisifo sokuguqulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okungenzeka kuzo zonke izinga lokulawula, kufaka phakathi amazinga e-DNA methylation, i-histone acetylation, kanye nokusebenza kwezinto ezibhaliwe. Ngokuqonda ukuthi isigaba ngasinye sokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo sisebenza kanjani kumaseli ajwayelekile, singaqonda ukuthi yini ehamba kabi ezimweni ezigulayo. Isibonelo, izinguquko emsebenzini we-tumor suppressor gene p53 zingabangela umdlavuza. I-Phosphorylation kanye nokunye ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni nakho kuye kwahlotshaniswa nomdlavuza.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.B
Ukuvezwa kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kuhilela izindlela zamaseli kanye nama-molecule.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.B.2 Izinhlobonhlobo zokudluliselwa kwesignali phakathi kwamangqamuzana kanye nangaphakathi kwamangqamuzana ziqondisa ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.22 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izindlela zesignali ziqondisa kanjani ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo, okuhlanganisa nokuthi le nqubo ingathinta kanjani ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.B.2 Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudluliselwa kwesignali phakathi kwamangqamuzana kanye nangaphakathi kwamangqamuzana ziqondisa ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.23 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo ukuchaza izindlela zokulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Umdlavuza awusona isifo esisodwa kodwa uhlanganisa izifo eziningi ezahlukene. Emaseli omdlavuza, ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kushintsha ukulawulwa komjikelezo weseli futhi amaseli awayeki ukukhula njengoba ayevame ukwenza. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungashintsha futhi izinga lokukhula noma ukuqhubeka kweseli ngomjikelezo weseli. Isibonelo esisodwa sokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okushintsha izinga lokukhula ukwanda kwe-phosphorylation ye-cyclin B, iphrotheni elawula ukuqhubeka kweseli ngomjikelezo weseli futhi isebenza njengephrotheni yokuhlola umjikelezo weseli.

 Ukuze amaseli adlule esigabeni ngasinye somjikelezo weseli, iseli kumele lidlule ezindaweni zokuhlola. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iseli liqede kahle isinyathelo futhi alikaze lihlangane nanoma yiluphi ushintsho oluzoshintsha umsebenzi walo. Amaprotheni amaningi, kufaka phakathi i-cyclin B, alawula lezi zindawo zokuhlola. I-phosphorylation ye-cyclin B, isenzakalo sangemva kokuhumusha, ishintsha umsebenzi wayo. Ngenxa yalokho, amaseli angathuthuka ngomjikelezo weseli ngaphandle kokuvinjelwa, noma ngabe izinguquko zikhona esitokisini futhi ukukhula kwayo kufanele kuqedwe. Lolu shintsho lwe-cyclin B ngemuva kokuguqulwa luyivimbela ekulawuleni umjikelezo weseli futhi lunegalelo ekuthuthukisweni komdlavuza
question1: Umdlavuza ungabangelwa ukungajwayelekile ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo ngawaphi amazinga?
answer1: Amazinga amaningi, kufaka phakathi i-DNA methylation, i-histone acetylation, izici zokubhala, kanye nokuguqulwa kwamaprotheni ngemuva kokuhumusha
question2: Kungani ukuqonda ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuvamile kubalulekile ku-biology yomdlavuza?
answer2: Kuyasiza ukuchaza ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kwezindlela ezijwayelekile zokulawula kuholela kanjani kumdlavuza
distractor2a: Kubonisa ukuthi amangqamuzana omdlavuza aqukethe i-DNA ehlukile kunamaseli avamile
distractor2b: Kufakazela ukuthi umdlavuza ubangelwa amagciwane kuphela
distractor2c: Kubonisa ukuthi ukubhalwa kwe-transcription akudingekile emangqamuzaneni omdlavuza
question3: Yisiphi i-gene yokucindezela isimila okukhulunywe ngaso ngqo njengehilelekile kumdlavuza lapho umsebenzi wawo ushintsha?
question4: Yiluphi uhlobo lokuguqulwa kwamaprotheni oluye lwahlotshaniswa nomdlavuza?
answer4: I-Phosphorylation
question5: Iyini inkinga eyinhloko emaseli omdlavuza echazwe kulesi sigaba?
answer5: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphazamisa ukulawulwa komjikelezo weseli, okuvumela amaseli ukuthi aqhubeke nokuhlukana lapho kufanele ame khona
question6: Iyini indima evamile yezindawo zokuhlola umjikelezo weseli?
answer6: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isigaba ngasinye somjikelezo weseli siqedwa kahle ngaphambi kokuba iseli liqhubeke
question7: Yiliphi iphrotheni okukhulunywe ngalo ngqo njengolawula inqubekela phambili kulo lonke umjikelezo weseli?
answer7: I-Cyclin B
question8: Ukwanda kwe-phosphorylation ye-cyclin B kungaba nomthelela kanjani kumdlavuza?
answer8: Ishintsha umsebenzi we-cyclin B, ivumela amaseli anezinguquko ukuthi aqhubeke phakathi nomjikelezo weseli
question9: Ukwanda kwe-phosphorylation ye-cyclin B kuyisibonelo saluphi uhlobo lokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer9: Umthethonqubo wangemva kokuhumusha
question10: Kungani ukulawulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuziphatheni kweseli?
answer10: Ngoba ukuguqula amaprotheni alawulayo kungashintsha ngokushesha ukuqhubeka komjikelezo weseli kanye nokusebenza kwamaprotheni ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor10c: Ngoba iguqula amaprotheni ngqo abe yi-DNA

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.7 Umdlavuza Nokulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | Umdlavuza: Isifo Sokuvela Kwezakhi Zofuzo Okushintshile
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.7 Umdlavuza Nokulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | Umdlavuza: Isifo Sokuvela Kwezakhi Zofuzo Okushintshile
chapterContent:
Umdlavuza ungachazwa njengesifo sokuguqulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Kunamaprotheni amaningi avulwa noma avaliwe (ukuvuselelwa kwezakhi zofuzo noma ukuthuliswa kwezakhi zofuzo) okushintsha kakhulu umsebenzi wonke weseli. Izakhi zofuzo ezingavamile ukuvezwa kulelo seli zingavulwa futhi ziboniswe emazingeni aphezulu. Lokhu kungaba umphumela wokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo noma izinguquko ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo (i-epigenetic, ukuqoshwa, ukuqoshwa ngemva kokubhalwa, ukuhumusha, noma ukuqoshwa ngemva kokuhumusha).

 Izinguquko ekulawulweni kwe-epigenetic, ukuqoshwa, ukuzinza kwe-RNA, ukuhunyushwa kweprotheyini, kanye nokulawulwa ngemva kokuhumusha kungatholakala kumdlavuza. Nakuba lezi zinguquko zingenzeki ngesikhathi esisodwa kumdlavuza owodwa, izinguquko kulelo nalelo zinga zingatholakala lapho kubonwa umdlavuza ezindaweni ezahlukene kubantu abahlukene. Ngakho-ke, izinguquko ku-histone acetylation (ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic okuholela ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo), ukusebenza kwezinto zokubhalwa nge-phosphorylation, ukuzinza kwe-RNA okwandisiwe, ukulawulwa okwandisiwe kokuhumusha, kanye nokuguqulwa kweprotheyini konke kungatholakala ngesikhathi esithile emaseli ahlukahlukene omdlavuza. Ososayensi basebenza ukuqonda izinguquko ezivamile ezibangela izinhlobo ezithile zomdlavuza noma ukuthi ukuguqulwa kungasetshenziswa kanjani ukubhubhisa iseli lesimila
question1: Kungani umdlavuza uvame ukuchazwa njengesifo sokushintsha kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ngoba ukusebenza okungavamile noma ukuthuliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kushintsha ukuziphatha kweseli ngaphandle kokushintsha ngempela ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor1a: Ngoba amangqamuzana omdlavuza alahlekelwa ngokuphelele yi-DNA yawo
distractor1b: Ngoba zonke izakhi zofuzo zivulwa unomphela
distractor1c: Ngoba ukubhalwa kwemibhalo akwenzeki emangqamuzaneni omdlavuza
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungabangela ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo okungavamile kumdlavuza?
answer2: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo noma izinguquko ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Kumaphi amazinga lapho ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungashintshwa khona kumaseli omdlavuza?
answer3: Amazinga e-Epigenetic, transcriptional, post-transcriptional, translational, kanye namazinga angemuva kokuhumusha
question4: Imuphi umphumela ukwanda kwe-histone acetylation ngokuvamile okunawo kumaseli omdlavuza?
answer4: Ikhuthaza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokwenza i-chromatin itholakale kalula
distractor4b: Ivimba ukubopha kwe-RNA polymerase kuzo zonke izakhi zofuzo
question5: Ukusebenza kwezinto zokubhala nge-phosphorylation kuthinta liphi izinga lokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Umthethonqubo wokuloba
question6: Ukuqina kwe-RNA okwandisiwe kungaba nomthelela kanjani kumdlavuza?
answer6: Ivumela i-mRNA ukuthi ihlale isikhathi eside, okwandisa ukukhiqizwa kweprotheni yayo
question7: Ingabe zonke izinhlobo zomdlavuza zibonisa izinguquko ezifanayo zokulawula izakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi esisodwa?
answer7: Cha, izinhlobo ezahlukene zomdlavuza zingase zibonise izinguquko emazingeni ahlukene okulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor7a: Yebo, wonke umdlavuza unezinguquko ezifanayo zomthetho
distractor7b: Yebo, kodwa kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor7c: Cha, ngoba ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo akukho emaseli omdlavuza
question8: Iyiphi inqubo yangemva kokuhumusha okukhulunywe ngayo kulesi sigaba engaba nomthelela kumdlavuza?
answer8: Ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni
question9: Kungani ososayensi befunda ngezinguquko ezivamile zokulawula izakhi zofuzo phakathi komdlavuza?
answer9: Ukuthola izindlela ezingase zihloselwe ukubhubhisa amangqamuzana esimila
distractor9b: Ukwandisa ukuqina kwe-RNA unomphela kuzo zonke izicubu
question10: Izakhi zofuzo ezivame ukungasebenzi esitokisini esithile zibonakala kakhulu esimila. Lesi yisibonelo salokhu okulandelayo:
answer10: Ukuguqulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokusebenzisa ukusebenza kwezakhi zofuzo okungavamile

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Umdlavuza Nokulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | Umdlavuza: Isifo Sokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Okushintshile | Izakhi zofuzo Ezicindezela Isisu, I-Oncogenes, Nomdlavuza
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Umdlavuza Nokulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | Umdlavuza: Isifo Sokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Okushintshile | Izakhi zofuzo Ezicindezela Isisu, I-Oncogenes, Nomdlavuza
chapterContent:
Emaseli ajwayelekile, ezinye izakhi zofuzo zisebenza ukuvimbela ukukhula ngokweqile nokungafanele kwamaseli. Lawa ama-gene okucindezela isimila, asebenza emaseli avamile ukuvimbela ukukhula kwamaseli okungalawulwa. Kunezakhi zofuzo eziningi zokucindezela isimila emaseli. Izakhi zofuzo zokucindezela isimila ezifundwe kakhulu yi-p53, eguquliwe ngaphezu kwamaphesenti angama-50 azo zonke izinhlobo zomdlavuza. Iphrotheni ye-p53 ngokwayo isebenza njengesici sokubhala. Ingabopha ezindaweni ezikhuthaza izakhi zofuzo ukuze iqalise ukubhala. Ngakho-ke, ukuguqulwa kwe-p53 kumdlavuza kuzoshintsha kakhulu umsebenzi wokubhala wezakhi zofuzo zayo eziqondiwe.

 Ama-proto-oncogenes alawula umjikelezo weseli kahle. Uma eguquliwe, ama-proto-oncogenes angaba ama-oncogenes futhi abangele umdlavuza. Ukuvezwa ngokweqile kwe-oncogene kungaholela ekukhuleni kweseli okungalawulwa. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ama-oncogenes angashintsha umsebenzi wokubhala, ukuzinza, noma ukuhumusha kwephrotheni kwenye i-gene elawula ngqo noma ngokungaqondile ukukhula kweseli. Isibonelo se-oncogene ehilelekile kumdlavuza yiphrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-myc. I-Myc iyi-transcription factor esebenza ngokungajwayelekile ku-Burkett's Lymphoma, umdlavuza wesistimu ye-lymph. Ukwanda kwe-myc kuguqula amaseli e-B ajwayelekile abe amaseli anomdlavuza aqhubeka nokukhula ngokungalawuleki. Amanani aphezulu amaseli e-B angabangela izimila ezingaphazamisa ukusebenza komzimba okuvamile. Iziguli ezine-Burkett's lymphoma zingaba nezimila emhlathini wazo noma emlonyeni wazo eziphazamisa ikhono lokudla.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yezakhi zofuzo ezicindezela umdlavuza emaseli ajwayelekile?
answer1: Zivimbela ukukhula kwamaseli ngokweqile noma okungafanele
distractor1c: Baqala ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kuwo wonke amaseli
question2: Yisiphi i-gene yokucindezela isimila eguquliwe kubantu abangaphezu kuka-50% abanomdlavuza?
question3: Uyini umsebenzi ojwayelekile weprotheyini ye-p53?
answer3: Isebenza njengesici sokubhala esibopha abagqugquzeli ukulawula ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question4: Kungani izinguquko ku-p53 zingaba nomthelela emdlavuzeni?
answer4: Ngoba zishintsha ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ekulawuleni ukukhula kwamaseli
question5: Iyini i-proto-oncogene?
answer5: Izakhi zofuzo ezivamile ezikhuthaza ukuqhubeka komjikelezo weseli kodwa zingaba imbangela yomdlavuza uma ziguquliwe
question6: Uma i-proto-oncogene iguquguquka, iba yi-a(n):
answer6: I-Oncogene
question7: I-oncogenes ingawukhuthaza kanjani umdlavuza?
answer7: Ngokwandisa ukuqoshwa, ukuzinza kwe-RNA, noma ukuhunyushwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngamaprotheni okukhuthaza ukukhula kweseli
question8: Yisiphi isici sokubhala esisebenza ngendlela engajwayelekile ku-Burkitts lymphoma?
answer8: I-Myc
question9: Kungani ukuvezwa ngokweqile kwe-myc kuholela ezimila ku-Burkitts lymphoma?
answer9: Ngoba iguqula amaseli e-B ajwayelekile abe amaseli ahlukana ngokungalawuleki
distractor9a: Ngoba kuvimbela amaseli e-B ukuthi angahlukani
distractor9c: Ngoba ivimba ukubhalwa kuwo wonke amaseli
question10: Ukwelashwa komdlavuza kuvame ukubizwa ngokuthi ukulwa nebhayoloji. Chaza ukuthi kungani ukusetshenziswa kwe-p53 kusekela lesi sitatimende
answer10: Ngoba amaseli avamile avame ukuthinteka kabi yimithi yokwelapha umdlavuza, okuhlanganisa i-p53
distractor10a: Ngoba amangqamuzana omdlavuza ahlala ethintwa ukwelashwa komdlavuza kwamanje, okuhlanganisa i-p53
distractor10b: Ngoba amangqamuzana avamile avame ukuthinteka kabi ngokwelashwa komdlavuza, ngaphandle kwe-p53
distractor10c: Ngoba amangqamuzana omdlavuza avame ukungathinteki ngokwelashwa komdlavuza, ngaphandle kwe-p53

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi zofuzo | Ukuguqulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi zofuzo | Ukuguqulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi zofuzo
chapterContent:
Ukuthulisa izakhi zofuzo ngokusebenzisa izindlela ze-epigenetic nakho kuvame kakhulu kumaseli omdlavuza. Kukhona izinguquko eziphawulekayo kumaphrotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA ezihlotshaniswa nezakhi zofuzo ezithulile. Kumaseli omdlavuza, i-DNA esifundeni sokukhuthaza izakhi zofuzo ezithulile i-methylated kuma-residues e-cytosine DNA eziqhingini ze-CpG. Amaprotheni e-histone azungeze leso sifunda awanalo ukuguqulwa kwe-acetylation okukhona lapho izakhi zofuzo zivezwa kumaseli ajwayelekile. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwe-methylation ye-DNA kanye ne-histone deacetylation (ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic okuholela ekuthuliseni izakhi zofuzo) kuvame ukutholakala kumdlavuza. Lapho lokhu kuguqulwa kwenzeka, isakhi sofuzo esikhona kuleso sifunda se-chromosome siyathuliswa. Ososayensi bayaqonda ngokwengeziwe ukuthi izinguquko ze-epigenetic zishintshwa kanjani kumdlavuza. Ngoba lezi zinguquko zingezesikhashana futhi zingaguqulwa—isibonelo, ngokuvimbela isenzo sephrotheni ye-histone deacetylase esusa amaqembu e-acetyl, noma ngama-enzyme e-DNA methyl transferase anezela amaqembu e-methyl kuma-cytosine ku-DNA—kungenzeka ukuklama imithi emisha kanye nezindlela zokwelapha ezintsha ukuze kuzuze isimo esiguqukayo salezi zinqubo. Ngempela, abacwaningi abaningi bahlola ukuthi i-gene ethule ingashintshwa kanjani esitokisini somdlavuza ukuze kusizwe ekuvuseleleni amaphethini okukhula ajwayelekile.

 I-gene ehilelekile ekuthuthukisweni kwezinye izifo eziningi, kusukela ekungezwani komzimba kuya ekuvuvukeni kuya ku-autism, kucatshangwa ukuthi ilawulwa izindlela ze-epigenetic. Njengoba ulwazi lwethu lokuthi izakhi zofuzo zilawulwa kanjani luya lujula, kuzovela izindlela ezintsha zokwelapha izifo ezinjengomdlavuza.
question1: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic okuvame ukutholakala ezindaweni zokukhuthazwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithule emaseli omdlavuza?
answer1: I-DNA methylation yezinsalela ze-cytosine eziqhingini ze-CpG
question2: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwe-histone okuvamile ukungabikho mayelana nezakhi zofuzo ezithule emaseli omdlavuza?
question3: Iyini imiphumela ehlanganisiwe ye-methylation ye-DNA kanye ne-histone deacetylation?
answer3: Ukuthulisa izakhi zofuzo
question4: Kungani izinguquko ze-epigenetic zibhekwa njengezinhloso zokwelapha ezithembisayo kumdlavuza?
answer4: Ngoba ziyaguquguquka
distractor4b: Ngoba ziqeda wonke amangqamuzana omdlavuza ngokushesha
question5: Yimuphi i-enzyme esusa amaqembu e-acetyl kumaprotheni e-histone?
answer5: I-Histone deacetylase
question6: Yimuphi i-enzyme enezela amaqembu e-methyl kuma-residues e-cytosine ku-DNA?
answer6: I-DNA methyltransferase
question7: Iyini inhloso eyodwa yokwelashwa komdlavuza we-epigenetic?
answer7: Ukuvuselela izakhi zofuzo ezithulile nokubuyisela amaphethini ajwayelekile okukhula kwamaseli
question8: Yiziphi izifo ngaphandle komdlavuza okucatshangwa ukuthi zihilela ukulawulwa kwe-epigenetic?
answer8: Ukungezwani komzimba, ukuvuvukala, kanye ne-autism
question9: Uhlobo luni lwesifunda se-chromosome oluvame ukuba ne-methylated kuma-gene omdlavuza athule?
answer9: Iziqhingi ze-CpG ngaphakathi kwezifunda zokukhuthaza
question10: I-histone acetylation kanye ne-DNA methylation ngokuvamile kuthinta kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: I-Histone acetylation ikhuthaza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo, kanti i-DNA methylation ngokuvamile ithulisa izakhi zofuzo.
distractor10a: Kokubili kuhlala kukhulisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nokubhalwa Kwazo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nokubhalwa Kwazo
chapterContent:
Ushintsho emaselini abangela umdlavuza lungathinta ukulawulwa kokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okusebenzayo, njengokwanda kwe-phosphorylation, kungandisa ukubopha kwe-transcription factor endaweni yayo yokubopha ku-promoter. Lokhu kungaholela ekukhulisweni kokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuholela ekukhuleni kweseli okuguquliwe. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukuguquka kwe-DNA ye-promoter noma indawo ye-enhancer kungandisa ikhono lokubopha le-transcription factor. Lokhu kungaholela nasekukhulisweni kokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okungajwayelekile okubonakala emaseli omdlavuza.

 Abacwaningi bebephenya ukuthi bangalawula kanjani ukusebenza kokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kumdlavuza. Ukuthola ukuthi i-transcription factor ibopha kanjani, noma indlela esebenza lapho i-gene ingacinywa khona, kuholele emithini emisha nezindlela ezintsha zokwelapha umdlavuza. Kumdlavuza webele, isibonelo, amaprotheni amaningi akhiqizwa ngokweqile. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwe-phosphorylation yezici ezibalulekile zokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezikhulisa ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Esinye isibonelo esinjalo ukuvezwa ngokweqile kwe-epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) ku-subset yomdlavuza webele. Indlela ye-EGFR isebenzisa ama-protein kinase amaningi, nawo asebenzisa izici eziningi zokubhala ezilawula izakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ekukhuleni kwamaseli. Imithi emisha evimbela ukusebenza kwe-EGFR iye yathuthukiswa futhi isetshenziselwa ukwelapha lezi zomdlavuza.
question1: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezibhalwe phansi kungaba nomthelela kanjani kumdlavuza?
answer1: Zingandisa umsebenzi we-transcription factor, okuholela ekubhalweni ngokweqile kwezakhi zofuzo okukhuthaza ukukhula kwamaseli
question2: Yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha okukhulunywe ngakho ngqo njengokwandisa umsebenzi we-transcription factor?
question3: Uguquko lapho izifunda ze-DNA zingakhulisa khona ukubopha kwe-transcription factor futhi zibe nomthelela kumdlavuza?
answer3: Izindawo zokukhuthaza noma zokuthuthukisa
question4: Yini engaba umphumela wokwanda kwe-transcription factor okubophezela kumgqugquzeli?
answer4: Ukwanda kokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okungavamile
question5: Kungani abacwaningi befunda izici zokubhalwa kombhalo kumdlavuza?
answer5: Ukuthola izindlela zokuvimba ukusebenza kwezakhi zofuzo okungavamile nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokwelapha eziqondiwe
distractor5b: Ukususa zonke izinto zokubhala ezivela kumaseli
question6: Yimuphi umuthi ovame ukuvezwa ngokweqile kuhlobo oluthile lomdlavuza webele?
answer6: I-Epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)
question7: Ukwanda ngokweqile kwe-EGFR kunomthelela kanjani kumdlavuza?
answer7: Ivuselela ama-protein kinase avuselela izici zokubhala ezilawula izakhi zofuzo zokukhula kwamaseli
distractor7a: Ibhubhisa ngqo izakhi zofuzo ezicindezela isimila
question8: Hlobo luni lwamaprotheni asebenza ngaphansi kokubonakaliswa kwe-EGFR?
answer8: Ama-protein kinase
question9: Imithi eqondiwe yokulwa ne-EGFR isebenza ngokuyinhloko ngokuthi:
answer9: Ukuvimbela ukusebenza kwendlela yokubonisa ye-EGFR
distractor9c: Ukuvimba ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA kuwo wonke amaseli
question10: Kungani izinguquko ezindaweni zokuphromotha noma ezithuthukisayo zingaba nomthelela kumdlavuza ngisho noma ukulandelana kokubhala ikhodi kungashintshi?
answer10: Ngoba zingakhulisa ukubopha kwe-transcription factor futhi zishintshe ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphandle kokushintsha ukulandelana kwe-protein-coding
distractor10a: Ngoba abagqugquzeli banquma ukulandelana kwama-amino acid
distractor10c: Ngoba ukuguqulwa kwe-promoter kuhlala kumisa ukubhalwa ngokuphelele

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo Ngemva Kokuqoshwa Kwezincwadi
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo Ngemva Kokuqoshwa Kwezincwadi
chapterContent: Izinguquko ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo ngemva kokuqoshwa kwazo zingaholela nasekutheleleni umdlavuza. Muva nje, amaqembu amaningana abacwaningi abonise ukuthi umdlavuza othize ushintshe ukubonakaliswa kwama-miRNA. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-miRNA abopha ama-UTR angu-3 ama-molecule e-RNA ukuze awehlise, ukuvezwa ngokweqile kwala ma-miRNA kungaba yingozi emsebenzini ojwayelekile wamaseli. Ama-miRNA amaningi kakhulu anganciphisa kakhulu inani le-RNA okuholela ekunciphiseni ukubonakaliswa kwamaprotheni. Izifundo eziningana zibonise ushintsho kubantu be-miRNA ezinhlotsheni ezithile zomdlavuza. Kubonakala sengathi inani elincane lama-miRNA abonakaliswa emaseli omdlavuza webele lihlukile kakhulu kunenani elincane eliboniswa emaseli omdlavuza wamaphaphu noma ngisho nakumaseli avamile ebele. Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi izinguquko emsebenzini we-miRNA zingasiza ekukhuleni kwamaseli omdlavuza webele. Lezi zinhlobo zezifundo zisikisela nokuthi uma amanye ama-miRNA evezwa ngqo kumaseli omdlavuza kuphela, angaba yizithako ezingaba khona zemithi. Ngakho-ke, kungenzeka ukuthi imithi emisha evala ukubonakaliswa kwe-miRNA emdlavuza ingaba yindlela ephumelelayo yokwelapha umdlavuza.
question1: Izinguquko emithethweni yomthetho ngemva kokuqoshwa zingaba kanjani nomthelela emdlavuzeni?
answer1: Ngokushintsha ukuzinza kwe-mRNA kanye nokukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni ngokushintsha kokubonakaliswa kwe-miRNA
question2: Yimaphi ama-molecule ahileleke ngqo ekulawulweni komdlavuza ngemva kokuqoshwa kulesi sigaba?
question3: Ama-miRNA abopha kuphi kuma-mRNA aqondiwe?
answer3: Isifunda esingahunyushiwe esingu-3 (3 UTR)
question4: Uyini umphumela ojwayelekile we-miRNA obopha i-mRNA?
answer4: Kukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-mRNA, kunciphisa ukubonakaliswa kwamaprotheni
question5: Kungani ukuvezwa ngokweqile kwama-miRNA kungaba yingozi kumaseli ajwayelekile?
answer5: Ngoba ukuwohloka kwe-mRNA ngokweqile kunganciphisa kakhulu ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni
question6: Amaphethini okubonakaliswa kwe-miRNA ahluke kanjani phakathi komdlavuza?
answer6: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zomdlavuza ziveza ama-subset ahlukene ama-miRNA
distractor6a: Zonke izinhlobo zomdlavuza ziveza ama-miRNA afanayo ncamashi
question7: Uma kuqhathaniswa namaseli ebele avamile, amaseli omdlavuza webele avame ukuba nalokhu:
answer7: I-subset ehlukile yama-miRNA abonisiwe
question8: Kungani ama-miRNA aqondene nomdlavuza ebhekwa njengezinhloso zemithi ezithembisayo?
answer8: Ngoba ukuzivimba ngokukhetha kunganciphisa ukukhula komdlavuza ngenkathi kunciphisa imiphumela emaseli ajwayelekile
distractor8c: Ngoba ziguqula amangqamuzana omdlavuza abe amangqamuzana avamile ngokushesha
question9: Isu lokwelapha elingaba khona elichazwe kulesi sigaba yileli:
answer9: Yakha imithi evimbela ukubonakaliswa kwe-miRNA ethile yomdlavuza
question10: Kungani izinguquko emsebenzini we-miRNA zingaba nemiphumela ebanzi ekuvezweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer10: Ngoba ama-miRNA alawula ukuzinza kwama-mRNA amaningi futhi ngaleyo ndlela athonya ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni
distractor10a: Ngoba ama-miRNA ashintsha ngqo ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide ye-DNA

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi zofuzo | Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nokuhumusha/Ngemva Kokuhumusha
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi zofuzo | Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nokuhumusha/Ngemva Kokuhumusha
chapterContent: Kunezibonelo eziningi zendlela ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni okuguqulwa noma ngemva kokuguqulwa okuvela ngayo kumdlavuza. Ukuguqulwa kutholakala kumaseli omdlavuza kusukela ekuhumusheni okwandisiwe kweprotheni kuya ekushintsheni kwe-phosphorylation yamaprotheni kuya kwezinye izinhlobo ze-splice zeprotheni. Isibonelo sendlela ukuvezwa kwefomu ehlukile yeprotheni okungaba ngayo nemiphumela ehluke kakhulu sibonakala kumaseli omdlavuza wamathumbu amakhulu. Iphrotheni ye-c-Flip, iphrotheni ehilelekile ekulawuleni indlela yokufa kweseli, iza ngezindlela ezimbili: ende (c-FLIPL) kanye nemfushane (c-FLIPS). Zombili lezi zinhlobo zibonakala zihilelekile ekuqaliseni izindlela ezilawulwayo zokufa kweseli kumaseli ajwayelekile. Kodwa-ke, kumaseli omdlavuza wamathumbu amakhulu, ukuvezwa kwefomu ende kuphumela ekukhuleni kwamaseli esikhundleni sokufa kweseli. Ngokusobala, ukuvezwa kwephrotheni engalungile kushintsha kakhulu ukusebenza kweseli futhi kunegalelo ekuthuthukisweni komdlavuza.
question1: Kukuziphi amazinga amabili okulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo lapho izinguquko zamaprotheni zingaba nomthelela emdlavuzeni ngokwalesi sigaba?
answer1: Umthethonqubo wokuhumusha kanye nowokuhumusha
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha okuvame ukuhlotshaniswa nomdlavuza?
question3: Yisiphi isibonelo soshintsho lokuhumusha noma lokuhumusha olutholakala emaseli omdlavuza?
answer3: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaprotheni
question4: Yiliphi iphrotheni elisetshenziswa njengesibonelo sezinhlobo zamaprotheni ezihlukile kumdlavuza wamathumbu amakhulu?
answer4: C-Flip
question5: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zeprotheyini ye-c-Flip?
answer5: Ifomu elide (c-FLIPL) kanye nefomu elifushane (c-FLIPS)
question6: Uyini umsebenzi ojwayelekile wamaprotheni e-c-Flip?
answer6: Bahilelekile ekuxazululeni izindlela ezilawulwayo zokufa kwamangqamuzana
question7: Ukuvezwa kwesimo eside se-c-Flip (c-FLIPL) kunamuphi umphumela kumaseli omdlavuza wamathumbu amakhulu?
answer7: Kukhuthaza ukukhula kwamangqamuzana esikhundleni sokufa kwamangqamuzana
question8: Kungani ukuvezwa kweprotheni engalungile kungaba nomthelela emdlavuzeni?
answer8: Ngoba izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaprotheni zingaba nemiphumela ehlukene kakhulu ekusebenzeni kweseli
distractor8b: Ngoba izinhlobo zamaprotheni zihlala zimisa ukulotshwa
distractor8c: Ngoba zonke izinhlobo zamaprotheni ziyafana ngomsebenzi
question9: Isibonelo se-c-Flip sibonisani ngokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer9: Izinhlobo zamaprotheni ezihlukile zingashintsha ukuziphatha okuvamile kwamangqamuzana futhi zifake isandla ekuthuthukisweni komdlavuza
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esifingqa kangcono umthetho wokuhumusha kanye nowokuhunyushwa komdlavuza?
answer10: Izinguquko ekukhiqizweni noma ekuguqulweni kwamaprotheni zingashintsha ukusebenza kwamaseli futhi zikhuthaze umdlavuza
distractor10b: Ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni kuthinta kuphela amangqamuzana anempilo
distractor10c: Ukuhumusha akunandima ekulawuleni ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Imithi Emisha Yokulwa Nomdlavuza: Ukwelashwa Okuqondiwe
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Imithi Emisha Yokulwa Nomdlavuza: Ukwelashwa Okuqondiwe
chapterContent: Ososayensi basebenzisa lokho okwaziwayo mayelana nokulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezimweni zesifo, okuhlanganisa nomdlavuza, ukuthuthukisa izindlela ezintsha zokwelapha nokuvimbela ukukhula kwesifo. Ososayensi abaningi baklama imithi ngokusekelwe kumaphethini okubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwezimila zomuntu ngamunye. Lo mbono, wokuthi ukwelashwa kanye nemithi kungenziwa ngendlela yomuntu ngamunye, udale insimu yezokwelapha ezenzelwe umuntu ngamunye. Ngokuqonda okwengeziwe kokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo, imithi ingaklanywa ukuze iqondise ngqo amangqamuzana anesifo ngaphandle kokulimaza amangqamuzana anempilo. Eminye imithi emisha, ebizwa ngokuthi ukwelashwa okuqondisiwe, isebenzise kakhulu ukubonakaliswa kweprotheni ethile noma ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ukuthuthukisa umuthi omusha wokwelapha isifo. Esinye isibonelo esinjalo ukusetshenziswa kwemithi yokwelapha i-anti-EGF receptor ukwelapha i-subset yezimila zomdlavuza webele ezinamazinga aphezulu kakhulu ephrotheni ye-EGF. Akungabazeki ukuthi ukwelashwa okuqondisiwe kuzothuthukiswa njengoba ososayensi befunda kabanzi ngokuthi izinguquko zokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo zingawubangela kanjani umdlavuza.
question1: Yini eye yakhulisa ukuqonda kokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo evumele ososayensi ukuba bathuthukise ukwelashwa kwezifo?
answer1: Izindlela zokwelapha ezintsha eziqondiwe ezihlasela ngqo amangqamuzana anesifo
distractor1a: Imithi ebhubhisa wonke amaseli ahlukana ngokushesha ngokulinganayo
distractor1b: Imithi eshintsha unomphela ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo yawo wonke amaseli
distractor1c: Imithi yokugomela yonke evimbela zonke izinhlobo zomdlavuza
question2: Iyini imithi yomuntu siqu?
answer2: Indlela yokwelapha eklanyelwe izici zesifo somuntu ngamunye
distractor2b: Ukusebenzisa izinqubo zokuhlinzwa kuphela ukwelapha izifo
distractor2c: Ukuklama imithi ehlose wonke amaseli emzimbeni ngokulinganayo
question3: Yiluphi ulwazi oluvame ukusetshenziswa ekwakheni ukwelashwa komdlavuza okwenzelwe wena?
answer3: Amaphethini okubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwesimila somuntu ngamunye
question4: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokwelashwa okuqondiwe?
answer4: Zihlose ngqo amangqamuzana anesifo ngenkathi zinciphisa ukulimala kwamangqamuzana anempilo
distractor4c: Bathatha indawo ye-DNA yonke eguquliwe nge-DNA enempilo
question5: Izindlela zokwelapha eziqondiwe zivame ukusebenzisa ziphi izici zamaseli omdlavuza?
answer5: Ukuvezwa ngokweqile kwamaprotheni athile noma izinguquko ezakhiweni ezithile zofuzo
question6: Yisiphi isibonelo sokwelashwa okuqondiwe esichazwe kulesi sigaba?
answer6: Imithi yokwelapha ama-anti-EGF receptor esetshenziswa ukwelapha izimila zomdlavuza webele ezinamazinga aphezulu e-EGF
question7: Kungani imithi yokwelapha i-anti-EGF receptor isebenza kahle kwabanye abantu abanomdlavuza webele kuphela?
answer7: Ngoba zihlasela izimila eziveza ngokweqile indlela ye-EGF receptor
distractor7b: Ngoba zidinga amangqamuzana anempilo ukuze zikwazi ukukhiqiza i-EGF ngokweqile
distractor7c: Ngoba zihlose kuphela izicubu zebele ezijwayelekile
question8: Kungani ulwazi ngomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo lubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokwelapha umdlavuza?
answer8: Ivumela ososayensi ukuklama imithi ehlose ngqo izinguquko zama-molecule ezibangela izifo
distractor8c: Kwenza amangqamuzana omdlavuza afane namaseli anempilo
question9: Yini engase yenzeke njengoba ososayensi befunda kabanzi ngezinguquko ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezibangela umdlavuza?
answer9: Kuzothuthukiswa izindlela zokwelapha eziqondiwe kakhulu
distractor9a: Ucwaningo lokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo luzoba olungadingekile
distractor9c: Izindlela zokwelapha eziqondiwe zizothathelwa indawo ngokuphelele ngama-antibiotic
question10: Kungani ukwelashwa okuqondiwe kubhekwa njengokuthuthuka kunezindlela eziningi zokwelapha zendabuko?
answer10: Ngoba bahlose ukuhlasela amaseli omdlavuza ngokukhetha ngenkathi benciphisa umonakalo ezicutshini ezinempilo
distractor10a: Ngoba zisebenza ngokubulala wonke amaseli ahlukana ngokushesha ngokulinganayo
distractor10b: Ngoba zimisa unomphela konke ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor10c: Ngoba abathembeli ekuqondeni ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Umxhumanisi Wesilingo Sezokwelapha
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.7 Ukulawulwa Komdlavuza Nezakhi Zofuzo | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Umxhumanisi Wesilingo Sezokwelapha
chapterContent: Umxhumanisi wesilingo somtholampilo ngumuntu ophethe izinqubo zesilingo somtholampilo. Lo msebenzi uhlanganisa ukuxhumanisa amashejuli eziguli kanye nokuqokwa, ukugcina amanothi anemininingwane, ukwakha isizindalwazi sokulandelela iziguli (ikakhulukazi izifundo zokulandelela zesikhathi eside), ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo efanele itholiwe futhi yamukelwa, kanye nokusebenza nabahlengikazi nodokotela ukuze kube lula ukuhlolwa kanye nokushicilelwa kwemiphumela. Umxhumanisi wesilingo somtholampilo angaba nesifundo sesayensi kg, njengeziqu zobuhlengikazi, noma esinye isitifiketi. Abantu abake basebenza emalabhorethri esayensi noma emahhovisi ezokwelapha nabo bayafaneleka ukuba ngumxhumanisi wesilingo somtholampilo. Le misebenzi ngokuvamile isezibhedlela; noma kunjalo, eminye imitholampilo kanye namahhovisi odokotela nawo enza izivivinyo zomtholampilo futhi angaqasha umxhumanisi.
question1: Uyini umthwalo wemfanelo oyinhloko womxhumanisi wesilingo somtholampilo?
answer1: Ukuphatha izinqubo zansuku zonke kanye nokuhlela isivivinyo somtholampilo
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungumthwalo wemfanelo womxhumanisi wesilingo sezokwelapha?
distractor2a: Ukwenza ukulandelana kwe-DNA yelabhorethri yesiguli ngasinye
question3: Kungani umxhumanisi wesilingo somtholampilo egcina amanothi anemininingwane kanye nezizindalwazi?
answer3: Ukulandelela iziguli ngokunembile nokusekela izifundo zokulandelela zesikhathi eside
distractor3c: Ukunquma ukuthi yimiphi imithi etholakala kwezentengiselwano
question4: Yimuphi umsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu ezifundweni zezokwelapha zesikhathi eside?
answer4: Ukugcina isizindalwazi sokulandelela inqubekela phambili yesiguli ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
question5: Kungani imibhalo efanele ibalulekile ezivivinyweni zemitholampilo?
answer5: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi adingekayo aphelele, anembile, futhi ayamukelwa
question6: Abaxhumanisi bezivivinyo zemitholampilo bavame ukusebenza nobani ochwepheshe bezempilo?
answer6: Abahlengikazi nodokotela
question7: Yimuphi umjikelezo wemfundo we-bac kg ongenza umuntu afanelekele ukuba ngumxhumanisi wesilingo sezokwelapha?
answer7: Umjikelezo wesayensi we-bac kg, njengeziqu zobuhlengikazi, noma esinye isitifiketi esifanele
question8: Ngaphandle kweziqu zesayensi, yiluphi ulwazi olungafanelekela umuntu kulo msebenzi?
answer8: Ulwazi lokusebenza emalabhorethri esayensi noma emahhovisi emitholampilo
question9: Bakuphi abaxhumanisi bezivivinyo zemitholampilo abavame ukuqashwa?
answer9: Izibhedlela, yize imitholampilo namahhovisi odokotela nawo angawaqasha
question10: Kungani indima yomxhumanisi wesilingo sezokwelapha ibalulekile?
answer10: Zisiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izivivinyo zemitholampilo zihlelekile, zibhalwe kahle, futhi ziqhutshwa kahle kusukela ekubhalisweni kweziguli kuya ekushicilelweni kwemiphumela.
distractor10a: Zithatha indawo yesidingo sodokotela ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwemitholampilo
distractor10c: Bavumela ngokuzimela imithi emisha ukuthi isetshenziswe ngumphakathi

question1: Uyini umsebenzi we-3 UTR ku-molecule ye-mRNA?
answer1: Kuyisifunda esingahunyushiwe esingezansi kochungechunge lokubhala ikhodi yamaprotheni esiza ukulawula ukuzinza kwe-mRNA kanye nokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.
question2: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-5 cap ku-mRNA ye-eukaryotic?
answer2: Ivikela izingxenye ezi-5 ze-mRNA ekuwohlokeni futhi isiza ekuqaliseni ukuhumusha
question3: Iyini i-5 UTR ye-mRNA?
answer3: Isifunda esingahunyushiwe esingaphezulu kochungechunge lokubhala amaphrotheni esiza ekulawuleni ukuhumusha
question4: Uyini umsebenzi we-activator ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo ze-prokaryotic?
answer4: Ibopha i-DNA futhi yandisa ukuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile
question5: Iyini indima yeprotheyini ye-catabolite activator (CAP)?
answer5: Ibopha i-cAMP futhi ikhuthaza ukuqoshwa kwama-operon ahilelekile ekusetshenzisweni koshukela okunye lapho i-glucose ingekho khona.
distractor5a: Icindezela i-operon ye-trp uma kukhona i-tryptophan
question6: Iyini isici esisebenza nge-cis?
answer6: Indawo yokubopha i-transcription factor eseduze ne-gene eyilawulayo
question7: Uyini umsebenzi we-dicer?
answer7: Icubungula i-pre-miRNA ibe yi-miRNA evuthiwe
question8: Kuyini i-DNA methylation?
answer8: Ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic okuvame ukuthulisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question9: Kuyini isithuthukisi?
answer9: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA olwandisa ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile, ngisho noma zisendaweni ekude
question10: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi epigenetic?
answer10: Izinguquko ezizuzwa njengefa ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezingashintshi ukulandelana kwe-DNA
question11: Iyini indima ye-eukaryotic initiation factor-2 (eIF-2)?
answer11: Iqala ngokubopha ku-mRNA futhi isiza ekuqaliseni ukuhumusha
question12: Kusho ukuthini ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer12: Izinqubo ezilawula ukuthi i-gene ivuliwe noma ivaliwe futhi zikhiqiza i-RNA kanye ne-protein
question13: Kuyini i-guanosine diphosphate (GDP)?
answer13: I-molecule ehlala ngemva kwe-GTP inikeza amandla okuqala ukuhumusha
question14: Iyini indima ye-guanosine triphosphate (GTP) ngesikhathi sokuqaliswa kokuhumusha?
answer14: Inikeza amandla ngokubopha i-eIF-2 ukuze kuqalwe ukuhumusha
question15: Iyiphi ithonya i-histone acetylation evame ukuba nalo ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer15: Ikhulula isakhiwo se-chromatin futhi ikhuthaza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question16: Iyini i-inducer ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo ze-prokaryotic?
answer16: I-molecule encane evuselela noma ecindezela ukubhalwa kwemibhalo kuye ngezimo zeseli
question17: Iyini i-operon engasebenzi?
answer17: I-operon okuthi ukuqoshwa kwayo kusebenze noma kucindezelwe kuye ngendawo ezungezile nezidingo zamaseli
distractor17c: I-operon esebenza kuphela ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
question18: Iyini inkimbinkimbi yokuqalisa ekuhumusheni?
answer18: I-protein complex equkethe i-eIF-2 ehlangana ukuze iqale ukuhumusha
answer19: Iqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezidingekayo ukuze kuthathwe futhi kugaywe i-lactose
question20: Iyini indima ye-subunit enkulu ye-ribosomal engu-60S kuma-eukaryotes?
answer20: Ijoyina inkimbinkimbi yokuqalisa futhi ihlanganyela ekuguquleni i-mRNA ibe yiprotheni
answer21: Ama-molecule amafushane e-RNA abopha ama-mRNA aqondiwe futhi akhuthaze ukuwohloka kwawo
answer22: I-oncogene engasiza ekuthuthukisweni komdlavuza uma ikhuliswe ngokweqile noma iguquliwe

answer32: Ihlangana ne-miRNA ukuze yonakalise ama-molecule e-RNA aqondiwe

answer34: Ibopha esifundeni esingahunyushiwe esingu-3 noma esingu-5 se-mRNA ukuze kwandiswe noma kuncishiswe ukuzinza kwayo

answer35: Ibopha i-mRNA futhi isiza ekuqaliseni ukuhumusha
