chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.9 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 16. Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi zofuzo | 16.9 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
16.1 Ukulawulwa Kokubonakaliswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
Nakuba wonke amaseli omzimba ngaphakathi kwento ephilayo aqukethe i-DNA efanayo, akuwona wonke amaseli ngaphakathi kwaleyo nto ephilayo aveza amaprotheni afanayo. Izinto eziphilayo ze-Prokaryotic ziveza yonke i-DNA eziyibhala kuwo wonke amaseli, kodwa hhayi zonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Amaprotheni abonakaliswa kuphela lapho edingeka. Izinto eziphilayo ze-Eukaryotic ziveza ingxenye encane ye-DNA ebhalwe kunoma yiliphi iseli elinikeziwe. Ohlotsheni ngalunye lweseli, uhlobo kanye nenani leprotheni kulawulwa ngokulawula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukuze kuvezwe iphrotheni, i-DNA ibhalwa kuqala ibe yi-RNA, bese ihunyushwa ibe amaprotheni. Kumaseli e-prokaryotic, lezi zinqubo zenzeka cishe ngesikhathi esisodwa. Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, ukubhalwa kwenzeka ku-nucleus futhi kuhlukile ekuhunyushweni okwenzeka ku-cytoplasm. Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuma-prokaryotes kulawulwa kakhulu ezingeni lokubhalwa, kanti kumaseli e-eukaryotic, ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa emazingeni e-epigenetic, transcriptional, post-transcriptional, translational, kanye ne-post-translational.

 16.2 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ze-Prokaryotic
Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli e-prokaryotic kwenzeka ezingeni lokubhalwa. Kunezindlela ezintathu zokulawula ukubhalwa kwe-operon: ukulawula okucindezelayo, ukulawula okuvuselelayo, kanye nokulawula okungenayo i-inducible. Ukulawulwa okucindezelayo, okufanekiswa yi-trp operon, kusebenzisa amaprotheni aboshelwe kuchungechunge lomqhubi ukuvimbela ngokomzimba ukubopha kwe-RNA polymerase kanye nokusebenza kokubhalwa. Ngakho-ke, uma i-tryptophan ingadingeki, i-repressor iboshelwe kumqhubi futhi ukubhalwa kuhlala kuvaliwe. Ukulawulwa kwe-Activator, okufanekiswa yisenzo se-CAP, kwandisa ikhono lokubopha le-RNA polymerase kuphromotha lapho i-CAP iboshelwe. Kulesi simo, amazinga aphansi e-glucose aholela ekuboshweni kwe-cAMP ku-CAP. I-CAP bese ibopha i-promotha, okuvumela i-RNA polymerase ukuthi ibophe i-promotha kangcono. Esibonelweni sokugcina—i-lac operon—kumele kuhlangatshezwane nezimo ezimbili ukuze kuqalwe ukubhalwa. I-glucose akumele ibe khona, futhi i-lactose kumele ibe khona ukuze i-lac operon ibhalwe. Uma i-glucose ingekho, i-CAP ibopha kumqhubi. Uma i-lactose ikhona, iphrotheni yokucindezela ayibopha kumqhubi wayo. Kuphela uma zombili izimo zihlangatshezwana lapho i-RNA polymerase ibopha kuphromotha ukuze ibangele ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 16.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ze-Epigenetic Ze-Eukaryotic
Kumaseli e-eukaryotic, isigaba sokuqala sokulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo senzeka ezingeni le-epigenetic. Izindlela ze-epigenetic zilawula ukufinyelela esifundeni se-chromosome ukuvumela izakhi zofuzo ukuthi zivulwe noma zivaliwe. Lezi zindlela zilawula indlela i-DNA epakishwe ngayo ku-nucleus ngokulawula ukuthi i-DNA iboshwe ngokuqinile kangakanani eduze kwamaprotheni e-histone. Ukwengezwa noma ukususwa kokuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali (noma amafulegi) kumaprotheni e-histone noma izimpawu ze-DNA esitokisini ukuvula noma ukuvala isifunda se-chromosome. Ngakho-ke, amaseli e-eukaryotic angalawula ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zivezwa yini ngokulawula ukufinyeleleka kwezinto zokubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nokubopha kwe-RNA polymerase ukuze kuqalwe ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo.

 16.4 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Zokuqoshwa Kwe-Eukaryotic
Ukuze uqale ukubhalwa, izici zokubhala ezijwayelekile, njenge-TFIID, i-TFIIH, nezinye, kumele ziqale zibophe ebhokisini le-TATA futhi ziqoqe i-RNA polymerase kuleyo ndawo. Ukubopha ezinye izici zokubhala ezilawulayo ezintweni ezisebenza nge-cis kuzokhulisa noma kuvimbele ukubhalwa. Ngaphezu kokulandelana kwephromotha, izifunda zokuthuthukisa zisiza ukwandisa ukubhalwa. Izithuthukisi zingaba phezulu, phansi, ngaphakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ngokwazo, noma kwamanye ama-chromosome. Izici zokubhala zibopha ezindaweni zokuthuthukisa ukwandisa noma ukuvimbela ukubhalwa.

 16.5 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Zokuqoshwa Kwe-Eukaryotic
Ukulawulwa kwangemuva kokubhalwa kungenzeka kunoma yisiphi isigaba ngemuva kokubhalwa, kufaka phakathi ukuhlanganiswa kwe-RNA, ukuthunyelwa kwe-nuclear, kanye nokuzinza kwe-RNA. Uma i-RNA isibhaliwe, kumele icutshungulwe ukuze kudalwe i-RNA evuthiwe elungele ukuhunyushwa. Lokhu kuhilela ukususwa kwama-intron angakhokhi iphrotheni. Ama-Spliceosome abopha izimpawu eziphawula umngcele we-exon/intron ukuze asuse ama-intron futhi ahlanganise ama-exons ndawonye. Uma lokhu sekwenzekile, i-RNA ivuthiwe futhi ingahunyushwa. I-RNA iyadalwa futhi ihlanganiswe ku-nucleus, kodwa idinga ukuthuthwa iye ku-cytoplasm ukuze ihunyushwe. I-RNA ithuthwa iye ku-cytoplasm nge-nuclear pore complex. Uma i-RNA isiku-cytoplasm, ubude besikhathi ehlala lapho ngaphambi kokuba yonakale, okubizwa ngokuthi ukuzinza kwe-RNA, kungashintshwa futhi ukulawula inani eliphelele leprotheyini elakhiwe. Ukuzinza kwe-RNA kungandiswa, okuholela esikhathini eside sokuhlala ku-cytoplasm, noma kunciphe, okuholela esikhathini esifushane kanye nokwakheka okuncane kweprotheyini. Ukuzinza kwe-RNA kulawulwa amaprotheni abophezela i-RNA (ama-RPB) nama-microRNA (ama-miRNA). Lawa ma-RPB nama-miRNA abopha ku-5 UTR noma ku-3 UTR ye-RNA ukuze kwandiswe noma kunciphe ukuzinza kwe-RNA. Kuye nge-RBP, ukuzinza kungandiswa noma kunciphe kakhulu; noma kunjalo, ama-miRNA ahlala ehlisa ukuzinza futhi akhuthaze ukubola.

 16.6 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezihunyushwayo Nezihunyushwayo Ngemva Kokuhumusha
Ukushintsha isimo se-RNA noma iphrotheni ngokwayo kungathinta inani lephrotheni, umsebenzi wephrotheni, noma ukuthi itholakala isikhathi esingakanani esitokisini. Ukuze kuhunyushwe iphrotheni, i-protein initiator complex kumele ihlangane ku-RNA. Ukuguqulwa (njengokufosforasila) kwamaprotheni kulesi sakhiwo kungavimbela ukuhumusha okufanele ukuthi kwenzeke. Uma iphrotheni isiyenziwe, ingaguqulwa (i-phosphorylated, i-acetylated, i-methylated, noma i-ubiquitinated). Lokhu kuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha kungathinta kakhulu ukuzinza, ukuwohloka, noma umsebenzi wephrotheni.

 16.7 Ukulawulwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Ezihunyushwayo
Umdlavuza ungachazwa njengesifo sokuguqulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Izinguquko kuzo zonke izinga lokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezi-eukaryotic zingatholakala ohlotsheni oluthile lomdlavuza ngesikhathi esithile. Ukuze siqonde ukuthi izinguquko ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo zingawubangela kanjani umdlavuza, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi isigaba ngasinye sokulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo sisebenza kanjani kumaseli ajwayelekile. Ngokuqonda izindlela zokulawula kumaseli ajwayelekile, angaguli, kuzoba lula kososayensi ukuqonda ukuthi yini ehamba kabi ezimweni zezifo kufaka phakathi eziyinkimbinkimbi njengomdlavuza.
question1: Ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli e-eukaryotic kwenzeka kuliphi izinga (amazinga)?
answer1: Amazinga e-epigenetic kanye ne-transcriptional, translational, kanye namazinga angemva kokuhumusha
distractor1c: Amazinga e-epigenetic kanye ne-transcriptional kanye ne-translational
question2: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.16. Izibalo u-X no-Y ezikulesi sithombe zibonisani?
answer2: Ukubhalwa nokuhumusha kuseli le-prokaryotic (isibalo X) kanye neseli le-eukaryotic (isibalo Y)
distractor2a: Ukubhalwa nokuhumusha kuseli le-eukaryotic (isibalo X) kanye neseli le-prokaryotic (isibalo Y)
distractor2b: Ukubhalwa phansi kweseli le-eukaryotic (isibalo X) kanye nokuhumusha kweseli le-prokaryotic (isibalo Y)
distractor2c: Ukubhalwa phansi kweseli le-prokaryotic (isibalo X) kanye nokuhumusha kweseli le-eukaryotic (isibalo Y)
question3:
Uma i-glucose ingekho kodwa kukhona i-lactose, i-lac operon izoba
_______
answer3: Kusebenze
question4: Yini ebingenzeka uma uchungechunge lwe-opharetha lwe-lac operon luqukethe uguquko oluvimbela iphrotheni yokucindezela ukuthi ibophe opharetha?
answer4: Uma ingekho i-lactose, i-lac operon izobhalwa
distractor4a: Uma kukhona i-lactose, i-lac operon ngeke ibhalwe phansi
distractor4b: I-cAMP-CAP complex ngeke ikhulise ukwakheka kwe-RNA
question5: Yini ebingenzeka uma uchungechunge lwe-opharetha lwe-trp operon luqukethe uguquko oluvimbela iphrotheni yokucindezela ukuthi ingabimbi ku-opharetha?
answer5: Uma kukhona i-tryptophan, izakhi zofuzo ze-trpA-E zizobhalwa phansi
distractor5a: Uma kungekho i-tryptophan, izakhi zofuzo ze-trpA-E ngeke zibhalwe phansi
distractor5b: Uma kungekho i-tryptophan, kuzobhalwa kuphela izakhi zofuzo i-trpE kanye ne-trpD.
distractor5c: Uma kukhona i-tryptophan, i-trpE gene ngeke ibhalwe phansi
question6: Kuyini ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic?
answer6: Ukwengezwa kwezinguquko eziguqukayo kumaprotheni e-histone kanye ne-DNA
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nomthetho we-epigenetic esingamanga?
answer7: Ukushaja kweprotheyini ye-Histone kuba ngcono kakhulu uma kungezwa amaqembu e-acetyl
distractor7a: Ama-molecule e-DNA aguqulwa ngaphakathi kweziqhingi ze-CpG
distractor7b: I-Methylation ye-DNA nama-histones ibangela ukuthi ama-nucleosome ahlangane ndawonye
distractor7c: I-acetylation ye-Histone iholela ekupakishweni okuxekethile kwama-nucleosome
question8: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyiqiniso ngezinguquko ze-epigenetic?
answer8: Zivumela ukunyakaza kwama-histone
question9: Ukubopha kwalokho okudingekayo ukuze umbhalo uqale?
answer9: Isici sokubhala
question10: Uyoba yini umphumela wokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okwavimbela ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni agobile e-DNA?
answer10: Ukuncipha kokubhalwa phansi ngoba izithuthukisi ngeke zikwazi ukubopha ezintweni zokubhalwa phansi
distractor10a: Ukwehla kokubhalwa phansi ngoba izici zokubhalwa phansi ngeke zibophe ezindaweni zokubopha ukubhalwa phansi
distractor10b: Ukubhalwa okwandisiwe ngoba abacindezeli ngeke bakwazi ukubopha ezindaweni zabakhuthazi
distractor10c: Ukubhalwa okwandisiwe ngoba i-RNA polymerase izokwazi ukwandisa ukubopha ezindaweni zokukhuthaza
question11: Yini ezoba umphumela wokubopha i-transcription factor endaweni ye-enhancer?
question12: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuhilelekile ekulawulweni kokubhalwa kwangemuva kokubhalwa?
question13: I-Gene A kucatshangwa ukuthi ihlotshaniswa nokungaboni kombala. Iphrotheni ehambisana ne-gene A ihlukanisiwe. Ukuhlaziywa kwephrotheni etholiwe kukhombisa ukuthi empeleni kunezinhlobo ezimbili zamaprotheni ezihlukile ngesisindo sama-molecule ezihambisana ne-gene A. Yisiphi esinye isizathu sokuthi kungani kungase kube namaprotheni amabili ahambisana ne-gene?
distractor13a: Iphrotheni eyodwa yayine-cap engu-5' kanye nomsila we-poly-A ku-mRNA yayo, kanti enye iphrotheni yayingenayo
distractor13b: Iphrotheni eyodwa yayine-UTR engu-5’ kanye ne-UTR engu-3’ ku-RNA yayo, kanti enye iphrotheni yayingenayo
distractor13c: I-gene yakhiqiza ama-molecule e-mRNA anokuqina okuhlukile
question14: Ukubopha iphrotheni yokubopha i-RNA kuzoshintsha kanjani ukuzinza kwe-molecule ye-RNA?
answer14: Kungabe kuyandisa noma kuyanciphisa
question15: Ukuguquka kwe-5’UTR okuvimbela noma yimaphi amaprotheni ukuthi abophe esifundeni kuzo______________
answer15: Ukwandisa noma ukunciphisa ukuzinza kwe-molecule ye-RNA
distractor15c: Ukwandisa noma ukunciphisa ubude bomsila we-poly-A
question16: Ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni ngemva kokuhumusha kungathinta yikuphi okulandelayo?
answer16: Ukuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali
question17: Kutholakala uguquko ku-eIF-2 oluphazamisa ukuqaliswa kokuhumusha. Uguquko lungathinta yonke imisebenzi elandelayo ye-eIF-2 ngaphandle kowodwa. Yimuphi ongeke uthinteke?
answer17: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela i-eIF-2 ukuthi ingabi yi-phosphorylated
distractor17a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela i-eIF-2 ekubopheni ku-RNA
distractor17b: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela i-eIF-2 ekubophezeleni ku-GTP
distractor17c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuvimbela i-eIF-2 ekubopheni kwi-subunit ye-ribosomal engu-40S
question18: Ukwengezwa kweqembu le-ubiquitin kuphrotheni kwenzani?
answer18: Kuphawula iphrotheni yokuwohloka
question19: Zibizwa ngokuthini izakhi zofuzo ezibangela umdlavuza?
question20: Ukwelashwa okuqondiwe kusetshenziswa ezigulini ezinephethini ethile yokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukwelashwa okuqondiwe okuvimbela ukusebenza kwe-estrogen receptor kumdlavuza webele kungaba usizo kuluphi uhlobo lwesiguli?
answer20: Iziguli ezine-ER alpha ebonakala kakhulu emaseli azo esimila
distractor20a: Iziguli eziveza i-EGFR receptor kumaseli ajwayelekile
distractor20c: Iziguli ezine-VEGF ekhuphukile, okusiza ekukhuleni kwe-angiogenesis yesimila
question21: Ekwelashweni okusha komdlavuza, igciwane lomkhuhlane liguqulwa ngokwezakhi zofuzo ukuze libopheke, lingene, futhi liphindaphindwe emaseli, okubangela ukuba aqhume. Igciwane lomkhuhlane eliguquliwe alikwazi ukuphindaphinda uma iphrotheni ye-wildtype p53 ikhona esitokisini. Lokhu kwelashwa kwelapha kanjani umdlavuza ngaphandle kokulimaza amaseli anempilo?
answer21: Igciwane eliguquliwe liphindaphinda kuphela kumaseli omdlavuza
distractor21a: Igciwane eliguquliwe lithelela futhi lingene kuphela emangqamuzaneni omdlavuza
distractor21b: Igciwane eliguquliwe liyaphindaphindeka kumaseli ajwayelekile kanye nawomdlavuza
distractor21c: Igciwane eliguquliwe lithelela futhi lingene emaseli ajwayelekile kuphela
question22: Umuthi oklanyelwe ukubuyisela izakhi zofuzo ezithulile emaseli omdlavuza ungenzani?
answer22: Ukuvimbela i-methylation ye-DNA kanye nokususwa kwe-acetylation yama-histone
distractor22a: Kuvimbela i-methylation ye-DNA kanye ne-acetylation yama-histones
distractor22b: Kuvimbela ukuncipha kwe-acetylation ye-DNA kanye ne-methylation yama-histones
distractor22c: Kuvimbela i-acetylation ye-DNA kanye nokususwa kwe-methylation yama-histone
question23: Lithini igama elinikezwa abalawuli bemijikelezo yamaseli abahle abangabangela umdlavuza uma beguquliwe?
question24: Yikuphi okuhlukanisa kangcono amaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic?
answer24: Amaseli e-Eukaryotic aqukethe i-nucleus kanti ama-prokaryotes awanawo, kanti ama-eukaryotes abonisa ukuhlukaniswa okukhulu okuvumela ukulawulwa okukhulu kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor24a: Ama-Prokaryotes ane-nucleus kanti ama-eukaryotes awanawo, kodwa ama-eukaryotes abonisa ukuhlukaniswa okukhulu okuvumela ukulawulwa okukhulu kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor24b: Amaseli e-Prokaryotic awanzima kangako futhi enza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo okulawulwa kakhulu kanti ama-eukaryotes enza ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo okulawulwa kancane.
distractor24c: Amaseli e-Eukaryotic ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu futhi enza ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okungalawulwa kakhulu kanti amaseli e-prokaryotic enza ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo okulawulwa kakhulu.
question25: Yisiphi isitatimende esinembile mayelana nomehluko phakathi kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic?
answer25: Ama-prokaryotes alawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezingeni lokubhalwa phansi kanti ama-eukaryotes alawula emazingeni amaningi okuhlanganisa i-epigenetic, i-transcriptional kanye ne-translational
distractor25a: Ama-prokaryotes alawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezingeni lokuhumusha kanti ama-eukaryotes alawula ezingeni lokubhalwa ukuze alawule amazinga amaprotheni.
distractor25b: Ama-prokaryotes alawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngosizo lwezicindezeli kanye nama-activator kuyilapho ama-eukaryotes elawula ukuvezwa ngokwehlisa ama-mRNA transcripts, ngaleyo ndlela elawula amazinga amaprotheni.
distractor25c: Ama-prokaryotes alawula amazinga amaprotheni esebenzisa ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic kuyilapho ama-eukaryotes elawula amazinga amaprotheni ngokulawula izinga lokubhalwa nokuhumusha.
question26: Wonke amangqamuzana ento eyodwa abelana nge-genome. Kodwa-ke, ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa, amanye amangqamuzana akhula abe amangqamuzana esikhumba kanti amanye akhula abe amangqamuzana emisipha. Imiyalelo efanayo yezakhi zofuzo ingaphumela kanjani ezinhlotsheni ezimbili ezahlukene zamangqamuzana ento efanayo? Chaza kahle impendulo yakho
answer26: Izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ziveza izinhlobo ezahlukene zamajini afanayo. Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo kulawulwa ngokuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic, izici zokubhala, ukucutshungulwa kwe-RNA, ukuhumusha, kanye nezindlela zangemva kokuhumusha, okuvumela amangqamuzana esikhumba nemisipha ukuthi akhiqize amaprotheni ahlukene futhi enze imisebenzi ehlukene naphezu kokuba ne-DNA efanayo.
distractor26a: Amaseli esikhumba nemisipha alahlekelwa unomphela izakhi zofuzo ezingazidingi ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa
distractor26b: Uhlobo ngalunye lweseli luqukethe i-genome ehlukile edalwa ngesikhathi sokukhula kombungu
distractor26c: Izakhi zofuzo zenziwa zisebenze ngokungahleliwe kuseli ngayinye, zikhiqiza izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ngaphandle komthethonqubo
question27: Yisiphi kwezitatimende ezilandelayo esichaza ukuqoshwa kwe-prokaryotic kwe-lac operon?
answer27: I-Lactose isebenza njenge-inducer ye-lac operon uma i-glucose ingekho
distractor27a: Uma i-lactose ne-glucose zikhona endaweni, ukukopishwa kwe-lac operon kuyabangelwa
distractor27b: Uma i-lactose ikhona kodwa i-glucose ingekho, i-lac operon iyacindezelwa
distractor27c: I-Lactose isebenza njenge-inducer ye-lac operon uma i-glucose ikhona
question28: I-lac operon inezindawo ezilawulayo ezifana ne-promoter kanye nezakhi zofuzo zesakhiwo i-lacZ, i-lacY, kanye ne-lacA, okuyikhodi yamaprotheni ahilelekile ekugayweni kwe-lactose. Uyoba yini umphumela wokuguqulwa okungafanele kwenye yezakhi zofuzo zesakhiwo se-lac operon?
answer28: Ukubhalwa kuzoqhubeka kodwa i-lactose ngeke isetshenziswe kahle
distractor28a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuzomisa ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor28c: I-lacA eguquliwe izoguqula i-lactose noma i-maltodextrin ibe yi-metabolism
question29: Kwezinye izifo, ukuguqulwa kwezinguquko ze-epigenetic kuvala izakhi zofuzo ezivame ukuvezwa. Ngomqondo, ungayiguqula kanjani le nqubo ukuze uvule lezi zakhi zofuzo futhi?
answer29: Ngokuguqula ukuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic—isibonelo, ukunciphisa i-DNA methylation nokwandisa i-histone acetylation—ukuvula kabusha i-chromatin nokuvumela izici zokubhala kanye ne-RNA polymerase ukuthi kufinyelele ku-gene
distractor29a: Ngokushintsha unomphela ukulandelana kwe-DNA ukuze kususwe i-gene ethulisiwe
distractor29b: Ngokwehlisa i-mRNA yesakhi sofuzo esithulile ukuze ikwazi ukulotshwa futhi
distractor29c: Ngokuvimba ama-ribosome ekuhumusheni amaprotheni kuze kube yilapho ukubhalwa kabusha kombhalo
question30: I-Flooring Locus C (FLC) iyi-gene ebangela ukuqhakaza kwezitshalo ezithile. I-FLC ivezwa ezitshalweni ezintsha, okuvimbela ukuqhakaza. Lapho ibhekene namazinga okushisa abandayo, ukuvezwa kwe-FLC kuyehla futhi isitshalo siyaqhakaza. I-FLC ilawulwa ngokuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic. Hlobo luni lokuguqulwa kwe-epigenetic olukhona ezitshalweni ezintsha kanye nangemuva kokuvezwa emakhazeni?
answer30: Ezitshalweni ezintsha, ama-acetylation e-histone akhona; lapho kubanda, i-methylation iyenzeka
distractor30a: Ezitshalweni ezintsha, kukhona i-histone deacetylations; lapho kubanda, kwenzeka i-methylation
distractor30b: Ezitshalweni ezintsha, kukhona i-histone methylations; lapho kubanda, kwenzeka i-acetylation
distractor30c: Ezitshalweni ezintsha, kukhona i-histone methylations; lapho kubanda, kwenzeka i-deacetylation
question31: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo esifundeni somkhuthazi kungashintsha ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Chaza ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kanjani
answer31: Abagqugquzeli abaguquliwe bashintsha indawo yokubopha ukuze kube nezici zokubhala ukuze kwandiswe noma kwehliswe izinga lokubhala
distractor31a: Abagqugquzeli abaguquliwe banciphisa izinga lokubhalwa ngokushintsha indawo yokubopha yesici sokubhalwa
distractor31b: Abagqugquzeli abaguquliwe bandisa izinga lokubhalwa ngokushintsha indawo yokubopha yesici sokubhalwa
distractor31c: Abagqugquzeli abaguquliwe bashintsha indawo yokubopha ngenxa yezinto zokubhala futhi ngaleyo ndlela bayeke ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo eziseduze.
question32: Yini engenzeka uma iseli linesici esiningi kakhulu sokubhala esisebenzayo?
answer32: Izinga lokubhalwa kwemibhalo lizokhula, lishintshe umsebenzi weseli
distractor32a: Izinga lokubhalwa kwemibhalo lizoncipha, livimbele imisebenzi yamaseli
distractor32b: Izinga lokubhalwa phansi liyancipha ngenxa yokuvaleka kwezici zokubhalwa phansi
distractor32c: Izinga lokubhalwa kwemibhalo liyakhuphuka ngenxa yokuvaleka kwezici zokubhalwa kwemibhalo
question34: Chaza ukuthi ama-RBP angavimbela kanjani ama-miRNA ekungcoliseni i-molecule ye-RNA
answer34: Ama-RBP angabopha kuqala i-RNA, ngaleyo ndlela avimbele ukubopha kwe-miRNA, okonakalisa i-RNA
distractor34a: Ama-RBP abopha i-miRNA, ngaleyo ndlela avikele i-mRNA ekuwohlokeni
distractor34b: Ama-RBP e-methylate miRNA ukuvimbela ukusebenza kwawo ngaleyo ndlela amise ukuwohloka kwe-mRNA
distractor34c: Ama-RBP aqondisa ukuwohloka kwe-miRNA ngosizo lwe-DICER protein complex
question35: Izisusa zangaphandle zingakushintsha kanjani ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngemva kokulotshwa?
distractor35a: Imisebe ye-UV ingashintsha i-methylation kanye ne-acetylation yamaprotheni
distractor35b: Izinto ezingaphandle ezibangela ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-acetylation kanye nokungasebenzi kahle kwe-methylation yombhalo
distractor35c: Imisebe ye-UV ingabangela ukufiphala kwamaprotheni okubopha i-RNA
question36: Ukuguqulwa kwamaprotheni kungashintsha ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngezindlela eziningi. Chaza ukuthi i-phosphorylation yamaprotheni ingashintsha kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
answer36: I-phosphorylation yamaprotheni ingashintsha ukuhumusha, ukuthutha kwe-RNA, ukuzinza kwe-RNA noma ukuguqulwa kwangemva kokubhalwa kwe-transcription
distractor36a: I-phosphorylation yamaprotheni ingashintsha ukuphindaphindeka kwe-DNA, ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli, ukuqashelwa kwe-pathogen kanye nokuqina kwe-RNA
distractor36b: Amaprotheni ane-phosphorylated athinta ukuhumusha kuphela futhi angabangela umdlavuza ngokushintsha umsebenzi we-p53
distractor36c: Amaprotheni aqukethe i-phosphory athinta kuphela i-RNA shuttling, ukuzinza kwe-RNA, kanye nokuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha
question37: Izinguquko ekuguqulweni kwe-epigenetic zishintsha ukufinyeleleka kanye nokubhalwa kwe-DNA. Chaza ukuthi izinto ezithinta imvelo, njengokuvezwa kokukhanya kwe-ultraviolet, zingaguqula kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
answer37: Imisebe ye-UV ingabangela i-methylation kanye nokususwa kwe-acetylation kwezakhi zofuzo okungashintsha ukufinyeleleka kanye nokubhalwa kwe-DNA
distractor37a: Imisebe ye-UV ingabangela i-phosphorylation kanye ne-acetylation ye-DNA nama-histones okungashintsha amandla okubhala kwe-DNA.
distractor37b: Imisebe ye-UV ingabangela i-methylation kanye ne-phosphorylation yezisekelo ze-DNA okungase kuncishiswe okungenza i-DNA ingatholakali kalula.
distractor37c: Imisebe ye-UV ingabangela i-methylation kanye ne-acetylation yama-histone okwenza i-DNA iqine kakhulu futhi iholele ekungafinyeleleki kalula.
question38: Kuthuthukiswa imithi emisha enciphisa i-DNA methylation futhi ivimbele ukususwa kwamaqembu e-acetyl kumaprotheni e-histone. Chaza ukuthi le mithi ingathinta kanjani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ukusiza ukubulala amangqamuzana omdlavuza
answer38: Le mithi igcina izinhlobo ze-DNA ezingasebenzi kahle kanye ne-acetylated ukuze kugcinwe ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezidingekayo.
distractor38a: Izinhlobo ze-DNA ezingasebenzi kahle kanye ne-acetylated ziyaguqulwa lapho kuvezwa i-gene ethulisiwe.
distractor38b: Umuthi uhlanganisa ama-methylate nama-acetylates ezakhi zofuzo ezithulile ukuze uzibuyisele emuva.
distractor38c: Izidakamizwa zigcina i-DNA methylation kanye ne-acetylation ukuze kuthuliswe izakhi zofuzo ezingabalulekile emangqamuzaneni omdlavuza
question39: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.17. Yisiphi isiphetho esingasithola kule grafu?
answer39: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ezingxenyeni zokuqala zesakhi sofuzo kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi kubangele umdlavuza
distractor39a: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo esifundeni esiphakathi sezakhi zofuzo kungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi kubangele umdlavuza
distractor39c: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kugxile kuma-codon ayi-5. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwamanye ama-codon akukhulisi ingozi yomdlavuza.
question40: Chaza ukuthi umuthi oqondene nomuntu ngamunye uyini nokuthi ungasetshenziswa kanjani ukwelapha umdlavuza
answer40: Imithi eyenzelwe wena izohluka ngokuya ngohlobo lwezinguquko kanye nephethini yokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor40a: Imithi inikezwa ngokusekelwe ohlotsheni lwesimila esitholakala emzimbeni womuntu.
distractor40b: Imithi eyenzelwe wena inikezwa ngokusekelwe kuphela ezimpawini zesiguli
distractor40c: Imithi ivame ukuhlukahluka kuye ngokuthi umdlavuza ungakanani kanye nesigaba sawo.
question41: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okutholakala kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes?
question42: I-enzyme i-polyadenylate polymerase ikhuthaza ukungezwa kwe-adenosine monophosphate emaphethelweni angu-3’ e-mRNA ukuze kwakheke umsila we-poly-A. Uma i-enzyme ivinjiwe ukuze ingakwazi ukusebenza, umphumela ubuyoba:
answer42: Ukwehla kokuqina kwe-mRNA kuma-eukaryotes, futhi akukho mphumela kuma-prokaryotes
distractor42a: Ukuqina kwe-mRNA kuma-eukaryotes, kanye nokwehla kokuqina kwe-mRNA kuma-prokaryotes
distractor42b: Akukho mphumela kuma-eukaryotes, kanye nokuqina kwe-mRNA okwandisiwe kuma-prokaryotes
distractor42c: Akukho mphumela kuma-eukaryotes, kanye nokwehla kokuqina kwe-mRNA kuma-prokaryotes
question43: Chaza izindlela ezimbili lapho ukulawulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuhluka khona kanye nezindlela ezimbili okufana ngazo kuma-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes
answer43: Ama-prokaryotes abonisa ukuhumusha okubhaliwe ngokubambisana kuyilapho ama-eukaryotes enza ukubhalwa ngaphambi kokuhumusha; kuzo zombili izinhlobo zamaseli, ukulawulwa kwenzeka ngokubopha izinto zokubhala, ama-activator, kanye nama-repressors
distractor43a: Ama-Prokaryotes enza ukubhalwa kwemibhalo ngaphambi kokuhumusha kanti ama-eukaryotes abonisa ukuhumusha kokubhalwa kwemibhalo ngokubambisana (izinqubo zenzeka ku-organelle efanayo)
distractor43b: Ama-prokaryotes abonisa ukuhumusha okubhaliwe ngokubambisana okulawulwa ngaphambi kokuhumusha kanti ama-eukaryotes enza ukubhalwa ngaphambi kokuhumusha okulawulwa kuphela ezingeni lokubhalwa. Kuzo zombili izizinda, izici zokubhalwa, ama-activator, kanye nama-repressors anikeza umthethonqubo
distractor43c: Ama-prokaryotes abonisa ukuhumusha okubhaliwe ngokubambisana okwenzeka ku-nucleus kuyilapho ama-eukaryotes ebonisa ukubhalwa ngaphambi kokuhumusha. Kuzo zombili izinhlobo zamaseli, ukulawulwa kwenzeka kusetshenziswa izinto zokubhala, ama-activator, kanye nama-repressors
question44: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.19. Zihambelana nani izifunda 1 no-5?
question45: Uyoba yini umphumela wokuguquka kweprotheni ecindezelayo eyayivimbela ekuhlanganiseni i-lactose?
answer45: I-repressor izobopha opharetha uma kukhona i-lactose
distractor45a: I-repressor izobopha i-lactose uma isuswa kumuntu oyisebenzisayo
distractor45b: I-repressor ngeke ibophe opharetha uma kukhona i-lactose
distractor45c: I-repressor ngeke ibophe opharetha uma kungekho i-lactose
question46: Uhlobo luni lokuguqulwa olungabonakala ku-GR gene kuwo wonke amagundane asanda kuzalwa?
question47: Uhlobo luni lokuguqulwa oluzobonakala ku-GR gene kumagundane akhuliswe kakhulu?
question48: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.18. Yikuphi ukususwa okusesithuthukisini esihilelekile ekulawuleni i-gene?
question49: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.18. Yikuphi ukususwa okuku-repressor ehilelekile ekulawuleni i-gene?
question50: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.19. Uguquko kusiphi isifunda okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi lulimaze iseli?
question51:
Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeke kwenzeke ngenxa yokuvezwa yi-UV uma ukuguqulwa kwe-p53 kuvimbela iphrotheni ye-p53?
Ukulimala kwe-DNA
ukusebenza kwe-p53
ukusebenza kwe-p21
I-Apoptosis
question52: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.20. Yiziphi izifunda kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-5 kumdwebo?
answer52: 1, 3, kanye no-5 bangama-exons; 2 kanye no-4 bangama-intron
distractor52c: 2, 3, kanye no-4 bangama-exons; 1 kanye no-5 bangama-intron
question53: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.21. Luhlobo luni lokuhlanganisa okuhlukile olukhona kulesi sibonelo?
question54: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.22. Uyoba yini umphumela wokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-p53 okuzenza zingasasebenzi?
answer54: Akukho ukuxebuka kwesikhumba okuzokwenzeka ngenxa yokuvezwa yi-UV
distractor54c: Akukho monakalo we-DNA ozokwenzeka ngenxa yokuchayeka kwe-UV
question55: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.24. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana ne-Anabaena esingamanga?
answer55: Ukuguqulwa kwe-HetR okwenza ingasebenzi kuzovumela namaseli aseduze ukuba akhule njengama-heterocyst
distractor55a: Ukunciphisa ukuhlushwa kwama-ion e-calcium yamahhala kuzovimbela ukukhula kwe-heterocyst
distractor55b: Uma kukhona i-nitrogen engaguquki, i-NtcA ngeke ivezwe
distractor55c: Amazinga aphansi e-nitrogen aqinile aholela ekwandeni kwamazinga e-PatS
question56: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.23. Kwenzekani uma kukhona i-tryptophan?
answer56: I-repressor ibopha ku-opharetha, futhi ukwenziwa kwe-RNA kuvinjelwe
distractor56a: I-RNA polymerase ibopha ku-opharetha, futhi ukwenziwa kwe-RNA kuyavinjelwa
distractor56b: I-Tryptophan ibopha ku-repressor, bese ukwakheka kwe-RNA kuyaqhubeka
distractor56c: I-Tryptophan ibopha i-RNA polymerase, futhi ukwakheka kwe-RNA kuyaqhubeka
question57: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.23. Kwenzekani uma kungekho i-tryptophan?
question58: Bheka uMfanekiso 16.24. Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho izindlela ukudluliselwa kwesignali okuhlanganisa ngazo umsebenzi weseli, yikuphi kokubikezela okulandelayo okuhambisana kakhulu nolwazi olunikezwe ngenhla?
answer58: Endaweni ene-nitrogen ephansi engaguquki, ukwelapha amaseli e-Anabaena nge-calcium-binding compound kufanele kuvimbele ukuhlukaniswa kwe-heterocyst
distractor58a: Uhlobo oluveza kakhulu i-patS gene kufanele lukhiqize ama-heterocyst amaningi endaweni ene-nitrogen ephansi
distractor58b: Endaweni ene-nitrogen eningi engaguquki, amazinga e-calcium yamahhala kufanele abe phezulu kuwo wonke amaseli, okuvimbela ukukhula kwama-heterocyst.
distractor58c: Ezindaweni ezine-nitrogen eningi engaguquki, ukulahleka kwe-hetR gene kufanele kubangele ukukhula kwe-heterocyst

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Ezinye zezinto ezinkulu ezifezwe yi-biotechnology zisemkhakheni wezokwelapha nocwaningo lwezokwelapha. Isibonelo, ukwehluleka kwamathumbu ngenxa yokulahleka kwezicubu zamathumbu noma okungajwayelekile kuyinkinga evamile ezinganeni ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Izinkinga zamathumbu zivame futhi kubantu abaye basuswa izingxenye zamathumbu abo amancane ngezizathu, njengeSifo sikaCrohn, umdlavuza, kanye nokuvaleka. Izinkinga ezibangelwa ukwehluleka kwamathumbu zingafaka phakathi isifo sesibindi, ukukhula ngokweqile kwamagciwane, ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, kanye nokungondleki kahle.

 Ososayensi basanda kuthuthukisa indlela yokuklama amathumbu abantu avela emangqamuzaneni abantu besebenzisa amagundane. Besebenzisa ingxube yamagundane anempilo namaseli abantu bese bewabeka esikafuleni esiswini samagundane angenawo amasosha omzimba aqinile, amangqamuzana abantu asebenzayo amathumbu akhula zingakapheli amasonto amane. Lokhu kungaba yintuthuko edingekayo ukusiza iziguli ezihlushwa ukwehluleka kwamathumbu. Bheka Umfanekiso 17.1
question1: I-biotechnology ingaba kanjani negalelo ekwelapheni ukwehluleka kwamathumbu?
answer1: Ingasetshenziswa ukuklama izicubu zamathumbu omuntu ezisebenzayo ezivela kumaseli omuntu
distractor1a: Kungavimbela unomphela zonke izifo zamathumbu ngokushintsha ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo
distractor1b: Ingathatha indawo yokugaya ukudla ngokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA
distractor1c: Kungaqeda isidingo sezakhamzimba ezinganeni ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi
question2: Kungani izicubu zamathumbu ezakhiwe zingaba usizo ezinganeni ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi?
answer2: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi zingase zibe nokwehluleka kwamathumbu ngenxa yezicubu zamathumbu ezilahlekile noma ezingavamile
distractor2a: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi azikwazi ukukhiqiza i-DNA
distractor2b: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi azinawo wonke ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla unomphela
distractor2c: Izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi azidingi izicubu zamathumbu ukuze zimunce izakhamzimba
question3: Yisiphi isimo esishiwo njengesizathu esenza abanye abantu basuswe izingxenye zamathumbu amancane?
answer3: Isifo sikaCrohn
question4: Yisiphi isici esingaba khona ngenxa yokwehluleka kwamathumbu?
answer4: Ukungondleki kahle
question5: Iyiphi indima eyadlalwa yi-scaffolding ekuhlolweni kobunjiniyela bezicubu zamathumbu?
answer5: Yanikeza isakhiwo lapho amangqamuzana amathumbu angakhula khona
question6: Kungani amagundane angenawo amasosha omzimba awusizo kulolu cwaningo lwe-biotechnology?
answer6: Babengenawo amathuba amaningi okulahla amangqamuzana amathumbu abantu
distractor6c: Baguqula amangqamuzana egundane abe amangqamuzana ebhaktheriya
question7: Yini eyakhiqizwa phakathi kwamasonto amane ekuhlolweni okuchaziwe?
answer7: Amaseli amathumbu omuntu asebenzayo
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani lolu cwaningo luyisibonelo se-biotechnology?
answer8: Isebenzisa amangqamuzana aphilayo kanye nezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ukuthuthukisa ukwelashwa okungenzeka
distractor8a: Isebenzisa izingxenye zomshini kuphela ukufaka esikhundleni sezitho zomzimba
distractor8b: Kugwema ukusetshenziswa kwamaseli noma izinto eziphilayo
distractor8c: Ifunda izinsalela ukuze inqume ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ingabe udle okusanhlamvu kwasekuseni noma utamatisi esaladini lakho lesidlo sakusihlwa? Ingabe ukhona umuntu omaziyo othole ukwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze elaphe isifo esifana nomdlavuza? Ingabe isikole sakho, umhlinzeki womshuwalense wezempilo, noma umqashi kufanele akwazi ukufinyelela iphrofayili yakho yezakhi zofuzo? Ukuqonda ukuthi i-DNA isebenza kanjani kuye kwavumela ososayensi ukuthi bahlanganise kabusha ama-molecule e-DNA, bahlanganise izinto eziphilayo, futhi bakhiqize amagundane akhanya ebumnyameni. Cishe sidle ukudla okuguqulwe izakhi zofuzo futhi sijwayelene nendlela ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA okusetshenziswa ngayo ukuxazulula ubugebengu. Ukuphathwa kwe-DNA ngabantu kuye kwaholela kuma-bacteria angavikela izitshalo ezinambuzaneni ezilokazane futhi abuyisele imvelo. Ubuchwepheshe be-biotechnologies busetshenziswe futhi ukukhiqiza i-insulin, ama-hormone, ama-antibiotic, kanye nemithi eqeda amahlule egazi. Izakhi zofuzo eziqhathanisayo ziveza ukuqonda okusha ngobudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlobo, futhi ukulandelana kwe-DNA kwembula ukwakheka kwethu kwezakhi zofuzo. Kodwa-ke, ukuphathwa kwe-DNA kuza nemithwalo yemfanelo yomphakathi neyokuziphatha, okuphakamisa imibuzo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwayo okufanele.

 Ama-Nucleic acid angahlukaniswa namaseli ukuze ahlaziywe ngokucubungula ama-membrane esisele futhi abhubhise wonke amanye ama-macromolecule nge-enzymatic. Ama-chromosome aqhekekile noma aphelele angahlukaniswa ngesisekelo sobukhulu (ubude be-base pair) nge-gel electrophoresis. Ukulandelana okufushane kwe-DNA noma i-RNA kungandiswa kusetshenziswa i-polymerase chain reaction (PCR). Ubuchwepheshe be-Recombinant DNA bungahlanganisa i-DNA evela emithonjeni ehlukene besebenzisa ama-plasmid noma ama-virus angama-bacterial njenge-vectors ukuthwala izakhi zofuzo zangaphandle emaseli abanikazi, okuholela ezintweni eziphilayo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo (ama-GMO). Ama-transgenic bacteria, izitshalo zezolimo ezifana nommbila nelayisi, kanye nezilwane zasemapulazini zikhiqiza imikhiqizo yamaprotheni efana nama-hormone kanye nemijovo ezuzisa abantu. (Kubalulekile ukuzikhumbuza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe be-recombinant bungenzeka ngoba ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo iyinto yonke, futhi izinqubo zokubhala nokuhumusha ziyafana kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo.) I-Cloning ikhiqiza amakhophi afanayo ezakhi zofuzo e-DNA, amaseli, noma ngisho nezinto eziphilayo eziphelele (i-reproductive cloning). Ukuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo kukhomba izakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo, futhi ukwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo kungasetshenziswa ukwelapha noma ukwelapha isifo esizuzwa njengefa. Kodwa-ke, kuvela imibuzo kulezi zobuchwepheshe kufaka phakathi ukuphepha kwama-GMO kanye nezinkinga zobumfihlo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Biotechnology ukusetshenziswa kwezinto eziphilayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubuchwepheshe. I-Biotechnology yayisetshenziselwa ukuzalisa imfuyo nezitshalo isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba kuqondwe isisekelo sesayensi salezi zindlela. Selokhu kwatholakala isakhiwo se-DNA ngo-1953, insimu ye-biotechnology ikhule ngokushesha kokubili ocwaningweni lwezemfundo kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Ukusetshenziswa okuyinhloko kwalolu buchwepheshe kusemithini (ekukhiqizweni kwemithi yokugoma kanye nama-antibiotic) kanye nezolimo (ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo zezitshalo, njengokwandisa isivuno). I-Biotechnology inezinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zezimboni, njengokubilisa, ukwelashwa kokuchitheka kukawoyela, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwama-biofuel
question1: Kuyini i-biotechnology?

distractor2b: Ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo ziqukethe ama-chromosome afanayo
distractor2c: Ngoba amabhaktheriya ngokwemvelo adlulisela zonke izakhi zofuzo kwezinye izinhlobo
question3: Iyini injongo eyinhloko ye-polymerase chain reaction (PCR)?
answer3: Ukukhulisa ukulandelana kwe-DNA noma i-RNA ethile
question4: Yimuphi inqubo ehlukanisa izingcezu ze-DNA ngokobukhulu?
answer4: I-electrophoresis yejeli
question5: Uyini umsebenzi we-vector kubuchwepheshe be-DNA ephindaphindayo?

answer6: Ibhaktheriya eklanyelwe ukukhiqiza i-insulin yomuntu
question7: Iyini inhloso yokwelashwa ngezakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ukwelapha noma ukwelapha izifo ngokungenisa noma ukuguqula izakhi zofuzo

distractor7b: Ukufaka esikhundleni sawo wonke amaprotheni ngama-molecule okwenziwa
question8: Iyiphi inkinga evame ukuhlotshaniswa ne-biotechnology?
answer8: Ukukhathazeka ngokuziphatha kanye nobumfihlo mayelana nolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo
distractor8b: Ukuqedwa kwazo zonke izifo zofuzo emhlabeni jikelele
distractor8c: Ukungenzeki kokuguqula izinto eziphilayo ngokwezakhi zofuzo

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA)
chapterContent: Ukuze uqonde amasu ayisisekelo asetshenziswa ukusebenza nama-nucleic acid, khumbula ukuthi ama-nucleic acid angama-macromolecule enziwe ngama-nucleotide (ushukela, i-phosphate, kanye nesisekelo se-nitrogen) axhunywe ngama-phosphodiester bonds. Amaqembu e-phosphate kula ma-molecule ngalinye anokushaja okungenayo. Iqoqo lonke lama-molecule e-DNA ku-nucleus libizwa ngokuthi i-genome. I-DNA inezintambo ezimbili ezihambisanayo ezixhunywe ngama-hydrogen bonds phakathi kwezisekelo ezibhangqiwe. Izintambo ezimbili zingahlukaniswa ngokuchayeka emazingeni okushisa aphezulu (i-DNA denaturation) futhi zingaphinde zihlanganiswe ngokupholisa. I-DNA ingaphindaphindwa yi-enzyme ye-DNA polymerase. Ngokungafani ne-DNA, etholakala ku-nucleus yamaseli e-eukaryotic, ama-molecule e-RNA ashiya i-nucleus. Uhlobo oluvame kakhulu lwe-RNA oluhlaziywayo yi-messenger RNA (mRNA) ngoba imelela izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni ezivezwa ngenkuthalo. Kodwa-ke, ama-molecule e-RNA aletha ezinye izinselele ekuhlaziyweni, njengoba ngokuvamile engazinzile kune-DNA
question1: Kungani ama-molecule e-DNA ethuthela ku-electrode enhle ngesikhathi se-gel electrophoresis?
answer1: Ngoba amaqembu e-phosphate ku-DNA aphethe ishaja engalungile
distractor1a: Ngoba i-DNA iqukethe izisekelo ze-nitrogen ezishajwe kahle
distractor1c: Ngoba i-DNA ibopha ngqo ku-electrode enhle
question2: Iyini i-genome?
answer2: Iqoqo eliphelele lama-molecule e-DNA ku-nucleus yeseli
distractor2c: I-chromosome eyodwa ephethe zonke izakhi zofuzo
question3: Yini ebangela ukuthi imicu emibili ye-DNA ihlukane ngesikhathi sokuguquka kwe-DNA?
answer3: Ukuchayeka emazingeni okushisa aphezulu okuphazamisa izibopho ze-hydrogen
distractor3a: Ukuchayeka emazingeni okushisa aphansi okuqinisa izibopho ze-phosphodiester
question4: Kwenzekani uma i-DNA engcolile ipholiswa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele?
answer4: Izintambo ze-DNA ezengeziwe ziphinde zivuselelwe ngokuguqula izibopho ze-hydrogen
question5: Yimuphi i-enzyme ekhiqiza imicu emisha ye-DNA ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA?
answer5: I-DNA polymerase
question6: Kungani i-RNA yesithunywa (mRNA) ivame ukuhlaziywa ku-biotechnology?
answer6: Ngoba imelela izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni ezivezwa ngenkuthalo
question7: Kungani i-RNA ngokuvamile kunzima ukuyihlaziya kune-DNA?
answer7: I-RNA ayizinzile futhi yonakala kalula kune-DNA
distractor7c: I-RNA ihlala ikhona njenge-molecule enezintambo ezimbili
question8: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesibopho oluxhumanisa ama-nucleotide ngaphakathi kwentambo ye-DNA?
answer8: Izibopho ze-Phosphodiester

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA) | Ukukhishwa kwe-DNA kanye ne-RNA
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA) | Ukukhishwa kwe-DNA kanye ne-RNA
chapterContent:
Ukuze kufundwe noma kulawulwe ama-nucleic acid, i-DNA noma i-RNA kumele kuqala ihlukaniswe noma ikhishwe emaseli. Kusetshenziswa amasu ahlukahlukene ukukhipha izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-DNA (Isithombe 17.2). Amasu amaningi okukhipha i-nucleic acid ahilela izinyathelo zokuphula iseli futhi asebenzise ukusabela kwe-enzyme ukubhubhisa wonke ama-macromolecule angafunwa (njengokuwohloka kwama-molecule angafuneki kanye nokuhlukaniswa nesampula ye-DNA). Amaseli aphulwa kusetshenziswa i-lysis buffer (isixazululo esivame ukuba yi-detergent); i-lysis isho ukuhlukana.” Lawa ma-enzyme ahlukanisa ama-lipid molecule kuma-membrane esisele kanye nama-membrane enuzi. Ama-Macromolecule awasebenzi kusetshenziswa ama-enzyme afana nama-protease aphula amaprotheni, kanye nama-ribonuclease (ama-RNA) aphula i-RNA. I-DNA ibe isiba yingozi kusetshenziswa utshwala. I-DNA ye-genomic yomuntu ivame ukubonakala njenge-gelatinous, emhlophe. Amasampula e-DNA angagcinwa eqandisiwe ku--80°C iminyaka eminingana.

 Ukuhlaziywa kwe-RNA kwenziwa ukuze kufundwe amaphethini okubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kumaseli. I-RNA ayizinzile ngokwemvelo ngoba ama-RNA avame ukuba khona emvelweni futhi kunzima kakhulu ukuwavala. Ngokufanayo ne-DNA, ukukhishwa kwe-RNA kuhilela ukusetshenziswa kwama-buffer nama-enzyme ahlukahlukene ukuze kuvinjelwe ama-macromolecule futhi kulondolozwe i-RNA.
question1: Yisiphi isinyathelo sokuqala esikhulu sokukhipha i-DNA noma i-RNA emaseli?
answer1: Ukuphula amaseli usebenzisa i-lysis buffer
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-lysis buffer ngesikhathi sokukhishwa kwe-nucleic acid?
question3: Kungani ama-protease engezwa ngesikhathi sokukhishwa kwe-DNA?
answer3: Ukuphula amaprotheni angafuneki
question4: Uyini umsebenzi wama-ribonuclease (ama-RNases) ngesikhathi sokukhishwa kwe-DNA?
answer4: Ziyawohloka ama-molecule e-RNA angafuneki
question5: I-DNA ihlukaniswa kanjani ngokuvamile nesisombululo sokukhipha?
answer5: Ngokuyithela ngotshwala
question6: I-DNA ye-genomic yomuntu ehlanziwe ivame ukubonakala kanjani ngemva kwemvula?
answer6: Isisindo esimhlophe esinongwengwezi
question7: Kungani kunzima kakhulu ukusebenza nge-RNA kune-DNA?
answer7: I-RNA ayizinzile kangako ngoba ama-RNase asakazeke kabanzi futhi kunzima ukuwavimba
question8: Iyini injongo yama-buffer nama-enzyme asetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokukhishwa kwe-RNA?
answer8: Ukuvimbela ama-macromolecule angafuneki nokulondoloza i-RNA

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA) | I-Gel Electrophoresis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA) | I-Gel Electrophoresis
chapterContent: Ngenxa yokuthi ama-nucleic acid angama-ion ashajelwe kabi ku-pH engathathi hlangothi noma eyisisekelo endaweni enamanzi, angashukunyiswa yinsimu kagesi. I-gel electrophoresis iyindlela esetshenziselwa ukuhlukanisa ama-molecule ngokusekelwe kusayizi, kusetshenziswa le charge. Ama-nucleic acid angahlukaniswa njengama-chromosome aphelele noma izingcezu. Ama-nucleic acid alayishwa endaweni eseduze ne-electrode engemihle ye-semisolid, i-porous gel matrix bese edonswa aye ku-electrode engemihle ekugcineni okuphambene kwe-gel. Ama-molecule amancane ahamba nge-pores ku-gel ngokushesha kunama-molecule amakhulu; lo mehluko ngesivinini sokufuduka uhlukanisa izingcezu ngokusekelwe kusayizi. Kunezibonelo ezijwayelekile zesisindo sama-molecule ezingaqhutshwa eceleni kwama-molecule ukuze kunikezwe ukuqhathanisa usayizi. Ama-nucleic acid ku-gel matrix angabonwa kusetshenziswa amadayi ahlukahlukene e-fluorescent noma anombala. Izingcezu ze-nucleic acid ezihlukile zivela njengezibopho ezikude ezithile ukusuka phezulu kwe-gel (ukuphela kwe-electrode engemihle) ngokusekelwe kusayizi wazo (Isithombe 17.3). Ingxube yezingcezu ze-DNA ye-genomic ezinobukhulu obuhlukahlukene ibonakala njenge-smear ende, kanti i-DNA ye-genomic engakanqunywa ivame ukuba nkulu kakhulu ukuba idlule ejelini futhi yakha ibhande elilodwa elikhulu phezulu kwejeli.
question1: Yisiphi isici sama-nucleic acid esivumela ukuthi ahlukaniswe yi-gel electrophoresis?
answer1: Ukushaja kwabo okungenayo i-net kubavumela ukuthi bahambe ensimini kagesi
distractor1a: Ukushaja kwabo okuhle kubadonsela ku-electrode engemihle
question2: Iyini injongo eyinhloko ye-gel electrophoresis?
question3: Izingcezu ze-DNA zithutha zibheke ngakuphi ngesikhathi se-gel electrophoresis?
answer3: Kusukela ku-electrode engemihle kuya ku-electrode engemihle
distractor3a: Kusukela ku-electrode enhle kuya ku-electrode engemihle
question4: Kungani izingcezu ezincane ze-DNA zithutha zidlulela phambili ngejeli kunezingcezu ezinkulu?
answer4: Zihamba kalula ngemibhobho yejeli
question5: Iyini inhloso yokusebenzisa indinganiso yesisindo sama-molecule eceleni kwamasampula e-DNA?
answer5: Ukulinganisa ubukhulu bezingcezu ze-DNA ngokuqhathanisa
question6: Izingcezu ze-DNA zibonakala kanjani ngemva kwe-gel electrophoresis?
answer6: Ukusebenzisa amadayi akhanyayo noma anombala aveza imivimbo
question7: I-DNA ye-genomic ehlukanisiwe ivame ukuvela kanjani kujeli?
answer7: Njenge-smear ende equkethe izingcezu zobukhulu obuhlukahlukene
question8: Kungani i-DNA yezakhi zofuzo engakanqunywa ivame ukuhlala eduze kwengxenye ephezulu yejeli?
answer8: Ngoba ama-molecule e-DNA makhulu kakhulu ukuba angahamba kahle ngokusebenzisa ama-pores ejeli
distractor8b: Ngoba i-DNA engakanqunywa ifuduka ngokushesha kunezingcezu ezincane
distractor8c: Ngoba i-DNA engakanqunywa ayikwazi ukubopha amadayi okupenda

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA) | Ukwandiswa Kwezingcezu Ze-Nucleic Acid yi-Polymerase Chain Reaction
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA) | Ukwandiswa Kwezingcezu Ze-Nucleic Acid yi-Polymerase Chain Reaction
chapterContent:
Nakuba i-DNA ye-genomic ibonakala ngeso lenyama uma ikhishwa ngobuningi, ukuhlaziywa kwe-DNA kuvame ukudinga ukugxila endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ethize ye-genome. I-Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) iyindlela esetshenziswa ukukhulisa izindawo ezithile ze-DNA ukuze kuhlaziywe kabanzi (Isithombe 17.4). I-PCR isetshenziswa ngezinjongo eziningi emalabhorethri, njengokuhlanganisa izingcezu zezakhi zofuzo ukuhlaziya izifo zofuzo, ukuhlonza i-DNA yangaphandle engcolisayo kusampula, kanye nokukhulisa i-DNA ukuze kulandelelwe. Izicelo ezisebenzayo ezengeziwe zifaka phakathi ukutholakala kwezifo zofuzo.

 Izingcezu ze-DNA zingakhuliswa futhi kusukela kuthempulethi ye-RNA enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-reverse transcriptase PCR (RT-PCR). Isinyathelo sokuqala ukuphinda udale intambo yethempulethi ye-DNA yokuqala (ebizwa ngokuthi i-cDNA) ngokusebenzisa ama-nucleotide e-DNA ku-mRNA. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-reverse transcription. Lokhu kudinga ukuba khona kwe-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-reverse transcriptase. Ngemva kokuba i-cDNA yenziwe, i-PCR ejwayelekile ingasetshenziswa ukuyikhulisa.
question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko ye-polymerase chain reaction (PCR)?
answer1: Ukukhulisa izindawo ezithile ze-DNA ukuze zihlaziywe
question2: Kungani i-PCR ivame ukudingeka lapho kuhlaziywa i-DNA ye-genomic?
answer2: Ngoba abacwaningi bavame ukudinga ukutadisha izindawo ezithile ze-genome kunokutadisha lonke isampula ye-DNA
distractor2a: Ngoba i-DNA ye-genomic ayikwazi ukukhishwa kumaseli
distractor2b: Ngoba i-PCR ishintsha njalo ukulandelana kwe-DNA
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okusetshenziswa okuvamile kwe-PCR?
answer3: Ukuthola izifo zofuzo
question4: I-RT-PCR imele ini?
answer4: Ukusabela kwe-reverse transcriptase polymerase chain
distractor4b: Ukusabela kwe-polymerase chain polymerase transcription ye-ribosomal
distractor4c: Ukusabela kwe-protein chain chain yokuhumusha okuphambene
question5: Iyini isinyathelo sokuqala se-RT-PCR?
answer5: Ukukhiqiza i-DNA ehambisanayo (i-cDNA) kusuka kuthempulethi ye-mRNA
question6: Yimuphi i-enzyme edingekayo ukuze kubhalwe kabusha ngesikhathi se-RT-PCR?
answer6: I-transcriptase ebuyela emuva
question7: Kuyini i-cDNA?
answer7: Ikhophi ye-DNA eyenziwe ngethempulethi ye-mRNA
question8: Ngemva kokukhiqizwa kwe-cDNA ngesikhathi se-RT-PCR, kwenzekani ngokulandelayo?
answer8: I-PCR ejwayelekile isetshenziselwa ukukhulisa i-cDNA

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Amasu Ayisisekelo Okulawula Izinto Zezakhi Zofuzo (i-DNA kanye ne-RNA) | Ukuxutshwa, Ukuvinjelwa KwaseNingizimu, kanye Nokuvinjelwa KwaseNyakatho
chapterContent: Amasampula e-Nucleic acid, njenge-DNA ye-genomic ehlukanisiwe kanye ne-RNA extracts, angahlolwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi kukhona yini ukulandelana okuthile. Izingcezu ze-DNA ezimfushane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-probe zakhiwe futhi zibhalwe ngamadayi anemisebe noma i-fluorescent ukusiza ekutholakaleni. I-gel electrophoresis ihlukanisa izingcezu ze-nucleic acid ngokuya ngosayizi wazo. Izingcezu eziku-gel zibe sezidluliselwa ku-membrane ye-nylon ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-blotting (Isithombe 17.5). Izingcezu ze-nucleic acid eziboshwe ebusweni be-membrane zingahlolwa nge-probe sequences ezithile ezinemisebe noma ezinemisebe. Lapho i-DNA idluliselwa ku-membrane ye-nylon, le ndlela ibizwa ngokuthi i-Southern blotting, kanti lapho i-RNA idluliselwa ku-membrane ye-nylon, ibizwa ngokuthi i-north blotting. Ama-Southern blots asetshenziselwa ukuthola ukuthi kukhona ezinye izingcezu ze-DNA ku-genome ethile, kanti ama-north blots asetshenziselwa ukuthola ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo.
question1: Iyini inhloso ye-nucleic acid probe ekuhlolweni kwe-hybridization?
answer1: Ukuthola ukulandelana kwe-DNA noma i-RNA ethile ngokubopha kuma-nucleic acid ahambisanayo

answer3: Ukudlulisa izingcezu ze-nucleic acid kusuka kujeli ziye kulwelwesi lwe-nylon
question4: Kuyini i-Southern blotting?
answer4: Ukudluliselwa kwezingcezu ze-DNA kulwelwesi lwe-nylon ukuze kutholakale ukulandelana kwe-DNA ethile
question5: Yini i-Northern blotting esetshenziswa kakhulu ukuthola?
answer5: Ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuthola ama-molecule athile e-RNA

answer6: I-RNA

answer7: Ukufiphaza kweNyakatho

answer8: Ukuhlukanisa izingcezu ngobukhulu ngaphambi kokuzidlulisela kulwelwesi

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukwenziwa Kwama-Molecular Cloning
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukwenziwa Kwama-Molecular Cloning
chapterContent:
Ngokuvamile, igama elithi cloning” lisho ukudalwa kwekhophi ephelele; nokho, ku-biology, ukudalwa kabusha kwento yonke kubizwa ngokuthi i-reproductive cloning.” Esikhathini eside ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe imizamo yokuhlanganisa yonke into, abacwaningi bafunda indlela yokukhiqiza kabusha izindawo noma izingcezu ezifunwayo ze-genome, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-molecular cloning.

 Ukuhlanganisa izingcezu ezincane ze-genome kuvumela ukuphathwa nokufundwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile (kanye nemikhiqizo yazo yamaprotheni), noma izifunda ezingabhalisi ngokwazo. I-plasmid (ebizwa nangokuthi i-vector) iyi-molecule encane eyindilinga ye-DNA ephindaphinda ngokuzimela i-DNA ye-chromosome. Ekuhlanganiseni, ama-molecule e-plasmid angasetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngefolda lapho kufakwa khona isingcezu se-DNA esifunwayo. Ama-plasmid avame ukufakwa ku-host yebhaktheriya ukuze akhule. Esimweni sebhaktheriya, isingcezu se-DNA esivela ku-genome yomuntu (noma i-genome yesinye isidalwa esifundwayo) sibizwa ngokuthi i-DNA yangaphandle, noma i-transgene, ukuze ihlukaniswe ne-DNA yebhaktheriya, ebizwa ngokuthi i-host DNA.

 Ama-plasmid atholakala ngokwemvelo emiphakathini yamagciwane (njenge-Escherichia coli) futhi anezakhi zofuzo ezingaba negalelo elihle emzimbeni, njengokumelana nama-antibiotic (ikhono lokungathinteki ngama-antibiotic). Ama-plasmid asetshenziswe kabusha futhi aklanywa njenge-vectors for molecular cloning kanye nokukhiqizwa okukhulu kwama-reagents abalulekile, njenge-insulin kanye ne-hormone yokukhula komuntu. Isici esibalulekile sama-plasmid vectors ukuthi kulula kanjani ukuthi ingxenye ye-DNA yangaphandle ingenwe nge-multiple cloning site (MCS). I-MCS iwuchungechunge olufushane lwe-DNA oluqukethe izindawo eziningi ezingasikwa ngama-restriction endonuclease ahlukene atholakalayo. Ama-restriction endonucleases aqaphela ukulandelana kwe-DNA ethile futhi awasike ngendlela ebikezelwayo; akhiqizwa ngokwemvelo ama-bacteria njengendlela yokuzivikela ku-DNA yangaphandle. Ama-restriction endonucleases amaningi enza ukusikwa okulinganiselwe emicu emibili ye-DNA, kangangokuthi iziphetho ezisikiwe zine-2- noma 4-base single-strand overhang. Ngenxa yokuthi la ma-overhangs ayakwazi ukunamathela ngama-overhang ahambisanayo, lawa abizwa ngokuthi ama-sticky ends.” Ukwengezwa kwe-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-DNA ligase kuhlanganisa unomphela izingcezu ze-DNA ngezibopho ze-phosphodiester. Ngale ndlela, noma yisiphi isingcezu se-DNA esikhiqizwa ukuhlukaniswa kwe-restriction endonuclease singahlukaniswa phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezimbili ze-plasmid DNA esinqunywe nge-restriction endonuclease efanayo (Isithombe 17.6)
question1: Kuyini ukwakheka kwama-molecule?
answer1: Inqubo yokukhiqiza izingcezu ezithile ze-DNA noma izakhi zofuzo ukuze kufundwe noma kushintshwe
distractor1a: Ukudalwa kwento yonke efana nezakhi zofuzo
question2: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-plasmid ekuhlanganisweni kwama-molecule?
answer2: Ukusebenza njenge-vector ethwala i-DNA yangaphandle iye esitokisini sombungazi
question3: Kuyini i-transgene?
answer3: Ingcezu ye-DNA yangaphandle efakwe esilwaneni esisiphethe
question4: Kungani ama-plasmid evame ukusetshenziswa njenge-cloning vectors?
answer4: Ngoba ziyaphindaphinda ngokuzimela ngaphandle kwe-chromosome yebhaktheriya
distractor4a: Ngoba zithatha indawo ye-chromosome yebhaktheriya unomphela
distractor4c: Ngoba zingaba khona kuphela kumaseli e-eukaryotic
question5: Iyini injongo yesayithi le-multiple cloning (MCS) ku-plasmid?
answer5: Iqukethe izindawo eziningana zokuqaphela ama-enzyme okukhawulela lapho i-DNA yangaphandle ingafakwa khona

answer6: Bayaqaphela ukulandelana kwe-DNA ethile futhi basika i-DNA kulezo zindawo

answer7: Ama-overalls e-DNA anomucu owodwa anganamathelana nezinhlangothi ze-DNA ezihambisanayo
distractor7c: Izingcezu ze-DNA ezinezintambo ezimbili ezingenakukwazi ukuhlanganisa
question8: Uyini umsebenzi we-DNA ligase ngesikhathi sokwenziwa kwe-molecular cloning?
answer8: Ihlanganisa unomphela izingcezu ze-DNA ngokwakha izibopho ze-phosphodiester
question9: Kungani ama-plasmid evame ukuqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezimelana nama-antibiotic?
answer9: Zivumela abacwaningi ukuthi bathole amabhaktheriya athathe ngempumelelo i-plasmid

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukukhiqizwa Kwama-Molecular | Ama-Recombinant DNA Molecules
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukukhiqizwa Kwama-Molecular | Ama-Recombinant DNA Molecules
chapterContent:
Ama-plasmid ane-DNA yangaphandle afakwe kuwo abizwa ngokuthi ama-molecule e-recombinant DNA ngoba adalwe ngendlela yokwenziwa futhi awaveli emvelweni. Abizwa nangokuthi ama-molecule e-chimeric ngoba imvelaphi yezingxenye ezahlukene zama-molecule ingalandelelwa emuva ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo noma ngisho nasekuhlanganisweni kwamakhemikhali. Amaprotheni avezwa kuma-molecule e-DNA aphinde ahlanganiswe abizwa ngokuthi ama-protein aphinde ahlanganiswe. Akuwona wonke ama-plasmid aphinde ahlanganiswe akwazi ukuveza izakhi zofuzo. I-DNA ephinde ahlanganiswe kungadingeka ithuthelwe ku-vector ehlukile (noma i-host) eyenzelwe kangcono ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Ama-plasmid angaphinde aklanywe ukuveza amaprotheni kuphela uma ekhuthazwa yizici ezithile zemvelo, ukuze ososayensi bakwazi ukulawula ukuvezwa kwamaprotheni aphinde ahlanganiswe.

 Kokubili i-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-plasmid kunqunywa nge-enzyme efanayo yokuvimbela. Indawo yokuvimbela yenzeka kanye kuphela ku-plasmid phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ze-enzyme (lacZ).

 I-enzyme yokuvimbela ishiya iziphetho ezinamathelayo ezihambisanayo ku-extract ye-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-plasmid. Lokhu kuvumela i-DNA yangaphandle ukuthi ifakwe ku-plasmid lapho i-sticky ends anneal. Ukwengeza i-DNA ligase kuhlanganisa kabusha i-DNA backbones. Lawa ama-recombinant plasmids.

 Ama-plasmids ahlanganiswe nesiko lamabhaktheriya aphilayo. Amaningi amagciwane awathathi noma yimaphi ama-plasmid emaseli awo, amaningi athatha ama-plasmid angenayo i-DNA yangaphandle kuwo, kanti ambalwa athatha i-recombinant plasmid. Amabhaktheriya athatha i-recombinant plasmid awakwazi ukwenza i-enzyme kusuka ku-gene lapho i-fragment ifakwe khona (i-lacZ). Aphinde aphathe i-gene yokumelana ne-antibiotic ampicillin, eyayiku-plasmid yokuqala.

 Ukuze kutholakale amabhaktheriya ane-recombinant plasmid, amabhaktheriya akhuliswa epuletini eline-antibiotic ampicillin kanye nento eshintsha umbala lapho ivezwa ku-enzyme ekhiqizwa yi-lacZ gene. I-ampicillin izobulala noma yimaphi amagciwane angazange athathe i-plasmid. Umbala walesi sici ngeke ushintshe uma i-lacZ gene iqukethe i-DNA yangaphandle. Lawa amabhaktheriya ane-recombinant plasmid esifuna ukuyikhulisa.

question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 17.6. Hlola isithombe, esibonisa ukuhlolwa kokwakheka kwama-molecule. Usebenza kule lab yebhayoloji yama-molecule futhi, ungazi, umlingani wakho welab ushiye i-DNA ye-genomic yangaphandle ohlela ukuyibumba ebhentshini lelab ubusuku bonke esikhundleni sokuyigcina efrijini. Ngenxa yalokho, i-DNA yonakaliswa yi-nucleases, kodwa wena nomlingani wakho nisayisebenzise ekuhlolweni. I-plasmid, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ilungile. Yimiphi imiphumela ongayibikezela ekuhlolweni kwakho kokwakheka kwama-molecule?
answer7: Kuzoba namakholoni aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuphela epuletini lebhaktheriya

distractor7b: Kuzoba namakholoni aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka namhlophe epuletini lebhaktheriya

question8: Yimiphi imisebenzi yama-enzyme okukhawulela kanye ne-DNA ligase ekuhlanganisweni kabusha?
answer8: Ama-enzyme okuvinjelwa ahlanganisa i-DNA endaweni ethile, ukuze kufakwe ingxenye entsha ye-DNA. I-DNA ligase ihlanganisa i-gene entsha yangaphandle nengxenye ekhona ye-DNA.
distractor8a: Ama-enzyme okuvimbela avimbela inqubo yokuhlanganisa kabusha. I-DNA ligase ihlanganisa imikhiqizo yokuhlanganisa kabusha komunye nomunye
distractor8b: I-DNA ligase ihlanganisa i-DNA endaweni ethile, ukuze kufakwe ingxenye entsha ye-DNA. Ama-enzyme okuvimbela ahlanganisa i-gene entsha nengxenye ekhona ye-DNA
distractor8c: Ama-enzyme okukhawulela ahlanganisa ingxenye ekhona ye-DNA ukuze afake ingxenye entsha ye-DNA. I-DNA ligase ihlanganisa i-DNA entsha ne-DNA ekhona.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukwenziwa Kwe-Cellular Cloning
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukwenziwa Kwe-Cellular Cloning
chapterContent: Izinto eziphilayo ezi-unicellular, njengebhaktheriya nemvubelo, ngokwemvelo zikhiqiza ama-clone azo uma ziphindaphinda ngokungahambisani nobulili ngokuhlukana kwe-binary; lokhu kwaziwa ngokuthi i-cell cloning. I-DNA yenuzi iphindaphindwa ngenqubo ye-mitosis, edala ikhophi eqondile yezinto zofuzo.
question1: Kuyini ukwenziwa kwe-cell cloning?
answer1: Ukukhiqizwa kwamaseli afanayo ngokwezakhi zofuzo ngokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli angaxubile
distractor1a: Ukukhiqizwa kwamaseli ahlukene ngokwezakhi zofuzo nge-meiosis
question2: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezivame ukuzala ngokwenziwa kwamaseli ngendlela yemvelo?

answer4: Ngoba i-DNA yenuzi ikopishwa ngokunembile ngaphambi kokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
distractor4a: Ngoba i-DNA ayikopishwa ngesikhathi sokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli
distractor4c: Ngoba izinguquko zenzeka njalo ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda
question5: Iyiphi inqubo edala ikhophi eqondile yezinto zofuzo ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwamaseli?
answer5: I-Mitosis

answer6: Ziyizinhlobo ezifanayo zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukuzala kwe-Cloning
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukuzala kwe-Cloning
chapterContent:
Ukuzala kwe-cloning kuyindlela esetshenziswa ukwenza i-clone noma ikhophi efanayo yento yonke ephilayo enamangqamuzana amaningi. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi ezinamaseli amaningi ziyazalana ngezindlela zocansi, okubandakanya ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo zabantu ababili (abazali), okwenza kube nzima ukukhiqiza ikhophi efanayo noma i-clone yomzali ngamunye. Intuthuko yakamuva kwezobuchwepheshe be-bio yenze kwaba nokwenzeka ukugqugquzela ngokwenziwa ukuzala kwezilwane ezincelisayo ngaphandle kocansi elabhorethri.

 I-Parthenogenesis, noma ukuzalwa kwentombi,” kwenzeka lapho umbungu ukhula futhi ukhula ngaphandle kokukhulelwa kweqanda; lolu uhlobo lokuzala okungenabo ubulili. Isibonelo se-parthenogenesis senzeka ezinhlotsheni lapho owesifazane ebeka iqanda futhi uma iqanda livundisiwe, liba yiqanda le-diploid bese umuntu ekhula abe ngowesifazane; uma iqanda lingavundisiwe, lihlala liyiqanda le-haploid futhi likhula libe ngowesilisa. Iqanda elingavundisiwe libizwa ngokuthi iqanda le-parthenogenic, noma iqanda eliyi-virgin. Ezinye izinambuzane nezilwane ezihuquzelayo zibeka amaqanda e-parthenogenic angakhula abe ngabantu abadala.

 Ukuzala ngokocansi kudinga amaseli amabili; lapho iqanda le-haploid namaseli esidoda ehlangana, kuvela i-zygote ye-diploid. I-nucleus ye-zygote iqukethe ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ukuze ikhiqize umuntu omusha. Kodwa-ke, ukuthuthukiswa kokuqala kombungu kudinga izinto ze-cytoplasmic eziqukethwe kuseli leqanda. Lo mbono wakha isisekelo sokuzala. Ngakho-ke, uma i-nucleus ye-haploid yeseli leqanda ithathelwa indawo yi-nucleus ye-diploid evela kuseli lanoma yimuphi umuntu wohlobo olufanayo (obizwa ngokuthi umnikeli), izoba yi-zygote efana nezakhi zofuzo. kumuntu onikelayo. Ukudluliselwa kwe-nuclear cell somatic kuyindlela yokudlulisa i-nucleus ye-diploid ibe yiqanda elikhishwe i-nucleus. Ingasetshenziswa ekwenzeni i-cloning yokwelapha noma ukwenza i-cloning yokuzala.

 Isilwane sokuqala esifakwe i-cloning kwakunguDolly, imvu eyazalwa ngo-1996. Izinga lempumelelo lokwenza i-cloning yokuzala ngaleso sikhathi laliphansi kakhulu. UDolly waphila iminyaka eyisikhombisa futhi wafa ngenxa yezinkinga zokuphefumula (Isithombe 17.7). Kukhona ukuqagela ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi i-DNA yeseli ingeyomuntu omdala, ubudala be-DNA bungathinta isikhathi sokuphila somuntu ofakwe i-cloning. Kusukela kuDolly, izilwane eziningana ezifana namahhashi, izinkunzi, nezimbuzi ziye zafakwa i-cloning ngempumelelo, yize laba bantu bevame ukubonisa ukukhubazeka kobuso, izitho zomzimba, kanye nenhliziyo. Kuye kwaba nemizamo yokukhiqiza imibungu yabantu efakwe i-cloning njengemithombo yamaseli okuqala e-embryonic, ngezinye izikhathi okubizwa ngokuthi ukwenza i-cloning ngezinjongo zokwelapha. Ukwenza i-cloning yokwelapha kukhiqiza amaseli okuqala ukuzama ukwelapha izifo noma amaphutha ayingozi (ngokungafani nokwenza i-cloning yokuzala, okuhlose ukuzala into ephilayo). Noma kunjalo, imizamo yokwenza i-cloning yokwelapha iye yahlangabezana nokuphikiswa ngenxa yezizathu zokuziphatha okuhle
question1: Kuyini ukuzala kwe-cloning?
answer1: Ukukhiqizwa kwekhophi efana nezakhi zofuzo yesidalwa sonke esinamangqamuzana amaningi
distractor1a: Ukukhiqizwa kwezingcezu ze-DNA ezifanayo kusetshenziswa i-PCR
question2: Kungani ukuzala okuvamile ngokocansi kungakhiqizi inzalo efana nezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Ngoba ihlanganisa izinto zofuzo ezivela kubazali ababili ngokukhulelwa
question3: Kuyini i-parthenogenesis?
answer3: Ukuthuthukiswa kombungu kusuka eqandeni elingavundisiwe
question4: Kuyini ukudluliswa kwe-nuclear cell (i-SCNT)?
answer4: Ukudluliselwa kwe-nucleus ye-diploid ibe yiseli leqanda elikhishwe i-nucleus
question5: Kungani iqanda elikhishwe i-nuclei lisetshenziswa ekudlulisweni kwe-nuclei yamaseli omzimba?
answer5: I-cytoplasm yayo isekela ukukhula kwe-embryonic kusenesikhathi kuyilapho i-donor nucleus inikeza ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo
question6: Yisiphi isilwane esasiyisilwane sokuqala esincelisayo esadalwa ngempumelelo ngokudluliswa kwe-nuclear cell?
answer6: UDolly imvu
question7: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yokwenza i-cloning yokwelapha?
answer7: Ukukhiqiza amaseli okuqala okwelapha izifo noma ukulungisa izicubu ezonakele
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esihlukanisa kangcono i-reproductive cloning ne-therapeutic cloning?
answer8: Ukuzala kwe-cloning kuhlose ukukhiqiza isidalwa sonke, kanti ukwelapha kwe-cloning kuhlose ukukhiqiza amaseli okuqala okwelashwa.
distractor8a: Ukwenziwa kwe-cloning yokwelapha kukhiqiza izilwane ezifanayo, kanti ukwenziwa kwe-cloning yokuzala kukhiqiza izicubu kuphela
distractor8b: Ukwenziwa kwe-cloning yokuzala kusebenzisa i-PCR, kuyilapho ukwenziwa kwe-cloning yokwelapha kusebenzisa i-gel electrophoresis
distractor8c: Ukwenziwa kwe-cloning yokwelapha kudinga ukukhulelwa, kanti ukwenziwa kwe-cloning yokuzala akudingi
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 17.7. Sebenza ngenqubo evezwe lapha, ekhombisa ukuthi ukwenziwa kwe-cloning kwenzeka kanjani kuDolly, imvu kanye nesilwane esincelisayo sokuqala ukwenziwa kwe-cloning. Ucabanga ukuthi uDolly wayeyimvu yaseFinn-Dorset noma yaseScotland Blackface? Sekela isimangalo sakho ngokunikeza isizathu.
answer9: UDolly wayeyimvu yaseFinn-Dorset ngoba i-nucleus enkambisweni yayithathwe kumama waseFinn-Dorset.
distractor9a: UDolly wayeyimvu yaseScotland Blackface ngoba lo mphumela ulandela ufuzo lwe-cytoplasmic
distractor9b: UDolly wayeyimvu yaseFinn-Dorset ngoba lo mphumela ulandela ifa le-cytoplasmic
distractor9c: UDolly wayeyimvu yaseScotland Blackface ngenxa yefa le-epigenetic

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo | Ukuhloswa kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo | Ukuhloswa kwezakhi zofuzo
chapterContent:
Ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo ukuguqulwa kwe-genotype yesidalwa kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe be-recombinant DNA ukuguqula i-DNA yesidalwa ukuze kufezwe izici ezifiselekayo. Ukwengezwa kwe-DNA yangaphandle ngesimo se-recombinant DNA vectors ekhiqizwa yi-molecular cloning kuyindlela evame kakhulu yobunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo. Isidalwa esithola i-recombinant DNA sibizwa ngokuthi isidalwa esiguqulwe izakhi zofuzo (i-GMO). Uma i-DNA yangaphandle eyethulwa ivela kolunye uhlobo, isidalwa esiphethe sibizwa ngokuthi i-transgenic. Amabhaktheriya, izitshalo, nezilwane kuye kwaguqulwa izakhi zofuzo kusukela ekuqaleni kwawo-1970 ngezinjongo zezemfundo, zezokwelapha, zezolimo, nezezimboni. E-US, ama-GMO afana nobhontshisi wesoya omelana nokhula kanye nommbila omelana ne-borer ayingxenye yokudla okuningi okuvamile okucutshungulwa.

 Ukuqondiswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
Nakuba izindlela zakudala zokufunda umsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo zaqala nge-phenotype ethile futhi zanquma isisekelo sezakhi zofuzo saleyo phenotype, amasu anamuhla avumela abacwaningi ukuthi baqale ezingeni lokulandelana kwe-DNA babuze: Lenzani le gene noma i-DNA element? Le ndlela, ebizwa ngokuthi i-reverse genetics, iholele ekuguquleni indlela yezakhi zofuzo yakudala. Le ndlela ingafana nokulimaza ingxenye yomzimba ukuze kunqunywe umsebenzi wayo. Isinambuzane esilahlekelwa yiphiko asikwazi ukundiza, okusho ukuthi umsebenzi wephiko ukundiza. Indlela yezakhi zofuzo yakudala ingaqhathanisa izinambuzane ezingakwazi ukundiza nezinambuzane ezingandiza, futhi ibone ukuthi izinambuzane ezingandizi zilahlekelwe amaphiko. Ngokufanayo, ukuguqula noma ukususa izakhi zofuzo kunikeza abacwaningi izinkomba mayelana nomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo. Izindlela ezisetshenziswa ukukhubaza umsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo zibizwa ngokuthi yi-gene targeting. I-Gene targeting ukusetshenziswa kwama-recombinant DNA vectors ukushintsha ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile, kungaba ngokungenisa izinguquko ku-gene, noma ngokuqeda ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile ngokususa ingxenye noma yonke i-gene sequence ku-genome yento ephilayo.
question1: Kuyini ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ukuguqulwa kwe-genotype yezinto eziphilayo kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe be-DNA ephindaphindayo ukukhiqiza izici ezifiselekayo
question2: Iyini i-organism eguqulwe izakhi zofuzo (i-GMO)?
question3: Kunini lapho isidalwa esiguqulwe izakhi zofuzo sibhekwa njenge-transgenic?
answer3: Uma i-DNA eyethulwe ivela kolunye uhlobo
distractor3a: Uma i-DNA yayo ikhuliswa kusetshenziswa i-PCR
question4: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko ye-reverse genetics?
answer4: Ukunquma umsebenzi wesakhi sofuzo ngokusishintsha noma ukusivala
distractor4c: Ukuqhathanisa izici zomzimba ngaphambi kokufunda i-DNA
question5: Izakhi zofuzo eziphambene zihluke kanjani kwezakhi zofuzo zakudala?
answer5: Izakhi zofuzo ezibuyela emuva ziqala ngokulandelana kwe-DNA okwaziwayo futhi ziphenye umsebenzi wazo, kanti izakhi zofuzo zakudala ziqala nge-phenotype
distractor5a: Izakhi zofuzo ezibuyela emuva zifunda amaprotheni kuphela, kanti izakhi zofuzo zakudala zifunda i-DNA kuphela
distractor5b: I-reverse genetics isebenzisa i-RNA esikhundleni se-DNA
question6: Kuyini ukuqondisa izakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-recombinant DNA vectors ukushintsha noma ukuqeda ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile
distractor6c: Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwama-chromosome afanayo
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuqondiswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ukususa ingxenye noma yonke i-gene ukuze kutholakale umsebenzi wayo
question8: Kungani ukukhubaza isakhi sofuzo kungasiza ososayensi baqonde umsebenzi waso?
answer8: Ngoba izinguquko ku-phenotype yezinto eziphilayo zingaveza indima evamile yesakhi sofuzo esilahlekile
distractor8a: Ngoba ukususa i-gene kuhlale kuthuthukisa umzimba
distractor8b: Ngoba zonke izakhi zofuzo zinemisebenzi efanayo
distractor8c: Ngoba ukususwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwandisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo unomphela

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | I-Biotechnology kwezokwelapha kanye nezolimo | Ukuxilongwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo kanye Nokwelashwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | I-Biotechnology kwezokwelapha kanye nezolimo | Ukuxilongwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo kanye Nokwelashwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
chapterContent:
Kulula ukubona ukuthi i-biotechnology ingasetshenziswa kanjani ngezinjongo zokwelapha. Ulwazi ngokwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zezinhlobo zethu, isisekelo sezakhi zofuzo zezifo ezidluliselwa ngofuzo, kanye nokusungulwa kobuchwepheshe bokuphatha nokulungisa izakhi zofuzo eziguquliwe kunikeza izindlela zokwelapha izifo. I-biotechnology kwezolimo ingathuthukisa ukumelana nezifo, izinambuzane, kanye nokucindezeleka kwemvelo, futhi ithuthukise kokubili isivuno sezitshalo kanye nekhwalithi.

 Ukuxilongwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Nokwelashwa Kwezakhi Zofuzo
Inqubo yokuhlola amaphutha ofuzo okusolwayo ngaphambi kokunikeza ukwelashwa ibizwa ngokuthi ukuxilongwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo. Kuye ngamaphethini ofuzo esakhi sofuzo esibangela isifo, amalungu omndeni ayelulekwa ukuthi ahlolwe izakhi zofuzo. Isibonelo, abesifazane abatholakale benomdlavuza webele bavame ukwelulekwa ukuthi benze i-biopsy ukuze ithimba lezokwelapha likwazi ukunquma isisekelo sezakhi zofuzo sokuthuthukiswa komdlavuza. Izinhlelo zokwelapha zisekelwe ekutholakaleni kokuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo okunquma uhlobo lomdlavuza. Uma umdlavuza ubangelwa ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuzuzwe njengefa, ezinye izihlobo zesifazane nazo zelulekwa ukuthi zihlolwe izakhi zofuzo kanye nokuhlolwa njalo komdlavuza webele. Ukuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo nakho kuyanikezwa ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa (noma ama-embryo ane-in vitro fertilization) ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zikhona noma azikho izakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo emindenini enezifo ezithile eziwohlozayo.

 Ukwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuyindlela yobunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo esetshenziselwa ukwelapha isifo. Ngendlela yayo elula, kuhilela ukwethulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezinhle endaweni engahleliwe ku-genome ukusiza ekwelapheni isifo esibangelwa yizakhi zofuzo eziguquliwe. Izakhi zofuzo ezinhle zivame ukungeniswa emangqamuzaneni anesifo njengengxenye ye-vector edluliselwa yigciwane elingathelela iseli eliyibamba futhi lilethe i-DNA yangaphandle (Isithombe 17.8). Izindlela ezithuthukisiwe kakhulu zokwelapha izakhi zofuzo zizama ukulungisa ukuguquka endaweni yokuqala ku-genome, njengoba kunjalo ngokwelashwa kwe-severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID)
question1: Iyini inhloso yokuxilonga izakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ukuhlola amaphutha ofuzo okusolwayo ngaphambi kokunikezwa ukwelashwa
question2: Kungani amalungu omndeni womuntu onesifo sofuzo esizuzwe njengefa engase elulekwe ukuthi ahlolwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Ngoba zingase zithwale noma zizuze njengefa ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okubangela lesi sifo
distractor2b: Ngoba zonke izihlobo ziphathwa yilesi sifo
question3: Kungani abesifazane abatholakale benomdlavuza webele bevame ukwelulekwa ukuthi bahlolwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Ukunquma isisekelo sezakhi zofuzo somdlavuza nokuqondisa izinqumo zokwelapha
question4: Kungahlolwa nini ngaphambi kokuzalwa?
answer4: Uma imindeni isengozini yokudlulisela izifo ezithile ezizuzwe njengefa
question5: Kuyini ukwelashwa ngezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Indlela yobunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo esetshenziswa ukwelapha izifo ngokuletha noma ukulungisa izakhi zofuzo
distractor5c: Inqubo ebhubhisa izakhi zofuzo eziguquliwe ngaphandle kokuzishintsha
question6: Ngendlela elula, ukwelashwa ngezakhi zofuzo kusebenza kanjani?
answer6: Ngokufaka i-gene esebenzayo ku-genome ukuze kulungiswe i-gene eguquliwe
distractor6c: Ngokuvala unomphela konke ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question7: Yini evame ukusetshenziswa ukuletha izakhi zofuzo zokwelapha kumaseli aqondiwe?
answer7: I-vector yegciwane
question8: Izinhlobo ezithuthukisiwe zokwelapha ngezakhi zofuzo zihluke kanjani endleleni elula?
answer8: Bazama ukulungisa ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo endaweni yalo yokuqala ku-genome
distractor8c: Zimisa unomphela ukubhalwa kwemibhalo kuwo wonke amaseli
question9: Yisiphi isifo esizuzwe njengesibonelo sokwelashwa kusetshenziswa ukwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuthuthukisiwe?
answer9: Ukuntuleka okukhulu kwamasosha omzimba okuhlangene (i-SCID)

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukukhiqizwa Kwemithi Yokugoma, Ama-Antibiotic, kanye nama-Hormone
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Ukukhiqizwa Kwemithi Yokugoma, Ama-Antibiotic, kanye nama-Hormone
chapterContent:
Amasu okugoma endabuko asebenzisa izinhlobo ezibuthakathaka noma ezingasebenzi zama-microorganism ukufaka impendulo yokuqala yomzimba. Amasu esimanje asebenzisa izakhi zofuzo zama-microorganisms ezihlanganiswe kuma-vectors ukuze zikhiqize i-antigen efiselekayo ngobuningi. I-antigen ibe isifakwa emzimbeni ukuze ivuselele impendulo yokuqala yomzimba futhi ivuse inkumbulo yomzimba. Izakhi zofuzo ezihlanganiswe kusuka egciwaneni lomkhuhlane zisetshenziswe ukulwa nezinhlobo ezishintsha njalo zaleli gciwane.

 Ama-antibiotic angumkhiqizo we-biotechnology. Akhiqizwa ngokwemvelo ngama-microorganisms, njenge-fungi, ukuze athole inzuzo ngaphezu kwenani lamagciwane. Ama-antibiotics akhiqizwa ngezinga elikhulu ngokuhlakulela nokulawula amaseli e-fungal.

 Ubuchwepheshe be-DNA obuhlanganisiwe basetshenziswa ukukhiqiza inani elikhulu le-insulin yomuntu ku-E. coli kusukela ngo-1978. Ngaphambilini, kwakungenzeka kuphela ukwelapha isifo sikashukela nge-insulin yengulube, eyayibangela ukusabela kokungezwani komzimba kubantu ngenxa yokungafani komkhiqizo wezakhi zofuzo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-hormone yokukhula komuntu (HGH) isetshenziselwa ukwelapha izinkinga zokukhula ezinganeni. I-gene ye-HGH yakhiwa kusuka kulabhulali ye-cDNA yafakwa kumaseli e-E. coli ngokuyihlanganisa ne-vector yebhaktheriya.
question1: Imithi eminingi yokugoma yesimanje ihluke kanjani emithini yokugoma yendabuko?
answer1: Imithi yokugoma yesimanje ivame ukusebenzisa ama-antigen aphinde ahlanganiswe akhiqizwa yizakhi zofuzo ezihlanganisiwe esikhundleni sezinto ezincane ezibuthakathaka noma ezingasebenzi
distractor1a: Imithi yokugoma yesimanje ihlala iqukethe amabhaktheriya aphilayo
distractor1b: Imithi yokugoma yesimanje iqukethe ama-antibiotic kuphela
distractor1c: Imithi yokugoma yesimanje isebenza ngokubhubhisa ama-antibodies
question2: Iyini injongo yokungenisa i-antigen emzimbeni ngesikhathi sokugoma?
answer2: Ukukhuthaza impendulo eyinhloko yomzimba nokwakha inkumbulo yomzimba
distractor2a: Ukubhubhisa ngqo zonke izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane
question3: Kungani izakhi zofuzo zegciwane lomkhuhlane zenziwe ngendlela yokwenziwa kwemithi yokugomela?
answer3: Ukusiza ekulweni nezinhlobo zomkhuhlane ezishintsha njalo
question4: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezikhiqiza ama-antibiotic amaningi ngokwemvelo?
answer4: Isikhunta
question5: Ama-antibiotic avame ukukhiqizwa kanjani ngezinga elikhulu?
answer5: Ngokuhlakulela nokuphatha amaseli esikhunta
question6: Kungani kwakhiqizwa i-insulin yomuntu ephinde yahlanganiswa?
answer6: Ukufaka esikhundleni se-insulin yengulube, engabangela ukusabela kokungezwani komzimba kubantu
question7: Yisiphi isitho esasetshenziswa kabanzi okokuqala ukukhiqiza i-insulin yomuntu ephindaphindwayo?
answer7: I-Escherichia coli (E. coli)
question8: I-human growth hormone (HGH) gene yalungiselelwa kanjani ukuvezwa kwamagciwane?
