answer8: I-HGH gene yathathwa kusuka kulabhulali ye-cDNA yafakwa ku-E. coli kusetshenziswa i-bacterial vector.
distractor8b: I-gene ye-HGH yafakwa kuma-chromosome e-fungal ngaphandle kokwenza i-cloning
distractor8c: I-gene ye-HGH yandiswa kuphela yi-gel electrophoresis

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izilwane Eziguquliwe Ezakhini Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izilwane Eziguquliwe Ezakhini Zofuzo
chapterContent: Nakuba amaprotheni amaningana aphinde ahlanganiswe asetshenziswa kwezokwelapha ekhiqizwa ngempumelelo kumagciwane, amanye amaprotheni adinga isilwane esihlala e-eukaryotic ukuze kucutshungulwe kahle. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, izakhi zofuzo ezifunwayo ziyahlanganiswa futhi ziboniswe ezilwaneni, njengezimvu, izimbuzi, izinkukhu, namagundane. Izilwane eziguqulwe ukuze ziveze i-DNA ephinde ihlanganiswe zibizwa ngokuthi izilwane eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo. Amaprotheni amaningana abantu abonakaliswa obisini lwezimvu nezimbuzi eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo, kanti amanye abonakala emaqandeni ezinkukhu. Amagundane asetshenziswe kakhulu ekuvezeni nasekufundeni imiphumela yezakhi zofuzo eziphinde zihlanganiswe kanye nokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo.
question1: Iyini isilwane esiguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Isilwane esiguqulwe izakhi zofuzo ukuze siveze i-DNA ephindaphindayo
question2: Kungani amanye amaprotheni aphinde ahlanganiswe akhiqizwa ezilwaneni eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo esikhundleni samagciwane?
answer2: Ngoba amanye amaprotheni adinga i-eukaryotic host ukuze icutshungulwe kahle
distractor2c: Ngoba amangqamuzana ezilwane akhula ngokushesha kunamabhaktheriya
question3: Yiziphi izilwane ezilandelayo ezivame ukusetshenziswa njengezivakashi eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Izimvu, izimbuzi, izinkukhu, namagundane
distractor3a: Izinhlanzi nezilwane eziphila emanzini nasemanzini kuphela
question4: Kuphi amaprotheni amaningana abantu aphinde ahlanganiswa akhiqizwa ezimvwini nasezimbuzini eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Obisini lwabo
question5: Aphi amanye amaprotheni abantu aphinde ahlanganiswa akhiqizwa ezinkukhu eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Emaqandeni abo
question6: Kungani amagundane esetshenziswa kabanzi njengezilwane eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo ocwaningweni?
answer6: Ukuveza izakhi zofuzo eziphinda zihlangane futhi ufunde imiphumela yokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile
question7: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-biotechnology olusetshenziswa ukudala izilwane eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ukufakwa nokubonakaliswa kwe-DNA ephindaphindayo
question8: Iyini inzuzo enkulu yokukhiqiza amaprotheni okwelapha ezilwaneni eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer8: Bangakwazi ukucubungula kahle amaprotheni ayinkimbinkimbi eukaryotic angenakwenziwa amabhaktheriya
distractor8a: Bakhiqiza amaprotheni ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Eziguqulwe Ufuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Eziguqulwe Ufuzo
chapterContent:
Ukulawula i-DNA yezitshalo (okungukuthi, ukudala ama-GMO) kusize ekudaleni izici ezifiselekayo, njengokumelana nezifo, ukumelana nokubulala ukhula kanye nezibulala-zinambuzane, inani elingcono lokudla, kanye nokuphila isikhathi eside (Isithombe 17.9). Izitshalo ziwumthombo obaluleke kakhulu wokudla kwabantu. Abalimi bathuthukise izindlela zokukhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo ezinezimpawu ezifiselekayo kudala ngaphambi kokuba kusungulwe imikhuba yesimanje ye-biotechnology.

 Izitshalo ezithole i-DNA ephindaphindayo kwezinye izinhlobo zibizwa ngokuthi izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo. Ngenxa yokuthi azizona zemvelo, izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo kanye nezinye ama-GMO ziqashwe eduze yizikhungo zikahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zilungele ukusetshenziswa ngabantu futhi azifaki engcupheni ezinye izitshalo nezilwane. Ngenxa yokuthi izakhi zofuzo zakwamanye amazwe zingasakazekela kwezinye izinhlobo emvelweni, kudingeka ukuhlolwa okubanzi ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza kwemvelo. Izitsha eziyisisekelo ezifana nommbila, amazambane, kanye notamatisi kwakuyizitshalo zokuqala zezitshalo ezathuthukiswa izakhi zofuzo.
question1: Iyini isitshalo esiguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Isitshalo esithole i-DNA ephindaphindayo evela kolunye uhlobo
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyinhloso efanayo yezitshalo zobunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Ukuthuthukisa ukumelana nezifo, inani lokudla okunomsoco, noma isikhathi sokuphelelwa yisikhathi
question3: Kungani izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo zibhekwa njengezinto eziphilayo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo (ama-GMO)?
answer3: Ngoba i-DNA ephindaphindayo ingeniswe kuma-genome ayo
distractor3b: Ngoba zizala kuphela ngendlela engahambisani nobulili
question4: Kungani izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo ziqashwe ngokucophelela yizikhungo zikahulumeni?
answer4: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ziphephile ukusetshenziswa ngabantu futhi azilimazi imvelo
question5: Kungani kudingeka ukuhlolwa okubanzi kwemvelo ngaphambi kokukhipha izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezethulwe zingasakazekela kwezinye izinhlobo emvelweni
distractor5a: Ngoba izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo azikwazi ukusinda ngaphandle
distractor5b: Ngoba i-DNA ephinde yahlanganiswa iyanyamalala ngemva kwesizukulwane esisodwa
question6: Yiziphi izitshalo zezitshalo ezaziphakathi kwezokuqala ukwenziwa izakhi zofuzo?
answer6: Ummbila, amazambane, notamatisi
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesici esifiselekayo esifakwa ezitshalweni eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Ukumelana nokubulala ukhula
question8: Kungani kwakhethwa izici zezitshalo ezifiselekayo ngisho nangaphambi kokuba kube khona ubuchwepheshe be-biotechnology banamuhla?
answer8: Abalimi bakhethe izitshalo ezinezimpawu ezizuzisayo ezizukulwaneni eziningi
distractor8a: Abalimi basebenzise ubuchwepheshe be-DNA ephinde yahlanganiswa
distractor8b: Abalimi bavame ukukhiqiza izitshalo zezitshalo eziklonyelisiwe

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Eziguqulwe Ufuzo | Ukuguqulwa Kwezitshalo Ezisebenzisa i-Agrobacterium tumefaciens
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Eziguqulwe Ufuzo | Ukuguqulwa Kwezitshalo Ezisebenzisa i-Agrobacterium tumefaciens
chapterContent:
Ukudluliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka ngokwemvelo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezitholakala ezinhlakeni ezincane. Amagciwane amaningi abangela izifo zabantu asebenza ngokufaka i-DNA yawo ku-genome yomuntu. Ezitshalweni, izimila ezibangelwa yibhaktheriya i-Agrobacterium tumefaciens zenzeka ngokudluliselwa kwe-DNA isuka kubhaktheriya iye esitshalweni. Nakuba izimila zingazibulali izitshalo, zenza izitshalo zingakwazi ukuqina futhi zibe sengozini enkulu yezimo zemvelo ezinzima. Izitshalo eziningi, njenge-walnuts, amagilebhisi, izihlahla zamantongomane, kanye ne-beetroot, zithintwa yi-A. tumefaciens. Ukungeniswa kwe-DNA okwenziwayo kumaseli ezitshalo kuyinselele kakhulu kunakumaseli ezilwane ngenxa yodonga olukhulu lweseli lesitshalo.

 Abacwaningi basebenzise ukudluliswa kwemvelo kwe-DNA isuka ku-Agrobacterium iye kumnikazi wesitshalo ukuze bangenise izingcezu ze-DNA abazikhethele zona ezihlalweni. Emvelweni, i-A. tumefaciens ebangela izifo inesethi yama-plasmid, abizwa ngokuthi ama-Ti plasmids (ama-plasmid abangela umdlavuza), aqukethe izakhi zofuzo zokukhiqiza izimila ezitshalweni. I-DNA evela ku-Ti plasmid ihlangana ne-genome yeseli lesitshalo elithelelekile. Abacwaningi basebenzisa ama-plasmid e-Ti ukuze basuse izakhi zofuzo ezibangela umdlavuza bese befaka ingxenye ye-DNA efiselekayo ukuze idluliselwe ku-genome yesitshalo. Ama-plasmid e-Ti aphethe izakhi zofuzo zokumelana namagciwane ukusiza ekukhetheni futhi angasakazeka nasemaseli e-E. coli.
question1: Kungani i-Agrobacterium tumefaciens ibalulekile ku-biotechnology yezitshalo?
answer1: Idlulisela i-DNA ngokwemvelo emangqamuzaneni ezitshalo futhi ingaklanywa ukuze iveze izakhi zofuzo ezifiselekayo.
question2: Yini ebangela ngokwemvelo izimila ezitshalweni ezitheleleke yi-Agrobacterium tumefaciens?
answer2: Ukudluliswa kwe-DNA kusuka kubhaktheriya kuya ku-genome yesitshalo
question3: Kungani ukufaka i-DNA kumaseli ezitshalo kunzima kakhulu kunokufaka kumaseli ezilwane?
answer3: Ngoba amangqamuzana ezitshalo anodonga olukhulu lweseli
distractor3c: Ngoba amangqamuzana ezitshalo awakwazi ukuphindaphinda i-DNA
question4: Ziyini i-Ti plasmids?
answer4: Ama-plasmid abangela umdlavuza atholakala ku-Agrobacterium tumefaciens
question5: Ama-plasmid e-Ti aguqulwa kanjani ukuze abe ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Izakhi zofuzo ezibangela umdlavuza ziyasuswa bese kufakwa uchungechunge lwe-DNA olufunwayo.
distractor5b: Izakhi zofuzo zokumelana nama-antibiotic ziyasuswa esikhundleni salokho
question6: Kungani ama-plasmid e-Ti anjiniyela evame ukuqukethe izakhi zofuzo ezimelana nama-antibiotic?
answer6: Ukusiza ekutholeni nasekukhetheni amaseli aguqulwe ngempumelelo
question7: Yiliphi igciwane elivame ukusetshenziswa ukusabalalisa ama-plasmid e-Ti aklanywe ngobunjiniyela?
answer7: I-Escherichia coli (E. coli)
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima ye-Agrobacterium tumefaciens ekudaleni izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer8: Isebenza njenge-vector yemvelo edlulisela i-DNA ephindaphindayo ku-genome yesitshalo
distractor8a: Ihlela ngqo i-DNA yesitshalo ngaphandle kokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo
distractor8b: Isusa izakhi zofuzo ezingafuneki kuma-chromosome ezitshalo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Ezishintsha Ufuzo | I-Organic Insecticide Bacillus thuringiensis
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Ezishintsha Ufuzo | I-Organic Insecticide Bacillus thuringiensis
chapterContent: I-Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) yigciwane elikhiqiza amakristalu amaprotheni ngesikhathi sokukhula kwe-sporulation anobuthi ezinhlotsheni eziningi zezinambuzane ezithinta izitshalo. Ubuthi be-Bt kufanele bugwinywe yizinambuzane ukuze ubuthi busebenze. Izinambuzane ezidle ubuthi be-Bt ziyayeka ukudla izitshalo zingakapheli amahora ambalwa. Ngemva kokuba ubuthi busebenze emathunjini ezinambuzane, ukufa kwenzeka zingakapheli izinsuku ezimbalwa. I-biotechnology yanamuhla ivumele izitshalo ukuthi zibhale ubuthi bazo be-Bt obuyikristalu obusebenza ngokumelene nezinambuzane. Izakhi zofuzo ze-crystal toxin ziqoqwe kusuka ku-Bt futhi zafakwa ezitshalweni. Ubuthi be-Bt butholakale buphephile emvelweni, abunabuthi kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo, futhi buvunyelwe ukusetshenziswa abalimi bemvelo njengesibulala-zinambuzane semvelo.
question1: Iyini i-Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt)?
answer1: Ibhaktheriya ekhiqiza amakristalu amaprotheni anobuthi ezinambuzaneni eziningi
question2: Ubuthi be-Bt buqala nini ukusebenza?
answer2: Ngemva kokugwinywa futhi kusebenze emathunjini ezinambuzane
distractor2a: Ngokushesha ngemva kokuthintana nezinambuzane ezingaphandle kwethambo
question3: Kwenzekani ezinambuzaneni ngokushesha nje ngemva kokudla ubuthi be-Bt?
answer3: Bayayeka ukudla izitshalo zingakapheli amahora ambalwa
distractor3b: Ziba namandla okumelana nazo zonke izibulala-zinambuzane
question4: Uyini umphumela wokugcina we-activated Bt toxin ezinambuzaneni ezisengozini?
answer4: Izinambuzane ziyafa zingakapheli izinsuku ezimbalwa
distractor4a: Lezi zinambuzane azikwazi ukumelana nobuthi be-Bt
distractor4c: Izinambuzane ziyaguquka zibe izithuthi zempova ezizuzisayo
question5: I-biotechnology ithuthukise kanjani ukusetshenziswa kwe-Bt toxin kwezolimo?
answer5: Ngokufaka izakhi zofuzo ze-Bt toxin ezitshalweni ukuze zikhiqize ubuthi ngokwazo
distractor5a: Ngokususa zonke izakhi zofuzo zamagciwane ezitshalweni zezitshalo
distractor5c: Ngokufaka i-DNA yebhaktheriya esikhundleni se-DNA yesitshalo
question6: Zazitholakalaphi izakhi zofuzo ze-Bt crystal toxin ekuqaleni?
answer6: Kusuka ku-Bacillus thuringiensis
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nobuthi be-Bt esisekelwa yile ndima?
answer7: Kubhekwa njengokuphephile endaweni ezungezile futhi akunabo ubuthi kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo
distractor7a: Kuyingozi kakhulu kuzo zonke izilwane ezincelisayo
question8: Kungani i-Bt ivunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ngabalimi bemvelo?
answer8: Ngoba kubhekwa njengesibulala-zinambuzane semvelo esiphephile emvelweni
distractor8a: Ngoba iqeda unomphela zonke izinhlobo zezinambuzane
distractor8b: Ngoba isebenza njengomuthi wokubulala ukhula owenziwe ngokwenziwa

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Eziguqulwe Ufuzo | Utamatisi Omnandi
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.1 I-Biotechnology | Izitshalo Eziguqulwe Ufuzo | Utamatisi Omnandi
chapterContent: Isitshalo sokuqala se-GM sasingo-1994. Kwakuyitamatisi eyayimelana nokubola futhi igcina ukunambitheka isikhathi eside. Ubuchwepheshe be-Antisense RNA basetshenziswa ukunciphisa inqubo yokuthamba nokubola okubangelwa ukutheleleka kwesikhunta, okwaholela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuphila kwamatamatisi e-GM. Ukuguqulwa okwengeziwe kwezakhi zofuzo kuthuthukise ukunambitheka kwale tomato. Le tomato ye-GM ayizange ihlale emakethe ngempumelelo ngenxa yezinkinga zokugcina nokuthumela isivuno.
question1: Yisiphi isitshalo sokuqala esiguqulwe izakhi zofuzo (GM) esakhishwa ngokuhweba?
answer1: Utamatisi we-Flavr Savr
question2: Isitshalo sokuqala se-GM saqala ukukhiqizwa ngamuphi unyaka?
question3: Yayiyini inzuzo eyinhloko katamatisi i-Flavr Savr?
answer3: Yamelana nokubola futhi yagcina ukunambitheka kwayo isikhathi eside
question4: Yisiphi isimiso se-biotechnology esasetshenziswa ukwandisa impilo yeshelufu yetamatisi i-Flavr Savr?
answer4: Ubuchwepheshe be-RNA ye-Antisense
question5: Ubuchwepheshe be-RNA ye-antisense buyithuthukise kanjani itamatisi i-Flavr Savr?
answer5: Kwehlisa inqubo yokuthamba nokubola okubangelwa ukutheleleka ngefungus
question6: Ngaphandle kokwelula isikhathi sokuphila, yikuphi ukuthuthukiswa okwengeziwe okwenziwe kutamatisi i-Flavr Savr?
answer6: Ukunambitheka kwayo kwathuthukiswa ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question7: Kungani utamatisi i-Flavr Savr ungaphumelelanga emakethe ekugcineni?
answer7: Ngenxa yobunzima bokunakekela nokuthumela isivuno
question8: Yayiyini inhloso eyinhloko yokuthuthukisa utamatisi i-Flavr Savr?
answer8: Ukukhiqiza utamatisi ohlala isikhathi eside ngesikhathi esifanayo ugcina ukunambitheka okuhle
distractor8a: Ukwenza utamatisi umelane nawo wonke amagciwane

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumapha i-Genomes | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumapha i-Genomes | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukumapha kwezakhi zofuzo kufana nokuxazulula iphazili enkulu neyinkimbinkimbi enezingcezu zolwazi eziqoqwe emalabhorethri emhlabeni wonke. Amamephu ezakhi zofuzo anikeza uhlaka lwendawo yezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwe-chromosome. Ibanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nezimpawu zezakhi zofuzo lilinganiswa ngokusekelwe kuma-recombination (crossing over) frequency ngesikhathi se-meiosis. I-Human Genome Project isize abacwaningi ukuhlonza izinkulungwane zezakhi zofuzo zabantu kanye nemikhiqizo yazo yamaprotheni. Izindawo ze-DNA ezingabhalisi amakhodi zingase zihileleke ekulawuleni ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo, kanti ezinye izilandelana ezake zabhekwa njengeziyimfucuza” zingadlala indima ebalulekile ekuziphendukeleni kwezakhi zofuzo. Zimbalwa umehluko okhona phakathi kwezilandelana ze-DNA yomuntu nezezinye izinto eziningi eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwekharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi olusekelwe ebholeni lokucwaninga, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zithole, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.A
Ulwazi oluzuzwa luhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuphila.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.1 I-DNA, futhi kwezinye izimo i-RNA, ingumthombo oyinhloko wolwazi oluzuzwayo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo nezibikezelo mayelana nezenzakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.5 Umfundi angathethelela isimangalo sokuthi abantu bangalawula ulwazi oluzuzwayo ngokukhomba izibonelo zobuchwepheshe obusetshenziswa kakhulu.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.2 Kuma-eukaryotes, ulwazi oluzuzwayo ludluliselwa esizukulwaneni esilandelayo ngezinqubo ezifaka umjikelezo weseli kanye ne-mitosis noma i-meiosis.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izimo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.10 Umfundi uyakwazi ukumela ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-meiosis kanye nokwanda kokwehlukahlukana kwezakhi zofuzo okudingekayo ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.A.3 Isisekelo se-chromosome sefa sinikeza ukuqonda iphethini yokudluliselwa (ukudluliselwa) kwezakhi zofuzo kusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angakha izethulo namamodeli ezehlakalo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngumuntu kulesi sizinda.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izindawo) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuqhubekayo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 I-Genomics isifundo sama-genome aphelele, okuhlanganisa isethi ephelele yezakhi zofuzo, ukulandelana kwazo kwe-nucleotide kanye nokuhleleka kwazo, kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo ngaphakathi kohlobo kanye nezinye izinhlobo. I-genome mapping inqubo yokuthola izindawo zezakhi zofuzo ku-chromosome ngayinye. Amamephu adalwe yi-genome mapping afana namamephu esiwasebenzisayo ukuhamba emigwaqweni. Imephu yezakhi zofuzo umfanekiso obala izakhi zofuzo nendawo yazo ku-chromosome. Amamephu ezakhi zofuzo anikeza isithombe esikhulu (esifana nemephu yemigwaqo emikhulu ephakathi kwezifundazwe) futhi asebenzisa izimpawu zezakhi zofuzo (ezifana nezimpawu zofuzo). I-genetic marker iyi-gene noma ukulandelana ku-chromosome ihlukanisa ngokuhlanganyela (ikhombisa ukuxhumana kwezakhi zofuzo) nesici esithile. Izazi zezakhi zofuzo zakuqala zabiza lokhu kuhlaziywa kokuxhumana. Amamephu angokoqobo aveza imininingwane eseduze yezindawo ezincane zama-chromosome (njengomephu womgwaqo onemininingwane). Imephu engokoqobo iwukumelwa kwebanga elingokoqobo, kuma-nucleotide, phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo noma izimpawu zezakhi zofuzo. Kokubili amamephu okuxhumana kwezakhi zofuzo kanye namamephu angokoqobo kuyadingeka ukwakha isithombe esiphelele se-genome. Ukuba nemephu ephelele ye-genome kwenza kube lula ngabacwaningi ukutadisha izakhi zofuzo ngazinye. Amamephu e-genome yabantu asiza abacwaningi emizamweni yabo yokuhlonza izakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo kubantu ezihlobene nezifo ezifana nomdlavuza, isifo senhliziyo, kanye ne-cystic fibrosis. Ukumapha kwe-genome kungasetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezahlukahlukene, njengokusebenzisa amagciwane aphilayo ukuhlanza ukungcola noma ngisho nokuvimbela ukungcola. Ucwaningo oluhilela ukumapha kwe-genome yezitshalo lungaholela ekukhiqizeni isivuno esikhulu sezitshalo noma ekukhuleni kwezitshalo ezizivumelanisa kangcono noshintsho lwesimo sezulu.
question1: Kuyini i-genomics?
answer1: Ucwaningo lwama-genome aphelele, okuhlanganisa izakhi zofuzo, ukulandelana kwazo, inhlangano, kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo
distractor1c: Ucwaningo lwama-chromosome ngamanye angenazo izakhi zofuzo
question2: Iyini inhloso yokuhlela i-genome?
question3: Amamephu ezakhi zofuzo alinganisela amabanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo kusetshenziswa yiphi inqubo?
answer3: Ama-recombination (crossing over) frequency ngesikhathi se-meiosis
distractor3c: Imvamisa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi se-mitosis
question4: Iyini uphawu lwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Uchungechunge lwezakhi zofuzo noma lwe-DNA oluhlukanisa isici esithile
question5: Imephu ebonakalayo ihluke kanjani kumephu yezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Imephu ebonakalayo ikhombisa amabanga angempela e-nucleotide phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo noma izimpawu
distractor5a: Imephu ebonakalayo ibonisa ukusebenzisana kwamaprotheni kuphela
distractor5b: Imephu ebonakalayo isekelwe kuphela ekuvameni kokuhlanganiswa kabusha
distractor5c: Imephu ebonakalayo iqukethe i-DNA engabhalwanga ikhodi kuphela
question6: Kungani kokubili amamephu okuxhumanisa izakhi zofuzo kanye namamephu angokoqobo kubalulekile?
answer6: Ndawonye zinikeza isithombe esiphelele sokuhleleka kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor6a: Ngoba kokubili kuyadingeka ukuze kuphindaphindwe i-DNA
distractor6c: Ngoba amamephu angokoqobo awakwazi ukuhlonza izakhi zofuzo
question7: I-Human Genome Project iluzuzise kanjani ucwaningo lwezinto eziphilayo?
answer7: Kusize ekuboneni izinkulungwane zezakhi zofuzo zabantu kanye nemikhiqizo yazo yamaprotheni
distractor7b: Kwafakazela ukuthi i-DNA engabhalisi ikhodi ayinawo umsebenzi
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-DNA engabhalisi ikhodi esisekelwa ubufakazi bamanje?
answer8: Ezinye izindawo ezingabhalisi amakhodi zilawula ukuvezwa kwezakhi zofuzo futhi zinegalelo ekuziphendukeleni kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor8a: Yonke i-DNA engabhalisi ikhodi iyi-DNA engenalutho engenamsebenzi
distractor8b: I-DNA engabhalisi ikhodi ihunyushwa ibe amaprotheni
question9: Imephu ye-genome ingaba nomthelela kanjani kwezokwelapha?
answer9: Kusiza ekuboneni izakhi zofuzo ezihlotshaniswa nezifo ezifana nomdlavuza, isifo senhliziyo, kanye ne-cystic fibrosis
distractor9a: Yelapha unomphela zonke izifo ezizuzwe njengefa
distractor9c: Kuthatha indawo yesidingo sokuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo
question10: Yikuphi ukusetshenziswa okubalulekile kwemephu ye-genome ngaphandle kwemithi yabantu?
answer10: Ukuthuthukisa izitshalo ezithuthukisiwe kanye nama-microorganisms ukuze kuhlanzwe imvelo
distractor10c: Ukususa zonke izinguquko ezivela ku-genome yezitshalo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumapha Izakhi zofuzo | Amamephu Ezakhi zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumapha Izakhi zofuzo | Amamephu Ezakhi zofuzo
chapterContent:
Ucwaningo lwamamephu ezakhi zofuzo luqala ngokuhlaziywa kokuxhumanisa, inqubo ehlaziya imvamisa yokuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zixhumene noma zibonisa ukuhlukahluka okuzimele. Igama elithi ukuxhumana lalisetshenziswa ngaphambi kokutholakala kwe-DNA. Izazi zezakhi zofuzo zokuqala zazithembele ekubonweni kwezinguquko ze-phenotypic ukuze ziqonde uhlobo lwezakhi zofuzo lwesidalwa. Ngemva nje kokuba uGregor Mendel (ubaba wezakhi zofuzo zanamuhla) ephakamise ukuthi izici zazinqunywa yilokho okwaziwa manje ngokuthi izakhi zofuzo, abanye abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi izici ezahlukene zazivame ukutholwa ndawonye, ngakho-ke baphetha ngokuthi izakhi zofuzo zazixhunyaniswe ngokomzimba ngokutholakala ku-chromosome efanayo. Ukumakwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezihlobene nomunye nomunye ngokusekelwe ekuhlaziyweni kokuxhumanisa kwaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwamamephu okuqala ezakhi zofuzo.

 Ukuqaphela ukuthi izici ezithile zazixhunyaniswe njalo kanti ezinye ezithile azixhunyanisiwe kwavela ekutadisheni inzalo yeziphambano phakathi kwabazali abanezimpawu ezahlukene. Isibonelo, ekuhlolweni okwenziwe ku-pea engadini, kwatholakala ukuthi umbala wembali nesimo sempova yesitshalo kwakuyizimpawu ezixhunyanisiwe, ngakho-ke izakhi zofuzo ezifaka lezi zimpawu zaziseduze kakhulu ku-chromosome efanayo. Ukushintshana kwe-DNA phakathi kwama-chromosome amabili afanayo kubizwa ngokuthi i-genetic recombination, okwenzeka ngokuwela i-DNA phakathi kwezintambo ze-DNA ezifanayo, njenge-non-sister chromatids. Ukuhlaziywa kokuxhumanisa kuhilela ukufunda imvamisa yokuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwanoma yiziphi izakhi zofuzo ezimbili. Uma ibanga eliphakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili likhulu, kulapho amathuba okuthi kwenzeke isenzakalo sokuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwazo aphezulu, futhi kulapho imvamisa yokuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwazo iphakeme. Amathuba amabili okuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwama-chromatids amabili angafani ngesikhathi se-meiosis aboniswe ku-Figure 17.10. Uma imvamisa yokuhlangana kabusha phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili ingaphansi kwamaphesenti angu-50, kuthiwa axhunyiwe.

 Ukukhiqizwa kwamamephu ezakhi zofuzo kudinga izimpawu, njengoba nje imephu yomgwaqo idinga izimpawu (njengemifula nezintaba). Amamephu ezakhi zofuzo okuqala ayesekelwe ekusetshenzisweni kwezakhi zofuzo ezaziwayo njengezimpawu. Izimpawu eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, kufaka phakathi lezo ezisekelwe ku-DNA engabhalisi ikhodi, manje zisetshenziselwa ukuqhathanisa ama-genome abantu ngabanye emphakathini. Nakuba abantu bohlobo oluthile befana ngezakhi zofuzo, abafani; umuntu ngamunye unesethi ehlukile yezimpawu. Lo mehluko omncane ku-genome phakathi kwabantu ngabanye emphakathini uwusizo ngezinhloso zokudweba imephu yezakhi zofuzo. Ngokuvamile, uphawu oluhle lwezakhi zofuzo yisifunda esiku-chromosome esibonisa ukuguquguquka noma i-polymorphism (izinhlobo eziningi) emphakathini.

 Ezinye izimpawu zezakhi zofuzo ezisetshenziswa ekudaleni amamephu ezakhi zofuzo yi-restriction fragment length polymorphisms (RFLP), variable number of tandem repeats (VNTRs), microsatellite polymorphisms, kanye ne-single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs). Ama-RFLP (ngezinye izikhathi abizwa ngokuthi ama-rif-lips) atholakala lapho i-DNA yomuntu isikwa nge-restriction endonuclease eqaphela ukulandelana okuthile ku-DNA ukuze kukhiqizwe uchungechunge lwezingcezu ze-DNA, ezibe sezihlaziywa yi-gel electrophoresis. I-DNA yomuntu ngamunye izoveza iphethini ehlukile yama-band lapho isikwa ngesethi ethile yama-restriction endonucleases; lokhu ngezinye izikhathi kubizwa ngokuthi i-DNA fingerprint yomuntu ngamunye.” Ezinye izindawo ze-chromosome ezingaphansi kwe-polymorphism zizoholela ekwakhiweni kwephethini ehlukile ye-banding. Ama-VNTR ayiziqoqo eziphindaphindwayo zama-nucleotide akhona ezindaweni ezingabhalisi i-DNA. Akubhalisi i-DNA, noma imfucumfucu,” i-DNA ayinawo umsebenzi webhayoloji owaziwayo; nokho, ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi ingxenye enkulu yale DNA empeleni ibhaliwe. Nakuba umsebenzi wayo ungaqinisekile, ngokuqinisekile iyasebenza, futhi ingase ihileleke ekulawulweni kwezakhi zofuzo zokubhala ikhodi. Inani lokuphindaphinda lingahluka ezintweni eziphilayo ngazinye zabantu. Ama-polymorphisms e-Microsatellite afana nama-VNTR, kodwa iyunithi yokuphindaphinda incane kakhulu. Ama-SNP ayizinhlobo ze-nucleotide eyodwa.

 Ngenxa yokuthi amamephu ezakhi zofuzo athembele ngokuphelele enkambisweni yemvelo yokuphinda kuhlanganiswe, ukumaka kuthinteka ukwanda noma ukwehla ngokwemvelo kwezinga lokuphinda kuhlanganiswe kunoma iyiphi indawo ethile ye-genome. Ezinye izingxenye ze-genome ziyizindawo ezishisayo zokuphinda kuhlanganiswe, kanti ezinye azibonisi ukuthambekela kokuphinda kuhlanganiswe. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, kubalulekile ukubheka ulwazi lokumaka oluthuthukiswe ngezindlela eziningi.
question1: Iyini inhloso yokuhlaziywa kokuxhumana?
answer1: Ukunquma ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zixhumene yini ngokuhlaziya amaza okuphindaphinda
question2: Kusho ukuthini ukuphindaphindwa kwezakhi zofuzo okungaphansi kwama-50% phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili?
question3: Ibanga eliphakathi kwezakhi zofuzo ezimbili lithinta kanjani imvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha?
answer3: Uma ibanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo likhulu, kulapho imvamisa yokuphindaphinda iphakama khona
distractor3a: Uma ibanga likhulu, imvamisa yokuphindaphinda iyancipha
distractor3b: Ibanga alinawo umthelela ekuvameni kokuhlanganiswa kabusha
distractor3c: Ukuhlangana kabusha kwenzeka kuphela phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo eziseduze
question4: Kuyini ukuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer4: Ukushintshaniswa kwe-DNA phakathi kwama-chromosomes afanayo ngokuwela
question5: Kungani izimpawu zofuzo zibalulekile ekwakheni amamephu ofuzo?
answer5: Zihlinzeka ngezimpawu ze-chromosome ezibonakala kalula ezivumela izindawo zezakhi zofuzo ukuthi zinqunywe
question6: Iyini i-restriction fragment length polymorphism (RFLP)?
answer6: Ukwehluka kwe-DNA kutholakale ngokusika i-DNA ngama-enzyme okuvimbela kanye nokuhlaziya ubukhulu bezingcezu
distractor6a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kutholwe kuphela yi-PCR
question7: Yiluphi uhlobo lophawu lwezakhi zofuzo oluqukethe ukulandelana kwe-DNA okuphindaphindiwe ezindaweni ezingabhalisi ikhodi ezihluka ngenombolo yamakhophi phakathi kwabantu?
answer7: Inombolo eguquguqukayo yokuphindaphinda kwe-tandem (ama-VNTR)
question8: Iyini i-single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP)?
answer8: Ukwehluka okubandakanya i-nucleotide eyodwa ku-DNA sequence
distractor8c: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okuthinta ama-molecule e-RNA kuphela
question9: Kungani amazinga okuhlangana kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo engathinta ukunemba kwamamephu ezakhi zofuzo?
answer9: Ngoba ezinye izindawo ze-genomic ziyizindawo ezishisayo zokuphinda kuhlanganiswe kanti ezinye azivamile ukuphinda kuhlanganiswe
distractor9a: Ngoba ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwenzeka ngokulinganayo kulo lonke i-genome
distractor9b: Ngoba ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwenzeka kuphela ngesikhathi se-mitosis
distractor9c: Ngoba ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kususa zonke izimpawu zofuzo
question10: Kungani izindlela eziningi zokumapha zivame ukusetshenziswa ukutadisha ama-genome?
answer10: Ngoba imvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha iyahlukahluka kulo lonke i-genome, ngakho-ke ukuhlanganisa izindlela kukhiqiza amamephu anembe kakhudlwana
distractor10a: Ngoba amamephu ezakhi zofuzo awakwazi ukuhlonza izakhi zofuzo ezixhunyiwe
distractor10b: Ngoba amamephu angokoqobo athatha indawo yedatha yokuhlanganiswa kabusha ngokuphelele
distractor10c: Ngoba ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwenzeka kuphela kumagciwane

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumapha Ama-Genomes | Amamephu Angokoqobo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumapha Ama-Genomes | Amamephu Angokoqobo
chapterContent: Imephu ebonakalayo inikeza imininingwane yebanga langempela elibonakalayo phakathi kwezimpawu zofuzo, kanye nenani lama-nucleotide. Kunezindlela ezintathu ezisetshenziswa ukudala imephu ebonakalayo: imephu ye-cytogenetic, imephu ye-radiation hybrid, kanye nemephu yokulandelelana. Imephu ye-cytogenetic isebenzisa ulwazi olutholwe ngokuhlaziywa kwe-microscope kwezingxenye ezinemibala ye-chromosome (Isithombe 17.11). Kungenzeka ukunquma ibanga elilinganiselwe phakathi kwezimpawu zofuzo kusetshenziswa imephu ye-cytogenetic, kodwa hhayi ibanga eliqondile (inani lama-base pairs). Imephu ye-radiation hybrid isebenzisa imisebe, njenge-x-ray, ukuphula i-DNA ibe yizicucu. Inani lemisebe lingalungiswa ukuze kudalwe izicucu ezincane noma ezinkulu. Le ndlela inqoba umkhawulo wemephu yezakhi zofuzo futhi ayithintwa ukwanda noma ukwehla kwemvamisa yokuphinda kuhlanganiswe. Imephu yokulandelelana ebangelwe ubuchwepheshe bokulandelana kwe-DNA obuvumele ukudalwa kwamamephu ezinto ezibonakalayo anemininingwane enamabanga alinganiswa ngokwenani lama-base pairs. Ukudalwa kwama-genomic libraries kanye nama-DNA libraries ahambisanayo (amaqoqo e-cloned sequences noma yonke i-DNA evela ku-genome) kusheshise inqubo yemephu engokoqobo. Indawo yezakhi zofuzo esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza imephu ebonakalayo ngobuchwepheshe bokulandelana (indawo ene-sequence-tagged, noma i-STS) iwuchungechunge oluhlukile ku-genome olunendawo eyaziwayo ye-chromosome. Ithegi yochungechunge oluveziwe (EST) kanye ne-single sequence length polymorphism (SSLP) yi-STS evamile. I-EST yi-STS emfushane ehlonzwa ngemitapo yolwazi ye-cDNA, kuyilapho ama-SSLP etholakala kuma-genetic markers aziwayo futhi ahlinzeka ngesixhumanisi phakathi kwamamephu ezakhi zofuzo namamephu angokwenyama.
question1: Yiluphi ulwazi olunikezwa yimephu ebonakalayo?
answer1: Ibanga langempela elibonakalayo phakathi kwezimpawu zofuzo ezilinganiswa kuma-nucleotide noma ama-base pairs
distractor1a: Imvamisa yokuphindaphindana phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo kuphela
question2: Yiziphi izindlela ezintathu ezivame ukusetshenziswa ukudala amamephu angokoqobo?
answer2: Imephu ye-Cytogenetic, imephu ye-radiation hybrid, kanye nemephu yokulandelana
distractor2a: I-gel electrophoresis, i-PCR, kanye ne-Southern blotting
question3: Iyini imingcele eyinhloko yokuhlela i-cytogenetic?
answer3: Ilinganisa amabanga aphakathi kwama-marker kodwa ayikwazi ukunquma inani eliqondile lama-base pair
question4: Imephu ye-radiation hybrid idala kanjani izingcezu ze-chromosome?
answer4: Ngokusebenzisa imisebe efana ne-X-ray ukuphula i-DNA ibe yizicucu
distractor4b: Ngokufudumeza i-DNA kuze kube yilapho ibola
question5: Iyini inzuzo yemephu ye-radiation hybrid ngaphezu kwemephu yezakhi zofuzo?
answer5: Akuthinteki ukushintshashintsha kwemvamisa yokuhlanganiswa kabusha
question6: Yikuphi ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe okwenza kwaba nokwenzeka ukwenza imephu yokulandelana enemininingwane eminingi?
answer6: Ubuchwepheshe bokulandelana kwe-DNA
question7: Uyini umtapo wolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo?
answer7: Iqoqo lezinhlelo ze-DNA ezihlanganisiwe ezimele i-genome yezinto eziphilayo
question8: Iyini isayithi eline-sequence-tagged (STS)?
answer8: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA oluyingqayizivele olunendawo eyaziwayo ye-chromosome esetshenziselwa ukumepha ngokomzimba
distractor8a: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA oluphindaphindwayo olutholakala kuwo wonke ama-chromosome
question9: Iyini ithegi yokulandelana evezwe (EST)?
answer9: Isayithi elinohlu olufushane olunezimpawu zokulandelana elitholwe kusetshenziswa imitapo yolwazi ye-cDNA
distractor9c: I-chromosome edwetshwe ukuze kuhlolwe i-cytogenetic mapping
question10: Iyini indima ye-single sequence length polymorphism (SSLP) ekuhlolweni kwe-genome?
answer10: Isebenza njengesayithi elinethegi yokulandelana elixhumanisa amamephu ezakhi zofuzo namamephu angokoqobo
distractor10a: Ithatha indawo yazo zonke izindawo ezibekwe uphawu lokulandelana kumephu ye-genome

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumaka Ama-Genomes | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwamamephu Ezakhi Zofuzo Nawezinto Ezibonakalayo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.2 Ukumaka Ama-Genomes | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwamamephu Ezakhi Zofuzo Nawezinto Ezibonakalayo
chapterContent: Amamephu ezakhi zofuzo anikeza uhlaka kanti amamephu angokoqobo anikeza imininingwane. Kulula ukuqonda ukuthi kungani zombili izinhlobo zamasu okumaka izakhi zofuzo zibalulekile ukukhombisa isithombe esikhulu. Ulwazi olutholakala kuhlelo ngalunye lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganiswa ukutadisha izakhi zofuzo. Ukumaka izakhi zofuzo kusetshenziswa nezinto eziphilayo ezahlukene ezisetshenziswa ocwaningweni. Ukumaka izakhi zofuzo kuseyinqubo eqhubekayo, futhi njengoba kuthuthukiswa amasu athuthukile, kulindeleke intuthuko eyengeziwe. Ukumaka izakhi zofuzo kufana nokuqedela iphazili eyinkimbinkimbi kusetshenziswa yonke idatha etholakalayo. Ulwazi lokumaka olukhiqizwa emalabhorethri emhlabeni wonke lufakwa kudathabheyisi ephakathi, njengeGenBank eNational Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI). Kwenziwa imizamo yokwenza ulwazi lutholakale kalula kubacwaningi kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Njengoba nje sisebenzisa izinhlelo zokubeka umhlaba wonke esikhundleni samamephu ephepha ukuze sihambe emigwaqweni, i-NCBI idale ithuluzi lokubuka izakhi zofuzo ukuze kube lula inqubo yokumba idatha.
question1: Kungani amamephu ezakhi zofuzo kanye namamephu angokoqobo kudingeka ukuze kufundwe izakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Amamephu ofuzo ahlinzeka ngobudlelwano bezakhi zofuzo obuphelele, kuyilapho amamephu angokoqobo enikeza imininingwane enembile yezinga le-nucleotide
distractor1a: Ngoba amamephu ezakhi zofuzo angasetshenziswa kuphela kuma-bacteria
distractor1b: Ngoba amamephu angokoqobo awakwazi ukuhlonza izakhi zofuzo
distractor1c: Ngoba zombili izindlela zilinganisa imvamisa yokuphinda kuhlanganiswe
question2: Idatha yemephu yezakhi zofuzo kanye neyomzimba isetshenziswa kanjani ndawonye?
answer2: Zihlanganiswe ukuze kudalwe ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhleleka kwe-genome
distractor2a: Amamephu angokoqobo athatha indawo yamamephu ofuzo ngokuphelele
distractor2b: Amamephu ezakhi zofuzo kuphela asetshenziswa ku-genomics yesimanje
question3: Kungani imephu ye-genome ibhekwa njengenqubo eqhubekayo?
answer3: Ngoba ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe buyaqhubeka nokukhiqiza ulwazi olunembile kakhulu lwe-genomic
distractor3c: Ngoba amamephu angokoqobo ahlala ethathelwa indawo amamephu ezakhi zofuzo
question4: Kungani izinto eziphilayo eziyimodeli zibalulekile ocwaningweni lokumapha i-genome?
answer4: Basiza abacwaningi ukuthi bahlole ukuhlelwa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nomsebenzi wezakhi zofuzo
distractor4a: Ziqeda isidingo sokutadisha izakhi zofuzo zabantu
question5: Iyini i-GenBank?
answer5: Isizindalwazi esiphakathi esigcina imephu ye-genome kanye nolwazi lokulandelana kwe-DNA
question6: Iyiphi inhlangano egcina iGenBank?
answer6: Isikhungo Sikazwelonke Solwazi Lwe-Biotechnology (NCBI)
distractor6b: I-National Institutes of Health Genome Bank
question7: Kungani idatha yemephu ye-genome yabelwana ngayo ngedathabheyisi ephakathi?
answer7: Ukwenza ulwazi lwe-genomic lutholakale kubacwaningi kanye nomphakathi emhlabeni jikelele
distractor7c: Ukuqeda ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo phakathi kwabantu
question8: Yiliphi ithuluzi elikhiqizwe yi-NCBI ukuze kube lula ukuhlaziywa kwedatha ye-genome?
answer8: Isibukeli se-genome

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo eziphelele | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo eziphelele | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluvezwe esigabeni alukho emkhakheni we-AP®. Kodwa-ke, ungafunda ulwazi esigabeni njengolwazi olukhethekile noma olubonisayo.

 Nakuba kube nentuthuko ebalulekile kwezesayensi yezokwelapha eminyakeni yamuva nje, odokotela basadidekile ngezinye izifo, futhi basebenzisa ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele ukuze bafinyelele emnyombweni wenkinga. Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kuyinqubo enquma ukulandelana kwe-DNA ye-genome yonke. Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kuyindlela enamandla amakhulu yokuxazulula izinkinga lapho kunesisekelo sezakhi zofuzo emnyombweni wesifo. Amalabhorethri amaningana manje ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokulandelana, ukuhlaziya, nokuhumusha ama-genome aphelele.

 Ukulandelana kwe-exome ephelele kuyindlela engabizi kakhulu kune-genome ephelele. Ekulandeleni kwe-exome, kuphela izindawo ezikhiqiza i-exon ze-DNA ezilandelanayo. Ngo-2010, ukulandelana kwe-exome ephelele kwasetshenziswa ukusindisa umfana omncane omathumbu akhe ayenamathumba amaningi angaqondakali. Ingane yahlinzwa kaningana emathunjini ngaphandle kokukhululeka. Ekugcineni, kwenziwa uchungechunge lwe-whole-exome, okwaveza iphutha endleleni elawula i-apoptosis (ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe). Ukufakelwa umnkantsha kwasetshenziswa ukunqoba lesi sifo sofuzo, okwaholela ekwelapheni lo mfana. Wayengumuntu wokuqala ukwelashwa ngempumelelo ngokusekelwe ekuxilongweni okwenziwe uchungechunge lwe-whole-exome.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa ehlobene nezinto ezikulesi sigaba ezizokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 2.23][APLO 3.5][APLO 3.20][APLO 3.21]
question1: Kuyini ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele?
answer1: Inqubo enquma ukulandelana okuphelele kwe-DNA ye-genome yezinto eziphilayo
distractor1a: Indlela elandelanisa izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni kuphela
distractor1c: Inqubo ekhomba amaprotheni ngaphandle kokulandelanisa i-DNA
question2: Kungani ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo eziphelele kuwusizo kwezokwelapha?
answer2: Ingakhomba izimbangela zezakhi zofuzo zezifo okunzima ukuzixilonga.
distractor2b: Ithatha indawo yazo zonke izindlela zokuthatha izithombe zezokwelapha
question3: Kuyini ukulandelana kwe-whole-exome?
answer3: Ukulandelanisa kuphela izindawo ze-exon ze-genome eziqukethe amaprotheni
question4: Kungani ukuhlelwa kwe-whole-exome kuvame ukukhethwa esikhundleni sokuhlelwa kwe-whole-genome?
answer4: Kuyindlela ehlukile engabizi kakhulu egxile ezifundeni zokubhala amakhodi
distractor4a: Ilandelanisa i-DNA eningi kunokulandelana kwe-genome ephelele
question5: Yisiphi isici sofuzo esatholakala kumfana ophathwe ngokusebenzisa i-whole-exome sequencing?
answer5: Iphutha endleleni elawula i-apoptosis
question6: Yikuphi ukwelashwa okwamphulukisa umfana ngempumelelo ngemva kokuba ukuhlolwa kwe-whole-exome kuthole imbangela yokugula kwakhe?
answer6: Ukufakelwa umnkantsha
question7: Kungani icala elichazwe endimeni libhekwa njengelibalulekile?
answer7: Kwakuwukwelashwa kokuqala okuphumelelayo okusekelwe ekuxilongweni okwenziwe ngokuhlola i-whole-exome sequencing
distractor7a: Kwakuyi-genome yokuqala yomuntu eyake yahlelwa ngokulandelana
distractor7b: Kufakazele ukuthi zonke izifo zibangelwa ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo olulodwa
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kanye nokulandelana kwe-exome ephelele?
answer8: Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kuhlaziya i-genome yonke, kuyilapho ukulandelana kwe-exome ephelele kuhlaziya ama-exons kuphela
distractor8a: Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kuhlaziya ama-exons kuphela, kuyilapho ukulandelana kwe-exome ephelele kuhlaziya i-genome yonke
distractor8b: Zombili lezi zindlela zilandelana kuphela i-DNA engabhalisi ikhodi

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Amasu Asetshenziswa Kumaphrojekthi Okulandelana
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Amasu Asetshenziswa Kumaphrojekthi Okulandelana
chapterContent: Indlela eyisisekelo yokulandelana esetshenziswa kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokulandelana zanamuhla yindlela yokuqeda uchungechunge (eyaziwa nangokuthi indlela ye-dideoxy), eyathuthukiswa nguFred Sanger ngawo-1970. Indlela yokuqeda uchungechunge ihilela ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kwethempulethi enezintambo eyodwa kusetshenziswa i-primer kanye ne-deoxynucleotide ejwayelekile (dNTP), okuyi-monomer, noma iyunithi eyodwa, ye-DNA. I-primer kanye ne-dNTP kuxutshwe nengxenye encane yama-dideoxynucleotides anelebula elikhanyayo (ddNTPs). Ama-ddNTP angama-monomer aswele iqembu le-hydroxyl (–OH) endaweni lapho enye i-nucleotide ivame ukunamathela khona ukuze yakhe uchungechunge (Isithombe 17.12). I-ddNTP ngayinye ilebula ngombala ohlukile we-fluorophore. Njalo lapho i-ddNTP ifakwa kuchungechunge olukhulayo oluhambisanayo, iqeda inqubo yokuphindaphinda kwe-DNA, okuholela emicu eminingi emifushane ye-DNA ephindaphindwayo eqedwa ngayinye endaweni ehlukile ngesikhathi sokuphindaphinda. Uma ingxube yokusabela icutshungulwa yi-gel electrophoresis ngemva kokuhlukaniswa ibe yimicu eyodwa, imicu eminingi ye-DNA ephindaphindwayo yakha ileli ngenxa yobukhulu obuhlukahlukene. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-ddNTP anelebula elikhanyayo, ibhendi ngayinye kujeli ibonisa usayizi womucu we-DNA kanye ne-ddNTP eqede ukusabela. Imibala ehlukene yama-ddNTP anelebula le-fluorophore isiza ukuhlonza i-ddNTP efakwe kuleyo ndawo. Ukufunda ijeli ngokusekelwe kumbala webhendi ngayinye esitebhisini kukhiqiza ukulandelana komucu wethempulethi (Isithombe 17.13)
question1: Iyiphi indlela yokulandelana kwe-DNA eyakha isisekelo samaphrojekthi amaningi okulandelana kwesimanje?
answer1: Indlela yokuqeda uchungechunge (i-dieoxy) eyasungulwa nguFred Sanger
question2: Iyini indima ye-primer ekulandeleni i-Sanger?
answer2: Inikeza indawo yokuqala ye-DNA polymerase ukuqala ukwenziwa kwe-DNA
distractor2b: Ifaka amalebula ezingcezu ze-DNA ngamadayi e-fluorescent
question3: Kungani ama-dideoxynucleotides (ddNTPs) eqeda ukwenziwa kwe-DNA?
answer3: Ngoba azinalo iqembu lama-hydroxyl (-OH) amathathu elidingekayo ukuze kufakwe enye i-nucleotide
distractor3b: Ngoba zivimbela i-DNA polymerase ekubopheni ithempulethi
question4: Kungani uhlobo ngalunye lwe-ddNTP luphawulwe ngodayi ohlukile we-fluorescent?
answer4: Ukuthola ukuthi iyiphi i-nucleotide eqede ingxenye ngayinye ye-DNA
question5: Kungani kukhiqizwa izingcezu eziningi ze-DNA ezinobude obuhlukene ngesikhathi sokulandelana kwe-Sanger?
answer5: Ngoba ukwakheka kwe-DNA kuyama noma nini lapho kufakwa i-ddNTP ekhanyayo
distractor5a: Ngoba i-DNA polymerase idlula ama-nucleotide ngokungahleliwe
distractor5b: Ngoba ama-enzyme okuvimbela anquma i-DNA ngokuphindaphindiwe
question6: Iyini inhloso ye-gel electrophoresis ekulandeleni kwe-Sanger?
answer6: Ukuhlukanisa izingcezu ze-DNA ngokobukhulu bazo
question7: Ukulandelana kwe-DNA kunqunywa kanjani ngemva kwe-electrophoresis?
answer7: Ngokufunda ukulandelana kwezingcezu ze-DNA ezibhalwe nge-fluorescent kusukela ezincane kakhulu kuya kwezinkulu kakhulu
distractor7c: Ngokuthola ingxenye ende kunazo zonke kuqala
question8: Yisiphi isici esihlukanisa i-dideoxynucleotide (ddNTP) ku-deoxynucleotide evamile (dNTP)?
answer8: I-ddNTP ayinalo iqembu le-hydroxyl elidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokwandiswa kwe-DNA chain.
distractor8b: I-ddNTP iqukethe amaqembu amabili e-phosphate esikhundleni samathathu
distractor8c: I-ddNTP ayikwazi ukuhambisana nezisekelo ze-DNA ezihambisanayo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Amasu Asetshenziswa Kumaphrojekthi Okulandelana | Amasu Okuqala: Ukulandelana Kwezibhamu Ezinezibhamu kanye Nokulandelana Kwazo Ngokusebenzisa Uhlaka Lweziphetho Olunezingqimba Ezimbili
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Amasu Asetshenziswa Kumaphrojekthi Okulandelana | Amasu Okuqala: Ukulandelana Kwezibhamu Ezinezibhamu kanye Nokulandelana Kwazo Ngokusebenzisa Uhlaka Lweziphetho Olunezingqimba Ezimbili
chapterContent:
Ngendlela yokulandelana kwezibhamu, amakhophi amaningana esiqephu se-DNA asikwa ngokungahleliwe abe yizicucu eziningi ezincane (cishe njengoba kwenzeka ku-cartridge eyindilinga lapho idutshulwa kusuka kusibhamu). Zonke izingxenye zibe sezihlelwa kusetshenziswa indlela yokulandelana kwezintambo. Bese, ngosizo lwekhompyutha, izingcezu ziyahlaziywa ukuze kubonakale ukuthi izingcezu zazo zihlangana kuphi. Ngokufanisa izingcezu ezihambisanayo ekugcineni kwesicucu ngasinye, lonke uhlu lwe-DNA lungaguqulwa. Uhlu olukhulu oluqoqwe kusuka kuzingcezu ezimfushane ezihambisanayo lubizwa ngokuthi i-contig. Njengomfanekiso, cabanga ukuthi othile unamakhophi amane esithombe sendawo ongakaze usibone ngaphambili futhi ongazi lutho ngokuthi kufanele sivele kanjani. Umuntu ube esedabula isithombe ngasinye ngezandla zakhe, ukuze kube nezingcezu zobukhulu obuhlukene ezivela kukhophi ngayinye. Umuntu ube esehlanganisa zonke izingcezu ndawonye bese ekucela ukuthi wakhe kabusha isithombe. Kwenye yezingcezu ezincane ubona intaba. Esiqeshini esikhulu, ubona ukuthi intaba efanayo ingemuva kwechibi. Isingcezu sesithathu sibonisa ichibi kuphela, kodwa sembula ukuthi kukhona ikhabhini ogwini lwechibi. Ngakho-ke, ngokubheka ulwazi oluhambisanayo kulezi zingcezu ezintathu, uyazi ukuthi isithombe siqukethe intaba ngemuva kwechibi elinekhabhini ogwini lwalo. Lesi yisimiso sokwakha kabusha yonke imigqa ye-DNA kusetshenziswa imigqa yesibhamu.

 Ekuqaleni, imigqa yesibhamu yayihlaziya kuphela umkhawulo owodwa wengxenye ngayinye ukuze ithole ukugqagqana. Lokhu kwakwanele ekulandeleni imigqa yesibhamu encane. Kodwa-ke, isifiso sokulandelana kwemigqa yesibhamu emikhulu, njengaleyo yomuntu, saholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemigqa yesibhamu yesibhamu enemigqomo emibili, eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi imigqa yesibhamu yemigqomo emibili. Ekulandeleni kwemigqa yesibhamu yemigqomo emibili, zombili iziphetho zengxenye ngayinye zihlaziywa ukuze zigqagqane. Ngakho-ke, imigqa yesibhamu yemigqomo emibili inzima kakhulu kunokulandelana kwesibhamu yemigqomo emibili, kodwa kulula ukwakha kabusha imigqa ngoba kunolwazi oluningi olutholakalayo.
question1: Yisiphi isinyathelo sokuqala sokulandelana kwezibhamu?
answer1: Amakhophi amaningi e-DNA anqunywa ngokungahleliwe abe yizicucu eziningi ezincane
distractor1b: I-chromosome yonke ihlelwe ngokulandelana ngaphandle kokuqhekeka
distractor1c: Ama-enzyme okuvimbela ahlala esika i-DNA ngezikhawu ezifanayo
question2: Izingcezu ze-DNA zihlanganiswa kanjani ngemva kokulandelana kwezibhamu?
answer2: Ikhompyutha ihlonza ukulandelana kwe-DNA okufana bese ihlanganisa izingcezu ndawonye
question3: Kuyini i-contig?
answer3: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA olude oluhlanganiswe kusuka ezingcezwini ze-DNA ezimfushane ezihambisanayo
question4: Kungani ukulandelana kwe-DNA okufana kubalulekile ekulandeleni izibhamu?
answer4: Zivumela ukulandelana kwe-DNA yokuqala ukuthi kwakhiwe kabusha ngokunembile
distractor4c: Bahlonza ngqo izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni
question5: Yimuphi umkhawulo owawukhona endleleni yokuqala yokulandelana kwezibhamu?
answer5: Ihlaziye ingxenye eyodwa kuphela yengxenye ngayinye ye-DNA
question6: Kungani kwasungulwa ukulandelana kwezinhlangothi ezimbili?
answer6: Ukuthuthukisa ukulandelana kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwama-genome amakhulu ngokuhlaziya zombili iziphetho zengxenye ngayinye ye-DNA
distractor6c: Ukufaka esikhundleni se-DNA polymerase nge-RNA polymerase
question7: Ukulandelana kwezinhlangothi ezimbili kuhluke kanjani endleleni yokuqala yokulandelana kwezibhamu?
answer7: Ilandelanisa izinhlangothi zombili zengxenye ngayinye ye-DNA esikhundleni sokuphela okukodwa kuphela
question8: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yokulandelana kwezinhlangothi ezimbili?
answer8: Ulwazi olwengeziwe lokugqagqana kwenza ukwakha kabusha ama-genome amakhulu kube lula futhi kunembe kakhudlwana
distractor8b: Kudinga izingcezu ze-DNA ezimbalwa kunokulandelana kwezibhamu

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Amasu Asetshenziswa Kumaphrojekthi Okulandelana | Ukulandelana Kwesizukulwane Esilandelayo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Amasu Asetshenziswa Kumaphrojekthi Okulandelana | Ukulandelana Kwesizukulwane Esilandelayo
chapterContent: Kusukela ngo-2005, amasu okulandelana okuzenzakalelayo asetshenziswa amalabhorethri angaphansi kwesambulela sokulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo, okuyiqembu lamasu okuzenzakalelayo asetshenziselwa ukulandelana kwe-DNA okusheshayo. Lawa ma-sequencer ashibhile azenzakalelayo angakhiqiza ukulandelana kwamakhulu ezinkulungwane noma izigidi zezingcezu ezimfushane (izingcezu eziyisisekelo ezingu-25 kuya ku-500) esikhathini sosuku olulodwa. Lawa ma-sequencer asebenzisa isofthiwe eyinkimbinkimbi ukuze adlule enkambisweni enzima yokubeka zonke izingcezu ngokulandelana.
question1: Kuyini ukulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo (NGS)?
answer1: Iqembu lamasu azenzakalelayo asetshenziswa ekulandeleni i-DNA ngokushesha
question2: Ubuchwepheshe bokulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo obuzenzakalelayo buqale nini ukusetshenziswa kabanzi?
question3: Iyini inzuzo enkulu yokulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo uma kuqhathaniswa nezindlela zangaphambilini?
answer3: Ilandelanisa ngokushesha amakhulu ezinkulungwane noma izigidi zezingcezu ze-DNA ngentengo ephansi
distractor3c: Ilandelanisa izakhi zofuzo ezibhala amaprotheni kuphela
question4: Cishe zingakanani izingcezu ze-DNA ezikhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo?
answer4: Cishe amabhangqa esisekelo angu-25 kuya kwangu-500
question5: Zingaki izingcezu ze-DNA ezingakhiqizwa yi-sequencers yesizukulwane esilandelayo ngosuku olulodwa?
answer5: Amakhulu ezinkulungwane noma izigidi zezingcezu ze-DNA ezimfushane
question6: Kungani isofthiwe yekhompyutha eyinkimbinkimbi ibalulekile ekulandeleni isizukulwane esilandelayo?
answer6: Ihlanganisa inani elikhulu lezingcezu ze-DNA ezimfushane zibe yizilandelaniso ezifanele
distractor6c: Ifaka amalebula ezingcezu ze-DNA ngamadayi e-fluorescent
question7: Yisiphi isici esibe negalelo ekwamukelweni kabanzi kokulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo?
answer7: Inhlanganisela yayo yesivinini esiphezulu kanye nezindleko eziphansi kakhulu
distractor7c: Imfuneko yayo yokuhlanganiswa kokulandelana ngesandla kuphela
question8: Iyini inselele eyinhloko ngemva kokukhiqiza izigidi zezingcezu ze-DNA kusetshenziswa ukulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo?
answer8: Ukuhlela kahle ukulandelana kwe-DNA okufushane ngokulandelana kwayo kwasekuqaleni

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Ukusetshenziswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele Zezinto Eziphilayo Eziyimodeli
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele | Ukusetshenziswa Kwezakhi Zofuzo Eziphelele Zezinto Eziphilayo Eziyimodeli
chapterContent: I-genome yokuqala eyahlelwa ngokuphelele yayiyigciwane lebhaktheriya, i-bacteriophage fx174 (ama-base pairs angu-5368); lokhu kwafezwa nguFred Sanger esebenzisa ukulandelana kwesibhamu. Amanye ama-genome e-organelle nama-viral amaningana ahlelwa kamuva. Isidalwa sokuqala esahlelwa i-genome kwakuyi-bacterium Haemophilus influenzae; lokhu kwafezwa nguCraig Venter ngawo-1980. Cishe ama-laboratories angu-74 ahlukene abambisana ekulandeleni i-genome yemvubelo i-Saccharomyces cerevisiae, eyaqala ngo-1989 futhi yaqedwa ngo-1996, ngoba yayinkulu ngokuphindwe ka-60 kunanoma iyiphi enye i-genome eyayihlelwe ngokulandelana. Ngo-1997, kwakutholakala ukulandelana kwe-genome kwezinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezibalulekile: i-bacterium Escherichia coli K12 kanye nemvubelo i-Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Ama-genome ezinye izinto eziphilayo eziyimodeli, njengegundane i-Mus musculus, i-fruit fly i-Drosophila melanogaster, i-nematode Caenorhabditis. Ama-elegans, kanye nabantu Ama-Homo sapiens ayaziwa manje. Ucwaningo oluningi oluyisisekelo lwenziwa ezintweni eziphilayo eziyisibonelo ngoba ulwazi lungasetshenziswa ezintweni eziphilayo ezifana nezakhi zofuzo. Isilwane esiyisibonelo uhlobo olufundwa njengesibonelo ukuqonda izinqubo zezinto eziphilayo kwezinye izinhlobo ezimelelwa yisilwane esiyisibonelo. Ukuba nama-genome aphelele ahlelwe ngokulandelana kusiza ngemizamo yocwaningo kulezi zinto eziphilayo eziyisibonelo. Inqubo yokunamathisela ulwazi lwezinto eziphilayo ezilandelaneni zezakhi zofuzo ibizwa ngokuthi i-genome annotation. Ukuchaza ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo kusiza ngokuhlolwa okuyisisekelo ku-molecular biology, njengokuklama ama-primer e-PCR kanye nezinhloso ze-RNA
question1: Yiliphi i-genome yokuqala eyahlelwa ngokuphelele?
answer1: I-genome ye-bacteriophage φX174
question2: Ubani owaqala ukulandelanisa ngokuphelele i-genome ye-bacteriophage φX174?
question3: Yisiphi isidalwa esasiyisilwane sokuqala samaseli ukuba ne-genome yaso ehlelwe ngokulandelana ngokuphelele?
answer3: Umkhuhlane we-Haemophilus
question4: Kungani izinto eziphilayo eziyisibonelo zisetshenziswa kabanzi ocwaningweni lwezinto eziphilayo?
answer4: Ngoba okutholakale kuzo ngokuvamile kungasetshenziswa ezintweni eziphilayo ezifana nezakhi zofuzo
distractor4c: Ngoba zizala kuphela ngendlela engahambisani nobulili
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sezinto eziphilayo eziyisibonelo?
answer5: I-Drosophila melanogaster
question6: Kuyini isichasiselo se-genome?
answer6: Inqubo yokunamathisela ulwazi lwebhayoloji kuhlu lwezakhi zofuzo
question7: Isichasiselo se-genome sisiza kanjani ucwaningo lwe-molecular biology?
answer7: Kusiza abacwaningi ukuklama ama-primer e-PCR kanye nezinhloso ze-RNA
question8: Kungani ukulandelana kwe-Saccharomyces cerevisiae genome kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu?
answer8: I-genome yayo yayinkulu kakhulu kune-genome eyayilandelaniswe ngaphambilini futhi yayidinga ukubambisana phakathi kwama-laboratory amaningi.
distractor8b: Yayincane kunawo wonke ama-genome ahlelwe ngokulandelana ngaphambili
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 17.13. Buyekeza indlela yokulandelana kwe-Sanger njengoba kuboniswe esithombeni. Yenza isibonelo sokuthi ukulandelana okujulile kunikeza kanjani intuthuko ekulandeleni kwe-Sanger
answer9: Ukulandelana okujulile kuvumela ukulandelana okusheshayo kakhulu kwemicu emifushane ye-DNA uma kuqhathaniswa nokulandelana kwe-Sanger, okufunda kuphela ukulandelana okufushane kwe-DNA ngesivinini esiphansi, futhi kugwema izinkinga ze-Sangers ngokuqedwa nokuhlukaniswa kweketanga.
distractor9a: Ukumbozwa kokulandelana kuphezulu kakhulu ekulandeleni kweSanger uma kuqhathaniswa nokulandelana okujulile
distractor9b: Ukulandelana kwe-Sanger kufanelekile uma kunomehluko owodwa kuphela we-nucleotide phakathi kwamaketanga, kanti ukulandelana okujulile kufanelekile uma kunomehluko we-nucleotide ongaphezu kowodwa phakathi kwamaketanga.
distractor9c: Ukulandelana kwe-Sanger kufunda futhi kulandele i-genome izikhathi eziningi, kuyilapho ukulandelana okujulile kufunda ngokunembile ukulandelana kwe-genome yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi zofuzo Eziphelele | Ukusetshenziswa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ezilandelayo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.3 Ukulandelana Kwezakhi zofuzo Eziphelele | Ukusetshenziswa Kwezakhi zofuzo Ezilandelayo
chapterContent:
Ama-microarray e-DNA ayizindlela ezisetshenziswa ukuthola ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuhlaziya uhlu lwezingcezu ze-DNA ezinamathele ku-slide yengilazi noma ku-silicon chip ukuze kutholakale izakhi zofuzo ezisebenzayo futhi kutholakale ukulandelana. Cishe isigidi esisodwa sezakhi zofuzo singatholakala kusetshenziswa ama-microarray, kanti ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo eziphelele kunganikeza ulwazi mayelana nazo zonke izibiliboco eziyisisekelo eziyizigidi eziyisithupha ku-genome yomuntu. Nakuba ucwaningo lwezokwelapha lokulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo luthakazelisa, lo mkhakha uvame ukugxila ekusebenzeni kwezakhi zofuzo okungavamile. Ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo eziphelele luzovumela izifo eziqala esikhathini esizayo kanye nezinye izifo zezakhi zofuzo ukuthi zitholakale kusenesikhathi, okuzovumela ukuthi kwenziwe izinqumo ezinolwazi oluthe xaxa mayelana nendlela yokuphila, imithi, kanye nokuba nezingane. Izakhi zofuzo zisesencane, nakuba ngolunye usuku kungaba yinto evamile ukusebenzisa ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo eziphelele ukuhlola zonke izingane ezisanda kuzalwa ukuze kutholakale ukukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ngaphezu kwezifo kanye nemithi, izakhi zofuzo zingaba negalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwama-enzyme amasha aguqula i-biomass ibe yi-biofuel, okuholela ekukhiqizweni okuphezulu kwezitshalo kanye nophethiloli, kanye nezindleko eziphansi kumthengi. Lolu lwazi kufanele luvumele izindlela ezingcono zokulawula amagciwane asetshenziswa ekukhiqizweni kwamafutha e-biofuel. I-Genomics ingathuthukisa nezindlela ezisetshenziswa ukuqapha umthelela wokungcola ezindaweni zemvelo futhi isize ekuhlanzeni ukungcola kwemvelo. I-Genomics ivumele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhemikhali ezolimo kanye nemithi engasiza isayensi yezokwelapha kanye nezolimo.

 Kuzwakala kukuhle ukuba nolwazi lonke esingaluthola ekulandeleni i-genome ephelele; noma kunjalo, abantu banomthwalo wemfanelo wokusebenzisa lolu lwazi ngokuhlakanipha. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kungaba lula ukusebenzisa kabi amandla alolu lwazi, okuholela ekubandlululweni okusekelwe ku-genetics yomuntu, ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo zabantu, kanye nezinye izinkinga zokuziphatha. Lolu lwazi lungaholela nasezindabeni zomthetho mayelana nempilo kanye nobumfihlo
question1: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yama-microarray e-DNA?
answer1: Ukuthola ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo nokuhlonza izakhi zofuzo ezisebenzayo ngokuhlaziya izingcezu ze-DNA eziboshwe ku-chip noma ku-slide
question2: Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kuhluke kanjani kuma-microarray e-DNA?
answer2: Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kunikeza ulwazi mayelana ne-genome yonke, kuyilapho ama-microarray e-DNA ebona ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile kanye nokukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor2a: Ama-microarray e-DNA alandelana kakhulu ne-DNA kunokulandelana kwe-genome ephelele
distractor2b: Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kuthola izakhi zofuzo ezisebenzayo kuphela
distractor2c: Zombili lezi zindlela zinikeza ulwazi olufanayo ncamashi
question3: Kungani ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kungaba usizo ekuhlolweni kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa?
answer3: Kungahlonza ukukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo kusenesikhathi, okuvumela izinqumo ezinolwazi lwezokwelapha kanye nendlela yokuphila
distractor3c: Kuqinisekisa ukuthi azikho izifo zofuzo ezizovela
question4: I-genomics ingasiza kanjani ekukhiqizweni kukaphethiloli we-biofuel?
answer4: Ngokusiza ekuthuthukiseni ama-enzyme nokuthuthukisa ama-microorganism asetshenziswa ukuguqula i-biomass ibe yi-biofuel
question5: I-genomics ingazuzisa kanjani isayensi yezemvelo?
answer5: Kungathuthukisa ukuqapha ukungcola futhi kusize ekuhlanzeni ukungcola kwemvelo
distractor5a: Isusa unomphela konke ukungcola okuvela ezintweni eziphilayo
question6: I-genomics ingaba negalelo kanjani kwezolimo nakwezokwelapha?
answer6: Isekela ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhemikhali ezolimo athuthukisiwe kanye nemithi
distractor6b: Ithatha indawo yayo yonke imithi ekhona
question7: Yikuphi ukukhathazeka kokuziphatha okuhlobene nokusetshenziswa kabanzi kokulandelana kwe-genome ephelele?
answer7: Ukusetshenziswa kabi kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo okuholela ekubandlululweni nasekukhathazekeni ngobumfihlo
distractor7b: Ukususwa kwazo zonke izici ezizuzwe njengefa
question8: Kungani ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lwe-genomic ngokwethembeka kubalulekile?
answer8: Ngoba ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo lungasetshenziswa kabi ngenxa yokubandlulula, ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo, noma ukwephulwa kobumfihlo
distractor8a: Ngoba ukulandelana kwe-genome kubhubhisa i-DNA unomphela
distractor8b: Ngoba ulwazi lwe-genomic alukwazi ukugcinwa ngokuphephile

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluvezwe esigabeni alukho emkhakheni we-AP®. Kodwa-ke, ungafunda ulwazi esigabeni njengento ongayikhetha noma efanekisayo.

 Ukwethulwa kokulandelana kwe-DNA kanye namaphrojekthi okulandelana kwe-genome ephelele, ikakhulukazi iphrojekthi ye-Human Genome, kwandisa ukusebenza kolwazi lokulandelana kwe-DNA. I-Genomics manje isetshenziswa emikhakheni eyahlukahlukene, njenge-metagenomics, i-pharmacogenomics, kanye ne-mitochondrial genomics. Ukusetshenziswa okuvame kakhulu kwe-genomics ukuqonda nokuthola ukwelashwa kwezifo.
question1: Yini eyenza ukusetshenziswa okuningi kwesimanje kwe-genomics kwaba nokwenzeka?
answer1: Ukuthuthukiswa kokulandelana kwe-DNA kanye namaphrojekthi okulandelana kwe-genome ephelele, okuhlanganisa ne-Human Genome Project
question2: Kuyini i-genomics?
answer2: Ucwaningo kanye nokusetshenziswa kwama-genome aphelele kanye nolwazi lokulandelana kwawo kwe-DNA
question3: Yimuphi umsebenzi owandise kakhulu ukutholakala kanye nokusebenza kolwazi lokulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer3: Iphrojekthi Yezakhi Zofuzo Zabantu
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuwukusetshenziswa kwe-genomics okukhulunywe ngakho kulesi sigaba?
answer4: I-Metagenomics
question5: Yimuphi umkhakha ofunda ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo kuthonya kanjani izimpendulo zemithi?
answer5: I-Pharmacogenomics
question6: Yiliphi igatsha le-genomics eligxile kwi-DNA ye-mitochondrial?
answer6: I-genomics ye-Mitochondrial
question7: Ngokusho kwendima, iyiphi indlela esetshenziswa kakhulu ye-genomics?
answer7: Ukuqonda izifo nokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa noma ukwelashwa
question8: Kungani i-genomics isisebenza emikhakheni eminingi yesayensi ehlukene?
answer8: Ngoba ubuchwepheshe bokulandelanisa i-DNA buhlinzeka ngolwazi oluphelele lwezakhi zofuzo olungasetshenziswa emibuzweni eyahlukahlukene yezinto eziphilayo
distractor8a: Ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo
distractor8b: Ngoba i-genomics ithatha indawo yazo zonke ezinye izifundo zebhayoloji
distractor8c: Ngoba ukulandelana kwe-genome kuqeda ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | Ukubikezela Ingozi Yesifo Ezingeni Lomuntu Ngamunye
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | Ukubikezela Ingozi Yesifo Ezingeni Lomuntu Ngamunye
chapterContent: Ukubikezela ingozi yesifo kuhilela ukuhlola abantu abaphilile njengamanje ngokuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo ezingeni lomuntu ngamunye. Ukungenelela ngezinguquko zendlela yokuphila kanye nemithi kunganconywa ngaphambi kokuqala kwesifo. Kodwa-ke, le ndlela isebenza kakhulu uma inkinga ingaphakathi kwesici esisodwa sezakhi zofuzo. Amaphutha anjalo ahlanganisa cishe amaphesenti ama-5 ezifo emazweni athuthukile. Iningi lezifo ezivamile, njengesifo senhliziyo, zinezici eziningi noma zi-polygenic, okuyisici se-phenotypic esihilela izakhi zofuzo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu, futhi sihilela nezici zemvelo ezifana nokudla. Ngo-Ephreli 2010, ososayensi eStanford University bashicilele ukuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo komuntu ophilile (uStephen Quake, usosayensi eStanford University, owahlela i-genome yakhe ngokulandelana); ukuhlaziywa kwabikezela ukuthambekela kwakhe ekutholeni izifo ezahlukahlukene. Ukuhlolwa kwengozi kwenziwa ukuze kuhlaziywe iphesenti lengozi kaQuake yezimo zezokwelapha ezahlukene ezingu-55. Kutholakale ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okungavamile, okwambonisa ukuthi usengozini yokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo ngokuzumayo. Kwakubikezelwe nokuthi usengozini yamaphesenti angama-23 yokuba nomdlavuza wendlala kanye nengozi yamaphesenti ayi-1.4 yokuba ne-Alzheimer's. Ososayensi basebenzise izizindalwazi kanye nezincwadi eziningana ukuhlaziya idatha ye-genomic. Ngisho noma ukulandelana kwe-genomic kuya ngokuya kuthengeka futhi amathuluzi okuhlaziya eba nokwethenjelwa kakhudlwana, izinkinga zokuziphatha eziphathelene nokuhlaziywa kwe-genomic ezingeni labantu zisazoxazululwa.
question1: Iyini inhloso yokubikezela ingozi yesifo kusetshenziswa i-genomics?
answer1: Ukuhlonza ingozi yesifo kubantu abaphilile ukuze kuqalwe izinguquko zendlela yokuphila noma ukwelashwa ngaphambi kokuba isifo siqale
distractor1b: Ukuqeda izinguquko ezizuzwe njengefa ezivela ku-genome
distractor1c: Ukufaka esikhundleni sazo zonke izivivinyo zezokwelapha
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezifo lapho ukubikezela ingozi ye-genomic kusebenza kakhulu njengamanje?
answer2: Izifo ezibangelwa kakhulu yiphutha elilodwa lezakhi zofuzo
question3: Cishe yiliphi iphesenti lezifo emazweni athuthukile elibangelwa kakhulu ukukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo olulodwa?
answer3: Cishe amaphesenti ama-5
question4: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi polygenic?
answer4: Isici noma isifo esithonywa izakhi zofuzo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu
question5: Kungani izifo ezivamile njengesifo senhliziyo kunzima ukuzibikezela kusetshenziswa izakhi zofuzo zodwa?
answer5: Ngoba kuhilela izakhi zofuzo eziningi kanye nezici zemvelo ezifana nokudla
distractor5b: Ngoba azikaze zibe nengxenye yezakhi zofuzo
distractor5c: Ngoba zivela ekuguqukeni kwezakhi zofuzo olulodwa kuphela
question6: Ukuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo kwembule ini ngoStephen Quake?
answer6: Ithole izingozi zofuzo zezifo eziningana, okuhlanganisa nokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo okungavamile okuhlobene nokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo okungazelelwe
distractor6a: Kwafakazela ukuthi ngokuqinisekile uzoba nesifo i-Alzheimer
distractor6b: Kwabonisa ukuthi wayengenazo izinguquko ezihlobene nesifo
distractor6c: Kwaqeda ingozi yakhe yesikhathi esizayo yomdlavuza
question7: Kungani kusalokhu kunezinkinga zokuziphatha mayelana nokuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo kubantu bonke?
answer7: Ngoba ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo luphakamisa ukukhathazeka mayelana nobumfihlo, ukubandlululwa, kanye nokusetshenziswa okunesibopho
distractor7b: Ngoba idatha ye-genomic ayikwazi ukugcinwa nge-elekthronikhi
distractor7c: Ngoba amagciwane kuphela angahlelwa ngokulandelana ngokuthembekile
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 17.14 kanye noMfanekiso 17.14.1. Ukusebenzisa amagciwane ukuguqula ushukela ube uphethiloli kuyinsimu ethuthukayo yokufunda. Ithebula linikeza ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezifundwe ocwaningweni olunjalo futhi libonisa nokuthi zisebenza kahle kangakanani kanye nohlobo lwe-biofuel ezikhiqizayo. Yenza isiphetho ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi
answer8: Ama-alcohol (i-ethanol, i-butanol kanye nezinye eziphela ngo--ol) yiwona mafutha e-biofuel avame kakhulu ukukhiqizwa yilezi zinto eziphilayo
distractor8a: Ukusebenza kahle kakhulu yi-Escherichia coli ekhiqiza i-ethanol
distractor8b: Ama-fatty acid yi-biofuel evame kakhulu ukukhiqizwa yilezi zinto eziphilayo
distractor8c: I-Zymomonas mobilis ingaphumelela ukukhiqiza i-ethanol noma i-2, 3-butanediol

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Pharmacogenomics kanye ne-Toxicogenomics
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Pharmacogenomics kanye ne-Toxicogenomics
chapterContent: I-Pharmacogenomics, ebizwa nangokuthi i-toxicogenomics, ihilela ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle nokuphepha kwemithi ngokusekelwe kolwazi oluvela kuchungechunge lwe-genomic lomuntu ngamunye. Izimpendulo ze-genomic emithini zingafundwa kusetshenziswa izilwane ezihlolwayo (njengegundane noma amagundane ase-laboratory) noma amaseli aphilayo elabhorethri ngaphambi kokuqala izifundo nabantu. Ukufunda izinguquko ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo kunganikeza ulwazi mayelana nephrofayili yokubhalwa phansi phambi komuthi, ongasetshenziswa njengesibonakaliso sokuqala semiphumela enobuthi. Isibonelo, izakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ekukhuleni kwamaseli kanye nokufa kwamaseli okulawulwayo, uma kuphazamiseka, kungaholela ekukhuleni kwamaseli anomdlavuza. Izifundo ze-genome zingasiza futhi ekutholeni izakhi zofuzo ezintsha ezihilelekile ebuthi bemithi. Ulwazi lochungechunge lwezakhi zofuzo lomuntu siqu lungasetshenziswa ukunikeza imithi ezoba ngcono kakhulu futhi engabi nobuthi kakhulu ngokusekelwe kuhlobo lwe-genotype yesiguli ngasinye. Ukusayina kwezakhi zofuzo kungenzeka kungabi nembambo ngokuphelele, kodwa kungahlolwa kabanzi ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izimpawu ze-pathologic.
question1: Kuyini i-pharmacogenomics?
answer1: Ucwaningo lokuthi i-genome yomuntu ngamunye ithonya kanjani ukusebenza kahle nokuphepha kwemithi
distractor1a: Ucwaningo lokuthi izidakamizwa zishintsha kanjani ukulandelana kwe-DNA unomphela
question2: Liyini elinye igama le-pharmacogenomics?
question3: Kungani izilwane zaselabhorethri noma amaseli akhuliswe kusetshenziswa ngesikhathi sezifundo ze-pharmacogenomic?
answer3: Ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle kwemithi kanye nobuthi ngaphambi kokuhlola kubantu
distractor3a: Ukufaka esikhundleni sazo zonke izivivinyo zemitholampilo unomphela
question4: Kungani ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo kuhlaziywa ngemva kokuchayeka kumuthi?
answer4: Ukuhlonza izinguquko zokubhala ezingase zibonise imiphumela emihle noma ubuthi obungaba khona
question5: Izinguquko kuziphi izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo ezingabonisa ukuthi umuthi unemiphumela enobuthi?
answer5: Izakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ekukhuleni kwamangqamuzana kanye nokufa kwamangqamuzana okuhleliwe
distractor5a: Izakhi zofuzo ezibangela uhlobo lwegazi kuphela
distractor5c: Izakhi zofuzo ezifaka ikhodi ye-ribosomal RNA kuphela
question6: Izifundo ze-genome yonke zingaba kanjani negalelo ku-pharmacogenomics?
answer6: Bangakwazi ukubona izakhi zofuzo ezintsha ezihilelekile ebuthi bezidakamizwa
question7: Uchungechunge lwe-genome yesiguli lungaluthuthukisa kanjani ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha?
answer7: Kungasiza ekukhetheni imithi engaba ngcono kakhulu futhi engabi yingozi kangako kulowo muntu
distractor7a: Iqinisekisa ukuvikeleka okuphelele kuzo zonke izifo
distractor7b: Ivumela yonke imithi ukuthi isebenze kahle ngokulinganayo
question8: Kungani izibikezelo ze-pharmacogenomic kusamele zihlolwe kabanzi?
answer8: Ngoba ukusayina kwezakhi zofuzo akunembile ngokuphelele futhi kudinga ukuqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izimpawu zesifo
distractor8a: Ngoba ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo akukwazi ukuhlonza izakhi zofuzo
distractor8b: Ngoba izimpendulo zemithi azikaze zincike ku-genetics
distractor8c: Ngoba bonke abantu basabela ngendlela efanayo emithini

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Microbial Genomics: I-Metagenomics
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Microbial Genomics: I-Metagenomics
chapterContent: Ngokwesiko, i-microbiology ifundiswe ngombono wokuthi ama-microorganism afundwa kangcono ngaphansi kwezimo zokulima ezihlanzekile, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukanisa uhlobo olulodwa lweseli nokulikhulisa elabhorethri. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-microorganism angadlula ezizukulwaneni eziningana ngehora nje, amaphrofayili awo okubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ajwayelana nendawo entsha yelabhorethri ngokushesha okukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iningi lezinhlobo zama-bacteria liyamelana nokukhuliswa ngokwazo. Ama-microorganism amaningi awahlali njengezinto ezihlukanisiwe, kodwa ahlala emiphakathini yama-microorganism eyaziwa ngokuthi ama-biofilms. Ngenxa yazo zonke lezi zizathu, isiko elihlanzekile akuyona njalo indlela engcono kakhulu yokufunda ama-microorganism. I-Metagenomics iwukufunda ama-genome ahlangene ezinhlobo eziningi ezikhula futhi zihlanganyele endaweni yemvelo. I-Metagenomics ingasetshenziswa ukuhlonza izinhlobo ezintsha ngokushesha okukhulu nokuhlaziya umphumela wokungcola emvelweni (Isithombe 17.15)
question1: Kungani ukufunda ngezinto ezincane ezitholakala emasikweni ahlanzekile ngokuvamile kungeyona indlela engcono kakhulu?
answer1: Ngenxa yokuthi ama-microorganisms azivumelanisa ngokushesha nezimo zelebhu, izinhlobo eziningi azikwazi ukukhuliswa zodwa, futhi eziningi zihlala ngokwemvelo kuma-biofilms
distractor1a: Ngoba ama-microorganism awakwazi ukuzala kabusha ezimweni zelebhu
distractor1b: Ngoba amasiko ahlanzekile ahlala equkethe izinhlobo eziningi zamagciwane
distractor1c: Ngoba ama-microorganisms alahlekelwa yi-DNA yawo unomphela ngesikhathi sokukhulisa
question2: Kuyini i-metagenomics?
answer2: Ucwaningo lwezakhi zofuzo ezihlanganisiwe zezinhlobo eziningi ezikhula futhi zihlanganyele endaweni ezungezile
distractor2a: Ucwaningo lwe-genome ye-microorganism eyodwa ekhuliswe emasikweni ahlanzekile
distractor2b: Ucwaningo lwezakhi zofuzo zamagciwane kuphela kumasampula emvelo
question3: Iyini i-biofilm?
answer3: Umphakathi wezinambuzane lapho izinhlobo eziningi zikhula futhi zixhumana khona
distractor3a: Ingubo yeprotheni evikelayo ezungeze i-DNA yebhaktheriya
question4: Kungani ama-microorganisms akhuliswe elabhorethri engahluka kulawo asendaweni yawo yemvelo?
answer4: Ngoba zidlula ezizukulwaneni eziningana ngokushesha nangokushesha zishintsha ukubonakaliswa kwazo kwezakhi zofuzo ukuze zivumelane nezimo zelebhu
distractor4a: Ngoba zishintsha ngokushesha zibe izinhlobo ezintsha
distractor4b: Ngoba bayayeka ukuveza izakhi zofuzo ngemva kokuzihlukanisa
distractor4c: Ngoba balahlekelwa unomphela ama-chromosome abo ekukhuleni
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuwukusetshenziswa kwe-metagenomics?
answer5: Ukuhlonza izinhlobo ezintsha ngokushesha okukhulu nokuhlaziya imiphumela yokungcola emvelweni
distractor5a: Ukukhiqiza izitshalo zezitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo
distractor5c: Ukuthuthukisa imithi yokugoma kusetshenziswa amasiko ezilwane

chapterName: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Microbial Genomics: Ukudalwa Kwamafutha Amasha Ezakhi Zofuzo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi Zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Microbial Genomics: Ukudalwa Kwamafutha Amasha Ezakhi Zofuzo
chapterContent: Ulwazi lwe-genomics yama-microorganism lusetshenziswa ukuthola izindlela ezingcono zokusebenzisa ama-biofuel avela ku-algae kanye ne-cyanobacteria. Imithombo eyinhloko kaphethiloli namuhla ngamalahle, uwoyela, izinkuni, neminye imikhiqizo yezitshalo, njenge-ethanol. Nakuba izitshalo ziyimithombo evuselelekayo, kusenesidingo sokuthola eminye imithombo yamandla evuselelekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zamandla zabantu bethu. Umhlaba wama-microbial ungomunye wemithombo emikhulu yezakhi zofuzo ezifaka ama-enzyme amasha futhi zikhiqize ama-com amasha e-organic amakhilogremu, futhi awukasetshenziswa kakhulu. Ama-microorganism asetshenziselwa ukudala imikhiqizo, njengama-enzyme asetshenziswa ocwaningweni, ama-antibiotic, kanye nezinye izindlela zokulwa nama-microbial. Ama-microbial genomics asiza ekuthuthukiseni amathuluzi okuxilonga, imijovo ethuthukisiwe, ukwelashwa okusha kwezifo, kanye namasu athuthukile okuhlanza imvelo.
question1: I-genomics yama-microbial inegalelo kanjani ekuthuthukisweni kwe-biofuel?
answer1: Ngokubona izakhi zofuzo nama-enzyme kuma-microorganisms athuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-biofuel
distractor1c: Ngokuguqula amafutha asetshenziswayo abe ugesi ngqo
question2: Yiziphi izinto ezincane ezikhulunywa ngazo ngqo njengemithombo ethembisayo yokukhiqizwa kukaphethiloli we-biofuel?
question3: Kungani kuqhubeka intshisekelo ekuthuthukiseni eminye imithombo yamandla avuselelekayo?
answer3: Ngoba izidingo zamandla abantu ezikhulayo zidinga imithombo eyengeziwe evuselelekayo ngale kwamafutha avamile
distractor3a: Ngoba amafutha asetshenziswa kudala avuseleleka kabusha
distractor3b: Ngoba izitshalo azikwazi ukukhiqiza uphethiloli we-biofuel
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okubhalwe njengomthombo wamanje oyinhloko kaphethiloli?
answer4: Amalahle
question5: Kungani umhlaba we-microbial ubhekwa njengomthombo obalulekile we-biotechnology?
answer5: Iqukethe umthombo omkhulu futhi ongakasetshenziswa kakhulu wezakhi zofuzo ezifaka ama-enzyme awusizo kanye ne-organic com amakhilogremu
question6: Yimiphi imikhiqizo eseyisetshenziswa kakhulu ukukhiqiza ama-microorganisms?
answer6: Ama-enzyme, ama-antibiotic, kanye nezinye izidakamizwa zokulwa namagciwane amakhilogremu
question7: Ngaphandle kwama-biofuel, yiluphi uhlelo lwezokwelapha olusekelwa yi-genomics yamagciwane?
answer7: Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo ethuthukisiwe kanye nokwelashwa kwezifo ezintsha
question8: Izakhi zofuzo zamagciwane zingayizuzisa kanjani imvelo?
answer8: Ngokusekela amasu okuhlanza imvelo athuthukile kanye namathuluzi okuxilonga athuthukisiwe
distractor8c: Ngokususa unomphela zonke izinto ezingcolisayo ngaphandle kwezinqubo zezinto eziphilayo

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Mitochondrial Genomics
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | I-Mitochondrial Genomics
chapterContent:
Ama-Mitochondria angama-organelle angaphakathi kweseli aqukethe i-DNA yawo. I-DNA ye-Mitochondrial iyashintsha ngokushesha futhi ivame ukusetshenziselwa ukutadisha ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Esinye isici esenza ukutadisha i-genome ye-mitochondrial kube mnandi ukuthi i-DNA ye-mitochondrial ezilwaneni eziningi ezinamaseli amaningi idluliselwa kumama ngesikhathi senqubo yokukhulelwa. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, i-genomics ye-mitochondrial ivame ukusetshenziselwa ukulandelela uhlu lozalo.
