 Ulwazi kanye nezinkomba ezitholakale kumasampula e-DNA atholakale ezindaweni zobugebengu zisetshenziswe njengobufakazi emacaleni asenkantolo, kanti izimpawu zofuzo zisetshenziswe ekuhlaziyeni kwe-forensic. Ukuhlaziywa kwe-genomic nakho kube wusizo kulo mkhakha. Ngo-2001, kwanyatheliswa ukusetshenziswa kokuqala kwe-genomics ku-forensic. Kwakuwumzamo wokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zocwaningo lwezemfundo kanye ne-FBI ukuxazulula amacala angaqondakali e-anthrax adluliselwa nge-US Postal Service. Besebenzisa i-genomics ye-microbial, abacwaningi bathola ukuthi uhlobo oluthile lwe-anthrax lusetshenziswe kuzo zonke izincwadi ezithunyelwayo.
question1: Kungani i-DNA ye-mitochondrial ivame ukusetshenziswa ukutadisha ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
answer1: Ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial iqoqa izinguquko ngokushesha okukhulu
distractor1b: Ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial izuzwe njengefa kubazali bobabili ngokulinganayo
distractor1c: Ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial iqukethe zonke izakhi zofuzo eziphilayo
question2: I-DNA ye-mitochondrial ivame ukutholwa kanjani njengefa ezintweni eziningi eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
question3: Kungani i-mitochondrial genomics iwusizo ekulandeleleni uhlu lozalo?
answer3: Ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial ivame ukutholwa njengefa ngozalo lukamama
distractor3a: Ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial izuzwa kuphela ngozalo lukababa
distractor3c: Ngoba i-DNA ye-mitochondrial iyafana kubo bonke abantu
question4: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-genomic kungasiza kanjani ophenyweni lwe-forensic?
answer4: Ngokuqhathanisa izimpawu ze-DNA noma zofuzo ukuze kutholakale abantu noma imithombo yobufakazi bezinto eziphilayo
question5: Uhlobo luni lobufakazi olunganikezwa yizimpawu zofuzo kwisayensi yezomthetho?
answer5: Ubufakazi obusiza ukuhlonza abantu noma amasampula ebhayoloji
question6: Yiluphi uphenyo olukhulu lwezobunhloli olwaqala ukubonisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-genomics ngo-2001?
answer6: Uphenyo lwe-anthrax oluthunyelwe nge-U.S. Postal Service
question7: I-genomics yamagciwane isize kanjani ekuxazululeni uphenyo lwe-anthrax?
answer7: Ithole ukuthi uhlobo olufanayo lwe-anthrax lusetshenziswa kuzo zonke izincwadi ezithunyelwa ngeposi.
question8: Yisiphi isici esenza i-DNA ye-mitochondrial ibe yigugu kakhulu kokubili ezifundweni zokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye nozalo?
answer8: Izuzwe njengomama futhi iqoqa izinguquko ngesivinini esiphezulu.
distractor8a: Izuzwe njengefa ngokulinganayo kubazali bobabili futhi ayiguquki kakhulu

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | Izakhi zofuzo kwezolimo
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics | Izakhi zofuzo kwezolimo
chapterContent: I-genomics inganciphisa izivivinyo kanye nokwehluleka okuhilelekile ocwaningweni lwesayensi ngezinga elithile, okungathuthukisa ikhwalithi kanye nenani lesivuno sezitshalo kwezolimo. Ukuxhumanisa izici nezakhi zofuzo noma izisayini zezakhi zofuzo kusiza ukuthuthukisa ukuzalanisa izitshalo ukuze kukhiqizwe izinhlobo ezixubile ezinezimfanelo ezifiselekayo kakhulu. Ososayensi basebenzisa idatha yezakhi zofuzo ukuthola izici ezifiselekayo, bese bedlulisela lezo zimfanelo kwenye into ephilayo. Ososayensi bathola ukuthi izakhi zofuzo zingathuthukisa kanjani ikhwalithi kanye nenani lemikhiqizo yezolimo. Isibonelo, ososayensi bangasebenzisa izici ezifiselekayo ukudala umkhiqizo owusizo noma ukuthuthukisa umkhiqizo okhona, njengokwenza isitshalo esizwela isomiso sibekezelele kakhudlwana isizini yesomiso.
question1: I-genomics ingaluthuthukisa kanjani ucwaningo lwezolimo?
answer1: Ngokunciphisa ukuzama nokulungisa amaphutha nokusiza ososayensi ukuthi bathole izakhi zofuzo ezihlotshaniswa nezici ezifiselekayo
question2: Kungani ososayensi bexhumanisa izici nezakhi zofuzo noma izimpawu zezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Ukuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo nokukhiqiza izinhlobo ezixubile ezinezici ezifiselekayo
distractor2b: Ukwandisa amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuzo zonke izitshalo
question3: Ulwazi lwe-genomic lungasetshenziswa kanjani ukuthuthukisa izitshalo zezitshalo?
answer3: Ngokubona izici ezifiselekayo bese uzidlulisela kwezinye izinto eziphilayo
distractor3a: Ngokususa zonke izakhi zofuzo ezitshalweni zezitshalo
question4: Iyini inhloso eyodwa enkulu yokusebenzisa i-genomics kwezolimo?
answer4: Ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi kanye nenani lesivuno sezitshalo
question5: Hlobo luni lokuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo okukhulunywe ngalo ngqo kulesi sigaba?
answer5: Ukwenza izitshalo ezizwela isomiso zikwazi ukubekezelela izimo ezomile
question6: Kungani ukuhlonza izakhi zofuzo ezifiselekayo kubalulekile kwezolimo?
answer6: Ivumela abalimi ukuthi bathuthukise izitshalo ngokusebenza okuthuthukisiwe kanye nezici eziwusizo
question7: Ngaphandle kokwandisa isivuno sezitshalo, iyiphi enye inzuzo engayinikezwa yi-genomics?
answer7: Kungathuthukisa ikhwalithi yemikhiqizo yezolimo
question8: I-genomics isiza kanjani ekukhiqizeni ama-hybrid ezitshalo athuthukisiwe?
answer8: Ngokuvumela ososayensi ukuba bakhethe futhi bahlanganise izakhi zofuzo ezihlotshaniswa nezici ezifiselekayo
distractor8a: Ngokuhlanganisa ngokungahleliwe i-DNA evela ezintweni eziphilayo ezingahlobene

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.5 Izakhi zofuzo kanye ne-Proteomics | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.5 Izakhi zofuzo kanye ne-Proteomics | Ukuxhumana kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluvezwe esigabeni alukho emkhakheni we-AP®. Kodwa-ke, ungafunda ulwazi esigabeni njengento ongayikhetha noma efanekisayo.

 Amaprotheni ayimikhiqizo yokugcina yezakhi zofuzo, ezisiza ekwenzeni umsebenzi obhalwe yizakhi zofuzo. Amaprotheni akhiwa ama-amino acid futhi adlala indima ebalulekile esitokisini. Wonke ama-enzyme (ngaphandle kwama-ribozyme) amaprotheni asebenza njengezinto ezibangela ukusabela. Amaprotheni nawo angama-molecule alawulayo, kanti amanye angama-hormone. Amaprotheni okuthutha, njenge-hemoglobin, asiza ukuthutha umoya-mpilo ezithweni ezahlukahlukene. Ama-antibodies avikela izinhlayiya zangaphandle nawo angamaprotheni. Esimweni sokugula, umsebenzi weprotheni ungaphazamiseka ngenxa yezinguquko ezingeni lezakhi zofuzo noma ngenxa yomthelela oqondile kuprotheni ethile.

 I-proteome iyiqoqo lonke lamaprotheni akhiqizwa uhlobo lweseli. Ama-Proteome angafundwa kusetshenziswa ulwazi lwama-genome ngoba ama-gene code ama-mRNA, futhi ama-mRNA afaka ikhodi yamaprotheni. Nakuba ukuhlaziywa kwe-mRNA kuyisinyathelo esiqonde ngqo, akuwona wonke ama-mRNA ahunyushwa abe amaprotheni. Ucwaningo lomsebenzi wama-proteome lubizwa ngokuthi ama-proteomics. Ama-proteomics agcwalisa ama-genomics futhi ayasiza lapho ososayensi befuna ukuhlola imibono yabo eyayisekelwe kuma-gene. Ngisho noma wonke amaseli ento ephilayo enamaseli amaningi enesethi efanayo yama-gene, isethi yamaprotheni akhiqizwa ezicutshini ezahlukene ihlukile futhi incike ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo. Ngakho-ke, i-genome ihlala njalo, kodwa i-proteome iyahlukahluka futhi iyashintshashintsha ngaphakathi kwento ephilayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-RNA angahlukaniswa ngokushintshana (anqunywe futhi anamathiselwe ukuze kudalwe inhlanganisela entsha namaprotheni amasha) futhi amaprotheni amaningi aguqulwa ngemva kokuguqulwa ngezinqubo ezifana nokuqhekeka kwe-proteolytic, i-phosphorylation, i-glycosylation, kanye ne-ubiquitination. Kukhona futhi ukusebenzisana kwamaprotheni namaprotheni, okwenza kube nzima ukutadisha ama-proteome. Nakuba i-genome inikeza uhlelo, ukwakheka kokugcina kuncike ezintweni eziningana ezingashintsha ukuqhubeka kwezehlakalo ezikhiqiza i-proteome.

 Ama-Metabolomics ahlobene nama-genomics nama-proteomics. Ama-Metabolomics ahilela ukutadisha ama-metabolites amancane ama-molecule atholakala ento ephilayo. I-metabolome iyiqoqo eliphelele lama-metabolites ahlobene nokwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zento ephilayo. Ama-Metabolomics anikeza ithuba lokuqhathanisa ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nezici zomzimba, kanye nokwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nezici zemvelo. Umgomo wocwaningo lwe-metabolome ukuhlonza, ukulinganisa, kanye nokubhala uhlu lwazo zonke izakhi zofuzo ezitholakala ezicutshini nasezintweni eziphilayo.
question1: Iyini i-proteome?
answer1: Isethi ephelele yamaprotheni akhiqizwa uhlobo oluthile lweseli
question2: Kuyini i-proteomics?
answer2: Ucwaningo lwesakhiwo, umsebenzi, kanye nokusebenzisana kwama-proteome
question3: Kungani ama-proteomics ephelelisa i-genomics?
answer3: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo zinikeza uhlelo, kodwa amaprotheni ayimikhiqizo esebenzayo eyenza imisebenzi yamaseli
distractor3b: Ngoba amaprotheni athatha indawo yezakhi zofuzo ngesikhathi sokubhalwa
distractor3c: Ngoba i-genomics ihlola ama-molecule e-RNA kuphela
question4: Kungani izinhlobo ezimbili zamaseli ezahlukene zingaba nama-proteome ahlukene yize zine-genome efanayo?
answer4: Ngoba izakhi zofuzo ezahlukene zibonakaliswa ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zamaseli
distractor4a: Ngoba uhlobo ngalunye lweseli luqukethe ama-chromosome ahlukene
distractor4b: Ngoba amaprotheni anquma ukuthi yiziphi izakhi zofuzo ezikhona
distractor4c: Ngoba i-DNA ihlukile unomphela esicutshini ngasinye
question5: Iyiphi inqubo engakhiqiza amaprotheni ahlukene avela ku-gene efanayo?
answer5: Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-RNA ehlukile
question6: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokuguqulwa kweprotheyini ngemva kokuhumusha?
answer6: I-Phosphorylation
question7: Kuyini i-metabolomics?
answer7: Ucwaningo lweqoqo eliphelele lama-metabolites amancane-molecule emzimbeni
question8: Iyini inhloso eyodwa yocwaningo lwe-metabolomics?
answer8: Ukuhlonza, ukulinganisa, kanye nokubhala uhlu lwazo zonke izinto ezitholakala ezicutshini nasezintweni eziphilayo.

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.5 Izakhi zofuzo kanye ne-Proteomics | Amasu Ayisisekelo Ekuhlaziyweni Kwamaprotheni
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.5 Izakhi zofuzo kanye ne-Proteomics | Amasu Ayisisekelo Ekuhlaziyweni Kwamaprotheni
chapterContent:
Umgomo wokugcina we-proteomics ukuhlonza noma ukuqhathanisa amaprotheni avela ku-genome ethile ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile, ukutadisha ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamaprotheni, nokusebenzisa ulwazi ukubikezela ukuziphatha kweseli noma ukuthuthukisa imigomo yemithi. Njengoba nje i-genome ihlaziywa kusetshenziswa indlela eyisisekelo yokulandelana kwe-DNA, i-proteomics idinga amasu okuhlaziya amaprotheni. Indlela eyisisekelo yokuhlaziya amaprotheni, efana nokulandelana kwe-DNA, yi-mass spectrometry. I-Mass spectrometry isetshenziselwa ukuhlonza nokunquma izici ze-molecule. Intuthuko ku-spectrometry ivumele abacwaningi ukuthi bahlaziye amasampula amancane kakhulu amaprotheni. I-X-ray crystallography, isibonelo, ivumela ososayensi ukuthi banqume isakhiwo esinezinhlangothi ezintathu se-protein crystal ngesisombululo se-athomu. Enye indlela yokuthwebula amaprotheni, i-nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), isebenzisa izakhiwo ze-magnetic zama-athomu ukuze inqume isakhiwo esinezinhlangothi ezintathu samaprotheni kusisombululo samanzi. Ama-protein microarray nawo asetshenziswe ukutadisha ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamaprotheni. Ukulungiswa okukhulu kwesikrini esiyisisekelo esine-hybrid ezimbili (Isithombe 17.16) kunikeze isisekelo sama-protein microarrays. Isofthiwe yekhompyutha isetshenziselwa ukuhlaziya inani elikhulu ledatha elakhiwe ukuhlaziywa kwe-proteomic.

 Ukuhlaziywa kwe-genomic- kanye ne-proteomic-scale kuyingxenye ye-systems biology. I-Systems biology ukutadisha izinhlelo zebhayoloji eziphelele (ama-genome nama-proteome) ngokusekelwe ekusebenzisaneni ngaphakathi kwesistimu. I-European Bioinformatics Institute kanye ne-Human Proteome Organisation (HUPO) bathuthukisa futhi basungula amathuluzi asebenzayo okuhlunga phakathi kwenqwaba enkulu yedatha yebhayoloji yezinhlelo. Ngenxa yokuthi amaprotheni ayimikhiqizo eqondile yezakhi zofuzo futhi abonisa umsebenzi ezingeni le-genomic, kungokwemvelo ukusebenzisa ama-proteome ukuqhathanisa amaphrofayili eprotheyini amaseli ahlukene ukuze kutholakale amaprotheni nezakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ezinqubweni zezifo. Iningi lezilingo zemithi yezokwelapha lihlose amaprotheni. Ulwazi olutholakala kuma-proteomics lusetshenziselwa ukuhlonza izidakamizwa ezintsha nokuqonda izindlela zazo zokusebenza.

 Inselele yamasu asetshenziswa ekuhlaziyweni kwe-proteomic ubunzima bokuthola inani elincane lamaprotheni. Nakuba i-mass spectrometry ilungele ukuthola inani elincane lamaprotheni, ukuhlukahluka kokubonakaliswa kwamaprotheni ezimweni ezigulayo kungaba nzima ukukubona. Amaprotheni angama-molecule angazinzile ngokwemvelo, okwenza ukuhlaziywa kwe-proteomic kube nzima kakhulu kunokuhlaziywa kwe-genomic
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko ye-proteomics?
answer1: Ukuhlonza, ukuqhathanisa, nokufunda amaprotheni kanye nokusebenzisana kwawo ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile
question2: Iyiphi indlela ebhekwa njengendlela eyisisekelo yokuhlaziya amaprotheni, efana nokulandelana kwe-DNA?
question3: Yiluphi ulwazi olunganikezwa yi-X-ray crystallography mayelana namaprotheni?
answer3: Isakhiwo esinezinhlangothi ezintathu seprotheyini ekuxazululweni kwe-athomu
question4: I-nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) ifaka kanjani isandla ekuhlaziyweni kwamaprotheni?
answer4: Inquma isakhiwo samaprotheni esinobukhulu obuthathu esixazululweni samanzi
question5: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezincane zamaprotheni ezisetshenziswa kakhulu ekucwaningweni?
answer5: Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamaprotheni
question6: Iyini i-biology yezinhlelo?
answer6: Ucwaningo lwezinhlelo zebhayoloji eziphelele, kufaka phakathi ama-genome nama-proteome, ngokusekelwe ekusebenzisaneni kwazo
distractor6c: Ucwaningo lwamaprotheni ngamanye ngaphandle kokucabangela ukusebenzisana
question7: Kungani amaprotheni eyizinhloso ezivamile ekuthuthukisweni kwemithi yezokwelapha?
answer7: Ngoba amaprotheni ayimikhiqizo esebenzayo yezakhi zofuzo futhi athonya ngqo izinqubo zamaseli
question8: Iyini inselele enkulu yokuhlaziywa kwe-proteomic?
answer8: Amaprotheni avame ukuba khona ngamanani amancane kakhulu futhi awazinzile ngokwemvelo, okwenza kube nzima ukuwabona nokuwahlaziya
distractor8c: Amaprotheni azinzile kakhulu kune-DNA ngakho-ke kunzima ukuwaguqula

chapterName: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.5 Izakhi zofuzo kanye ne-Proteomics | Izakhi zofuzo zomdlavuza
chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.5 Izakhi zofuzo kanye ne-Proteomics | Izakhi zofuzo zomdlavuza
chapterContent:
Ama-genome nama-proteome eziguli ezihlushwa izifo ezithile ayafundwa ukuze kuqondwe isisekelo sezakhi zofuzo salesi sifo. Isifo esivelele kakhulu esifundwa ngezindlela ze-proteomic umdlavuza. Izindlela ze-proteomic zisetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa ukuhlolwa kanye nokutholakala komdlavuza kusenesikhathi; lokhu kufezwa ngokuhlonza amaprotheni abonakala ethinteka yinqubo yesifo. Iphrotheni ngayinye ibizwa ngokuthi i-biomarker, kanti isethi yamaprotheni anamazinga okuvezwa ashintshiwe ibizwa ngokuthi i-protein signature. Ukuze i-biomarker noma i-protein signature ibe usizo njengomuntu ozohlolwa kusenesikhathi kanye nokutholakala komdlavuza, kumele ikhishwe oketshezini lomzimba, njengokujuluka, igazi, noma umchamo, ukuze ukuhlolwa okukhulu kwenziwe ngendlela engahlaseli. Inkinga yamanje yokusebenzisa ama-biomarker ekutholakaleni komdlavuza kusenesikhathi izinga eliphezulu lemiphumela emibi engamanga. I-false negative umphumela wokuhlolwa ongalungile obekufanele ube positive. Ngamanye amazwi, amacala amaningi omdlavuza awatholakali, okwenza ama-biomarker angathembeki. Ezinye izibonelo zama-protein biomarker asetshenziswa ekutholakaleni komdlavuza yi-CA-125 yomdlavuza wesibeletho kanye ne-PSA yomdlavuza we-prostate. Ama-protein signatures angase athembeke kakhulu kune-biomarkers ukuthola amangqamuzana omdlavuza. Ama-Proteomics asetshenziswa futhi ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwelapha eziqondene nomuntu ngamunye, okuhlanganisa ukubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzosabela yini emithini ethile kanye nemiphumela emibi umuntu angase abe nayo. Ama-Proteomics asetshenziswa futhi ukubikezela ukuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi isifo siphinde sibuye.

 I-National Cancer Institute ithuthukise ama-pro amagremu ukuthuthukisa ukutholakala nokwelashwa komdlavuza. I-Clinical Proteomic Technologies for Cancer kanye ne-Early Detection Research Network yimizamo yokuhlonza ama-protein signatures aqondene nezinhlobo ezahlukene zomdlavuza. Uhlelo lwe-Biomedical Proteomics lwenzelwe ukuhlonza ama-protein signatures nokuklama izindlela zokwelapha ezisebenzayo zeziguli zomdlavuza.
question1: Kungani izindlela ze-proteomic zisetshenziswa kabanzi ocwaningweni lomdlavuza?
answer1: Ukuhlonza izinguquko zamaprotheni ezihambisana nomdlavuza ukuze kutholakale ukuxilongwa, ukwelashwa, kanye nokuqapha
distractor1b: Ukuqeda zonke izinguquko ezivela kumaseli omdlavuza
question2: Iyini i-biomarker ku-proteomics yomdlavuza?
answer2: Iphrotheni ngayinye ebonakala ngayo ihlotshaniswa nesifo
question3: Iyini isignature yeprotheni?
answer3: Iqoqo lamaprotheni anamazinga okuvezwa ashintshiwe ahlobene nesifo
question4: Kungani kufanele kutholakale i-biomarker yomdlavuza osebenzayo oketshezini lomzimba?
answer4: Ngakho-ke ukuhlolwa okukhulu, okungahlaseli kungenziwa
question5: Uyini umphumela ongemuhle ngamanga?
answer5: Umphumela wokuhlolwa okhombisa ngokungalungile ukuthi akukho sifo uma isifo sikhona ngempela
distractor5a: Umphumela wokuhlolwa okhombisa ngokungalungile isifo lapho kungekho khona
question6: Yisiphi i-biomarker yephrotheni evame ukusetshenziswa ukusiza ekutholeni umdlavuza wendlala?
answer6: I-PSA
question7: Kungani izimpawu zamaprotheni zingaba usizo kakhulu kunezimpawu zomdlavuza ezizimele?
answer7: Ngoba amaphethini amaprotheni amaningi anganikeza ukutholwa okuthembekile kakhulu kuneprotheni eyodwa
distractor7a: Ngoba izimpawu zamaprotheni ziqukethe ukulandelana kwe-DNA
distractor7b: Ngoba zisusa yonke imiphumela emibi engamanga
question8: Ama-proteomics angasiza kanjani ekwelashweni komdlavuza komuntu siqu?
answer8: Ngokusiza ekubikezeleni izimpendulo zemithi, imiphumela emibi, kanye namathuba okuphindeka kwesifo
distractor8a: Ngokushintsha yonke i-chemotherapy ngokwelashwa ngezakhi zofuzo
distractor8c: Ngokulandelanisa i-genome yonke yesiguli ngaphambi kokwelashwa ngakunye

chapterNameEnglish: 3. Izakhi zofuzo | 17. I-Biotechnology kanye ne-Genomics | 17.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
17.1 I-Biotechnology
Ama-Nucleic acid angahlukaniswa namaseli ngenhloso yokuhlaziya okwengeziwe ngokuphula amaseli nokubhubhisa ngama-enzyme wonke amanye ama-macromolecule amakhulu. Ama-chromosome aqhekekile noma aphelele angahlukaniswa ngokusekelwe kusayizi nge-gel electrophoresis. Ukunwebeka okufushane kwe-DNA noma i-RNA kungandiswa yi-PCR. Ukufiphaza okuseningizimu nasenyakatho kungasetshenziswa ukuthola ukuba khona kwezinhlu ezimfushane ezithile kusampula ye-DNA noma ye-RNA. Igama elithi "cloning"lingabhekisela ekwakhiweni kwezingcezu ezincane ze-DNA (ukwakheka kwama-molecule), ukwakheka kwamaseli (ukwakheka kwamaseli), noma ukwakheka kwezinto eziphilayo eziphelele (ukwakheka kokuzala). Ukuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenziwa ukuze kutholakale izakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo, futhi ukwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo kusetshenziselwa ukwelapha isifo esizuzwa njengefa.

 Izinto eziphilayo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo zine-DNA evela kolunye uhlobo, ngokuvamile ekhiqizwa ngamasu okwakheka kwama-molecule. Imithi yokugoma, ama-antibiotic, nama-hormone kuyizibonelo zemikhiqizo etholakala ngobuchwepheshe be-DNA obuhlanganisiwe. Izitshalo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo zivame ukudalelwa ukuthuthukisa izici zezitshalo zezitshalo.

 17.2 Ukumaka Ama-Genome
Ukumaka ama-Genome kufana nokuxazulula iphazili enkulu, eyinkimbinkimbi enezingcezu zolwazi ezivela emalabhorethri emhlabeni wonke. Amamephu ezakhi zofuzo anikeza uhlaka lwendawo yezakhi zofuzo ngaphakathi kwe-genome, futhi alinganisa ibanga phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo kanye nezimpawu zezakhi zofuzo ngokusekelwe kumaza okuphindaphinda ngesikhathi se-meiosis. Amamephu angokoqobo anikeza ulwazi oluningiliziwe mayelana nebanga elingokoqobo phakathi kwezakhi zofuzo. Ulwazi olunemininingwane eminingi luyatholakala ngokumaka ukulandelana. Ulwazi oluvela kuyo yonke imithombo yokumaka kanye nokulandelana luhlanganiswa ukufunda i-genome yonke.

 17.3 Ukulandelana kwe-Genome Yonke
Ukulandelana kwe-genome yonke kuyinsiza yakamuva etholakalayo yokwelapha izifo zofuzo. Abanye odokotela basebenzisa ukulandelana kwe-genome yonke ukusindisa izimpilo. I-Genomics inezinhlelo eziningi zezimboni okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-biofuel, ezolimo, imithi, kanye nokulawula ukungcola. Isimiso esiyisisekelo samasu onke okulandelana kwanamuhla sihilela indlela yokuqeda uchungechunge lokulandelana.

 Nakuba ukulandelana kwe-genome yomuntu kunikeza ukuqonda okubalulekile kochwepheshe bezokwelapha, abacwaningi basebenzisa ukulandelana kwe-genome yonke yezinto eziphilayo eziyimodeli ukuze baqonde kangcono i-genome yezinhlobo. Ukuzenzakalela kanye nezindleko ezincishisiwe zokulandelana kwe-genome yonke kungaholela emithini eyenzelwe wena esikhathini esizayo.

 17.4 Ukusebenzisa i-Genomics
Ukucabanga yisona kuphela isithiyo ekusebenzeni kwe-genomics. I-Genomics isetshenziswa emikhakheni eminingi yebhayoloji; isetshenziselwa umuthi oqondene nomuntu ngamunye, ukubikezela izingozi zezifo ku- izinga lomuntu ngamunye, isifundo sokusebenzisana kwezidakamizwa ngaphambi kokuqhutshwa kwezivivinyo zemitholampilo, kanye nocwaningo lwezincane ezincane endaweni ezungezile ngokungafani nelabhorethri. Iphinde isetshenziswe ekuthuthukisweni okufana nokukhiqizwa kwamafutha amasha e-biofuel, ukuhlolwa kozalo kusetshenziswa i-mitochondria, intuthuko kwesayensi yezomthetho, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezolimo.

 17.5 I-Genomics kanye ne-Proteomics
I-Proteomics isifundo seqoqo lonke lamaprotheni aboniswa uhlobo oluthile lweseli ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile zemvelo. Esintwini esinamangqamuzana amaningi, izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli zizoba nama-proteome ahlukene, futhi lawa azohluka ngokushintsha kwendawo ezungezile. Ngokungafani ne-genome, i-proteome iyashintshashintsha futhi ishintshashintsha njalo, okwenza kube yinkimbinkimbi futhi kube usizo kakhulu kunolwazi lwama-genome kuphela.

 Izindlela ze-Proteomics zithembele ekuhlaziyweni kwamaprotheni; lawa masu ahlala ethuthukiswa. I-Proteomics isetshenziswe ukutadisha izinhlobo ezahlukene zomdlavuza. Ama-biomarker ahlukene kanye nezimpawu zamaprotheni zisetshenziswa ukuhlaziya uhlobo ngalunye lomdlavuza. Umgomo wesikhathi esizayo ukuba nohlelo lokwelapha lomuntu ngamunye.
question1: Zidalwa kanjani izinto eziphilayo eziguqulwe izakhi zofuzo (ama-GMO)?
answer1: Ngokufaka i-DNA ephindaphindayo entweni ephilayo nganoma iyiphi indlela
question2: Iyiphi indlela esetshenziswayo ukuphatha izinto zofuzo eholela ekwandeni okukhulu kwezingcezu ze-DNA noma ze-RNA?
question3: Iyini indima ye-plasmid ekuhlanganisweni kwama-molecule?
answer3: Zisetshenziswa njengezinto ezithwala izakhi zofuzo kubhaktheriya.
distractor3c: Ziqukethe i-chromosome eyindilinga yezinto eziphilayo ze-prokaryotic.
question4: Kusho ukuthini nge-molecule ye-DNA ephinda ihlanganiswe?
answer4: Ama-molecule e-Chimeric.
distractor4c: Umphumela wokuwela ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza kabusha kwamaseli.
question5: Ngokusekelwe esakhiweni sayo samakhemikhali, iyiphi indlela engcono kakhulu yokuchaza ubuthi be-Bt?
answer5: Iphrotheni ephinda ihlanganiswe.
question6: Yisiphi isici esisodwa sikatamatisi i-Flavr Savr?
answer6: Ihlala isikhathi esingcono eshalofini.
distractor6a: Akuyona uhlobo oluthile lukatamatisi oluvuthiwe ezitolo ezinkulu.
question7: Yisiphi isinyathelo sokuqala sokuhlukanisa i-DNA?
answer7: Ukubeka amaseli kusampula.
distractor7a: Ukukhiqiza izingcezu ze-DNA ze-genomic ezine-restriction endonucleases.
distractor7b: Ukwethula i-DNA ephinda ihlanganiswe emzimbeni nganoma iyiphi indlela.
question8: Kuyini i-genomics?
answer8: I-Genomics iwucwaningo lwama-genome aphelele, okuhlanganisa isethi ephelele yama-gene, ukulandelana kwawo kwe-nucleotide kanye nokuhleleka kwawo, kanye nokusebenzisana kwawo ngaphakathi kohlobo kanye nezinye izinhlobo.
distractor8a: I-Genomics inqubo yokuthola izindawo zezakhi zofuzo ku-chromosome ngayinye.
distractor8b: I-Genomics iyisibonelo esibala izakhi zofuzo kanye nendawo ezikuyo ku-chromosome.
distractor8c: I-Genomics iwuphawu lwezakhi zofuzo, i-gene noma ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo ku-chromosome okuhlukanisa (kubonisa ukuxhumana kwezakhi zofuzo) nesici esithile.
question9: Yini edingekayo ngaphezu kwemephu yokuxhumanisa izakhi zofuzo ukuze kwakhiwe isithombe esiphelele se-genome?
answer9: Imephu ebonakalayo.
question10: Ukuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka ngayiphi inqubo?
answer10: Ukuwela.
question11: Yimuphi inqubo ehlukanisa izingcezu ze-DNA ngokobukhulu besebenzisa insimu kagesi?
question12: Iyini inhloso ye-Southern blotting?
question13: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-cloning olukhiqiza ikhophi efanayo yento yonke ephilayo?
question14: Kungani amamephu ezakhi zofuzo ewusizo?
answer14: Balinganisa izindawo zezakhi zofuzo kanye nezimpawu zezakhi zofuzo ngokusekelwe ezikhathini zokuphindaphinda.
distractor14a: Banquma ukulandelana okuphelele kwe-DNA yawo wonke ama-chromosome.
question15: Kungani i-proteome ibhekwa njenge-dynamic?
answer15: Ngoba amaprotheni avezwa yiseli ayashintsha ngohlobo lweseli kanye nezimo zemvelo.
distractor15b: Ngoba amaprotheni ashintsha njalo ukulandelana kwe-DNA.
distractor15c: Ngoba iseli ngalinye lihlala likhiqiza amaprotheni afanayo.
question16: Ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele kungasetshenziswa ekuthuthukisweni kuyiphi insimu?
answer16: Umuthi.
question17:
Ukulandelanisa i-genome yomuntu ngamunye
_.
answer17: Kusiza ekubikezeleni izakhi zofuzo ezinephutha ezifweni.
distractor17b: Ngeke kuholele ezindabeni zomthetho mayelana nokubandlululwa kanye nobumfihlo.
distractor17c: Ngeke kusize ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinolwazi mayelana nokwelashwa.
question18: I-genomics ingasetshenziswa kanjani kwezolimo?
answer18: Thuthukisa isivuno, ukumelana nezifo, kanye nokukhiqiza izinhlobo ezintsha ezixubile.
answer19: Ukuhlonza izinhlobo ezintsha ngokushesha okukhulu nokuhlaziya umphumela wokungcola emvelweni.
distractor19b: Ukuhlolwa kokutholakala kwezidakamizwa eziningi kubantu abaningi.
question20: I-Genomics ingasetshenziswa ezingeni lomuntu siqu ukwenzani?
answer20: Thola izingozi zezifo zofuzo ezinganeni ngazinye.
question21: Emazweni athuthukile, yiliphi iphesenti lezifo elibangelwa ukukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo olulodwa?
question22: Yimuphi ubuchwepheshe noma insimu yokufunda efaneleka kakhulu ekuhlonzweni okusheshayo kwezinhlobo ezintsha kanye nokuhlaziywa kwemiphumela yokungcola emvelweni?
question23: Izingozi zezifo zofuzo ezinganeni zingatholakala nge-____.
answer24: Iphrotheni ekhiqizwa ngendlela ekhethekile esimweni sokugula.
distractor24a: Ukufakwa kwekhodi yombala kwezakhi zofuzo ezahlukene.
answer25: Iqoqo eliphelele lama-metabolites ahlobene nokwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo zento ephilayo.
question26: Ungalichaza kanjani isethi yamaprotheni anamazinga okuvezwa ashintshiwe?
answer27: Isethi eyingqayizivele yamaprotheni akhona esimweni sokugula.
distractor27b: Indlela ilandelwa yiprotheni ngemva kokuba yenziwe ku-nucleus.
question28: Yiliphi igama elichaza iphrotheni ekhiqizwa ngendlela ekhethekile yisidalwa esisesimweni sokugula?
question29: Ukuqoqwa kwama-metabolites avela ekuphenduleni kwe-anabolic kanye ne-catabolic komzimba kubizwa ngokuthini?
answer30: I-Southern blotting isetshenziselwa ukuthola ukulandelana kwe-DNA. Izingcezu zihlukaniswa kujeli, zidluliselwe kulwelwesi lwenayiloni, bese zifakwa kuma-probe ukuze kuhlolwe ukulandelana kwesithakazelo.
distractor30a: I-Southern blotting isetshenziselwa ukuthola ukulandelana kwe-DNA. Izingcezu zihlukaniswa kujeli, zifakwe ama-probe ukuze kuhlolwe ukulandelana kwesithakazelo, bese zidluliselwa kulwelwesi lwe-nylon.
distractor30b: Uma kusetshenziswa i-RNA, inqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-Northern blotting.
distractor30c: I-Southern blotting isetshenziselwa ukuthola ukulandelana kwe-RNA. Izingcezu zihlukaniswa kujeli, zifakwe ama-probe ukuze kuhlolwe ukulandelana kwesithakazelo, bese zidluliselwa kulwelwesi lwe-nylon.
question31: Umcwaningi ufuna ukutadisha amangqamuzana omdlavuza avela esigulini esinomdlavuza webele. Ingabe ukwenza amaseli omdlavuza abe yi-cloning kuyindlela yokukhetha?
answer31: Amaseli omdlavuza, njengoba kakade eyizinhlayiya zomunye nomunye, kufanele akhuliswe ngqo endaweni yokukhulisa amangqamuzana bese efundwa.
distractor31a: Amaseli omdlavuza kufanele ahlanganiswe kanye ne-biomarker ukuze kutholakale futhi kufundwe kangcono.
distractor31b: Amaseli kufanele ahlolwe kuqala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abangela umdlavuza.
distractor31c: Amaseli omdlavuza kufanele akhishwe kusetshenziswa ama-antibodies athile.
answer32: Ukuhlela i-genome kuyasiza ekuboneni izakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo kubantu, ukuthuthukisa amagciwane ukuze kuhlanzwe ukungcola, kanye nokwandisa isivuno.
distractor32a: Ukumapha kwe-genome kuyadingeka ngqo ukuze kukhiqizwe ama-recombinant, ekutholakaleni kwe-FISH, nasekutholeni izingxenye ze-methylated zezinto zofuzo.
distractor32b: Ukumapha kwe-genome kuyasiza ekwazini uhlu lwezifo kubantu kanye nokulandelela ukunyakaza kwama-transposon ezitshalweni.
distractor32c: Ukumapha kwezakhi zofuzo kukhomba izakhi zofuzo ezibangela izifo kubantu kuphela.
question33: Unikezwa ithuba lokulandelanisa i-genome yakho. Uma ucabangela imigomo yokulandelanisa i-genome, nquma ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi ongase ukwazi ukulifunda ngawe kusukela kokukhethwa kukho okunikeziwe.
answer33: Thola ukuthi izifo zivelaphi kanye nemvelaphi yazo yezakhi zofuzo kanye nokuthambekela kwazo ezidakamizweni.
distractor33a: Thola imithi engaba khona engalungisa isifo, izimpawu zaso, kanye nobunzima baso.
distractor33b: Bika izimpawu zesifo, izimbangela ezizosetshenziswa ekwelapheni izakhi zofuzo, kanye nemvelo eyimbangela yalesi sifo.
distractor33c: Thola uhlu lozalo lwesifo, ukhiqize ama-recombinant, bese uthola ukuthi kukhona izakhi zofuzo ezingaphandle kweseli usebenzisa i-FISH.
question34: Chaza isibonelo sendlela yokwenza imephu ye-genomic.
answer34: Imephu ye-cytogenetic ithola ulwazi ngokuhlaziywa kwe-microscopic yama-chromosomes anombala. Ingalinganisa ibanga eliphakathi kwezimpawu.
distractor34a: Indlela yokumapha ngemisebe iyisibonelo esisebenzisa imisebe ukuphula i-DNA futhi ithintwa izinguquko ekuvameni kokuhlanganiswa kabusha.
distractor34b: Ekuhlolweni kwemingcele, izingcezu ze-DNA zinqunywa ngokusebenzisa ama-enzyme okuvimbela bese izingcezu ezinemibala zibukwa kujeli.
distractor34c: Imephu ye-cytogenetic ithola ulwazi ngokuhlaziywa kwe-microscopic kwama-chromosomes anombala. Ingalinganisa ibanga eliqondile le-base pair phakathi kwezimpawu.
question35: Kusetshenziswe amasu ahlukahlukene ukuze kwenziwe ukulandelana kwe-genome ephelele, ngayinye ehlukahluka ngamasu ayo athile. Qhathanisa izincazelo ezinikeziwe zezindlela ezintathu zokulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo. Yikuphi okuhlonza kahle futhi kuchaze umehluko ezindleleni?
answer35: Ukuphela kweketanga - ukufakwa kwe-ddNTP ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA; ukulandelana kwezibhamu - ukusika i-DNA ibe yizicucu ezingahleliwe, ukulandelana kusetshenziswa ukuphela kweketanga, nokuhlanganisa ukulandelana okugqagqene; ukulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo - ama-sequencer azenzakalelayo asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ukulandelana kwezicucu ezimfushane.
distractor35a: Ukuphela kweketanga - ama-sequencer azenzakalelayo asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ukulandelana kwezingcezu ezimfushane; ukulandelana kwe-dideoxy - ukufakwa kwe-ddNTP ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA; ukulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo - ukusika i-DNA ibe yizingcezu ezingahleliwe, ukulandelana kusetshenziswa ukuphela kweketanga, nokuhlanganisa ukulandelana okugqagqene.
distractor35b: Ukulandelana kwe-Pairwise-end - ukufakwa kwe-ddNTP ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA; ukulandelana kwe-shotgun - ama-sequencer azenzakalelayo asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ukulandelana kwezingcezu ezimfushane; ukulandelana kwesizukulwane esilandelayo - ukusika i-DNA ibe yizingcezu ezingahleliwe, ukulandelana kusetshenziswa ukuphela kweketanga, nokuhlanganisa ukulandelana okugqagqene.
distractor35c: Ukuphela kweketanga - ama-sequencer azenzakalelayo asetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ukulandelana kwezingcezu ezimfushane; ukulandelana kwezibhamu - ukusika i-DNA ibe yizingcezu ezingahleliwe, ukulandelana kusetshenziswa ukuphela kweketanga, nokuhlanganisa ukulandelana okugqagqene; ukulandelana kwezinhlangothi ezimbili - ukufakwa kwe-ddNTP ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA.
question36: Iyiphi inselele enkulu kunazo zonke ebhekene nokulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer36: Izinkinga zokuziphatha ezifana nokubandlulula okusekelwe ku-genetics yomuntu.
distractor36a: Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamakhemikhali ukuze kulandelwe izingcezu ze-DNA.
distractor36b: Ukusetshenziswa kwamakhemikhali ngesikhathi sezindlela zokulandelana ezingase zihlanganise ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo.
distractor36c: Izinkinga zesayensi, njengokulondoloza ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo zomuntu.
question37: Bheka uMfanekiso 17.17. Kule ndlela yokulandelana kwe-genome, izingcezu ze-DNA zibekwe ngokulandelana ngokwezindawo zazo ezivamile. Ibizwa ngokuthini le ndlela?
question38: I-Coumadin umuthi ovame ukunikezwa ukuvimbela ukujiya kwegazi ngokweqile ezigulini ezinesifo sohlangothi noma ezihlaselwe yinhliziyo, okungaholela kwesinye isifo sohlangothi noma ezihlaselwe yinhliziyo. Kodwa-ke, ingozi eyodwa engaba khona yokusebenzisa umuthi ukudlula ngokweqile kwezinye iziguli, kuye ngokuthi isibindi sazo sisebenza kanjani. Qagela indlela okungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi i-pharmacogenomics ingasetshenziswa ngayo esikhathini esizayo ukusiza lezi ziguli.
answer38: I-Pharmacogenomics izohlola isiguli ngasinye ukuthi singase sizizwele yini ngomuthi.
distractor38a: I-Pharmacogenomics izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngomuthi osebenza ngokumelene nomphumela we-Coumadin.
distractor38c: I-Pharmacogenomics izonikeza isiguli ngasinye isilinganiso sokweqisa izidakamizwa ukuze kuhlolwe izimpawu zomuthi.
question39: Kungani kwenziwa umzamo omkhulu kangaka ekusetshenzisweni kwemephu ye-genome?
answer39: Ukumapha kwe-genome kusiza ekuboneni ama-allele anephutha, angabangela izifo.
distractor39a: Ukumapha kwe-genome kuyadingeka ukuze wazi umehluko phakathi kwesisekelo se-base pair phakathi kwezimpawu.
distractor39b: Ukumapha kuzosiza ososayensi ukuqonda indima yamaprotheni kuma-organelle athile.
distractor39c: Indlela yokwenza imephu ikhomba indima yama-transposon.
question40: Yisiphi isizathu sokutadisha izakhi zofuzo ze-mitochondrial esibaluleke kakhulu kubantu?
answer40: I-Mitochondria iqukethe i-DNA, futhi idluliselwa kusuka kumama iye enzalweni, okwenza ibe usizo ekulandeleni uhlu lozalo.
distractor40a: I-Mitochondria yavela kumagciwane; ngakho-ke, i-genome yawo ibalulekile ukuyihlola.
distractor40b: I-Mitochondria ishintsha ngokushesha futhi kubalulekile ukuthi le ndlela ifundwe.
distractor40c: Ama-Mitochondria yiwona kuphela ama-organelle akhiqiza i-ATP aleli seli, ngakho-ke i-genome yawo ibalulekile.
answer41: Ucwaningo lwezakhi zofuzo aluphelele ngaphandle kocwaningo lwamaprotheni azo futhi ngaleyo ndlela ziyaphelelisana.
distractor41a: Izakhi zofuzo zinesibopho sokukhiqiza amaprotheni futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi ama-proteomics agcwalisa izakhi zofuzo.
distractor41b: I-Genomics inesibopho sokunquma isakhiwo samaprotheni, futhi, ngaleyo ndlela, umphumela wezifundo ze-proteomic.
distractor41c: I-genome ayiguquguquki kodwa i-proteome iyashintshashintsha njengoba izicubu ezahlukene zinezakhi zofuzo ezifanayo kodwa ziveza izakhi zofuzo ezahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zihambisana nezakhi zofuzo.
question42: Bheka uMfanekiso 17.16. Ukuhlolwa okuxubile okubili, njengoba kuboniswe esithombeni, kudlale indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ama-microarray amaprotheni asetshenziswa ekuhlaziyweni kwe-proteomic. Cabanga ngenqubo eboniswe ukubikezela ukuthi imephu ye-proteomic ye-genome yomuntu ingasiza kanjani ekutholeni ikhambi lomdlavuza.
answer42: I-Proteomics ithola futhi idwebe ama-biomarker okubonakaliswa kwawo okuthintwa yinqubo yesifo.
distractor42a: Imephu ye-proteomic ingasiza ekuboneni izakhi zofuzo ezingamelana nembangela yomdlavuza.
distractor42b: I-Metabolomics enqunywe yimephu ye-proteomic ingasetshenziswa ukutadisha izakhi zofuzo ezikhiqiza ama-metabolites ngesikhathi somdlavuza.
distractor42c: Ukumapha kwe-proteomic kusiza ekuhlaziyeni amaphethini ofuzo abangela umdlavuza.
question43: Ngokusekelwe olwazini lwakho ngalesi sihloko, thola ukuthi yimiphi iminikelo elandelayo kwisayensi nobuchwepheshe eyenziwe ngokusebenzisa i-genomics yamagciwane.
answer43: Ukuhlolwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-microbial kube negalelo elikhulu ekukhiqizeni ama-antibiotic, ama-enzyme, imijovo ethuthukisiwe, ukwelashwa kwezifo, kanye namasu okuhlanza athuthukile.
distractor43a: I-genomics ye-microbial inikeze amathuluzi ahlukahlukene okutadisha ukuziphatha kwengqondo kwezinto eziphilayo.
distractor43b: I-genomics ye-microbial ibe negalelo ekumelaneni kwamanye amagciwane ngezindlela zokudlulisa izakhi zofuzo ezivundlile nezisemaceleni.
distractor43c: I-genomics ye-microbial ibe negalelo ezinqubweni ezithuthukiswe ukulwa nokufudumala komhlaba.
question44: Ekuhlukaniseni i-DNA ukuze kuhlaziywe izakhi zofuzo, hlola imiphumela engaba khona ye-RNA engcolisa isampula ngesikhathi sesinyathelo sokuhlaziywa kweseli. Yimiphi le miphumela, futhi yikuphi okufanele kucatshangelwe, uma kukhona, ekulungiseni inqubo?
answer44: I-DNA ayithinteki yi-RNA; akukho senzo sokulungisa esidingekayo.
distractor44a: I-DNA iyahlukana ibe yi-supernatant; akukho senzo sokulungisa esidingekayo.
distractor44b: I-DNA ibhujiswa yi-protease; i-RNA ne-DNA kumele zihlukaniswe ngesikhathi sesinyathelo sokususwa kweseli.
distractor44c: I-DNA ihlangana ne-RNA; i-RNA ne-DNA kumele zihlukaniswe ngesikhathi sesinyathelo sokususwa kweseli.
question45: Kunezindlela eziningi zokuphenya ngezifo zofuzo zabantu. I-Western blotting ifuna iphrotheni, i-Eastern blotting ifuna izinguquko zangemuva kokuhumusha, i-Northern blotting ibheka i-mRNA, kanye ne-Southern blotting ibheka i-DNA. Qhathanisa lo mehluko ukuze uphendule okulandelayo: Uma ubungabheka i-sickle cell anemia, isifo esithinta i-hemoglobin ekhiqizwa kumaseli abomvu egazi, iyiphi indlela engaba usizo kakhulu ekutholeni i-polymorphism kusampula?
question46: Inqwaba yezinambuzane yahlukaniswa ngokusemthethweni ngemibala exubile esifubeni nasemilenzeni yazo. Lesi sibalo sabonakala sihlukana ngokuhamba kwesikhathi saba amaqembu amancane amabili, anemilenze ensomi kanye nemilenze ephuzi. Abacwaningi bacabanga ukuthi iqembu elinemilenze ensomi lingase limelane kakhulu nobuthi be-Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis). Yimuphi inqubo yezinto eziphilayo esekela isimangalo sabo?
question47: Esikhundleni sokukhiqiza ikhophi eqondile yento ekhona—indlela esivame ukucabanga ngayo ngokuhlanganisa—ukubumbana kwama-molecule kukhiqiza izingcezu ze-genome eziqondile nezikhethiwe. Hlola izincazelo zezindlela ezihilelekile enkambisweni yokubumbana kwama-molecule bese ukhetha isifinyezo esinembile kakhulu.
answer47: I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-plasmid kuyasikwa nge-enzyme efanayo yokuvimbela bese i-DNA ifakwa ngaphakathi kwe-lacZ gene, umkhiqizo wayo oguqula i-lactose. I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-vector kuyavunyelwa ukuthi kuncishiswe. I-vector idluliselwa kumnikazi webhaktheriya ozwela i-ampicillin futhi labo abane-lacZ gene ephazamisekile babonisa ukungakwazi ukuguqula i-X-gal.
distractor47a: I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-plasmid kuyasuswa ngokusebenzisa ukushisa okuphezulu, bese i-DNA ifakwa ngaphakathi kwe-lacZ gene, umkhiqizo wayo oguqula i-glucose. I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-vector kuyavunyelwa ukuthi kuncishiswe. I-vector idluliselwa kumnikazi webhaktheriya ozwela i-ampicillin futhi i-lacZ gene ephazamisekile izoguqula i-X-gal.
distractor47b: I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-plasmid kuyasikwa nge-enzyme efanayo yokuvimbela bese i-DNA ifakwa ngokungahleliwe ku-plasmid. I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-vector kuyavunyelwa ukuthi ku-anneal. I-vector idluliselwa kumnikazi webhaktheriya ozwela i-ampicillin futhi i-lacZ gene ephazamisekile ikhombisa ukungakwazi ukukhiqiza i-X-gal.
distractor47c: I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-plasmid kuyasikwa nge-enzyme efanayo yokuvimbela bese i-DNA ifakwa ngaphakathi kwe-lacZ gene, umkhiqizo wayo oguqula i-lactose. I-DNA yangaphandle kanye ne-vector kuyavunyelwa ukuthi kuncishiswe. I-vector iguqulwa ibe yi-viral host ezwela i-ampicillin futhi i-lacZ gene ephazamisekile ikhombisa ukungakwazi ukukhiqiza i-X-gal.
question48: Bheka uMfanekiso 17.11.
